procedures.name_en: Registration of valuable items by departing residents for duty-free re-import (Customs Law 207/2020, Executive Regulation 430/2021)
procedures.name_zh: 离境居民贵重物品登记，供返国时免税带回（2020年第207号海关法、2021年第430号实施条例）
procedures.agency: Egyptian Customs Authority (مصلحة الجمارك المصرية), Ministry of Finance
procedures.applicability_en: Residents departing Egypt who wish to bring valuable items back into the country on a later return. To document those items for the returning-resident baggage treatment, the departing resident must record them on the form designated for this purpose ('على النموذج المعد لذلك'); the current official passengers page publishes no form number and no downloadable form. On return, the personal baggage previously recorded at departure on that form is included alongside new personal goods (e.g. gifts) up to EGP 15,000, with customs and other taxes due on new goods above that allowance; the new-goods exemption is granted at most twice per year with the passport holder present in person. The EGP 15,000 figure is the arriving new-goods allowance, not a threshold that triggers this registration. The page does not say unregistered valuables are prohibited from re-importation.
procedures.applicability_zh: 离境埃及、且希望日后返国时将贵重物品带回的居民。为使物品纳入返国居民行李待遇，离境居民须在为此指定的表格上（"على النموذج المعد لذلك"）证明/登记；现行官方旅客页未公布表号，也无表格下载。回国时，离境时已在上述表格登记的个人行李属于可带回行李；另有不超过15000埃镑的新个人物品（如礼品）免税额，新品超额部分征税；新品免税每年最多给予2次，且须护照持有人本人在场。15000埃镑为入境新品免税额度，并非触发本登记的金额门槛。该页未称未登记贵重品禁止返国带入。
procedures.timing_en: Before leaving Egypt, record the valuable items on the designated form for use when returning. The official page does not specify the exact counter or submission workflow.
procedures.timing_zh: 离埃前在指定表格上证明/登记贵重物品，以备返国时使用。官方页面未说明具体办理窗口或提交流程。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 離境居民貴重物品登記，供返國時免稅帶回（2020年第207號海關法、2021年第430號實施條例）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 離境埃及、且希望日後返國時將貴重物品帶回的居民。為使物品納入返國居民行李待遇，離境居民須在為此指定的表格上（"على النموذج المعد لذلك"）證明/登記；現行官方旅客頁未公佈表號，也無表格下載。回國時，離境時已在上述表格登記的個人行李屬於可帶回行李；另有不超過15000埃鎊的新個人物品（如禮品）免稅額，新品超額部分徵稅；新品免稅每年最多給予2次，且須護照持有人本人在場。15000埃鎊為入境新品免稅額度，並非觸發本登記的金額門檻。該頁未稱未登記貴重品禁止返國帶入。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 離埃前在指定表格上證明/登記貴重物品，以備返國時使用。官方頁面未說明具體辦理窗口或提交流程。

procedures.name_en: Customs declaration on entry of imported commercial papers, means of payment and financial instruments and, on departure, of the re-export of previously imported foreign-currency instruments or means of payment (declaration of devises)
procedures.name_zh: 入境携带商业票据、支付工具及金融工具及出境再携出先前带入外币票据/支付工具的海关申报（外币）
procedures.agency: Office des Changes (rule) — declaration subscribed with the customs services of the Administration des Douanes et Impôts Indirects (ADII)
procedures.applicability_en: Any person entering Morocco with commercial papers (effets de commerce), means of payment or financial instruments must subscribe a customs declaration when their value is equal to or above MAD 100,000; below MAD 100,000 the customs declaration is optional. The import declaration is valid for up to 1 month for residents and 6 months for non-residents and is annotated by the bank up to the amounts cashed; it must be presented to justify the origin of the funds, in particular on re-export of the devises, whatever the amount. On departure, foreign non-resident natural persons and Moroccans Resident Abroad (MRE) may export foreign-currency instruments or means of payment previously imported by them; this operation is subject to declaration to the border customs services and must be justified by the import declaration subscribed at entry. For MRE only, the 2025 ADII circular additionally makes the declaration obligatory at both entry and exit when the amount of foreign-currency instruments or means of payment is equal to or above the counter-value of MAD 100,000 (optional below), the declaration being kept to justify the origin of the means of payment exported at exit.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何人员入境摩洛哥时携带商业票据（effets de commerce）、支付工具或金融工具的，当其价值达到或超过10万迪拉姆时，必须办理海关申报；低于10万迪拉姆的，海关申报为自愿办理。入境申报单对居民有效期不超过1个月、对非居民不超过6个月，并由银行按已收款金额批注；该申报单须予出示以证明资金来源，特别是在再携出（复出口）外币时，无论金额大小。出境时，外国非居民自然人及旅居国外的摩洛哥人（MRE）可携出其本人先前带入摩洛哥的、以外币计价的票据或支付工具；该操作须向边境海关服务申报，并以入境时填写的申报单作为凭据。仅就MRE而言，2025年ADII通函另行规定：当外币计价的票据或支付工具金额达到或超过等值10万（100,000）迪拉姆时，入境与出境均必须申报（低于该金额可自愿申报），申报单须留存以在出境时证明所携出支付工具的来源。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, at the border: subscribe the declaration with the customs services at entry. During the stay, the bank annotates the declaration up to the amounts cashed. On departure, when re-exporting previously imported foreign-currency instruments or means of payment, foreign non-residents and MRE subscribe the declaration with the border customs services and produce the import declaration subscribed at entry.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达口岸入境时：入境即向海关服务申报。停留期间，申报单由银行按已收款金额批注。出境时，外国非居民与MRE再携出先前带入的外币票据或支付工具，向边境海关服务申报并出示入境时填写的申报单。

fee.note: Unknown for 2026: no currently readable official source states any fee, tax or charge for this customs declaration. The former ADII page (articleId=51901) that supported the baseline fee of MAD 0 now returns 'Request Rejected' and could not be re-read this round; do not reuse the old figure without re-verification.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境攜帶商業票據、支付工具及金融工具及出境再攜出先前帶入外幣票據/支付工具的海關申報（外幣）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何人員入境摩洛哥時攜帶商業票據（effets de commerce）、支付工具或金融工具的，當其價值達到或超過10萬迪拉姆時，必須辦理海關申報；低於10萬迪拉姆的，海關申報為自願辦理。入境申報單對居民有效期不超過1個月、對非居民不超過6個月，並由銀行按已收款金額批註；該申報單須予出示以證明資金來源，特別是在再攜出（復出口）外幣時，無論金額大小。出境時，外國非居民自然人及旅居國外的摩洛哥人（MRE）可攜出其本人先前帶入摩洛哥的、以外幣計價的票據或支付工具；該操作須向邊境海關服務申報，並以入境時填寫的申報單作為憑據。僅就MRE而言，2025年ADII通函另行規定：當外幣計價的票據或支付工具金額達到或超過等值10萬（100,000）迪拉姆時，入境與出境均必須申報（低於該金額可自願申報），申報單須留存以在出境時證明所攜出支付工具的來源。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達口岸入境時：入境即向海關服務申報。停留期間，申報單由銀行按已收款金額批註。出境時，外國非居民與MRE再攜出先前帶入的外幣票據或支付工具，向邊境海關服務申報並出示入境時填寫的申報單。

procedures.name_en: Disclosure of cross-border currency and bearer negotiable instruments to Customs on entry and exit
procedures.name_zh: 入境或离开苏丹时向海关申报跨境携带的货币及无记名可转让金融工具
procedures.agency: Sudan Customs authorities (سلطات الجمارك) under Article 31 of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2014; disclosure amounts are set by regulations — per CBOS Policies Administration Circular No. 33/2022, rules issued by the Customs Authority (هيئة الجمارك) and the Financial Intelligence Unit (وحدة المعلومات المالية)
procedures.applicability_en: Every natural person entering or leaving Sudan must disclose to the Customs authorities the currencies or bearer negotiable instruments in their possession which are to be transported physically across the border (Article 31(1)); "physical cross-border transportation" covers carriage by the person, in accompanying baggage or a vehicle, shipment in containers, and sending by mail (Article 3 definition). The duty attaches at the amounts that regulations specify — وتحدد اللوائح المبالغ اللازمة للإفصاح — and the 2014 Act itself contains no numeric threshold, so this procedure is conditional on reaching a regulation-specified amount that no official source read identifies: neither assume that every amount triggers it nor invent a threshold such as USD 10,000. CBOS Policies Administration Circular No. 33/2022 (14 November 2022, repealing Circular No. 7/2001 of 21 May 2001) confirms that foreign-currency cash carried by travellers (natural persons) and control of its entry and exit at airports and land/sea ports are governed by regulations and controls issued by the Customs Authority and the Financial Intelligence Unit, likewise without any figure. Non-disclosure counts as "false disclosure" (Article 3 definition); on false disclosure Customs may demand additional information on the source and intended use of the funds (Article 31(2)), may seize part or all of the currency or instruments on suspicion of money laundering or terrorism financing, or on false disclosure (Article 32), and must refer the information plus a copy of the disclosure form to the Financial Intelligence Unit (Article 31(3)); violating Article 31 is punished with a fine equal to double the amount subject to the disclosure (penalties article). Legal basis: the AML/CFT Act 2014 as published by the Central Bank of Sudan; by its Article 2 it repeals the AML/CFT Act 2010 (that Act's regulations, procedures and decisions remain in force until repealed or amended), so the 2010 Act must not be cited as current law. This record covers Sudan (SD) only, not South Sudan (SS); bank foreign-currency sale limits (e.g., USD 3,000) are domestic FX transaction limits, not border declaration thresholds.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每一自然人入境或离开苏丹时，必须向海关当局申报其持有的、拟实体跨境运输的货币或无记名可转让金融工具（第31条第(1)款）；「实体跨境运输」包括本人随身携带、置于随行行李或车辆中、以集装箱货运以及邮寄（第3条定义）。该义务仅适用于条例规定的金额——«وتحدد اللوائح المبالغ اللازمة للإفصاح»（申报所需金额由条例确定）——而2014年法律本身未设任何数字门槛，故本程序以达到条例规定金额为条件，且所读官方来源均未载明该金额：既不可认定任何金额均触发申报，也不得虚构诸如10,000美元的门槛。苏丹中央银行政策管理局2022年第33号通知（2022年11月14日，废止2001年5月21日第7/2001号通知）确认：旅客（自然人）携带外币现金及其经机场与陆、海口岸的进出管制，由海关总局与金融情报单位发布的条例和规章调整，同样未给出数额。未申报即构成「虚假申报」（第3条定义）；虚假申报时海关可要求补充说明资金来源与用途（第31条第(2)款），可因涉嫌洗钱、恐怖融资或虚假申报而扣押部分或全部货币或工具（第32条），并须将信息连同申报表副本移送金融情报单位（第31条第(3)款）；违反第31条者处以相当于申报标的金额两倍的罚款（罚则条款）。法律依据：苏丹中央银行公布的2014年《反洗钱和恐怖主义融资法》；依其第2条废止2010年同名法律（该法的条例、程序和决定在依本法修改或废止前继续有效），故不得将2010年法律引为现行法。本记录仅覆盖苏丹（SD），不涉及南苏丹（SS）；银行外币售卖限额（如3,000美元）属境内外汇交易限制，不是边境申报门槛。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entering or leaving Sudan, made to the Customs authorities at the border (airports and land/sea ports per CBOS Circular No. 33/2022), using a disclosure form — Article 31(3) shows a form exists, since Customs must refer a copy of it to the Financial Intelligence Unit — but the form itself and where to obtain it are not identified in the official sources read (see unresolved item sd-cash-disclosure-amount-and-form).
procedures.timing_zh: 于入境或离开苏丹之时，在边境（依苏丹央行2022年第33号通知，为机场及陆、海口岸）向海关当局申报，并使用申报表——第31条第(3)款表明申报表确实存在，因海关须将其副本移送金融情报单位——但该表格本身及获取渠道未见于所读官方来源（见未决项 sd-cash-disclosure-amount-and-form）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境或離開蘇丹時向海關申報跨境攜帶的貨幣及無記名可轉讓金融工具
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每一自然人入境或離開蘇丹時，必須向海關當局申報其持有的、擬實體跨境運輸的貨幣或無記名可轉讓金融工具（第31條第(1)款）；「實體跨境運輸」包括本人隨身攜帶、置於隨行行李或車輛中、以集裝箱貨運以及郵寄（第3條定義）。該義務僅適用於條例規定的金額——«وتحدد اللوائح المبالغ اللازمة للإفصاح»（申報所需金額由條例確定）——而2014年法律本身未設任何數字門檻，故本程序以達到條例規定金額為條件，且所讀官方來源均未載明該金額：既不可認定任何金額均觸發申報，也不得虛構諸如10,000美元的門檻。蘇丹中央銀行政策管理局2022年第33號通知（2022年11月14日，廢止2001年5月21日第7/2001號通知）確認：旅客（自然人）攜帶外幣現金及其經機場與陸、海口岸的進出管制，由海關總局與金融情報單位發佈的條例和規章調整，同樣未給出數額。未申報即構成「虛假申報」（第3條定義）；虛假申報時海關可要求補充說明資金來源與用途（第31條第(2)款），可因涉嫌洗錢、恐怖融資或虛假申報而扣押部分或全部貨幣或工具（第32條），並須將資訊連同申報表副本移送金融情報單位（第31條第(3)款）；違反第31條者處以相當於申報標的金額兩倍的罰款（罰則條款）。法律依據：蘇丹中央銀行公佈的2014年《反洗錢和恐怖主義融資法》；依其第2條廢止2010年同名法律（該法的條例、程序和決定在依本法修改或廢止前繼續有效），故不得將2010年法律引為現行法。本記錄僅覆蓋蘇丹（SD），不涉及南蘇丹（SS）；銀行外幣售賣限額（如3,000美元）屬境內外匯交易限制，不是邊境申報門檻。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於入境或離開蘇丹之時，在邊境（依蘇丹央行2022年第33號通知，為機場及陸、海口岸）向海關當局申報，並使用申報表——第31條第(3)款表明申報表確實存在，因海關須將其副本移送金融情報單位——但該表格本身及獲取渠道未見於所讀官方來源（見未決項 sd-cash-disclosure-amount-and-form）。

procedures.name_en: Currency declaration at entry/exit/transit (déclaration de devises)
procedures.name_zh: 入境/出境/过境货币申报（外币申报）
procedures.agency: Direction Générale de la Douane (Tunisie)
procedures.applicability_en: Any import, export or transit of currency valued at or above the equivalent of TND 20,000 must be declared to customs (Finance Minister decree of 24 July 2019 amending the 2016 decree under Law 2015-26). Non-residents who want to re-export more than TND 5,000 equivalent of imported banknotes must have filed a customs-stamped import declaration at entry; re-export of more than TND 30,000 equivalent must go through authorised banks.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境、出境或过境携带价值达到或超过2万第纳尔等值的外汇必须向海关申报（2019年7月24日财政部令修订2016年令，依据2015年第2015-26号法律）。非居民若想复出境超过5000第纳尔等值的入境外币现钞，须在入境时填报经海关签章的进口申报单；复出境超过3万第纳尔等值须通过授权银行办理。
procedures.timing_en: The online module covers declaration of currencies carried on entry into Tunisia only (per the official module description); exit and transit declarations are made at the customs counter. A declaration of currencies actually made on return to Tunisia is subject to a TND 10 fiscal stamp whatever the declared amount (due only when such a declaration is made; not a charge on all travellers). The import declaration is valid for 3 months from entry and a single use - it lapses on a second entry.
procedures.timing_zh: 在线模块仅用于申报入境突尼斯时携带的外汇（按官方模块描述仅限入境申报）；出境与过境申报在海关柜台办理。回突尼斯时实际办理外汇申报的，不论申报金额均需缴纳10第纳尔印花税（仅在作出该申报时缴纳，并非对所有旅客收取）。入境申报单自入境起3个月内有效、仅限一次使用，第二次入境即失效。

fee.note: fiscal stamp due only when a declaration of currencies is actually made on return to Tunisia, whatever the declared amount; not a charge on all travellers

procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境/出境/過境貨幣申報（外幣申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境、出境或過境攜帶價值達到或超過2萬第納爾等值的外匯必須向海關申報（2019年7月24日財政部令修訂2016年令，依據2015年第2015-26號法律）。非居民若想復出境超過5000第納爾等值的入境外幣現鈔，須在入境時填報經海關簽章的進口申報單；復出境超過3萬第納爾等值須通過授權銀行辦理。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 線上模塊僅用於申報入境突尼斯時攜帶的外匯（按官方模塊描述僅限入境申報）；出境與過境申報在海關櫃檯辦理。回突尼斯時實際辦理外匯申報的，不論申報金額均需繳納10第納爾印花稅（僅在作出該申報時繳納，並非對所有旅客收取）。入境申報單自入境起3個月內有效、僅限一次使用，第二次入境即失效。

procedures.name_en: Traveller cash declaration at border posts (foreign currencies and Burundian francs)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客在边境口岸办理的现金申报（外币与布隆迪法郎）
procedures.agency: Banque de la République du Burundi (BRB) — Article 13, Réglementation des changes du 28.12.2023; declaration lodged at border posts
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers either entering or leaving Burundi ("se rendant à ou venant de l'étranger") must declare cash at border posts on the form designed for that purpose only where the amount exceeds — strictly more than, not equal to — the applicable threshold: foreign-currency cash exceeding USD 10,000 or its equivalent in another currency; Burundian-franc banknotes exceeding BIF 200,000; Burundian-franc coins exceeding BIF 1,000. At exactly USD 10,000, BIF 200,000 in banknotes or BIF 1,000 in coins, Article 13 requires no declaration. On non-declaration, the amounts in excess are placed under conservatory seizure and deposited with the BRB; if the funds derive from a lawful operation they are returned to the owner subject to a retention of 25% of the seized sums; where the operation is suspicious, the funds remain seized and are returned only on the decision of a court or other competent authority. Legal basis: Article 13 of the BRB foreign-exchange regulation signed at Bujumbura on 28 December 2023; under its Article 100 the regulation enters into force upon publication in the Official Bulletin and on the BRB website, repealing earlier contrary provisions, and the BRB legal-texts index retrieved on 2026-09-27 still lists it as the current foreign-exchange regulation (revision of the 17 September 2019 regulation); no specific Official Bulletin publication date is evidenced in the sources read.
procedures.applicability_zh: 进入或离开布隆迪的旅客（« se rendant à ou venant de l'étranger »）仅在现金金额超过——严格大于、不含本数——相应阈值时，须在边境口岸以专设表格申报：外币现金超过 10,000 美元或等值其他货币；布隆迪法郎纸币超过 200,000 布隆迪法郎；布隆迪法郎硬币超过 1,000 布隆迪法郎。恰好等于 10,000 美元、200,000 布隆迪法郎（纸币）或 1,000 布隆迪法郎（硬币）时，第 13 条不要求申报。未申报的，超限金额予以保全性扣押并存入布隆迪共和国银行（BRB）；资金属合法交易的，扣减被扣押金额的 25% 后发还所有人；涉嫌可疑交易的，资金继续扣押，仅凭法院或其他有权机关的决定发还。法律依据：2023 年 12 月 28 日于布琼布拉签署的 BRB《外汇管理条例》第 13 条；依其第 100 条，条例自在官方公报及 BRB 网站公布之日起生效并废止此前相抵触条款，2026-09-27 检索的 BRB 法律文本索引仍将其列为现行外汇条例（对 2019 年 9 月 17 日条例的修订版）；所读来源未载明官方公报的具体公布日期。
procedures.timing_en: At the border post, on entering or leaving Burundi, using the form designed for this purpose ("suivant le formulaire conçu à cet effet"); the exact form copy and where to obtain it are not identified in the sources read (see unresolved item bi-cash-declaration-form-not-sourced).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或出境时在边境口岸以专设表格（« suivant le formulaire conçu à cet effet »）申报；所读来源未载明该表格的具体样式与获取渠道（见未决项 bi-cash-declaration-form-not-sourced）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客在邊境口岸辦理的現金申報（外幣與布隆迪法郎）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 進入或離開布隆迪的旅客（« se rendant à ou venant de l'étranger »）僅在現金金額超過——嚴格大於、不含本數——相應閾值時，須在邊境口岸以專設表格申報：外幣現金超過 10,000 美元或等值其他貨幣；布隆迪法郎紙幣超過 200,000 布隆迪法郎；布隆迪法郎硬幣超過 1,000 布隆迪法郎。恰好等於 10,000 美元、200,000 布隆迪法郎（紙幣）或 1,000 布隆迪法郎（硬幣）時，第 13 條不要求申報。未申報的，超限金額予以保全性扣押並存入布隆迪共和國銀行（BRB）；資金屬合法交易的，扣減被扣押金額的 25% 後發還所有人；涉嫌可疑交易的，資金繼續扣押，僅憑法院或其他有權機關的決定發還。法律依據：2023 年 12 月 28 日於布瓊布拉簽署的 BRB《外匯管理條例》第 13 條；依其第 100 條，條例自在官方公報及 BRB 網站公佈之日起生效並廢止此前相牴觸條款，2026-09-27 檢索的 BRB 法律文本索引仍將其列為現行外匯條例（對 2019 年 9 月 17 日條例的修訂版）；所讀來源未載明官方公報的具體公佈日期。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或出境時在邊境口岸以專設表格（« suivant le formulaire conçu à cet effet »）申報；所讀來源未載明該表格的具體樣式與獲取渠道（見未決項 bi-cash-declaration-form-not-sourced）。

procedures.name_en: Traveler goods and baggage declaration at Comorian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 科摩罗海关旅客货物及行李申报
procedures.agency: Douane Comorienne (2024 traveler-control order issued by the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Banking Sector)
procedures.applicability_en: Under Arrêté No. 24-08/MFBSB/CAB of 3 May 2024, Article 3, travelers arriving in or departing from the Union of the Comoros report to customs and make the prescribed declaration to an officer for goods, baggage or a conveyance in their possession or control. Article 17 permits travelers to declare non-commercial goods verbally, including certain unaccompanied baggage. Article 6 allows a green lane at airports and ports for travelers with nothing to declare and a red lane for those who must declare goods. The Customs website describes a written arrival declaration stating nature, quantity and value, but it must be read with the order and its personal-effects franchise in Article 19; it does not prove that every personal effect or a traveler with nothing to declare requires a written form.
procedures.applicability_zh: 根据科摩罗财政、预算与银行业部2024年5月3日第24-08/MFBSB/CAB号部长令第3条，入境或离境旅客须向海关报到，并按规定形式向海关人员申报其持有或控制的货物、行李或交通工具。第17条允许旅客对非商业货物作口头申报，符合条件的非随身行李亦可口头申报。第6条允许机场和港口设置绿通道供无须申报者使用、红通道供须申报货物者使用。海关网站概述称入境书面申报需说明物品性质、数量和价值；但须与部长令及第19条个人物品临时免税规定合读，不能据此断言每件个人物品或无申报物品的旅客都必须填写书面表格。
procedures.timing_en: At entry or exit, report to the customs office and declare goods, baggage or conveyance in the prescribed manner when required; the generic site calls the arrival declaration written, while Article 17 expressly permits oral declaration for non-commercial goods. At ports and airports, use the red lane for goods to declare and green lane if there is nothing to declare. The exact form URL and whether any particular personal effect needs a form remain unresolved.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或离境时到海关办事处报到，并在需要时按规定方式申报货物、行李或交通工具；官网概述称入境货物申报为书面形式，但第17条明确允许非商业货物口头申报。机场及港口对须申报货物者设红通道、无须申报者设绿通道。具体表格链接及特定个人物品是否需要表格仍待核实。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 科摩羅海關旅客貨物及行李申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 根據科摩羅財政、預算與銀行業部2024年5月3日第24-08/MFBSB/CAB號部長令第3條，入境或離境旅客須向海關報到，並按規定形式向海關人員申報其持有或控制的貨物、行李或交通工具。第17條允許旅客對非商業貨物作口頭申報，符合條件的非隨身行李亦可口頭申報。第6條允許機場和港口設置綠通道供無須申報者使用、紅通道供須申報貨物者使用。海關網站概述稱入境書面申報需說明物品性質、數量和價值；但須與部長令及第19條個人物品臨時免稅規定合讀，不能據此斷言每件個人物品或無申報物品的旅客都必須填寫書面表格。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或離境時到海關辦事處報到，並在需要時按規定方式申報貨物、行李或交通工具；官網概述稱入境貨物申報為書面形式，但第17條明確允許非商業貨物口頭申報。機場及港口對須申報貨物者設紅通道、無須申報者設綠通道。具體表格連結及特定個人物品是否需要表格仍待核實。

procedures.name_en: Adult traveler declaration of cash, bearer instruments, precious metals or stones above 1,500,000 francs
procedures.name_zh: 成年旅客携现金、无记名票据、贵金属或宝石总值超过1,500,000“francs”申报
procedures.agency: Douane Comorienne (2024 traveler-control order issued by the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Banking Sector)
procedures.applicability_en: Article 26 of Arrêté No. 24-08/MFBSB/CAB requires an adult traveler entering or leaving the Union of the Comoros to declare to Customs cash (espèces), bearer instruments (instruments au porteur), precious metals or precious stones when their total value is strictly greater than 1,500,000 francs per adult. At exactly 1,500,000 francs the Article 26 threshold is not exceeded. The order says only “francs”; this record does not substitute an ISO currency code or a conversion. A separate rule for minors was not found.
procedures.applicability_zh: 第24-08/MFBSB/CAB号部长令第26条规定，入境或离境的成年旅客携带现金、无记名票据、贵金属或宝石，总价值按每名成年人严格超过1,500,000“francs”时，须向海关申报。恰为1,500,000“francs”不超过该条门槛。原文仅写“francs”，本记录不自行换成ISO币种代码或折算金额；尚未找到未成年旅客的对应规则。
procedures.timing_en: Declare to Comorian Customs when entering or leaving with the listed assets above the Article 26 total-value threshold.
procedures.timing_zh: 携上述资产总值超过第26条门槛入境或离境时向科摩罗海关申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 成年旅客攜現金、無記名票據、貴金屬或寶石總值超過1,500,000“francs”申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 第24-08/MFBSB/CAB號部長令第26條規定，入境或離境的成年旅客攜帶現金、無記名票據、貴金屬或寶石，總價值按每名成年人嚴格超過1,500,000“francs”時，須向海關申報。恰為1,500,000“francs”不超過該條門檻。原文僅寫“francs”，本記錄不自行換成ISO幣種代碼或折算金額；尚未找到未成年旅客的對應規則。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 攜上述資產總值超過第26條門檻入境或離境時向科摩羅海關申報。

procedures.name_en: Traveller baggage and currency declaration (Voyageurs)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客行李与货币申报
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI), Djibouti
procedures.applicability_en: All travellers arriving in Djibouti must declare the goods they carry and pay the corresponding duties and taxes; the traveller must declare goods in detail, declare currencies and negotiable bearer instruments (cheques, bank cards), and pay duties owed. The page lists import quantity limits without stating a duty exemption for these lines: 1 carton of cigarettes, one 1 L bottle of alcohol, one flask of perfume or toilet water; medicines for personal use allowed with a medical prescription. Carrying goods within these limits is not stated to be duty-free — the traveller's duty to declare and pay corresponding duties and taxes stands. Physical transport of cash of an amount equal to or above 1,000,000 FD (equivalent to USD 5,618) must be declared and automatically justified to the customs authorities by the carrier.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有抵达吉布提的旅客须申报所运货物并缴纳相应税费；旅客须详细申报所携带货物、申报外币和不记名可转让票据（支票、银行卡等）并缴纳税费。官网对以下品目只列了可携带/进口数量限制，并未声明免税：香烟一条、1升装烈酒一瓶、香水或化妆水一瓶；自用药品凭医嘱允许携带。在此数量内携带不等于免税——申报并缴纳相应税费的义务不变。携带等于或超过100万吉布提法郎（等值5618美元）的现金实物出入境，携带人必须向海关当局申报并自动说明来源。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival on Djibouti soil; a downloadable declaration form (formulaire.pdf) is linked from the official travellers page. The customs website also lists an e-service 'Déclaration d'espèces' under E-Services.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达吉布提时办理；官网旅客页提供可下载的申报表（formulaire.pdf）。海关网站 E-Services 菜单下还列有现金申报电子服务（Déclaration d'espèces）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客行李與貨幣申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有抵達吉布提的旅客須申報所運貨物並繳納相應稅費；旅客須詳細申報所攜帶貨物、申報外幣和不記名可轉讓票據（支票、銀行卡等）並繳納稅費。官網對以下品目只列了可攜帶/進口數量限制，並未聲明免稅：香菸一條、1升裝烈酒一瓶、香水或化妝水一瓶；自用藥品憑醫囑允許攜帶。在此數量內攜帶不等於免稅——申報並繳納相應稅費的義務不變。攜帶等於或超過100萬吉布提法郎（等值5618美元）的現金實物出入境，攜帶人必須向海關當局申報並自動說明來源。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達吉布提時辦理；官網旅客頁提供可下載的申報表（formulaire.pdf）。海關網站 E-Services 菜單下還列有現金申報電子服務（Déclaration d'espèces）。

procedures.name_en: Declaration to Eritrean Customs of foreign currency strictly exceeding USD 10,000 (or equivalent) carried by travelers arriving into or departing from Eritrea
procedures.name_zh: 抵达或离开厄立特里亚的旅客申报严格超过一万（10,000）美元或等值外币
procedures.agency: Eritrean Customs Officers at the port of entry or departure in Eritrea, on declaration forms prepared by the Bank of Eritrea (Proclamation No. 173/2013, Article 6)
procedures.applicability_en: Proclamation No. 173/2013 (Government of Eritrea, Gazette of Eritrean Laws Vol.21/2013 No.1, Asmara, 20 February 2013), Article 6: there is no limitation on the amount of foreign currency travelers may bring into or take out from Eritrea, but where the amount they bring into or take out EXCEEDS US Dollars ten thousand (10,000) or its equivalent in other convertible currencies, they must complete a declaration form prepared by the Bank of Eritrea and submit the same to Eritrean Customs Officers at the port of entry or departure. The threshold is strict: only amounts above USD 10,000 equivalent trigger the declaration; carrying exactly USD 10,000 does not. The duty is conditional and applies in BOTH directions (arriving into and departing from Eritrea) to convertible foreign currency; Article 6 does not cover bearer negotiable instruments, and must not be inferred to cover goods or personal electronics (see unresolved er-goods-electronics-primary-source). The July 2025 ESAAMLG mutual evaluation independently reports Eritrea still implements this Article 6 written incoming/outgoing declaration above USD 10,000 and that bearer negotiable instruments, mail and cargo are not covered — that report is currentness corroboration, not Eritrean law. Article 7(3): bringing into or taking out of Eritrea foreign currency exceeding USD 10,000 equivalent without completing and submitting the declaration form is punishable, upon conviction by the competent civil court, in addition to confiscation of the money, with simple imprisonment (10 days up to three years) or a fine not exceeding 50,000 Nakfa. Article 2 repeals and replaces Legal Notices 101/2005 and 102/2005, which must not be cited as current law. Article 8: the Proclamation entered into force on Gazette publication, i.e. 20 February 2013. A UK FCDO advice page says '10,000 US dollars or more', which conflicts with the Gazette at exactly USD 10,000; the Government of Eritrea Gazette is the primary source and controls — FCDO is not used to support this procedure.
procedures.applicability_zh: 《第173/2013号公告》（厄立特里亚政府《厄立特里亚法律公报》2013年第21卷第1期，阿斯马拉，2013年2月20日）第6条：对旅客携入或携出厄立特里亚的外币金额不设限制，但携入或携出金额「超过」一万（10,000）美元或其等值其他可兑换货币时，须填写厄立特里亚银行制作的申报表，并在厄立特里亚的入境或出境口岸提交给厄立特里亚海关官员。门槛为严格标准：仅高于10,000美元等值的金额触发申报；恰为10,000美元不触发。该义务为附条件义务，适用于入境与出境两个方向的可兑换外币；第6条不涵盖无记名可转让金融工具，亦不得推定涵盖货物或个人电子产品（见未决项 er-goods-electronics-primary-source）。2025年7月ESAAMLG互评估独立报告：厄立特里亚仍在执行第6条超过10,000美元的入出境书面申报制度，且无记名可转让金融工具及邮寄、货运不在覆盖范围内——该报告属时效性佐证，非厄立特里亚法律。第7条第(3)款：携入或携出超过10,000美元等值外币而未填写并向海关官员提交申报表的，经有管辖权的民事法院定罪，除没收该款项外，处简单监禁（10日至3年）或不超过五万（50,000）纳克法的罚款。第2条废止并替代第101/2005号及第102/2005号法律通告，二者不得再引为现行法。第8条：本公告自公报公布之日起生效，即2013年2月20日。英国FCDO旅行建议称「10,000美元或以上」，在恰为10,000美元时与公报冲突；厄立特里亚政府公报为原始法律渊源并优先适用——FCDO不用于支持本程序。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of arrival into or departure from Eritrea, at the port of entry or departure, by submitting the completed Bank of Eritrea declaration form to Eritrean Customs Officers (Article 6). The form itself was not located in any official publication (see unresolved er-boe-declaration-form-and-amendments); ESAAMLG's July 2025 evaluation confirms travellers submit the written declaration form to Eritrean Customs officers.
procedures.timing_zh: 于抵达或离开厄立特里亚之时，在入境或出境口岸，向厄立特里亚海关官员提交填写完成的厄立特里亚银行申报表（第6条）。该表格本身未见于任何官方出版物（见未决项 er-boe-declaration-form-and-amendments）；ESAAMLG 2025年7月评估确认旅客向厄立特里亚海关官员提交书面申报表。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達或離開厄立特里亞的旅客申報嚴格超過一萬（10,000）美元或等值外幣
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 《第173/2013號公告》（厄立特里亞政府《厄立特里亞法律公報》2013年第21卷第1期，阿斯馬拉，2013年2月20日）第6條：對旅客攜入或攜出厄立特里亞的外幣金額不設限制，但攜入或攜出金額「超過」一萬（10,000）美元或其等值其他可兌換貨幣時，須填寫厄立特里亞銀行製作的申報表，並在厄立特里亞的入境或出境口岸提交給厄立特里亞海關官員。門檻為嚴格標準：僅高於10,000美元等值的金額觸發申報；恰為10,000美元不觸發。該義務為附條件義務，適用於入境與出境兩個方向的可兌換外幣；第6條不涵蓋無記名可轉讓金融工具，亦不得推定涵蓋貨物或個人電子產品（見未決項 er-goods-electronics-primary-source）。2025年7月ESAAMLG互評估獨立報告：厄立特里亞仍在執行第6條超過10,000美元的入出境書面申報制度，且無記名可轉讓金融工具及郵寄、貨運不在覆蓋範圍內——該報告屬時效性佐證，非厄立特里亞法律。第7條第(3)款：攜入或攜出超過10,000美元等值外幣而未填寫並向海關官員提交申報表的，經有管轄權的民事法院定罪，除沒收該款項外，處簡單監禁（10日至3年）或不超過五萬（50,000）納克法的罰款。第2條廢止並替代第101/2005號及第102/2005號法律通告，二者不得再引為現行法。第8條：本公告自公報公佈之日起生效，即2013年2月20日。英國FCDO旅行建議稱「10,000美元或以上」，在恰為10,000美元時與公報衝突；厄立特里亞政府公報為原始法律淵源並優先適用——FCDO不用於支持本程序。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於抵達或離開厄立特里亞之時，在入境或出境口岸，向厄立特里亞海關官員提交填寫完成的厄立特里亞銀行申報表（第6條）。該表格本身未見於任何官方出版物（見未決項 er-boe-declaration-form-and-amendments）；ESAAMLG 2025年7月評估確認旅客向厄立特里亞海關官員提交書面申報表。

procedures.name_en: TAAF visa when required
procedures.name_zh: 法属南部领地条件性签证
procedures.agency: Administration supérieure des Terres australes et antarctiques françaises (TAAF) — binding accord of the administrateur supérieur; visa then issued by French embassies/consulates or, for residents of metropolitan France, by the prefecture
procedures.applicability_en: Foreign nationals entering the Terres australes et antarctiques françaises (here the îles Australes — Crozet, Kerguelen, Saint-Paul, Amsterdam — and the îles Éparses). The TAAF are pays et territoires d'outre-mer situated outside the European Union and outside the Schengen area, so this regime is separate from metropolitan-French/Schengen visa rules. Under article L. 367-1 of the Code de l'entrée et du séjour des étrangers et du droit d'asile (completed by ordonnance no. 2020-1733 of 16 December 2020) and law no. 71-569 of 15 July 1971 (title II), every foreigner entering the TAAF must hold the documents and visas required by the international conventions and regulations in force; the dedicated TAAF visa page asks 'Avez-vous besoin d'un visa ?' and a visa is issued only 'lorsqu'un visa est requis' — the Australes and Éparses access pages' blanket wording that any foreign national must beforehand have obtained a visa under law no. 71-569 cannot be read as proof that every nationality absolutely requires one (exemption list unpublished, see unresolved). Two-step procedure: (1) the accord of the administrateur supérieur des TAAF must be requested at least two months before the date of arrival on the territory (the diplomatic or consular authority may seek a reduction of this delay in urgent situations); the administrateur supérieur sets the duration and conditions of stay, and this accord is binding on the authority issuing the visa; (2) after that accord, the visa application is made at the embassies or consulates of the applicant's country of residence; residents of metropolitan France apply at the préfecture of their département of residence, and non-resident foreigners holding a Schengen visa may apply for an extension of it at the metropolitan préfecture where they are temporarily staying. TAAF publishes dedicated application forms (scientific, Australes, Éparses; French and English versions). The chapter does not apply to diplomatic agents and career consuls.
procedures.applicability_zh: 进入法属南部和南极领地（本卡指南方群岛——克罗泽、凯尔盖朗、圣保罗、阿姆斯特丹——及离散群岛）的外国公民。TAAF 为海外领地（PTOM），位于欧盟与申根区之外，故此制度与法国本土/申根签证分开。依《外国人入境、居留与庇护法典》L. 367-1 条（经 2020 年 12 月 16 日第 2020-1733 号条例补充）及 1971 年 7 月 15 日第 71-569 号法律（第二编），任何外国人进入 TAAF 须持国际公约和现行条例所要求的证件与签证；TAAF 签证专页即设问“是否需要签证？”，并明文“当需要签证时”方予签发——南方群岛与离散群岛页面“任何外国公民须事先取得签证”的笼统表述不能读作所有国籍绝对必办（豁免清单未公布，见未决项）。两步程序：(1) 须至少在抵达日期前两个月申请 TAAF 高级行政长官的同意（外交或领事机关可在紧急情况下请求缩短该期限）；高级行政长官确定停留期限与条件，该同意对签证签发机关具有约束力；(2) 获同意后，向居住国使领馆申请签证；法国本土居民向其居住省的省政府（préfecture）申请，持申根签证的非居民外国人可向其临时所在地的法国本土省政府申请签证延期。TAAF 公布专用申请表（科研、南方群岛、离散群岛；法文/英文）。该章不适用于外交人员与职业领事。
procedures.timing_en: The accord of the administrateur supérieur must be requested at least two months before the arrival date (reducible in urgent situations at the request of the diplomatic or consular authority); the visa itself is then issued by the competent embassy/consulate or prefecture.
procedures.timing_zh: 须至少在抵达日期前两个月申请高级行政长官的同意（紧急情况下经外交或领事机关请求可缩短）；签证随后由有管辖权的使领馆或法国本土省政府签发。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 法屬南部領地條件性簽證
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 進入法屬南部和南極領地（本卡指南方群島——克羅澤、凱爾蓋朗、聖保羅、阿姆斯特丹——及離散群島）的外國公民。TAAF 為海外領地（PTOM），位於歐盟與申根區之外，故此制度與法國本土/申根簽證分開。依《外國人入境、居留與庇護法典》L. 367-1 條（經 2020 年 12 月 16 日第 2020-1733 號條例補充）及 1971 年 7 月 15 日第 71-569 號法律（第二編），任何外國人進入 TAAF 須持國際公約和現行條例所要求的證件與簽證；TAAF 簽證專頁即設問“是否需要簽證？”，並明文“當需要簽證時”方予簽發——南方群島與離散群島頁面“任何外國公民須事先取得簽證”的籠統表述不能讀作所有國籍絕對必辦（豁免清單未公佈，見未決項）。兩步程序：(1) 須至少在抵達日期前兩個月申請 TAAF 高級行政長官的同意（外交或領事機關可在緊急情況下請求縮短該期限）；高級行政長官確定停留期限與條件，該同意對簽證簽發機關具有約束力；(2) 獲同意後，向居住國使領館申請簽證；法國本土居民向其居住省的省政府（préfecture）申請，持申根簽證的非居民外國人可向其臨時所在地的法國本土省政府申請簽證延期。TAAF 公佈專用申請表（科研、南方群島、離散群島；法文/英文）。該章不適用於外交人員與職業領事。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 須至少在抵達日期前兩個月申請高級行政長官的同意（緊急情況下經外交或領事機關請求可縮短）；簽證隨後由有管轄權的使領館或法國本土省政府簽發。

procedures.name_en: Australes pleasure-craft mooring and access permit
procedures.name_zh: 南方群岛游艇停泊与登岛许可
procedures.agency: Administration supérieure des Terres australes et antarctiques françaises (TAAF, préfet administrateur supérieur)
procedures.applicability_en: Îles Australes only (Crozet, Kerguelen, Saint-Paul and Amsterdam) — not the îles Éparses and not the Antarctic area south of 60°S. The islands form a national nature reserve (decree no. 2006-1211 of 3 October 2006, as amended) inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list in July 2019; there is no ordinary tourist access. Mooring of pleasure craft in the territorial sea and access to the islands are very limited and strictly regulated: only in special, motivated circumstances can an exceptional request for mooring in the territorial sea around the archipelagos and for access to these islands by pleasure craft be addressed to the préfet administrateur supérieur des TAAF, using the activity-authorization forms 1–5 (AUST) published on taaf.fr. The 2026 general Form 1 ('FORMULAIRE DE DÉCLARATION OU DE DEMANDE D’AUTORISATION D’ACCES ET DE MISE EN ŒUVRE D’ACTIVITÉS DANS LES TERRES AUSTRALES FRANÇAISES ET LES ÎLES ÉPARSES' — the same official file the Australes and Éparses pages both link as Formulaire 1) asks for the applicant (demandeur) only as 'NOM Prénom, fonctions' plus 'organisme', i.e. a named individual with a function and/or an organization, and nowhere requires the applicant to be the vessel's master or owner, so no such restriction is recorded; it also carries the district checkboxes (Kerguelen, Crozet, Saint-Paul et Amsterdam, îles Éparses), the activity boxes 'Mouillage- stationnement' and 'Accès, débarquement sur les îles', and the number of persons involved. This is one dossier for the vessel/activity, not an entry card filed by each ordinary passenger; foreign nationals on board remain covered by the separate TAAF visa procedure. All movement ashore is subject to district-chief authorization and certain sites additionally require prior written authorization from the prefect; integral protection zones and sites reserved for scientific and technical research are closed (Saint-Paul island and its crater in their entirety, except express prefect authorization; on Amsterdam, landing only at La Cale). A mooring tax and a territorial stay tax are set by arrêté of the préfet administrateur supérieur (arrêté no. 2022-03 of 11 January 2022) and collected by the headquarters services before departure or, failing that, adjusted by the district chief; these are taxes on mooring and stay, not a form-processing fee (amounts not extracted, see unresolved).
procedures.applicability_zh: 仅适用南方群岛（克罗泽、凯尔盖朗、圣保罗、阿姆斯特丹）——不含离散群岛，也不含南纬 60 度以南的南极地区。诸岛为国家级自然保护区（2006 年 10 月 3 日第 2006-1211 号法令，经修改），2019 年 7 月列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产，无普通旅游准入。游艇在领海停泊及登岛极为有限且受严格管制：仅在特殊且有理由的情况下，才可就游艇在群岛周围领海停泊及登岛向 TAAF 高级行政长官（省长）提出例外申请，使用 taaf.fr 公布的第 1–5 号（AUST）活动许可表。2026 年总表1（表题直译《在法属南部领地与离散群岛进入并开展活动的申报或许可申请表》；Australes 页与 Éparses 页的 Formulaire 1 为同一官方深链）的“申请人信息”仅设“NOM Prénom, fonctions（姓名、职能）”与“organisme（所属机构）”栏，即具职能的具名个人和/或机构，并未要求申请人须为船长或船东，故此处不作该限定；表内另有辖区勾选（KERGUELEN、CROZET、SAINT-PAUL ET AMSTERDAM、ÎLES ÉPARSES）、“Mouillage- stationnement（停泊—驻留）”“Accès, débarquement sur les îles（进入、登上诸岛）”活动栏与“参与人数”栏。这是船舶/活动的一份卷宗，不是每名普通乘客分别填写的入境卡；船上外国公民仍适用另行分离的 TAAF 签证程序。一切上岸活动须经区长批准，部分地点还须省长事先书面许可；整体保护区及科研专用区禁止进入（圣保罗岛及其火山口全境，除省长明示许可外；阿姆斯特丹岛仅可在 La Cale 登陆）。停泊税与领地居留税由省长法令规定（2022 年 1 月 11 日第 2022-03 号法令），由总部部门出发前征收，或由区长补征/调整；此为停泊与居留税款，不是表格手续费（税额本轮未提取，见未决项）。
procedures.timing_en: The complete dossier in French (general Form 1 plus any complementary forms) must be sent to saji@taaf.fr, for the préfet administrateur supérieur, at least 2 months before the planned start date of the activity (processing may be longer where the scientific council of the relevant national nature reserve must be consulted); the mooring and stay taxes are collected by the headquarters services before departure (or adjusted by the district chief).
procedures.timing_zh: 完整法语卷宗（总表1及可能的补充表）须至少在预定活动开始日期前 2 个月寄至 saji@taaf.fr 呈省长（如须征询相关国家自然保护区科学委员会意见，办理期限可能更长）；停泊税与居留税由总部部门出发前征收（或由区长调整）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 南方群島遊艇停泊與登島許可
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 僅適用南方群島（克羅澤、凱爾蓋朗、聖保羅、阿姆斯特丹）——不含離散群島，也不含南緯 60 度以南的南極地區。諸島為國家級自然保護區（2006 年 10 月 3 日第 2006-1211 號法令，經修改），2019 年 7 月列入聯合國教科文組織世界遺產，無普通旅遊准入。遊艇在領海停泊及登島極為有限且受嚴格管制：僅在特殊且有理由的情況下，才可就遊艇在群島周圍領海停泊及登島向 TAAF 高級行政長官（省長）提出例外申請，使用 taaf.fr 公佈的第 1–5 號（AUST）活動許可表。2026 年總表1（表題直譯《在法屬南部領地與離散群島進入並開展活動的申報或許可申請表》；Australes 頁與 Éparses 頁的 Formulaire 1 為同一官方深鏈）的“申請人資訊”僅設“NOM Prénom, fonctions（姓名、職能）”與“organisme（所屬機構）”欄，即具職能的具名個人和/或機構，並未要求申請人須為船長或船東，故此處不作該限定；表內另有轄區勾選（KERGUELEN、CROZET、SAINT-PAUL ET AMSTERDAM、ÎLES ÉPARSES）、“Mouillage- stationnement（停泊—駐留）”“Accès, débarquement sur les îles（進入、登上諸島）”活動欄與“參與人數”欄。這是船舶/活動的一份卷宗，不是每名普通乘客分別填寫的入境卡；船上外國公民仍適用另行分離的 TAAF 簽證程序。一切上岸活動須經區長批准，部分地點還須省長事先書面許可；整體保護區及科研專用區禁止進入（聖保羅島及其火山口全境，除省長明示許可外；阿姆斯特丹島僅可在 La Cale 登陸）。停泊稅與領地居留稅由省長法令規定（2022 年 1 月 11 日第 2022-03 號法令），由總部部門出發前徵收，或由區長補徵/調整；此為停泊與居留稅款，不是表格手續費（稅額本輪未提取，見未決項）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 完整法語卷宗（總表1及可能的補充表）須至少在預定活動開始日期前 2 個月寄至 saji@taaf.fr 呈省長（如須徵詢相關國家自然保護區科學委員會意見，辦理期限可能更長）；停泊稅與居留稅由總部部門出發前徵收（或由區長調整）。

procedures.name_en: Éparses mooring and access permit
procedures.name_zh: 离散群岛停泊与登岛许可
procedures.agency: Administration supérieure des Terres australes et antarctiques françaises (TAAF, préfet administrateur supérieur)
procedures.applicability_en: Îles Éparses only (Europa, Bassas da India, Juan de Nova, Glorieuses, Tromelin) — not the îles Australes. Mooring in the territorial waters of the îles Éparses and access to the islands are subject to the prior authorization of the préfet administrateur supérieur des TAAF, together with prescriptions framing ecotourism activities (in particular arrêté no. 2014-39 of 25 March 2014); the request uses the activity-authorization forms 1–5 (IEP) published on taaf.fr. The 2026 general Form 1 ('FORMULAIRE DE DÉCLARATION OU DE DEMANDE D’AUTORISATION D’ACCES ET DE MISE EN ŒUVRE D’ACTIVITÉS DANS LES TERRES AUSTRALES FRANÇAISES ET LES ÎLES ÉPARSES') is the same file as the Australes general form and lists the ÎLES ÉPARSES district with the EUROPA, JUAN DE NOVA, BASSAS DA INDIA, TROMELIN and ARCHIPEL DES GLORIEUSES checkboxes; it asks for the applicant (demandeur) only as 'NOM Prénom, fonctions' plus 'organisme' — a named individual with a function and/or an organization — and nowhere requires the applicant to be the vessel's master or owner, so no such restriction is recorded; it covers 'Mouillage- stationnement' and 'Accès, débarquement sur les îles' and the number of persons involved. This is one dossier for the vessel/activity, not an entry card filed by each ordinary passenger; foreign nationals remain covered by the separate TAAF visa procedure. Any movement ashore is forbidden except with prior authorization of the préfet administrateur supérieur, and on Tromelin any disembarkation is impossible. A mooring tax and a territorial stay tax are set by arrêté of the préfet administrateur supérieur and collected by the headquarters services before departure — taxes, not a form-processing fee (amounts not extracted, see unresolved). Fishing is forbidden in the territorial sea around each island.
procedures.applicability_zh: 仅适用离散群岛（欧罗巴岛、印度巴萨岛、新胡安岛、格洛里厄斯群岛、特罗姆兰岛）——不含南方群岛。在离散群岛领海停泊及登岛须经 TAAF 高级行政长官（省长）事先许可，并遵守规范生态旅游活动的各项规定（尤其 2014 年 3 月 25 日第 2014-39 号法令）；申请使用 taaf.fr 公布的第 1–5 号（IEP）活动许可表。2026 年总表1与南方群岛页所链为同一官方文件，其辖区勾选含“ÎLES ÉPARSES（离散群岛）”及 EUROPA、JUAN DE NOVA、BASSAS DA INDIA、TROMELIN、ARCHIPEL DES GLORIEUSES 五岛；表上“申请人信息”仅设“NOM Prénom, fonctions（姓名、职能）”与“organisme（所属机构）”栏——具职能的具名个人和/或机构——并未要求申请人须为船长或船东，故此处不作该限定；表含“Mouillage- stationnement（停泊—驻留）”“Accès, débarquement sur les îles（进入、登上诸岛）”活动栏并要求填报参与人数。这是船舶/活动的一份卷宗，不是每名普通乘客分别填写的入境卡；外国公民仍适用另行分离的 TAAF 签证程序。一切上岸活动一律禁止，除非事先取得省长许可；特罗姆兰岛无法登陆。停泊税与领地居留税由省长法令规定，由总部部门出发前征收——此为税款，不是表格手续费（税额本轮未提取，见未决项）。各岛周围领海禁止捕鱼。
procedures.timing_en: The prior authorization of the préfet administrateur supérieur must be obtained before the voyage: the complete dossier in French (general Form 1 plus any complementary forms) is due at saji@taaf.fr at least 2 months before the planned start date of the activity; the mooring and stay taxes are collected by the headquarters services before departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 航行前须先取得省长事先许可：完整法语卷宗（总表1及可能的补充表）须至少在预定活动开始日期前 2 个月送达 saji@taaf.fr；停泊税与居留税由总部部门出发前征收。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 離散群島停泊與登島許可
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 僅適用離散群島（歐羅巴島、印度巴薩島、新胡安島、格洛裡厄斯群島、特羅姆蘭島）——不含南方群島。在離散群島領海停泊及登島須經 TAAF 高級行政長官（省長）事先許可，並遵守規範生態旅遊活動的各項規定（尤其 2014 年 3 月 25 日第 2014-39 號法令）；申請使用 taaf.fr 公佈的第 1–5 號（IEP）活動許可表。2026 年總表1與南方群島頁所鏈為同一官方文件，其轄區勾選含“ÎLES ÉPARSES（離散群島）”及 EUROPA、JUAN DE NOVA、BASSAS DA INDIA、TROMELIN、ARCHIPEL DES GLORIEUSES 五島；表上“申請人資訊”僅設“NOM Prénom, fonctions（姓名、職能）”與“organisme（所屬機構）”欄——具職能的具名個人和/或機構——並未要求申請人須為船長或船東，故此處不作該限定；表含“Mouillage- stationnement（停泊—駐留）”“Accès, débarquement sur les îles（進入、登上諸島）”活動欄並要求填報參與人數。這是船舶/活動的一份卷宗，不是每名普通乘客分別填寫的入境卡；外國公民仍適用另行分離的 TAAF 簽證程序。一切上岸活動一律禁止，除非事先取得省長許可；特羅姆蘭島無法登陸。停泊稅與領地居留稅由省長法令規定，由總部部門出發前徵收——此為稅款，不是表格手續費（稅額本輪未提取，見未決項）。各島周圍領海禁止捕魚。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 航行前須先取得省長事先許可：完整法語卷宗（總表1及可能的補充表）須至少在預定活動開始日期前 2 個月送達 saji@taaf.fr；停泊稅與居留稅由總部部門出發前徵收。

procedures.name_en: Passenger declaration (Form F88) and dual-channel clearance
procedures.name_zh: 旅客申报表（F88表）与双通道通关
procedures.agency: Kenya Revenue Authority — Customs & Border Control
procedures.applicability_en: Two distinct questions, which current KRA pages answer inconsistently — in part within a single page — are kept separate here: declaration of goods to customs, and completion of the specific Passenger Declaration Form (F88). Declaration to customs — unresolved within-page contradiction: the live KRA knowledge base (https://www.kra.go.ke/component/knowledge_base/category/5) corrects the misconception “Only new items exceeding USD 2,000 must be declared” with the clarification “All items brought into Kenya from a foreign/partner state must be declared to customs (including currencies and monetary instruments of more than $10,000)”, and its Step 2 states “A passenger arriving is required to make a declaration to customs of all personal items brought with him/her from abroad”; yet immediately below, under Personal Items, the same page states “Used personal items and effects are exempt from customs duties and do not need to be declared”. The page thus contradicts itself on whether used personal effects must be declared to customs; both wordings are juxtaposed and neither is resolved. Form F88 trigger — cross-page conflict: the only form edition KRA still serves is the May-2018 print, which states it “MUST be completed by ALL passengers prior to arrival” and cites EACCMA 2004 Sections 44-46 and Fifth Schedule Part B Paragraph 5(4); the live Passenger Terminal FAQ likewise says “All passengers arriving into the country are supposed to make declarations using the prescribed Passenger Declaration Form (s) (Form F88)”; the knowledge base, however, ties the form to new goods: “Any new items with a value of up to USD 2,000 per traveler are exempt from import tax, provided they are declared to the Customs Officer. If the value exceeds this limit, the passenger must declare the items in the Passenger Declaration Form (F88) before arrival.” Official texts therefore conflict on whether F88 completion is universal (printed form; terminal FAQ) or conditional on new goods over USD 2,000 (knowledge base); no unconditional up-to-date F88 duty is asserted as established current law (see unresolved). The USD 2,000 figure is a tax concession, not by itself a declaration trigger: EAC Legal Notice EAC/427/2024 (Gazette of 31 December 2024; five-page official Gazette read in full via web reader, no local complete PDF) amended EACCMA Fifth Schedule Part B Paragraph 5(9) by substituting “five hundred” with “two thousand”; the terminal FAQ gives a “concession of USD. 2000 applicable only to goods for personal and/or household use”, the knowledge base “a concession of up to USD 2,000 on items bought for personal and/or household use”. Under the knowledge-base wording the exemption of new items up to USD 2,000 is conditional on their being declared to the Customs Officer, and F88 form completion attaches only above that limit; the tax exemption and any declaration or form duty are separate questions. Superseded USD 500 figures persist on the older Customs FAQ, the 02/11/2023 KRA public notice (which already flagged review to a higher limit), the goods checkbox of the printed form and a stale declare-item on the terminal FAQ itself; used personal effects are exempt from tax (knowledge base; terminal FAQ), subject to the declaration contradiction above. Section 45 EACCMA 2004 provides dual-channel clearance: Green Channel for passengers with nothing to declare carrying dutiable goods within the duty-free allowance (oral declaration / declaration on the Passenger Declaration, passenger Categories A & B); Red Channel for passengers carrying dutiable or restricted goods — all crew members use the Red Channel, and the printed form directs any “Yes” answer to the Red Channel counter. For passengers aged 18 or over — the 18+ qualifier attaches to these consumables allowances in source wording; no age condition is stated for the USD 2,000 concession itself — duty is not levied on: spirits (including liquors) or wine not exceeding one litre, or wine not exceeding two litres; perfume and toilet water not exceeding in all one-half litre, of which not more than a quarter may be perfume; cigarettes, cigars, cheroots, cigarillos, tobacco and snuff not exceeding 250 grammes in total. Currency: the terminal FAQ requires arriving passengers to declare “Currency of USD. 10,000 and above or its equivalent”; the knowledge base states cash “exceeding 10,000 USD or its equivalent MUST be declared at Customs on arrival or before departure”, while its misconception-clarification says “more than $10,000” — current official pages conflict at exactly USD 10,000, and the printed form’s “exceeding the equivalent of USD 10,000” checkbox is form print, not a current tax-allowance or legal cash comparator. Search-reader excerpts of FRC guidance and the POCAMLA Second Schedule (Kenya Law) suggest an inclusive threshold applying into and out of Kenya, but no complete official original of either text was captured, so the legal cash comparator and any departure-side form/medium remain unverified; the arrival Form F88 is not presumed to satisfy a departure-side report, and no separate cash-declaration procedure is asserted on this basis. Non- or mis-declaration contravenes Section 203 EACCMA 2004, with strict penal action and seizure/confiscation. Duty is assessed on the transaction value under the East African Community Common External Tariff 2022 and paid, after generation of an electronic payment slip, through appointed banks at the terminal, PDQ card machines or M-Pesa (paybill 222222).
procedures.applicability_zh: 本记录区分两个不同的问题，现行KRA页面对其答复不一（部分矛盾发生在同一页面之内）：向海关申报物品，与填写特定的旅客申报表（F88表）。向海关申报——页面内部矛盾未决：KRA现行知识库（https://www.kra.go.ke/component/knowledge_base/category/5）在纠正“仅超过2,000美元的新物品须申报”这一误解时称“所有从外国/伙伴国带入肯尼亚的物品均须向海关申报（包括超过1万美元的货币及货币工具）”，其步骤2又称“入境旅客须就其从国外随身携带的所有个人物品向海关申报”；但紧接其下“个人物品”项下，同一页面称“使用过的个人物品及自用品免征关税，无需申报”。该页面就使用过的个人自用物品是否须向海关申报自相矛盾；本记录并列两种表述，不作裁断。F88表触发条件——跨页冲突：KRA官网仍在提供的唯一表格版本为2018年5月印刷版，其注明“本表必须由所有旅客在抵达肯尼亚前填写”，并援引EACCMA 2004第44-46条及第五附表B部第5(4)段；现行“旅客航站楼通关”FAQ亦称“所有入境旅客应使用规定的旅客申报表（F88表）作出申报”；而知识库仅就新物品设定该表义务：“任何价值不超过每旅客2,000美元的新物品均免征进口税，但须向海关官员申报。若价值超过该限额，旅客须在抵达前在旅客申报表（F88）中申报该物品。”因此各官方文本就F88表填报属全体强制（印刷版表格；航站楼FAQ）抑或以新物品超过2,000美元为条件（知识库）存在冲突；本记录不将无条件F88填报义务认定为现行确定法律（见未决事项）。2,000美元系税收优惠额度，其本身并非申报触发条件：东非共同体第EAC/427/2024号法律公告（2024年12月31日公报；5页官方公报已经网页阅读器全文读取，无本地完整PDF）将EACCMA第五附表B部第5(9)段中的“五百”替换为“二千”；航站楼FAQ称仅就“个人及/或家庭自用物品”给予“2,000美元”优惠额度，知识库称“就购买作个人及/或家庭自用之物品可获最高2,000美元的优惠额度”。依知识库表述，不超过2,000美元新物品的免税以向海关官员申报为条件，F88表填报义务仅系于超过该限额的情形；税收减免与申报/填表义务系两个不同的问题。已被取代的500美元数额仍见于较旧的Customs FAQ、KRA 2023年11月2日公告（该公告已预告将上调限额）、印刷版表格的物品勾选项及航站楼FAQ遗留条目；使用过的个人自用品免税（知识库；航站楼FAQ），但受上述申报矛盾影响。EACCMA 2004第45条规定双通道通关：无申报且应税物品在免税额度内的旅客走绿色通道（以口头申报/旅客申报表申报，适用于A、B类旅客）；携带应税或受限物品的旅客走红色通道——全体机组/船员须走红色通道，表格并指示凡任一勾选项答“是”者前往红色通道柜台。年满18周岁的旅客以下物品免税——18周岁条件在原文中仅系于这些消耗品免税限额，2,000美元一般优惠额度本身的官方表述未设年龄条件：烈酒（含利口酒）或葡萄酒不超过1升，或葡萄酒不超过2升；香水和化妆水合计不超过0.5升（其中香水不超过四分之一）；香烟、雪茄、方头雪茄、小雪茄、烟草及鼻烟合计不超过250克。货币：航站楼FAQ要求入境旅客申报“1万美元及以上或等值货币”；知识库FAQ称“超过1万美元或等值的货币及货币工具必须在抵达时或离境前向海关申报”，其误解澄清项则称“超过1万美元”——现行官方页面在恰为1万美元处口径不一；印刷版表格“超过等值1万美元”勾选项属表格印刷内容，并非现行税收额度或法定现金比较口径。FRC指引与POCAMLA第二附表（Kenya Law）的检索阅读器摘录显示该限额为“等于或超过”且适用于运入及运出肯尼亚两个方向，但两者均未捕获完整官方原文，故法定现金比较口径及任何离境申报表格/方式仍未核实；不推定入境F88表即可满足离境申报，亦不据此增设独立货币申报程序。未申报或虚报违反EACCMA 2004第203条，将受严厉处罚并可能被扣押/没收物品。关税按成交价格依《东非共同体共同对外关税2022》估征，电子缴费单生成后，经航站楼指定银行、PDQ刷卡机或M-Pesa（222222支付号）缴纳。
procedures.timing_en: Where Form F88 applies, it (served May-2018 edition) is completed before arrival and presented to Customs at the point of entry; whether it applies to all passengers or only to new items over USD 2,000 is the unresolved conflict described in the applicability, and the knowledge base adds that “declaration is supposed to be done before scanning”. The passenger is cleared at the Green or Red Channel after disembarkation. The knowledge base places cash declaration “on arrival or before departure”; the departure-side form/medium is unidentified.
procedures.timing_zh: 凡适用F88表者（现行提供的2018年5月版），于抵达前填写并在入境口岸交海关；该表适用于全体旅客抑或仅适用于超过2,000美元的新物品，属上文所述未决冲突；知识库并称“申报应在扫描前完成”。下机后经绿色或红色通道通关。知识库称现金申报须于“抵达时或离境前”作出；离境申报的表格/方式尚未查明。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客申報表（F88表）與雙通道通關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 本記錄區分兩個不同的問題，現行KRA頁面對其答覆不一（部分矛盾發生在同一頁面之內）：向海關申報物品，與填寫特定的旅客申報表（F88表）。向海關申報——頁面內部矛盾未決：KRA現行知識庫（https://www.kra.go.ke/component/knowledge_base/category/5）在糾正“僅超過2,000美元的新物品須申報”這一誤解時稱“所有從外國/夥伴國帶入肯尼亞的物品均須向海關申報（包括超過1萬美元的貨幣及貨幣工具）”，其步驟2又稱“入境旅客須就其從國外隨身攜帶的所有個人物品向海關申報”；但緊接其下“個人物品”項下，同一頁面稱“使用過的個人物品及自用品免徵關稅，無需申報”。該頁面就使用過的個人自用物品是否須向海關申報自相矛盾；本記錄並列兩種表述，不作裁斷。F88表觸發條件——跨頁衝突：KRA官網仍在提供的唯一表格版本為2018年5月印刷版，其註明“本表必須由所有旅客在抵達肯尼亞前填寫”，並援引EACCMA 2004第44-46條及第五附表B部第5(4)段；現行“旅客航站樓通關”FAQ亦稱“所有入境旅客應使用規定的旅客申報表（F88表）作出申報”；而知識庫僅就新物品設定該表義務：“任何價值不超過每旅客2,000美元的新物品均免徵進口稅，但須向海關官員申報。若價值超過該限額，旅客須在抵達前在旅客申報表（F88）中申報該物品。”因此各官方文本就F88表填報屬全體強制（印刷版表格；航站樓FAQ）抑或以新物品超過2,000美元為條件（知識庫）存在衝突；本記錄不將無條件F88填報義務認定為現行確定法律（見未決事項）。2,000美元系稅收優惠額度，其本身並非申報觸發條件：東非共同體第EAC/427/2024號法律公告（2024年12月31日公報；5頁官方公報已經網頁閱讀器全文讀取，無本地完整PDF）將EACCMA第五附表B部第5(9)段中的“五百”替換為“二千”；航站樓FAQ稱僅就“個人及/或家庭自用物品”給予“2,000美元”優惠額度，知識庫稱“就購買作個人及/或家庭自用之物品可獲最高2,000美元的優惠額度”。依知識庫表述，不超過2,000美元新物品的免稅以向海關官員申報為條件，F88表填報義務僅繫於超過該限額的情形；稅收減免與申報/填表義務系兩個不同的問題。已被取代的500美元數額仍見於較舊的Customs FAQ、KRA 2023年11月2日公告（該公告已預告將上調限額）、印刷版表格的物品勾選項及航站樓FAQ遺留條目；使用過的個人自用品免稅（知識庫；航站樓FAQ），但受上述申報矛盾影響。EACCMA 2004第45條規定雙通道通關：無申報且應稅物品在免稅額度內的旅客走綠色通道（以口頭申報/旅客申報表申報，適用於A、B類旅客）；攜帶應稅或受限物品的旅客走紅色通道——全體機組/船員須走紅色通道，表格並指示凡任一勾選項答“是”者前往紅色通道櫃檯。年滿18週歲的旅客以下物品免稅——18週歲條件在原文中僅繫於這些消耗品免稅限額，2,000美元一般優惠額度本身的官方表述未設年齡條件：烈酒（含利口酒）或葡萄酒不超過1升，或葡萄酒不超過2升；香水和化妝水合計不超過0.5升（其中香水不超過四分之一）；香菸、雪茄、方頭雪茄、小雪茄、菸草及鼻菸合計不超過250克。貨幣：航站樓FAQ要求入境旅客申報“1萬美元及以上或等值貨幣”；知識庫FAQ稱“超過1萬美元或等值的貨幣及貨幣工具必須在抵達時或離境前向海關申報”，其誤解澄清項則稱“超過1萬美元”——現行官方頁面在恰為1萬美元處口徑不一；印刷版表格“超過等值1萬美元”勾選項屬表格印刷內容，並非現行稅收額度或法定現金比較口徑。FRC指引與POCAMLA第二附表（Kenya Law）的檢索閱讀器摘錄顯示該限額為“等於或超過”且適用於運入及運出肯尼亞兩個方向，但兩者均未捕獲完整官方原文，故法定現金比較口徑及任何離境申報表格/方式仍未核實；不推定入境F88表即可滿足離境申報，亦不據此增設獨立貨幣申報程序。未申報或虛報違反EACCMA 2004第203條，將受嚴厲處罰並可能被扣押/沒收物品。關稅按成交價格依《東非共同體共同對外關稅2022》估徵，電子繳費單生成後，經航站樓指定銀行、PDQ刷卡機或M-Pesa（222222支付號）繳納。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 凡適用F88表者（現行提供的2018年5月版），於抵達前填寫並在入境口岸交海關；該表適用於全體旅客抑或僅適用於超過2,000美元的新物品，屬上文所述未決衝突；知識庫並稱“申報應在掃描前完成”。下機後經綠色或紅色通道通關。知識庫稱現金申報須於“抵達時或離境前”作出；離境申報的表格/方式尚未查明。

procedures.name_en: Traveller customs passage — green/yellow channel and duty-free allowances
procedures.name_zh: 旅客通关——红绿通道与免税额度
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes, Madagascar
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving travelers choose a channel: green if they have nothing to declare and carry no more than 3 large suitcases; yellow if they carry goods to declare or more than 3 large suitcases. Duty-free allowances per person (lost if traveling more than twice per month): alcoholic beverages 2 L and wine 2 bottles (separate line items, age 18+), cigarettes 200 sticks / cigarillos 100 / cigars 50 / smoking tobacco 250 g (250 g total when mixing tobacco types), perfumes and toilet water 2 x 100 ml, 1 laptop + 1 tablet + 2 mobile phones, and other new personal non-commercial goods whose total value does not exceed 1,000 EUR (invoice to be presented on request; the list above is not exhaustive). Declaration is required for: franchise-list items exceeding the stated quantities, new articles worth 1,000 EUR or more, and non-personal-effect goods (professional or sports equipment). Declaring does not automatically mean paying duties: a baggage check determines whether duties and taxes apply and the amount; where due, payment is made at the customs cash desk by cash, card or mobile money and a receipt (quittance) is issued.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境旅客自选通道：无申报物且不超过3件大行李走绿色通道；有申报物或超过3件大行李走黄色通道。每人免税额度（每月旅行超过2次则丧失）：酒精饮品2升与葡萄酒2瓶（表格中两项单列，年满18岁）、香烟200支/小雪茄100支/雪茄50支/烟丝250克（多种烟草混装合计不超过250克）、香水及/或化妆水合计2×100毫升、笔记本电脑1台+平板1台+手机2部，以及其他总价值不超过1000欧元的新自用非商用物品（受检时须出示发票；以上并非全部清单）。须申报的物品：免税清单内超出数量的品目、价值1000欧元及以上的新物品、以及非自用品（专业或运动器材）。申报不等于必然缴税：由行李查验判定是否适用税费及金额；如需缴纳，在海关柜台以现金、刷卡或移动支付付款并取得收据。
procedures.timing_en: At the airport customs checkpoint after baggage claim; channel choice is made before meeting the customs officer.
procedures.timing_zh: 在机场提取行李后的海关查验口；在见到关员前选定通道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客通關——紅綠通道與免稅額度
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境旅客自選通道：無申報物且不超過3件大行李走綠色通道；有申報物或超過3件大行李走黃色通道。每人免稅額度（每月旅行超過2次則喪失）：酒精飲品2升與葡萄酒2瓶（表格中兩項單列，年滿18歲）、香菸200支/小雪茄100支/雪茄50支/菸絲250克（多種菸草混裝合計不超過250克）、香水及/或化妝水合計2×100毫升、筆電電腦1臺+平板1臺+手機2部，以及其他總價值不超過1000歐元的新自用非商用物品（受檢時須出示發票；以上並非全部清單）。須申報的物品：免稅清單內超出數量的品目、價值1000歐元及以上的新物品、以及非自用品（專業或運動器材）。申報不等於必然繳稅：由行李查驗判定是否適用稅費及金額；如需繳納，在海關櫃檯以現金、刷卡或移動支付付款並取得收據。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在機場提取行李後的海關查驗口；在見到關員前選定通道。

procedures.name_en: Currency import/export formalities
procedures.name_zh: 货币出入境手续
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes, Madagascar
procedures.applicability_en: The guide's currency rules appear in its departure section and concern foreign currency; the guide states no separate limit for local currency (ariary). As written: a traveler may travel with less than 10,000 EUR or its equivalent — amounts over 1,000 EUR require presenting customs an exchange justification from a bank or bureau de change, and above 10,000 EUR the operation must go through a bank transaction. Separately, any traveler entering Madagascar with foreign currency — in particular if they intend to take it out again on a later departure — must declare it to customs, and the amount re-exported must not exceed 10,000 EUR or its equivalent. Currency formalities are handled at the Douane office, Gate 87 Terminal C (Ivato).
procedures.applicability_zh: 指南中的货币规则位于出境（AU DÉPART）栏目，针对外币；指南未对本币（阿里亚里）另设限额。原文为：旅客可携带低于1万欧元或等值外币出行——超过1000欧元须向海关出示银行或兑换点的兑换证明，超过1万欧元须通过银行交易办理。另外，任何携外币入境马达加斯加的旅客——尤其计划在日后离境时再次携出者——须向海关申报，且再携出境的金额不得超过1万欧元或等值外币。货币手续在 Ivato 机场 C 航站楼87号门海关办公室办理。
procedures.timing_en: Currency formalities at the Douane office, Gate 87 Terminal C (Ivato); re-export declaration for imported foreign currency is made on arrival, exchange justification for amounts over 1,000 EUR at the border.
procedures.timing_zh: 货币手续在 Ivato 机场 C 航站楼87号门海关办公室办理；携入外币的复带出境申报在入境时进行，超过1000欧元的兑换证明在口岸出示。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 貨幣出入境手續
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 指南中的貨幣規則位於出境（AU DÉPART）欄目，針對外幣；指南未對本幣（阿里亞里）另設限額。原文為：旅客可攜帶低於1萬歐元或等值外幣出行——超過1000歐元須向海關出示銀行或兌換點的兌換證明，超過1萬歐元須通過銀行交易辦理。另外，任何攜外幣入境馬達加斯加的旅客——尤其計劃在日後離境時再次攜出者——須向海關申報，且再攜出境的金額不得超過1萬歐元或等值外幣。貨幣手續在 Ivato 機場 C 航站樓87號門海關辦公室辦理。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 貨幣手續在 Ivato 機場 C 航站樓87號門海關辦公室辦理；攜入外幣的復帶出境申報在入境時進行，超過1000歐元的兌換證明在口岸出示。

procedures.name_en: Departure declaration — precious metals and regulated products
procedures.name_zh: 离境申报——贵金属与受管制产品
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes, Madagascar
procedures.applicability_en: On departure, travelers must declare precious metals and jewelry exceeding 250 g, respect regulated quantity limits per product (e.g. 250 g of hallmarked jewelry, 2 kg of prepared vanilla), and carry required certificates for regulated products (phytosanitary for plants and foodstuffs, sanitary for animals and animal products, export authorization for precious woods).
procedures.applicability_zh: 离境时须申报超过250克的贵金属和珠宝，遵守各产品的法定数量限额（如带戳记珠宝250克、加工香草2公斤），并携带受管制产品的相应证书（植物和食品的植物检疫证书、动物及动物产品的卫生证书、贵重木材的出境许可）。
procedures.timing_en: At departure customs checkpoint.
procedures.timing_zh: 离境海关查验口。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 離境申報——貴金屬與受管制產品
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 離境時須申報超過250克的貴金屬和珠寶，遵守各產品的法定數量限額（如帶戳記珠寶250克、加工香草2公斤），並攜帶受管制產品的相應證書（植物和食品的植物檢疫證書、動物及動物產品的衛生證書、貴重木材的出境許可）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 離境海關查驗口。

procedures.name_en: Pre-arrival baggage declaration app 'Déclaration en Douane MDG'
procedures.name_zh: 行前行李申报应用「Déclaration en Douane MDG」
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes, Madagascar
procedures.applicability_en: Madagascar Customs offers a mobile app 'Déclaration en Douane MDG' for submitting a baggage declaration before crossing the border; the information is transmitted on arrival to customs via an electronic declaration terminal deployed at international airports. Per the guide: after completing and saving the required information a QR code is generated; on arrival the passport is checked by staff at the customs declaration counter; the declaration details are read by a QR reader; the data is stored on a tablet and verified by customs officers.
procedures.applicability_zh: 马达加斯加海关提供手机应用「Déclaration en Douane MDG」，可在过境前提交行李申报；信息在抵达时通过部署在国际机场的电子申报终端传送给海关。按指南所述：填写并保存所需信息后生成二维码；抵达时在海关申报柜台由工作人员核验护照；申报明细由二维码读取器读取；数据存储于平板电脑并由关员核验。
procedures.timing_en: Before arrival; QR code generated on submission, read at arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达前填报；提交时生成二维码，抵达时读取。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 行前行李申報應用「Déclaration en Douane MDG」
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 馬達加斯加海關提供手機應用「Déclaration en Douane MDG」，可在過境前提交行李申報；資訊在抵達時通過部署在國際機場的電子申報終端傳送給海關。按指南所述：填寫並保存所需資訊後生成 QR Code；抵達時在海關申報櫃檯由工作人員核驗護照；申報明細由 QR Code 讀取器讀取；資料儲存於平板電腦並由關員核驗。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達前填報；提交時生成 QR Code，抵達時讀取。

procedures.name_en: Arrival clearance — green/red channel, duty-free allowances
procedures.name_zh: 入境通关——绿色/红色通道与免税额度
procedures.agency: Malawi Revenue Authority (published on Malawi Trade Portal, Ministry of Trade and Industry)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers arriving at Malawi's international airports or border crossings may import duty-free, in accompanied baggage for personal use: 200 cigarettes or 250 g of tobacco in any other form; 1 litre of wine or beer; 1 litre of spirituous beverages; 1/4 litre of toilet water and 50 g of perfume (these reliefs apply only to persons aged 16 or more); and dutiable goods, new or used, not exceeding K300,000 in value per person. The K300,000 relief does not apply to goods imported by a person returning to Malawi after an absence of less than 24 hours. Non-residents may additionally import personal and household goods that the officer is satisfied will be re-exported on departure. No customs declaration form is needed if within limits — walk through the green 'Nothing to Declare' channel; goods in excess or restricted/prohibited require the red 'Something to Declare' channel.
procedures.applicability_zh: 抵达马拉维国际机场或边境口岸的旅客，随身行李中个人自用物品可免税携带：香烟200支或其他形式烟草250克；葡萄酒或啤酒1升；烈性酒1升；化妆水1/4升和香水50克（以上免税仅适用于年满16岁者）；以及应税物品（新旧不限）每人价值不超过30万克瓦查。离开马拉维不足24小时即返回者不适用30万克瓦查免税额。非常住居民另可进口经关员确认将在离境时复运出境的个人及家庭用品。在限额内无需填报海关申报表，走绿色「无申报」通道；超出限额或携带受限/禁止物品须走红色「有申报」通道申报。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival at international airports or border crossings. Travellers remain bound by regulations on foreign or Malawi currency, precious objects, archaeological and cultural objects and other restricted goods.
procedures.timing_zh: 在国际机场或边境口岸入境时办理。旅客仍受外币/马拉维克瓦查、贵金属物品、文物及其他受限物品相关规定的约束。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境通關——綠色/紅色通道與免稅額度
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 抵達馬拉維國際機場或邊境口岸的旅客，隨身行李中個人自用物品可免稅攜帶：香菸200支或其他形式菸草250克；葡萄酒或啤酒1升；烈性酒1升；化妝水1/4升和香水50克（以上免稅僅適用於年滿16歲者）；以及應稅物品（新舊不限）每人價值不超過30萬克瓦查。離開馬拉維不足24小時即返回者不適用30萬克瓦查免稅額。非常住居民另可進口經關員確認將在離境時復運出境的個人及家庭用品。在限額內無需填報海關申報表，走綠色「無申報」通道；超出限額或攜帶受限/禁止物品須走紅色「有申報」通道申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在國際機場或邊境口岸入境時辦理。旅客仍受外幣/馬拉維克瓦查、貴金屬物品、文物及其他受限物品相關規定的約束。

procedures.name_en: Departure procedures and temporary export registration
procedures.name_zh: 离境手续与暂时出口登记
procedures.agency: Malawi Revenue Authority (published on Malawi Trade Portal)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers leaving Malawi need no specific customs procedures unless exporting restricted or prohibited goods (permits per Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism lists). Goods exported temporarily for processing, repair or return in an unaltered state must be registered with Customs as a temporary export at exit (MRA Form 38 Temporary Export Permit; Form 48 General Registration Certificate), allowing re-import without further VAT or duties.
procedures.applicability_zh: 离境旅客无专门海关手续，除非出口受限或禁止物品（须按工商与旅游部清单取得许可）。暂时出境用于加工、修理或原状返回的物品，须在出境时向海关办理暂时出口登记（MRA 38号表暂时出口许可证；48号表通用登记证），以便返程入境时免再缴增值税或关税。
procedures.timing_en: At exit; temporary export registered with Customs at the time of exiting.
procedures.timing_zh: 出境时；暂时出口在离境时向海关登记。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 離境手續與暫時出口登記
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 離境旅客無專門海關手續，除非出口受限或禁止物品（須按工商與旅遊部清單取得許可）。暫時出境用於加工、修理或原狀返回的物品，須在出境時向海關辦理暫時出口登記（MRA 38號表暫時出口許可證；48號表通用登記證），以便返程入境時免再繳增值稅或關稅。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出境時；暫時出口在離境時向海關登記。

sources.publisher: Ministry of Industry and Trade of the Republic of Malawi (Malawi Trade Portal, customs content from MRA)

procedures.name_en: On-arrival declaration and Red/Green channel
procedures.name_zh: 入境申报与红绿通道
procedures.agency: Mauritius Revenue Authority — Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Passengers on international flights arriving in Mauritius must declare to customs: prohibited or restricted goods (weapons, agricultural products, wildlife products, pharmaceuticals, illicit drugs); goods in excess of the duty-free allowance (Rs 30,000 Mauritian / Rs 15,000 foreign passport holders, and tobacco/alcohol beyond allowance); merchandise for sale; and currency or bearer negotiable instruments (bearer traveller's cheques, cheques, promissory notes, money orders), precious stones and metals including gold, diamond and jewellery, or other high-value goods including works of art exceeding Rs 500,000 in value. A self-elective Red/Green Channel system operates at the airport and port; passengers with anything to declare — or unsure — must use the Red Channel. Selecting the Green Channel is deemed a declaration that the passenger has none of the above; interception with such goods constitutes an offence with duty, penalties and/or seizure.
procedures.applicability_zh: 乘国际航班抵达毛里求斯的旅客须向海关申报：禁止或受限物品（武器、农产品、野生动物制品、药品、毒品）；超出免税额度的物品（毛里求斯护照持有人3万卢比、外国护照持有人1.5万卢比，及超出的烟酒）；销售用商品；以及超过50万卢比的货币或不记名可转让票据（不记名旅行支票、支票、本票、汇票）、贵金属和宝石（含黄金、钻石、珠宝）或其他高价值物品（含艺术品）。机场和港口实行自助选择的红绿通道制；有申报物或不确定者必须走红色通道。走绿色通道即视为声明无上述物品；被查获即构成违法，须补税、罚款及/或没收。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival at the airport or port; baggage of any traveller may be searched by Customs officers.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达机场或港口时办理；任何旅客的行李都可能被海关关员查验。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境申報與紅綠通道
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 乘國際航班抵達毛里求斯的旅客須向海關申報：禁止或受限物品（武器、農產品、野生動物製品、藥品、毒品）；超出免稅額度的物品（毛里求斯護照持有人3萬盧比、外國護照持有人1.5萬盧比，及超出的菸酒）；銷售用商品；以及超過50萬盧比的貨幣或不記名可轉讓票據（不記名旅行支票、支票、本票、匯票）、貴金屬和寶石（含黃金、鑽石、珠寶）或其他高價值物品（含藝術品）。機場和港口實行自助選擇的紅綠通道制；有申報物或不確定者必須走紅色通道。走綠色通道即視為聲明無上述物品；被查獲即構成違法，須補稅、罰款及/或沒收。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達機場或港口時辦理；任何旅客的行李都可能被海關關員查驗。

procedures.name_en: Duty-free allowances (18+ for alcohol/tobacco)
procedures.name_zh: 免税额度（烟酒限18岁以上）
procedures.agency: Mauritius Revenue Authority — Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Personal effects (clothing, toilet articles, personal jewellery including watches) for the passenger's own use are admitted free of duty and VAT. Alcohol and tobacco allowances require age 18+ and the passenger may choose only one option (effective 1 September 2025): A — tobacco 250 g + spirits 1 L + wine/ale/beer 2 L; B — tobacco 250 g + spirits 2 L, no wine/ale/beer; C — tobacco 250 g + wine/ale/beer 4 L, no spirits. Duty, excise and VAT are payable on excess. Other accompanied goods allowance (excluding arms/ammunition, tobacco, wine/spirits, merchandise for sale): from Rodrigues — Rs 20,000 (12+) / Rs 10,000 (under 12); on international flights — Mauritian passport holders Rs 30,000 (12+) / Rs 15,000 (under 12), foreign passport holders Rs 15,000 (no age limit). Tourists may additionally import professional implements/tools duty-free, and one sporting firearm with up to 50 cartridges if re-exported within the prescribed period.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自用个人物品（衣物、盥洗用品、含手表的个人首饰）免关税和增值税入境。烟酒免税须年满18岁，且只能三选一（2025年9月1日起生效）：A——烟草250克+烈酒1升+葡萄酒/麦芽酒/啤酒2升；B——烟草250克+烈酒2升，无葡萄酒/麦芽酒/啤酒；C——烟草250克+葡萄酒/麦芽酒/啤酒4升，无烈酒。超出部分须缴关税、消费税和增值税。其他随身物品免税额（不含武器弹药、烟草、酒类、销售商品）：自罗德里格斯岛抵——12岁以上2万卢比、12岁以下1万卢比；国际航班——毛里求斯护照12岁以上3万卢比、12岁以下1.5万卢比，外国护照不限年龄1.5万卢比。游客另可免税携带职业用器具工具，以及一支运动用枪和不超过50发子弹（须在规定期限内复运出境）。
procedures.timing_en: Applied at the Customs arrival process; goods must accompany the passenger.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境海关环节适用；物品须随旅客同行。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 免稅額度（菸酒限18歲以上）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自用個人物品（衣物、盥洗用品、含手錶的個人首飾）免關稅和增值稅入境。菸酒免稅須年滿18歲，且只能三選一（2025年9月1日起生效）：A——菸草250克+烈酒1升+葡萄酒/麥芽酒/啤酒2升；B——菸草250克+烈酒2升，無葡萄酒/麥芽酒/啤酒；C——菸草250克+葡萄酒/麥芽酒/啤酒4升，無烈酒。超出部分須繳關稅、消費稅和增值稅。其他隨身物品免稅額（不含武器彈藥、菸草、酒類、銷售商品）：自羅德里格斯島抵——12歲以上2萬盧比、12歲以下1萬盧比；國際航班——毛里求斯護照12歲以上3萬盧比、12歲以下1.5萬盧比，外國護照不限年齡1.5萬盧比。遊客另可免稅攜帶職業用器具工具，以及一支運動用槍和不超過50發子彈（須在規定期限內復運出境）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境海關環節適用；物品須隨旅客同行。

procedures.name_en: Arrival/return declaration and duty-free thresholds in Mayotte
procedures.name_zh: 马约特抵达/返回申报与免税门槛
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (French customs)
procedures.applicability_en: On arrival or return to Mayotte, travelers must declare goods acquired or received as gifts when value or quantities exceed the duty-free thresholds and pay the duties and taxes due. Arriving from metropolitan France or an EU country: no customs duty, but octroi de mer and regional octroi de mer apply, with no tax on goods valued at or below EUR 1,000; tobacco thresholds — 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g smoking tobacco; alcohol — 4 L still wine and 16 L beer, plus either 1 L of spirits over 22% or 2 L of beverages 22% or less. Arriving from a non-EU country: customs duty plus octroi de mer apply, duty- and tax-free up to EUR 150 (under 15) / EUR 430 (15 and over), with the same tobacco and alcohol quantity thresholds. Persons under 17 cannot import tobacco or alcohol duty-free. Values cannot be pooled across persons; an object exceeding the threshold is taxed on its full value. Flat-rate 2.5% customs taxation is available for non-EU purchases; sample rates above threshold: TV 40%, digital camera 30%.
procedures.applicability_zh: 抵达或返回马约特时，旅客须就价值或数量超过免税门槛的购置或受赠物品申报并缴纳相应税费。自法国本土或欧盟国家抵达：免关税，但须缴海洋税（octroi de mer）及大区海洋税，价值不超过1000欧元的物品免税；烟草门槛——香烟200支或小雪茄100支或雪茄50支或烟丝250克；酒类——静止葡萄酒4升和啤酒16升，外加烈度超过22度的1升或22度及以下的2升。自非欧盟国家抵达：须缴关税和海洋税，价值150欧元（15岁以下）/430欧元（15岁及以上）以下免税，烟酒数量门槛同上。未满17岁不得免税携带烟酒。额度不能多人合并计算；单件物品超门槛按全额征税。非欧盟购置可选2.5%关税简化计税；超门槛示例税率：电视机40%、数码相机30%。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival or return to Mayotte; declaration at customs with duties and taxes paid as applicable.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达或返回马约特时；向海关申报并按情况缴纳税费。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 馬約特抵達/返回申報與免稅門檻
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 抵達或返回馬約特時，旅客須就價值或數量超過免稅門檻的購置或受贈物品申報並繳納相應稅費。自法國本土或歐盟國家抵達：免關稅，但須繳海洋稅（octroi de mer）及大區海洋稅，價值不超過1000歐元的物品免稅；菸草門檻——香菸200支或小雪茄100支或雪茄50支或菸絲250克；酒類——靜止葡萄酒4升和啤酒16升，外加烈度超過22度的1升或22度及以下的2升。自非歐盟國家抵達：須繳關稅和海洋稅，價值150歐元（15歲以下）/430歐元（15歲及以上）以下免稅，菸酒數量門檻同上。未滿17歲不得免稅攜帶菸酒。額度不能多人合併計算；單件物品超門檻按全額徵稅。非歐盟購置可選2.5%關稅簡化計稅；超門檻示例稅率：電視機40%、數碼相機30%。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達或返回馬約特時；向海關申報並按情況繳納稅費。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration — EUR 10,000 threshold for cross-border movements
procedures.name_zh: 现金申报——1万欧元跨境申报义务
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (French customs)
procedures.applicability_en: To combat illicit financial flows, cross-border transports of cash of an amount equal to or above EUR 10,000 must be declared. This obligation applies to cross-border flows, i.e. between the overseas territory and foreign countries (EU member states or third countries).
procedures.applicability_zh: 为打击非法资金流动，携带等于或超过1万欧元的现金跨境必须申报。该义务适用于跨境流动，即海外领地与外国（欧盟成员国或第三国）之间的流动。
procedures.timing_en: When crossing the border between Mayotte and a foreign country.
procedures.timing_zh: 在马约特与外国之间跨境时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金申報——1萬歐元跨境申報義務
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 為打擊非法資金流動，攜帶等於或超過1萬歐元的現金跨境必須申報。該義務適用於跨境流動，即海外領地與外國（歐盟成員國或第三國）之間的流動。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在馬約特與外國之間跨境時。

procedures.name_en: e-Viajante — Traveller Goods Declaration (Declaração de Bens de Viajantes)
procedures.name_zh: e-Viajante 旅客物品申报系统
procedures.agency: Autoridade Tributária de Moçambique — Direção Geral das Alfândegas
procedures.applicability_en: The e-Viajante portal of the Mozambique Tax Authority is a Declaration System through which travellers declare online the goods they carry when entering or leaving Mozambique, receiving a QR code on submission; the portal states the declaration is a mandatory document. Portal guidance directs travellers to declare, especially those carrying goods above the duty-free franchise (franquia), cash (any currency) above MZN 10,000 or USD 10,000, or restricted goods; it is mandatory for commercial-purpose goods and recommended even with nothing to declare, to speed customs clearance and avoid queues. The franchise is the duty-free value — above the limit, customs duty is payable — and is evaluated on a rolling 30-day window (a declaration made 20 days earlier still counts against the current balance, calculated automatically by the system). The franchise table lists currency (MZN 10,000.00 national / USD 10,000.00 foreign), tobacco, and beverages (spirits 1 litre, wine 2.25 litres); see unresolved MZ-franchise-tobacco-figures for the portal-internal tobacco/alcohol discrepancy. Caution: a portal FAQ separately states cash above the equivalent of USD 5,000 must be declared — this conflicts with the statutory border thresholds (USD 10,000 foreign / MZN 10,000 national, Banco de Moçambique Aviso n.º 3/GBM/2024 of 20 March 2024, Arts. 104–105), which control legally; see unresolved MZ-currency-threshold-conflict. e-Viajante is a goods-declaration portal: the statutory cash declaration of Aviso Arts. 104–105 is a traveller-filled form handed to Customs at the border (see MZ-cash-declaration); nothing in the portal's literal strings shows that declaring through e-Viajante satisfies that Arts. 104/105 obligation, or that the cash form is filed through the portal.
procedures.applicability_zh: 莫桑比克税务局的 e-Viajante 门户（税务局申报系统）供旅客在线申报进出莫桑比克所携物品，提交后获得二维码；门户称申报为强制性文件。门户指引要求旅客进行申报，尤其是携带超出免税额度（franquia）物品、超过1万莫桑比克梅蒂卡尔或1万美元现金（任何币种）或受限物品者；商用货物必须申报，无申报物者也建议申报，以加快通关、避免排队。免税额度即免税价值——超出限额须缴关税——并按30天滚动窗口核算（20天前的申报仍计入当前余额，由系统自动计算）。额度表列有货币（本币10,000.00莫桑比克梅蒂卡尔／外币10,000.00美元）、烟草及酒类（烈酒1升、葡萄酒2.25升）；门户内部烟草/酒类数字矛盾见未决事项 MZ-franchise-tobacco-figures。注意：门户 FAQ 另称超过等值5000美元的现金必须申报——与法定边境申报门槛（外币1万美元／本币1万梅蒂卡尔，莫桑比克央行2024年3月20日第3/GBM/2024号通告第104–105条）相冲突，法律以法定门槛为准；见未决事项 MZ-currency-threshold-conflict。e-Viajante 为物品申报门户：上述通告第104–105条规定的法定现金申报，是旅客在边境填写并递交海关当局的表格（见 MZ-cash-declaration）；门户字面文本既未显示通过 e-Viajante 申报即可满足第104/105条义务，也未显示该现金表格经门户提交。
procedures.timing_en: Can be made in advance online before travel (the portal FAQ recommends declaring in advance); a QR code is issued on submission; the franchise is evaluated on a rolling 30-day window.
procedures.timing_zh: 可在出行前在线提前申报（门户 FAQ 建议提前申报）；提交后获得二维码；免税额度按30天滚动窗口核算。
procedures.name_zh_hant: e-Viajante 旅客物品申報系統
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 莫桑比克稅務局的 e-Viajante 門戶（稅務局申報系統）供旅客線上申報進出莫桑比克所攜物品，提交後獲得 QR Code；門戶稱申報為強制性文件。門戶指引要求旅客進行申報，尤其是攜帶超出免稅額度（franquia）物品、超過1萬莫桑比克梅蒂卡爾或1萬美元現金（任何幣種）或受限物品者；商用貨物必須申報，無申報物者也建議申報，以加快通關、避免排隊。免稅額度即免稅價值——超出限額須繳關稅——並按30天滾動窗口核算（20天前的申報仍計入當前餘額，由系統自動計算）。額度表列有貨幣（本幣10,000.00莫桑比克梅蒂卡爾／外幣10,000.00美元）、菸草及酒類（烈酒1升、葡萄酒2.25升）；門戶內部菸草/酒類數字矛盾見未決事項 MZ-franchise-tobacco-figures。注意：門戶 FAQ 另稱超過等值5000美元的現金必須申報——與法定邊境申報門檻（外幣1萬美元／本幣1萬梅蒂卡爾，莫桑比克央行2024年3月20日第3/GBM/2024號通告第104–105條）相沖突，法律以法定門檻為準；見未決事項 MZ-currency-threshold-conflict。e-Viajante 為物品申報門戶：上述通告第104–105條規定的法定現金申報，是旅客在邊境填寫並遞交海關當局的表格（見 MZ-cash-declaration）；門戶字面文本既未顯示通過 e-Viajante 申報即可滿足第104/105條義務，也未顯示該現金錶格經門戶提交。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 可在出行前線上提前申報（門戶 FAQ 建議提前申報）；提交後獲得 QR Code；免稅額度按30天滾動窗口核算。

procedures.name_en: Border declaration of physical currency, on entry or exit — foreign notes/coins above USD 10,000; Mozambican notes/coins above MZN 10,000
procedures.name_zh: 出入境现金实物申报（外币纸币硬币超1万美元；莫桑比克本币超1万梅蒂卡尔）
procedures.agency: Autoridade Tributária de Moçambique — Direção Geral das Alfândegas (legal basis: Banco de Moçambique Aviso n.º 3/GBM/2024)
procedures.applicability_en: Under Banco de Moçambique Aviso n.º 3/GBM/2024 of 20 March 2024, this declaration applies only above the statutory thresholds, and in both directions — on physical entry into and physical exit from Mozambique. Art. 104 (foreign banknotes and coins): up to the equivalent of USD 10,000, no declaration to the customs authority is required; above USD 10,000, the amount must be declared to the customs authority on entry or exit, accompanied by (a) a declaration form and (b) proof of lawful possession of the funds (Art. 104(2)). Art. 105 (Mozambican national banknotes and coins): above MZN 10,000, the physical entry or exit must likewise be declared to the customs authority (Art. 105(1)); at or below MZN 10,000 no declaration obligation is stated. Form mechanics (Arts. 104(3) and 105(2)): the traveller fills in the declaration form and hands it to the customs authority, which validates the information, keeps the original and gives the duplicate to the traveller; the Aviso says only this — it does not state the form's medium (paper or electronic), so whether it can be satisfied electronically, including through the e-Viajante portal, is unknown (see unresolved MZ-cash-form-eviajante-relation). These are the controlling legal border thresholds: the e-Viajante portal FAQ (USD 5,000) and older ministry travel guidance (US$5,000) conflict with them and are not law — see unresolved MZ-currency-threshold-conflict.
procedures.applicability_zh: 根据莫桑比克央行2024年3月20日第3/GBM/2024号通告（Aviso n.º 3/GBM/2024），本申报仅在超过法定门槛时适用，且双向适用——即于携现金实物进入或离开莫桑比克之时。第104条（外币纸币及硬币）：不超过等值1万美元的，无需向海关当局申报；超过1万美元的，须在出入境时向海关当局申报，并附（a）申报表及（b）资金合法持有证明（第104条第2款）。第105条（莫桑比克本币纸币及硬币）：超过1万梅蒂卡尔的，其出入境同样须向海关当局申报（第105条第1款）；不超过1万梅蒂卡尔未规定申报义务。表格机制（第104条第3款、第105条第2款）：申报表由旅客填写后递交海关当局，海关核验信息、留存正本并向旅客交回副本；通告仅作此规定——未载明表格载体（纸质或电子），故能否以电子方式（包括通过 e-Viajante 门户）满足该要求不明（见未决事项 MZ-cash-form-eviajante-relation）。上述即边境现金申报的法定门槛：e-Viajante 门户 FAQ（5000美元）及较早的政府部门（MINEC）旅行指引（5000美元）与之冲突，且并非法律——见未决事项 MZ-currency-threshold-conflict。
procedures.timing_en: At the customs authority, at the border, upon either physical entry or physical exit — and only where the amounts exceed the thresholds: the traveller completes the form and hands it to Customs, which validates it on the spot, keeps the original and returns the duplicate.
procedures.timing_zh: 在边境向海关当局办理，于携现金实物入境或出境之时——且仅在金额超过门槛时：旅客当场填写申报表递交海关，海关当场核验、留存正本并交回副本。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境現金實物申報（外幣紙幣硬幣超1萬美元；莫桑比克本幣超1萬梅蒂卡爾）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 根據莫桑比克央行2024年3月20日第3/GBM/2024號通告（Aviso n.º 3/GBM/2024），本申報僅在超過法定門檻時適用，且雙向適用——即於攜現金實物進入或離開莫桑比克之時。第104條（外幣紙幣及硬幣）：不超過等值1萬美元的，無需向海關當局申報；超過1萬美元的，須在出入境時向海關當局申報，並附（a）申報表及（b）資金合法持有證明（第104條第2款）。第105條（莫桑比克本幣紙幣及硬幣）：超過1萬梅蒂卡爾的，其出入境同樣須向海關當局申報（第105條第1款）；不超過1萬梅蒂卡爾未規定申報義務。表格機制（第104條第3款、第105條第2款）：申報表由旅客填寫後遞交海關當局，海關核驗資訊、留存正本並向旅客交回副本；通告僅作此規定——未載明表格載體（紙質或電子），故能否以電子方式（包括通過 e-Viajante 門戶）滿足該要求不明（見未決事項 MZ-cash-form-eviajante-relation）。上述即邊境現金申報的法定門檻：e-Viajante 門戶 FAQ（5000美元）及較早的政府部門（MINEC）旅行指引（5000美元）與之衝突，且並非法律——見未決事項 MZ-currency-threshold-conflict。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在邊境向海關當局辦理，於攜現金實物入境或出境之時——且僅在金額超過門檻時：旅客當場填寫申報表遞交海關，海關當場核驗、留存正本並交回副本。
