procedures.name_en: Arrival traveller oral declaration; red/green double-circuit choice constitutes the declaration act only where customs operates it (National Customs Code 2018)
procedures.name_zh: 到达旅客口头申报；红/绿双通道选择仅在海关启用处构成申报行为（2018年国家海关法典）
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes du Niger (Ministère des Finances)
procedures.applicability_en: Under the National Customs Code (Loi n°2018-19 of 27 April 2018) two layers apply to arriving travellers. General layer: traveller and baggage inspection proceeds under cover of an oral declaration ('sous couvert d'une déclaration verbale') and only at places designated by the customs administration (Article 214); Articles 214–222 apply to travellers by any mode of transport (Article 223(1)); a Minister of Finance order may further specify traveller processing (Article 223(2), not obtained). Conditional layer: the 'double circuit' is the simplified customs control system whereby arriving travellers make an act of declaration by choosing between two circuits — green, for travellers carrying no goods exceeding the duty-free admissible quantities or values and nothing prohibited or restricted; red, for all others (Article 1(24)); customs uses the double-circuit system only when circumstances and installations permit (Article 218(2)(b)), so the channel-choice form of the declaration act exists only where the double circuit is actually operated — the Code does not state that any given airport or land border operates the two channels, and that operational fact is not verified here (the channel field is 'conditional' for this reason). Declaration in detail of goods is made in writing, by computer process, or orally where the customs administration so provides (Article 107) — the general goods-declaration regime, not a traveller paper form. Baggage duty-free amounts and values are not stated in the articles read and remain unknown; separately, Article 219 lets returning residents re-import duty-free their previously exported personal effects and private means of transport, and Article 220 grants non-residents temporary admission of their private means of transport for up to one year, renewable, possibly against security. The channel scheme is defined for arrival only; no departure channel scheme is established in the Code, and exit cash reporting follows the regional rules above.
procedures.applicability_zh: 依据2018年4月27日第2018-19号国家海关法，到达旅客适用两层制度。一般层：旅客及行李查验以口头申报（"sous couvert d'une déclaration verbale"）为前提，且仅可在海关指定地点进行（第214条）；第214至222条适用于任何交通方式的旅客（第223条第1款）；财政部长令可另行细化旅客处理（第223条第2款，该令未取得）。条件层："双通道"（double circuit）是简化的海关监管制度，到达旅客通过在两类通道之间作出选择即完成申报行为——绿色通道供未携带超过免税可容纳数量或价值的货物、且无禁限物品的旅客，红色通道供其余旅客（第1条第24款）；但海关仅在情形与设施允许时使用双通道制度（第218条第2款b项），故"选择通道即申报"仅在海关实际启用双通道的口岸存在，本法未载明任一机场或陆路口岸实际设置双通道，该运营事实未经核实（本程序 channel 因此记为 conditional）。货物明细申报以书面、计算机或（在海关规定允许时）口头方式作出（第107条）——这是一般货物报关制度，不是旅客纸表。行李免税的数量与价值在所读条文中未载明，为unknown；另，第219条允许回返居民免税复进口其先前出口的个人物品及私人交通工具，第220条给予非居民私人交通工具临时进口，最长一年、可续期，必要时可要求担保。通道制度仅就到达定义；本法未设离境通道制度，离境现金申报按上述区域规则办理。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, at places designated by customs and under cover of an oral declaration (Article 214); where the double circuit is operated — which the Code permits only when circumstances and installations allow (Article 218(2)(b)) — the traveller's choice between green and red circuit itself constitutes the declaration act.
procedures.timing_zh: 到达时在海关指定地点、以口头申报为前提办理（第214条）；仅在海关因情形与设施允许而实际启用双通道的口岸（第218条第2款b项），旅客选择绿或红通道本身即构成申报行为。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 到達旅客口頭申報；紅/綠雙通道選擇僅在海關啟用處構成申報行為（2018年國家海關法典）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 依據2018年4月27日第2018-19號國家海關法，到達旅客適用兩層制度。一般層：旅客及行李查驗以口頭申報（"sous couvert d'une déclaration verbale"）為前提，且僅可在海關指定地點進行（第214條）；第214至222條適用於任何交通方式的旅客（第223條第1款）；財政部長令可另行細化旅客處理（第223條第2款，該令未取得）。條件層："雙通道"（double circuit）是簡化的海關監管制度，到達旅客通過在兩類通道之間作出選擇即完成申報行為——綠色通道供未攜帶超過免稅可容納數量或價值的貨物、且無禁限物品的旅客，紅色通道供其餘旅客（第1條第24款）；但海關僅在情形與設施允許時使用雙通道制度（第218條第2款b項），故"選擇通道即申報"僅在海關實際啟用雙通道的口岸存在，本法未載明任一機場或陸路口岸實際設置雙通道，該營運事實未經核實（本程序 channel 因此記為 conditional）。貨物明細申報以書面、計算機或（在海關規定允許時）口頭方式作出（第107條）——這是一般貨物報關制度，不是旅客紙表。行李免稅的數量與價值在所讀條文中未載明，為unknown；另，第219條允許回返居民免稅復進口其先前出口的個人物品及私人交通工具，第220條給予非居民私人交通工具臨時進口，最長一年、可續期，必要時可要求擔保。通道制度僅就到達定義；本法未設離境通道制度，離境現金申報按上述區域規則辦理。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 到達時在海關指定地點、以口頭申報為前提辦理（第214條）；僅在海關因情形與設施允許而實際啟用雙通道的口岸（第218條第2款b項），旅客選擇綠或紅通道本身即構成申報行為。

procedures.name_en: Electronic Currency Declaration (E-CDF) — USD 10,000 threshold, inward and outward
procedures.name_zh: 电子货币申报（E-CDF）——1万美元门槛，入境与出境
procedures.agency: Nigeria Customs Service (NCS)
procedures.applicability_en: The live NCS Electronic Currency Declaration Form (E-CDF) applies to travellers carrying foreign currency or items of value of USD 10,000 or more (or equivalent), in both directions: the form offers an Inward/Outward direction choice and states that declaration is required before entering or leaving Nigeria. It asks for the entry or departure point, chosen from listed international airports, seaports and land borders, or 'Other'. It covers cash currencies, negotiable instruments (traveller's/bank cheques, money orders, promissory notes, bearer bonds, prepaid cards, etc.) and precious stones/metals or other high-value items — ordinary baggage is not declared through this form. Submit online before crossing the border; afterwards present yourself to a Nigeria Customs officer at the border for in-person validation. The declaration status remains Pending until validated by a proper officer, so a reference number alone is not a validated declaration. The form states that it is free of charge and cites as its legal basis the Money Laundering (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022, the Foreign Exchange (Monitoring and Miscellaneous) Provisions Act 1995 and the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023.
procedures.applicability_zh: 尼日利亚海关现行电子货币申报表（E-CDF）适用于携带达到或超过1万美元（或等值）外币或有价值物品的旅客，双向适用：表内可选“入境（Inward）/出境（Outward）”方向，并载明须在进入或离开尼日利亚之前申报。表格要求选择入境或离境地点，可从列表所列国际机场、海港、陆路口岸中选择，或选“其他”。申报范围是现金货币、可转让票据（旅行支票/银行支票、汇票、本票、无记名债券、预付卡等）及宝石/贵金属或其他高价值物品——普通行李不通过此表申报。过境前在线提交；随后须在边境向尼日利亚海关关员当面核验。经正式关员核验前，申报状态一直为“待定”，仅取得参考号不等于已核验申报。表格声明免费，并载明其法律依据为《2022年洗钱（预防与禁止）法》、《1995年外汇（监管与杂项）规定法》与《2023年尼日利亚海关法》。
procedures.timing_en: Submit online before crossing the border (both when entering and when leaving Nigeria); afterwards present yourself to a Nigeria Customs officer at the border for in-person validation — the declaration stays Pending until validated.
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入或离开尼日利亚过境前在线提交；随后须在边境向尼日利亚海关关员当面核验——核验前申报状态一直为待定。

fee.note: 表格原文：This form is free. Nigeria Customs does not charge for declarations.（本表免费，海关申报不收费）

procedures.name_zh_hant: 電子貨幣申報（E-CDF）——1萬美元門檻，入境與出境
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 尼日利亞海關現行電子貨幣申報表（E-CDF）適用於攜帶達到或超過1萬美元（或等值）外幣或有價值物品的旅客，雙向適用：表內可選“入境（Inward）/出境（Outward）”方向，並載明須在進入或離開尼日利亞之前申報。表格要求選擇入境或離境地點，可從列表所列國際機場、海港、陸路口岸中選擇，或選“其他”。申報範圍是現金貨幣、可轉讓票據（旅行支票/銀行支票、匯票、本票、無記名債券、預付卡等）及寶石/貴金屬或其他高價值物品——普通行李不通過此表申報。過境前線上提交；隨後須在邊境向尼日利亞海關關員當面核驗。經正式關員核驗前，申報狀態一直為“待定”，僅取得參考號不等於已核驗申報。表格聲明免費，並載明其法律依據為《2022年洗錢（預防與禁止）法》、《1995年外匯（監管與雜項）規定法》與《2023年尼日利亞海關法》。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入或離開尼日利亞過境前線上提交；隨後須在邊境向尼日利亞海關關員當面核驗——核驗前申報狀態一直為待定。

procedures.name_en: Passenger entry declaration (Regulation 10(1) and Second Schedule, Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016; official consolidated PDF dated 2026-07-01)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客入境申报（规例第10(1)条及第二附表，《Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016》，2026-07-01官方合并版）
procedures.agency: HM Customs and Excise, St Helena
procedures.applicability_en: All passengers entering St Helena must complete a declaration in the form shown in the Second Schedule ("Every passenger or head of family MUST complete this form when entering St Helena") and submit it to Customs; the Collector may exempt a passenger under Regulation 10(2). If you do not have anything to declare then please state "NONE"; goods obtained outside St Helena that are not within duty-free allowances (not exempt from dues) must be listed — under s.30 of the Customs and Excise Ordinance, 1999, only goods not exempt from dues must be listed, so duty-free allowance items are not itemised. Territorial scope: St Helena island only; not extrapolated to Ascension or Tristan da Cunha.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有入境圣赫勒拿的旅客（或家庭户主）均须填写第二附表所载表格（“Every passenger or head of family MUST complete this form when entering St Helena”）并交海关；依规例第10(2)条，Collector（海关负责人）可豁免特定旅客。如无任何须申报之物，请填写“NONE”；在圣赫勒拿以外取得、不属免税额度（即不享 dues 豁免）的物品须列明——依《Customs and Excise Ordinance, 1999》第30条，仅不享 dues 豁免的货物须列报，免税额度内物品无须逐项列报。地域范围：仅圣赫勒拿岛；不外推至阿森松（Ascension）与特里斯坦达库尼亚（Tristan da Cunha）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in St Helena, at the Customs hall.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达圣赫勒拿时，在入境海关大厅填写并提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客入境申報（規例第10(1)條及第二附表，《Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016》，2026-07-01官方合併版）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有入境聖赫勒拿的旅客（或家庭戶主）均須填寫第二附表所載表格（“Every passenger or head of family MUST complete this form when entering St Helena”）並交海關；依規例第10(2)條，Collector（海關負責人）可豁免特定旅客。如無任何須申報之物，請填寫“NONE”；在聖赫勒拿以外取得、不屬免稅額度（即不享 dues 豁免）的物品須列明——依《Customs and Excise Ordinance, 1999》第30條，僅不享 dues 豁免的貨物須列報，免稅額度內物品無須逐項列報。地域範圍：僅聖赫勒拿島；不外推至阿森松（Ascension）與特里斯坦達庫尼亞（Tristan da Cunha）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達聖赫勒拿時，在入境海關大廳填寫並提交。

procedures.name_en: Currency declaration strictly over £6,000 when entering or leaving St Helena (Regulation 12(1) and Fourth Schedule, Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016; official consolidated PDF dated 2026-07-01)
procedures.name_zh: 出入圣赫勒拿携严格超过6,000英镑货币申报（规例第12(1)条及第四附表，《Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016》，2026-07-01官方合并版）
procedures.agency: HM Customs and Excise, St Helena
procedures.applicability_en: Trigger: carrying currency, cheques or monetary instruments, or any combination of them, which in total exceeds £6,000 (strictly more than), or the equivalent of that amount in any currency or combination of currencies. Direction: both entering and departing St Helena. Obligations: (a) declare this fact in the form contained in the Fourth Schedule — the currency declaration form records personal data (name, date and country of birth, nationality, occupation, home address), whether entering or departing, the monetary value with a breakdown if required, and a signed certification that failure to make a full declaration is an offence and can result in seizure, fines and/or imprisonment; its notes state that monetary instruments include coins, currency, travellers cheques and bearer instruments such as personal cheques; (b) provide information on the origin of the currency, cheques or monetary instruments and their intended use as requested by the Customs Officer, who must record identification and other data and may provide it to the Money Laundering Reporting Authority established by s.9 of the Money Laundering Ordinance, 2008. Failure to make the declaration or provide the information is an offence: fine of £2,000 or imprisonment for 6 months, or both. Territorial scope: St Helena island only; not extrapolated to Ascension or Tristan da Cunha.
procedures.applicability_zh: 触发：携带货币、支票或货币票据，或其任何组合，总额严格超过6,000英镑，或以任何单一或组合币种计的等值金额。方向：进入或离开圣赫勒拿均适用。义务：(a) 以第四附表所载表格申报该事实——该现金申报表记录个人资料（姓名、出生日期与出生国、国籍、职业、家庭住址）、系入境或离境、货币金额（如需附明细），并签署证明：所有申报真实、准确、完整，且知悉未完整申报即属犯罪，可导致货物没收、罚款及/或监禁；附表注释载明货币票据包括硬币、货币、旅行支票及无记名票据（如个人支票）；(b) 按海关关员要求提供该货币、支票或票据来源及预期用途的信息；关员须记录身份识别及其他数据，并可将该信息提供给《2008年反洗钱条例》（Money Laundering Ordinance, 2008）第9条设立的反洗钱报告机构。不申报或不按要求提供信息即属犯罪：罚款2,000英镑或监禁6个月，或两者并罚。地域范围：仅圣赫勒拿岛；不外推至阿森松与特里斯坦达库尼亚。
procedures.timing_en: At the time of entering or departing St Helena, by completing the Fourth Schedule currency declaration form and providing origin and intended-use information as requested by the Customs Officer.
procedures.timing_zh: 于进入或离开圣赫勒拿时，填写第四附表现金申报表，并按海关关员要求提供来源与预期用途信息。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入聖赫勒拿攜嚴格超過6,000英鎊貨幣申報（規例第12(1)條及第四附表，《Customs and Excise (Arriving and Departing Ships and Aircraft) Regulations, 2016》，2026-07-01官方合併版）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 觸發：攜帶貨幣、支票或貨幣票據，或其任何組合，總額嚴格超過6,000英鎊，或以任何單一或組合幣種計的等值金額。方向：進入或離開聖赫勒拿均適用。義務：(a) 以第四附表所載表格申報該事實——該現金申報表記錄個人資料（姓名、出生日期與出生國、國籍、職業、家庭住址）、系入境或離境、貨幣金額（如需附明細），並簽署證明：所有申報真實、準確、完整，且知悉未完整申報即屬犯罪，可導致貨物沒收、罰款及/或監禁；附表註釋載明貨幣票據包括硬幣、貨幣、旅行支票及無記名票據（如個人支票）；(b) 按海關關員要求提供該貨幣、支票或票據來源及預期用途的資訊；關員須記錄身份識別及其他資料，並可將該資訊提供給《2008年反洗錢條例》（Money Laundering Ordinance, 2008）第9條設立的反洗錢報告機構。不申報或不按要求提供資訊即屬犯罪：罰款2,000英鎊或監禁6個月，或兩者並罰。地域範圍：僅聖赫勒拿島；不外推至阿森松與特里斯坦達庫尼亞。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於進入或離開聖赫勒拿時，填寫第四附表現金申報表，並按海關關員要求提供來源與預期用途資訊。

procedures.name_en: Arrival goods declaration
procedures.name_zh: 入境货物申报
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes du Sénégal (DGD)
procedures.applicability_en: On arrival the traveller must declare in detail the goods carried; relief from duties and taxes does not remove this declaration obligation. Accompanied personal effects are generally declared verbally. Where customs channels are in place, passing through the 'Nothing to declare' or 'Goods to declare' corridor itself counts as the declaration; per the DGD traveller guide this channel form exists, for now, only at certain customs offices (the guide cites Dakar-Yoff) and is not generalized to all border posts. Used personal effects showing no commercial intent are admitted duty-free, and the guide grants tolerances (personal gold or silver jewellery up to 50 g; 10 packets of cigarettes or 50 cigars or 250 g of tobacco, or a proportionate assortment up to 250 g; one bottle of spirits and one bottle of wine; tobacco and alcohol tolerances are excluded for persons under 18). These quantities are quoted from the old guide and are not re-confirmed as current. Relief goods must not be sold or given away locally, and unconsumed goods must be re-exported at the end of the stay. Basis: the DGD traveller guide on the former douanes-senegal.com site, still returned complete this round, while the same /ndn69/ path is not found on the current douanes.sn main site, so current validity is unconfirmed. The guide's currency figures are superseded and are not used here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境旅客须就其携带的货物作详细申报；免税不免除申报义务。随行个人物品一般为口头申报。设有海关通道的口岸，走“无申报”或“有申报”通道本身即视同申报；据海关总署旅客指南，该通道形式目前仅存在于部分海关（指南举例达喀尔-约夫），不泛化到所有口岸。在用且无商业性质的个人物品免税，指南另列容忍量（个人金银首饰不超过50克；香烟10包或雪茄50支或烟草250克，或按比例混合不超过250克；烈酒1瓶、葡萄酒1瓶；未满18岁无烟酒容忍量）。上述数量引自旧指南，未重新核实现行性，不作为现行免税承诺。免税物品不得在塞内加尔当地出售或转让，未消耗品须在停留结束时复带出境。依据：旧站douanes-senegal.com旅客指南（本轮仍完整可读），但相同/ndn69/路径在现行douanes.sn主站未见，现行性未经当前主站证实。指南中的现金数字已被取代，不用于本程序。
procedures.timing_en: At entry; relief goods that are unconsumed must be re-exported at the end of the stay.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时；未消耗的免税物品须在停留结束时复带出境。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境貨物申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境旅客須就其攜帶的貨物作詳細申報；免稅不免除申報義務。隨行個人物品一般為口頭申報。設有海關通道的口岸，走“無申報”或“有申報”通道本身即視同申報；據海關總署旅客指南，該通道形式目前僅存在於部分海關（指南舉例達喀爾-約夫），不泛化到所有口岸。在用且無商業性質的個人物品免稅，指南另列容忍量（個人金銀首飾不超過50克；香菸10包或雪茄50支或菸草250克，或按比例混合不超過250克；烈酒1瓶、葡萄酒1瓶；未滿18歲無煙酒容忍量）。上述數量引自舊指南，未重新核實現行性，不作為現行免稅承諾。免稅物品不得在塞內加爾當地出售或轉讓，未消耗品須在停留結束時復帶出境。依據：舊站douanes-senegal.com旅客指南（本輪仍完整可讀），但相同/ndn69/路徑在現行douanes.sn主站未見，現行性未經當前主站證實。指南中的現金數字已被取代，不用於本程序。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時；未消耗的免稅物品須在停留結束時復帶出境。

procedures.name_en: Traveller personal-effects limits under section 27(c)
procedures.name_zh: 第27(c)条旅客个人物品额度
procedures.agency: National Revenue Authority, Sierra Leone
procedures.applicability_en: NRA’s explanation of Tax and Duty Exemption Act 2023 section 27(c) limits treatment as travellers’ personal effects to no more than 0.25 litre eau de toilette and 50 grams perfume. It concerns customs treatment of excess quantities, not a ban on carrying those products. The source does not verify a general baggage declaration form, cash threshold or precious-stone export licence.
procedures.applicability_zh: NRA对2023年税费豁免法第27(c)条的说明规定：作为旅客个人物品的花露水不超过0.25升、香水不超过50克。该条说明海关怎样处理超量，并非禁止携带这些产品。此来源未证明一般行李表、现金门槛或宝石出口许可。
procedures.timing_en: When customs examines traveller baggage.
procedures.timing_zh: 海关查验旅客行李时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 第27(c)條旅客個人物品額度
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: NRA對2023年稅費豁免法第27(c)條的說明規定：作為旅客個人物品的花露水不超過0.25升、香水不超過50克。該條說明海關怎樣處理超量，並非禁止攜帶這些產品。此來源未證明一般行李表、現金門檻或寶石出口許可。

procedures.name_en: Simplified definitive declaration for accompanied traveller baggage (Arrêté 118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI of 8 June 2020)
procedures.name_zh: 随行旅客行李简化最终申报（2020年6月8日第118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI号令）
procedures.agency: Office Togolais des Recettes (OTR) — Commissariat des Douanes et Droits Indirects
procedures.applicability_en: Article 2 of Arrêté 118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI (signed Lomé, 8 June 2020) lists baggage accompanying travellers as one class eligible for simplified definitive customs declarations, which customs may authorise; the same article's CFA 250,000 ceiling attaches only to a different class, goods in frontier traffic, and no value ceiling is stated for baggage. Article 5 allows the simplified and global declarations to be drawn up by the traveller personally or by approved customs brokers (commissionnaires en douane agréés). Article 3's minimum particulars still include the rate and amount of entry duties, so this is a clearance simplification, not an exemption from declaration or duties. The arrêté prescribes no form medium and no fee.
procedures.applicability_zh: 第118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI号令（2020年6月8日于洛美签署）第2条将旅客随行行李列为可适用简化最终海关申报的货物类别之一（须经海关授权）；同条250,000（25万）FCFA上限仅针对另一类别即边境贸易货物，条文未对行李设定价值上限。第5条允许简化申报及汇总申报由旅客本人或经认可的报关行（commissionnaires en douane agréés）编制。第3条所列最低申报要素仍包括进口关税税率与应收金额，故此系通关简化而非免申报或免税。该令未规定表格介质，亦未规定费用。
procedures.timing_en: When accompanied baggage is cleared through customs.
procedures.timing_zh: 随行行李办理海关通关时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 隨行旅客行李簡化最終申報（2020年6月8日第118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI號令）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 第118/MEF/OTR/CG/CDDI號令（2020年6月8日於洛美簽署）第2條將旅客隨行行李列為可適用簡化最終海關申報的貨物類別之一（須經海關授權）；同條250,000（25萬）FCFA上限僅針對另一類別即邊境貿易貨物，條文未對行李設定價值上限。第5條允許簡化申報及彙總申報由旅客本人或經認可的報關行（commissionnaires en douane agréés）編制。第3條所列最低申報要素仍包括進口關稅稅率與應收金額，故此係通關簡化而非免申報或免稅。該令未規定表格介質，亦未規定費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 隨行行李辦理海關通關時。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of physical transport of cash and bearer negotiable instruments (Instructions 002-03-2025 and 231/07/2024)
procedures.name_zh: 现金及无记名可转让票据实运申报（002-03-2025号及231/07/2024号指令）
procedures.agency: BCEAO (instructions applicable in TG as a UMOA member state); declared to the Customs administration at the entry or exit point
procedures.applicability_en: Togo is named among the eight UMOA member states, so these BCEAO instructions apply in Togo. Physical cash and bearer negotiable instruments transported from one member state to another must be declared to the Customs administration at the entry or exit point from CFA 10,000,000 (Instruction 002-03-2025, signed 18 March 2025 and in force on signature). When entering from or leaving for a third state, the same transport must be declared from CFA 5,000,000 (Instruction 231/07/2024, signed 16 July 2024 and in force on signature, expressly repealing Instruction 008-09-2017). Both thresholds are route-based comparators ('le seuil à partir duquel'), stated in CFA, with no aggregation rule in either text. This is a distinct legal family from the resident/non-resident traveller foreign-currency declaration under Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE, with a different population, direction and comparators, and no common Togo form may be assumed between the two. Neither instruction prescribes a form medium or a fee.
procedures.applicability_zh: 多哥被列为UMOA八个成员国之一，故下列BCEAO指令适用于多哥。在成员国之间运输现金及无记名可转让票据，自10,000,000（1,000万）FCFA起须在出入境点向海关申报（第002-03-2025号指令，2025年3月18日签署并于当日生效）。自第三国入境或前往第三国时，同类运输自5,000,000（500万）FCFA起须申报（第231/07/2024号指令，2024年7月16日签署并于当日生效，明确废止第008-09-2017号指令）。两项门槛均按路线区分（条文表述为“自该金额起的门槛”），以FCFA计，两文本均无累计规则。本程序与第06/07/2025/RFE号指令下居民/非居民旅客外币申报属不同法律类别——适用人群、方向与比较标准均不同——不得假定两者共用同一多哥表格。两指令均未规定表格介质与费用。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of crossing the border point while transporting the cash or instruments.
procedures.timing_zh: 携带现金或票据经出入境点跨境之时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及無記名可轉讓票據實運申報（002-03-2025號及231/07/2024號指令）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 多哥被列為UMOA八個成員國之一，故下列BCEAO指令適用於多哥。在成員國之間運輸現金及無記名可轉讓票據，自10,000,000（1,000萬）FCFA起須在出入境點向海關申報（第002-03-2025號指令，2025年3月18日簽署並於當日生效）。自第三國入境或前往第三國時，同類運輸自5,000,000（500萬）FCFA起須申報（第231/07/2024號指令，2024年7月16日簽署並於當日生效，明確廢止第008-09-2017號指令）。兩項門檻均按路線區分（條文表述為“自該金額起的門檻”），以FCFA計，兩文本均無累計規則。本程序與第06/07/2025/RFE號指令下居民/非居民旅客外幣申報屬不同法律類別——適用人群、方向與比較標準均不同——不得假定兩者共用同一多哥表格。兩指令均未規定表格介質與費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 攜帶現金或票據經出入境點跨境之時。

procedures.name_en: Resident and non-resident traveller foreign-currency declaration (Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE)
procedures.name_zh: 居民及非居民旅客外币申报（第06/07/2025/RFE号指令）
procedures.agency: BCEAO / UEMOA Commission (instruction applicable in TG as a UEMOA member state)
procedures.applicability_en: Togo is named among the eight UMOA member states, so Instruction 06/07/2025/RFE (issued under Règlement 06/2024/CM/UEMOA of 20 December 2024; effective 1 August 2025, repealing the 2011 traveller-allocation instruction) applies in Togo. Its traveller declaration duties are: residents travelling to non-UEMOA states declare the foreign-currency cash they carry when its CFA countervalue exceeds CFA 3,000,000 (art. 4); non-residents declare in writing, on the model annexed to the instruction, at entry and at exit, foreign-currency cash payment means whose CFA countervalue exceeds CFA 500,000 (art. 7). A declaration under this procedure does not by itself authorise carrying foreign banknotes without limit: export of foreign banknotes above the CFA 500,000 ceiling remains subject to separate conditions (art. 8), which are not themselves a filing duty and are recorded only as background in the report. Amounts are measured as CFA countervalue; 'excède' is strictly above. This is a distinct legal family from the route-based declaration of physical cash and bearer negotiable instruments under Instructions 002-03-2025 and 231/07/2024, with a different population, direction and comparators, and no common Togo form may be assumed between the two. The instruction's allocation-delivery, surrender and carry-limit provisions for residents are separate exchange controls, not declaration duties, and are deliberately excluded from this procedure.
procedures.applicability_zh: 多哥被列为UMOA八个成员国之一，故第06/07/2025/RFE号指令（依据2024年12月20日第06/2024/CM/UEMOA号条例发布；2025年8月1日生效，废止2011年旅客配额指令）适用于多哥。其旅客申报义务为：居民前往非UEMOA国家，随身携带外币现金折合超过3,000,000（300万）FCFA时须申报（第4条）；非居民出入境时须按指令附件所示格式书面申报折合超过500,000（50万）FCFA的外币现金支付工具（第7条）。本程序项下的申报本身并不授权无限额携带外币纸钞：携出超过500,000（50万）FCFA上限的外币纸钞仍须满足另行条件（第8条），该条件本身并非申报义务，仅作为背景载于报告。金额按FCFA折合计算；“excède”（超过）指严格高于。本程序与第002-03-2025号、第231/07/2024号指令下按路线区分的现金及无记名可转让票据申报属不同法律类别——适用人群、方向与比较标准均不同——不得假定两者共用同一多哥表格。指令中有关居民配额交付、售汇及携出限额的条款系另行外汇管制，非申报义务，明确排除于本程序之外。
procedures.timing_en: Non-residents: on entry and on exit (art. 7); residents: when carrying foreign-currency cash to a non-UEMOA state (art. 4).
procedures.timing_zh: 非居民：入境及出境时（第7条）；居民：携带外币现金前往非UEMOA国家时（第4条）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 居民及非居民旅客外幣申報（第06/07/2025/RFE號指令）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 多哥被列為UMOA八個成員國之一，故第06/07/2025/RFE號指令（依據2024年12月20日第06/2024/CM/UEMOA號條例發佈；2025年8月1日生效，廢止2011年旅客配額指令）適用於多哥。其旅客申報義務為：居民前往非UEMOA國家，隨身攜帶外幣現金摺合超過3,000,000（300萬）FCFA時須申報（第4條）；非居民出入境時須按指令附件所示格式書面申報摺合超過500,000（50萬）FCFA的外幣現金支付工具（第7條）。本程序項下的申報本身並不授權無限額攜帶外幣紙鈔：攜出超過500,000（50萬）FCFA上限的外幣紙鈔仍須滿足另行條件（第8條），該條件本身並非申報義務，僅作為背景載於報告。金額按FCFA摺合計算；“excède”（超過）指嚴格高於。本程序與第002-03-2025號、第231/07/2024號指令下按路線區分的現金及無記名可轉讓票據申報屬不同法律類別——適用人群、方向與比較標準均不同——不得假定兩者共用同一多哥表格。指令中有關居民配額交付、售匯及攜出限額的條款系另行外匯管制，非申報義務，明確排除於本程序之外。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 非居民：入境及出境時（第7條）；居民：攜帶外幣現金前往非UEMOA國家時（第4條）。

procedures.name_en: Traveller customs declaration on entry (Customs Act s. 89(1); Customs (Declaration Form) Regulations C169-9)
procedures.name_zh: 入境旅客海关申报（Customs Act s89(1)；海关（申报表）条例 C169-9）
procedures.agency: Anguilla Customs Department
procedures.applicability_en: Every person entering Anguilla must make the declarations referred to in section 89(1) of the Customs Act by completing the form set out in the Schedule, or a form to like effect (Customs (Declaration Form) Regulations, R.R.A. C169-9, s. 1(1)). An entrant may make these declarations on behalf of an accompanying spouse or of a child who has not attained 18 years, and a person declared for need not declare again (s. 1(2)-(3)). Section 89(1) of the Customs Act determines what must be declared: anything in his baggage or carried with him that he obtained outside Anguilla, or dutiable or chargeable goods obtained in Anguilla without payment of duty, in respect of which he is not entitled to exemption from duty or tax by virtue of any enactment. Text read from the Revised Edition of 15/12/2010; later amendment status not verified in this batch.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每名进入安圭拉的人均须填写《海关（申报表）条例》（R.R.A. C169-9）第1(1)条 Schedule 所列表格或同效表，以完成 Customs Act 第89(1) 条所指的申报。入境者可代同行配偶或未满18岁子女作出申报，被代报者无须重复申报（第1(2)-(3)条）。Customs Act 第89(1) 条决定须披露的货物范围：行李内或随身携带、在安圭拉境外取得之物，或在安圭拉境内未完税取得的应课税（dutiable）/应征税费（chargeable）货物，且无任何成文法豁免资格者。以上文本出自2010年12月15日修订版重编本，本批未核实后续修订。
procedures.timing_en: On entry to Anguilla, at such place and in such manner as the Comptroller may direct with the approval of the Governor in Council (Customs Act s. 89(1)).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境安圭拉时，于 Comptroller 经总督会同行政局批准所指示的地点与方式办理（Customs Act s89(1)）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境旅客海關申報（Customs Act s89(1)；海關（申報表）條例 C169-9）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每名進入安圭拉的人均須填寫《海關（申報表）條例》（R.R.A. C169-9）第1(1)條 Schedule 所列表格或同效表，以完成 Customs Act 第89(1) 條所指的申報。入境者可代同行配偶或未滿18歲子女作出申報，被代報者無須重複申報（第1(2)-(3)條）。Customs Act 第89(1) 條決定須披露的貨物範圍：行李內或隨身攜帶、在安圭拉境外取得之物，或在安圭拉境內未完稅取得的應課稅（dutiable）/應徵稅費（chargeable）貨物，且無任何成文法豁免資格者。以上文本出自2010年12月15日修訂版重編本，本批未核實後續修訂。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境安圭拉時，於 Comptroller 經總督會同行政局批准所指示的地點與方式辦理（Customs Act s89(1)）。

procedures.name_en: Currency and monetary instruments report on entry or departure (Customs Act s. 89(2)(a); Customs (Currency Report) Regulations C169-10)
procedures.name_zh: 出入境货币及货币票据报告（Customs Act s89(2)(a)；海关（货币报告）条例 C169-10）
procedures.agency: Anguilla Customs Department
procedures.applicability_en: A person entering or leaving Anguilla in possession of currency, cheques or monetary instruments, or any combination thereof, of or exceeding $27,000, or the equivalent in any currency or combination of currencies, must declare and make a report in such form and manner as the Comptroller directs (Customs Act s. 89(2)(a)). For entrants, the Customs (Currency Report) Regulations, R.R.A. C169-10, s. 1 require every person entering with currency or monetary instruments totalling over $27,000 to answer the questions contained in the scheduled form, or a form to like effect, in accordance with s. 89(2). The two texts differ on entry at exactly $27,000: the Act says 'of or exceeding' (inclusive, entry and departure) while the Regulations say 'over' (strictly exceeding, entry only); this record states both as written and leaves the conflict open — the Regulations cannot be read as exempting departure or as narrowing the Act's inclusive threshold. The Regulations' wording also omits 'cheques'. The statute writes only '$27,000'; no official currency definition is readable in this batch, so no USD or other conversion is made. This is the s. 89(2)/C169-10 currency report, not a duplicate field of the general baggage declaration. Text read from the Revised Edition of 15/12/2010 (s. 89(2) amended by Act 15/2010, s. 19); later amendment status not verified in this batch.
procedures.applicability_zh: 出入安圭拉（入境或出境）的人，如持有现金（currency）、支票（cheques）或货币票据（monetary instruments）或其任何组合，达‘$27,000 或以上’（of or exceeding，含本数），或任何货币或货币组合的等值，须按 Comptroller 指示的表格与方式申报并作出报告（Customs Act s89(2)(a)）。就入境者，《海关（货币报告）条例》（R.R.A. C169-10）第1条规定：携现金或货币票据合计‘超过 $27,000’（over，严格超过）者，须按 s89(2) 回答 Schedule 表格（或同效表）中的问题。两文本在入境且恰为 $27,000 时不一致：主法为含本数、入出境双向；条例为严格超过、仅入境。本记录按原文并列、留冲突未决——不得由条例推出出境免报，也不得以其严格超过收窄主法的含本数。条例措辞亦未列‘支票’。法条仅写 ‘$27,000’，本批无可读的官方币种定义，故不作美元或其他换算。本程序是 s89(2)/C169-10 项下的货币报告，并非一般行李申报表的重复字段。文本出自2010年12月15日修订版重编本（s89(2) 经 2010年第15号法令第19条修正），本批未核实后续修订。
procedures.timing_en: At entry or departure, in such form and manner and containing such particulars as the Comptroller may direct (Customs Act s. 89(2)(a)).
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境时，按 Comptroller 指示的表格、方式与内容要件办理（Customs Act s89(2)(a)）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境貨幣及貨幣票據報告（Customs Act s89(2)(a)；海關（貨幣報告）條例 C169-10）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 出入安圭拉（入境或出境）的人，如持有現金（currency）、支票（cheques）或貨幣票據（monetary instruments）或其任何組合，達‘$27,000 或以上’（of or exceeding，含本數），或任何貨幣或貨幣組合的等值，須按 Comptroller 指示的表格與方式申報並作出報告（Customs Act s89(2)(a)）。就入境者，《海關（貨幣報告）條例》（R.R.A. C169-10）第1條規定：攜現金或貨幣票據合計‘超過 $27,000’（over，嚴格超過）者，須按 s89(2) 回答 Schedule 表格（或同效表）中的問題。兩文本在入境且恰為 $27,000 時不一致：主法為含本數、入出境雙向；條例為嚴格超過、僅入境。本記錄按原文並列、留衝突未決——不得由條例推出出境免報，也不得以其嚴格超過收窄主法的含本數。條例措辭亦未列‘支票’。法條僅寫 ‘$27,000’，本批無可讀的官方幣種定義，故不作美元或其他換算。本程序是 s89(2)/C169-10 項下的貨幣報告，並非一般行李申報表的重複欄位。文本出自2010年12月15日修訂版重編本（s89(2) 經 2010年第15號法令第19條修正），本批未核實後續修訂。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境時，按 Comptroller 指示的表格、方式與內容要件辦理（Customs Act s89(2)(a)）。

procedures.name_en: Electronic Immigration and Customs form for airport arrivals (ArriveAntigua.com)
procedures.name_zh: 机场入境电子移民及海关表（ArriveAntigua.com）
procedures.agency: Antigua and Barbuda immigration/customs authorities (operator of ArriveAntigua.com not named on the airport page; passenger guidance published by V.C. Bird International Airport)
procedures.applicability_en: Passengers travelling to Antigua and Barbuda through V.C. Bird International Airport are encouraged to complete their Immigration and Customs declaration online before arrival at www.ArriveAntigua.com; the previous physical ED card has been replaced by this fully integrated electronic system. Once the form is completed a QR code is issued (save a screenshot, add it to iPhone Wallet, or keep the email confirmation available), and all passengers arriving at V.C. Bird International Airport will be asked to present the Arrive Antigua QR code at customs. Assistance is available on arrival for passengers who require support. No app download is required; the form can be completed using a mobile phone, tablet, or computer, and includes a short questionnaire with questions relating to the stay and customs declaration. The page lists faster arrival and departure processing as a use of the QR code, without creating a separate departure procedure. Answering customs questions and declaring goods obtained abroad or in excess of allowances are recorded separately under AG-arrival-customs-declaration and are not waived by the electronic form.
procedures.applicability_zh: 经V.C. Bird国际机场前往安提瓜和巴布达的旅客获鼓励在抵达前于 www.ArriveAntigua.com 在线填写移民及海关申报表；原纸质ED卡已被该一体化电子系统替代。完成后获发二维码（可截图保存、加入iPhone钱包或保留邮件确认），所有抵达V.C. Bird国际机场的旅客在海关处将被要求出示Arrive Antigua二维码。抵达现场为需要协助的旅客提供协助。无需下载App，可用手机、平板或电脑填写；表内含与停留及海关申报有关的简短问卷。页面另将“抵达与出境更快捷”列为出示二维码的用途，但未据此设立单独的出境程序。回答海关提问及申报境外取得物品、超额货物的义务另记于 AG-arrival-customs-declaration，不因电子表而免除。
procedures.timing_en: Within 72 hours of the scheduled flight, before arrival: the same day of travel, the day before travel, or up to three days before travel.
procedures.timing_zh: 预定航班时间前72小时内、抵达前填写：出行当天、前一天或最迟三天前均可。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 機場入境電子移民及海關表（ArriveAntigua.com）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 經V.C. Bird國際機場前往安提瓜和巴布達的旅客獲鼓勵在抵達前於 www.ArriveAntigua.com 線上填寫移民及海關申報表；原紙質ED卡已被該一體化電子系統替代。完成後獲發 QR Code（可截圖保存、加入iPhone錢包或保留郵件確認），所有抵達V.C. Bird國際機場的旅客在海關處將被要求出示Arrive AntiguaQR Code。抵達現場為需要協助的旅客提供協助。無需下載App，可用手機、平板或電腦填寫；表內含與停留及海關申報有關的簡短問卷。頁面另將“抵達與出境更快捷”列為出示 QR Code 的用途，但未據此設立單獨的出境程序。回答海關提問及申報境外取得物品、超額貨物的義務另記於 AG-arrival-customs-declaration，不因電子表而免除。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 預定航班時間前72小時內、抵達前填寫：出行當天、前一天或最遲三天前均可。

procedures.name_en: Arrival Customs Declaration (goods in excess of the duty-free allowance; cash and negotiable instruments over USD 10,000)
procedures.name_zh: 入境海关申报（超免税额货物；超过10,000美元的现金及可转让票据）
procedures.agency: Customs and Excise Division, Antigua and Barbuda (passenger guidance published by V.C. Bird International Airport)
procedures.applicability_en: At V.C. Bird International Airport, arriving passengers proceed to the designated Customs line — the "Nothing to Declare" line, or the "Declare" line if they have something to declare — and should have their Declaration form ready. Per the airport page, the Customs Declaration only needs to be completed by those arriving in Antigua and Barbuda if they have goods in excess of their duty-free allowance; when more than one member of the same household is travelling together, one household member may complete a combined Customs declaration. Cash and negotiable instruments of a value strictly greater than USD $10,000 must be declared to Customs — "cash" includes coins and banknotes in any currency, and "negotiable instruments" include cheques, travellers' cheques, promissory notes, and money orders; the page is arriving-passenger guidance and states no corresponding departure threshold. Separately, the Customs and Excise Division's Airport Baggage Section page states that all persons entering the country are required by law to declare to Customs anything contained in their baggage, or carried with them, which has been obtained outside of Antigua and Barbuda, and to answer all questions asked by the Customs Officer relating to their travels, baggage, contents and other items being imported; this is a general legal duty on all entrants to declare to Customs and answer the officer's questions, not a requirement that every entrant complete the excess-goods Customs Declaration. The same customs page describes the paper combined Immigration/Customs declaration forms distributed at ports of entry and exit, airline and ships agents, and their offices, and advises filling out the declaration in advance of arrival. Neither page states the relationship between the paper combined form and the ArriveAntigua electronic form, nor whether the excess-goods Customs Declaration is completed on paper or within the electronic form; these remain open under AG-audit-3.
procedures.applicability_zh: 在V.C. Bird国际机场，入境旅客前往指定海关队列——“Nothing to Declare”（无申报）队，或如物品须申报则改走“Declare”（申报）队——并应备妥Declaration form（申报表）。按机场页，只有携带超出免税额货物的抵安提瓜和巴布达者才需完成Customs Declaration；同户多名成员同行时，可由一名成员完成合并海关申报。价值严格大于（>）10,000美元（USD $10,000）的现金及可转让票据须向海关申报——“现金”含任何币种的硬币与纸币，“可转让票据”含支票、旅行支票、本票及汇票；该页属入境旅客指引，未陈述对应的出境申报门槛。另据海关及货物税局本域Airport Baggage Section页：所有入境人员依法须向海关申报其行李中或随身携带、在安提瓜和巴布达境外取得的物品，并须回答海关关员就其旅行、行李及内容物与其他进口物品提出的全部问题；此为加于全体入境者“向海关申报并回答关员询问”的一般法定义务，并非要求全体入境者填写超额货物的Customs Declaration。同一海关页述及纸质合并Immigration/Customs申报表于入出境口岸、航司与船舶代理及其办事处发放，并建议抵达前预先填妥。两页均未说明该纸质合并表与ArriveAntigua电子表的关系，亦未说明超额货物Customs Declaration的填写载体（纸质或在电子表内）；两项仍列为未知，记于AG-audit-3。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival customs; the Customs Division page advises completing the declaration in advance of arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时在海关办理；海关及货物税局页建议抵达前预先填妥申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境海關申報（超免稅額貨物；超過10,000美元的現金及可轉讓票據）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 在V.C. Bird國際機場，入境旅客前往指定海關隊列——“Nothing to Declare”（無申報）隊，或如物品須申報則改走“Declare”（申報）隊——並應備妥Declaration form（申報表）。按機場頁，只有攜帶超出免稅額貨物的抵安提瓜和巴布達者才需完成Customs Declaration；同戶多名成員同行時，可由一名成員完成合並海關申報。價值嚴格大於（>）10,000美元（USD $10,000）的現金及可轉讓票據須向海關申報——“現金”含任何幣種的硬幣與紙幣，“可轉讓票據”含支票、旅行支票、本票及匯票；該頁屬入境旅客指引，未陳述對應的出境申報門檻。另據海關及貨物稅局本域Airport Baggage Section頁：所有入境人員依法須向海關申報其行李中或隨身攜帶、在安提瓜和巴布達境外取得的物品，並須回答海關關員就其旅行、行李及內容物與其他進口物品提出的全部問題；此為加於全體入境者“向海關申報並回答關員詢問”的一般法定義務，並非要求全體入境者填寫超額貨物的Customs Declaration。同一海關頁述及紙質合併Immigration/Customs申報表於入出境口岸、航司與船舶代理及其辦事處發放，並建議抵達前預先填妥。兩頁均未說明該紙質合併表與ArriveAntigua電子表的關係，亦未說明超額貨物Customs Declaration的填寫載體（紙質或在電子表內）；兩項仍列為未知，記於AG-audit-3。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時在海關辦理；海關及貨物稅局頁建議抵達前預先填妥申報。

procedures.name_en: Entry and exit money notification (MOT)
procedures.name_zh: 出入境资金通知（MOT）
procedures.agency: Departamento di Aduana (Customs Department), Aruba
procedures.applicability_en: Entering or leaving Aruba with strictly more than AWG 20,000 in cash or securities, including the equivalent in foreign currencies (to be converted into Aruban florins), must be notified to the Customs Department (Departamento di Aduana) with an MOT form (Unusual Transactions form) available at the Customs counter at the airport or harbor. Carrying exactly AWG 20,000 does not trigger the notification duty. You must also report cash or securities that you carry for someone else. The duty applies in both directions, at entry and at exit.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境或出境阿鲁巴时，携带现金或证券严格超过AWG 20,000（即多于20,000阿鲁巴弗罗林；恰为20,000不触发申报义务），含等值外币（须折算为阿鲁巴弗罗林后判断），须向海关部门（Departamento di Aduana）申报：在机场或港口的海关柜台领取并填写MOT表格（Unusual Transactions）。代他人携带的现金或证券同样必须申报。该义务在入境与出境两个方向均适用。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entry or exit, at the Customs counter at the airport or harbor.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或出境时，在机场或港口的海关柜台办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境資金通知（MOT）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境或出境阿魯巴時，攜帶現金或證券嚴格超過AWG 20,000（即多於20,000阿魯巴弗羅林；恰為20,000不觸發申報義務），含等值外幣（須折算為阿魯巴弗羅林後判斷），須向海關部門（Departamento di Aduana）申報：在機場或港口的海關櫃檯領取並填寫MOT表格（Unusual Transactions）。代他人攜帶的現金或證券同樣必須申報。該義務在入境與出境兩個方向均適用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或出境時，在機場或港口的海關櫃檯辦理。

procedures.name_en: Passenger goods customs declaration on arrival
procedures.name_zh: 抵境旅客货物海关申报
procedures.agency: Departamento di Aduana (Customs Department), Aruba
procedures.applicability_en: Travelers arriving in Aruba by plane or boat can declare goods orally or in writing at the Customs Department (Departamento di Aduana) counter at the airport or harbor. A written declaration is always required for commercial goods, temporary export goods, and goods for which conditional exemption can be granted. Allowance background only (no separate submission act; goods above the allowances are declared and taxed): used personal goods brought temporarily to Aruba (e.g. clothing or a camera) are free of customs duties; passengers aged 16 or older are entitled to exemption from import and excise duties on passenger luggage — 200 cigarettes or 25 cigars or 50 cigarillos (each weighing not more than 3 grams) or 250 g of tobacco; 1 liter of spirits or 2.25 liters of wine or 3 liters of beer; and other goods up to a total invoice value of AWG 900 (raised from AWG 400 with effect from 1 April 2024). The exemption covers only goods for personal use, not for trade or use in a business or profession; the goods must be in the passenger's own possession, and exemption cannot be claimed for goods brought in as a group. Quantities or values above these maxima incur import and excise duties; certain goods are prohibited or require a permit (e.g. drones, medicines, plants, meat).
procedures.applicability_zh: 乘飞机或船抵达阿鲁巴的旅客，可在机场或港口的海关部门（Departamento di Aduana）柜台以口头或书面方式申报所携货物；商用货物、临时出口货物以及可获有条件免税的货物必须始终书面申报。以下免税额度仅作申报适用背景（额度本身不是提交动作，超出者须申报并缴税）：临时带入阿鲁巴的自用旧物（如衣物、相机）免缴海关税；年满16岁的旅客可就行李获得进口税与消费税免税——烟草为200支香烟或25支雪茄或50支小雪茄（每支不超过3克）或250克烟草，酒类为1升烈酒或2.25升葡萄酒或3升啤酒，其他货物按发票总值最高AWG 900（自2024年4月1日起由AWG 400上调）。该免税仅限自用（非贸易、经营或职业用途）且货物须在旅客本人占有之下，不得多人合并申报免税；超过上述限量或限额须缴进口税及消费税；部分货物禁止携带入境或须许可证（如无人机、药品、植物、肉类）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Aruba, at the Customs counter at the airport or harbor.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达阿鲁巴时，在机场或港口的海关柜台办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵境旅客貨物海關申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 乘飛機或船抵達阿魯巴的旅客，可在機場或港口的海關部門（Departamento di Aduana）櫃檯以口頭或書面方式申報所攜貨物；商用貨物、臨時出口貨物以及可獲有條件免稅的貨物必須始終書面申報。以下免稅額度僅作申報適用背景（額度本身不是提交動作，超出者須申報並繳稅）：臨時帶入阿魯巴的自用舊物（如衣物、相機）免繳海關稅；年滿16歲的旅客可就行李獲得進口稅與消費稅免稅——菸草為200支香菸或25支雪茄或50支小雪茄（每支不超過3克）或250克菸草，酒類為1升烈酒或2.25升葡萄酒或3升啤酒，其他貨物按發票總值最高AWG 900（自2024年4月1日起由AWG 400上調）。該免稅僅限自用（非貿易、經營或職業用途）且貨物須在旅客本人佔有之下，不得多人合併申報免稅；超過上述限量或限額須繳進口稅及消費稅；部分貨物禁止攜帶入境或須許可證（如無人機、藥品、植物、肉類）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達阿魯巴時，在機場或港口的海關櫃檯辦理。

procedures.name_en: Accompanied baggage declaration (Form C17)
procedures.name_zh: 随行行李申报（C17表）
procedures.agency: Bahamas Customs Department
procedures.applicability_en: For travellers entering The Bahamas. Disembarking passengers must make an oral declaration of all goods they are carrying or which are in their baggage, and complete this form in respect of any goods that are liable to duty; members of a family residing in the same household and travelling together may make a single declaration. A written declaration is required from persons carrying currency or monetary instruments of B$10,000 or more (threshold inclusive) or the foreign-currency equivalent; the reverse of the form defines currency to include cash, travellers cheques and drafts, and directs travellers carrying cash, negotiable instruments, precious metals or precious stones of a value equivalent to B$10,000 or more to read those notes before completing all items. Duty-free allowances: for adults only, alcoholic beverages up to one quart of spirits and one quart of wine, and tobacco up to one pound in weight or 200 cigarettes or 50 cigars; any other articles up to a value of $500.00, which is an allowance and not a filing threshold. The form warns that false or incorrect declarations and prohibited or restricted goods (including fruit or other plant materials, animals, birds, drugs, firearms) attract penalties and possible forfeiture. This 2018 Form C17 replaced the Form C17 in the First Schedule of the Customs Management Regulations 2013 with effect from 1 July 2018 (official Ministry of Finance scan). Later amendment history is only partly checked: the 2026 amendment regulations visible on the official yearly listing do not alter this form, and 2019-2025 remain unchecked (see unresolved). The form's separate instruction that 'each person or responsible family member travelling is required to complete this form' is broader than the dutiable-goods condition; this record does not claim that every arriving traveller must complete a C17. No declaration requirement is established for departures. No form-handling fee is stated; duty paid on dutiable goods is tax, not a form fee.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于入境巴哈马的旅客。下机/下船旅客须就其携带或行李中的所有货物先作口头申报，并仅就应税货物完成本表；同住一户且同行的家庭成员可合并填报一份。携带现金或货币工具达 B$10,000 或以上（含本数）或等值外币者须作书面申报；表背面对 currency 的定义包括现金、旅行支票、汇票等，并提示携带现金、可流通票据、贵金属或宝石价值达 B$10,000 或以上者先读背面说明再填全表。免税优惠：仅限成人——酒精饮料不超过一夸脱烈酒及一夸脱葡萄酒，烟草不超过一磅或200支香烟或50支雪茄；其他物品价值不超过 $500.00，此为免税优惠额度而非填表门槛。表格警示虚假或错误申报及违禁/受限货物（含水果或其他植物材料、动物、鸟类、毒品、枪支）将受处罚并可没收。本2018年版 C17 表自2018年7月1日起替换《2013海关管理条例》第一附表的 C17 表（据财政部官方扫描件）。其后修订史仅部分核查：官方2026年列表所见两份修订条例不改动本表，2019-2025年未查（见 unresolved）。表中另有“每位旅客或负责任的家庭成员须完成本表”的指示，较应税条件为宽；本记录不断言所有入境旅客一律填表。未确立离境申报要求。表本身未规定办理手续费；应税货物所缴关税为税款而非表格费用。
procedures.timing_en: On entering The Bahamas (disembarking passengers).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境巴哈马时（下机/下船旅客）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 隨行行李申報（C17表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於入境巴哈馬的旅客。下機/下船旅客須就其攜帶或行李中的所有貨物先作口頭申報，並僅就應稅貨物完成本表；同住一戶且同行的家庭成員可合併填報一份。攜帶現金或貨幣工具達 B$10,000 或以上（含本數）或等值外幣者須作書面申報；表背面對 currency 的定義包括現金、旅行支票、匯票等，並提示攜帶現金、可流通票據、貴金屬或寶石價值達 B$10,000 或以上者先讀背面說明再填全表。免稅優惠：僅限成人——酒精飲料不超過一夸脫烈酒及一夸脫葡萄酒，菸草不超過一磅或200支香菸或50支雪茄；其他物品價值不超過 $500.00，此為免稅優惠額度而非填表門檻。表格警示虛假或錯誤申報及違禁/受限貨物（含水果或其他植物材料、動物、鳥類、毒品、槍支）將受處罰並可沒收。本2018年版 C17 表自2018年7月1日起替換《2013海關管理條例》第一附表的 C17 表（據財政部官方掃描件）。其後修訂史僅部分核查：官方2026年列表所見兩份修訂條例不改動本表，2019-2025年未查（見 unresolved）。表中另有“每位旅客或負責任的家庭成員須完成本表”的指示，較應稅條件為寬；本記錄不斷言所有入境旅客一律填表。未確立離境申報要求。表本身未規定辦理手續費；應稅貨物所繳關稅為稅款而非表格費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境巴哈馬時（下機/下船旅客）。

procedures.name_en: Online Immigration and Customs Form (single combined submission, including passenger customs declaration Form C.23)
procedures.name_zh: 在线移民与海关合并表（一次提交，含C.23旅客海关申报）
procedures.agency: Barbados Immigration Department (online form portal) and Customs & Excise Department (Form C.23 under Customs Act Cap. 66)
procedures.applicability_en: All travellers to Barbados complete one online Immigration and Customs Form and, once completed, save or print the Immigration and Customs receipts for presentation on arrival — the two receipts belong to this single submission, not two procedures. The customs part is Form C.23 (Passenger Customs Declaration, Customs Act Cap. 66, as substituted by the Customs (Amendment) Regulations 2020): every traveller, or head of a family travelling with children under 18, must complete a Customs Form. Its Yes/No questions cover pieces of luggage; fruits, plants, cut flowers, vegetables, soil, meat, live animals and organisms, honey, wildlife products, plant material, food; pharmaceuticals; narcotics and other illicit drugs, biological substances, arms, ammunition, explosives and other weapons; commercial merchandise; and carrying currency or monetary instruments over BDS$10,000 or equivalent — a question inside the same submission, not a separate form. It also asks citizens/residents aged 18 or more whether they have claimed the duty exemption on goods up to BDS$500 per calendar year; all passengers aged 18 or more may bring wine or spirits not exceeding 1 litre.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有赴巴巴多斯旅客须完成一份在线移民与海关合并表，完成后将移民与海关两份回执存入手机或打印、抵达时出示——两份回执同属一次提交，不拆成两个程序。海关部分即C.23旅客海关申报表（海关法Cap. 66，经2020年《海关（修订）条例》替换）：表载明每位旅客或携未满18岁子女同行的家长须完成海关表。是/否问项涵盖行李件数；水果、植物、切花、蔬菜、土壤、肉类、活体动物及生物、蜂蜜、野生动植物产品、植物材料、食品；药品；麻醉品及其他毒品、生物制品、枪械、弹药、爆炸物及其他武器；商业物品；以及携带超过10,000巴巴多斯元（BDS$10,000）等值的现金或票据——该现金点仅是同一份提交内的问项，不另立表格。表内另问18岁及以上公民/居民本年度是否已申报过每历年不超过500巴巴多斯元（BDS$500）的免税额；所有18岁及以上旅客可携葡萄酒或烈酒不超过1升。
procedures.timing_en: The online form will be available 72 hours prior to arrival in Barbados; travellers fill it in at a time and place convenient to them and present the two receipts to Immigration and Customs on arrival. The 72 hours marks when the online window opens, not a deadline to file 72 hours in advance; neither source states an advance-filing deadline. The 2020 regulation sets no time window for Form C.23.
procedures.timing_zh: 在线合并表自抵达巴巴多斯前72小时起开放可用；旅客可在方便的时间与地点填写，抵达时向移民与海关出示两份回执。72小时是在线窗口的开放时点，并非必须提前72小时提交；两源均未载提前提交截止时限。2020年条例对C.23表未设时间窗。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 線上移民與海關合並表（一次提交，含C.23旅客海關申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有赴巴巴多斯旅客須完成一份線上移民與海關合並表，完成後將移民與海關兩份回執存入手機或列印、抵達時出示——兩份回執同屬一次提交，不拆成兩個程序。海關部分即C.23旅客海關申報表（海關法Cap. 66，經2020年《海關（修訂）條例》替換）：表載明每位旅客或攜未滿18歲子女同行的家長鬚完成海關表。是/否問項涵蓋行李件數；水果、植物、切花、蔬菜、土壤、肉類、活體動物及生物、蜂蜜、野生動植物產品、植物材料、食品；藥品；麻醉品及其他毒品、生物製品、槍械、彈藥、爆炸物及其他武器；商業物品；以及攜帶超過10,000巴巴多斯元（BDS$10,000）等值的現金或票據——該現金點僅是同一份提交內的問項，不另立表格。表內另問18歲及以上公民/居民本年度是否已申報過每歷年不超過500巴巴多斯元（BDS$500）的免稅額；所有18歲及以上旅客可攜葡萄酒或烈酒不超過1升。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 線上合併表自抵達巴巴多斯前72小時起開放可用；旅客可在方便的時間與地點填寫，抵達時向移民與海關出示兩份回執。72小時是線上窗口的開放時點，並非必須提前72小時提交；兩源均未載提前提交截止時限。2020年條例對C.23表未設時間窗。

procedures.name_en: Entry and exit cash declaration in Caribbean Netherlands
procedures.name_zh: 加勒比荷兰出入境现金申报
procedures.agency: Belastingdienst Caribisch Nederland — Douane (Customs, Caribbean Netherlands: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba)
procedures.applicability_en: Entering or departing Caribbean Netherlands with USD 10,000 or more in cash or negotiable instruments requires declaration, including foreign-currency equivalents and money carried for someone else. People demonstrably travelling together must also report a joint total of USD 10,000 or more. Obtain, complete and submit the form at airport or seaport Customs. No tax is due merely for reporting. 2026-09-29 current page wording: the threshold is inclusive — 'USD 10,000 or more' — and applies whether the carrier owns the cash or is carrying it for somebody else; foreign-currency amounts are converted to USD for the threshold.
procedures.applicability_zh: 出入加勒比荷兰携带达到或超过10,000美元的现金或可转让票据须申报，包括等值外币及代他人携带。确实同行的人合计达到该金额也须申报。在机场或海港海关领取、填写并提交表格；申报本身不产生税款。 2026-09-29 现行页面措辞：门槛为含本数「USD 10,000 or more」，无论携带自有现金还是替他人携带均须申报；外币按美元折算计槛。
procedures.timing_en: At entry or departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或离境时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 加勒比荷蘭出入境現金申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 出入加勒比荷蘭攜帶達到或超過10,000美元的現金或可轉讓票據須申報，包括等值外幣及代他人攜帶。確實同行的人合計達到該金額也須申報。在機場或海港海關領取、填寫並提交表格；申報本身不產生稅款。 2026-09-29 現行頁面措辭：門檻為含本數「USD 10,000 or more」，無論攜帶自有現金還是替他人攜帶均須申報；外幣按美元折算計檻。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或離境時。

procedures.name_en: Online ED Card — one online submission covering immigration entry information and the goods declaration to His Majesty's Customs (Virgin Islands)
procedures.name_zh: 在线出入境卡（Online ED Card）——英属维尔京群岛一次在线提交，同时涵盖移民入境资料与向国王海关的货物申报
procedures.agency: Department of Immigration, Government of the Virgin Islands (the embedded declaration section is made to His Majesty's Customs; portal bviedcard.gov.vg; assistance contact edprocessing@gov.vg)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers complete the Online ED Card at bviedcard.gov.vg by filling the arrival, personal, travel destination, family (where applicable), and declaration sections of one form. The immigration entry information and the goods declaration to His Majesty's Customs are sections of this single form and one submission, not two procedures. Upon successful completion the applicant receives one email entailing completion notifications for both entry and declaration of goods to His Majesty's Customs, and the barcode-bearing documents are presented to the Immigration Officer and the Customs Officer. The card can be completed as early as 72 hours prior to travel date, or as late as upon arrival, but must be completed before seeking entry from an Immigration Officer. There is no charge to obtain an Online ED Card, and BVIEDCARD.GOV.VG is the only official website for the service.
procedures.applicability_zh: 旅客在 bviedcard.gov.vg 填写在线 ED 卡，完成同一张表单的 arrival（抵达）、personal（个人资料）、travel destination（旅行目的地）、family（如适用）与 declaration（申报）各部分。移民入境资料与向国王海关（His Majesty's Customs）的货物申报是这张单一表单的组成部分、属同一次提交，并非两个程序。成功完成后，申请人收到一封邮件，同时载明入境与向国王海关货物申报两项完成通知；含条形码的文件向移民官与海关官出示。该卡最早可在旅行日前 72 小时填写，最晚可到抵达时，但必须在向移民官寻求入境之前完成。办理 ED 卡不收取费用，BVIEDCARD.GOV.VG 是该项服务唯一的官方网站。
procedures.timing_en: The card "can be completed as early as 72 hours prior to travel date, or as late as upon arrival, but must be completed before seeking entry from an Immigration Officer" (10 January 2025 announcement). 72 hours before travel is the earliest opening window, not a mandatory advance deadline.
procedures.timing_zh: 该卡“最早可在旅行日前 72 小时填写，最晚可到抵达时，但必须在向移民官寻求入境之前完成”（2025-01-10 公告原文）。行前 72 小时是最早开放窗口，并非强制提前期限。

fee.note: 2026-02-02 移民局公告原文：There is NO charge to obtain an Online ED Card to enter The Virgin Islands。零费用仅指 ED 卡本身，不含货物关税、税费或违规罚款，也不延伸至法定现金申报的任何可能的办理成本。Free per the 2 February 2026 Immigration Department bulletin; the zero covers the ED Card only — not duties/taxes on goods or penalties.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 線上出入境卡（Online ED Card）——英屬維爾京群島一次線上提交，同時涵蓋移民入境資料與向國王海關的貨物申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 旅客在 bviedcard.gov.vg 填寫線上 ED 卡，完成同一張表單的 arrival（抵達）、personal（個人資料）、travel destination（旅行目的地）、family（如適用）與 declaration（申報）各部分。移民入境資料與向國王海關（His Majesty's Customs）的貨物申報是這張單一表單的組成部分、屬同一次提交，並非兩個程序。成功完成後，申請人收到一封郵件，同時載明入境與向國王海關貨物申報兩項完成通知；含條形碼的文件向移民官與海關官出示。該卡最早可在旅行日前 72 小時填寫，最晚可到抵達時，但必須在向移民官尋求入境之前完成。辦理 ED 卡不收取費用，BVIEDCARD.GOV.VG 是該項服務唯一的官方網站。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 該卡“最早可在旅行日前 72 小時填寫，最晚可到抵達時，但必須在向移民官尋求入境之前完成”（2025-01-10 公告原文）。行前 72 小時是最早開放窗口，並非強制提前期限。

procedures.name_en: Money declaration on entry and officer-inquiry disclosure on departure (CI$10,000 or more)
procedures.name_zh: 现金申报：入境书面申报达CI$10,000或等值；出境仅在官员询问时披露
procedures.agency: Customs & Border Control Service, Cayman Islands Government
procedures.applicability_en: In-bound (SL 39 of 2019, reg. 3(1)): a person transporting into the Islands money amounting in the aggregate to ten thousand dollars (CI$10,000) or more, or its equivalent, must declare it in writing to an officer at the time of entry and supply the other particulars required on the form provided - Form C, Report of International Transportation of Money (for amounts of CI$10,000 or more); the declaration card's reverse likewise requires declaring Currency and Negotiable Monetary Instruments valued CI$10,000 or more, foreign equivalent, or a combination of both, and filing the additional particulars on the form provided. Under reg. 3(2) the Director determines the form and may combine the declaration with any other declaration required by law (the card's item 8(d)); Form C is therefore not a separate second procedure. Money covers bank notes or coins that are legal tender in any country plus bearer monetary instruments (cheques, traveller's cheques, promissory notes, money orders, postal orders, bearer negotiable instruments); bullion is not a monetary instrument under the card's definition but must still be declared on entry. Exempt (reg. 3(6)): the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority and common carriers of passengers as to passengers' money. The card front's item 8(d) wording 'over $10,000' conflicts with the reverse instructions, Form C and the regulation, which all read 'or more' and thus include exactly CI$10,000; the regulation governs. The money obligation attaches to the person transporting; no family-aggregation rule for money is stated. Out-bound (reg. 4): reg. 3 applies to money transported out of the Islands except that the disclosure is only required upon verbal or written inquiry by an officer (officers may question any person entering or leaving, reg. 6(1)) - these official sources establish no traveller-initiated departure money form; Form C's official-use field records the basis as 'Declaration' or 'Disclosure', confirming one form with two triggers. Penalties: false declaration - fine up to ten thousand dollars and/or one year's imprisonment plus forfeiture of the money up to the value transported (reg. 3(3)); administrative penalty possible instead (reg. 5); Form C warns of forfeiture of up to 25% of the money and notes a photocopy of your identification document is retained with the form.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境（2019年第39号附属法规第3(1)条）：携带进入群岛、总额达一万开曼元（CI$10,000）或等值者，须在入境时以书面向官员申报，并按所提供表格填报其他详情——即Form C《国际资金运送报告》（适用于CI$10,000或以上）；入境卡背面说明同样要求对达CI$10,000或以上、等值外币或两者合计的现金及可转让票据进行申报，并按所提供表格补交详情。第3(2)条规定表格由主管决定，并可与其他法定申报合并（即卡内第8(d)项），故Form C并非独立的第二程序。现金指任何国家法定货币的纸币或硬币，并含不记名票据（支票、旅行支票、本票、汇票、邮政汇票、不记名可转让票据）；贵金属条块不属该卡定义的货币票据，但入境仍须申报。豁免（第3(6)条）：开曼群岛金融管理局；载客承运人（就乘客款项）。卡正面第8(d)项写'over $10,000'，与背面说明、Form C及法规均写'or more'（含CI$10,000本数）不一致，以法规为准。现金义务归于携带者本人，未见按家庭合并计算的规则。出境（第4条）：第3条同样适用于携出款项，但仅在官员口头或书面询问时才须披露（官员可对出入境任何人员提问，第6(1)条）——本批官源不存在旅客主动出境现金表；Form C官方栏位将依据记为'Declaration'或'Disclosure'，印证一表两用。罚则：虚假申报可罚款最高一万开曼元及/或监禁一年，并没收所携款项（第3(3)条）；亦可改处行政罚（第5条）；Form C警示可没收所运款项的25%，并注明身份证件复印件将随表留存。
procedures.timing_en: In-bound: written declaration to an officer at the time of entry, with the additional Form C particulars on the form provided. Out-bound: disclosure only if an officer makes a verbal or written inquiry.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境：入境时以书面向官员申报，并按所提供表格补交Form C详情。出境：仅在官员口头或书面询问时披露。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金申報：入境書面申報達CI$10,000或等值；出境僅在官員詢問時披露
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境（2019年第39號附屬法規第3(1)條）：攜帶進入群島、總額達一萬開曼元（CI$10,000）或等值者，須在入境時以書面向官員申報，並按所提供表格填報其他詳情——即Form C《國際資金運送報告》（適用於CI$10,000或以上）；入境卡背面說明同樣要求對達CI$10,000或以上、等值外幣或兩者合計的現金及可轉讓票據進行申報，並按所提供表格補交詳情。第3(2)條規定表格由主管決定，並可與其他法定申報合併（即卡內第8(d)項），故Form C並非獨立的第二程序。現金指任何國家法定貨幣的紙幣或硬幣，並含不記名票據（支票、旅行支票、本票、匯票、郵政匯票、不記名可轉讓票據）；貴金屬條塊不屬該卡定義的貨幣票據，但入境仍須申報。豁免（第3(6)條）：開曼群島金融管理局；載客承運人（就乘客款項）。卡正面第8(d)項寫'over $10,000'，與背面說明、Form C及法規均寫'or more'（含CI$10,000本數）不一致，以法規為準。現金義務歸於攜帶者本人，未見按家庭合併計算的規則。出境（第4條）：第3條同樣適用於攜出款項，但僅在官員口頭或書面詢問時才須披露（官員可對出入境任何人員提問，第6(1)條）——本批官源不存在旅客主動出境現金錶；Form C官方欄位將依據記為'Declaration'或'Disclosure'，印證一表兩用。罰則：虛假申報可罰款最高一萬開曼元及/或監禁一年，並沒收所攜款項（第3(3)條）；亦可改處行政罰（第5條）；Form C警示可沒收所運款項的25%，並註明身份證件複印件將隨表留存。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境：入境時以書面向官員申報，並按所提供表格補交Form C詳情。出境：僅在官員口頭或書面詢問時披露。

procedures.name_en: Arrival customs declaration card and duty-free allowances
procedures.name_zh: 入境海关申报卡及免税额度
procedures.agency: Customs & Border Control Service, Cayman Islands Government
procedures.applicability_en: Card policy: persons within their duty-free allowances are not required to complete the form and may proceed through the free-flow channel upon entry; every passenger, or the head of a family travelling together, with goods to be declared must complete it - only ONE written declaration per family. Cayman Islands residents must declare the total value of all articles acquired abroad (by purchase, as a gift or otherwise) in their or their family's possession at arrival; visitors must declare the total value of gifts, foods, spirits, liquor, tobacco products and any articles they intend to leave or consume in the islands (legal basis printed on the card: s. 62 Customs and Border Control Law, 2018 Revision). Allowance (CBC press release, 9 September 2026): effective 1 September 2026, returning residents may bring personal and household goods valued at up to CI$800 duty free at the Director's discretion (amendment to Schedule 2 of the Customs Tariff Act, 2026 Revision); the CI$500 allowance printed on the card is outdated. A temporary CI$1,000 allowance applies only from 23 November 2026 through 7 January 2027, with the permanent CI$800 allowance resuming 8 January 2027; as of late September 2026 the applicable rate is CI$800 - do not apply the winter rate early or to visitors. The allowance covers returning residents' personal and household goods only, not merchandise, commercial goods or items intended for resale; goods exceeding the applicable allowance must be declared with duty paid on the excess. Passengers over 18 (card): up to 1 litre of spirits, or 1 case (not exceeding 8 litres) of beer, or 4 litres of wine; up to 200 cigarettes, or 250 grammes of tobacco, or 25 cigars, or 100 cigarillos. Agricultural items, restricted goods and reportable currency require declaration regardless of allowances.
procedures.applicability_zh: 卡片政策：免税额度内的旅客无须填写本卡，可在入境时走free-flow通道；有需申报物品的旅客或同行家庭负责人须填卡——每个家庭仅一份书面申报。开曼居民须申报入境时其本人或家人持有的所有境外取得物品（购买、受赠或其他方式）总值；访客须申报礼品、食品、烈酒、酒类、烟草制品及拟留在当地或在当地消费的物品总值（卡载法律依据：《海关与边境管制法》2018年修订版第62条）。额度（CBC 2026年9月9日新闻稿）：自2026年9月1日起，返国居民可免税携带价值最高CI$800的个人及家庭用品，由主管酌情（经《关税法》2026年修订版附表2修正）；卡上所印CI$500额度已过时。临时CI$1,000额度仅适用于2026年11月23日至2027年1月7日，2027年1月8日起恢复常设CI$800；截至2026年9月下旬适用额度为CI$800——切勿提前套用冬季额度或将其套用于访客。额度仅限返国居民个人及家庭用品，不适用于商品、商业物品或拟转售物品；超过适用额度的物品须申报并就超出部分缴税。卡载18岁以上旅客：烈酒最多1升，或啤酒1箱（不超过8升），或葡萄酒4升；香烟最多200支，或烟草250克，或雪茄25支，或小雪茄100支。农产品、受限物品及应报现金不论额度仍须申报。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival customs clearance; duty, if any, is assessed on the declared value under the appropriate tariff.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境海关通关时；如需缴税，按申报价值依相应税则核定。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境海關申報卡及免稅額度
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 卡片政策：免稅額度內的旅客無須填寫本卡，可在入境時走free-flow通道；有需申報物品的旅客或同行家庭負責人須填卡——每個家庭僅一份書面申報。開曼居民須申報入境時其本人或家人持有的所有境外取得物品（購買、受贈或其他方式）總值；訪客須申報禮品、食品、烈酒、酒類、菸草製品及擬留在當地或在當地消費的物品總值（卡載法律依據：《海關與邊境管制法》2018年修訂版第62條）。額度（CBC 2026年9月9日新聞稿）：自2026年9月1日起，返國居民可免稅攜帶價值最高CI$800的個人及家庭用品，由主管酌情（經《關稅法》2026年修訂版附表2修正）；卡上所印CI$500額度已過時。臨時CI$1,000額度僅適用於2026年11月23日至2027年1月7日，2027年1月8日起恢復常設CI$800；截至2026年9月下旬適用額度為CI$800——切勿提前套用冬季額度或將其套用於訪客。額度僅限返國居民個人及家庭用品，不適用於商品、商業物品或擬轉售物品；超過適用額度的物品須申報並就超出部分繳稅。卡載18歲以上旅客：烈酒最多1升，或啤酒1箱（不超過8升），或葡萄酒4升；香菸最多200支，或菸草250克，或雪茄25支，或小雪茄100支。農產品、受限物品及應報現金不論額度仍須申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境海關通關時；如需繳稅，按申報價值依相應稅則核定。

procedures.name_en: Traveller Cuban-peso import/export limits and declaration (5,000 CUP free; BCC permission beyond)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客古巴比索自由进出境限额与申报（5,000 CUP；超出需央行许可）
procedures.agency: Aduana General de la República de Cuba / Banco Central de Cuba (BCC)
procedures.applicability_en: Per the Aduana General de la República's official news item (28 March 2022, describing the current Banco Central de Cuba resolution): the free import and export limit for Cuban pesos was raised from 2,000 to 5,000 CUP (verbatim: 'se eleva a 5 000 CUP'). Separately, the same item states a current BCC resolution 'establece como límite para la importación y exportación libre 5 000 MLC' — a 5,000 MLC free import/export limit — and that the international export limit for MLC is 10,000. These two statements are kept distinct as printed; the item does not infer any currency/unit interaction between them. Above the applicable limit, permission from the BCC is required under current rule Resolución 124/2020, with the bank answering requests within seven days and the traveller demonstrating the licit origin of funds. Passengers receive a declaration form on the aircraft itself and declare there ('los pasajeros tienen acceso a un formulario que se les entrega en el propio avión y ahí se declara'). The Res79-2022 BCC PDF could not be downloaded this round (HTTP 404; audit round saw an empty file), so the resolution number/effective date should be confirmed against the Gaceta Oficial or the BCC site. 2026-09-29 re-capture of the Aduana news: free import/export of Cuban pesos 5,000 CUP (raised from 2,000); a BCC resolution in force sets the free MLC limit at 5,000 (import free); above those limits a Banco Central de Cuba permit is required under Resolution 124/2020 and the bank answers within up to seven days.
procedures.applicability_zh: 据古巴海关总署官方新闻（2022年3月28日，说明现行古巴央行决议）：古巴比索自由进出境限额自2,000提高至5,000 CUP（原文：'se eleva a 5 000 CUP'）。同一新闻另行写明现行BCC决议'establece como límite para la importación y exportación libre 5 000 MLC'——即5,000 MLC的自由进出境限额——以及MLC的国际出口限额为10,000。以上两条按原文分别保留，本记录不推断两者之间的币种/单位换算关系。超出适用限额须经古巴央行（BCC）许可（现行第124/2020号决议框架，银行最长7日答复，旅客须证明资金合法来源）。旅客在机上即获发申报表并当场申报（'los pasajeros tienen acceso a un formulario que se les entrega en el propio avión y ahí se declara'）。Res79-2022 BCC 的PDF本轮无法下载（HTTP 404；审计轮为空文件），决议编号/生效日期仍须以官方公报或BCC网站确认。 2026-09-29 海关新闻复取：古巴比索自由出入境额度 5,000 CUP（自 2,000 上调）；现行 BCC 决议规定 MLC 自由额度 5,000（进口自由）；超限须按第 124/2020 号决议申请古巴央行许可，银行至多七日答复。
procedures.timing_en: Declared at the border on arrival/departure; the form is handed out on the aircraft; BCC permission requests answered within seven days.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达/离境时在边境申报；申报表在机上发放；BCC许可申请7日内答复。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客古巴比索自由進出境限額與申報（5,000 CUP；超出需央行許可）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 據古巴海關總署官方新聞（2022年3月28日，說明現行古巴央行決議）：古巴比索自由進出境限額自2,000提高至5,000 CUP（原文：'se eleva a 5 000 CUP'）。同一新聞另行寫明現行BCC決議'establece como límite para la importación y exportación libre 5 000 MLC'——即5,000 MLC的自由進出境限額——以及MLC的國際出口限額為10,000。以上兩條按原文分別保留，本記錄不推斷兩者之間的幣種/單位換算關係。超出適用限額須經古巴央行（BCC）許可（現行第124/2020號決議框架，銀行最長7日答覆，旅客須證明資金合法來源）。旅客在機上即獲發申報表並當場申報（'los pasajeros tienen acceso a un formulario que se les entrega en el propio avión y ahí se declara'）。Res79-2022 BCC 的PDF本輪無法下載（HTTP 404；審計輪為空文件），決議編號/生效日期仍須以官方公報或BCC網站確認。 2026-09-29 海關新聞復取：古巴比索自由出入境額度 5,000 CUP（自 2,000 上調）；現行 BCC 決議規定 MLC 自由額度 5,000（進口自由）；超限須按第 124/2020 號決議申請古巴央行許可，銀行至多七日答覆。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達/離境時在邊境申報；申報表在機上發放；BCC許可申請7日內答覆。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border declaration of cash, electronic wallets and bearer instruments to Customs (entry or exit; statutory duty under Ley 155-17 Art. 65)
procedures.name_zh: 出入境现金、电子钱包及无记名票据海关申报（法定义务，Ley 155-17第65条）
procedures.agency: Dirección General de Aduanas (DGA), República Dominicana
procedures.applicability_en: Statutory duty under Ley núm. 155-17, Artículo 65: every natural person, national or foreign, who enters or leaves the national territory by air, sea or land must present, on the form provided for that purpose by the Dirección General de Aduanas, a declaration notifying whether or not they transport money, electronic wallets, values or negotiable instruments to bearer, for an amount 'igual o superior a' (equal to or greater than) US$10,000.00 or its equivalent in national or foreign currency — the statutory wording is inclusive, so carrying exactly US$10,000 triggers the duty. The notification must include at least: identity, signature and address of the persons transporting or sending; identity and address of the person on whose behalf it is transported; origin and destination of the person; quantity and type of money or values; and their origin and intended use. The DGA traveller guidance requires declaring to DGA officers at the moment of entry or exit, using the form enabled for that purpose, with documents justifying the lawful source of the values. Threshold wording differs across official texts and is preserved as written, without merging: the DGA FAQ writes 'más de US$10,000' (strictly more), the same page's checklist writes bare 'Dinero en efectivo US$10,000' with no operator, the MITUR E-Ticket arrival Customs question writes 'si supera los US$10,000' (strictly exceeds), and the same law's sanction provision for non-declaration phrases the amount as 'exceda' (strictly exceeds) — how exactly US$10,000 is handled inside the online flow is open under DO-audit-4. For air arrivals the cash question sits inside the E-Ticket Customs section; the E-Ticket exit form has no Customs section, so the filing channel for an air passenger exiting with US$10,000 or more is not captured (DO-audit-6). The DGA FAQ states that no taxes are charged for carrying money itself.
procedures.applicability_zh: 第155-17号法律（Ley núm. 155-17）第65条设立的法定义务：任何自然人——本国人或外国人——经空路、海路或陆路进入或离开国家领土时，必须以海关总局（DGA）为此提供的表格提交申报，声明是否携带金额『igual o superior a』（等于或超过）10,000.00美元或其本币/外币等值的现金、电子钱包、有价物或无记名可转让票据——法定措辞含本数，恰携10,000美元即触发申报义务。申报须至少包含：运送或寄送人的身份、签名与地址；受托运送对象的身份与地址；当事人的来源地与目的地；钱款或有价物的数量与种类；及其来源与拟用途。DGA旅客指引要求于入境或出境时向DGA关员申报，使用专设表格并出示证明该等价值合法来源的文件。各官方文本阈值措辞不一，按原文分别保留、不合并：DGA FAQ写『más de US$10,000』（严格超过），同页清单写无比较词的『Dinero en efectivo US$10,000』，MITUR E-Ticket入境海关问项写『si supera los US$10,000』（严格超过），同一法律的未申报制裁条款又写『exceda』（严格超过）——恰10,000美元者在线流程内如何处理留DO-audit-4未决。空路入境的现金问项位于E-Ticket海关部分内；E-Ticket出境表无海关部分，空路旅客出境携带10,000美元及以上时的申报载体未捕获（DO-audit-6）。DGA FAQ明示携带资金本身不征税。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entry or exit, before DGA officers, using the form enabled for that purpose.
procedures.timing_zh: 于入境或出境时，向DGA关员以专设表格办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境現金、電子錢包及無記名票據海關申報（法定義務，Ley 155-17第65條）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 第155-17號法律（Ley núm. 155-17）第65條設立的法定義務：任何自然人——本國人或外國人——經空路、海路或陸路進入或離開國家領土時，必須以海關總局（DGA）為此提供的表格提交申報，聲明是否攜帶金額『igual o superior a』（等於或超過）10,000.00美元或其本幣/外幣等值的現金、電子錢包、有價物或無記名可轉讓票據——法定措辭含本數，恰攜10,000美元即觸發申報義務。申報須至少包含：運送或寄送人的身份、簽名與地址；受託運送對象的身份與地址；當事人的來源地與目的地；錢款或有價物的數量與種類；及其來源與擬用途。DGA旅客指引要求於入境或出境時向DGA關員申報，使用專設表格並出示證明該等價值合法來源的文件。各官方文本閾值措辭不一，按原文分別保留、不合並：DGA FAQ寫『más de US$10,000』（嚴格超過），同頁清單寫無比較詞的『Dinero en efectivo US$10,000』，MITUR E-Ticket入境海關問項寫『si supera los US$10,000』（嚴格超過），同一法律的未申報制裁條款又寫『exceda』（嚴格超過）——恰10,000美元者線上流程內如何處理留DO-audit-4未決。空路入境的現金問項位於E-Ticket海關部分內；E-Ticket出境表無海關部分，空路旅客出境攜帶10,000美元及以上時的申報載體未捕獲（DO-audit-6）。DGA FAQ明示攜帶資金本身不徵稅。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 於入境或出境時，向DGA關員以專設表格辦理。

procedures.name_en: Traveller arrival customs declaration: online ED form and red/green channel at Maurice Bishop International Airport
procedures.name_zh: 旅客到达海关申报：在线ED表与莫里斯·毕晓普国际机场红绿通道
procedures.agency: Grenada Customs and Excise Division
procedures.applicability_en: All persons entering Grenada are required by law to declare to Customs anything contained in their baggage, or carried with them, which has been obtained outside of Grenada, and must answer all questions asked by the Customs Officer relating to their travels, baggage, its contents and other items being imported. This is one single traveller arrival customs declaration procedure, not two separate applications or forms. Submission channel — Online ED Form: travellers are required to complete the online Immigration and Customs Form (the Customs page links the Online ED Form to edcard.gov.gd), which is available 72 hours prior to arrival; once completed, the Immigration and Customs receipts should be saved to the passenger's mobile device or printed, for presentation to Customs upon arrival; passengers are asked to be honest when filling the declarations — misinformation can result in delays and penalties. On-arrival step — red/green channel: the page states Customs has 2 channels at Maurice Bishop International Airport; this record confines the red/green channel step to that airport and does not extend it to other ports of entry. Green Channel (Nothing to Declare): fast clearance for passengers carrying only permissible items; passing through it signifies a "deemed declaration" that the passenger has no items exceeding duty-free allowances, nor any banned/restricted items; random checks may still occur. Red Channel (Goods to Declare): for declaring goods that require duty payment or special clearance — i.e. excess, high-value, restricted or commercial items; passengers must declare items to customs officials, and failure to do so can result in fines, seizures, or legal action; if unsure whether items are allowed or taxable, always choose the red channel. Duty-free allowances are conditions of this procedure, not a separate form: tobacco goods 200 cigarettes or 50 cigars or 250 grams of tobacco; alcohol 1 litre of wine or 1 litre of spirits; perfumed spirits 10 fluid ounces; other goods to the value of EC$1,000.00. No relief is afforded to any person who enters Grenada after an absence therefrom of less than twenty-four (24) hours; no relief for any person under the age of eighteen (18) years in respect of spirits (other than perfumed spirits), tobacco goods or wine; and no relief is granted if the articles are brought in for commercial purposes. Duties/taxes payable on red-channel goods are distinct from any service fee for the declaration itself; the current page contains no service-fee information for the declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有入境格林纳达的人员依法须向海关申报其行李中所含或随身携带、在格林纳达境外取得的任何物品，并须回答海关官员就其旅行、行李及其内容与其他进口物品所提的全部问题。这是同一条旅客到达海关申报程序，不是两项独立申请或两张表格。提交渠道——在线ED表：旅客须填写在线移民与海关表格（海关页将该表链接至 edcard.gov.gd），于抵达前72小时开放；填写完成后，移民与海关回执应保存于乘客移动设备或打印，抵达时向海关出示；填写申报须诚实——不实信息可导致延误与处罚。抵达现场步骤——红/绿通道：页面载明海关在莫里斯·毕晓普国际机场（Maurice Bishop International Airport）设有2条通道；本记录将红/绿通道步骤限于该机场，不外推至其他入境口岸。绿道（Nothing to Declare）：供仅携带允许物品的旅客快速通关；走过绿道即构成“视同申报”（deemed declaration），表示没有超过免税额度的物品，也没有禁止或受限物品；仍可能被抽查。红道（Goods to Declare）：用于申报须缴关税或特别清关的物品，即超额、高价值、受限或商用物品；旅客须向海关官员申报，未申报可致罚款、没收或法律行动；如不确定物品是否被允许或应税，应一律走红道。免税额度是本程序的条件而非独立表单：烟草类200支香烟或50支雪茄或250克烟草；酒类1升葡萄酒或1升烈酒；香酒（perfumed spirits）10液盎司；其他物品价值不超过EC$1,000.00。下列情形不获免税：离开格林纳达不足二十四（24）小时即入境者；未满十八（18）岁者就烈酒（香酒除外）、烟草类或葡萄酒不获免税；物品为商业目的带入的一律不获免税。红道物品应缴的关税/税款与申报本身的服务费分立；现行页面未载明申报本身的任何服务费。
procedures.timing_en: Online ED form available 72 hours prior to arrival; receipts presented to Customs on arrival, when the red/green channel step takes place at Maurice Bishop International Airport.
procedures.timing_zh: 在线ED表于抵达前72小时开放；抵达时向海关出示回执，并在莫里斯·毕晓普国际机场进行红/绿通道步骤。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客到達海關申報：線上ED表與莫里斯·畢曉普國際機場紅綠通道
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有入境格林納達的人員依法須向海關申報其行李中所含或隨身攜帶、在格林納達境外取得的任何物品，並須回答海關官員就其旅行、行李及其內容與其他進口物品所提的全部問題。這是同一條旅客到達海關申報程序，不是兩項獨立申請或兩張表格。提交渠道——線上ED表：旅客須填寫線上移民與海關表格（海關頁將該表連結至 edcard.gov.gd），於抵達前72小時開放；填寫完成後，移民與海關回執應保存於乘客移動設備或列印，抵達時向海關出示；填寫申報須誠實——不實資訊可導致延誤與處罰。抵達現場步驟——紅/綠通道：頁面載明海關在莫里斯·畢曉普國際機場（Maurice Bishop International Airport）設有2條通道；本記錄將紅/綠通道步驟限於該機場，不外推至其他入境口岸。綠道（Nothing to Declare）：供僅攜帶允許物品的旅客快速通關；走過綠道即構成“視同申報”（deemed declaration），表示沒有超過免稅額度的物品，也沒有禁止或受限物品；仍可能被抽查。紅道（Goods to Declare）：用於申報須繳關稅或特別清關的物品，即超額、高價值、受限或商用物品；旅客須向海關官員申報，未申報可致罰款、沒收或法律行動；如不確定物品是否被允許或應稅，應一律走紅道。免稅額度是本程序的條件而非獨立表單：菸草類200支香菸或50支雪茄或250克菸草；酒類1升葡萄酒或1升烈酒；香酒（perfumed spirits）10液盎司；其他物品價值不超過EC$1,000.00。下列情形不獲免稅：離開格林納達不足二十四（24）小時即入境者；未滿十八（18）歲者就烈酒（香酒除外）、菸草類或葡萄酒不獲免稅；物品為商業目的帶入的一律不獲免稅。紅道物品應繳的關稅/稅款與申報本身的服務費分立；現行頁面未載明申報本身的任何服務費。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 線上ED表於抵達前72小時開放；抵達時向海關出示回執，並在莫里斯·畢曉普國際機場進行紅/綠通道步驟。

procedures.name_en: Guadeloupe traveler goods franchises and excess-goods declaration by origin
procedures.name_zh: 瓜德罗普旅客物品按来源地的免税额度与超额申报
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (French Customs) — Direction régionale des douanes de Guadeloupe
procedures.applicability_en: Guadeloupe (with Martinique) is a French overseas department inside the EU customs territory but a distinct fiscal territory, treated as a third territory fiscally even towards metropolitan France, so flows between the DOM and metropole or another EU member state count as imports/exports. Arriving in Guadeloupe from metropolitan France or an EU country: no customs duty is due; TVA, octroi de mer and octroi de mer régional apply to goods bought or received as gifts, but no tax is due while total value is EUR 1,000 or less (inclusive); quantity franchises also apply (tobacco: 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g smoking tobacco; 4 L still wine and 16 L beer, plus either 1 L of beverages over 22 degrees or 2 L at 22 degrees or below). Arriving from a non-EU country: customs duty (flat-rate 2.5% option or per-product taxation), TVA and octroi apply; nothing is due while value is EUR 150 or less for travellers under 15, or EUR 430 or less for travellers aged 15 and over (inclusive). Only when the applicable value or quantity franchise is exceeded must the traveller declare the goods and pay the duties and taxes due; the franchise itself is not a separate procedure or form. Travellers under 17 have no tobacco or alcohol franchise on either route; proportional assortment is allowed within one category of goods; allowances of several travellers cannot be pooled for a single item, and an over-threshold item is taxed on its full value without abatement. Octroi rates are set locally (indicatively 7-15%, up to 20/25/50% for certain goods; regional octroi 1.5% or 2.5%). Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy follow their own COM rules and are out of scope here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 瓜德罗普（与马提尼克）为法国海外省，位于欧盟关境之内，但财政上属独立税区、即使对法国本土也视同第三地区，故本土/其他欧盟成员国与该省之间的往来按进出口处理。从法国本土或欧盟国家抵达瓜德罗普：无关税，仅就购买或受赠物品涉及 TVA、octroi de mer 与 octroi de mer régional，但物品总值不超过（含本数）1,000 欧元即无需纳税；并适用数量免税（烟草：200 支香烟或 100 支小雪茄或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟丝；4 升静葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒，另加 1 升 22 度以上或 2 升 22 度及以下饮品）。从非欧盟国家抵达：涉及关税（可选 2.5% 从简计税或按产品计税）、TVA 及 octroi；未满 15 岁旅客物品价值不超过（含本数）150 欧元、15 岁及以上旅客不超过（含本数）430 欧元即无需缴纳。仅当超过适用价值或数量额度时，旅客才须申报物品并缴纳相应税费；免税额度本身不是独立程序或表单。未满 17 岁在任何方向均无烟酒免税；同类商品内可按比例搭配；多人额度不能合并抵一件物品，超限单件按全部价值计税、不予减免。octroi 税率由地方设定（指示性 7–15%，部分商品可达 20/25/50%；地方 octroi régional 为 1.5% 或 2.5%）。圣马丁、圣巴泰勒米适用各自 COM 规则，不在本程序范围。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival or return to Guadeloupe, only for goods exceeding the applicable value or quantity franchise.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达或返回瓜德罗普时，仅针对超过适用价值或数量额度的物品。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 瓜德羅普旅客物品按來源地的免稅額度與超額申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 瓜德羅普（與馬提尼克）為法國海外省，位於歐盟關境之內，但財政上屬獨立稅區、即使對法國本土也視同第三地區，故本土/其他歐盟成員國與該省之間的往來按進出口處理。從法國本土或歐盟國家抵達瓜德羅普：無關稅，僅就購買或受贈物品涉及 TVA、octroi de mer 與 octroi de mer régional，但物品總值不超過（含本數）1,000 歐元即無需納稅；並適用數量免稅（菸草：200 支香菸或 100 支小雪茄或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸絲；4 升靜葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒，另加 1 升 22 度以上或 2 升 22 度及以下飲品）。從非歐盟國家抵達：涉及關稅（可選 2.5% 從簡計稅或按產品計稅）、TVA 及 octroi；未滿 15 歲旅客物品價值不超過（含本數）150 歐元、15 歲及以上旅客不超過（含本數）430 歐元即無需繳納。僅當超過適用價值或數量額度時，旅客才須申報物品並繳納相應稅費；免稅額度本身不是獨立程序或表單。未滿 17 歲在任何方向均無煙酒免稅；同類商品內可按比例搭配；多人額度不能合併抵一件物品，超限單件按全部價值計稅、不予減免。octroi 稅率由地方設定（指示性 7–15%，部分商品可達 20/25/50%；地方 octroi régional 為 1.5% 或 2.5%）。聖馬丁、聖巴泰勒米適用各自 COM 規則，不在本程序範圍。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達或返回瓜德羅普時，僅針對超過適用價值或數量額度的物品。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration for proven routes between Guadeloupe and a foreign country
procedures.name_zh: 已证路线的现金申报：瓜德罗普与外国之间
procedures.agency: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (French Customs) — DALIA teleservice
procedures.applicability_en: Only for directions proven in the official texts: transporting cash of EUR 10,000 or more (inclusive, or the equivalent in other currencies) between Guadeloupe (a DROM) and a foreign country — a non-EU third country or another EU member state — must be declared to French Customs. Covered cash includes banknotes and coins, bearer or endorsable negotiable instruments (bearer cheques, traveller cheques, non-domiciled commercial paper and letters of credit, money orders, anonymous cashier's notes, bearer securities) and gold; prepaid cards only for intra-EU flows. Transports between metropolitan France and Guadeloupe are expressly outside the declaration scope. Routes between Guadeloupe and other DROM/COM (e.g. Martinique, Saint-Martin, Saint-Barthélemy) are not named in the cached texts and are not asserted here (see unresolved GP-cash-route-gp-mq). Any natural person, French resident or not, is covered, including minors acting through parents or legal representatives; funds carried for a third party require identification of the owner. Filing is online via DALIA, or on paper — harmonized EU form for extra-EU movements, national FR form for intra-EU movements, both expressly covering DOM/DROM routes — with the customs service; no declaration can be filed a posteriori. Non-declaration, false or incomplete declaration exposes the person to a fine of up to 50% of the sum concerned, plus temporary retention of the funds. Local goods-tax differences are not equated with border cash obligations.
procedures.applicability_zh: 仅限官方正文已证方向：在瓜德罗普（DROM）与外国——非欧盟第三国或其他欧盟成员国——之间运送现金达 10,000 欧元（含本数，或等值外币）即须向法国海关申报。所涉现金包括纸币硬币、无记名或可背书流通票据（无记名支票、旅行支票、未指定兑付地的商业票据与信用证、汇款单、匿名储蓄凭证、无记名有价证券）及黄金；预付卡仅限欧盟内流向。法国本土与瓜德罗普之间的运送明确不在申报范围。瓜德罗普与其他 DROM/COM（如马提尼克、圣马丁、圣巴泰勒米）之间的路线未见于缓存正文，本记录不作断言（见未决 GP-cash-route-gp-mq）。任何自然人无论是否法国居民均适用，未成年人经父母或法定代理人申报；代第三人运送资金须载明所有人身份。可经 DALIA 在线申报，或以纸质表——欧盟外流向用统一 EU 表、欧盟内流向用国家 FR 表，两表均明列 DOM/DROM 路线——交海关办理；不得事后补报。未申报、虚假或不完整申报可处涉案金额最高 50% 罚款，并临时扣留资金。地方货物税区差异不视为国境现金义务。
procedures.timing_en: Via DALIA at the earliest 30 days before the transport date and at the latest before crossing the border on the day of travel; or with the customs service at the moment of entry into or exit from French territory.
procedures.timing_zh: 经 DALIA 最早可于运送日前 30 天、最迟于旅行当日越境前申报；或在入出法国国境时交海关办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 已證路線的現金申報：瓜德羅普與外國之間
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 僅限官方正文已證方向：在瓜德羅普（DROM）與外國——非歐盟第三國或其他歐盟成員國——之間運送現金達 10,000 歐元（含本數，或等值外幣）即須向法國海關申報。所涉現金包括紙幣硬幣、無記名或可背書流通票據（無記名支票、旅行支票、未指定兌付地的商業票據與信用證、匯款單、匿名儲蓄憑證、無記名有價證券）及黃金；預付卡僅限歐盟內流向。法國本土與瓜德羅普之間的運送明確不在申報範圍。瓜德羅普與其他 DROM/COM（如馬提尼克、聖馬丁、聖巴泰勒米）之間的路線未見於緩存正文，本記錄不作斷言（見未決 GP-cash-route-gp-mq）。任何自然人無論是否法國居民均適用，未成年人經父母或法定代理人申報；代第三人運送資金須載明所有人身份。可經 DALIA 線上申報，或以紙質表——歐盟外流向用統一 EU 表、歐盟內流向用國家 FR 表，兩表均明列 DOM/DROM 路線——交海關辦理；不得事後補報。未申報、虛假或不完整申報可處涉案金額最高 50% 罰款，並臨時扣留資金。地方貨物稅區差異不視為國境現金義務。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 經 DALIA 最早可於運送日前 30 天、最遲於旅行當日越境前申報；或在入出法國國境時交海關辦理。
