procedures.name_en: Entry and exit cash and receivables declaration
procedures.name_zh: 出入境现金及应收凭证申报
procedures.agency: Agencia Nacional de Aduanas de México (ANAM)
procedures.applicability_en: Anyone entering or leaving Mexico carrying a combined amount strictly more than US$10,000 equivalent — cash, domestic or foreign cheques, payment orders, any other documents receivable, or a combination — must declare to customs; exactly US$10,000 does not trigger the duty. On entry use the «Declaración de Aduana para pasajeros procedentes del extranjero»; on exit the «Declaración de dinero, salida de pasajeros». If the >US$10,000 answer is yes, additionally complete the detailed «Declaración de Internación o Extracción de Cantidades en Efectivo y/o Documento por Cobrar». The captured arrival form says that this detailed form may be requested from customs staff at ports of entry. Carrying the amount is legal; non-declaration is fined 20–40% of the excess, with imprisonment and forfeiture for larger unreported or illicit-origin amounts.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何人入出墨西哥，携带现金、本国或外国支票、支付指令、其他应收凭证或其合计严格超过10,000美元等值，须向海关申报；恰为10,000美元不触发。入境使用《来自外国的旅客海关申报表》，出境使用《出境旅客资金申报表》；勾选超过10,000美元后，另填《现金及/或应收凭证入出境详情表》。所核入境表说明可向入境口岸海关人员索取该详情表。携带本身合法，未申报按超额部分处20%–40%罚款，未申报数额较大或来源非法另有徒刑及没收。
procedures.timing_en: At the port in either direction: arrival uses the passenger customs declaration, departure the money declaration; both add the detailed form once the US$10,000 threshold is exceeded.
procedures.timing_zh: 在口岸按方向办理：入境用旅客海关表，出境用资金表；任一方向超过1万美元均须加填详情表。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境現金及應收憑證申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何人入出墨西哥，攜帶現金、本國或外國支票、支付指令、其他應收憑證或其合計嚴格超過10,000美元等值，須向海關申報；恰為10,000美元不觸發。入境使用《來自外國的旅客海關申報表》，出境使用《出境旅客資金申報表》；勾選超過10,000美元后，另填《現金及/或應收憑證入出境詳情表》。所核入境表說明可向入境口岸海關人員索取該詳情表。攜帶本身合法，未申報按超額部分處20%–40%罰款，未申報數額較大或來源非法另有徒刑及沒收。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在口岸按方向辦理：入境用旅客海關表，出境用資金錶；任一方向超過1萬美元均須加填詳情表。

procedures.name_en: Arrival declaration of taxable goods beyond baggage and allowance
procedures.name_zh: 入境行李及免税额以外应税货物申报
procedures.agency: Agencia Nacional de Aduanas de México (ANAM)
procedures.applicability_en: Arrival only, conditional: the ANAM passenger customs declaration asks whether the traveller carries taxable merchandise additional to baggage and franquicia; when yes, it records the goods and their value. Franquicia itself is a US$500-equivalent exemption for goods other than baggage entering by land, air or sea, which a family declaring together may pool; alcoholic beverages, manufactured tobacco and motor fuel are excluded. Baggage and goods within the allowance do not by themselves require a taxable-goods entry in the arrival declaration; the official form still says to complete the passenger declaration in full. Qualifying excess goods may be taxed at the 19% global rate where value excluding the allowance is no more than US$3,000 (US$4,000 including computer equipment).
procedures.applicability_zh: 仅限入境、条件触发：ANAM旅客海关申报表询问是否携带行李及免税额(franquicia)以外应税货物，答是即填报货物及其价值。免税额本身是陆/空/海入境非行李货物等值500美元的免征税额度，共同申报的家庭可合并使用；酒类、制成烟草、车用燃料除外。行李及额度内货物本身不要求在入境申报表填写应税货物栏；但官方表单仍要求完整填写旅客海关申报表。合条件超额货物可按19%全球税率缴税，扣除额度后不超过3,000美元（含计算机设备4,000美元）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, within the «Declaración de Aduana para pasajeros procedentes del extranjero»: answer the taxable-merchandise question and list goods and value when yes.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时在《来自外国的旅客海关申报表》内回答应税货物问题，答是即列明货物与价值。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境行李及免稅額以外應稅貨物申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 僅限入境、條件觸發：ANAM旅客海關申報表詢問是否攜帶行李及免稅額(franquicia)以外應稅貨物，答是即填報貨物及其價值。免稅額本身是陸/空/海入境非行李貨物等值500美元的免徵稅額度，共同申報的家庭可合併使用；酒類、製成菸草、車用燃料除外。行李及額度內貨物本身不要求在入境申報表填寫應稅貨物欄；但官方表單仍要求完整填寫旅客海關申報表。合條件超額貨物可按19%全球稅率繳稅，扣除額度後不超過3,000美元（含計算機設備4,000美元）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時在《來自外國的旅客海關申報表》內回答應稅貨物問題，答是即列明貨物與價值。

procedures.name_en: Sistema Declaración de Viajero (DGA)
procedures.name_zh: 尼加拉瓜海关旅客申报在线系统
procedures.agency: Dirección General de Servicios Aduaneros (DGA)
procedures.applicability_en: Form text (Spanish/English): 'TODO VIAJERO O JEFE DE FAMILIA QUE INGRESE O SALGA DEL PAÍS DEBE LLENAR UNA DECLARACIÓN' / 'ALL TRAVELERS OR HEAD FAMILY TO ENTER OR LEAVE THE COUNTRY MUST COMPLETE A DECLARATION' — all travelers or the head of family entering or leaving must declare, covering both ENTRADA/ENTRY and SALIDA/EXIT. One single online registration-and-print submission also carries every declaration topic together: tax exemption enjoyed in the last 6 months; cash, monetary values, titles, objects or precious metals (or a combination) equal to or above US$10,000.00 or equivalent — if yes, category, currency, class of title or precious metal, value in US$, origin and destination of funds; live animals, plants or food products; chemicals, pharmaceuticals, toxic substances or residues, weapons, ammunition or explosives; goods other than baggage; and countries visited in the last 30 days. These topics are one combined submission and are deliberately not split into separate procedures.
procedures.applicability_zh: 表单原文（西/英双语）：所有出入境旅客或一家之主（户主）均须填写申报（TODO VIAJERO O JEFE DE FAMILIA QUE INGRESE O SALGA DEL PAÍS DEBE LLENAR UNA DECLARACIÓN / ALL TRAVELERS OR HEAD FAMILY ... MUST COMPLETE A DECLARATION），覆盖入境（ENTRADA/ENTRY）与出境（SALIDA/EXIT）。同一次在线登记并打印的单一提交还合并承载全部申报问项：近6个月是否享受过税费豁免；现金、有价证券、物品、贵金属或其组合等于或超过 US$10,000.00 或等值——答“是”须填类别、币种、证券或贵金属类别、US$ 计价值、资金来源与去向；活体动物、植物或食品；化学品、药品、有毒物质或残留、武器、弹药或爆炸物；行李以外的货物；近30天到访过的国家。以上均为同一提交，刻意不拆分立项。
procedures.timing_en: Resolved from the official portal body text (bilingual): registration is allowed only three days before travel — 'Únicamente puede registrar la información tres días antes de su viaje.' / 'You can only register your information three days before traveling.'
procedures.timing_zh: 已由官方门户正文（双语）解决：仅可在出行前3天内登记信息（“Únicamente puede registrar la información tres días antes de su viaje.” / “You can only register your information three days before traveling.”）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 尼加拉瓜海關旅客申報線上系統
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 表單原文（西/英雙語）：所有出入境旅客或一家之主（戶主）均須填寫申報（TODO VIAJERO O JEFE DE FAMILIA QUE INGRESE O SALGA DEL PAÍS DEBE LLENAR UNA DECLARACIÓN / ALL TRAVELERS OR HEAD FAMILY ... MUST COMPLETE A DECLARATION），覆蓋入境（ENTRADA/ENTRY）與出境（SALIDA/EXIT）。同一次線上登記並列印的單一提交還合併承載全部申報問項：近6個月是否享受過稅費豁免；現金、有價證券、物品、貴金屬或其組合等於或超過 US$10,000.00 或等值——答“是”須填類別、幣種、證券或貴金屬類別、US$ 計價值、資金來源與去向；活體動物、植物或食品；化學品、藥品、有毒物質或殘留、武器、彈藥或爆炸物；行李以外的貨物；近30天到訪過的國家。以上均為同一提交，刻意不拆分立項。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 已由官方門戶正文（雙語）解決：僅可在出行前3天內登記資訊（“Únicamente puede registrar la información tres días antes de su viaje.” / “You can only register your information three days before traveling.”）。

procedures.name_en: Sworn Traveller Declaration (Declaración Jurada de Viajero) for entry and exit, digital or paper
procedures.name_zh: 旅客宣誓申报表（Declaración Jurada de Viajero，入境与出境，电子或纸质可选）
procedures.agency: Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA), Panamá
procedures.applicability_en: Every traveller entering or leaving Panama through any authorized route must file the sworn Traveller Declaration (Resolución 602 of 11 Dec 2019, art. 1). A family group files one single declaration (RECAUCA art. 579). The declaration may be digital or manual (Resolución 079 of 4 Apr 2024); paper forms are issued free at border posts, ports, airports and marinas (Decreto Ejecutivo 472 of 18 Aug 2017, art. 6). The same single declaration covers entry or exit carrying cash, values or negotiable instruments strictly exceeding B/. 10,000.00, which additionally requires explaining their origin and final recipient to ANA at a secondary interview or by documentation (DE 472/2017, art. 6). The online form's first screen lets the traveller choose declaration type entry or exit and the customs office of entry or exit.
procedures.applicability_zh: 凡经巴拿马任一开放口岸入境或出境的旅客均须填报“旅客宣誓申报表”（2019-12-11第602号决议第1条）。家庭同行只填一份（RECAUCA第579条）。申报可电子或纸质（2024-04-04第079号决议）；纸表在边境站、港口、机场及游艇码头免费发放（2017-08-18第472号执行令第6条）。入境或出境携带严格超过B/. 10,000.00的现金、有价证券或可转让单据亦由同一份申报涵盖，并须在二次面谈或以文件向海关说明来源及最终收受人（DE 472/2017第6条）。在线表首屏可选申报类型为入境或出境及入/出境海关口岸。
procedures.timing_en: Digital: the customs text allows completion within seventy-two (72) hours before arrival, and says the declaration must be presented 'no later than seventy-two (72) hours' without stating the anchor; the 72-hour wording is tied to arrival ('arribo al país'), so it is evidenced only for entry declarations, and the filling window for digital exit declarations is not stated. Paper: completed by hand and under oath at the port and handed to the designated ANA officer; no advance deadline stated.
procedures.timing_zh: 电子：海关原文称可在到达（arribo al país）前七十二（72）小时内填写，并称须“不迟于七十二（72）小时”呈交但未给起算点；该72小时表述仅系于到达，故仅对入境申报成立，电子出境申报的填写窗口未载明。纸质：在口岸以墨水清晰填写、经宣誓后当场交指定海关官员；原文未载提前时限。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客宣誓申報表（Declaración Jurada de Viajero，入境與出境，電子或紙質可選）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 凡經巴拿馬任一開放口岸入境或出境的旅客均須填報“旅客宣誓申報表”（2019-12-11第602號決議第1條）。家庭同行只填一份（RECAUCA第579條）。申報可電子或紙質（2024-04-04第079號決議）；紙表在邊境站、港口、機場及遊艇碼頭免費發放（2017-08-18第472號執行令第6條）。入境或出境攜帶嚴格超過B/. 10,000.00的現金、有價證券或可轉讓單據亦由同一份申報涵蓋，並須在二次面談或以文件向海關說明來源及最終收受人（DE 472/2017第6條）。線上表首屏可選申報類型為入境或出境及入/出境海關口岸。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 電子：海關原文稱可在到達（arribo al país）前七十二（72）小時內填寫，並稱須“不遲於七十二（72）小時”呈交但未給起算點；該72小時表述僅繫於到達，故僅對入境申報成立，電子出境申報的填寫窗口未載明。紙質：在口岸以墨水清晰填寫、經宣誓後當場交指定海關官員；原文未載提前時限。

procedures.name_en: Entry declaration of cash, bearer negotiable instruments and coined precious metals equal to or above USD 10,000 (form OM 2249-A)
procedures.name_zh: 入境现金、无记名可转让票据及铸币贵金属合计≥等值10,000美元申报（OM 2249-A表）
procedures.agency: ARCA — Agencia de Recaudación y Control Aduanero (Argentine Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers of any category and crew members entering Argentina who carry, as baggage or pacotilla, cash, bearer negotiable instruments (in foreign or Argentine legal-tender currency) and/or coined precious metals with a combined value EQUAL TO OR GREATER THAN the equivalent of USD 10,000 must declare it to the customs service at the moment of entry using form OM 2249-A, which is generated and issued by the customs service and signed by the declarant (Resolución General 5659/2025, article 1; in force from the tenth business day after publication in the Boletín Oficial of 10-03-2025, replacing RG 2704/2705 while keeping form OM 2249-A). Amounts are computed per traveller or crew member; for unemancipated persons under 16 the threshold is half, i.e. the equivalent of USD 5,000 (article 5). Conversion uses the Banco de la Nación Argentina buyer exchange rate at the close of the business day before entry. Transit passengers: the exit limits of articles 2-4 do not apply if OM 2249-A was filed at entry with the word 'Tránsito' entered in the 'Otros' field of 'DIVISAS - Motivo o destino'; that form must then be presented at the exit customs office (article 9). The ARCA help page still uses the looser 'inferiores a USD 10.000 / monto superior' wording; the regulation text governs the exactly-USD 10,000 case.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何类别旅客及机组人员入境阿根廷时，以行李或随身物品携带现金、无记名可转让票据（外币或阿根廷法定货币计价）和/或铸币贵金属，合计价值大于或等于等值 10,000 美元（≥USD 10,000）者，须在入境时向海关申报，使用 OM 2249-A 表；该表由海关生成并出具，由申报人签署（第5659/2025号一般决议第1条；自2025年3月10日官方公报公布后第十个工作日起生效，取代 RG 2704/2705 但保留 OM 2249-A 表）。金额按每位旅客或机组人员单独计算；未满16岁且未解放的未成年人门槛减半，即等值 5,000 美元（第5条）。折算采用阿根廷国家银行公布的入境前一营业日收盘买入汇率。过境旅客：入境时已填 OM 2249-A 并在“DIVISAS - Motivo o destino”的“Otros”栏注明“Tránsito”者，第2–4条出境限额不适用，出境时须向出境海关出示该表（第9条）。ARCA 帮助页仍用“低于10,000美元/更高金额”的宽松表述；恰好等于10,000美元的情形以法规原文为准。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entry to the country; the customs service integrates and issues form OM 2249-A and the declarant signs it. Data are recorded in the Sistema Ingreso y Egreso de Valores and passed to the UIF (article 7).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时办理；海关生成并出具 OM 2249-A 表并由申报人签署。申报数据录入出入境价值系统（Sistema Ingreso y Egreso de Valores）并报送金融信息局（UIF）（第7条）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境現金、無記名可轉讓票據及鑄幣貴金屬合計≥等值10,000美元申報（OM 2249-A表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何類別旅客及機組人員入境阿根廷時，以行李或隨身物品攜帶現金、無記名可轉讓票據（外幣或阿根廷法定貨幣計價）和/或鑄幣貴金屬，合計價值大於或等於等值 10,000 美元（≥USD 10,000）者，須在入境時向海關申報，使用 OM 2249-A 表；該表由海關生成並出具，由申報人簽署（第5659/2025號一般決議第1條；自2025年3月10日官方公報公佈後第十個工作日起生效，取代 RG 2704/2705 但保留 OM 2249-A 表）。金額按每位旅客或機組人員單獨計算；未滿16歲且未解放的未成年人門檻減半，即等值 5,000 美元（第5條）。折算採用阿根廷國家銀行公佈的入境前一營業日收盤買入匯率。過境旅客：入境時已填 OM 2249-A 並在“DIVISAS - Motivo o destino”的“Otros”欄註明“Tránsito”者，第2–4條出境限額不適用，出境時須向出境海關出示該表（第9條）。ARCA 幫助頁仍用“低於10,000美元/更高金額”的寬鬆表述；恰好等於10,000美元的情形以法規原文為準。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時辦理；海關生成並出具 OM 2249-A 表並由申報人簽署。申報資料錄入出入境價值系統（Sistema Ingreso y Egreso de Valores）並報送金融資訊局（UIF）（第7條）。

procedures.name_en: Exit declaration of Argentine legal-tender currency and peso bearer instruments equal to or above USD 10,000 equivalent (form OM 2250-B)
procedures.name_zh: 本币现钞及本币无记名票据≥等值10,000美元出境申报（OM 2250-B表）
procedures.agency: ARCA — Agencia de Recaudación y Control Aduanero (Argentine Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers of any category and crew leaving Argentina with Argentine legal-tender currency (peso) cash and/or bearer negotiable instruments issued in that currency whose combined value is EQUAL TO OR GREATER THAN the equivalent of USD 10,000 may take them out through a declaration to the customs service at the moment of departure using form OM 2250-B, which is generated and issued by the customs service and signed by the declarant (Resolución General 5659/2025, article 4). Conversion uses the Banco de la Nación Argentina seller exchange rate at the close of the business day before exit. Amounts are computed per person; for unemancipated persons under 16 the threshold is half (article 5). This route covers local-currency values only; under RG 5659/2025 arts. 2–3, foreign-currency cash or foreign-currency bearer instruments at or above USD 10,000 cannot be carried out in baggage by filing OM 2250-B and must instead move through authorized financial entities. Coined precious metals likewise are only allowed in baggage below the threshold under art. 2; this is a transport restriction, not a second traveller declaration. Transit exception per article 9 — see ar-currency-entry-om2249a.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何类别旅客及机组人员携带阿根廷法定货币（比索）现钞和/或以该货币发行的无记名可转让票据出境，合计价值大于或等于等值 10,000 美元（≥USD 10,000）者，可在出境时向海关申报后带出，使用 OM 2250-B 表；该表由海关生成并出具，由申报人签署（第5659/2025号一般决议第4条）。折算采用阿根廷国家银行公布的出境前一营业日收盘卖出汇率。金额按每人计算；未满16岁且未解放者门槛减半（第5条）。此途径仅适用于本币价值；依第5659/2025号一般决议第2–3条，外币现金及外币无记名票据达到或超过10,000美元时，不能靠填写 OM 2250-B 随身携出，须经获授权金融机构办理；铸币贵金属在该门槛以上也不属第2条准许随行李携出的范围。这是运输限制，不是另一张旅客申报表。过境例外见第9条及 ar-currency-entry-om2249a。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of departure from the country; the customs service integrates and issues form OM 2250-B and the declarant signs it, per the rules published on ARCA's 'Viajeros' microsite.
procedures.timing_zh: 出境时办理；海关生成并出具 OM 2250-B 表并由申报人签署，具体按 ARCA“Viajeros”微站公布的规则执行。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 本幣現鈔及本幣無記名票據≥等值10,000美元出境申報（OM 2250-B表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何類別旅客及機組人員攜帶阿根廷法定貨幣（比索）現鈔和/或以該貨幣發行的無記名可轉讓票據出境，合計價值大於或等於等值 10,000 美元（≥USD 10,000）者，可在出境時向海關申報後帶出，使用 OM 2250-B 表；該表由海關生成並出具，由申報人簽署（第5659/2025號一般決議第4條）。折算採用阿根廷國家銀行公佈的出境前一營業日收盤賣出匯率。金額按每人計算；未滿16歲且未解放者門檻減半（第5條）。此途徑僅適用於本幣價值；依第5659/2025號一般決議第2–3條，外幣現金及外幣無記名票據達到或超過10,000美元時，不能靠填寫 OM 2250-B 隨身攜出，須經獲授權金融機構辦理；鑄幣貴金屬在該門檻以上也不屬第2條准許隨行李攜出的範圍。這是運輸限制，不是另一張旅客申報表。過境例外見第9條及 ar-currency-entry-om2249a。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出境時辦理；海關生成並出具 OM 2250-B 表並由申報人簽署，具體按 ARCA“Viajeros”微站公佈的規則執行。

procedures.name_en: Conditional digital entry-baggage customs declaration (mobile app / self-service terminal; manual OM-2087/G5 or G6 fallback)
procedures.name_zh: 条件触发的入境行李海关数字申报（手机应用/自助终端；无法数字办理时手填 OM-2087/G5 或 G6）
procedures.agency: ARCA — Agencia de Recaudación y Control Aduanero (Argentine Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving travellers have to make the customs declaration ONLY when they (a) must pay the tax due for exceeding the current duty-free franchise, (b) carry goods regulated by SENASA, or (c) bring in cash and/or monetary instruments — in foreign or Argentine legal-tender currency — worth equal to or more than the equivalent of USD 10,000 (ARCA baggage régime page). Branch (c) is the OM 2249-A currency declaration described in ar-currency-entry-om2249a. The customs declaration is completed digitally: the entry-baggage declaration form in the mobile applications or on the self-service terminals; only if a digital declaration is not possible must it be made manually on form OM-2087/G5 or OM-2087/G6, as appropriate. Travellers forming a family group — married couples, civil unions and children under 16 not emancipated — may use the franchise jointly. The franchise amounts themselves are not stated on this page (see unresolved ar-entry-baggage).
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境旅客仅在以下情形须办理海关申报：(a) 超过现行免税额度（franquicia vigente）须缴纳税款；(b) 携带 SENASA 管制物品；(c) 携入现金和/或货币票据——外币或阿根廷法定货币——价值大于或等于等值 10,000 美元（ARCA 行李制度页）。其中情形 (c) 即 ar-currency-entry-om2249a 所述的 OM 2249-A 货币申报。海关申报以数字方式完成：通过移动设备应用程序或自助终端中的入境行李申报表；仅当无法数字申报时，才按对应情形手填 OM-2087/G5 或 OM-2087/G6 表。构成家庭组的旅客——婚姻、同居结合及未满16岁未解放子女——可合并使用免税额度。该页未给出免税额度具体数额（见未决项 ar-entry-baggage）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival: complete the digital entry-baggage declaration in the mobile app or at a self-service terminal before customs; the manual OM-2087/G5 or OM-2087/G6 form is the fallback only when digital submission is impossible. Any tax due relates to exceeded franchise, not to a charge for the declaration itself.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时办理：过海关前在手机应用或自助终端完成入境行李数字申报；仅在无法数字提交时才使用纸质 OM-2087/G5 或 OM-2087/G6 表。超额应缴税款属于超免税额的税负，并非申报手续本身的收费。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 條件觸發的入境行李海關數字申報（手機應用/自助終端；無法數字辦理時手填 OM-2087/G5 或 G6）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境旅客僅在以下情形須辦理海關申報：(a) 超過現行免稅額度（franquicia vigente）須繳納稅款；(b) 攜帶 SENASA 管制物品；(c) 攜入現金和/或貨幣票據——外幣或阿根廷法定貨幣——價值大於或等於等值 10,000 美元（ARCA 行李制度頁）。其中情形 (c) 即 ar-currency-entry-om2249a 所述的 OM 2249-A 貨幣申報。海關申報以數字方式完成：通過移動設備應用程序或自助終端中的入境行李申報表；僅當無法數字申報時，才按對應情形手填 OM-2087/G5 或 OM-2087/G6 表。構成家庭組的旅客——婚姻、同居結合及未滿16歲未解放子女——可合併使用免稅額度。該頁未給出免稅額度具體數額（見未決項 ar-entry-baggage）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時辦理：過海關前在手機應用或自助終端完成入境行李數字申報；僅在無法數字提交時才使用紙質 OM-2087/G5 或 OM-2087/G6 表。超額應繳稅款屬於超免稅額的稅負，並非申報手續本身的收費。

procedures.name_en: Departure registration of third-country-origin goods in accompanied baggage (form OM 121)
procedures.name_zh: 出境第三国原产随行行李物品登记（OM 121表）
procedures.agency: ARCA — Agencia de Recaudación y Control Aduanero (Argentine Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Narrowed to the régime text: a traveller leaving Argentina who carries goods ORIGINATING IN THIRD COUNTRIES as part of their accompanied baggage must declare and show them to the customs service before departure, by registering them on form OM 121, which can be completed by hand or generated through the internet (ARCA baggage régime page). The service records personal data, date and place of exit and the objects transported; the form is printed and presented to customs when travelling, is personal and non-transferable, and must be presented to the customs service again on return. The earlier broader wording on the ARCA travellers home page ('declare the objects and/or vehicles you travel with') is not carried forward as a blanket obligation; it is superseded by this narrower sourced rule.
procedures.applicability_zh: 按制度原文收窄：离开阿根廷的旅客，凡携带原产于第三国的物品作为随运行李的一部分，须在出境前向海关申报并出示，通过登记 OM 121 表办理；该表可手工填写，也可通过互联网生成（ARCA 行李制度页）。该服务录入个人资料、出境日期与地点及所运物品；表格打印后在旅行时向海关出示，具个人性且不可转让，返程时须再次向海关出示。ARCA 旅客首页较早的宽泛表述（“申报随身物品和/或车辆”）不再作为普遍义务保留，由上述有据可查的收窄规则取代。
procedures.timing_en: Before passing customs on departure: generate form OM 121 on the web (ARCA service 'Iniciar OM 121 web', https://serviciosweb.afip.gov.ar/DIA/EXTAPP/P121/P121.WebApp/formularios/E121_ppal.aspx) or complete it manually (printable 'OM121/A' from ARCA's form service), print it, present it at customs when travelling, and present it again at customs on the return trip.
procedures.timing_zh: 出境过海关前办理：通过 ARCA 网上服务“Iniciar OM 121 web”（https://serviciosweb.afip.gov.ar/DIA/EXTAPP/P121/P121.WebApp/formularios/E121_ppal.aspx）生成 OM 121 表，或手工填写（可从 ARCA 表单服务打印“OM121/A”），打印后在旅行时向海关出示，返程时再次向海关出示。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出境第三國原產隨行行李物品登記（OM 121表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 按制度原文收窄：離開阿根廷的旅客，凡攜帶原產於第三國的物品作為隨運行李的一部分，須在出境前向海關申報並出示，通過登記 OM 121 表辦理；該表可手工填寫，也可通過互聯網生成（ARCA 行李制度頁）。該服務錄入個人資料、出境日期與地點及所運物品；表格列印後在旅行時向海關出示，具個人性且不可轉讓，返程時須再次向海關出示。ARCA 旅客首頁較早的寬泛表述（“申報隨身物品和/或車輛”）不再作為普遍義務保留，由上述有據可查的收窄規則取代。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出境過海關前辦理：通過 ARCA 網上服務“Iniciar OM 121 web”（https://serviciosweb.afip.gov.ar/DIA/EXTAPP/P121/P121.WebApp/formularios/E121_ppal.aspx）生成 OM 121 表，或手工填寫（可從 ARCA 表單服務列印“OM121/A”），列印後在旅行時向海關出示，返程時再次向海關出示。

procedures.name_en: Simplified import of white-line household appliances by returning residents — virtual sworn declaration OM 2153
procedures.name_zh: 回流旅客白色家电简化进口——虚拟宣誓申报表 OM 2153
procedures.agency: ARCA — Agencia de Recaudación y Control Aduanero (Argentine Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: White-goods-specific procedure, not a general entry-baggage form: Argentine or foreign travellers resident in the country who return by the baggage route may import domestic white-line appliances (fridges/freezers, washing/drying machines and combined units, dishwashers, electric ovens/cookers, electric water heaters/boilers, air conditioners — all domestic use) under a simplified import régime, completing virtual form OM 2153, which has the character of a sworn declaration for the traveller. It is expressly NOT carried out under the baggage régime and does not affect its franchises. Maximum 1 new unit of the same species per calendar year per traveller over 16. Once the tax liquidation is generated and paid by the traveller, the import is authorized. Taxes are ad valorem per the OM 2153 table (20% import duty, 3% statistical rate, 21% VAT and 11% income tax for every species, plus a 9.50% internal tax on air conditioners only), so no fixed fee amount is recorded here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 家电专项程序，非一般入境行李表：在阿根廷居住的阿根廷或外国旅客经行李渠道返国时，可按简化进口制度进口家用白色家电（冰箱/冷柜、洗衣机/干衣机及功能组合机、洗碗机、电烤箱/电炉灶、电热水器/锅炉、空调，均为家用），填写虚拟 OM 2153 表，该表对旅客具有宣誓申报（Declaración Jurada）性质。该进口明示不在行李制度（Régimen de Equipaje）框架内进行，亦不影响其免税额度。同一品种每年历法年每位超过16岁的旅客限 1 件全新单位。旅客生成并缴纳税款核定单后，进口即获批准。税费按 OM 2153 表以从价税率计（所有品种均为进口税20%、统计税率3%、增值税21%及所得税11%，仅空调另加9.50%国内税），故此处不记录固定费用金额。
procedures.timing_en: When using the simplified import procedure on return, complete virtual OM 2153 and pay the resulting tax assessment before importation is authorized. The saved ARCA page gives no separate pre-travel filing deadline.
procedures.timing_zh: 返国采用此简化进口程序时填写虚拟 OM 2153，并在缴纳系统核定税款后获准进口。所核 ARCA 页面未规定独立的行前提交期限。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 迴流旅客白色家電簡化進口——虛擬宣誓申報表 OM 2153
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 家電專項程序，非一般入境行李表：在阿根廷居住的阿根廷或外國旅客經行李渠道返國時，可按簡化進口制度進口家用白色家電（冰箱/冷櫃、洗衣機/乾衣機及功能組合機、洗碗機、電烤箱/電爐灶、電熱水器/鍋爐、空調，均為家用），填寫虛擬 OM 2153 表，該表對旅客具有宣誓申報（Declaración Jurada）性質。該進口明示不在行李制度（Régimen de Equipaje）框架內進行，亦不影響其免稅額度。同一品種每年曆法年每位超過16歲的旅客限 1 件全新單位。旅客生成並繳納稅款核定單後，進口即獲批准。稅費按 OM 2153 表以從價稅率計（所有品種均為進口稅20%、統計稅率3%、增值稅21%及所得稅11%，僅空調另加9.50%國內稅），故此處不記錄固定費用金額。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 返國採用此簡化進口程序時填寫虛擬 OM 2153，並在繳納系統核定稅款後獲准進口。所核 ARCA 頁面未規定獨立的行前提交期限。

procedures.name_en: Formulario N° 250 — Declaración Jurada de Equipaje Acompañado e Ingreso y Salida de Divisas
procedures.name_zh: 玻利维亚第 250 号表（随行行李与外币出入境宣誓申报）
procedures.agency: Aduana Nacional de Bolivia (ANB)
procedures.applicability_en: Every international traveller must present Form 250 to Customs on arrival (Régimen de Viajeros FAQ Q1); the requirement rests on Supreme Decree 29681 of 20/08/2008, as amended by Supreme Decree 5404 of 23/05/2025 (Q2). Filing modalities (Q3): preprinted paper form, digital form reached by scanning a QR code, or the AN Viajero mobile app (through the anbsw01 online form service). Duty-free franchise (Q7): new articles of strict personal use or consumption, non-commercial, up to a FOB value of USD 1,000, with quantity limits (Q8): 3 litres of alcoholic beverages, 400 cigarettes, 50 cigars or 500 g of cut tobacco, and up to 3 units (boxes or vials) of prescription medicines; the used personal effects listed in Q8 (one camera, one laptop, one mobile phone, etc.) also enter duty-free. The franchise is granted once to the family-group representative and does not extend to each member (children under 18 are not covered), while children over 18 must individually file Form 250 for the baggage and cash they carry (Q5); the FAQ does not address a child exactly 18 years old (unresolved bo-franquicia-hijo-18). The franchise is available again only after 90 days or more since the last entry in which it was applied, and never for frequent travellers or commercial goods (Q6). New articles above the franchise: up to USD 2,000 total, import duties are paid on the excess through a minor-quantity goods declaration (Declaración de Mercancías de menor cuantía); above USD 2,000 with the franchise not applicable, duties are paid on the total through a Declaration of Importation for Consumption (Q4). Cash (Q10): a traveller may carry up to USD 50,000 on entry and up to USD 20,000 on exit, or the equivalent in other currencies; amounts from USD 10,000 to USD 50,000 inclusive on entry, and from USD 10,000 to USD 20,000 inclusive on exit, must be registered on Form 250 stating the type of currency, its origin and its destination; amounts strictly above USD 50,000 on entry or USD 20,000 on exit may not be carried on the traveller declaration and must be moved through financial-intermediary entities and/or money-order and remittance companies holding an operating licence from ASFI (Autoridad de Supervisión Financiera). Non-compliance: undeclared dutiable goods identified during primary-zone control under the traveller regime may be nationalized only after correcting numeral II of Form 250 and paying the customs contravention (Q9); cash in the declarable bands that is not declared is subject to retention of 30% of the total carried, 30% of the difference between verified and declared amounts for an imprecise declaration, and 30% of the excess where an amount above the limits is declared (Q11). No fee for the form itself is stated in any readable official text; import duties and the 30% sanction are taxes/penalties, not form fees.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每名国际旅客入境时须向海关呈交 250 号表（《旅客制度》FAQ 第1问）；呈交义务的依据为 2008-08-20 第 29681 号最高法令（经 2025-05-23 第 5404 号最高法令修改，第2问）。填报方式（第3问）：预印纸质表、扫码进入的电子表或 AN Viajero 手机应用（经 anbsw01 在线表单服务）。免税额度（第7问）：全新、严格自用或个人消费、非商用的物品，FOB 价值不超过 1,000 美元；限量（第8问）：酒 3 升、香烟 400 支、雪茄 50 支或烟丝 500 克、凭处方的药品不超过 3 单位（盒或瓶）；第8问所列旧个人用品（相机、笔记本电脑、手机各一台等）亦可免税入境。该额度仅一次性给予家庭组团代表，不延伸至每位成员（未满 18 周岁子女不单享），超过 18 周岁的子女须就其携带的行李与外币独立填报 250 号表（第5问）；恰满 18 周岁之情形 FAQ 未提及（未解决项 bo-franquicia-hijo-18）。距上次入境且已适用额度满 90 天方可再次享受；频繁旅客或商用货物不适用（第6问）。超过免税额的新品：总额不超过 2,000 美元时，按超额部分经小额货物申报（Declaración de Mercancías de menor cuantía）缴纳进口税款；超过 2,000 美元且不适用免税额时，经进口消费申报（Declaración de Importación a Consumo）按全额缴税（第4问）。现金（第10问）：旅客可随身携带入境不超过 50,000 美元、出境不超过 20,000 美元，或等值其他货币；入境 10,000–50,000 美元（含两端）、出境 10,000–20,000 美元（含两端）的金额须在 250 号表登记，写明币种、来源和去向；严格超过入境 50,000 美元或出境 20,000 美元的金额不得凭旅客申报表随身携带，须经持有 ASFI（金融监管局）经营许可的金融中介机构和/或汇兑汇款企业运送。违规后果：在一级区域查获的未申报应税物品，须先更正 250 号表第 II 栏并缴纳海关违规罚款后方可办理完税入境（第9问）；应报区间内现金未申报的，可被扣减所持总额的 30%，申报不实的按核实与申报差额的 30%，申报金额超过限额的按超额部分的 30% 处罚（第11问）。可读官方文本均未规定该表本身的费用；货物税款与 30% 处罚属税款/罚款，非表格费用。
procedures.timing_en: Presented to Customs on arrival; the paper form, QR-code digital form and AN Viajero app can be completed before reaching the border, and no advance-filing deadline or N-day window is stated. Cash of USD 10,000 to 20,000 (inclusive) taken out of the country is registered on the same form on departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时向海关呈交；纸表、扫码电子表与 AN Viajero 应用可在抵边前提前填报，FAQ 未规定提前天数或申报时限。出境携带 10,000–20,000 美元（含两端）现金时在同一表上登记。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 玻利維亞第 250 號表（隨行行李與外幣出入境宣誓申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每名國際旅客入境時須向海關呈交 250 號表（《旅客制度》FAQ 第1問）；呈交義務的依據為 2008-08-20 第 29681 號最高法令（經 2025-05-23 第 5404 號最高法令修改，第2問）。填報方式（第3問）：預印紙質表、掃碼進入的電子表或 AN Viajero 手機應用（經 anbsw01 線上表單服務）。免稅額度（第7問）：全新、嚴格自用或個人消費、非商用的物品，FOB 價值不超過 1,000 美元；限量（第8問）：酒 3 升、香菸 400 支、雪茄 50 支或菸絲 500 克、憑處方的藥品不超過 3 單位（盒或瓶）；第8問所列舊個人用品（相機、筆電電腦、手機各一臺等）亦可免稅入境。該額度僅一次性給予家庭組團代表，不延伸至每位成員（未滿 18 週歲子女不單享），超過 18 週歲的子女須就其攜帶的行李與外幣獨立填報 250 號表（第5問）；恰滿 18 週歲之情形 FAQ 未提及（未解決項 bo-franquicia-hijo-18）。距上次入境且已適用額度滿 90 天方可再次享受；頻繁旅客或商用貨物不適用（第6問）。超過免稅額的新品：總額不超過 2,000 美元時，按超額部分經小額貨物申報（Declaración de Mercancías de menor cuantía）繳納進口稅款；超過 2,000 美元且不適用免稅額時，經進口消費申報（Declaración de Importación a Consumo）按全額繳稅（第4問）。現金（第10問）：旅客可隨身攜帶入境不超過 50,000 美元、出境不超過 20,000 美元，或等值其他貨幣；入境 10,000–50,000 美元（含兩端）、出境 10,000–20,000 美元（含兩端）的金額須在 250 號表登記，寫明幣種、來源和去向；嚴格超過入境 50,000 美元或出境 20,000 美元的金額不得憑旅客申報表隨身攜帶，須經持有 ASFI（金融監管局）經營許可的金融中介機構和/或匯兌匯款企業運送。違規後果：在一級區域查獲的未申報應稅物品，須先更正 250 號表第 II 欄並繳納海關違規罰款後方可辦理完稅入境（第9問）；應報區間內現金未申報的，可被扣減所持總額的 30%，申報不實的按核實與申報差額的 30%，申報金額超過限額的按超額部分的 30% 處罰（第11問）。可讀官方文本均未規定該表本身的費用；貨物稅款與 30% 處罰屬稅款/罰款，非表格費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時向海關呈交；紙表、掃碼電子表與 AN Viajero 應用可在抵邊前提前填報，FAQ 未規定提前天數或申報時限。出境攜帶 10,000–20,000 美元（含兩端）現金時在同一表上登記。

procedures.name_en: Bouvetøya helicopter landing permit
procedures.name_zh: 布韦岛直升机登陆许可
procedures.agency: Norwegian Polar Institute (Norsk Polarinstitutt) — permitting authority for helicopter landings on Bouvetøya under power delegated by the Ministry of Climate and Environment (the 1971 reserve regulation names the department; NPI grants the permission)
procedures.applicability_en: Conditional and activity-scoped: only an applicant/organizer whose planned activity on the island makes helicopter landing necessary must first obtain this special permit from the Norwegian Polar Institute; landing of helicopters on Bouvetøya is otherwise prohibited. Not a per-visitor entry card: NPI states permission to land or stay on the island is basically not required, and the Nyrøysa seasonal rule (1 November – 15 March, approved environmental monitoring only) is not a general tourism approval.
procedures.applicability_zh: 条件性、活动层面：仅当申请人/活动组织方所规划的岛上活动确需以直升机登陆时，才须事先取得挪威极地研究所（NPI）的该特别许可；除此以外布韦岛直升机登陆被禁止。它不是每名访客的入境卡：NPI明言登陆或停留岛上原则上无需许可，Nyrøysa季节规则（11月1日–3月15日仅限NPI批准的环境监测活动）也不是一般旅游批准。
procedures.timing_en: The special permit must be obtained from the Norwegian Polar Institute before the helicopter landing on Bouvetøya — helicopter landing is prohibited without it, so the permit must be in hand no later than the landing; the official NPI page lists an online application and a letter/e-mail application for helicopter landing on Bouvetøya. The sources state no fixed pre-voyage deadline or advance period; exact advance days: unknown.
procedures.timing_zh: 须在直升机于布韦岛降落前取得挪威极地研究所（NPI）的该特别许可——无此许可直升机登陆即被禁止，故最迟须在降落时已持证在手；NPI官网页面列出布韦岛直升机登陆的在线申请与信件/电邮申请两种渠道。来源未规定固定的行前截止日期或提前期限；精确提前天数：unknown。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 布韋島直升機登陸許可
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 條件性、活動層面：僅當申請人/活動組織方所規劃的島上活動確需以直升機登陸時，才須事先取得挪威極地研究所（NPI）的該特別許可；除此以外布韋島直升機登陸被禁止。它不是每名訪客的入境卡：NPI明言登陸或停留島上原則上無需許可，Nyrøysa季節規則（11月1日–3月15日僅限NPI批准的環境監測活動）也不是一般旅遊批准。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 須在直升機於布韋島降落前取得挪威極地研究所（NPI）的該特別許可——無此許可直升機登陸即被禁止，故最遲須在降落時已持證在手；NPI官網頁面列出布韋島直升機登陸的線上申請與信件/電郵申請兩種渠道。來源未規定固定的行前截止日期或提前期限；精確提前天數：unknown。

procedures.name_en: Electronic Traveller Goods Declaration (e-DBV, Declaração Eletrônica de Bens do Viajante)
procedures.name_zh: 电子旅客物品申报（e-DBV）
procedures.agency: Receita Federal do Brasil (Brazilian Federal Revenue Service)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers (passengers and crew), Brazilian or foreign, entering or leaving Brazil, carrying specified declarable goods or cash — not all personal effects. Physical cash strictly above US$10,000 (or equivalent) triggers e-DBV on entry AND on departure; exactly US$10,000 does not ('mais de US$ 10.000,00'). Entry also triggers: goods above the duty-free value and/or quantity quota; temporary-admission goods with global value over US$3,000 that will return abroad (guide: for non-residents in Brazil); goods for a legal entity or outside the baggage concept; goods bound for common import-regime clearance; items under other federal agencies' control (animals, plants and derived products; medical and dental products; medicines, vitamins and supplements except personal use; weapons and ammunition). Departure also triggers: goods above US$2,000 registered in DU-E to prove domestic purchase; proof of cash origin may be demanded on exit. An under-16 carrying declarable items has the e-DBV filed in the minor's name and signed by a parent or guardian. Voluntary filing is allowed to document regular entry; declaring never makes prohibited goods (narcotics etc.) admissible.
procedures.applicability_zh: 旅客（乘客与机组），巴西人或外国人，出入境携带特定应申报物品或现金者——并非所有个人物品都需申报。现金严格超过等值10,000美元，入境与出境均触发e-DBV；恰为10,000美元不触发（"mais de US$ 10.000,00"）。入境另含：超过免税价值/数量额度的物品；总值超过3,000美元且将复运出境的临时入境物品（指引：适用于非巴西居民）；交付法人或不属行李概念的物品；须按普通进口制度清关的物品；其他联邦机构管制物（动植物及其制品；医疗牙科产品；药品、维生素、补充剂——个人自用除外；武器弹药）。出境另含：价值超过2,000美元并在DU-E登记以证明国内购买的物品；离境时可被要求出示现金来源证明。未满16岁携应申报物：以未成年人名义申报，由父/母或监护人签署。可自愿申报以证明物品合规入境；申报绝不使禁品（毒品等）可进口。
procedures.timing_en: Filled and transmitted fully online, optionally before travel; a receipt is issued on transmission. Entry: present at disembarkation after collecting baggage, choosing the red channel. Departure: present before baggage dispatch or boarding, and at least 1 hour before check-in starts. If tax is due, also present the paid DARF.
procedures.timing_zh: 全程在线填写并传送，可于行前完成；传送后生成回执。入境：下机取行李后呈交，选红色通道。出境：在托运行李或登机前呈交，且最迟于值机开始前1小时。如有应纳税款，须同时出示已缴DARF。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 電子旅客物品申報（e-DBV）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 旅客（乘客與機組），巴西人或外國人，出入境攜帶特定應申報物品或現金者——並非所有個人物品都需申報。現金嚴格超過等值10,000美元，入境與出境均觸發e-DBV；恰為10,000美元不觸發（"mais de US$ 10.000,00"）。入境另含：超過免稅價值/數量額度的物品；總值超過3,000美元且將復運出境的臨時入境物品（指引：適用於非巴西居民）；交付法人或不屬行李概念的物品；須按普通進口制度清關的物品；其他聯邦機構管制物（動植物及其製品；醫療牙科產品；藥品、維生素、補充劑——個人自用除外；武器彈藥）。出境另含：價值超過2,000美元並在DU-E登記以證明國內購買的物品；離境時可被要求出示現金來源證明。未滿16歲攜應申報物：以未成年人名義申報，由父/母或監護人簽署。可自願申報以證明物品合規入境；申報絕不使禁品（毒品等）可進口。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 全程線上填寫並傳送，可於行前完成；傳送後生成回執。入境：下機取行李後呈交，選紅色通道。出境：在托運行李或登機前呈交，且最遲於值機開始前1小時。如有應納稅款，須同時出示已繳DARF。

procedures.name_en: SAG sworn declaration on entry to Chile (Declaración Jurada SAG)
procedures.name_zh: 智利 SAG 入境宣誓申报（Declaración Jurada SAG）
procedures.agency: Servicio Agrícola y Ganadero (SAG)
procedures.applicability_en: Required at every entry to Chile (air, land or sea border): declare under oath whether you carry, on your person or in your baggage, products, parts or by-products of plant or animal origin, or products used in agricultural/forestry activities, regardless of quantity or when they were obtained. On age, the current SAG pages are addressed to “Personas mayores de 18 años que ingresen al país” (trámite page) and state that “El Formulario Declaración Jurada SAG debe ser llenado por toda persona mayor a 18 años que ingresa a Chile” (digital-controls page) — literally persons over 18; this record does not read that wording as unconditionally requiring a traveler who is exactly 18 to complete the form on their own (the 2020 paper form's instructions define legal age as “18 años o más”; see unresolved “cl-sag-age-exact-18”). The trámite page also covers diplomats, Chilean official officers, foreign-government personnel and international-organization staff, and states “Si eres responsable de menores de 18 años, debes declarar en tu formulario el contenido de su equipaje”: the baggage of persons under 18 is declared in the responsible adult's own declaration. The digital channel is available only at the border controls listed by SAG: Aeropuerto Arturo Merino Benítez (SCL/AAMB), Aeropuerto Diego de Aracena (IQQ), Pehuenche, Hua Hum, Cardenal Samoré, San Sebastián and Integración Austral; at other airports, seaports and land borders the paper form is used. The trámite is free of charge ('No tiene costo'); a false declaration may be fined. This agricultural-quarantine declaration does not replace the customs declaration for cash or bearer negotiable instruments (DPTE) and does not represent general Chilean customs duties or taxes.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每次入境智利（航空、陆路或海港口岸）均须宣誓申报：在随身衣着或行李中是否携带动植物来源的产品、部件或副产品，或农林生产活动用品，不论数量、不论取得时间。成年人范围按现行页面原词表述：办事页适用对象为“Personas mayores de 18 años que ingresen al país”，数字口岸页写明“El Formulario Declaración Jurada SAG debe ser llenado por toda persona mayor a 18 años que ingresa a Chile”，两处字面均为严格超过18岁；本记录不据此把恰满18岁者无条件纳入当前独立填表义务（2020 年纸表说明将成年定义为“18 años o más”，见未决项 cl-sag-age-exact-18）。适用对象亦包括外交人员、智利官方人员、外国政府人员及国际组织人员；按页面原词“Si eres responsable de menores de 18 años, debes declarar en tu formulario el contenido de su equipaje”，对未满18岁未成年人负责者须将其行李内容并入本人申报。数字渠道仅在 SAG 列举的口岸提供：Arturo Merino Benítez 国际机场（SCL/AAMB）、Diego Aracena 国际机场（IQQ）、Pehuenche、Hua Hum、Cardenal Samoré、San Sebastián、Integración Austral；其他机场、海港及陆路口岸使用纸质表。该办事免费（No tiene costo）；虚假申报可被罚款。此为农业检疫申报，不替代海关现金或无记名可转让票据申报（DPTE），亦不代表智利海关一般税费规则。
procedures.timing_en: Complete before SAG baggage inspection on each entry. SAG says the digital form can be accessed one day before arrival and via QR codes at enabled entry controls; save it and show it to SAG staff when requested. At other controls, complete the paper form supplied by the carrier or SAG. A new declaration is needed for each entry and is valid only for the stated arrival date.
procedures.timing_zh: 每次入境均须在 SAG 行李查验前完成。SAG 页面说数字表可在抵达前一日访问，也可在已启用口岸扫码办理；保存后依要求向 SAG 人员出示。其他口岸使用承运人或 SAG 提供的纸表。每次入境须重新填写，仅对所填抵达日有效。

procedures.name_zh_hant: 智利 SAG 入境宣誓申報（Declaración Jurada SAG）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每次入境智利（航空、陸路或海港口岸）均須宣誓申報：在隨身衣著或行李中是否攜帶動植物來源的產品、部件或副產品，或農林生產活動用品，不論數量、不論取得時間。成年人範圍按現行頁面原詞表述：辦事頁適用對象為“Personas mayores de 18 años que ingresen al país”，數字口岸頁寫明“El Formulario Declaración Jurada SAG debe ser llenado por toda persona mayor a 18 años que ingresa a Chile”，兩處字面均為嚴格超過18歲；本記錄不據此把恰滿18歲者無條件納入當前獨立填表義務（2020 年紙表說明將成年定義為“18 años o más”，見未決項 cl-sag-age-exact-18）。適用對象亦包括外交人員、智利官方人員、外國政府人員及國際組織人員；按頁面原詞“Si eres responsable de menores de 18 años, debes declarar en tu formulario el contenido de su equipaje”，對未滿18歲未成年人負責者須將其行李內容併入本人申報。數字渠道僅在 SAG 列舉的口岸提供：Arturo Merino Benítez 國際機場（SCL/AAMB）、Diego Aracena 國際機場（IQQ）、Pehuenche、Hua Hum、Cardenal Samoré、San Sebastián、Integración Austral；其他機場、海港及陸路口岸使用紙質表。該辦事免費（No tiene costo）；虛假申報可被罰款。此為農業檢疫申報，不替代海關現金或無記名可轉讓票據申報（DPTE），亦不代表智利海關一般稅費規則。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 每次入境均須在 SAG 行李查驗前完成。SAG 頁面說數字表可在抵達前一日訪問，也可在已啟用口岸掃碼辦理；保存後依要求向 SAG 人員出示。其他口岸使用承運人或 SAG 提供的紙表。每次入境須重新填寫，僅對所填抵達日有效。

procedures.name_en: Declaration to Chilean Customs of cash or bearer negotiable instruments strictly exceeding USD 10,000 (DPTE)
procedures.name_zh: 向智利海关申报严格超过等值10,000美元的现金或无记名可转让票据（DPTE）
procedures.agency: Servicio Nacional de Aduanas (Chilean Customs) — the DPTE is transmitted to the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF)
procedures.applicability_en: Conditional duty applying to both entry into and exit from Chile: under Article 4 of Law N°19.913 and Article 168 bis of the Ordenanza de Aduanas, as stated on the official UAF page, anyone who carries or transports cash, or bearer negotiable instruments, into or out of the country for an amount strictly exceeding USD 10,000 (or its equivalent in other currencies) must inform the Servicio Nacional de Aduanas (Chilean Customs). Customs in turn sends the corresponding Declaración de Porte y Transporte de Efectivo (DPTE) to the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF); travelers do not file the DPTE directly with the UAF. Introducing or extracting such money through an unauthorized crossing, or without informing Customs, or with false information, constitutes smuggling (contrabando), and Customs must retain the whole amount when the offence is detected. The traveler-facing submission form or channel cannot be verified from the saved official text (handle it with Customs at the border); no fee information is available. This obligation is separate from, and is not replaced by, the SAG agricultural sworn declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于入境与出境双向的条件性义务：据 UAF 官方现行页面援引《反洗钱法》（Ley N°19.913）第4条及《海关条例》（Ordenanza de Aduanas）第168 bis 条，携带现金或无记名可转让票据入境或出境智利、金额严格超过等值10,000美元（或以其他货币计的等值金额）者，须告知智利海关（Servicio Nacional de Aduanas）。海关再将相应《现金携带与运输申报》（DPTE）送交金融分析机关（UAF）；旅客并不直接向 UAF 提交 DPTE。经未设关口进出、未告知海关或提供虚假信息即构成走私（contrabando），且查获时海关须扣留全部款项。面向旅客的提交表格或渠道无法从已存官方文本核实（在口岸向海关办理）；无费用信息。该义务独立于 SAG 农业宣誓申报，二者不能相互替代。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of entering or leaving Chile with cash or bearer negotiable instruments strictly exceeding the USD 10,000 equivalent, inform the Servicio Nacional de Aduanas at the border. The saved official text does not specify a traveler-facing form, deadline or online channel.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或出境时携带严格超过等值10,000美元的现金或无记名可转让票据，须在口岸告知智利海关。已存官方文本未指明面向旅客的表格、办理期限或线上渠道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 向智利海關申報嚴格超過等值10,000美元的現金或無記名可轉讓票據（DPTE）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於入境與出境雙向的條件性義務：據 UAF 官方現行頁面援引《反洗錢法》（Ley N°19.913）第4條及《海關條例》（Ordenanza de Aduanas）第168 bis 條，攜帶現金或無記名可轉讓票據入境或出境智利、金額嚴格超過等值10,000美元（或以其他貨幣計的等值金額）者，須告知智利海關（Servicio Nacional de Aduanas）。海關再將相應《現金攜帶與運輸申報》（DPTE）送交金融分析機關（UAF）；旅客並不直接向 UAF 提交 DPTE。經未設關口進出、未告知海關或提供虛假資訊即構成走私（contrabando），且查獲時海關須扣留全部款項。面向旅客的提交表格或渠道無法從已存官方文本核實（在口岸向海關辦理）；無費用資訊。該義務獨立於 SAG 農業宣誓申報，二者不能相互替代。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或出境時攜帶嚴格超過等值10,000美元的現金或無記名可轉讓票據，須在口岸告知智利海關。已存官方文本未指明面向旅客的表格、辦理期限或線上渠道。

procedures.name_en: Traveller baggage and currency declaration (Form 530)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客行李及资金申报（530表）
procedures.agency: DIAN Colombia
procedures.applicability_en: Every traveller entering the national customs territory must present baggage to the customs authority. The same single Form 530 ("Declaración de Equipaje, de Dinero en Efectivo y de Títulos Representativos de Dinero – Viajeros", one sheet with entry and exit boxes) is conditional and must be completed only in listed cases, on entry or exit: baggage subject to the single tax; goods other than personal effects exceeding US$2,000 or in commercial quantities; carrying cash of any currency (including Colombian legal currency) or monetary instruments strictly above US$10,000 equivalent, assessed per traveller or family unit; regulated plants, animals and their products including pets; cultural-heritage goods or goods controlled by the Ministry of Culture or of Environment and Sustainable Development; temporary duty-free professional articles of residents abroad; accredited medical-mission supplies; unaccompanied baggage; and goods requiring a change of import modality. A family unit is persons travelling together with civil, consanguineous or affinity ties; under DIAN Concept 014750 of 3 August 2026 it covers spouses, permanent partners and collateral relatives such as siblings, uncles, nephews and cousins (merely affective or occasional-cohabitation ties do not qualify), amounts carried by members are aggregated against the US$10,000 threshold — a group must declare even if no member alone exceeds it — and one Form 530 may cover the whole group; unrelated co-travellers are not automatically combined. Goods treatment on entry (travellers modality — a layered quota treatment, not a separate form; quotas are personal, minors receive 50%, duty-free shop purchases count): accompanied non-commercial goods up to US$2,000 duty-free, max 10 units per class; a further US$3,000 tier for household, sporting and professional/art/craft items, 3 units each — duty-free when accompanied, 15% single tax when unaccompanied; personal/family-use items up to 10 units per class at 15% single tax; up to 3 mobile phones enter as personal effects but must be declared in Form 530 with IMEI and value. Airlines must hand arriving travellers the prescribed form free of charge, and at land or sea crossings it is available at customs control posts, ports and border crossings; the current official pages show no online filing channel.
procedures.applicability_zh: 凡进入哥伦比亚关境的旅客均须向海关当局出示行李。同一张530表（《行李、现金及钱权凭证申报表——旅客》，"Declaración de Equipaje, de Dinero en Efectivo y de Títulos Representativos de Dinero – Viajeros"，一张表格设入境/出境勾选）属条件式申报，仅列明情形才须填报，出入境均适用：行李应缴单一税款；个人自用物品以外货物超过2,000美元或构成商业数量；携带任何币种现金（含哥伦比亚法定货币）或钱权凭证，严格超过10,000美元等值——按旅客或家庭组判定；受管制植物、动物及其产品（含宠物）；文化遗产物品或文化部/环境与可持续发展部管制物品；境外居民临时免税入境的专业用品；经认可医疗任务的物资；非随运行李；以及须变更进口方式的货物。家庭组指同行且彼此存在民事、血缘或姻亲关系之人；按DIAN 2026年8月3日第014750号法律意见，涵盖配偶、永久伴侣及兄弟姐妹、叔伯舅姑、侄甥、堂表亲等旁系亲属（单纯情感或临时同居关系不构成），成员各自携带金额须并入10,000美元门槛合并计算——即便无人单独超限，合计超限即须申报——且可由一份530表覆盖全组；无亲属关系的同行人不会自动合并。入境货物待遇（旅客方式——按条件分层的额度待遇，并非另一张表；额度属个人，未成年人减半，免税店购物计入额度）：随行非商业物品首2,000美元免税、同类最多10件；另设3,000美元额度用于家庭日用、体育及专业/技艺物品，各3件——随行免税、非随行按15%单一税；个人/家庭用途物品同类最多10件按15%单一税；手机最多3部可作为个人物品入境，但须在530表申报IMEI及价值。航空公司须向抵境旅客免费提供规定表格；陆路或海路口岸可在海关检查站、港口和边境通道领取；现行官方页面未见线上申报渠道。
procedures.timing_en: Currency: on entry, Form 530 must already be completed on arrival through the first port, airport or border crossing of entry; on exit, it must be fully completed once migration formalities before the competent authority are concluded, even if the intended trip is not ultimately carried out. Where a baggage declaration is required, the completed form is handed to the customs officer at the control post before the baggage belts.
procedures.timing_zh: 资金申报：入境时，须在经首个入境港口、机场或边境口岸抵达时即已填妥530表；出境时，须在主管机关移民手续办结时完全填妥，即便原定行程最终未成行亦不豁免。须申报行李时，应在行李传送带之前的查验点将填妥的表格交给海关关员。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客行李及資金申報（530表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 凡進入哥倫比亞關境的旅客均須向海關當局出示行李。同一張530表（《行李、現金及錢權憑證申報表——旅客》，"Declaración de Equipaje, de Dinero en Efectivo y de Títulos Representativos de Dinero – Viajeros"，一張表格設入境/出境勾選）屬條件式申報，僅列明情形才須填報，出入境均適用：行李應繳單一稅款；個人自用物品以外貨物超過2,000美元或構成商業數量；攜帶任何幣種現金（含哥倫比亞法定貨幣）或錢權憑證，嚴格超過10,000美元等值——按旅客或家庭組判定；受管制植物、動物及其產品（含寵物）；文化遺產物品或文化部/環境與可持續發展部管制物品；境外居民臨時免稅入境的專業用品；經認可醫療任務的物資；非隨運行李；以及須變更進口方式的貨物。家庭組指同行且彼此存在民事、血緣或姻親關係之人；按DIAN 2026年8月3日第014750號法律意見，涵蓋配偶、永久伴侶及兄弟姐妹、叔伯舅姑、侄甥、堂表親等旁系親屬（單純情感或臨時同居關係不構成），成員各自攜帶金額須併入10,000美元門檻合併計算——即便無人單獨超限，合計超限即須申報——且可由一份530表覆蓋全組；無親屬關係的同行人不會自動合併。入境貨物待遇（旅客方式——按條件分層的額度待遇，並非另一張表；額度屬個人，未成年人減半，免稅店購物計入額度）：隨行非商業物品首2,000美元免稅、同類最多10件；另設3,000美元額度用於家庭日用、體育及專業/技藝物品，各3件——隨行免稅、非隨行按15%單一稅；個人/家庭用途物品同類最多10件按15%單一稅；手機最多3部可作為個人物品入境，但須在530表申報IMEI及價值。航空公司須向抵境旅客免費提供規定表格；陸路或海路口岸可在海關檢查站、港口和邊境通道領取；現行官方頁面未見線上申報渠道。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 資金申報：入境時，須在經首個入境港口、機場或邊境口岸抵達時即已填妥530表；出境時，須在主管機關移民手續辦結時完全填妥，即便原定行程最終未成行亦不豁免。須申報行李時，應在行李傳送帶之前的查驗點將填妥的表格交給海關關員。

procedures.name_en: Formulario de Registro Aduanero (FRA) — air travellers
procedures.name_zh: 厄瓜多尔海关登记表（FRA）— 空运旅客
procedures.agency: Servicio Nacional de Aduana del Ecuador (SENAE)
procedures.applicability_en: Conditional customs registration for air travellers: the electronic FRA must be filed only by those who (1) enter with taxable goods (goods exceeding the personal-effects list in quantity, value or measure, or not on it); (2) bring in or take out cash, bearer negotiable instruments, precious metals or stones worth 'igual o superior a USD $10,000' (equal to or above USD 10,000); or (3) are non-resident foreigners who register cash on entry to qualify for the ISD exit-tax exemption (stay up to 90 days). Under Manual General SENAE-SENAE-2026-0041-RE (effective 2026-05-04), every adult traveller — or family group, which files one FRA through the accompanying parent or guardian — meeting these conditions must register the FRA electronically before customs control; unaccompanied minors' tax obligations fall on their legal representatives. The FRA is personal (no one may file it for a third party) and is shown as QR code or PDF with the passport before the scanner; paper is accepted only if the FRA website is unavailable, confirmed by SENAE. Declaring taxable goods means going directly to physical inspection and payment — distinct from mere inspection or the exempt allowance: goods with FOB value up to and including USD 2,000 are cleared in the International Arrival Hall using only the FRA (the inspection report serves as a simplified customs declaration); a single item, kit or set above USD 2,000 may still be cleared there; other goods above USD 2,000 cannot be cleared in the hall and need a customs destination within 5 working days (return abroad, express abandonment or temporary warehouse for formal import). Taxable goods worth between USD 1,000 and 2,000 without an FRA draw a fine for regulatory breach (COPCI Art. 193(d)) in addition to duties (below USD 1,000: duties only; above USD 2,000: offence or contravention proceedings possible). Duties unpaid within 5 working days of arrival mean definitive abandonment. Goods needing permits may enter without them if worth up to USD 500, once per fiscal year (clothing, footwear and made-up textiles excepted). Exempt personal effects include one TV up to 60-inch, one monitor up to 32-inch, one drone worth up to USD 1,000, one new plus one used mobile phone, up to 3 L alcohol (18+), and 500 ml perfume per passenger (1,000 ml per family). Neither page nor the manual states a fee for filing the FRA itself. The manual also applies supplementarily to maritime travellers. Legal basis: SENAE-SENAE-2025-0076-RE (2025-07-28) remains in force — it is not among the resolutions repealed by SENAE-SENAE-2026-0041-RE (which repeals SENAE-2017-0345, 2017-0408, 2023-0079, 2024-0123, 2025-0068 and 2025-0117).
procedures.applicability_zh: 空运旅客的条件性海关登记：仅以下人员须填写电子 FRA：(1) 入境携带应税货物（数量、价值或尺寸超过个人物品清单，或不在清单内）；(2) 携带进出境的现金、无记名可转让票据、贵金属或宝石价值“等于或超过 1 万美元”（≥ USD 10,000）；(3) 非居民外国人入境时登记现金以获得外汇出境税（ISD）豁免资格（停留不超过 90 天）。依据《通用手册》SENAE-SENAE-2026-0041-RE（2026-05-04 生效），符合上述情形的每名成年旅客——或家庭群体（由随行父/母或监护人填报一份 FRA）——须在提交海关监管前以电子方式登记 FRA；无人陪伴未成年人的纳税义务由其法定代理人承担。FRA 专人专用（不得代第三方填报），以 QR 码或 PDF 连同护照在扫描仪前出示；仅当 FRA 网站经 SENAE 确认不可用时方可使用纸质格式。申报应税货物即须直接接受物理查验并缴税——这与单纯查验或免税额度不同：FOB 价值不超过 2,000 美元（含）的货物仅在到港国际厅凭 FRA 清关（查验报告具有简化报关单效力）；单件物品/套装超过 2,000 美元仍可在该厅清关；其余超过 2,000 美元的货物不能在该厅清关，须在 5 个工作日内选定海关去向（退运境外、明示放弃或移入临时仓库走正式进口）。应税货物价值在 1,000 至 2,000 美元之间而未填 FRA 的，除补缴税款外还将按 COPCI 第 193 条 (d) 款处以违规罚款（低于 1,000 美元：仅缴税款；超过 2,000 美元：可能启动违法犯罪程序）。税款抵达后 5 个工作日内未缴清即视为最终放弃。需许可证的货物价值不超过 500 美元可免证入境，每财政年度一次（服装、鞋类和纺织品除外）。免税个人物品包括：电视一台 ≤60 英寸、显示器一台 ≤32 英寸、无人机一台价值不超过 1,000 美元、新手机一部加旧手机一部、酒精饮料最多 3 升（满 18 岁）、香水每人 500 毫升（每个家庭 1,000 毫升）。两个页面与该手册均未写明提交 FRA 本身的费用。该手册补充适用于海运旅客。法律依据：SENAE-SENAE-2025-0076-RE（2025-07-28）仍然有效——它不在 SENAE-SENAE-2026-0041-RE 废止的决议之列（后者废止 SENAE-2017-0345、2017-0408、2023-0079、2024-0123、2025-0068、2025-0117）。
procedures.timing_en: Register electronically up to before submitting to customs control ('hasta antes de someterse al control pertinente') — at the airport, before the passport scanner in the arrival hall; no N-day pre-arrival window is stated. Duties must be paid within 5 working days of arrival; goods above USD 2,000 need a customs destination within the same 5 working days, and unpaid goods are declared definitively abandoned.
procedures.timing_zh: 在提交海关监管前（“hasta antes de someterse al control pertinente”）以电子方式登记——在机场即到港厅扫描仪读取护照之前；未写提前 N 天窗口。税款须在抵达后 5 个工作日内缴清；超过 2,000 美元的货物须在同样 5 个工作日内选定海关去向，逾期未缴的货物将被视为最终放弃。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 厄瓜多爾海關登記表（FRA）— 空運旅客
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 空運旅客的條件性海關登記：僅以下人員須填寫電子 FRA：(1) 入境攜帶應稅貨物（數量、價值或尺寸超過個人物品清單，或不在清單內）；(2) 攜帶進出境的現金、無記名可轉讓票據、貴金屬或寶石價值“等於或超過 1 萬美元”（≥ USD 10,000）；(3) 非居民外國人入境時登記現金以獲得外匯出境稅（ISD）豁免資格（停留不超過 90 天）。依據《通用手冊》SENAE-SENAE-2026-0041-RE（2026-05-04 生效），符合上述情形的每名成年旅客——或家庭群體（由隨行父/母或監護人填報一份 FRA）——須在提交海關監管前以電子方式登記 FRA；無人陪伴未成年人的納稅義務由其法定代理人承擔。FRA 專人專用（不得代第三方填報），以 QR 碼或 PDF 連同護照在掃描儀前出示；僅當 FRA 網站經 SENAE 確認不可用時方可使用紙質格式。申報應稅貨物即須直接接受物理查驗並繳稅——這與單純查驗或免稅額度不同：FOB 價值不超過 2,000 美元（含）的貨物僅在到港國際廳憑 FRA 清關（查驗報告具有簡化報關單效力）；單件物品/套裝超過 2,000 美元仍可在該廳清關；其餘超過 2,000 美元的貨物不能在該廳清關，須在 5 個工作日內選定海關去向（退運境外、明示放棄或移入臨時倉庫走正式進口）。應稅貨物價值在 1,000 至 2,000 美元之間而未填 FRA 的，除補繳稅款外還將按 COPCI 第 193 條 (d) 款處以違規罰款（低於 1,000 美元：僅繳稅款；超過 2,000 美元：可能啟動違法犯罪程序）。稅款抵達後 5 個工作日內未繳清即視為最終放棄。需許可證的貨物價值不超過 500 美元可免證入境，每財政年度一次（服裝、鞋類和紡織品除外）。免稅個人物品包括：電視一臺 ≤60 英寸、顯示器一臺 ≤32 英寸、無人機一臺價值不超過 1,000 美元、新手機一部加舊手機一部、酒精飲料最多 3 升（滿 18 歲）、香水每人 500 毫升（每個家庭 1,000 毫升）。兩個頁面與該手冊均未寫明提交 FRA 本身的費用。該手冊補充適用於海運旅客。法律依據：SENAE-SENAE-2025-0076-RE（2025-07-28）仍然有效——它不在 SENAE-SENAE-2026-0041-RE 廢止的決議之列（後者廢止 SENAE-2017-0345、2017-0408、2023-0079、2024-0123、2025-0068、2025-0117）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在提交海關監管前（“hasta antes de someterse al control pertinente”）以電子方式登記——在機場即到港廳掃描儀讀取護照之前；未寫提前 N 天窗口。稅款須在抵達後 5 個工作日內繳清；超過 2,000 美元的貨物須在同樣 5 個工作日內選定海關去向，逾期未繳的貨物將被視為最終放棄。

procedures.name_en: Formulario de Registro Aduanero (FRA) — land travellers
procedures.name_zh: 厄瓜多尔海关登记表（FRA）— 陆路旅客
procedures.agency: Servicio Nacional de Aduana del Ecuador (SENAE)
procedures.applicability_en: Conditional customs registration for land-border travellers: the FRA filing conditions are the same as by air — only those who (1) enter with taxable goods (goods exceeding the personal-effects or cross-border family-basket limits), (2) bring in or take out cash, bearer negotiable instruments, precious metals or stones worth 'igual o superior a USD $10,000' (equal to or above USD 10,000), or (3) are non-resident foreigners registering cash on entry for the ISD exit-tax exemption must file it; ordinary travellers carrying only personal effects do not ('FRA — sólo cuando aplique'). It is shown as QR code or PDF with the passport or cédula before customs control, and it is personal (no third-party filing). Filing the FRA is distinct from clearing goods: taxable goods that exceed the exception regime's limit require the corresponding customs declaration in addition to the FRA — the FRA alone is not the import declaration. Separate goods channels: cross-border-trade goods up to and including USD 2,000 are registered electronically as a Declaración Aduanera Simplificada (DAS), payable only at authorised banks (never cash to officials); above USD 2,000 the traveller must register as importer, engage an authorised customs broker and file a Declaración Aduanera de Importación (DAI). Once per fiscal year, up to USD 500 of taxable goods may be imported without control documents (permits or technical certifications). No fee for filing the FRA itself is stated. Legal basis: SENAE-SENAE-2025-0076-RE (2025-07-28) and the transborder regime, SENAE-SENAE-2019-0033-RE as amended by SENAE-SENAE-2025-0077-RE.
procedures.applicability_zh: 陆路过境旅客的条件性海关登记：FRA 填报条件与空运相同——仅以下人员须填：(1) 入境携带应税货物（超过个人物品或跨境家庭“菜篮子”限额的货物）；(2) 携带进出境的现金、无记名可转让票据、贵金属或宝石价值“等于或超过 1 万美元”（≥ USD 10,000）；(3) 非居民外国人入境时登记现金以获得外汇出境税（ISD）豁免资格；仅携带个人物品的普通旅客无须填报（“FRA——仅当适用时”）。以 QR 码或 PDF 连同护照或身份证（cédula）在提交海关监管前出示；专人专用，不得代第三方填报。填报 FRA 不同于货物清关：超过例外制度限额的应税货物须在填写 FRA 之外另行提交相应的报关单——仅填 FRA 并非进口申报。货物另有通道：不超过 2,000 美元（含）的跨境贸易货物以电子方式登记简化报关单（DAS），款项只能在授权银行缴纳（绝不以现金交给官员）；超过 2,000 美元的，旅客须登记为进口人、聘请授权报关代理并提交进口报关单（DAI）。每财政年度一次，价值不超过 500 美元的应税货物可免交管制单证（许可或技术认证）。未见填写 FRA 本身收费的规定。法律依据：SENAE-SENAE-2025-0076-RE（2025-07-28）及跨境制度（SENAE-SENAE-2019-0033-RE，经 SENAE-SENAE-2025-0077-RE 修订）。
procedures.timing_en: Register electronically before customs control at the border crossing; no pre-arrival window is stated.
procedures.timing_zh: 在边境口岸提交海关监管前以电子方式登记；未写提前办理窗口。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 厄瓜多爾海關登記表（FRA）— 陸路旅客
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 陸路過境旅客的條件性海關登記：FRA 填報條件與空運相同——僅以下人員須填：(1) 入境攜帶應稅貨物（超過個人物品或跨境家庭“菜籃子”限額的貨物）；(2) 攜帶進出境的現金、無記名可轉讓票據、貴金屬或寶石價值“等於或超過 1 萬美元”（≥ USD 10,000）；(3) 非居民外國人入境時登記現金以獲得外匯出境稅（ISD）豁免資格；僅攜帶個人物品的普通旅客無須填報（“FRA——僅當適用時”）。以 QR 碼或 PDF 連同護照或身份證（cédula）在提交海關監管前出示；專人專用，不得代第三方填報。填報 FRA 不同於貨物清關：超過例外製度限額的應稅貨物須在填寫 FRA 之外另行提交相應的報關單——僅填 FRA 並非進口申報。貨物另有通道：不超過 2,000 美元（含）的跨境貿易貨物以電子方式登記簡化報關單（DAS），款項只能在授權銀行繳納（絕不以現金交給官員）；超過 2,000 美元的，旅客須登記為進口人、聘請授權報關代理並提交進口報關單（DAI）。每財政年度一次，價值不超過 500 美元的應稅貨物可免交管制單證（許可或技術認證）。未見填寫 FRA 本身收費的規定。法律依據：SENAE-SENAE-2025-0076-RE（2025-07-28）及跨境制度（SENAE-SENAE-2019-0033-RE，經 SENAE-SENAE-2025-0077-RE 修訂）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在邊境口岸提交海關監管前以電子方式登記；未寫提前辦理窗口。

procedures.name_en: Declaración Juramentada de Turista (DJT) — tourist vehicle temporary admission
procedures.name_zh: 游客宣誓声明书（DJT）— 旅游车辆临时进境
procedures.agency: Servicio Nacional de Aduana del Ecuador (SENAE)
procedures.applicability_en: Land travellers entering Ecuador in a private or tourist-rental vehicle: the Declaración Juramentada de Turista (DJT) is the sworn declaration through which SENAE authorises the vehicle's temporary admission free of import duties and charges, conditional on its mandatory re-export. Required at the border: identity document (passport duly stamped by migration), driving licence and vehicle registration; for rented vehicles, the rental contract, under which the entering vehicle constitutes a special preferential lien in favour of Ecuadorian Customs. The vehicle may remain for the same maximum period granted to the tourist under the migration record; Ecuadorians who prove residence abroad receive 90 calendar days, consecutive or not, within 12 months. A DJT is never issued to residents of Ecuador, and it is used only where no bilateral or international convention in force with Ecuador covers the vehicle. Local passenger transport and taxis instead present the single passenger-transport document; tourist-transport vehicles present the tourist transport document and the group list.
procedures.applicability_zh: 驾乘私人或旅游租赁车辆入境厄瓜多尔的陆路旅客：游客宣誓声明书（DJT）是向 SENAE 作出的宣誓声明，据此获准车辆临时进境、免缴进口税费，但须履行强制复出境义务。在边境须提交：身份证件（经移民局盖章的护照）、驾驶证和车辆登记证；租赁车辆还须租赁合同，据此入境车辆构成以厄瓜多尔海关为受益人的特别优先质押。车辆停留期与移民记录中授予游客的最长期限相同；能证明居住国外的厄瓜多尔人获 90 个日历日（可连续或不连续，在 12 个月内计算）。DJT 绝不签发给厄瓜多尔居民，且仅适用于不属厄瓜多尔现行双边或国际公约涵盖范围的车辆。当地客运和出租车则提交统一的旅客运输单证；旅游运输车辆提交旅游运输单证及团队名单。
procedures.timing_en: Granted at the border on entry; the vehicle must leave when the traveller's authorised stay expires (maximum per migration record; 90 calendar days within 12 months for Ecuadorians residing abroad); no advance window is stated.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时在边境办理；车辆须在旅客获准停留期届满时离境（按移民记录最长时限；居住国外的厄瓜多尔人为 12 个月内 90 个日历日）；未写提前办理窗口。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 遊客宣誓聲明書（DJT）— 旅遊車輛臨時進境
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 駕乘私人或旅遊租賃車輛入境厄瓜多爾的陸路旅客：遊客宣誓聲明書（DJT）是向 SENAE 作出的宣誓聲明，據此獲准車輛臨時進境、免繳進口稅費，但須履行強制復出境義務。在邊境須提交：身份證件（經移民局蓋章的護照）、駕駛證和車輛登記證；租賃車輛還須租賃合同，據此入境車輛構成以厄瓜多爾海關為受益人的特別優先質押。車輛停留期與移民記錄中授予遊客的最長期限相同；能證明居住國外的厄瓜多爾人獲 90 個日曆日（可連續或不連續，在 12 個月內計算）。DJT 絕不簽發給厄瓜多爾居民，且僅適用於不屬厄瓜多爾現行雙邊或國際公約涵蓋範圍的車輛。當地客運和出租車則提交統一的旅客運輸單證；旅遊運輸車輛提交旅遊運輸單證及團隊名單。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時在邊境辦理；車輛須在旅客獲准停留期屆滿時離境（按移民記錄最長時限；居住國外的厄瓜多爾人為 12 個月內 90 個日曆日）；未寫提前辦理窗口。

procedures.name_en: Biosecurity/Customs declaration card for all inbound passengers (single arrival submission)
procedures.name_zh: 全体入境旅客生物安全/海关申报卡（抵达时单一提交）
procedures.agency: Biosecurity Unit — Agriculture and Veterinary Services Directorate, Falkland Islands Government; card checked by Customs or Biosecurity officers, completed cards kept by the Biosecurity Unit
procedures.applicability_en: Single proven passenger-initiated submission. Per the Arrival section of the Import protocol — Personal imports and Baggage V3.0 (issued 25 May 2026, first issued May 2019), all inbound passengers to the Falklands must fill in one Biosecurity/Customs declaration form, which is handed to and checked by a Customs or Biosecurity Officer before clearance to enter the Islands; completed declaration cards are kept by the Biosecurity Unit. Declared items are inspected at the point of arrival; where there is uncertainty an item is confiscated for further inspection by the Biosecurity Unit; Customs and Biosecurity run spot checks on random passengers to verify declarations are correct and true; prohibited or restricted goods not complying with import restrictions are retained or seized at the time, a 'Notice of Seizure/Retention' is completed (original copy to the passenger, one copy to Customs, one to Biosecurity) and the passenger is informed of the action, the reasons and the right to appeal; an amnesty bin at the airport takes inadvertently imported goods that are not allowed. Personal-import food conditions are triggers of this same card, not a separate procedure: personal imports must be declared to Customs on arrival and are subject to biosecurity inspection; certain fruits, meats and dairy produce may be carried as a Personal Import without an import permit or sanitary certificate only under Appendix 1 conditions — permitted-list fruit purchased in the United Kingdom or Chile, commercially packed and labelled, visibly free from soil, pests or disease, accompanied by a proof of purchase, maximum 5kg total per person; meat, meat products and cheese from the EU bearing the EU symbol or from a non-EU approved establishment, in original sealed packaging, maximum 5kg per person; milk and milk products UHT in original sealed packaging clearly marked UHT; eggs bearing the British Lion mark on the shell, free from faeces and feathers, maximum 12 per person; fish and fish products in sealed commercial packaging; processed plant material and processed meats/dairy likewise requiring sealed commercial packaging detailing product, processing method, manufacturer and country of origin. The 5kg figures are conditional biosecurity admission limits for those specific categories only — not a general aggregate customs duty-free allowance for all goods; whether categories aggregate is not stated in the text and is not computed here. Imports outside the personal allowances (such as seed potatoes or personal imports of plants) require an import permit, obtainable before travel; individuals may apply for a single import permit and a reduced rate is available for non-commercial imports (amount not stated). The Department of Agriculture travelling page repeats the same duty for personal-use imports above its baggage-allowance guidelines — declared to Customs on arrival, subject to inspection, confiscable if criteria are not met or not declared on arrival (the guideline list on that page is an image not captured by this batch's text extraction) — so it is merged as the same card, not a second procedure. The former separate FK-customs-rules-reference entry is merged into this one: it carried the same protocol's import conditions and the same card with no independent second submission action. The official visitors page requires all visitors to provide the Customs & Immigration team with details of where they will stay, but evidences no separate immigration form or submission vehicle, so no second procedure is recorded on that single sentence. Cash-declaration thresholds and general customs duty-free allowances are not covered by any local official text captured this batch and remain unknown; UK mainland figures must not be transposed to the Falkland Islands.
procedures.applicability_zh: 唯一已证实的旅客主动提交。据《进口规程——个人进口与行李》V3.0（2026年5月25日发布，2019年5月首次发布）Arrival段，所有入境福克兰的旅客须填写一张生物安全/海关申报表，交由海关或生物安全官员查验后方可获准进入群岛；已填申报卡由生物安全部门留存。应报物品在抵达现场受检；存疑物品被没收交生物安全部门进一步检查；海关与生物安全对随机旅客抽查以核验申报正确真实；不合规的禁止或限制物品当场扣留或没收，填发《扣留/没收通知》（原件交旅客，海关、生物安全各存一份），旅客获告知处理、理由及可上诉；机场设自弃桶供丢弃误带的不允许物品。个人进口食品条件是同一张卡的触发情形、而非另一程序：个人进口须在抵达时向海关申报并接受生物安全检查；特定水果、肉类及乳制品仅在附件1条件内可作为个人进口免进口许可/卫生证书携带——许可清单内水果须购自英国或智利、商业包装贴标、肉眼无泥土病虫害、附购买凭证，每人最多合计5公斤；肉、肉制品及奶酪须来自欧盟（带EU标志）或欧盟认可的非欧盟企业、原封包装，每人最多5公斤；乳与乳制品须为UHT且原封包装并清晰标注UHT；蛋壳须带British Lion（英国狮）标、无粪便羽毛，每人最多12枚；鱼及鱼制品须密封商业包装；加工植物产品与加工肉类/乳制品同样须密封商业包装并标明产品、加工方式、厂商及原产国。5公斤数字仅是上述特定品类的条件性生物安全准入限量，不是所有物品的合计海关免税额；各品类是否合并计算原文未述、本文不自行累计。超出个人额度的进口（如种用马铃薯、个人携植物等）须办理进口许可，可在行前申请；个人可申请单一进口许可，非商业进口适用优惠费率（数额未载明）。农业部旅行页对超出其行李额度指南的自用进口重复同一义务——抵达时向海关申报、接受检查，未达标或未申报可被没收（该页额度指南本身为图片，本批文本抽取未捕获其内容）——故并入同一张卡、不另立程序。原FK-customs-rules-reference独立条目并入本条：其内容为同一规程的进口条件与同一张卡，无独立第二提交动作。官方访客页要求所有访客向Customs & Immigration提供在福期间住宿地点详情，但未证明存在独立移民表格或提交载体，仅凭该句不立第二程序。现金申报门槛与普通海关免税额本批未获任何本地官源正文覆盖、仍属未知；英国本土数字不得套用于福克兰群岛。

procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时填写，在获准进入福克兰群岛前交海关或生物安全官员。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 全體入境旅客生物安全/海關申報卡（抵達時單一提交）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 唯一已證實的旅客主動提交。據《進口規程——個人進口與行李》V3.0（2026年5月25日發佈，2019年5月首次發佈）Arrival段，所有入境福克蘭的旅客須填寫一張生物安全/海關申報表，交由海關或生物安全官員查驗後方可獲准進入群島；已填申報卡由生物安全部門留存。應報物品在抵達現場受檢；存疑物品被沒收交生物安全部門進一步檢查；海關與生物安全對隨機旅客抽查以核驗申報正確真實；不合規的禁止或限制物品當場扣留或沒收，填發《扣留/沒收通知》（原件交旅客，海關、生物安全各存一份），旅客獲告知處理、理由及可上訴；機場設自棄桶供丟棄誤帶的不允許物品。個人進口食品條件是同一張卡的觸發情形、而非另一程序：個人進口須在抵達時向海關申報並接受生物安全檢查；特定水果、肉類及乳製品僅在附件1條件內可作為個人進口免進口許可/衛生證書攜帶——許可清單內水果須購自英國或智利、商業包裝貼標、肉眼無泥土病蟲害、附購買憑證，每人最多合計5公斤；肉、肉製品及奶酪須來自歐盟（帶EU標誌）或歐盟認可的非歐盟企業、原封包裝，每人最多5公斤；乳與乳製品須為UHT且原封包裝並清晰標註UHT；蛋殼須帶British Lion（英國獅）標、無糞便羽毛，每人最多12枚；魚及魚製品須密封商業包裝；加工植物產品與加工肉類/乳製品同樣須密封商業包裝並標明產品、加工方式、廠商及原產國。5公斤數字僅是上述特定品類的條件性生物安全准入限量，不是所有物品的合計海關免稅額；各品類是否合併計算原文未述、本文不自行累計。超出個人額度的進口（如種用馬鈴薯、個人攜植物等）須辦理進口許可，可在行前申請；個人可申請單一進口許可，非商業進口適用優惠費率（數額未載明）。農業部旅行頁對超出其行李額度指南的自用進口重複同一義務——抵達時向海關申報、接受檢查，未達標或未申報可被沒收（該頁額度指南本身為圖片，本批文本抽取未捕獲其內容）——故併入同一張卡、不另立程序。原FK-customs-rules-reference獨立條目併入本條：其內容為同一規程的進口條件與同一張卡，無獨立第二提交動作。官方訪客頁要求所有訪客向Customs & Immigration提供在福期間住宿地點詳情，但未證明存在獨立移民表格或提交載體，僅憑該句不立第二程序。現金申報門檻與普通海關免稅額本批未獲任何本地官源正文覆蓋、仍屬未知；英國本土數字不得套用於福克蘭群島。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時填寫，在獲准進入福克蘭群島前交海關或生物安全官員。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding duty- and tax-free allowances when entering or returning to French Guiana
procedures.name_zh: 抵达或返回法属圭亚那时超免税值/量物品的旅客申报
procedures.agency: Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (French Customs) — Direction régionale des douanes de Guyane
procedures.applicability_en: Real traveler action, not a separate allowance procedure: on arrival in or return to French Guiana you must declare goods you bought or were given (even if bought all taxes included in metropolitan France) when their value exceeds the duty-free allowance, and pay the local taxes (octroi de mer and octroi de mer régional, Guiana rates). Value allowances per traveler, strictly by direction: (1) from metropolitan France or an EU country to Guiana: EUR 1,000 — the official table shows EUR 1,000 in every age/transport-mode column; (2) from a third country to Guiana: EUR 150 for its 'Voyageurs - de 15 ans' column, EUR 430 for 'Voyageurs + de 15 ans en avion ou en bateau' and EUR 300 for 'Voyageurs + de 15 ans autres modes de transport' — the page does not clarify which column applies to a traveler exactly 15 years old; (3) from Guiana to metropolitan France: the same EUR 150 / 430 / 300, and for this direction the general customs allowances page (updated 2026-08-06) words the categories as 'Voyageurs de moins de 15 ans' and 'Voyageurs de 15 ans et plus' (a traveler exactly 15 belongs to the 15-and-over tier). Quantity allowances per traveler, in both directions (third country / EU country / metropolitan France to Guiana, and Guiana to metropolitan France): tobacco 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g of smoking tobacco; alcohol 1 litre if more than 22° or 2 litres if less than 22° (page wording), plus 4 litres of wine and 16 litres of beer; all travelers under 17 are excluded from the tobacco/alcohol allowances — a separate age rule from the 15-year value columns. Allowances cannot be pooled for a single item (a family of four may not combine 4 × EUR 430 for one EUR 1,720 device). An item above the allowance is taxed on its full value without abatement: customs duty (third-country products only), VAT/TVA (in metropolitan France), octroi de mer and octroi de mer régional (Guiana rates); under CGI article 294-1, VAT is not applicable in Guiana itself. Octroi de mer is a local tax — not a customs duty and not a filing fee. This goods declaration is separate from the EUR 10,000 cash declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 真实旅客动作，免税额度本身不是另一程序：抵达或返回法属圭亚那时，所购或获赠（含在本土已含税购买）物品价值超过免税额度的，须申报并缴纳地方税（octroi de mer 与 octroi de mer régional，按圭亚那税率）。按方向严格区分的每名旅客价值额度：(1) 法国本土或欧盟国家→圭亚那：1,000欧元——官方表格各年龄/交通列均为1,000欧元；(2) 第三国→圭亚那：'Voyageurs - de 15 ans'列150欧元、'Voyageurs + de 15 ans en avion ou en bateau'列430欧元、'Voyageurs + de 15 ans autres modes de transport'列300欧元——页面未澄清恰满15岁者适用哪一列；(3) 圭亚那→法国本土：同为150/430/300欧元，且该方向一般海关额度页（2026-08-06更新）将类别表述为'Voyageurs de moins de 15 ans'与'Voyageurs de 15 ans et plus'（恰满15岁属'15岁及以上'档）。两方向（第三国/欧盟/本土→圭亚那，及圭亚那→本土）的每名旅客量额：烟草200支香烟或100支小雪茄或50支雪茄或250克吸烟用烟丝；酒精超过22°为1升、低于22°为2升（页面原文措辞），另加葡萄酒4升、啤酒16升；未满17岁的所有旅客不享受烟酒免税——与15岁价值档年龄规则相互独立。额度不得为单件物品合并计算（四人家庭不得以4×430欧元合并抵一件1,720欧元的设备）。超额度物品按全额计税、无任何减免：关税（仅限第三国产品）、TVA增值税（在本土）、octroi de mer 与 octroi de mer régional（圭亚那税率）；依CGI第294-1条，圭亚那本地不适用增值税。octroi de mer 为地方税——既非关税，也非申报手续费。本物品申报与1万欧元现金申报为两项独立事项。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in or return to French Guiana (page wording: 'à votre arrivée ou retour en Guyane'); the outbound direction (Guiana to metropolitan France) is checked on entering metropolitan France. The page names no specific form, channel or office.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达或返回法属圭亚那时办理（页面原文：'à votre arrivée ou retour en Guyane'）；圭亚那→本土方向于进入法国本土时核验。页面未列具体表单、通道或办理点。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達或返回法屬圭亞那時超免稅值/量物品的旅客申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 真實旅客動作，免稅額度本身不是另一程序：抵達或返回法屬圭亞那時，所購或獲贈（含在本土已含稅購買）物品價值超過免稅額度的，須申報並繳納地方稅（octroi de mer 與 octroi de mer régional，按圭亞那稅率）。按方向嚴格區分的每名旅客價值額度：(1) 法國本土或歐盟國家→圭亞那：1,000歐元——官方表格各年齡/交通列均為1,000歐元；(2) 第三國→圭亞那：'Voyageurs - de 15 ans'列150歐元、'Voyageurs + de 15 ans en avion ou en bateau'列430歐元、'Voyageurs + de 15 ans autres modes de transport'列300歐元——頁面未澄清恰滿15歲者適用哪一列；(3) 圭亞那→法國本土：同為150/430/300歐元，且該方向一般海關額度頁（2026-08-06更新）將類別表述為'Voyageurs de moins de 15 ans'與'Voyageurs de 15 ans et plus'（恰滿15歲屬'15歲及以上'檔）。兩方向（第三國/歐盟/本土→圭亞那，及圭亞那→本土）的每名旅客量額：菸草200支香菸或100支小雪茄或50支雪茄或250克吸菸用菸絲；酒精超過22°為1升、低於22°為2升（頁面原文措辭），另加葡萄酒4升、啤酒16升；未滿17歲的所有旅客不享受菸酒免稅——與15歲價值檔年齡規則相互獨立。額度不得為單件物品合併計算（四人家庭不得以4×430歐元合併抵一件1,720歐元的設備）。超額度物品按全額計稅、無任何減免：關稅（僅限第三國產品）、TVA增值稅（在本土）、octroi de mer 與 octroi de mer régional（圭亞那稅率）；依CGI第294-1條，圭亞那本地不適用增值稅。octroi de mer 為地方稅——既非關稅，也非申報手續費。本物品申報與1萬歐元現金申報為兩項獨立事項。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達或返回法屬圭亞那時辦理（頁面原文：'à votre arrivée ou retour en Guyane'）；圭亞那→本土方向於進入法國本土時核驗。頁面未列具體表單、通道或辦理點。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration for transport of EUR 10,000 or more between French Guiana and a foreign country
procedures.name_zh: 法属圭亚那与外国之间携带1万欧元及以上现金的申报
procedures.agency: Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (French Customs) — DALIA teleservice
procedures.applicability_en: Independent cash-control procedure, separate from goods allowances: any person (French resident or not; minors through a parent or legal representative) transporting cash — banknotes and coins, bearer-negotiable or endorsable instruments (bearer cheques, travellers' cheques, money orders, promissory notes...), gold, and for intra-EU flows prepaid cards — of an amount equal to or above EUR 10,000 (or the equivalent in foreign currency; exactly EUR 10,000 is included) must declare it to French customs. Proven directions for French Guiana (a DROM): between Guiana and a foreign country — a third country (for Guiana, e.g. Brazil or Suriname) or another EU member state — in either direction; the DALIA FAQ states that transports of cash between a DROM/COM and foreign territory (EU member states or third states) must be declared. Explicitly NOT declarable: cash transported between metropolitan France and French Guiana; the DALIA FAQ states this does not fall within the cash declaration obligation (crossing a goods-tax border is not a cash border). Paper channels: the harmonised EU form covers extra-EU movements to or from metropolitan France, the overseas departments (DOM) or Saint-Martin; the national FR form covers intra-EU movements to or from metropolitan France, the DROM or Saint-Martin. No declaration can be filed a posteriori as a regularisation. DROM-to-DROM routes are not named in the FAQ and remain unknown.
procedures.applicability_zh: 独立现金管制程序，与物品免税额度分开：任何人员（无论是否法国居民；未成年人经父母或法定代理人）携带现金——纸币与硬币、无记名或可背书转让票据（无记名支票、旅行支票、汇票、本票等）、黄金，以及欧盟内部流向的预付卡——金额等于或超过1万欧元（或等值外币；恰为1万欧元亦须申报）的，须向法国海关申报。已证实的法属圭亚那（DROM）方向：圭亚那与外国之间——第三国（对圭亚那如巴西、苏里南）或其他欧盟成员国——的双向运输；DALIA FAQ明确DROM/COM与外国（欧盟成员国或第三国）之间的现金运输须申报。明确无需申报：法国本土与法属圭亚那之间携带的现金；DALIA FAQ明确其不属于现金申报义务范围（货物税境的跨境不等于现金意义上的国境）。纸质渠道：欧盟统一表格（UE）适用于进出本土、海外省（DOM）或圣马丁的欧盟外流动；法国国家表格（FR）适用于进出本土、海外省与大区（DROM）或圣马丁的欧盟内流动。不得事后补报作regularisation。DROM之间路线FAQ未点名，保留未知。
procedures.timing_en: Electronically via the DALIA teleservice from 30 days before the transport date at the earliest, until before crossing the border on the day of travel; or at a customs office at the moment of entering or leaving French territory.
procedures.timing_zh: 最早可自运输日前30天起、最迟于旅行当日过境之前，经DALIA电子申报服务提交；或在出入法国领土之时刻向海关现场申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 法屬圭亞那與外國之間攜帶1萬歐元及以上現金的申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 獨立現金管制程序，與物品免稅額度分開：任何人員（無論是否法國居民；未成年人經父母或法定代理人）攜帶現金——紙幣與硬幣、無記名或可背書轉讓票據（無記名支票、旅行支票、匯票、本票等）、黃金，以及歐盟內部流向的預付卡——金額等於或超過1萬歐元（或等值外幣；恰為1萬歐元亦須申報）的，須向法國海關申報。已證實的法屬圭亞那（DROM）方向：圭亞那與外國之間——第三國（對圭亞那如巴西、蘇里南）或其他歐盟成員國——的雙向運輸；DALIA FAQ明確DROM/COM與外國（歐盟成員國或第三國）之間的現金運輸須申報。明確無需申報：法國本土與法屬圭亞那之間攜帶的現金；DALIA FAQ明確其不屬於現金申報義務範圍（貨物稅境的跨境不等於現金意義上的國境）。紙質渠道：歐盟統一表格（UE）適用於進出本土、海外省（DOM）或聖馬丁的歐盟外流動；法國國家表格（FR）適用於進出本土、海外省與大區（DROM）或聖馬丁的歐盟內流動。不得事後補報作regularisation。DROM之間路線FAQ未點名，保留未知。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 最早可自運輸日前30天起、最遲於旅行當日過境之前，經DALIA電子申報服務提交；或在出入法國領土之時刻向海關現場申報。
