procedures.name_en: Traveler Customs Declaration for Personal Goods and Currency Values (Customs Code Arts. 303-310; NBT Instruction No. 234)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客海关申报（个人物品及现金等货币价值：塔吉克斯坦海关法典第303-310条、国家银行第234号指令）
procedures.agency: Таможенная служба при Правительстве Республики Таджикистан (Customs Service under the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan); NBT Instruction No. 234 issued by the Board of the National Bank of Tajikistan, agreed with the Customs Service
procedures.applicability_en: Tajikistan Customs Code Arts. 303-310 (current consolidated text on the NCZ official page, status «Действующий», amendments listed through Law No. 2186 of 01.10.2025) govern goods moved across the customs border by individuals. Art. 304 grants full relief from customs duties and taxes for goods imported by individuals within Government-set weight (quantity) and value norms; the current numerical allowances of Government Resolution No. 544 cannot be verified from official sources this round (ADLIA public preview: status active, amendments through Decision No. 442 of 31.07.2024, text truncated after definitions) - unknown; duty-free treatment itself is not a separate declaration procedure. Art. 308(2), as amended by Law No. 2186 of 01.10.2025: goods, including vehicles, must be declared in electronic OR written form when they are (1) moved in unaccompanied baggage (still traveler-related, but declared at separate time points under Art. 308(6), not the traveler's on-site submission); (3) restricted for import under Tajik legislation or whose value and (or) quantity exceeds the Art. 304 duty-free limits; (4) restricted for export under Tajik legislation; (5) subject to mandatory written declaration on export under normative legal acts (the currency export rules of NBT Instruction No. 234 below are of this type); (6) vehicles. Art. 308(3): in cases not covered by part 2, goods are declared orally; voluntary written declaration is allowed. Art. 308(4): goods subject to oral declaration may be declared by conduct only in the cases and procedure determined by the customs authority - passage through a specially marked lane is treated as a statement to the customs authority that the person carries no goods subject to written declaration. Art. 308(5): goods of persons under 16 are declared by an accompanying parent, adopter, guardian or custodian, or by the leader of an organised group of minors. Art. 308(6): unaccompanied baggage - on import the declaration is lodged within the Art. 129 time limits; on export simultaneously with presentation of the goods to the customs authority. Art. 309(1), as amended by Laws No. 2001 of 13.11.2023 and No. 2186 of 01.10.2025: customs duties and taxes are paid by individuals in cashless form when goods are declared in electronic or written form, and a person who paid electronically is sent a copy of the payment order; this concerns payment of duties and taxes, not a traveler declaration service fee. Currency values (NBT Instruction No. 234 «О порядке ввоза в Республику Таджикистан и вывоза из Республики Таджикистан валютных ценностей», still listed in the current NBT normative index; NBT-hosted PDF is the version of NBT Board Resolution No. 55 of 23.05.2019 amending Instruction No. 30 of 15.03.2018, MoJ-registered 21.02.2020 - used as the currently obtainable official version, without claiming to have checked every later amendment), per single border crossing: EXPORT - up to the equivalent of USD 3,000 (mandatory written declaration starts from the equivalent of USD 3,001): no mandatory written declaration and no source-of-origin documents; residents, equivalent of USD 3,001 to 10,000 (original wording «от 3'001 ... до суммы эквивалентной 10'000» retained as written, not rewritten as 'strictly above USD 3,000'): mandatory written declaration without source documents; residents, non-integer amounts strictly between the equivalent of USD 3,000 and USD 3,001: point 2 prescribes no rounding or tier-assignment rule, so this narrow gap is left unknown and must not be read as automatically falling into the next tier; residents, strictly above the equivalent of USD 10,000: mandatory written declaration AND source-of-origin documents; non-residents, strictly above the equivalent of USD 3,000 (explicitly «превышающих 3'000»): mandatory written declaration AND source-of-origin documents - this strict threshold is unaffected by the residents-only 3,000-3,001 gap; voluntary declaration is possible for EXPORT of currency values up to the equivalent of USD 3,000. IMPORT of currency values: without quantity limits, in compliance with the customs legislation of Tajikistan; the current NBT PDF contains no import written-declaration threshold (the older scanned trade-portal version's sentence requiring written declaration on import at or above the equivalent of USD 3,000 is NOT adopted as current), so the current import declaration form/threshold is unknown. The Instruction's chapters on authorised banks' interbank currency movements do not apply to travelers. No official source obtained this round proves a separate currency declaration form or a second independent submission, so the cash rules are merged into this single traveler customs declaration procedure (original ID retained, name widened, no duplicate procedure counted). The Code's permission of electronic declaration does not by itself evidence that every checkpoint offers online submission with a receipt.
procedures.applicability_zh: 塔吉克斯坦海关法典第303-310条（NCZ官网现行汇编文本，状态«Действующий（有效）»，修订列至2025年10月1日第2186号法律）规范个人跨境物品。第304条：个人在政府规定的重量（数量）与价值额度内入境的物品，全额免征关税与税收；政府第544号决议的现行具体免税数值本轮无法从官方来源核定（ADLIA公开预览：状态有效、修订至2024年7月31日第442号决议、正文在定义之后截断）——留 unknown；免税待遇本身不构成另一个申报程序。第308条第2款（经2025年10月1日第2186号法律修订）：下列物品（含车辆）须以电子或书面形式申报：（1）非随行行李中的物品（仍与旅客相关，但按第308条第6款另行时点申报，非旅客当场提交，见下）；（3）依法受限入境，或价值及（或）数量超过第304条免税额度的物品；（4）依法受限出境的物品；（5）法令规定出境须强制书面申报的物品（下述国家银行第234号指令的现金出境规则即属此类型）；（6）车辆。第308条第3款：不属于第2款情形的物品口头申报，可自愿书面申报。第308条第4款：口头申报物品仅在海关主管机关确定的情形与程序下可以行为方式申报——走过专门标识的通道即视为向海关声明未携带须书面申报的物品。第308条第5款：未满16岁者的物品由随行的父母、养父母、监护人或照管人申报；未成年人有组织团体出入境时由该团领队申报。第308条第6款：非随行行李——入境时在第129条期限内申报，出境时与向海关呈验物品同时申报。第309条第1款（经2023年11月13日第2001号、2025年10月1日第2186号法律修订）：个人以电子或书面形式申报物品时，关税与税款以非现金方式缴纳，电子缴款人获发付款凭证（付款委托书）副本；此为关税/税款的缴纳，不是旅客申报服务费。现金等货币价值（国家银行第234号指令，国行现行规范目录仍列；国行托管PDF为2019年5月23日理事会第55号决议修订2018年3月15日第30号指令、2020年2月21日司法部登记的版本——仅作为当前可获得的官方版本，不声称核遍其后每次修法），按单次出入境计：出境——等值3,000美元及以下（强制书面申报自等值3,001美元起）：不强制书面申报、免来源文件；居民，等值3,001至10,000美元（原文«от 3'001 … до суммы эквивалентной 10'000»照录，不改写为“严格超过3,000美元”）：须书面申报、免来源文件；居民，等值3,000美元与3,001美元之间的非整数金额：第2项未规定取整或归档规则，此狭窄空档留 unknown，不得推断一切严格>3,000美元者自动落入下一档；居民，严格超过等值10,000美元：须书面申报并附来源文件；非居民，严格超过等值3,000美元（条文明写«превышающих 3'000»）：须书面申报并附来源文件——该严格>门槛不受居民3,000–3,001空档影响；等值3,000美元以内的现金出境可自愿申报。入境：现金等货币价值不限量，遵守塔吉克斯坦海关法规；现行国行PDF无入境书面申报门槛句（较旧的贸易门户扫描版中“入境等值或超过3,000美元须书面申报”一句不采信为现行），故入境现行申报形式/门槛留 unknown。指令中授权银行间资金调运章节不适用于旅客。本轮未获任何官源证明现金使用另一张申报表或需第二次独立提交，故现金规则并入本单一旅客海关申报程序（保留原ID、名称拓宽、不重复计表）。法典允许电子申报本身不证明每个口岸均提供在线提交回执。
procedures.timing_en: Hand luggage and accompanied baggage are declared by the person when crossing the State border (Art. 308(1)); unaccompanied baggage: on import within the Art. 129 time limits, on export simultaneously with presentation of the goods to the customs authority (Art. 308(6)); currency values above the export thresholds: mandatory written declaration when crossing the border on exit; duties and taxes for goods declared in electronic or written form: cashless payment, with a copy of the payment order sent to a person who paid electronically (Art. 309(1)).
procedures.timing_zh: 手提行李与随行行李由本人跨越国境时申报（第308条第1款）；非随行行李：入境时在第129条期限内申报，出境时与向海关呈验物品同时申报（第308条第6款）；超出门槛的现金等货币价值在出境通关时书面申报；以电子或书面形式申报物品的关税与税款以非现金方式缴纳，电子缴款人获发付款凭证副本（第309条第1款）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客海關申報（個人物品及現金等貨幣價值：塔吉克斯坦海關法典第303-310條、國家銀行第234號指令）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 塔吉克斯坦海關法典第303-310條（NCZ官網現行彙編文本，狀態«Действующий（有效）»，修訂列至2025年10月1日第2186號法律）規範個人跨境物品。第304條：個人在政府規定的重量（數量）與價值額度內入境的物品，全額免徵關稅與稅收；政府第544號決議的現行具體免稅數值本輪無法從官方來源核定（ADLIA公開預覽：狀態有效、修訂至2024年7月31日第442號決議、正文在定義之後截斷）——留 unknown；免稅待遇本身不構成另一個申報程序。第308條第2款（經2025年10月1日第2186號法律修訂）：下列物品（含車輛）須以電子或書面形式申報：（1）非隨行行李中的物品（仍與旅客相關，但按第308條第6款另行時點申報，非旅客當場提交，見下）；（3）依法受限入境，或價值及（或）數量超過第304條免稅額度的物品；（4）依法受限出境的物品；（5）法令規定出境須強制書面申報的物品（下述國家銀行第234號指令的現金出境規則即屬此類型）；（6）車輛。第308條第3款：不屬於第2款情形的物品口頭申報，可自願書面申報。第308條第4款：口頭申報物品僅在海關主管機關確定的情形與程序下可以行為方式申報——走過專門標識的通道即視為向海關聲明未攜帶須書面申報的物品。第308條第5款：未滿16歲者的物品由隨行的父母、養父母、監護人或照管人申報；未成年人有組織團體出入境時由該團領隊申報。第308條第6款：非隨行行李——入境時在第129條期限內申報，出境時與向海關呈驗物品同時申報。第309條第1款（經2023年11月13日第2001號、2025年10月1日第2186號法律修訂）：個人以電子或書面形式申報物品時，關稅與稅款以非現金方式繳納，電子繳款人獲發付款憑證（付款委託書）副本；此為關稅/稅款的繳納，不是旅客申報服務費。現金等貨幣價值（國家銀行第234號指令，國行現行規範目錄仍列；國行託管PDF為2019年5月23日理事會第55號決議修訂2018年3月15日第30號指令、2020年2月21日司法部登記的版本——僅作為當前可獲得的官方版本，不聲稱核遍其後每次修法），按單次出入境計：出境——等值3,000美元及以下（強制書面申報自等值3,001美元起）：不強制書面申報、免來源文件；居民，等值3,001至10,000美元（原文«от 3'001 … до суммы эквивалентной 10'000»照錄，不改寫為“嚴格超過3,000美元”）：須書面申報、免來源文件；居民，等值3,000美元與3,001美元之間的非整數金額：第2項未規定取整或歸檔規則，此狹窄空檔留 unknown，不得推斷一切嚴格>3,000美元者自動落入下一檔；居民，嚴格超過等值10,000美元：須書面申報並附來源文件；非居民，嚴格超過等值3,000美元（條文明寫«превышающих 3'000»）：須書面申報並附來源文件——該嚴格>門檻不受居民3,000–3,001空檔影響；等值3,000美元以內的現金出境可自願申報。入境：現金等貨幣價值不限量，遵守塔吉克斯坦海關法規；現行國行PDF無入境書面申報門檻句（較舊的貿易門戶掃描版中“入境等值或超過3,000美元須書面申報”一句不採信為現行），故入境現行申報形式/門檻留 unknown。指令中授權銀行間資金調運章節不適用於旅客。本輪未獲任何官源證明現金使用另一張申報表或需第二次獨立提交，故現金規則併入本單一旅客海關申報程序（保留原ID、名稱拓寬、不重複計表）。法典允許電子申報本身不證明每個口岸均提供線上提交回執。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 手提行李與隨行行李由本人跨越國境時申報（第308條第1款）；非隨行行李：入境時在第129條期限內申報，出境時與向海關呈驗物品同時申報（第308條第6款）；超出門檻的現金等貨幣價值在出境通關時書面申報；以電子或書面形式申報物品的關稅與稅款以非現金方式繳納，電子繳款人獲發付款憑證副本（第309條第1款）。

procedures.name_en: Customs Rules for Travelers: Declaration and Duty-free Amounts (State Customs Service)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客海关规则：申报义务与免税数量（土库曼斯坦国家海关服务）
procedures.agency: Türkmenistanyň Döwlet gümrük gullugy (State Customs Service of Turkmenistan)
procedures.applicability_en: Turkmen Customs requires written declaration of restricted or dutiable goods; other eligible personal goods may use simplified oral declaration and the green channel, while declarable goods use the red channel. Adults declare; accompanying parents/guardians declare minors goods. The page states duty exemption for hand luggage up to 60 kg including up to 1 kg jewellery; excess weight is charged USD 10 per kg and excess jewellery USD 0.20 per gram. The separate personal-use excise allowance is 1 litre alcohol and 2 packs tobacco. Personal-use status depends on the nature, quantity and frequency of movement. Licences and prohibitions still apply; a duty exemption does not remove them. Prescription medicines for personal treatment require the prescription under the stated guidance.
procedures.applicability_zh: 土库曼海关要求受限或应税物品书面申报；符合条件的其他自用物品可简化口头申报并走绿通道，有须申报物品走红通道。成人办理申报，未成年人物品由同行父母或监护人等办理。官方页列手提行李不超过60公斤（含首饰不超过1公斤）免关税；超重每公斤10美元、首饰超1公斤部分每克0.20美元。另列自用消费税免税量为酒1升及烟草2包。自用性质按货物种类、数量及过境频率判断。许可证和禁令仍须遵守，免关税不免许可。个人治疗处方药按指引须随附处方。
procedures.timing_en: At the customs border crossing on entry/exit; corridor choice and declaration at the customs control area.
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境时在口岸办理；在海关检查区选择通道并申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客海關規則：申報義務與免稅數量（土庫曼斯坦國家海關服務）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 土庫曼海關要求受限或應稅物品書面申報；符合條件的其他自用物品可簡化口頭申報並走綠通道，有須申報物品走紅通道。成人辦理申報，未成年人物品由同行父母或監護人等辦理。官方頁列手提行李不超過60公斤（含首飾不超過1公斤）免關稅；超重每公斤10美元、首飾超1公斤部分每克0.20美元。另列自用消費稅免稅量為酒1升及菸草2包。自用性質按貨物種類、數量及過境頻率判斷。許可證和禁令仍須遵守，免關稅不免許可。個人治療處方藥按指引須隨附處方。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境時在口岸辦理；在海關檢查區選擇通道並申報。

procedures.name_en: Import and Export of Cash Currency by Individuals
procedures.name_zh: 个人携带现金货币出入境规则
procedures.agency: Türkmenistanyň Döwlet gümrük gullugy (State Customs Service of Turkmenistan)
procedures.applicability_en: The State Customs Service states that individuals may import cash currency without a quantitative limit, but must declare it. It permits export of cash up to USD 10,000 equivalent, and separately allows taking out previously imported and declared cash on presentation of the import Customs declaration. The page does not specify a numeric import exemption from declaration. Retain the entry declaration for re-export.
procedures.applicability_zh: 国家海关服务页写明，个人携现钞入境不限数量，但须申报；可携出不超过等值1万美元现金，并另允许凭此前入境海关申报携回已申报携入的现金。该页没有列出小额入境免申报门槛。回带此前携入现金须保留入境申报。
procedures.timing_en: Declared to customs at the border on entry; export declaration at the border on departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时在口岸向海关申报；出境时在口岸办理携带申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 個人攜帶現金貨幣出入境規則
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 國家海關服務頁寫明，個人攜現鈔入境不限數量，但須申報；可攜出不超過等值1萬美元現金，並另允許憑此前入境海關申報攜回已申報攜入的現金。該頁沒有列出小額入境免申報門檻。迴帶此前攜入現金須保留入境申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時在口岸向海關申報；出境時在口岸辦理攜帶申報。

procedures.name_en: Passenger Customs Declaration under the Double Corridor (Red/Green) System — cash, finished jewellery and goods triggers
procedures.name_zh: 红绿双通道制度下的旅客海关申报单——现金、成品首饰与物品触发条件
procedures.agency: Давлат божхона қўмитаси (State Customs Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan)；规则制定：内阁第66号决议（2018-01-30，现行文本修订索引含2026-02-05）、第244号决议（2025-04-19）；指引发布：乌兹别克斯坦政府门户 gov.uz
procedures.applicability_en: Government guidance establishes the double corridor system at road, rail and air checkpoints: the green channel serves personal non-commercial goods in hand luggage and accompanied baggage that are not subject to written declaration; the red channel serves goods subject to written declaration and goods declared voluntarily at the traveller's wish. Customs may still exercise control over green-channel travellers (requiring production of goods, documents and, where provided by law, personal search; currency control; taking samples; other actions). Declaration is made when crossing the customs border simultaneously with presenting the goods; goods of persons under 16 are declared by an accompanying person, and any person acting under a power of attorney may declare; the declarant is responsible for the accuracy of the declared information. One and the same passenger customs declaration (Uzbek «йўловчи божхона декларацияси» / Russian «пассажирская таможенная декларация») is triggered by: (1) Cash — Cabinet Decision No. 66 of 30 January 2018, Annex 1, current text (LEX amendment index through 05.02.2026), applies to individuals, residents and non-residents, but not to persons with diplomatic immunity: soum and foreign cash being brought in or taken out in an amount strictly above the equivalent of UZS 100,000,000 (original text: 100 000 000 (юз миллион) сўм эквивалентидан ортиқ) is passed through customs control by filling in a passenger customs declaration and presenting it to a customs officer, the total sum being indicated in the declaration; an amount equal to or not exceeding that equivalent may also be declared voluntarily. Import of cash is unlimited in quantity, subject to customs control rules. Export of cash above the equivalent of UZS 100,000,000 is in principle not allowed, except: residents — members of Government delegations travelling abroad on official business under a Cabinet order; non-residents — within (i) the unused remainder of cash declared on entry under a passenger customs declaration, (ii) funds of prize-winners or participants of international competitions (contests, olympiads) organised in the republic in the established procedure, on the basis of documents confirming the legality of the funds, or (iii) foreign cash proceeds from selling jewellery brought into Uzbekistan under a passenger customs declaration at the «Termez International Trade Centre» free trade zone, the export basis being the passenger customs declaration indicating the jewellery's name, unit and quantity plus a document (cargo waybill) certified by the purchasing legal entity (purchase point). A document underlying an export above the threshold may not be given to other persons and may be used only once; filing a declaration does not itself permit an otherwise prohibited export. (2) Finished jewellery — resident and non-resident individuals may export finished jewellery worth less than UZS 100 million without filling in a passenger customs declaration; jewellery worth UZS 100 million or more may be exported only on the basis of a passenger customs declaration. This «at or above» test differs from the strictly «above» cash test; the two boundaries must not be merged. (3) Goods — Cabinet Decision No. 244 of 19 April 2025, para 3(v): goods worth up to USD 5,000 equivalent may be taken out of Uzbekistan without presenting a customs declaration, except goods for which export customs duty rates are set by legislation — this fixes the exemption boundary only. The positive act of filling in a passenger customs declaration above that figure is stated in the Decision's text only in para 3(g), and only for one class of goods: Uzbek-made measured precious-metal bars and Central Bank precious-metal coins, where their certificates exist, may be taken out of the republic without restriction and, where their value exceeds the value set in sub-item «v» of para 3, with a filled-in passenger customs declaration (original: йўловчи божхона декларациясини тўлдириб олиб чиқишга рухсат берилади). No reverse inference is drawn from para 3(v): for other goods above USD 5,000 equivalent (other than goods for which export customs duty rates are set by legislation) the excerpted Decision text states no written-declaration consequence, and this record asserts none. The duty-free import relief under the same Decision 244 (para 1, from 1 May 2025: USD 1,000 by air, USD 500 by rail and river, USD 300 via road/pedestrian checkpoints; LEX header in-force date 20 July 2025; under para 3(a) no relief applies where the person was abroad less than three calendar days by air or two calendar days by rail/river/road, the goods then being assessed at full value; Annex 1 quantitative norms as amended 09.04.2026: alcohol including beer 2 litres; one tobacco option of 200 cigarettes, 5 cigars or 100 g tobacco; perfume/toilet water 3 items not exceeding 300 ml; biologically active supplements in 10 different names, one primary package per name, total up to 3 kg; import of the listed alcohol and tobacco is prohibited for persons under 21 and by international postal and courier shipments) is tax relief, not a separate traveller-submitted form, and exceeding relief does not waive prohibitions or restrictions. The triggers above all concern the same single passenger customs declaration: a traveller triggering several of them at one crossing files this one declaration, not multiple forms.
procedures.applicability_zh: 政府指引规定公路、铁路和航空口岸实行双通道制度：绿通道供手提行李及随身行李中无须书面申报的自用非商业物品通行；红通道供须书面申报的物品以及旅客自愿申报的物品通行。海关仍可对走绿通道的旅客实施监管（要求出示物品和单证、依法进行人身检查、实施外汇管制、抽取样品等）。申报在通过海关边界时与物品呈验同时进行；未满16岁者的物品由同行人申报，也可由持有委托书的任何人代报；申报人对所报信息的真实性负责。同一张旅客海关申报单（乌文 «йўловчи божхона декларацияси»／俄文 «пассажирская таможенная декларация»）的触发条件：(1) 现金——内阁2018年1月30日第66号决议附件1现行文本（LEX修订索引至2026年2月5日）适用于居民和非居民个人，但不适用于享有外交豁免的人员：进出境的苏姆现金及外币现金严格超过等值1亿苏姆（原文：100 000 000 (юз миллион) сўм эквивалентидан ортиқ）的，须以填写旅客海关申报单并向海关人员出示的方式接受海关监管，单上注明进出境资金总额；等于或不超过该等值金额亦可自愿申报。现金入境数量不限，但须遵守海关监管规则。携出现金超过等值1亿苏姆原则上不允许，例外仅限：居民——经内阁命令随政府代表团因公出访的成员；非居民——在下列范围内：入境时已按旅客海关申报单申报且在乌境内未按法律要求使用的余额；按规定程序在共和国举办的国际赛事（比赛、奥林匹克竞赛）获奖者或参加者凭确认资金合法性的文件所得款项；在「铁尔梅兹国际贸易中心」自由贸易区出售依旅客海关申报单携入乌境的首饰所得外币现金，携出依据为载明首饰名称、计量单位和数量的旅客海关申报单及购买该物品的法人（购买点）确认的文件（货运单）。超限额携出的依据文件不得转交他人且仅可使用一次；填写申报单本身不使原本被禁止的携出变为允许。(2) 成品首饰——居民和非居民个人携出价值低于1亿苏姆的成品首饰无须填写旅客海关申报单；价值达到或超过1亿苏姆的成品首饰仅可凭旅客海关申报单携出。此「达到或超过」口径与现金的「严格超过」口径不同，两者不得混用。(3) 物品——内阁2025年4月19日第244号决议第3条«в»：价值不超过等值5,000美元的物品可无须向海关提交申报单即携出乌境，法定已定出口关税税率的物品除外——该条仅确立免表边界。超过该数额时的正向填表动作，决议文本只在第3条«г»明文规定，且仅限一类物品：持证书的乌兹别克斯坦产贵金属计量锭及央行贵金属币，可不受限制携出乌境，其价值超过第3条«в»小项所定数额时，以填妥旅客海关申报单的方式携出方获允许（原文：йўловчи божхона декларациясини тўлдириб олиб чиқишга рухсат берилади）。不由第3条«в»作反向推论：其他物品超过等值5,000美元（法定已定出口关税税率者除外）是否须书面申报，所据决议文本未载明，本记录不作断言。同决议免税入境优惠（第1条，自2025年5月1日起：航空1,000美元、铁路/河运500美元、公路（步行）口岸300美元；LEX页载生效日2025年7月20日；依第3条«а»，铁路/河运/公路携入者在境外停留不足2个日历日、航空不足3个日历日则不适用免税额度并按物品全值征收；附件1数量限额经2026年4月9日修订：含啤酒在内的酒类2升；烟草三选一为香烟200支、雪茄5支或烟草100克；香水/淡香水3件且不超过300毫升；生物活性补充剂10种、每种原包装1包、总重不超过3公斤；所列烟酒禁止未满21岁者携入、亦禁止经国际邮政和快递携入）属税收优惠而非独立的旅客提交表单，超优惠额度不免除禁限规定。上述触发条件均指向同一张旅客海关申报单：同次跨境同时触发多项者填写这一张申报单，而非多份表单。
procedures.timing_en: At the checkpoint when crossing the customs border in either direction: the corridor is chosen in the customs control area at places of arrival or departure; the passenger customs declaration is filled in and presented simultaneously with presenting the goods or cash to a customs officer.
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境通过海关边界时在口岸办理：在抵达地或离境地的海关监管区选择通道；填写旅客海关申报单并与物品或现金一同向海关人员出示，同时进行。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 紅綠雙通道制度下的旅客海關申報單——現金、成品首飾與物品觸發條件
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 政府指引規定公路、鐵路和航空口岸實行雙通道制度：綠通道供手提行李及隨身行李中無須書面申報的自用非商業物品通行；紅通道供須書面申報的物品以及旅客自願申報的物品通行。海關仍可對走綠通道的旅客實施監管（要求出示物品和單證、依法進行人身檢查、實施外匯管制、抽取樣品等）。申報在通過海關邊界時與物品呈驗同時進行；未滿16歲者的物品由同行人申報，也可由持有委託書的任何人代報；申報人對所報資訊的真實性負責。同一張旅客海關申報單（烏文 «йўловчи божхона декларацияси»／俄文 «пассажирская таможенная декларация»）的觸發條件：(1) 現金——內閣2018年1月30日第66號決議附件1現行文本（LEX修訂索引至2026年2月5日）適用於居民和非居民個人，但不適用於享有外交豁免的人員：進出境的蘇姆現金及外幣現金嚴格超過等值1億蘇姆（原文：100 000 000 (юз миллион) сўм эквивалентидан ортиқ）的，須以填寫旅客海關申報單並向海關人員出示的方式接受海關監管，單上註明進出境資金總額；等於或不超過該等值金額亦可自願申報。現金入境數量不限，但須遵守海關監管規則。攜出現金超過等值1億蘇姆原則上不允許，例外僅限：居民——經內閣命令隨政府代表團因公出訪的成員；非居民——在下列範圍內：入境時已按旅客海關申報單申報且在烏境內未按法律要求使用的餘額；按規定程序在共和國舉辦的國際賽事（比賽、奧林匹克競賽）獲獎者或參加者憑確認資金合法性的文件所得款項；在「鐵爾梅茲國際貿易中心」自由貿易區出售依旅客海關申報單攜入烏境的首飾所得外幣現金，攜出依據為載明首飾名稱、計量單位和數量的旅客海關申報單及購買該物品的法人（購買點）確認的文件（貨運單）。超限額攜出的依據文件不得轉交他人且僅可使用一次；填寫申報單本身不使原本被禁止的攜出變為允許。(2) 成品首飾——居民和非居民個人攜出價值低於1億蘇姆的成品首飾無須填寫旅客海關申報單；價值達到或超過1億蘇姆的成品首飾僅可憑旅客海關申報單攜出。此「達到或超過」口徑與現金的「嚴格超過」口徑不同，兩者不得混用。(3) 物品——內閣2025年4月19日第244號決議第3條«в»：價值不超過等值5,000美元的物品可無須向海關提交申報單即攜出烏境，法定已定出口關稅稅率的物品除外——該條僅確立免表邊界。超過該數額時的正向填表動作，決議文本只在第3條«г»明文規定，且僅限一類物品：持證書的烏茲別克斯坦產貴金屬計量錠及央行貴金屬幣，可不受限制攜出烏境，其價值超過第3條«в»小項所定數額時，以填妥旅客海關申報單的方式攜出方獲允許（原文：йўловчи божхона декларациясини тўлдириб олиб чиқишга рухсат берилади）。不由第3條«в»作反向推論：其他物品超過等值5,000美元（法定已定出口關稅稅率者除外）是否須書面申報，所據決議文本未載明，本記錄不作斷言。同決議免稅入境優惠（第1條，自2025年5月1日起：航空1,000美元、鐵路/河運500美元、公路（步行）口岸300美元；LEX頁載生效日2025年7月20日；依第3條«а»，鐵路/河運/公路攜入者在境外停留不足2個日曆日、航空不足3個日曆日則不適用免稅額度並按物品全值徵收；附件1數量限額經2026年4月9日修訂：含啤酒在內的酒類2升；菸草三選一為香菸200支、雪茄5支或菸草100克；香水/淡香水3件且不超過300毫升；生物活性補充劑10種、每種原包裝1包、總重不超過3公斤；所列菸酒禁止未滿21歲者攜入、亦禁止經國際郵政和快遞攜入）屬稅收優惠而非獨立的旅客提交表單，超優惠額度不免除禁限規定。上述觸發條件均指向同一張旅客海關申報單：同次跨境同時觸發多項者填寫這一張申報單，而非多份表單。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境通過海關邊界時在口岸辦理：在抵達地或離境地的海關監管區選擇通道；填寫旅客海關申報單並與物品或現金一同向海關人員出示，同時進行。

procedures.name_en: Luggage Articles Declaration and Red/Green Channel Clearance (GACC Order No. 276)
procedures.name_zh: 进出境行李物品书面申报与红绿通道通关（海关总署令第276号）
procedures.agency: 中华人民共和国海关总署 (General Administration of Customs of China, GACC)
procedures.applicability_en: GACC Order 276, effective 1 April 2025, requires truthful Customs declaration of luggage. Written declaration may use paper or electronic data. On entry it is required for prohibited/restricted or quarantine/health-risk articles, excess currency, goods above duty-free limits, commercial goods/samples, unaccompanied luggage and other specified items. Exit categories are listed separately in Article 10. Present travel documents and complete declaration before Customs inspection; otherwise it is treated as non-declaration. Where red/green channels operate, travellers requiring written declaration, or unsure of the rules, must use red. Declaration does not make prohibited imports or exports lawful.
procedures.applicability_zh: 2025年4月1日生效的海关总署第276号令要求行李如实申报，书面申报可用纸表或电子数据。入境须书面申报的包括禁限或检疫/健康风险物品、超额货币、超免税限额物品、商业货物/货样、分运行李及其他规定物品；出境类别按第10条另列。应出示旅行证件并在海关查验前完成申报，否则按未申报处理。实施红绿通道的口岸，须书面申报或不清楚规则者走红通道。申报不使禁止进出境物品合法。
procedures.timing_en: At the customs declaration desk or other designated place when entering or leaving; red/green channel selection happens at the customs site on crossing.
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境时在海关申报台等指定地点办理；红绿通道在通关现场选择。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出境行李物品書面申報與紅綠通道通關（海關總署令第276號）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 2025年4月1日生效的海關總署第276號令要求行李如實申報，書面申報可用紙表或電子資料。入境須書面申報的包括禁限或檢疫/健康風險物品、超額貨幣、超免稅限額物品、商業貨物/貨樣、分運行李及其他規定物品；出境類別按第10條另列。應出示旅行證件並在海關查驗前完成申報，否則按未申報處理。實施紅綠通道的口岸，須書面申報或不清楚規則者走紅通道。申報不使禁止進出境物品合法。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境時在海關申報臺等指定地點辦理；紅綠通道在通關現場選擇。

procedures.name_en: RMB and Foreign-currency Cash Crossing Limits and Declaration
procedures.name_zh: 人民币和外币现钞进出境限额与书面申报
procedures.agency: 中华人民共和国海关总署；携带证发放：银行/国家外汇管理局
procedures.applicability_en: RMB cash is limited to CNY 20,000 per person per crossing in either direction. Foreign-currency cash brought in above USD 5,000 equivalent must be declared in writing to Customs; for same-day repeat crossers (exiting or entering more than once within one day) and short-term repeat crossers (more than once within 15 days), the second and each subsequent entry must be declared in writing regardless of amount - these entry rules are confirmed consistently by the 2003 Interim Measures and by Article 89 of the 2020 Current Account Foreign Exchange Business Guideline. Taking foreign-currency cash out - general tiers only, which by the terms of the 2003 Interim Measures themselves exclude repeat crossers (Arts 4-5, 7 and the issuing notice; consistent with the 2020 Guideline Art. 89): (1) taking out no more than the amount declared on the most recent entry requires no Foreign Exchange Carriage Permit and is released against that declaration record; (2) with no such record, or exceeding it: up to and including USD 5,000 equivalent without a permit; above USD 5,000 up to and including USD 10,000 equivalent with a bank-issued Carriage Permit (multiple permits aggregating above USD 10,000 equivalent are not released); above USD 10,000 equivalent in principle not permitted, with SAFE-branch permits only for stated special situations (large outbound groups, long scientific-expedition teams, government-leader visits, travel to war-torn or strictly FX-controlled, financially poor or financially unstable countries, and other special cases). Applying for a Carriage Permit is a licence application to a bank or SAFE branch, not a Customs declaration, and is subject to review - application does not mean automatic approval. Exits by same-day and short-term (within 15 days) repeat crossers are carved out of the general tiers (2003 Measures Art. 5) and subject to separate special limits whose current amounts are unverified and cannot be inferred from the general tiers; check with SAFE or the port Customs before travel (see unresolved CN-frequent-exit-effect).
procedures.applicability_zh: 人民币现钞出入境每人每次限20,000元。外币现钞入境超过等值5,000美元的应向海关书面申报；当天多次往返（一天内出境或入境超过一次）及短期内多次往返（15天内出境或入境超过一次）者第二次及以上入境，不论金额均应书面申报——此入境规则为2003年《携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法》与2020年《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》第八十九条所一致确认。外币出境仅列通用档位，且依2003年《办法》自身条文排除多次往返人员（第四、五、七条及其印发通知，与2020年指引第八十九条一致）：(1)携出不超过最近一次入境时申报数额的，不需申领《携带外汇出境许可证》（《携带证》），海关凭该申报数额记录验放；(2)没有或超出该记录的：携出不超过等值5,000美元（含）免证放行；等值5,000美元以上至10,000美元（含）应向银行申领《携带证》（多张《携带证》累计超过等值10,000美元海关不予放行）；超过等值10,000美元原则上不得携带出境，仅人数较多的出境团组、出境时间较长或旅途较长的科学考察团组、政府领导人出访、赴战乱或外汇管制严格、金融条件差或金融动乱的国家（地区）及其他特殊情况可向外汇局申领。申领《携带证》是向银行或外汇局的许可申请，不是海关申报，且须经审核，不等于自动批准。当天多次往返及短期内（15天内）多次往返人员的出境不适用上述通用档位，另受专门额度约束；该专门额度的现行数值未核准、不能按通用层级推断，出行前向国家外汇管理局或口岸海关核实（见unresolved CN-frequent-exit-effect）。
procedures.timing_en: Entry: written declaration to Customs at the crossing when above the threshold. Exit: where required, obtain the Foreign Exchange Carriage Permit from a bank or SAFE branch before departure; Customs verifies it at the crossing.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境超过限额的，在入境时向海关书面申报；需《携带证》出境的，在离境前向银行或外汇局申领，出境时凭以验放。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 人民幣和外幣現鈔進出境限額與書面申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 人民幣現鈔出入境每人每次限20,000元。外幣現鈔入境超過等值5,000美元的應向海關書面申報；當天多次往返（一天內出境或入境超過一次）及短期內多次往返（15天內出境或入境超過一次）者第二次及以上入境，不論金額均應書面申報——此入境規則為2003年《攜帶外幣現鈔出入境管理暫行辦法》與2020年《經常項目外匯業務指引（2020年版）》第八十九條所一致確認。外幣出境僅列通用檔位，且依2003年《辦法》自身條文排除多次往返人員（第四、五、七條及其印發通知，與2020年指引第八十九條一致）：(1)攜出不超過最近一次入境時申報數額的，不需申領《攜帶外匯出境許可證》（《攜帶證》），海關憑該申報數額記錄驗放；(2)沒有或超出該記錄的：攜出不超過等值5,000美元（含）免證放行；等值5,000美元以上至10,000美元（含）應向銀行申領《攜帶證》（多張《攜帶證》累計超過等值10,000美元海關不予放行）；超過等值10,000美元原則上不得攜帶出境，僅人數較多的出境團組、出境時間較長或旅途較長的科學考察團組、政府領導人出訪、赴戰亂或外匯管制嚴格、金融條件差或金融動亂的國家（地區）及其他特殊情況可向外匯局申領。申領《攜帶證》是向銀行或外匯局的許可申請，不是海關申報，且須經審核，不等於自動批准。當天多次往返及短期內（15天內）多次往返人員的出境不適用上述通用檔位，另受專門額度約束；該專門額度的現行數值未核准、不能按通用層級推斷，出行前向國家外匯管理局或口岸海關核實（見unresolved CN-frequent-exit-effect）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境超過限額的，在入境時向海關書面申報；需《攜帶證》出境的，在離境前向銀行或外匯局申領，出境時憑以驗放。

procedures.name_en: Conditional health declaration under GACC Notice 151
procedures.name_zh: 海关151号公告的条件健康申报
procedures.agency: 中华人民共和国海关总署（原制度发布机关）
procedures.applicability_en: GACC Notice 151 of 2023 removed the general health declaration card requirement for entering and departing travellers from 1 November 2023. Travellers with infectious-disease symptoms, including fever, cough, breathing difficulties, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash or unexplained subcutaneous bleeding, or a diagnosed infectious disease, must still proactively declare their health to Customs and cooperate with health quarantine. The current GACC service guide for entry-exit health quarantine (item type: administrative inspection; no fee; no application materials from the public) records that all travellers undergo temperature monitoring and medical patrol as a universal administrative inspection, not universal card-filling; travellers with fever or other discomfort should proactively declare their health status; those taken into the medical screening room must cooperate with axillary mercury-thermometer temperature checks and truthfully and completely fill the health declaration card there. Showing a vaccination certificate for travel from yellow-fever-endemic countries (regions), or a health certificate in cases under Article 102 of the implementing rules, is a separate documentary track. This does not rule out additional origin- or outbreak-specific measures; the boundary of the check on Notice 151's continued effect is recorded under unresolved CN-health-current-annex.
procedures.applicability_zh: 海关2023年第151号公告自2023年11月1日起免一般出入境旅客健康申明卡；有发热、咳嗽、呼吸困难、呕吐、腹泻、皮疹、不明原因皮下出血等传染病症状，或已诊断患传染病的出入境人员，仍须主动向海关进行健康申报并配合卫生检疫。现行海关"出入境人员卫生检疫"办事指南（事项类型：行政检查；不收费；不需公众提交申请材料）载明：所有进出境人员均应接受海关体温监测、医学巡查等卫生检疫，此为普遍行政检查、不是普遍填卡；有发热或其他身体不适者应主动申报健康状况；被带入医学排查室做传染病排查的人员应配合腋下水银温度计体温检测，并如实完整填写《健康申明卡》。来自黄热病流行国家（地区）的应出示《预防接种证书》、属实施细则第一百零二条所列情形的应出示《健康证明》，系另一轨证件义务。不据此排除针对来源地或疫情的其他专项措施；151号现行性核对边界见unresolved CN-health-current-annex。
procedures.timing_en: Proactively report symptoms or diagnosed infection to Customs at entry/exit; where taken into medical screening, complete the health declaration card at the screening site.
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境时有相关症状或已诊断传染病的，主动向海关申报；被带入医学排查室的，在排查现场填写《健康申明卡》。

fee.note: 海关办事指南：该事项为行政检查，不收费。

procedures.name_zh_hant: 海關151號公告的條件健康申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 海關2023年第151號公告自2023年11月1日起免一般出入境旅客健康申明卡；有發熱、咳嗽、呼吸困難、嘔吐、腹瀉、皮疹、不明原因皮下出血等傳染病症狀，或已診斷患傳染病的出入境人員，仍須主動向海關進行健康申報並配合衛生檢疫。現行海關"出入境人員衛生檢疫"辦事指南（事項類型：行政檢查；不收費；不需公眾提交申請材料）載明：所有進出境人員均應接受海關體溫監測、醫學巡查等衛生檢疫，此為普遍行政檢查、不是普遍填卡；有發熱或其他身體不適者應主動申報健康狀況；被帶入醫學排查室做傳染病排查的人員應配合腋下水銀溫度計體溫檢測，並如實完整填寫《健康申明卡》。來自黃熱病流行國家（地區）的應出示《預防接種證書》、屬實施細則第一百零二條所列情形的應出示《健康證明》，系另一軌證件義務。不據此排除針對來源地或疫情的其他專項措施；151號現行性核對邊界見unresolved CN-health-current-annex。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境時有相關症狀或已診斷傳染病的，主動向海關申報；被帶入醫學排查室的，在排查現場填寫《健康申明卡》。

procedures.name_en: Foreign traveller arrival card: online or paper
procedures.name_zh: 外国人入境卡：网上或纸质
procedures.agency: National Immigration Administration
procedures.applicability_en: Since 20 November 2025 foreign travellers can fill the arrival card online before arrival, or use border equipment/QR code or a paper card if needed. Exemptions: Chinese permanent-resident ID holders; non-Chinese Hong Kong/Macao Mainland Travel Permit holders; group visas or group visa-free entry; 24-hour direct transit remaining in the restricted port area; cruise travellers returning on the same ship; expedited-channel entry; foreign international-transport crew. The National Immigration Administration explicitly states that submission is free.
procedures.applicability_zh: 2025年11月20日起外国人可来华前网上填入境卡；不便网上填者可到口岸扫码、使用现场设备或填纸卡。豁免包括外国人永久居留身份证、非中国籍港澳居民来往内地通行证、团体签证或团体免签、24小时直接过境不离口岸限定区域、乘邮轮出入境并随原船返回、快捷通道入境及出入境交通工具外籍员工。国家移民管理局明确填报不收任何费用。
procedures.timing_en: Before arrival online, or at the arrival checkpoint using official equipment or a paper card.
procedures.timing_zh: 来华前网上填，或抵达口岸使用官方设备/纸卡。

fee.note: 国家移民管理局明确不收费。

procedures.name_zh_hant: 外國人入境卡：網上或紙質
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 2025年11月20日起外國人可來華前網上填入境卡；不便網上填者可到口岸掃碼、使用現場設備或填紙卡。豁免包括外國人永久居留身份證、非中國籍港澳居民來往內地通行證、團體簽證或團體免簽、24小時直接過境不離口岸限定區域、乘郵輪出入境並隨原船返回、快捷通道入境及出入境交通工具外籍員工。國家移民管理局明確填報不收任何費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 來華前網上填，或抵達口岸使用官方設備/紙卡。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of Currency and Bearer Negotiable Instruments (CBNIs)
procedures.name_zh: 现金类物品（货币及不记名可转让票据）申报及披露
procedures.agency: 香港海关（香港海关及税务部门，Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department）
procedures.applicability_en: Arrivals at specified control points carrying currency and bearer negotiable instruments (CBNIs) totalling more than HKD 120,000 must declare at the red channel. Other arrivals and persons about to depart must disclose when required by Customs and declare if above the threshold. An accompanying adult who knows that an under-16 has such CBNIs must declare/disclose for the child. Airside transit passengers without immigration clearance are exempt. Travellers may pre-fill an e-form and present its QR code, or use a paper form. Foreign-currency valuation follows the Customs page exchange-rate rules; amounts on the form are recorded in the original currency. First-time HKD 2,000 settlement is conditional on no prior money-laundering/terror-financing conviction and no reasonable suspicion the funds are criminal proceeds or terrorist property; it is not automatic.
procedures.applicability_zh: 经指定管制站抵港、携现金及不记名可转让票据总值超过12万港元者须走红通道申报。其他地点抵港者及离境者按海关要求披露，超门槛时申报。同行成人知悉未满16岁者携有该等大额款项时须代其申报或披露。不经入境查验的机场过境旅客豁免。可先填电子表再出示二维码，或使用纸表。外币估值按海关页规定汇率，表中金额按原币填写。首次缴2,000港元解除法律责任须无洗钱/恐怖融资前科且款项无合理犯罪或恐怖资产嫌疑，并非所有首次违法自动适用。
procedures.timing_en: Arrival: declaration via Red Channel at the control point. Departure: disclosure when required by a Customs officer. E-form may be pre-filled before arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵港：在管制站经红通道申报。离港：经海关人员要求时披露。E-form 电子表格可预先填写。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金類物品（貨幣及不記名可轉讓票據）申報及披露
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 經指定管制站抵港、攜現金及不記名可轉讓票據總值超過12萬港元者須走紅通道申報。其他地點抵港者及離境者按海關要求披露，超門檻時申報。同行成人知悉未滿16歲者攜有該等大額款項時須代其申報或披露。不經入境查驗的機場過境旅客豁免。可先填電子表再出示 QR Code，或使用紙表。外幣估值按海關頁規定匯率，表中金額按原幣填寫。首次繳2,000港元解除法律責任須無洗錢/恐怖融資前科且款項無合理犯罪或恐怖資產嫌疑，並非所有首次違法自動適用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵港：在管制站經紅通道申報。離港：經海關人員要求時披露。E-form 電子表格可預先填寫。

procedures.name_en: Duty-free Concessions and Red/Green Channel Clearance for Incoming Passengers
procedures.name_zh: 入境旅客应课税品免税优惠与红绿通道通关
procedures.agency: 香港海关（Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department）
procedures.applicability_en: Incoming passengers aged 18+ may bring for personal use 1 litre of liquor above 30% ABV, and 19 cigarettes or 1 cigar or 25 g cigars or 25 g other manufactured tobacco. Hong Kong Identity Card holders must have spent at least 24 hours outside Hong Kong to qualify for the liquor concession. Cross-boundary drivers are not entitled to these concessions. Commercial dutiable goods have no traveller concession: use the red channel, declare the purpose and lodge the required import declaration. Dutiable goods exceeding the concession must be declared; prohibited/controlled goods remain governed separately.
procedures.applicability_zh: 18岁及以上入境旅客可为自用携1升酒精度超过30%的酒，以及19支香烟、或1支雪茄、或25克雪茄、或25克其他制成烟草。香港身份证持有人享酒类优惠须离港至少24小时；此条件不扩大到所有烟草优惠。跨境司机不享这些优惠。商业应税货物无旅客优惠，须走红通道、说明用途并办所需进口报关。超优惠数量的应税物品须申报；禁止或管制物品另按相关法规办理。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival, choose Red Channel (goods to declare) or Green Channel (nothing to declare) in the Customs Arrival Hall.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵港时在海关入境大堂选择红通道（有申报物品）或绿通道（无需申报）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境旅客應課稅品免稅優惠與紅綠通道通關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 18歲及以上入境旅客可為自用攜1升酒精度超過30%的酒，以及19支香菸、或1支雪茄、或25克雪茄、或25克其他製成菸草。香港身份證持有人享酒類優惠須離港至少24小時；此條件不擴大到所有菸草優惠。跨境司機不享這些優惠。商業應稅貨物無旅客優惠，須走紅通道、說明用途並辦所需進口報關。超優惠數量的應稅物品須申報；禁止或管制物品另按相關法規辦理。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵港時在海關入境大堂選擇紅通道（有申報物品）或綠通道（無需申報）。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of Cross-border Movement of Cash and Bearer Negotiable Instruments
procedures.name_zh: 携带现金和无记名可转让票据出入境申报
procedures.agency: 澳门海关（Serviços de Alfândega da RAEM）
procedures.applicability_en: Law 6/2017 Articles 2-4 require persons entering Macao with cash and bearer negotiable instruments totalling MOP 120,000 or more, including foreign-currency equivalent, to declare; use the red channel. Outbound persons at or above the same threshold must declare when questioned by Customs. The statutory wording includes the threshold itself, resolving the inconsistent shorthand on the general passenger page. Customs provides a paper declaration and an electronic submission platform. The Customs notice exempts transit passengers making a brief stop. Declaration does not impose a general limit on lawful funds.
procedures.applicability_zh: 第6/2017号法律第2至4条要求入境自然人携现金和无记名可转让票据总值达到或超过12万澳门元（含等值外币）时申报，使用红通道；出境达到同一门槛时按海关查问申报。法条明确包含本数，解决一般旅客页简写高于造成的歧义。海关提供纸表和电子平台，海关通告豁免中途短暂停留的过境旅客。申报制度并非合法资金的一般携带上限。
procedures.timing_en: Entry: declare at the Red Channel when crossing. Exit: declare upon questioning by a Customs officer. Online platform allows electronic submission in advance.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境：通关时经红色通道申报。出境：被海关人员查问时如实申报。可预先经网上电子申报平台提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜帶現金和無記名可轉讓票據出入境申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 第6/2017號法律第2至4條要求入境自然人攜現金和無記名可轉讓票據總值達到或超過12萬澳門元（含等值外幣）時申報，使用紅通道；出境達到同一門檻時按海關查問申報。法條明確包含本數，解決一般旅客頁簡寫高於造成的歧義。海關提供紙表和電子平臺，海關通告豁免中途短暫停留的過境旅客。申報制度並非合法資金的一般攜帶上限。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境：通關時經紅色通道申報。出境：被海關人員查問時如實申報。可預先經網上電子申報平臺提交。

procedures.name_en: Entry/Exit Goods Declaration and Red/Green Channel Clearance
procedures.name_zh: 入境/出境货物申报与红绿通道通关
procedures.agency: 澳门海关（Serviços de Alfândega da RAEM）
procedures.applicability_en: Goods requiring prior licences, sanitary/phytosanitary quarantine or special regimes, quantities above the personal-use table, and goods over MOP 5,000 unless covered by External Trade Law Article 10(3), require the stated declaration procedure on entry. Relevant licences remain necessary. The personal-use table is a declaration exemption, not a blanket tax or import-permit exemption. Its daily limits include specified food/plant categories up to 5 kg, 19 cigarettes, 1 cigar weighing less than 3 g, and 25 g tobacco, with the tobacco categories combined limited to 25 g; liquor above 30% ABV up to 1 litre. Listed controlled medicines are limited to 30 days treatment and other medicines to 90 days. On departure, prior-licence/special-regime goods and goods over MOP 5,000 outside the Article 10(3) exception require declaration. Cash is covered separately.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境携须预先许可、卫生/植物检疫或特别制度物品、超个人自用表数量的物品，以及超过5,000澳门元且不属《对外贸易法》第10(3)条例外的货物，须按规定申报；相关许可证仍须办理。个人自用表属于申报豁免，不等于全部免税或免进口许可。每人每日限表列特定食品/植物类别合计5公斤、香烟19支、单支少于3克雪茄1支、烟叶25克，烟草各类合计须不超过25克；酒精度超过30%的饮料1升。表列管制药物为30日治疗量、其他药物90日治疗量。出境须预先许可/特别制度物品，及超过5,000元又不属第10(3)条例外的货物须申报。现金另列。
procedures.timing_en: At the port when crossing: choose Red Channel (declare) or Green Channel (nothing to declare).
procedures.timing_zh: 在口岸通关时选择红色通道（申报）或绿色通道（无需申报）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境/出境貨物申報與紅綠通道通關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境攜須預先許可、衛生/植物檢疫或特別制度物品、超個人自用表數量的物品，以及超過5,000澳門元且不屬《對外貿易法》第10(3)條例外的貨物，須按規定申報；相關許可證仍須辦理。個人自用表屬於申報豁免，不等於全部免稅或免進口許可。每人每日限表列特定食品/植物類別合計5公斤、香菸19支、單支少於3克雪茄1支、菸葉25克，菸草各類合計須不超過25克；酒精度超過30%的飲料1升。表列管制藥物為30日治療量、其他藥物90日治療量。出境須預先許可/特別制度物品，及超過5,000元又不屬第10(3)條例外的貨物須申報。現金另列。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在口岸通關時選擇紅色通道（申報）或綠色通道（無需申報）。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of Accompanied and Unaccompanied Goods (Portable Goods Declaration)
procedures.name_zh: 携带品·别送品申报书（随身及分运行李申报）
procedures.agency: Japan Customs (財務省税関)
procedures.applicability_en: All persons entering or returning to Japan submit the accompanied/unaccompanied-goods declaration. A family examined together may submit one paper form through its representative; unaccompanied goods require two copies. Visit Japan Web electronic submission is recommended and paper remains available. Personal-use allowance combines accompanied goods and unaccompanied goods imported within six months after arrival. Limits per adult: alcohol 3 bottles of 760 ml; cigarettes 200; perfume 2 oz (about 56 ml), excluding eau de cologne/toilette; other goods JPY 200,000 overseas value. Heated tobacco, cigars and other tobacco have separate quantity rules on the linked table. Under-20s get no alcohol/tobacco exemption; under-6s only clearly personal items. Customs selects items fitting within JPY 200,000 for exemption and taxes the remaining items; a single item over JPY 200,000 is taxed in full. A category totalling JPY 10,000 or less is generally exempt.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有入境或回国者提交携带品/别送品申告书。同一家族同时受检可由代表交一份纸表，别送行李须两份。推荐Visit Japan Web电子申报，纸表仍可用。免税个人用品合并计算随身行李及入境后六个月内进口的别送行李。成年人额度：酒3瓶（每瓶760毫升）、香烟200支、香水2盎司约56毫升（不含古龙水/淡香水）、其他物品海外市价合计20万日元。加热烟、雪茄及其他烟草另依链接表的数量标准。未满20岁无烟酒免税；未满6岁仅玩具等明确自用品免税。海关选择落在20万日元内的物品免税，其余物品征税；单件超过20万日元全额计税。每品类总值不超过1万日元原则上免税。
procedures.timing_en: Submitted at the customs inspection area on arrival in Japan (after quarantine, immigration and animal/plant quarantine). Visit Japan Web input recommended before reaching the inspection area.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达日本后在税关检查场提交（位于检疫、入国审查、动植物检疫之后）。Visit Japan Web 建议在到达检查场前完成录入。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜帶品·別送品申報書（隨身及分運行李申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有入境或回國者提交攜帶品/別送品申告書。同一家族同時受檢可由代表交一份紙表，別送行李須兩份。推薦Visit Japan Web電子申報，紙表仍可用。免稅個人用品合併計算隨身行李及入境後六個月內進口的別送行李。成年人額度：酒3瓶（每瓶760毫升）、香菸200支、香水2盎司約56毫升（不含古龍水/淡香水）、其他物品海外市價合計20萬日元。加熱煙、雪茄及其他菸草另依連結表的數量標準。未滿20歲無煙酒免稅；未滿6歲僅玩具等明確自用品免稅。海關選擇落在20萬日元內的物品免稅，其餘物品徵稅；單件超過20萬日元全額計稅。每品類總值不超過1萬日元原則上免稅。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達日本後在稅關檢查場提交（位於檢疫、入國審查、動植物檢疫之後）。Visit Japan Web 建議在到達檢查場前完成錄入。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of Payment Means (Import/Export of Cash etc. over JPY 1,000,000)
procedures.name_zh: 支付手段等携带输出·输入申报书（超过100万日元现金等）
procedures.agency: Japan Customs (財務省税関)
procedures.applicability_en: Required when carrying payment means EXCEEDING the equivalent of JPY 1,000,000 (JPY 100,000 for exports destined for North Korea) on departure from or arrival in Japan. Covered items: total of cash (Japanese or foreign currency), cheques (including traveller's cheques), promissory notes and securities (stocks, government bonds etc.); separately, gold bullion of 90%+ purity exceeding 1kg in weight. The form is 支払手段等の携帯輸出・輸入申告書, available at customs offices nationwide or printable from the website (Japanese and English versions). Declaration applies in BOTH directions (import on arrival and export on departure). Separately regulated payment means may also require an export/import licence under the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act. Threshold wording: 超える (exceeding), i.e. strictly more than JPY 1,000,000 equivalent.
procedures.applicability_zh: 出国或入境日本时携带超过100万日元等值（出口目的地为朝鲜（北朝鲜）时为超过10万日元等值）的支付手段须申报。对象为现金（本国外币）、支票（含旅行支票）、本票、有价证券（股票、国债等）的合计额；另含纯度90%以上、重量超过1kg的金锭。申报表为「支付手段等携带输出·输入申报书」，全国机场/港口税关备置，也可从官网下载打印（日语、英语版）。入境和出境（双向）均适用。门槛措辞为「超える」（即严格大于100万日元等值）。属外汇法管制对象的支付手段另需许可申请。
procedures.timing_en: On departure: at the customs office in the departure lobby (checked baggage) or the customs departure counter before immigration (carry-on). On arrival: at the customs inspection area.
procedures.timing_zh: 出境时：出发大厅税关事务室（托运行李，须在交运行李前申报）或出国审查场前的税关出境柜台（手提行李）。入境时：税关检查场。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 支付手段等攜帶輸出·輸入申報書（超過100萬日元現金等）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 出國或入境日本時攜帶超過100萬日元等值（出口目的地為朝鮮（北朝鮮）時為超過10萬日元等值）的支付手段須申報。對象為現金（本國外幣）、支票（含旅行支票）、本票、有價證券（股票、國債等）的合計額；另含純度90%以上、重量超過1kg的金錠。申報表為「支付手段等攜帶輸出·輸入申報書」，全國機場/港口稅關備置，也可從官網下載列印（日語、英語版）。入境和出境（雙向）均適用。門檻措辭為「超える」（即嚴格大於100萬日元等值）。屬外匯法管制對象的支付手段另需許可申請。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出境時：出發大廳稅關事務室（托運行李，須在交運行李前申報）或出國審查場前的稅關出境櫃檯（手提行李）。入境時：稅關檢查場。

procedures.name_en: Foreigner's Entry Record (ED Card / 外国人入国記録)
procedures.name_zh: 外国人入国记录（ED卡，上陆申请卡）
procedures.agency: Immigration Services Agency of Japan (出入国在留管理庁)
procedures.applicability_en: All foreigners newly entering Japan are required to submit the Foreigner's Entry Record (ED card) at immigration inspection. Electronic submission via Visit Japan Web is recommended (register an account, enter the entry record menu, show the QR code to the immigration inspector); each accompanying family member needs their own entry and QR code. Paper ED cards remain available and acceptable, e.g. for those unfamiliar with smartphones; they are issued in 3 bilingual versions (JP/EN/Traditional Chinese, JP/EN/Simplified Chinese, JP/EN/Korean) and must be filled in in English or Japanese. Not applicable to re-entrants (including deemed re-entry), special landing, SOFA/UN status-of-forces and RAA agreement cases. Immigration inspection by an officer is still required even with the QR code. At some airports/terminals, joint kiosks read the Visit Japan Web QR code and IC passport for one-stop immigration and customs procedures. Short-term visitors should enter a stay of 90 days or fewer.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有新规入境日本的外国人均须在入国审查时提交「外国人入国记录（ED卡）」。官方推荐通过 Visit Japan Web 电子提交（注册账户后在外国人入国记录菜单录入，向审查官出示二维码）；同行家属须每人分别录入并各自出示二维码。纸质ED卡仍继续发放并可用（如不惯用智能手机者）；有日语/英语/繁体中文、日语/英语/简体中文、日语/英语/韩语三种併记版本，须用英语或日语填写。再入国（含视同再入国）、特例上陆、日美地位协定（SOFA）、联合国军地位协定及圆滑化协定（RAA）对象不适用。出示二维码仍须接受入国审查官审查。部分机场（航站楼）设有共同キオスク，可一次性读取 VJW 二维码与IC旅券办理入管与税关手续。短期滞在（观光/商务/探亲）者滞在日数应填90日以下。
procedures.timing_en: Submitted at immigration inspection on arrival; Visit Japan Web input recommended before reaching the inspection area.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达后在入国审查时提交；建议在到达入国审查场前完成 Visit Japan Web 录入。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 外國人入國記錄（ED卡，上陸申請卡）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有新規入境日本的外國人均須在入國審查時提交「外國人入國記錄（ED卡）」。官方推薦通過 Visit Japan Web 電子提交（註冊賬戶後在外國人入國記錄菜單錄入，向審查官出示 QR Code）；同行家屬須每人分別錄入並各自出示 QR Code。紙質ED卡仍繼續發放並可用（如不慣用智能手機者）；有日語/英語/繁體中文、日語/英語/簡體中文、日語/英語/韓語三種併記版本，須用英語或日語填寫。再入國（含視同再入國）、特例上陸、日美地位協定（SOFA）、聯合國軍地位協定及圓滑化協定（RAA）對象不適用。出示 QR Code 仍須接受入國審查官審查。部分機場（航站樓）設有共同キオスク，可一次性讀取 VJW QR Code 與IC旅券辦理入管與稅關手續。短期滯在（觀光/商務/探親）者滯在日數應填90日以下。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達後在入國審查時提交；建議在到達入國審查場前完成 Visit Japan Web 錄入。

procedures.name_en: Passenger Customs Declaration (Зорчигчийн гаалийн мэдүүлэг) — written declaration and red/green channel system
procedures.name_zh: 旅客海关申报单（Зорчигчийн гаалийн мэдүүлэг）——书面申报与红绿通道制
procedures.agency: Mongolian Customs General Administration (Гаалийн ерөнхий газар)
procedures.applicability_en: One form and one process; the former separate cash-declaration record MN-currency-declaration is merged here because the cash trigger uses the same passenger customs declaration. Customs Law Art 228 lets Customs apply red/green channels; the traveler chooses the channel and may use green when not carrying goods specified in Art 8.1 of that law; a green-channel traveler need not fill the passenger Customs (Goods) declaration (228.5), while the passenger and personal effects still cross under Customs control (regulation 6.12). Under the Customs regulation on travelers' personal-use items crossing the customs border (amended by Director General's Order A/350 of 2022-12-30): the passenger fills in the customs declaration, signs it and hands it to the state customs inspector (5.2); the red/green choice, or declaration by conduct, exists only at international airports and border points where the dual-channel system has been implemented, not at every land port (5.3); a passenger with any item listed in 5.5 crosses via the red channel (6.4) and declares it in writing on the passenger customs declaration (5.5), whereas a green-channel passenger may leave the form unwritten (6.10). Items requiring the written declaration include motor vehicles (5.5.1); more than MNT 15 million, or the equivalent in foreign currency, financial instruments or electronic money (5.5.2); quantities exceeding the 2.3.1 duty-free list (5.5.5); firearms, inheritance property, unaccompanied shipments, narcotic and psychotropic substances, duty-payable goods and goods carried for others (5.5.6-5.5.11). AML/CFT Law Art 15.1 separately obliges a passenger moving more than MNT 15 million, or the equivalent in foreign currency, financial instruments or electronic money, in cash across Mongolia's border to declare it truthfully in the customs declaration; Art 15.1 and regulation 5.5.2 both read '15 саяас дээш', strictly more than MNT 15 million. Regulation 6.6 of the same traveler regulation instead reads 'арван таван сая ба түүнээс дээш' - MNT 15 million and above: the declaration is completed in two copies, the inspector checks the cash and stamps the declaration, and one copy is returned to the passenger. The two calibers conflict at exactly MNT 15 million (15.1/5.5.2 apply only above it; 6.6 also reaches the amount itself), so a traveler carrying exactly MNT 15 million cannot safely be told that no written declaration is due; final applicability and channel choice at that exact amount remain unresolved. The rule applies to crossing the border in either direction. Inbound, currency carried on the person may be brought in up to the amount declared to Customs; outbound, Mongolian citizens may export freely convertible currency up to the declared amount, and foreign citizens and stateless persons on the basis of the import customs declaration or a bank purchase receipt (2.5). An unofficial 2022 English translation of the Currency Regulation Law (Art 13) states the same inbound rule and also lists a notarised gift/inheritance certificate among outbound evidence - context only, not authority for the current threshold. AML Art 15.4-15.5, which banned exporting physical precious metals and cash foreign currency valued above MNT 20 million unless declared, was expressly in force only until 2023-01-01 and is not a 2026 limit. Duty-free quantities (2.3.1, as amended): spirit items 2 litres; wine 2 litres; beer 3 litres; янжуур 200 units; сигар and навчин тамхи (leaf tobacco) 50 units each; задгай тамхи (loose tobacco) not more than 250 g. These benefits do not apply to travelers under 21 or who exit and re-enter within 24 hours (2.4; the Administrative Chamber of the Supreme Court, Decision No. 02 of 2023, invalidated only the added free-zone phrase in 2.4). Duty relief is a tax matter; exceeding 2.3.1 independently triggers the written declaration. Commercial-nature goods outside personal effects are cleared on separate forms - up to MNT 3,000,000 on the Passenger Goods Customs Clearance Sheet (Form No. 2), above that on a goods declaration (5.11) - never on the passenger declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 一张表格、一套流程；原独立的现金申报记录 MN-currency-declaration 已并入本条，因现金触发与通道/申报使用的是同一张旅客海关申报单。海关法第228条授权海关实施红绿通道；旅客自选通道，未携带该法第8.1条所列货物者可走绿通道；走绿通道者可免填旅客海关（物品）申报单（228.5），但旅客本人及其个人物品仍在海关监管下过境（规程6.12）。依据海关总署《旅客个人使用物品通过海关边境规程》（经署长2022年12月30日A/350号令修订）：旅客填写海关申报单、签名后交给国家海关检查员（5.2）；红绿通道选择或以行为向海关申报，仅在国际机场及已实施双通道系统的边境口岸提供，并非所有陆路口岸（5.3）；携带5.5所列任一物品的旅客应经红色通道通关（6.4），并以旅客海关申报单向海关书面申报（5.5）；走绿通道者可不填写该申报单（6.10）。须书面申报的物品包括：机动车辆（5.5.1）；超过1,500万图格里克、或等值外币、金融工具、电子货币（5.5.2）；超过2.3.1免税数量的物品（5.5.5）；枪支、遗产财产、分离托运货物、麻醉及精神药物、应税货物、代他人携带的货物（5.5.6–5.5.11）。《反洗钱和打击资助恐怖主义法》第15.1条另行规定：旅客以现金将超过1,500万图格里克、或等值外币、金融工具、电子货币跨越蒙古国境，须就该事项在海关申报单中如实申报（15.1与规程5.5.2原文均为“15 саяас дээш”，严格超过、不含本数）；同一规程6.6则采“达到或超过”口径（“арван таван сая ба түүнээс дээш”，含本数）：携带1,500万图格里克及以上现金者，申报单一式两份填写，海关检查员查验现金并在申报单上盖章，其中一份交还旅客。两个口径在恰好1,500万图格里克一点上条内冲突：15.1/5.5.2仅及严格超过，6.6则及于本数；超过1,500万确属必报，恰好1,500万不能安全称免报（6.6明文要求填两份），该本数点的最终适用与通道选择留为有界未知。该规则适用于任一方向的跨境。入境方向，随身携带的货币以向海关申报的数量为限带入；出境方向，蒙古公民可携出以申报数量为限的可自由兑换外币，外国公民及无国籍人士凭自国外带入的海关申报单或银行购买凭证携出（2.5）。2022年《货币监管法》非官方英文译本（第13条）载有同一入境规则，并将经国家公证处出具的赠与/遗产公证书列为出境凭证之一——仅作背景参考，不作为现行门槛的效力依据。反洗钱法第15.4–15.5条曾禁止未经申报携出价值超过2,000万图格里克（严格大于、不含本数）的实物贵金属与外币现金，但该两条明示仅适用至2023年1月1日，并非2026年现行限额。免税数量（2.3.1，经修订）：烈酒类2升、葡萄酒2升、啤酒3升、янжуур 200支、сигар与навчин тамхи（烟叶）各50支、задгай тамхи（散装烟丝）不超过250克。该免税优惠不适用于未满21周岁的旅客，以及出境后24小时内返回入境的旅客（2.4；最高法院行政审判庭2023年第02号裁定仅废止2.4中后增的“自由区返回”表述）。免税属税收优惠问题；超过2.3.1数量则独立触发书面申报义务。不属于个人使用物品的商业性质货物另行走单独单证——价值不超过300万图格里克者用《旅客货物海关通关单》（第2号表格），超过者用货物申报单（5.11）——不使用旅客申报单。
procedures.timing_en: At the crossing point on arrival and departure: where a written declaration is required, the passenger fills and signs it and hands it to the customs inspector; cash above MNT 15 million must be declared in writing; under regulation 6.6 (MNT 15 million or more) the declaration is completed in two copies, one returned to the passenger.
procedures.timing_zh: 在出入境口岸现场办理：需书面申报时，旅客当场填写、签名并交海关检查员；现金超过1,500万图格里克须书面申报；按规程6.6（达1,500万图格里克及以上者）一式两份申报，其中一份交还旅客。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客海關申報單（Зорчигчийн гаалийн мэдүүлэг）——書面申報與紅綠通道制
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 一張表格、一套流程；原獨立的現金申報記錄 MN-currency-declaration 已併入本條，因現金觸發與通道/申報使用的是同一張旅客海關申報單。海關法第228條授權海關實施紅綠通道；旅客自選通道，未攜帶該法第8.1條所列貨物者可走綠通道；走綠通道者可免填旅客海關（物品）申報單（228.5），但旅客本人及其個人物品仍在海關監管下過境（規程6.12）。依據海關總署《旅客個人使用物品通過海關邊境規程》（經署長2022年12月30日A/350號令修訂）：旅客填寫海關申報單、簽名後交給國家海關檢查員（5.2）；紅綠通道選擇或以行為向海關申報，僅在國際機場及已實施雙通道系統的邊境口岸提供，並非所有陸路口岸（5.3）；攜帶5.5所列任一物品的旅客應經紅色通道通關（6.4），並以旅客海關申報單向海關書面申報（5.5）；走綠通道者可不填寫該申報單（6.10）。須書面申報的物品包括：機動車輛（5.5.1）；超過1,500萬圖格里克、或等值外幣、金融工具、電子貨幣（5.5.2）；超過2.3.1免稅數量的物品（5.5.5）；槍支、遺產財產、分離託運貨物、麻醉及精神藥物、應稅貨物、代他人攜帶的貨物（5.5.6–5.5.11）。《反洗錢和打擊資助恐怖主義法》第15.1條另行規定：旅客以現金將超過1,500萬圖格里克、或等值外幣、金融工具、電子貨幣跨越蒙古國境，須就該事項在海關申報單中如實申報（15.1與規程5.5.2原文均為“15 саяас дээш”，嚴格超過、不含本數）；同一規程6.6則採“達到或超過”口徑（“арван таван сая ба түүнээс дээш”，含本數）：攜帶1,500萬圖格里克及以上現金者，申報單一式兩份填寫，海關檢查員查驗現金並在申報單上蓋章，其中一份交還旅客。兩個口徑在恰好1,500萬圖格里克一點上條內衝突：15.1/5.5.2僅及嚴格超過，6.6則及於本數；超過1,500萬確屬必報，恰好1,500萬不能安全稱免報（6.6明文要求填兩份），該本數點的最終適用與通道選擇留為有界未知。該規則適用於任一方向的跨境。入境方向，隨身攜帶的貨幣以向海關申報的數量為限帶入；出境方向，蒙古公民可攜出以申報數量為限的可自由兌換外幣，外國公民及無國籍人士憑自國外帶入的海關申報單或銀行購買憑證攜出（2.5）。2022年《貨幣監管法》非官方英文譯本（第13條）載有同一入境規則，並將經國家公證處出具的贈與/遺產公證書列為出境憑證之一——僅作背景參考，不作為現行門檻的效力依據。反洗錢法第15.4–15.5條曾禁止未經申報攜出價值超過2,000萬圖格里克（嚴格大於、不含本數）的實物貴金屬與外幣現金，但該兩條明示僅適用至2023年1月1日，並非2026年現行限額。免稅數量（2.3.1，經修訂）：烈酒類2升、葡萄酒2升、啤酒3升、янжуур 200支、сигар與навчин тамхи（菸葉）各50支、задгай тамхи（散裝菸絲）不超過250克。該免稅優惠不適用於未滿21週歲的旅客，以及出境後24小時內返回入境的旅客（2.4；最高法院行政審判庭2023年第02號裁定僅廢止2.4中後增的“自由區返回”表述）。免稅屬稅收優惠問題；超過2.3.1數量則獨立觸發書面申報義務。不屬於個人使用物品的商業性質貨物另行走單獨單證——價值不超過300萬圖格里克者用《旅客貨物海關通關單》（第2號表格），超過者用貨物申報單（5.11）——不使用旅客申報單。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在出入境口岸現場辦理：需書面申報時，旅客當場填寫、簽名並交海關檢查員；現金超過1,500萬圖格里克須書面申報；按規程6.6（達1,500萬圖格里克及以上者）一式兩份申報，其中一份交還旅客。

procedures.name_en: Entry Card (border control/immigration, separate from the customs declaration)
procedures.name_zh: 入境卡（边检环节，与海关申报单相互独立）
procedures.agency: Mongolian border control / immigration authority
procedures.applicability_en: Mongolia's eAIP GEN 1.3 (published under the currently valid eAIP; the cached page text carries no amendment date) states that before the aircraft arrives crew assist in giving out Entry Cards and getting passengers to fill them out (2.1.1), and that passengers must fill out an Entry Card when entering or leaving Mongolia, presenting it together with international travel documents at border control examination (2.1.2). This is an immigration border-control card, not a customs form. The evidence covers air travel only; whether Entry Cards are used at land border checkpoints is not established by this source and remains unknown.
procedures.applicability_zh: 蒙古eAIP GEN 1.3（收录于现行有效eAIP发布；缓存页面文本未显示修订日期）载明：航班抵达前机组协助发放Entry Card并指导乘客填写（2.1.1）；乘客进出蒙古须填写Entry Card，并连同国际旅行证件一并交边防检查查验（2.1.2）。该卡属边检环节单证，不是海关表格。上述证据仅覆盖航空旅行；Entry Card在陆路口岸是否使用，本来源不能证明，仍为未知。
procedures.timing_en: Distributed on board before arrival (crew assist); filled out and presented at border control on entry and exit (air).
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达前在航班上发放（机组协助），出入境边检时填写并出示（航空）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境卡（邊檢環節，與海關申報單相互獨立）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 蒙古eAIP GEN 1.3（收錄於現行有效eAIP發佈；緩存頁面文本未顯示修訂日期）載明：航班抵達前機組協助發放Entry Card並指導乘客填寫（2.1.1）；乘客進出蒙古須填寫Entry Card，並連同國際旅行證件一併交邊防檢查查驗（2.1.2）。該卡屬邊檢環節單證，不是海關表格。上述證據僅覆蓋航空旅行；Entry Card在陸路口岸是否使用，本來源不能證明，仍為未知。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達前在航班上發放（機組協助），出入境邊檢時填寫並出示（航空）。

procedures.name_en: Passenger Health Declaration Form (Зорчигчийн эрүүл мэндийн мэдүүлэг) — online form labeled Exit/Entry; AIP duty stated for visitors entering Mongolia
procedures.name_zh: 旅客健康声明表（Зорчигчийн эрүүл мэндийн мэдүүлэг）——标注“出境/入境”的在线表；AIP义务明说入境访客
procedures.agency: Ministry of Health of Mongolia / Health Development Center (Эрүүл мэндийн яам; hosted at dec.hdc.gov.mn)
procedures.applicability_en: Mongolia's currently valid eAIP GEN 1.3 states that all visitors to Mongolia are required to fill out a health declaration form (3.1.1), giving their current health condition and contact address in Mongolia in the form (3.1.2); the cached page's HTML metadata marks the edition effective 2026-09-17, and the identical 3.1.1 text stands in the AIRAC edition effective 2025-02-20. The AIP is an aviation publication: it evidences the duty in an air-travel framing and by itself neither extends the duty to land crossings nor proves checks at any particular port. A currently live official online channel exists for the traveler to comply in person: the Passenger Health Declaration Form of the Ministry of Health, hosted on the Health Development Center site (dec.hdc.gov.mn/gate?q_id=1; HTTP 200 on 2026-09-29). Its bilingual notice asks passengers, according to relevant laws and regulations, to fill out this Exit/Entry Health Declaration Form truthfully, warning that refusal to report, inaccurate reporting or calling on others not to comply brings liability under Articles 6.23 and 15.2 of the Law on Violations; selecting Disagree makes submission impossible. The page presents one form for both directions (its own heading says Exit/Entry Health Declaration Form), while the expressly stated legal duty in the cached sources is the AIP's requirement for visitors to Mongolia (entering; air framing); no cached source states an equally mandatory duty on all departing travelers. The form collects: the crossing port - airport entries Buyant-Ukhaa and Chinggis Khaan, or land ports Altanbulag, Sukhbaatar, Tsagaannuur, Zamiin-Uud; transport mode - airplane, train or vehicle (with airline and flight/trip fields); the border entry date; personal information (passport or ID number, surname, given name, nationality, sex, email); an active contact phone number in Mongolia; an address in Mongolia; foreign travel within the past 21 days; a symptom checklist (fever, sore throat, coughing, rash, red watery eyes, running nose, other); a truthfulness certification; and an arithmetic verification before the ИЛГЭЭХ (SUBMIT) button. The dropdown's inclusion of land ports and train/vehicle options shows the form is built to serve those crossings, not that checks are operated there. Chinggis Khaan International Airport's operator notice of 2026-08-17 addressed 'Dear Passengers' to complete this Exit/Entry Health Declaration Form, linking to the same ministry page; that notice's headline was framed for 'All COP17 guests and delegates', and UNCCD COP17 ran in Ulaanbaatar from 17 to 28 August 2026 and has ended, so the notice is event-era messaging: it corroborates the channel and an August 2026 airport-level direction to passengers, but does not by itself establish that every ordinary air passenger must currently submit. This record is accordingly scoped to three proven elements: the AIP-stated duty (air-visitor framing; edition effective 2026-09-17), a live official online form (labeled Exit/Entry) that the traveler can personally fill and submit, and airport-direction evidence dated 2026-08-17. Not established and not asserted: any submission window, advance deadline relative to the crossing, or point of on-site verification (neither the AIP nor the ministry page states one); whether and at which crossings submission is actually checked; whether a receipt or confirmation is returned after successful submission (not tested; no personal data submitted); any paper alternative; and actual enforcement at land ports.
procedures.applicability_zh: 蒙古现行 eAIP GEN 1.3 规定：所有访蒙旅客均须填写健康声明表（3.1.1），并须在表中填报本人当前健康状况及在蒙古的联系地址（3.1.2）；该页缓存 HTML 元数据标注版本生效日为2026-09-17，且2025-02-20生效的 AIRAC 版本载有同一 3.1.1 文本。AIP 属航空出版文件：其义务表述采航空语境，本身既不能把义务外推至陆路口岸，也不能证明任何具体口岸设有查验。现已存在可由旅客本人履行的现行官方在线渠道：卫生部旅客健康声明表，托管于卫生发展中心站点（dec.hdc.gov.mn/gate?q_id=1；2026-09-29 抓取 HTTP 200）。页面双语提示旅客按相关法律法规如实填写本出境/入境健康声明表，并警示拒绝申报、不如实申报或号召他人不履行者，依《违法法》第6.23、15.2条承担责任；选择“不同意”即无法提交。该页面以单一“出境/入境”双向界面呈现（页面标题即“出境/入境健康声明表”），而缓存官源中明文设定的义务只有 AIP 对访蒙旅客（入境、航空语境）的要求，并无任何官源断言出境方向对所有旅客同样强制。表单采集：入境口岸——机场项 Buyant-Ukhaa 与 Chinggis Khaan，或陆路口岸 Altanbulag、Sukhbaatar、Tsagaannuur、Zamiin-Uud；交通方式——飞机/火车/汽车（含航空公司及航班/行程号字段）；入境日期；个人信息（护照或登记号、姓、名、国籍、性别、邮箱）；在蒙有效联系电话；在蒙地址；近21天境外旅行史；症状自查清单（发热、咽痛、咳嗽、皮疹、眼红流泪、流涕、其他）；真实性确认；算术校验后点击 ИЛГЭЭХ（SUBMIT）提交。下拉项列入陆路口岸及火车/汽车选项，只说明该表为这些口岸设计，不证明当地设有查验。成吉思汗国际机场运营方2026-08-17公告以“Dear Passengers”请旅客完成本出境/入境健康声明表并链接同一卫生部页面；该公告标题面向“All COP17 guests and delegates”，而 UNCCD COP17 于2026-08-17至28在乌兰巴托举行且已结束——该公告属活动期信息，可佐证渠道本身及2026年8月机场对旅客的指引，但不能单独证明当前所有普通航空旅客均须提交。本记录据此仅限定于三项已证要素：AIP 所载义务（航空语境；版本生效日2026-09-17）、旅客可自行填写并提交的现行官方在线表（界面标注“出境/入境”）、日期为2026-08-17 的机场指引证据。未证且不在本记录断言：相对过境的提交开放窗口、提前时限或现场验收时点（AIP 与卫生部页均未载明）；各口岸是否实际查验提交；提交成功后是否出具回执或确认（未实测，未提交任何个人数据）；有无纸质替代渠道；陆路口岸的实际执行。
procedures.timing_en: Online: the traveler fills the official web form (select Agree, choose port and transport, fill the identity/contact/health fields, answer the arithmetic check) and clicks ИЛГЭЭХ (SUBMIT); neither the AIP nor the ministry page states a submission window, an advance deadline relative to the crossing, or when/where the declaration is verified, and what the site returns after successful submission (receipt or confirmation) is unverified.
procedures.timing_zh: 线上办理：旅客在官网表单填写——选“同意”、选口岸与交通方式、填写身份/联系/健康字段、回答算术校验——并点击 ИЛГЭЭХ（SUBMIT）提交；AIP 与卫生部页均未载明相对过境的提交开放窗口、提前时限或现场验收时点；提交成功后页面返回什么（回执或确认）未实测。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客健康聲明表（Зорчигчийн эрүүл мэндийн мэдүүлэг）——標註“出境/入境”的線上表；AIP義務明說入境訪客
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 蒙古現行 eAIP GEN 1.3 規定：所有訪蒙旅客均須填寫健康聲明表（3.1.1），並須在表中填報本人當前健康狀況及在蒙古的聯繫地址（3.1.2）；該頁緩存 HTML 元資料標註版本生效日為2026-09-17，且2025-02-20生效的 AIRAC 版本載有同一 3.1.1 文本。AIP 屬航空出版文件：其義務表述採航空語境，本身既不能把義務外推至陸路口岸，也不能證明任何具體口岸設有查驗。現已存在可由旅客本人履行的現行官方線上渠道：衛生部旅客健康聲明表，託管於衛生髮展中心網站（dec.hdc.gov.mn/gate?q_id=1；2026-09-29 抓取 HTTP 200）。頁面雙語提示旅客按相關法律法規如實填寫本出境/入境健康聲明表，並警示拒絕申報、不如實申報或號召他人不履行者，依《違法法》第6.23、15.2條承擔責任；選擇“不同意”即無法提交。該頁面以單一“出境/入境”雙向界面呈現（頁面標題即“出境/入境健康聲明表”），而緩存官源中明文設定的義務只有 AIP 對訪蒙旅客（入境、航空語境）的要求，並無任何官源斷言出境方向對所有旅客同樣強制。表單採集：入境口岸——機場項 Buyant-Ukhaa 與 Chinggis Khaan，或陸路口岸 Altanbulag、Sukhbaatar、Tsagaannuur、Zamiin-Uud；交通方式——飛機/火車/汽車（含航空公司及航班/行程號欄位）；入境日期；個人資訊（護照或登記號、姓、名、國籍、性別、信箱）；在蒙有效聯繫電話；在蒙地址；近21天境外旅行史；症狀自查清單（發熱、咽痛、咳嗽、皮疹、眼紅流淚、流涕、其他）；真實性確認；算術校驗後點擊 ИЛГЭЭХ（SUBMIT）提交。下拉項列入陸路口岸及火車/汽車選項，只說明該表為這些口岸設計，不證明當地設有查驗。成吉思汗國際機場營運方2026-08-17公告以“Dear Passengers”請旅客完成本出境/入境健康聲明表並連結同一衛生部頁面；該公告標題面向“All COP17 guests and delegates”，而 UNCCD COP17 於2026-08-17至28在烏蘭巴托舉行且已結束——該公告屬活動期資訊，可佐證渠道本身及2026年8月機場對旅客的指引，但不能單獨證明當前所有普通航空旅客均須提交。本記錄據此僅限定於三項已證要素：AIP 所載義務（航空語境；版本生效日2026-09-17）、旅客可自行填寫並提交的現行官方線上表（界面標註“出境/入境”）、日期為2026-08-17 的機場指引證據。未證且不在本記錄斷言：相對過境的提交開放窗口、提前時限或現場驗收時點（AIP 與衛生部頁均未載明）；各口岸是否實際查驗提交；提交成功後是否出具回執或確認（未實測，未提交任何個人資料）；有無紙質替代渠道；陸路口岸的實際執行。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 線上辦理：旅客在官網表單填寫——選“同意”、選口岸與交通方式、填寫身份/聯繫/健康欄位、回答算術校驗——並點擊 ИЛГЭЭХ（SUBMIT）提交；AIP 與衛生部頁均未載明相對過境的提交開放窗口、提前時限或現場驗收時點；提交成功後頁面返回什麼（回執或確認）未實測。

procedures.name_en: Traveler's Personal Effects Customs Declaration (여행자휴대품신고서)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客携带品海关申报（旅行者携带品申报书）
procedures.agency: Korea Customs Service (관세청)
procedures.applicability_en: Travelers with goods to declare submit the traveler's declaration (paper or mobile; mobile voluntary declaration also allows mobile issuance and payment of the tax bill). Travelers with nothing to declare skip the form and use the nothing-to-declare lane, and may still be subject to customs examination. Duty-free allowance per traveler, by total dutiable value of all items: USD 800 or less (이하, i.e. ≤), including agricultural/marine/livestock products limited to 5kg per item, 40kg total and KRW 100,000 total overseas purchase value. Additionally: alcohol with total volume of 2L or less and total price of USD 400 or less; 200 filtered (combustible) cigarettes; 20ml of e-cigarette nicotine liquid (nicotine content under 1%); 100ml perfume. Persons under 19 (by birth year) get NO duty-free allowance for alcohol or tobacco. Voluntary declaration of goods exceeding the allowance reduces duty by 30%; undeclared goods caught incur a penalty of 40% of payable tax (60% for repeat within 2 years). Items that must be declared regardless of duty-free limits include commercial goods/samples/repairs, guns, narcotics, CITES items, animals/plants/fruits/food, counterfeit goods, and means of payment exceeding USD 10,000.
procedures.applicability_zh: 有申报物品的旅客提交申报书（纸质或手机；手机自愿申报还可在线接收并缴纳税款通知单）。无申报物品的旅客可免交申报书、走「无申报通道」，但仍可能接受海关检查。免税额度（按各物品课税价格合计）：全体合计800美元（미화 800달러 이하，即≤800）以内，其中农畜水产品每品类限5公斤、总量40公斤、海外购置价合计10万韩元以内。另有额外额度：总量2升以内且总价400美元以内的酒类；卷烟（滤嘴烟）200支；电子烟烟液20毫升（尼古丁含量不足1%）；香水100毫升。未满19岁（按出生年份）者酒类和烟草无免税额度。自愿申报超额物品可减征关税30%；未申报被查获加征税额40%（2年内2次以上为60%）。与免税额度无关、必须申报的物品包括商用物品/样品/修理品、枪炮、麻醉类、CITES动植物及其制品、动物/植物/水果/食品类、侵权商品、超过1万美元的支付手段等。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, after baggage claim: travelers with declarable goods submit the declaration at customs (paper or mobile); others proceed through the nothing-to-declare lane.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达后领取行李之后：有申报物品的旅客向海关提交申报（纸质或手机）；其余旅客走无申报通道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客攜帶品海關申報（旅行者攜帶品申報書）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 有申報物品的旅客提交申報書（紙質或手機；手機自願申報還可線上接收並繳納稅款通知單）。無申報物品的旅客可免交申報書、走「無申報通道」，但仍可能接受海關檢查。免稅額度（按各物品課稅價格合計）：全體合計800美元（미화 800달러 이하，即≤800）以內，其中農畜水產品每品類限5公斤、總量40公斤、海外購置價合計10萬韓元以內。另有額外額度：總量2升以內且總價400美元以內的酒類；捲菸（濾嘴煙）200支；電子煙煙液20毫升（尼古丁含量不足1%）；香水100毫升。未滿19歲（按出生年份）者酒類和菸草無免稅額度。自願申報超額物品可減徵關稅30%；未申報被查獲加徵稅額40%（2年內2次以上為60%）。與免稅額度無關、必須申報的物品包括商用物品/樣品/修理品、槍炮、麻醉類、CITES動植物及其製品、動物/植物/水果/食品類、侵權商品、超過1萬美元的支付手段等。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達後領取行李之後：有申報物品的旅客向海關提交申報（紙質或手機）；其餘旅客走無申報通道。

procedures.name_en: Foreign Exchange Declaration on Entry/Departure (출입국시 외환신고)
procedures.name_zh: 出入境时外汇申报（超过1万美元支付手段申报）
procedures.agency: Korea Customs Service (관세청)
procedures.applicability_en: On entry, means of payment including foreign currency, won and cheques totalling more than USD 10,000 equivalent must be declared. Promissory notes, letters of credit and bills of exchange are exempt from this import declaration. Obtain the foreign-exchange declaration certificate before leaving the arrival hall. On departure, Korean-national residents carrying ordinary overseas travel expenses above USD 10,000 must declare to Customs; emigrants, long-term travellers, students and travel agencies above that amount, and foreign residents taking out domestic employment income, need foreign-exchange-bank confirmation. Non-residents may re-export the imported amount without a fresh declaration when supported by their entry declaration certificate. Payments for goods and capital transactions have separate reporting obligations; Customs declaration is not universal permission to export funds.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境携外币、韩元及支票等支付工具合计超过等值1万美元须申报；本票、信用证及汇票进口属所列豁免。离开到达大厅前须领取外汇申报证明，离开后不能补发。韩国国籍居民携超过1万美元的一般境外旅行费离境须向海关申报；移民、长期停留者、留学生、旅行社携款超过该额，及外国居民携出本国工作收入，须外汇银行确认。非居民可凭入境申报证明携回此前携入额而不重复申报。商品货款和资本交易另有报告义务，海关申报不等于所有资金均获准携出。
procedures.timing_en: Entry: at customs in the arrival hall (certificate cannot be issued after exiting the arrival hall). Departure: at the competent customs office before leaving Korea.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境：在入境大厅海关办理（离开入境大厅后无法补发证明）。出境：出境前向管辖海关办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入境時外匯申報（超過1萬美元支付手段申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境攜外幣、韓元及支票等支付工具合計超過等值1萬美元須申報；本票、信用證及匯票進口屬所列豁免。離開到達大廳前須領取外匯申報證明，離開後不能補發。韓國國籍居民攜超過1萬美元的一般境外旅行費離境須向海關申報；移民、長期停留者、留學生、旅行社攜款超過該額，及外國居民攜出本國工作收入，須外匯銀行確認。非居民可憑入境申報證明攜回此前攜入額而不重複申報。商品貨款和資本交易另有報告義務，海關申報不等於所有資金均獲准攜出。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境：在入境大廳海關辦理（離開入境大廳後無法補發證明）。出境：出境前向管轄海關辦理。

procedures.name_en: Korea Electronic Arrival Card (전자입국신고서, K-EAC / e-Arrival card)
procedures.name_zh: 韩国电子入境申报书（电子入国申报，K-EAC）
procedures.agency: Korea Immigration Service, Ministry of Justice (법무부 출입국·외국인정책본부)
procedures.applicability_en: Foreign nationals entering Korea must submit the e-Arrival Card online, except registered foreign residents, valid K-ETA holders and airline crew. The Ministry of Justice says the form can be submitted starting three days before arrival and remains valid for 72 hours after submission; it is free. The Korean Consulate in Montreal notice dated 2 February 2026 states that the electronic card replaces the old paper card from 2026. Submit passport, trip, purpose, address/contact and occupation information through the official portal.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境外国人须在线提交电子入境卡；已登记外国居民、有效K-ETA持有人及航空机组人员豁免。法务部说明可从抵达前三天开始提交，提交后有效72小时，免费。韩国驻蒙特利尔总领馆2026年2月2日通知明确，2026年起电子卡替代旧纸卡。须通过官方门户填护照、行程、目的、地址联系方式及职业资料。
procedures.timing_en: Can be filed from 3 days before arrival in Korea, via PC or mobile web; valid 72 hours after submission.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达韩国前3天起可通过PC或手机网页填写提交；提交后72小时内有效。

fee.note: 法务部正文明确전자입국신고는 무료입니다；未使用未独立读取的门户片段。

procedures.name_zh_hant: 韓國電子入境申報書（電子入國申報，K-EAC）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境外國人須線上提交電子入境卡；已登記外國居民、有效K-ETA持有人及航空機組人員豁免。法務部說明可從抵達前三天開始提交，提交後有效72小時，免費。韓國駐蒙特利爾總領館2026年2月2日通知明確，2026年起電子卡替代舊紙卡。須通過官方門戶填護照、行程、目的、地址聯繫方式及職業資料。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達韓國前3天起可通過PC或手機網頁填寫提交；提交後72小時內有效。

procedures.name_en: Brunei E-Arrival Card registration
procedures.name_zh: 文莱电子入境卡（E-Arrival Card）登记
procedures.agency: Jabatan Imigresen dan Pendaftaran Kebangsaan (Immigration Department), Brunei
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers arriving in Brunei Darussalam register for the E-Arrival Card (Kad Ketibaan-E) through the INRS portal at www.imm.gov.bn: log in and register on the portal, register an account and activate it with a one-time password (OTP), then complete registration with the required documents — a valid passport, travel details, and accommodation details in Brunei. Once registration is complete the individual receives the E-Arrival Card confirmation with a reference number. At the immigration control post the traveller presents a valid passport and, if applicable, a visa. This is an immigration procedure only and does not replace the customs dutiable-goods declaration or the BDCB traveller CBNI report.
procedures.applicability_zh: 抵达文莱的旅客通过 INRS 门户（www.imm.gov.bn）登记电子入境卡（Kad Ketibaan-E）：先登录门户注册账户，并以一次性密码（OTP）激活账户，再用所需文件完成登记——有效护照、行程信息和在文莱的住宿信息。登记完成后获得电子入境卡确认及参考编号。在移民检查站出示有效护照，如适用另出示签证。本项仅为移民手续，不能替代海关应税物品申报或文莱中央银行（BDCB）的旅客 CBNI 申报。
procedures.timing_en: Online registration before reaching the immigration control post on arrival; the E-Arrival Card confirmation with its reference number is issued once registration is complete. The official instructions do not state a fixed advance-registration deadline.
procedures.timing_zh: 在抵达移民检查站前在线登记；登记完成后签发带参考编号的电子入境卡确认。官方说明未规定固定的提前登记时限。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 文萊電子入境卡（E-Arrival Card）登記
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 抵達文萊的旅客通過 INRS 門戶（www.imm.gov.bn）登記電子入境卡（Kad Ketibaan-E）：先登入門戶註冊賬戶，並以一次性密碼（OTP）激活賬戶，再用所需文件完成登記——有效護照、行程資訊和在文萊的住宿資訊。登記完成後獲得電子入境卡確認及參考編號。在移民檢查站出示有效護照，如適用另出示簽證。本項僅為移民手續，不能替代海關應稅物品申報或文萊中央銀行（BDCB）的旅客 CBNI 申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在抵達移民檢查站前線上登記；登記完成後簽發帶參考編號的電子入境卡確認。官方說明未規定固定的提前登記時限。

procedures.name_en: Arrival declaration of dutiable goods to the proper officer of customs (RCED)
procedures.name_zh: 入境应税物品向海关关员申报（皇家海关与消费税局）
procedures.agency: Royal Customs and Excise Department (RCED), Brunei Darussalam
procedures.applicability_en: Every person arriving in Brunei Darussalam must declare all dutiable goods in their possession — on their person, in any baggage, or in any vehicle — to the proper officer of customs for examination; dutiable goods are goods subject to payment of customs duty on which duty has not yet been paid. Failure to declare makes the goods uncustomed goods, punishable by imprisonment or fine, and failure to give a true and correct declaration is an offence under Section 138 of the Customs Order, 2006 and Section 144 of the Excise Order, 2006. This traveller declaration to the officer is separate from the general customs goods declaration, which must be submitted in triplicate but expressly does not apply to passenger hand baggage or personal effects on arrival; the customs dutiable import declaration form no 5/C-16 is produced only if necessary, together with documents such as an invoice or bill. Where the total import duty is less than BND1, no import duty is charged. Published traveller conditions: there is no personal concession for cigarettes and any person importing cigarettes must declare them, subject to excise duty of BND0.50 per stick; alcoholic beverages may be brought in only by non-Muslims aged 17 years and above, limited to 2 bottles of liqueurs (1 litre per bottle) or beer not exceeding 12 cans (330ml per can), every importer must declare to the proper officer of customs, the subsequent importation must be 48 hours from the last importation, the liquor is for the importer's personal use and must not be given, transferred or sold, and may be stored and consumed only at the importer's private residence; passengers aged 17 years and above may bring in personal effects within concession (personally used items, perfume not exceeding 60 milliliters, and eau de toilette or scented water not exceeding 250 milliliters). The same official page also publishes further import conditions and quantity limits (processed food, cosmetics and medicines with a BND200 threshold, plants and plant products, animal feed) as conditions of import, not as separate traveller declaration procedures.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每一抵达文莱的人均须就其随身、行李或交通工具中携带的全部应税物品向海关关员申报并以供查验；应税物品指应缴关税且关税尚未缴纳的物品。未申报的物品将被视为未完税物品，可处监禁或罚款；申报不真实、不正确触犯2006年海关令第138条及2006年消费税令第144条。本项旅客向关员的申报不同于一般货物报关：一般报关须一式三联提交，但明文不适用于抵达旅客的手提行李或个人物品；海关应税进口申报表格第5号（5/C-16）仅在必要时提供，并附发票、账单等单证。进口税总额不足1文莱元的，不征进口税。对旅客公布的条件：香烟无任何个人免税额，任何入境者均须申报，消费税为每支0.50文莱元；酒类仅限17岁及以上非穆斯林携带入境，限每人2瓶烈酒（每瓶1升）或不超过12罐啤酒（每罐330毫升），每一入境者均须向海关关员申报，再次入境须与上次入境间隔48小时，仅限自用、不得转赠或出售，且仅可在申报人私人住所存放和饮用；17岁及以上旅客可在免税额内携带个人物品（自用旧物、香水不超过60毫升、古龙水或香氛水不超过250毫升）。同一官方页面另载有加工食品、化妆品及药品（门槛200文莱元）、植物及植物产品、动物饲料等进口条件与数量限制，属进口条件而非独立的旅客申报程序。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, at the border checkpoint, when presenting oneself and goods to the proper officer of customs for examination.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时在边境检查站办理，向海关关员申报并交由查验。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境應稅物品向海關關員申報（皇家海關與消費稅局）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每一抵達文萊的人均須就其隨身、行李或交通工具中攜帶的全部應稅物品向海關關員申報並以供查驗；應稅物品指應繳關稅且關稅尚未繳納的物品。未申報的物品將被視為未完稅物品，可處監禁或罰款；申報不真實、不正確觸犯2006年海關令第138條及2006年消費稅令第144條。本項旅客向關員的申報不同於一般貨物報關：一般報關須一式三聯提交，但明文不適用於抵達旅客的手提行李或個人物品；海關應稅進口申報表格第5號（5/C-16）僅在必要時提供，並附發票、賬單等單證。進口稅總額不足1文萊元的，不徵進口稅。對旅客公佈的條件：香菸無任何個人免稅額，任何入境者均須申報，消費稅為每支0.50文萊元；酒類僅限17歲及以上非穆斯林攜帶入境，限每人2瓶烈酒（每瓶1升）或不超過12罐啤酒（每罐330毫升），每一入境者均須向海關關員申報，再次入境須與上次入境間隔48小時，僅限自用、不得轉贈或出售，且僅可在申報人私人住所存放和飲用；17歲及以上旅客可在免稅額內攜帶個人物品（自用舊物、香水不超過60毫升、古龍水或香氛水不超過250毫升）。同一官方頁面另載有加工食品、化妝品及藥品（門檻200文萊元）、植物及植物產品、動物飼料等進口條件與數量限制，屬進口條件而非獨立的旅客申報程序。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時在邊境檢查站辦理，向海關關員申報並交由查驗。

procedures.name_en: Traveller CBNI declaration (Form S37) for physical currency or bearer negotiable instruments of BND15,000 or more
procedures.name_zh: 旅客现金或无记名可转让票据（CBNI）S37申报（1.5万文莱元或等值以上）
procedures.agency: Brunei Darussalam Central Bank (BDCB) — Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)
procedures.applicability_en: Any person travelling into or out of Brunei Darussalam who carries physical currency (notes and coins recognized as legal tender, from Brunei Darussalam or other countries) or bearer negotiable instruments (a traveller's cheque; or any negotiable instrument in bearer form, endorsed without restriction, made out to a fictitious payee, or signed with the payee's name omitted) amounting to BND15,000 or more, or its equivalent in a foreign currency, must complete a CBNI declaration report on Form S37 and submit it at the border control post: incoming travellers hand the report to the Customs Officer at the respective checkpoints; departing travellers submit the report to the Immigration Officer before departing Brunei Darussalam. There is no restriction on the type or amount of CBNI that may be moved into or out of Brunei Darussalam as long as the person gives a full and accurate report. Reporting CBNI sent or received by cargo, courier, postal service or any other means uses Form S39, submitted to the Financial Intelligence Unit, BDCB, and is a separate non-traveller procedure outside this record. Failure to give a full and accurate report is punishable by a fine not exceeding BND50,000, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 years, or both.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何携带现金（文莱或其他国家法定流通的纸币和硬币）或无记名可转让票据（旅行支票；或以无记名形式签发、无限制背书、以虚构收款人为抬头、或已签名但未填收款人姓名的可转让票据）出入文莱、金额达1.5万文莱元或以上（或等值外币）的人，须填写 S37 表格 CBNI 申报报告并在边境检查站提交：入境旅客将报告交予各检查站海关关员；离境旅客须在离开文莱前将报告提交移民官员。只要作出完整准确的申报，出入文莱的 CBNI 类型和金额不受限制。以货运、快递、邮政或其他方式寄送或接收 CBNI 适用 S39 表格，向文莱中央银行金融情报组（FIU）提交，属独立的非旅客程序，不在本记录范围内。未作出完整准确申报者，可处不超过5万文莱元罚款、不超过3年监禁，或两者并罚。
procedures.timing_en: At the border control post: on arrival, handed to the Customs Officer at the respective checkpoint; before departure, submitted to the Immigration Officer.
procedures.timing_zh: 在边境检查站办理：入境时交予检查站海关关员；离境时在出境前提交移民官员。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客現金或無記名可轉讓票據（CBNI）S37申報（1.5萬文萊元或等值以上）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何攜帶現金（文萊或其他國家法定流通的紙幣和硬幣）或無記名可轉讓票據（旅行支票；或以無記名形式簽發、無限制背書、以虛構收款人為抬頭、或已簽名但未填收款人姓名的可轉讓票據）出入文萊、金額達1.5萬文萊元或以上（或等值外幣）的人，須填寫 S37 表格 CBNI 申報報告並在邊境檢查站提交：入境旅客將報告交予各檢查站海關關員；離境旅客須在離開文萊前將報告提交移民官員。只要作出完整準確的申報，出入文萊的 CBNI 類型和金額不受限制。以貨運、快遞、郵政或其他方式寄送或接收 CBNI 適用 S39 表格，向文萊中央銀行金融情報組（FIU）提交，屬獨立的非旅客程序，不在本記錄範圍內。未作出完整準確申報者，可處不超過5萬文萊元罰款、不超過3年監禁，或兩者並罰。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在邊境檢查站辦理：入境時交予檢查站海關關員；離境時在出境前提交移民官員。

procedures.name_en: Cambodia e-Arrival — single online arrival card replacing paper Immigration, Health and Customs forms
procedures.name_zh: 柬埔寨电子入境卡（e-Arrival）——取代纸质移民表、健康表与海关申报表的单一在线填报
procedures.agency: General Department of Immigration / General Department of Customs and Excise, Cambodia
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: arrivals into the Kingdom of Cambodia. One online submission per traveler: per the official portal FAQ, the Cambodia e-Arrival replaces the paper Immigration Form, Health Form, and Customs Declaration by providing a single portal; the customs content is part of this one submission, and no separate customs form submission is established by official text. The General Department of Immigration states all travelers can submit the Cambodia e-Arrival within 7 days before arrival or on arrival, and that submission is free. Airports listed on the portal: Techo International Airport (KTI), Siem Reap Angkor International Airport, Sihanoukville International Airport.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进入柬埔寨王国的旅客。每位旅客一次在线提交：据官方门户常见问题，柬埔寨 e-Arrival 以单一门户取代纸质移民表、健康表和海关申报表；海关内容属于这一次提交的一部分，官方正文未确立需另行提交的独立海关表。移民局明确所有旅客可在抵达前7天内或抵达时提交 e-Arrival，且提交免费。门户所列机场：德崇国际机场（KTI）、暹粒吴哥国际机场、西哈努克国际机场。
procedures.timing_en: Within 7 days before arrival or on arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达前7天内或抵达时。

fee.note: The General Department of Immigration banner states Submission is Free; the currency field is nominal since no payment is required.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 柬埔寨電子入境卡（e-Arrival）——取代紙質移民表、健康表與海關申報表的單一線上填報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進入柬埔寨王國的旅客。每位旅客一次線上提交：據官方門戶常見問題，柬埔寨 e-Arrival 以單一門戶取代紙質移民表、健康表和海關申報表；海關內容屬於這一次提交的一部分，官方正文未確立需另行提交的獨立海關表。移民局明確所有旅客可在抵達前7天內或抵達時提交 e-Arrival，且提交免費。門戶所列機場：德崇國際機場（KTI）、暹粒吳哥國際機場、西哈努克國際機場。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達前7天內或抵達時。
