procedures.name_en: All Indonesia arrival declaration — unified immigration/customs/health/quarantine submission
procedures.name_zh: All Indonesia 入境申报——移民/海关/健康/检疫统一提交
procedures.agency: Government of Indonesia (Directorate General of Customs and Excise; Directorate General of Immigration — portal allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id)
procedures.applicability_en: Customs' current arrival guidance (site build 19 February 2026) states that every passenger entering or leaving Indonesia must submit the carried-goods list through a digital customs declaration form, and that arrivals by air and sea use the one-door All Indonesia service (allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id), which integrates immigration, customs declaration, health and quarantine in one link; the passenger selects Indonesian-citizen or foreign-visitor category. Passengers over 60, disabled passengers, regular hajj passengers and VVIP passengers may instead make an oral declaration to the receiving officer. Rollout history (retained, not per-port current status): mandatory from 1 September 2025 at the named international airports and Batam ports; Yogyakarta Immigration from 1 October 2025; individual checkpoints' technical integration is not established. Duty-free description (not a separate procedure): USD 500 FOB per passenger per arrival, excess dutiable at 10% plus VAT; 1 litre alcohol (21+) and 200 cigarettes/25 cigars/100g cut tobacco (18+), excess destroyed; USD 50 for crew.
procedures.applicability_zh: 海关现行到达须知（站点构建2026年2月19日）载明：每位进入或离开印尼的旅客均须以数字海关申报表提交随身物品清单；空港与海港到达使用 All Indonesia 一门式服务（allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id），将移民、海关申报、健康与检疫整合于一链接，填报时选择印尼公民或外国访客类别。60岁以上、残障、正规朝觐及VVIP旅客可向收单关员口头申报。推广沿革（保留，不作为逐口岸当下状态）：2025年9月1日起在指定国际机场与巴淡港强制；日惹移民局自2025年10月1日适用；个别口岸技术接入状态未被证实。免税说明（非独立程序）：每客每次到达FOB 500美元，超额部分征10%关税及增值税；酒1升（21岁以上）、香烟200支/雪茄25支/烟丝100克（18岁以上），超额没收销毁；运输工具机组人员50美元。
procedures.timing_en: Can be filled starting three days (H-3) before the scheduled arrival in Indonesia; the page does not define an exact 72-hour cutoff. Save the QR code for scanning at the terminal.
procedures.timing_zh: 自预定抵达印尼前3日（H-3）起可填写；页面未定义精确72小时截止。保存二维码供口岸扫描。

fee.note: 巴淡移民局公告（2025-09）明确 All Indonesia 申报免费；2026年海关页面未另列费用。

procedures.name_zh_hant: All Indonesia 入境申報——移民/海關/健康/檢疫統一提交
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 海關現行到達須知（網站構建2026年2月19日）載明：每位進入或離開印尼的旅客均須以數字海關申報表提交隨身物品清單；空港與海港到達使用 All Indonesia 一門式服務（allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id），將移民、海關申報、健康與檢疫整合於一連結，填報時選擇印尼公民或外國訪客類別。60歲以上、殘障、正規朝覲及VVIP旅客可向收單關員口頭申報。推廣沿革（保留，不作為逐口岸當下狀態）：2025年9月1日起在指定國際機場與巴淡港強制；日惹移民局自2025年10月1日適用；個別口岸技術接入狀態未被證實。免稅說明（非獨立程序）：每客每次到達FOB 500美元，超額部分徵10%關稅及增值稅；酒1升（21歲以上）、香菸200支/雪茄25支/菸絲100克（18歲以上），超額沒收銷燬；運輸工具機組人員50美元。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 自預定抵達印尼前3日（H-3）起可填寫；頁面未定義精確72小時截止。保存 QR Code 供口岸掃描。

procedures.name_en: e-CD for land-border arrivals (BC 2.2) and outbound departures (portal menu: money BC 32, goods BC 34)
procedures.name_zh: 陆路到达 e-CD（BC 2.2）与离境申报（门户菜单：现金 BC 32、货物 BC 34）
procedures.agency: Government of Indonesia, Directorate General of Customs and Excise (DJBC)
procedures.applicability_en: Customs' current arrival guidance directs passengers arriving by land (PLBN border-crossing posts) and passengers departing abroad carrying cash of Rp 100 million equivalent or more, or certain other goods, to fill the customs declaration at ecd.beacukai.go.id and keep the resulting QR code for scanning at the arrival or departure terminal, avoiding physical forms. The e-CD portal's own menu (footer: © 2026 Direktorat Jenderal Bea dan Cukai) separates Kedatangan (arrival) into (UDARA & LAUT) and (DARAT) ECD, and lists under Keberangkatan (departure) two distinct items - Pembawaan Uang (BC 32) for money carriage and Pembawaan Barang (BC 34) for goods - so the outbound cash declaration is the portal's BC 32 menu item, not the BC 2.2 customs-declaration form at /forms/bc22; the menu attests this channel/form classification only, states no filing window, and the form numbers are quoted exactly as displayed without expansion. The e-CD site's own notice states that from 1 September 2025 all passengers and crew bound for Indonesia fill the Customs Declaration via allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id; the land/departure e-CD allocation appears on the customs arrival page of February 2026 build, and per-checkpoint availability is not individually verified.
procedures.applicability_zh: 海关现行到达须知指引：经陆路（PLBN口岸）到达的旅客，以及携带等值1亿印尼盾及以上现金或特定其他物品出境的旅客，通过 ecd.beacukai.go.id 填报海关申报表，并保存二维码在到达或出境航站楼交验，免于填纸质表。e-CD 门户自身菜单（页脚 © 2026 Direktorat Jenderal Bea dan Cukai）将 Kedatangan（到达）分为 (UDARA & LAUT) 与 (DARAT) ECD，并在 Keberangkatan（离境）下分列两项——携运货币 Pembawaan Uang (BC 32) 与携运货物 Pembawaan Barang (BC 34)——故出境现金申报对应门户 BC 32 菜单项，而非 /forms/bc22 的 BC 2.2 海关申报表；该菜单仅证此渠道/表单分类，未载任何填报时窗，表号按页面显示原样引用、不作扩展。e-CD 网站自身公告称自2025年9月1日起所有赴印尼旅客与机组经 allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id 填报；陆路/出境 e-CD 划分见于2026年2月构建的海关到达页，逐口岸可用性未逐一核实。
procedures.timing_en: For land (PLBN) arrivals the page states filling can start three days (H-3) before the scheduled arrival in Indonesia. Passengers departing with cash of Rp 100 million equivalent or more, or other specified goods, should submit the declaration online under the official site's provisions, but the source text obtained gives no exact advance-filing window for this departure case - the H-3 sentence in the land/departure section reuses the arrival wording, so the departure e-CD window remains unknown; the e-CD portal menu likewise states no filing window for its Keberangkatan (BC 32/BC 34) items. The Barang Penumpang page's separate 'two days before arrival' sentence is another page's/possibly older usage and is not reconciled with H-3.
procedures.timing_zh: 陆路（PLBN）抵达情形：页面载明可自预定抵达印尼前3日（H-3）起填报。携等值1亿印尼盾及以上现金或其他规定物品出境者，应按官网规定在线提交申报，但当前所获原文未给出该出境情形确切的提前填报窗口——陆路/出境段落的 H-3 句系复用“抵达”措辞，出境 e-CD 窗口仍未知；e-CD 门户菜单对其 Keberangkatan（BC 32/BC 34）各项亦未载时窗。Barang Penumpang 页“抵达前两天开始填报”系另页/可能旧用途表述，不与 H-3 强行调和。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 陸路到達 e-CD（BC 2.2）與離境申報（門戶菜單：現金 BC 32、貨物 BC 34）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 海關現行到達須知指引：經陸路（PLBN口岸）到達的旅客，以及攜帶等值1億印尼盾及以上現金或特定其他物品出境的旅客，通過 ecd.beacukai.go.id 填報海關申報表，並保存 QR Code 在到達或出境航站樓交驗，免於填紙質表。e-CD 門戶自身菜單（頁腳 © 2026 Direktorat Jenderal Bea dan Cukai）將 Kedatangan（到達）分為 (UDARA & LAUT) 與 (DARAT) ECD，並在 Keberangkatan（離境）下分列兩項——攜運貨幣 Pembawaan Uang (BC 32) 與攜運貨物 Pembawaan Barang (BC 34)——故出境現金申報對應門戶 BC 32 菜單項，而非 /forms/bc22 的 BC 2.2 海關申報表；該菜單僅證此渠道/表單分類，未載任何填報時窗，表號按頁面顯示原樣引用、不作擴展。e-CD 網站自身公告稱自2025年9月1日起所有赴印尼旅客與機組經 allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id 填報；陸路/出境 e-CD 劃分見於2026年2月構建的海關到達頁，逐口岸可用性未逐一核實。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 陸路（PLBN）抵達情形：頁面載明可自預定抵達印尼前3日（H-3）起填報。攜等值1億印尼盾及以上現金或其他規定物品出境者，應按官網規定線上提交申報，但當前所獲原文未給出該出境情形確切的提前填報窗口——陸路/出境段落的 H-3 句系複用“抵達”措辭，出境 e-CD 窗口仍未知；e-CD 門戶菜單對其 Keberangkatan（BC 32/BC 34）各項亦未載時窗。Barang Penumpang 頁“抵達前兩天開始填報”系另頁/可能舊用途表述，不與 H-3 強行調和。

procedures.name_en: Cash and payment-instrument carriage declaration (Rp 100 million threshold)
procedures.name_zh: 现金及支付工具携带申报（1亿印尼盾门槛）
procedures.agency: Government of Indonesia, Directorate General of Customs and Excise; Bank Indonesia (high-value permits)
procedures.applicability_en: Cash (rupiah or foreign currency, including banknotes) and other payment instruments (bilyet giro; cheques, travellers cheques, surat sanggup bayar, deposit certificates) valued at Rp 100,000,000 or more - the threshold is inclusive - must be notified to the Customs officer when carried into or out of Indonesia; not reporting or incorrectly reporting cash carriage can attract administrative sanctions. The same current guidance requires foreign banknotes equivalent to Rp 1,000,000,000 or more to be accompanied by a Bank Indonesia permit. The cash item sits inside the online Customs Declaration, with the channel split of the current arrival page: air/sea arrivals declare within All Indonesia, land (PLBN) arrivals via e-CD, and passengers departing with cash of Rp 100 million equivalent or more file the e-CD, whose portal menu labels the outbound money item Pembawaan Uang (BC 32) - the menu attests channel classification only, not any filing window. Cash thresholds are distinct from goods duty-free allowances. 2026-09-29 complete FAQ: cash and/or other payment instruments of at least Rp100,000,000 must be reported to the Customs Officer (threshold inclusive, 'paling sedikit'); Rupiah cash of at least Rp100,000,000 carried out of the customs area requires a Bank Indonesia permit and the same amount brought in must be reported with authenticity checked; individuals may not carry foreign banknotes of at least Rp1,000,000,000 equivalent at all — only corporations or individuals acting on a corporation's behalf, with Bank Indonesia permission and approval. Basis cited on the page: PMK 100/PMK.04/2018 amending PMK 157/PMK.04/2017.
procedures.applicability_zh: 携带现金（印尼盾或外币，含纸币）及其他支付工具（bilyet giro；支票、旅行支票、surat sanggup bayar、存款凭证）价值达1亿印尼盾及以上（门槛含本数）进出印尼时，须向海关关员申报；未申报或申报不实可被处以行政制裁。同一现行须知另规定：等值10亿印尼盾及以上的外币纸币须随附印尼银行许可。现金事项载于在线海关申报表内，并按现行到达页的渠道分工：空/海到达在 All Indonesia 内申报，陆路（PLBN）到达走 e-CD，携等值1亿印尼盾及以上现金出境的旅客经 e-CD 填报，门户菜单将离境货币项标为 Pembawaan Uang (BC 32)——菜单仅证渠道分类、未证任何填报时窗。现金门槛与货物免税额相互独立。2026-09-29 完整 FAQ：携带现金及/或其他支付工具达 Rp100,000,000（含本数，paling sedikit）须通知海关官员；印尼盾现金达 Rp100,000,000 携出关税区须获印度尼西亚银行许可、携入须申报并验真；个人一律禁止携带等值 ≥Rp1,000,000,000 的外币纸币——仅法团或以法团名义携运者可为之并须获印尼银行许可与批准。页面依据：PMK 100/PMK.04/2018（修订 PMK 157/PMK.04/2017）。
procedures.timing_en: At entry or exit, whenever the amount carried is at or above the threshold; departure with cash of Rp 100 million equivalent or more is an e-CD case.
procedures.timing_zh: 进出关境时，携带金额达到门槛即申报；携等值1亿印尼盾及以上现金出境属 e-CD 情形。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及支付工具攜帶申報（1億印尼盾門檻）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 攜帶現金（印尼盾或外幣，含紙幣）及其他支付工具（bilyet giro；支票、旅行支票、surat sanggup bayar、存款憑證）價值達1億印尼盾及以上（門檻含本數）進出印尼時，須向海關關員申報；未申報或申報不實可被處以行政制裁。同一現行須知另規定：等值10億印尼盾及以上的外幣紙幣須隨附印尼銀行許可。現金事項載於線上海關申報表內，並按現行到達頁的渠道分工：空/海到達在 All Indonesia 內申報，陸路（PLBN）到達走 e-CD，攜等值1億印尼盾及以上現金出境的旅客經 e-CD 填報，門戶菜單將離境貨幣項標為 Pembawaan Uang (BC 32)——菜單僅證渠道分類、未證任何填報時窗。現金門檻與貨物免稅額相互獨立。2026-09-29 完整 FAQ：攜帶現金及/或其他支付工具達 Rp100,000,000（含本數，paling sedikit）須通知海關官員；印尼盾現金達 Rp100,000,000 攜出關稅區須獲印度尼西亞銀行許可、攜入須申報並驗真；個人一律禁止攜帶等值 ≥Rp1,000,000,000 的外幣紙幣——僅法團或以法團名義攜運者可為之並須獲印尼銀行許可與批准。頁面依據：PMK 100/PMK.04/2018（修訂 PMK 157/PMK.04/2017）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進出關境時，攜帶金額達到門檻即申報；攜等值1億印尼盾及以上現金出境屬 e-CD 情形。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cash, precious metals and BNIs — over LAK 100,000,000 entering/exiting Laos
procedures.name_zh: 现金、贵金属与无记名票据申报——出入老挝超过1亿基普
procedures.agency: Customs Department, Ministry of Finance, Lao PDR (Regulation 06/NCC published on the Lao National Trade Portal; threshold also set in the Law on Customs (Amended) No. 81/NA)
procedures.applicability_en: Regulation 06/NCC of 19 May 2015 and Article 51 of the Law on Customs (Amended), No. 81/NA of 2020, both require passengers — Lao nationals, foreigners and immigrants — entering and exiting Laos with cash, precious metals or bearer negotiable instruments worth more than LAK 100,000,000, or the equivalent value in other currencies, to declare to a customs officer at the border checkpoint, completing the customs declaration form (issued by the Ministry of Finance under the 2015 Regulation; the printed form designated by the Customs Administration under the 2020 Law). Cash includes banknotes and coins in any currency; BNIs include bank and travellers cheques, money orders, bonds and bank drafts. At exactly LAK 100,000,000 the two instruments conflict: Article 3 of the 2015 Regulation uses "100,000,000 (one hundred million) kip or more", so declaration may still be required at that exact amount — see the unresolved threshold item; do not treat exactly LAK 100,000,000 as exempt. For departure, Article 4 of the 2015 Regulation additionally requires supporting certificates/permits from relevant organizations and prior import documentation; declaration is not a substitute for those documents.
procedures.applicability_zh: 2015年5月19日第06/NCC号规章与2020年《海关法（修订）》第81/NA号第51条均要求入出老挝的旅客——老挝公民、外国人及移民——携带现金、贵金属或无记名可转让票据总值超过1亿基普（或等值外币）时，向口岸海关官员申报：2015年规章填财政部印发的海关申报表，2020年法律填海关署指定的打印表格。现金含任何币种的纸币和硬币；票据含银行和旅行支票、汇票、债券及银行汇票等。恰为1亿基普时两份文件冲突：2015年规章第3条写明“达到100,000,000（一亿）基普或以上”，该恰等金额可能仍须申报，见未决事项；不得视为恰等即免报。出境另按2015年规章第4条出示相关机构证明、许可及此前进口文件，申报不能代替这些文件。
procedures.timing_en: On both entry and exit, present the completed declaration form together with the cash, precious metals and BNIs to a customs officer at the border checkpoint.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境和出境两个方向均在口岸向海关官员出示填妥的申报表及现金、贵金属与无记名票据。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金、貴金屬與無記名票據申報——出入老撾超過1億基普
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 2015年5月19日第06/NCC號規章與2020年《海關法（修訂）》第81/NA號第51條均要求入出老撾的旅客——老撾公民、外國人及移民——攜帶現金、貴金屬或無記名可轉讓票據總值超過1億基普（或等值外幣）時，向口岸海關官員申報：2015年規章填財政部印發的海關申報表，2020年法律填海關署指定的列印表格。現金含任何幣種的紙幣和硬幣；票據含銀行和旅行支票、匯票、債券及銀行匯票等。恰為1億基普時兩份文件衝突：2015年規章第3條寫明“達到100,000,000（一億）基普或以上”，該恰等金額可能仍須申報，見未決事項；不得視為恰等即免報。出境另按2015年規章第4條出示相關機構證明、許可及此前進口文件，申報不能代替這些文件。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境和出境兩個方向均在口岸向海關官員出示填妥的申報表及現金、貴金屬與無記名票據。

procedures.name_en: Lao Digital Immigration Form (LDIF) — mandatory online registration before entry into or departure from Lao PDR at four international checkpoints
procedures.name_zh: 老挝数字入境表（LDIF）——四个国际口岸入出境前须在线注册
procedures.agency: Department of Immigration, Lao PDR
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: foreign nationals and stateless people using passports entering or departing Lao PDR at the four named international checkpoints. Per the Department of Immigration's official announcement (02-09-2025): the Department launched the new Lao Digital Immigration Form (LDIF) to streamline border procedure on 1 September 2025 at four international checkpoints — Wattay International Airport, Luangprabang International Airport, Pakse International Airport and Lao-Thai Friendship Bridge I — and all foreign nationals and stateless people using passports are required to register through LDIF at immigration.gov.la before entering into or departing from Lao PDR. Duty/cash thresholds are covered by the separate verified cash-declaration procedure.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：持护照进出老挝的外国人和无国籍人。据移民局官方公告（2025-09-02发布）：移民局于2025年9月1日在四个国际口岸启用新的老挝数字入境表（LDIF）以简化边检流程——瓦岱国际机场、琅勃拉邦国际机场、巴色国际机场及老泰友谊大桥I——所有持护照的外国人和无国籍人须在进入或离开老挝前通过 immigration.gov.la 的 LDIF 注册。税费/现金门槛由另一已核现金申报事项覆盖。
procedures.timing_en: Register through LDIF before entering into or departing from Lao PDR (announcement effective from 1 September 2025).
procedures.timing_zh: 2025年9月1日起，进出老挝前通过 LDIF 注册。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 老撾數字入境表（LDIF）——四個國際口岸入出境前須線上註冊
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：持護照進出老撾的外國人和無國籍人。據移民局官方公告（2025-09-02發佈）：移民局於2025年9月1日在四個國際口岸啟用新的老撾數字入境表（LDIF）以簡化邊檢流程——瓦岱國際機場、琅勃拉邦國際機場、巴色國際機場及老泰友誼大橋I——所有持護照的外國人和無國籍人須在進入或離開老撾前通過 immigration.gov.la 的 LDIF 註冊。稅費/現金門檻由另一已核現金申報事項覆蓋。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 2025年9月1日起，進出老撾前通過 LDIF 註冊。

procedures.name_en: Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC)
procedures.name_zh: 马来西亚数字入境卡（MDAC）
procedures.agency: Immigration Department of Malaysia (Jabatan Imigresen Malaysia), Ministry of Home Affairs
procedures.applicability_en: Malaysia Foreign Affairs guidance requires foreign citizens travelling to Malaysia to complete MDAC from 1 January 2024, except: Singapore citizens; diplomatic and official passport holders; Malaysian permanent residents and long-term pass holders; Brunei General Certificate of Identity holders; Brunei-Malaysia Frequent Traveller Facility holders; Thai border-pass holders; Indonesian PLB cross-border-document holders. Submit through the Immigration Department portal. An Immigration Department headquarters announcement, retrieved 2026-09-27, adds that MDAC can now be filled directly through the MyNIISe app; the announcement states no eligibility limits and no timing window. This is an immigration arrival card. No official text consulted states a filing fee.
procedures.applicability_zh: 马来西亚外交部指引明确，2024年1月1日起赴马外国公民须填MDAC；豁免为新加坡公民、外交与公务护照持有人、马来西亚永久居民及长期准证持有人、文莱General Certificate of Identity证件持有人、文莱马来西亚常旅设施持有人、泰国边境通行证持有人、印尼PLB跨境证件持有人。须经移民局门户提交。移民局总部公告（2026-09-27读取）补充：MDAC现可直接在MyNIISe应用程序填写；公告未写适用限制与时间窗。这属于移民入境卡。所读官方文本均未写提交费用。
procedures.timing_en: Three days before arrival per the embassy notice; a precise 72-hour interpretation is not asserted.
procedures.timing_zh: 使馆公告写抵达前三天；不擅自换算为精确72小时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 馬來西亞數字入境卡（MDAC）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 馬來西亞外交部指引明確，2024年1月1日起赴馬外國公民須填MDAC；豁免為新加坡公民、外交與公務護照持有人、馬來西亞永久居民及長期準證持有人、文萊General Certificate of Identity證件持有人、文萊馬來西亞常旅設施持有人、泰國邊境通行證持有人、印尼PLB跨境證件持有人。須經移民局門戶提交。移民局總部公告（2026-09-27讀取）補充：MDAC現可直接在MyNIISe應用程序填寫；公告未寫適用限制與時間窗。這屬於移民入境卡。所讀官方文本均未寫提交費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 使館公告寫抵達前三天；不擅自換算為精確72小時。

procedures.name_en: Cash and bearer instruments: Customs Form No. 7
procedures.name_zh: 现金与无记名票据：海关第7号表
procedures.agency: Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) / Royal Malaysian Customs Department
procedures.applicability_en: The January 2025 Customs pamphlet requires all travellers of any nationality entering or leaving Malaysia with cash and bearer negotiable instruments exceeding USD 10,000.00 equivalent to complete Customs Form No. 7 and submit it physically at a customs counter. Bank Negara Malaysia's current page uses the same exclusive wording: declaration is required for physical notes of either currency more than USD 10,000 equivalent. Importing or exporting Malaysian ringgit above that amount also needs prior written BNM approval, and approval does not remove the declaration. The Customs Travellers Guide, content dated 25 May 2023 and page last updated 5 January 2026, still writes the threshold as cash and BNI amounting to or exceeding USD 10,000.00, so the exactly-USD-10,000 case stays unresolved pending the gazetted declaration order and is not described as safely exempt. Penalties stated in the pamphlet: up to MYR 3 million fine or 5 years' imprisonment for undeclared amounts, up to MYR 50 million or 10 years for ringgit moved without BNM written approval.
procedures.applicability_zh: 海关2025年1月英文手册要求任何国籍旅客出入境马来西亚时，携现金及无记名可转让票据超过（exceeding）等值10,000.00美元即填写海关第7号表并亲自交海关柜台。马来西亚国家银行当前页面同样只用「超过」表述：携带任一币种纸币超过等值10,000美元须申报。携入或携出超过该数额的林吉特另须国家银行事先书面批准，批准不免除申报。海关旅客指南正文标注2023年5月25日、页面2026年1月5日更新，仍写现金及BNI达到或超过（amounting to or exceeding）10,000.00美元须申报；取得公报申报命令原文前，恰等于1万美元维持待厘清，不写成可放心免申报。手册所列刑罚：未申报最高300万林吉特罚金或5年监禁；未经国家银行书面批准移动林吉特最高5,000万林吉特或10年监禁。
procedures.timing_en: Submit the paper form at customs counters on entry/exit; as at current practice there is no online submission. BNM processes ringgit-permission applications in a few working days, so apply before travel.
procedures.timing_zh: 出入境时在海关柜台提交纸表；按现行做法无线上提交渠道。国家银行审批林吉特携带许可需数个工作日，应在出行前申请。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金與無記名票據：海關第7號表
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 海關2025年1月英文手冊要求任何國籍旅客出入境馬來西亞時，攜現金及無記名可轉讓票據超過（exceeding）等值10,000.00美元即填寫海關第7號表並親自交海關櫃檯。馬來西亞國家銀行當前頁面同樣只用「超過」表述：攜帶任一幣種紙幣超過等值10,000美元須申報。攜入或攜出超過該數額的林吉特另須國家銀行事先書面批准，批准不免除申報。海關旅客指南正文標註2023年5月25日、頁面2026年1月5日更新，仍寫現金及BNI達到或超過（amounting to or exceeding）10,000.00美元須申報；取得公報申報命令原文前，恰等於1萬美元維持待釐清，不寫成可放心免申報。手冊所列刑罰：未申報最高300萬林吉特罰金或5年監禁；未經國家銀行書面批准移動林吉特最高5,000萬林吉特或10年監禁。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 出入境時在海關櫃檯提交紙表；按現行做法無線上提交渠道。國家銀行審批林吉特攜帶許可需數個工作日，應在出行前申請。

procedures.name_en: Passenger customs declaration (CUSDEC-CR per Trade Portal), dual channels and foreign-currency declaration rules
procedures.name_zh: 旅客海关申报（贸易门户载CUSDEC-CR）、双通道与外币申报规则
procedures.agency: Customs Department, Myanmar (published on the Myanmar National Trade Portal, Ministry of Commerce)
procedures.applicability_en: Per the Myanmar National Trade Portal Travellers section as currently readable (retrieved 2026-09-29; the page shows no posting date and its linked CUSDEC-CR PDF returned HTTP 404 this round), travellers entering Myanmar must submit a customs declaration using the CUSDEC-CR Customs Declaration Form for passengers and, on arrival, choose the red 'something to declare' or green 'nothing to declare' channel. A foreign traveller's personal effects are exempt from duty and tax. Foreigners must declare foreign currency exceeding USD 10,000 (strictly above the threshold); citizens of Myanmar must declare all foreign currency. Duty and tax free allowances apply to up to 2 litres of beverage alcohol, up to 150 ml of perfume and up to 400 cigarettes, and certain other items. Bounded caveats: verification stays at the baseline date 2026-09-12 (this round only re-read one undated portal page; its form PDF 404s and the AIP conflict below do not establish 2026 currency); the undated portal text is not certified as verified-2026 rules, and the 2025-07-10 AIP GEN 1.3 instead names a CR.193 form in duplicate 'besides a Customs Baggage Declaration' plus a Foreign Exchange Declaration Form for all arriving passengers - a form-set and currency-threshold conflict reported but not resolved here. Customs guidance only; establishes no immigration or current health-card obligation.
procedures.applicability_zh: 据缅甸国家贸易门户当前可读的Travellers段（2026-09-29检取；页面本身无发布日期，其链接的CUSDEC-CR PDF本轮返回HTTP 404），入境缅甸旅客须使用旅客CUSDEC-CR海关申报表提交海关申报，并于抵达时选择红色“有申报”或绿色“无申报”通道。外国旅客个人用品免关税和税收。外国人携带外币超过10,000美元（严格高于该门槛）须申报；缅甸公民携带的所有外币均须申报。免税量为饮料酒最多2升、香水最多150毫升、香烟最多400支及其他特定物品。有界提示：核验保留基线日期2026-09-12（本轮仅重读一页无日期正文、其表单PDF 404、且与AIP冲突未决，不足以确认2026年现行）；该无日期门户文本不认证为已核实的2026年现行规则；2025-07-10版AIP GEN 1.3则表述为“除海关行李申报外”另交一式两份CR.193表、且所有抵达旅客须交外币兑换（FED）表——表单组与外币门槛冲突仅报告、不予合并裁定。本项仅为海关指引，不据此判定移民或现行健康卡义务。
procedures.timing_en: CUSDEC-CR submitted at arrival; red/green channel chosen at the checkpoint; currency-declaration thresholds apply to foreign currency carried on entry.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时提交CUSDEC-CR；在检查站选择红/绿通道；外币申报门槛适用于入境时携带的外币。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客海關申報（貿易門戶載CUSDEC-CR）、雙通道與外幣申報規則
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 據緬甸國家貿易門戶當前可讀的Travellers段（2026-09-29檢取；頁面本身無發佈日期，其連結的CUSDEC-CR PDF本輪返回HTTP 404），入境緬甸旅客須使用旅客CUSDEC-CR海關申報表提交海關申報，並於抵達時選擇紅色“有申報”或綠色“無申報”通道。外國旅客個人用品免關稅和稅收。外國人攜帶外幣超過10,000美元（嚴格高於該門檻）須申報；緬甸公民攜帶的所有外幣均須申報。免稅量為飲料酒最多2升、香水最多150毫升、香菸最多400支及其他特定物品。有界提示：核驗保留基線日期2026-09-12（本輪僅重讀一頁無日期正文、其表單PDF 404、且與AIP衝突未決，不足以確認2026年現行）；該無日期門戶文本不認證為已核實的2026年現行規則；2025-07-10版AIP GEN 1.3則表述為“除海關行李申報外”另交一式兩份CR.193表、且所有抵達旅客須交外幣兌換（FED）表——表單組與外幣門檻衝突僅報告、不予合併裁定。本項僅為海關指引，不據此判定移民或現行健康卡義務。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時提交CUSDEC-CR；在檢查站選擇紅/綠通道；外幣申報門檻適用於入境時攜帶的外幣。

procedures.name_en: eTravel — Philippine One-Stop Electronic Travel Declaration System (immigration/health/customs integrated)
procedures.name_zh: eTravel——菲律宾一站式电子旅行申报系统（移民/健康/海关整合）
procedures.agency: Government of the Philippines (IATF system; Bureau of Immigration / BOQ / Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: The eTravel FAQ (re-read in full 2026-09-27) requires registration by: arriving Filipino and foreign passengers; arriving Filipino and foreign crewmembers; and departing Filipino passengers — departing foreign passengers are not listed among the required categories. Exempt: foreign diplomats and dependants, foreign dignitaries and members of their delegations, 9(e) visa holders, and holders of diplomatic and official/service passports. eTravel is the government's single digital data-collection platform for passengers arriving in and departing from the Philippines, used for border control, health surveillance and economic data analysis; it is web-based (no app or download required, mobile-responsive) and registration/updating is free, with no online payment collected. Register “within 72 hours (3 days) prior to your arrival into or departure from the Philippines”; take a screenshot or print the QR code and show it to the airline representative before boarding — a green QR code proceeds directly to immigration inspection, a red QR code requires Bureau of Quarantine review first. Currency (per BOC advisory of 2 March 2026, verified 2026-09-12, not re-fetched this round): customs accepts currency declarations through eTravel before travel or at designated counters at airports/seaports; foreign currency above USD 10,000 equivalent must be declared in full on entry and exit; Philippine currency above PHP 50,000 requires declaration and prior written BSP authority, requested before departure from the country of origin, with permitted purposes limited to numismatics, currency awareness and currency-machine testing/calibration/configuration. The FAQ covers no baggage duty-free allowances or goods-declaration fields; see unresolved item PH-baggage.
procedures.applicability_zh: eTravel官方FAQ（2026-09-27完整重读）要求登记的范围：抵达的菲律宾及外国旅客、抵达的菲律宾及外国机组船员、离境的菲律宾旅客——离境外国旅客不在要求登记之列。豁免：外国外交官及家属、外国政要及代表团成员、9(e)签证持有人，以及外交或公务/服务护照持有人。eTravel是菲律宾政府对出入境旅客的统一数字采集平台，用于边防管控、卫生监测与经济分析；网页版即可使用（无需下载应用，适配移动端），登记/更新免费，不收取任何在线付款。适用人群可在“抵达或离境菲律宾前72小时（3天）内”登记；截图或打印二维码，登机前向航空公司职员出示——绿码直接办理入境边检，红码须先接受检疫局(BOQ)复核。现金部分（据BOC 2026年3月2日通告，2026-09-12核验，本轮未重取）：海关接受经eTravel出行前申报，或在机场/海港指定柜台申报；出入境外币超过等值1万美元须全额申报；菲律宾比索超过5万比索须申报并取得BSP事先书面许可（须在出发国离境前申请），批准用途限钱币收藏、货币认知展示及点钞分钞设备测试校准配置。FAQ不含行李免税额度或货物申报字段；见未决项PH-baggage。
procedures.timing_en: Applicable eTravel registration within 72 hours (3 days) before the relevant arrival or departure; QR code ready for airline and border checks; currency declaration before travel online or at designated border counters; BSP authority for excess Philippine currency obtained before leaving the country of origin.
procedures.timing_zh: 适用人群的eTravel登记在相应抵达或离境前72小时（3天）内；二维码备妥供航空公司与边检查验；现金可提前在线申报或在指定口岸柜台申报；超限比索须在离开始发国前取得BSP许可。

fee.note: FAQ of 2026-09-27: registration/updating is “absolutely free of charge”; the official site does not collect or require any form of online payment.

procedures.name_zh_hant: eTravel——菲律賓一站式電子旅行申報系統（移民/健康/海關整合）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: eTravel官方FAQ（2026-09-27完整重讀）要求登記的範圍：抵達的菲律賓及外國旅客、抵達的菲律賓及外國機組船員、離境的菲律賓旅客——離境外國旅客不在要求登記之列。豁免：外國外交官及家屬、外國政要及代表團成員、9(e)簽證持有人，以及外交或公務/服務護照持有人。eTravel是菲律賓政府對出入境旅客的統一數字採集平臺，用於邊防管控、衛生監測與經濟分析；網頁版即可使用（無需下載應用，適配行動裝置），登記/更新免費，不收取任何線上付款。適用人群可在“抵達或離境菲律賓前72小時（3天）內”登記；截圖或列印 QR Code，登機前向航空公司職員出示——綠碼直接辦理入境邊檢，紅碼須先接受檢疫局(BOQ)複核。現金部分（據BOC 2026年3月2日通告，2026-09-12核驗，本輪未重取）：海關接受經eTravel出行前申報，或在機場/海港指定櫃檯申報；出入境外幣超過等值1萬美元須全額申報；菲律賓比索超過5萬比索須申報並取得BSP事先書面許可（須在出發國離境前申請），批准用途限錢幣收藏、貨幣認知展示及點鈔分鈔設備測試校準配置。FAQ不含行李免稅額度或貨物申報欄位；見未決項PH-baggage。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 適用人群的eTravel登記在相應抵達或離境前72小時（3天）內；QR Code 備妥供航空公司與邊檢查驗；現金可提前線上申報或在指定口岸櫃檯申報；超限比索須在離開始發國前取得BSP許可。

procedures.name_en: SG Arrival Card with Electronic Health Declaration
procedures.name_zh: 新加坡入境卡及电子健康申报
procedures.agency: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA), Singapore
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: all travellers arriving in Singapore, EXCEPT: (1) those transiting/transferring through Singapore without seeking immigration clearance; and (2) residents (Singapore citizens, Permanent Residents, Long-Term Pass holders including Student's Pass, Dependant's Pass, Long-Term Visit Pass and Work Pass) travelling through Woodlands and Tuas Checkpoints. The SG Arrival Card (SGAC) with Electronic Health Declaration must be submitted within 3 days (including arrival day) before arriving. Submission is free of charge via the SGAC e-Service or the MyICA mobile app. The SG Arrival Card is not a visa; a separate visa (where required) is still needed. The SGAC includes an electronic health declaration for disease control under the Infectious Diseases Act. NOTE: the SGAC is an immigration/health arrival card — goods declarations are administered separately by Singapore Customs via the Customs@SG traveller portal (see SG-duty-free-and-tobacco procedure).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：所有抵达新加坡的旅客，豁免：（1）不经移民查验的新加坡过境/换乘旅客；（2）经 Woodlands 和 Tuas 关卡入境的新加坡公民、永久居民及长期准证持有人（含学生证、家属证、长期访问证和工作证）。新加坡入境卡（SGAC）含电子健康申报须在抵达当日（含）前三天内提交。经 SGAC 电子服务或 MyICA 手机应用免费提交。SG 入境卡不是签证；需签证的旅客仍须另行取得。SGAC 含依《传染病法》用于疾病防控的电子健康申报。注：SGAC 为移民/健康入境卡——物品申报由新加坡海关经 Customs@SG 旅客门户另行管理（见 SG-duty-free-and-tobacco 事项）。
procedures.timing_en: Submitted within 3 days (including arrival day) before arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达当日（含）前三天内提交。

fee.note: SGAC submission is free of charge per ICA; commercial third-party services are not endorsed.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 新加坡入境卡及電子健康申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：所有抵達新加坡的旅客，豁免：（1）不經移民查驗的新加坡過境/換乘旅客；（2）經 Woodlands 和 Tuas 關卡入境的新加坡公民、永久居民及長期準證持有人（含學生證、家屬證、長期訪問證和工作證）。新加坡入境卡（SGAC）含電子健康申報須在抵達當日（含）前三天內提交。經 SGAC 電子服務或 MyICA 手機應用免費提交。SG 入境卡不是簽證；需簽證的旅客仍須另行取得。SGAC 含依《傳染病法》用於疾病防控的電子健康申報。注：SGAC 為移民/健康入境卡——物品申報由新加坡海關經 Customs@SG 旅客門戶另行管理（見 SG-duty-free-and-tobacco 事項）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達當日（含）前三天內提交。

procedures.name_en: Duty-free liquor concession (conditions and options) and zero tobacco concession (Singapore Customs)
procedures.name_zh: 免税酒类优惠（条件与选项）与烟草零免税（新加坡海关）
procedures.agency: Singapore Customs
procedures.applicability_en: On arrival, liquor duty-free concession requires age 18+, at least 48 hours abroad, no arrival from Malaysia, personal consumption and goods not prohibited. Choose: 1 L spirits plus 1 L wine or beer; 1 L wine plus 1 L beer; 2 L wine; or 2 L beer. Bona fide crew have lower limits. More than 10 L liquor requires a Customs permit. Tobacco has no duty-free or GST relief; non-standardised packaging is prohibited. New personal-use goods qualify for GST relief up to S$500 after 48 hours abroad, or S$100 for a shorter absence. Work/employment/student/dependant/long-term pass holders and crew are ineligible for this new-goods relief. Used belongings are a separate relief: residents must have owned and taken them out before leaving; non-residents must have owned them before arrival and take them out again. Goods exceeding relief must be declared and tax paid through Customs@SG in advance or checkpoint kiosks; failure to declare at the red channel can lead to penalties.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境酒类免税须同时满足：18岁及以上、境外停留至少48小时、非从马来西亚抵达、自用且非禁品。可选1升烈酒加1升葡萄酒或啤酒、1升葡萄酒加1升啤酒、2升葡萄酒，或2升啤酒。真正履职的机组及船员额度较低；超过10升酒须海关许可。烟草没有关税或GST免税，不符合标准化包装者禁止进口。新购自用物品的GST减免为境外至少48小时可减免500新元，否则100新元；工作、就业、学生、家属及长期准证持有人和机组船员不享有此新物品减免。旧随身物品另行减免：居民须为离境前已拥有并携出的物品；非居民须为入境前已拥有并将再次携出的物品。超额须申报缴税，可提前使用Customs@SG或口岸终端；不在红通道申报可受处罚。
procedures.timing_en: Assessed at the arrival checkpoint (red/green channel).
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时在口岸通道核验（红/绿通道）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 免稅酒類優惠（條件與選項）與菸草零免稅（新加坡海關）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境酒類免稅須同時滿足：18歲及以上、境外停留至少48小時、非從馬來西亞抵達、自用且非禁品。可選1升烈酒加1升葡萄酒或啤酒、1升葡萄酒加1升啤酒、2升葡萄酒，或2升啤酒。真正履職的機組及船員額度較低；超過10升酒須海關許可。菸草沒有關稅或GST免稅，不符合標準化包裝者禁止進口。新購自用物品的GST減免為境外至少48小時可減免500新元，否則100新元；工作、就業、學生、家屬及長期準證持有人和機組船員不享有此新物品減免。舊隨身物品另行減免：居民須為離境前已擁有並攜出的物品；非居民須為入境前已擁有並將再次攜出的物品。超額須申報繳稅，可提前使用Customs@SG或口岸終端；不在紅通道申報可受處罰。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時在口岸通道核驗（紅/綠通道）。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border cash and bearer negotiable instruments declaration
procedures.name_zh: 跨境现金及无记名可转让票据申报
procedures.agency: Singapore Police Force
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers entering or leaving Singapore with physical cash and bearer negotiable instruments whose total value exceeds S$20,000 or foreign-currency equivalent must report electronically. This is a reporting obligation, not a general cap on the amount that may be moved.
procedures.applicability_zh: 旅客携带总值超过20,000新元或等值外币的现金及无记名可转让票据入境或出境，须电子申报。这是报告义务，并非可携带总额的一般上限。
procedures.timing_en: Within 72 hours before entry or departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境或离境前72小时内。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境現金及無記名可轉讓票據申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 旅客攜帶總值超過20,000新元或等值外幣的現金及無記名可轉讓票據入境或出境，須電子申報。這是報告義務，並非可攜帶總額的一般上限。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境或離境前72小時內。

procedures.name_en: Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC)
procedures.name_zh: 泰国数字入境卡（TDAC）
procedures.agency: Thai Immigration Bureau
procedures.applicability_en: Non-Thai nationals entering Thailand by air, land or sea must submit TDAC. Exemptions are transit/transfer without immigration clearance and entry using a Border Pass. It replaces the paper arrival card and includes immigration and health information; it is not a visa or a goods customs declaration. Required from 1 May 2025; official registration is free.
procedures.applicability_zh: 经空、陆、海入境的非泰国国籍旅客须提交 TDAC；不办理入境手续的过境或转机旅客，以及持边境通行证入境者豁免。TDAC 替代纸质入境卡，含移民与健康资料；不属于签证或物品海关申报。2025年5月1日起实施，官方登记免费。
procedures.timing_en: Submit within the three-day window including the arrival date, before entry.
procedures.timing_zh: 在包含抵达当日在内的三天窗口内、入境前提交。

fee.note: 泰国驻罗马使馆正文明确登记免费。

procedures.name_zh_hant: 泰國數字入境卡（TDAC）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 經空、陸、海入境的非泰國國籍旅客須提交 TDAC；不辦理入境手續的過境或轉機旅客，以及持邊境通行證入境者豁免。TDAC 替代紙質入境卡，含移民與健康資料；不屬於簽證或物品海關申報。2025年5月1日起實施，官方登記免費。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在包含抵達當日在內的三天窗口內、入境前提交。

procedures.name_en: Traveller duty-free allowance (Thai Customs) — separate from TDAC
procedures.name_zh: 旅客免税额度（泰国海关）——与TDAC分开
procedures.agency: The Customs Department of Thailand
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving air passengers may use the green channel only when carrying no dutiable, prohibited or restricted goods. Duty-free personal belongings must be in reasonable quantities, total value not over THB 20,000, excluding prohibited/restricted goods and food. Tobacco limit: 200 cigarettes or 250 g tobacco or 250 g combined; alcohol: no more than 1 litre. Excess tobacco or alcohol must be put in the Customs disposal box to avoid prosecution. Non-commercial accompanying goods valued up to THB 200,000 are assessed at the red channel. Other cases may require an import declaration; declaration does not legalise prohibited/restricted goods.
procedures.applicability_zh: 航空入境旅客仅在无应税、禁止或受限物品时使用绿色通道。个人用品须为合理数量、总值不超过20,000泰铢，且不含禁限物品及食品。烟草限香烟200支，或烟草250克，或各类合计250克；酒不超过1升。超量烟酒须投入海关投弃箱，否则可能被追诉。非商业随身物品总值不超过200,000泰铢时可在红通道核税；其他情形可能须另办进口申报，申报本身不使禁限物品合法。
procedures.timing_en: Assessed at the arrival customs channel (red/green).
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时在海关通道（红/绿）核验。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客免稅額度（泰國海關）——與TDAC分開
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 航空入境旅客僅在無應稅、禁止或受限物品時使用綠色通道。個人用品須為合理數量、總值不超過20,000泰銖，且不含禁限物品及食品。菸草限香菸200支，或菸草250克，或各類合計250克；酒不超過1升。超量菸酒須投入海關投棄箱，否則可能被追訴。非商業隨身物品總值不超過200,000泰銖時可在紅通道核稅；其他情形可能須另辦進口申報，申報本身不使禁限物品合法。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時在海關通道（紅/綠）核驗。

procedures.name_en: Customs Arrival Declaration, duty-free allowances and goods declaration (Timor-Leste Customs Authority)
procedures.name_zh: 海关抵达申报、免税额度与物品申报（东帝汶海关总署）
procedures.agency: Timor-Leste Customs Authority (Ministério das Finanças)
procedures.applicability_en: All arriving travellers are legally required to complete a paper Customs Arrival Declaration form with eight questions (downloadable from the Customs website); if no form is available on arrival, the traveller instead makes a verbal declaration and Customs asks the relevant questions. Personal baggage and gifts must be non-commercial. Each adult traveller aged 17 or over has a duty-free allowance of goods up to USD 300, with per-traveller item limits: 200 cigarettes, or 100 cigarillos (max 3 g each), or 75 cigars; cut tobacco: the Customs page states 30 g while the underlying Decreto-Lei n.º 8/2006, art. 13(1)(a)(iv), states 300 g — the two official figures conflict tenfold and the limit actually enforced is unknown, so no single figure is asserted here (unresolved item TL-cut-tobacco-30g-vs-300g); perfume 75 g; eau de toilette 0.375 L; still wine 5 L; distilled beverages and spirits above 22% vol. and non-denatured ethyl alcohol of 80% vol. or more: 1.5 L (quantity per Decreto-Lei n.º 8/2006, art. 13(1)(b)(i); the Customs English sentence is garbled); coffee 1 kg or 400 g of extracts; tea 200 g or 80 g of extracts; medicines for personal needs. Travellers under 17: the Customs guidance states that they cannot bring tobacco or alcohol and that other goods may still be brought in duty-free up to USD 300; the statute says the opposite — Decreto-Lei n.º 8/2006, art. 13(2), grants travellers under 17 no global duty-free allowance at all (and no tobacco or alcohol allowance). Guidance and law conflict, and which rule is applied at the border is unknown, so no duty-free entitlement is promised here for under-17s. Goods worth more than USD 300 must be declared to Customs on arrival — the traveller is legally obliged to inform Customs, and failure can draw a fine or legal action. Goods valued less than USD 1,000: Traveller's Declaration (IT4) — Customs completes a simple electronic form with the traveller's assistance (passport number, name, address, invoice or receipt, country of purchase, currency of purchase, flight number), makes the electronic declaration in the customs processing system (ASYCUDA World) right away without a Customs Broker, issues a payment slip, and the traveller pays the calculated duties and taxes by debit or credit card or at a bank (Customs accepts no cash directly); there is no fee for the declaration itself — the only costs are the duties and taxes shown on the electronic payment slip. Goods exceeding USD 1,000: Commercial Import Declaration (IM4) — the traveller must contact a Customs Broker who declares on the traveller's behalf. No traveller self-service online declaration channel is evidenced on the official pages consulted: the electronic filing is completed by Customs staff (IT4) or a Customs Broker (IM4), and the online report form on the Customs page is only a channel for reporting improper payment demands or misconduct (Customs Hotline 12200), not a declaration channel — this is what the consulted official pages show and does not prove that no online channel exists anywhere. Cash: for cash of USD 20,000 or more (equal to or greater than USD 20,000), obtain prior BCTL authorization and, on arrival, declare the cash to Customs and show the authorization — see TL-bctl-cash-authorization; separately, the AML law requires declaration of cash of USD 10,000 or more (equal to or greater than USD 10,000) when entering or leaving — see TL-aml-cash-declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有抵达旅客依法须填写含八道问题的纸质海关抵达申报表（可在海关网站下载）；如抵达时无表格，则改为口头申报，由海关人员提问。个人行李与馈赠须为非商业用途。每名17岁及以上成年旅客可免税携带价值不超过300美元的物品，并按人设品类上限：香烟200支，或小雪茄100支（每支最多3克），或雪茄75支；切丝烟草：海关页写30克，其依据的第8/2006号法令第13(1)(a)(iv)条则写300克——两份官方数字相差十倍、实际执行口径未知，本记录不采信任何单一数字（待核项TL-cut-tobacco-30g-vs-300g）；香水75克；花露水0.375升；静态葡萄酒5升；酒精度高于22% vol.的蒸馏酒与烈酒以及80% vol.及以上的未变性乙醇：1.5升（数量依据第8/2006号法令第13(1)(b)(i)条；海关英文原句表述有误）；咖啡1公斤或400克浸膏；茶叶200克或80克浸膏；自用所需数量药品。未满17岁旅客：海关指引写明不得携带烟草和酒类、其他物品仍可免税携带至300美元；法令则相反——第8/2006号法令第13(2)条规定未满17岁不享受任何全球免税额（含烟酒额度）。指引与法律冲突、边境实际执行口径未知，本记录不向未满17岁旅客承诺任何免税待遇。携带物品价值超过300美元的，抵达时必须向海关申报（告知义务），否则可能被罚款甚至追究法律责任。物品价值低于1,000美元：走旅客申报（IT4）——海关人员协助旅客填写简易电子表格（护照号、姓名、住址、购物发票或收据、购买国家、购买货币、航班号），当场在海关处理系统（ASYCUDA World）录入、无需报关行，生成缴款单，旅客以借记卡/信用卡或到银行缴纳核定的关税与税款（海关不直接收现金）；申报本身不收费——仅有的费用即电子缴款单上列明的关税与税款。物品价值超过1,000美元：商业进口申报（IM4）——旅客须联系报关行代为申报。所查官方页面未见旅客自助在线申报渠道：电子录入由海关人员（IT4）或报关行（IM4）完成；海关页面的“在线举报表”仅是举报不当收费或违规行为的渠道（海关热线12200），并非申报渠道——此为所查官页范围内的结论，不据此断言全网不存在在线申报方式。现金：达到或超过20,000美元（含20,000美元）的，须事先取得央行许可，抵达时向海关申报该现金并出示许可，见TL-bctl-cash-authorization；另依反洗钱法，入境或出境时携带达到或超过10,000美元（含10,000美元）的现金须申报，见TL-aml-cash-declaration。
procedures.timing_en: Complete the Customs Arrival Declaration on arrival (verbal declaration if no form is available); IT4 electronic processing with Customs is done right away at the counter; IM4 requires contacting a Customs Broker.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时填写海关抵达申报表（如无表格则口头申报）；IT4电子申报由海关当场协助完成；IM4须联系报关行办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 海關抵達申報、免稅額度與物品申報（東帝汶海關總署）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 所有抵達旅客依法須填寫含八道問題的紙質海關抵達申報表（可在海關網站下載）；如抵達時無表格，則改為口頭申報，由海關人員提問。個人行李與饋贈須為非商業用途。每名17歲及以上成年旅客可免稅攜帶價值不超過300美元的物品，並按人設品類上限：香菸200支，或小雪茄100支（每支最多3克），或雪茄75支；切絲菸草：海關頁寫30克，其依據的第8/2006號法令第13(1)(a)(iv)條則寫300克——兩份官方數字相差十倍、實際執行口徑未知，本記錄不採信任何單一數字（待核項TL-cut-tobacco-30g-vs-300g）；香水75克；花露水0.375升；靜態葡萄酒5升；酒精度高於22% vol.的蒸餾酒與烈酒以及80% vol.及以上的未變性乙醇：1.5升（數量依據第8/2006號法令第13(1)(b)(i)條；海關英文原句表述有誤）；咖啡1公斤或400克浸膏；茶葉200克或80克浸膏；自用所需數量藥品。未滿17歲旅客：海關指引寫明不得攜帶菸草和酒類、其他物品仍可免稅攜帶至300美元；法令則相反——第8/2006號法令第13(2)條規定未滿17歲不享受任何全球免稅額（含菸酒額度）。指引與法律衝突、邊境實際執行口徑未知，本記錄不向未滿17歲旅客承諾任何免稅待遇。攜帶物品價值超過300美元的，抵達時必須向海關申報（告知義務），否則可能被罰款甚至追究法律責任。物品價值低於1,000美元：走旅客申報（IT4）——海關人員協助旅客填寫簡易電子表格（護照號、姓名、住址、購物發票或收據、購買國家、購買貨幣、航班號），當場在海關處理系統（ASYCUDA World）錄入、無需報關行，生成繳款單，旅客以借記卡/信用卡或到銀行繳納核定的關稅與稅款（海關不直接收現金）；申報本身不收費——僅有的費用即電子繳款單上列明的關稅與稅款。物品價值超過1,000美元：商業進口申報（IM4）——旅客須聯繫報關行代為申報。所查官方頁面未見旅客自助線上申報渠道：電子錄入由海關人員（IT4）或報關行（IM4）完成；海關頁面的“線上舉報表”僅是舉報不當收費或違規行為的渠道（海關熱線12200），並非申報渠道——此為所查官頁範圍內的結論，不據此斷言全網不存在線上申報方式。現金：達到或超過20,000美元（含20,000美元）的，須事先取得央行許可，抵達時向海關申報該現金並出示許可，見TL-bctl-cash-authorization；另依反洗錢法，入境或出境時攜帶達到或超過10,000美元（含10,000美元）的現金須申報，見TL-aml-cash-declaration。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時填寫海關抵達申報表（如無表格則口頭申報）；IT4電子申報由海關當場協助完成；IM4須聯繫報關行辦理。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration to Customs when entering or leaving Timor-Leste (USD 10,000 or more, AML law)
procedures.name_zh: 入境或出境东帝汶时向海关申报现金（达到或超过10,000美元，反洗钱法）
procedures.agency: Timor-Leste Customs Authority (declaration at the border); legal basis: Lei n.º 17/2011, as amended and republished by Lei n.º 5/2013, art. 7 (Jornal da República, Ministry of Justice)
procedures.applicability_en: Legal basis: Lei n.º 17/2011 (AML/CFT law), art. 7(1), in the wording republished as current by Lei n.º 5/2013 (Jornal da República, Ministry of Justice). Any natural person who, on entering or leaving Timor-Leste, transports cash or bearer negotiable instruments of an amount equal to or greater than USD 10,000 (USD 10,000 or more) must declare the amount carried to the customs authorities. The duty applies in both directions — entering and exiting. Channel note: recorded as conditional — the duty is triggered by the amount carried and falls due at the border whether entering or exiting; no dedicated form or online channel for it is described in official guidance (see TL-cash-declaration-channel). Copies of the declarations are transmitted immediately by Customs to the Financial Intelligence Unit (UIF); where there is founded suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing, or where a false declaration is made, Customs seizes the undeclared amount in whole or in part, with judicial review within three business days; under art. 32(1)(a), non-declaration of currency or bearer instruments of USD 10,000 or more is an infringement punishable by a fine of USD 250 to 150,000 for individuals. Currency-status caveat: the cited text is the 2013 republication; whether art. 7 was further amended after 2013 cannot be verified from the cached sources (bounded unknown). Coverage gap: the current Customs traveller guidance describes cash declaration on arrival only from USD 20,000 or more (the BCTL authorization threshold) and does not mention this lower USD 10,000 duty; how a traveller makes this declaration (whether through the same paper Customs Arrival Declaration form or another form or channel), and the exit-side channel, are not described in the available official traveller guidance (bounded unknown). No fee for this declaration is evidenced.
procedures.applicability_zh: 法律依据：第17/2011号法律（反洗钱及反恐融资法）第7条第1款，其文本经第5/2013号法律以“现行表述”重刊（司法部《共和国公报》）。任何自然人入境或出境东帝汶时，携带现金或无记名可转让票据达到或超过10,000美元（含10,000美元）的，必须将所携金额向海关申报。该义务双向适用——入境与出境。渠道说明：记为conditional——该义务由所携金额触发，入境或出境时均于边境履行；官方指引未描述专用表格或在线渠道（见TL-cash-declaration-channel）。申报副本由海关立即传送金融情报组（UIF）；如有洗钱或恐怖融资的合理怀疑或申报不实，海关扣押全部或部分未申报款项，由主管司法机关在最多三个工作日内审查；依第32(1)(a)条，达到或超过10,000美元不申报属违法，自然人可处250至150,000美元罚款。现行性提示：所据文本为2013年重刊本，第7条其后是否再被修改无法从缓存核实（bounded unknown）。指引覆盖缺口：现行海关旅客指引仅从达到或超过20,000美元（央行许可门槛）起描述抵达时的现金申报，未提及此项更低的10,000美元申报义务；旅客如何完成该项申报（是否通过同一张纸质海关抵达申报表或另有表格/渠道）及出境侧的具体渠道，现有官方旅客指引均无描述（bounded unknown）。无任何证据显示该申报收费。
procedures.timing_en: At the border, on entering or leaving Timor-Leste, to the customs authorities.
procedures.timing_zh: 在边境，于入境或出境东帝汶时向海关申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境或出境東帝汶時向海關申報現金（達到或超過10,000美元，反洗錢法）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 法律依據：第17/2011號法律（反洗錢及反恐融資法）第7條第1款，其文本經第5/2013號法律以“現行表述”重刊（司法部《共和國公報》）。任何自然人入境或出境東帝汶時，攜帶現金或無記名可轉讓票據達到或超過10,000美元（含10,000美元）的，必須將所攜金額向海關申報。該義務雙向適用——入境與出境。渠道說明：記為conditional——該義務由所攜金額觸發，入境或出境時均於邊境履行；官方指引未描述專用表格或線上渠道（見TL-cash-declaration-channel）。申報副本由海關立即傳送金融情報組（UIF）；如有洗錢或恐怖融資的合理懷疑或申報不實，海關扣押全部或部分未申報款項，由主管司法機關在最多三個工作日內審查；依第32(1)(a)條，達到或超過10,000美元不申報屬違法，自然人可處250至150,000美元罰款。現行性提示：所據文本為2013年重刊本，第7條其後是否再被修改無法從緩存核實（bounded unknown）。指引覆蓋缺口：現行海關旅客指引僅從達到或超過20,000美元（央行許可門檻）起描述抵達時的現金申報，未提及此項更低的10,000美元申報義務；旅客如何完成該項申報（是否通過同一張紙質海關抵達申報表或另有表格/渠道）及出境側的具體渠道，現有官方旅客指引均無描述（bounded unknown）。無任何證據顯示該申報收費。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在邊境，於入境或出境東帝汶時向海關申報。

procedures.name_en: Prior BCTL authorization to bring in or take out cash of USD 20,000 or more
procedures.name_zh: 携带达到或超过20,000美元现金入境或出境的央行事先许可
procedures.agency: Banco Central de Timor-Leste (BCTL) — Departamento de Supervisão do Sistema Financeiro, Divisão de Licenciamento e Regulação; authorization presented to Timor-Leste Customs at entry or exit
procedures.applicability_en: Legal basis: Instrução do BCTL n.º 4/2017 on the import and export of cash (Jornal da República, Series II no. 16, 21 April 2017; in force 30 days after publication), which expressly revokes the 2009 instruction (Instrução Pública n.º 4/2009) — the former USD 5,000-era regime is not current. Without authorization, no person may import or export cash — in US Dollars or any other currency — of an amount equal to or greater than USD 20,000 (USD 20,000 or more), in either direction (bringing into or taking out of Timor-Leste). Comparator note: the art. 3(1) prohibition and the current Customs guidance both use “equal to or greater than” (“$20,000 or more”), so exactly USD 20,000, too, must not be carried without authorization and prior authorization should be obtained first; however, the application duty in art. 4(1) is worded for cash that “ultrapasse” (exceeds) the amount referred to in art. 3(1) — on its face strictly more than USD 20,000 — so whether the art. 4 application details (Anexo I form, at least 5 business days' advance filing, fees) apply unambiguously at exactly USD 20,000 is a wording difference the cached texts do not resolve (bounded unknown; see TL-bctl-art4-equality); this record does not advise carrying exactly USD 20,000 without authorization. Who applies and when: the person who will transport the cash (requests must be signed by that person) submits the written authorization request on the form in Anexo I of the Instruction, at least 5 business days before the proposed transport date (later requests are treated as urgent), to BCTL, Department of Supervision of the Financial System, Licensing and Regulation Division, Avenida Xavier do Amaral n.º 9, Díli, or by e-mail to dsflicensing@bancocentral.tl, with the supporting documents listed in art. 5(6). The application is a written paper-form process (Anexo I form, submitted to the BCTL division or by e-mail); no traveller self-service online application portal is described in the Instruction, so the channel is recorded as paper. Fee (art. 7): USD 100 for a non-urgent request, USD 300 for an urgent request, paid to BCTL on submission — this is the BCTL authorization-request fee, not a border declaration fee; the structured fee field is recorded as unknown because the amount is not a single value. Urgent route: export — the cash is delivered to BCTL and the decision comes within 48 hours; import — the request is submitted with the urgent fee and the decision comes within 72 hours; if no decision is taken within the deadlines, the request is treated as rejected. Authorization validity: maximum 20 business days from issuance, for a single import or a single export. Use at the border: the traveller presents the authorization to the Timor-Leste customs authorities at the moment of entry or exit; on arrival the traveller must also declare the cash to Customs and show the BCTL authorization (Customs guidance, which warns that failing to declare goods or cash totaling USD 20,000 or more may be a criminal offence). Additional restriction: cash of USD 150,000 or more is only permitted in the situations listed in art. 3(3) (e.g., through a bank or financial institution duly licensed in Timor-Leste, or documented exceptional hardship, including medical emergencies). Sanctions: fines of 20% of the amount transported or to be transported (max USD 5,000) for breaching the USD 20,000 / USD 150,000 thresholds, and 50% of the excess (max USD 5,000) for exceeding the amount stated in the authorization.
procedures.applicability_zh: 法律依据：东帝汶中央银行第4/2017号指示《关于现金的进口与出口》（2017年4月21日《共和国公报》第二系列第16期，公布30日后生效），其明文废止2009年第4/2009号公共指示——旧的5,000美元时代规则已非现行。未获许可，任何人不得携带入境或携带出境金额达到或超过20,000美元（含20,000美元）的现金——美元或任何其他货币均适用，双向（携带入境或携带出境）。比较符提示：第3(1)条禁止句与海关现行指引均用“达到或超过”（$20,000 or more），故恰好20,000美元同样不得无许可携带、应事前取得许可；但第4(1)条申请义务的措辞为“Numerário que ultrapasse o montante referido no número 1 do artigo 3.º”（字面上严格超过第3(1)条所指金额，即超过20,000美元）——恰好20,000美元时第4条申请细则（附件一表格、至少提前5个工作日、费用等）能否无歧义适用，属条文措辞差异、缓存内无法定论（bounded unknown，见TL-bctl-art4-equality）；本记录不建议恰好携带20,000美元而不取得许可。申请人与时点：由将实际携带现金者本人提出（申请书须由该人签署），按指示附件一的表格以书面申请，于预定携带日前至少5个工作日提交（迟交按“紧急”处理），送达帝力Xavier do Amaral大道9号东帝汶中央银行金融体系监管部许可与监管科，或发送电子邮件至dsflicensing@bancocentral.tl，并附第5(6)条所列证明材料。该申请为书面纸表流程（附件一表格，送交央行该部门或经电邮提交）；指示未描述旅客自助在线申请门户，故渠道记为paper。费用（第7条）：普通申请100美元、紧急申请300美元，提交时向央行缴纳——此为央行许可申请费，并非边境申报服务费；因金额非单一值，结构化fee字段记为unknown。紧急通道：出境——将现金交存央行，48小时内作出决定；入境——随紧急费一并提交申请，72小时内作出决定；逾期未决定的视为驳回。许可效力：自签发起最长20个工作日，且仅限一次进口或一次出口。边境使用：旅客于入境或出境时向东帝汶海关出示该许可；抵达时还须向海关申报该现金并出示央行许可（海关指引，并警告不申报相关物品或合计达到或超过20,000美元的现金可能构成刑事犯罪）。附加限制：达到或超过150,000美元的现金仅限第3(3)条列明情形（如经在东帝汶持牌经营的银行或金融机构，或有证明的特别困难情形，含医疗紧急情况）。处罚：违反20,000/150,000美元门槛的，按所运或将运金额的20%罚款（最高5,000美元）；超过许可载明金额的，按超额部分的50%罚款（最高5,000美元）。
procedures.timing_en: Apply to BCTL at least 5 business days before the travel date (urgent route: decision within 48 hours for export, 72 hours for import); present the authorization to Customs at entry or exit; on arrival, declare the cash to Customs at the same time.
procedures.timing_zh: 至少在出行日前5个工作日向央行申请（紧急通道：出境48小时内、入境72小时内决定）；入境或出境时向海关出示许可；抵达时同时向海关申报现金。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜帶達到或超過20,000美元現金入境或出境的央行事先許可
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 法律依據：東帝汶中央銀行第4/2017號指示《關於現金的進口與出口》（2017年4月21日《共和國公報》第二系列第16期，公佈30日後生效），其明文廢止2009年第4/2009號公共指示——舊的5,000美元時代規則已非現行。未獲許可，任何人不得攜帶入境或攜帶出境金額達到或超過20,000美元（含20,000美元）的現金——美元或任何其他貨幣均適用，雙向（攜帶入境或攜帶出境）。比較符提示：第3(1)條禁止句與海關現行指引均用“達到或超過”（$20,000 or more），故恰好20,000美元同樣不得無許可攜帶、應事前取得許可；但第4(1)條申請義務的措辭為“Numerário que ultrapasse o montante referido no número 1 do artigo 3.º”（字面上嚴格超過第3(1)條所指金額，即超過20,000美元）——恰好20,000美元時第4條申請細則（附件一表格、至少提前5個工作日、費用等）能否無歧義適用，屬條文措辭差異、緩存內無法定論（bounded unknown，見TL-bctl-art4-equality）；本記錄不建議恰好攜帶20,000美元而不取得許可。申請人與時點：由將實際攜帶現金者本人提出（申請書須由該人簽署），按指示附件一的表格以書面申請，於預定攜帶日前至少5個工作日提交（遲交按“緊急”處理），送達帝力Xavier do Amaral大道9號東帝汶中央銀行金融體系監管部許可與監管科，或發送電子郵件至dsflicensing@bancocentral.tl，並附第5(6)條所列證明材料。該申請為書面紙表流程（附件一表格，送交央行該部門或經電郵提交）；指示未描述旅客自助線上申請門戶，故渠道記為paper。費用（第7條）：普通申請100美元、緊急申請300美元，提交時向央行繳納——此為央行許可申請費，並非邊境申報服務費；因金額非單一值，結構化fee欄位記為unknown。緊急通道：出境——將現金交存央行，48小時內作出決定；入境——隨緊急費一併提交申請，72小時內作出決定；逾期未決定的視為駁回。許可效力：自簽發起最長20個工作日，且僅限一次進口或一次出口。邊境使用：旅客於入境或出境時向東帝汶海關出示該許可；抵達時還須向海關申報該現金並出示央行許可（海關指引，並警告不申報相關物品或合計達到或超過20,000美元的現金可能構成刑事犯罪）。附加限制：達到或超過150,000美元的現金僅限第3(3)條列明情形（如經在東帝汶持牌經營的銀行或金融機構，或有證明的特別困難情形，含醫療緊急情況）。處罰：違反20,000/150,000美元門檻的，按所運或將運金額的20%罰款（最高5,000美元）；超過許可載明金額的，按超額部分的50%罰款（最高5,000美元）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 至少在出行日前5個工作日向央行申請（緊急通道：出境48小時內、入境72小時內決定）；入境或出境時向海關出示許可；抵達時同時向海關申報現金。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration under Circular 15/2011/TT-NHNN
procedures.name_zh: 15/2011/TT-NHNN现金申报
procedures.agency: State Bank of Vietnam / Border Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Individuals using passports or passport-equivalent documents at international border gates must declare foreign cash exceeding USD 5,000 equivalent, or Vietnamese cash exceeding VND 15,000,000, on both entry and exit. Border-pass travel is governed separately. Incoming foreign cash of USD 5,000 equivalent or less must also be declared if it will be deposited into a personal foreign-currency payment account. Travellers cheques, bank cards and other securities are excluded from these cash thresholds. Outbound amounts above the threshold generally require an authorised-bank certificate or State Bank approval; a Customs-confirmed declaration of the latest import can instead support re-export not exceeding that import, on the next departure within 12 months. Article 18(4)(b) of Circular 20/2022 amends certificate issuance in Article 5(1)(a), not Article 2 amounts; effective 15 February 2023. This is a separate border-cash procedure, distinct from the voluntary PAI pre-arrival pilot.
procedures.applicability_zh: 持护照或护照替代证件经国际口岸出入境者，外币现金超过等值5,000美元，或越南盾现金超过1,500万元时须向海关申报；边境通行证另按专门规定。入境外币现金等于或低于5,000美元、但拟存入个人外币结算账户时也须申报。这些现金门槛不涵盖旅行支票、银行卡及其他有价单证。超过门槛携出通常须授权银行证明或央行批准；若不超过最近申报携入金额，可用海关确认的该次入境申报，在12个月内下一次出境时携回。20/2022通知第18(4)(b)条修订第5(1)(a)条证明签发主体，不改第2条金额，2023年2月15日生效。本项为口岸现金单独程序，与自愿性PAI行前试点无关。
procedures.timing_en: Declare at the international border gate; obtain outbound approval or qualifying prior-import proof before exit.
procedures.timing_zh: 在国际口岸申报；出境前备妥所需批准或符合条件的此前入境证明。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 15/2011/TT-NHNN現金申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 持護照或護照替代證件經國際口岸出入境者，外幣現金超過等值5,000美元，或越南盾現金超過1,500萬元時須向海關申報；邊境通行證另按專門規定。入境外幣現金等於或低於5,000美元、但擬存入個人外幣結算賬戶時也須申報。這些現金門檻不涵蓋旅行支票、銀行卡及其他有價單證。超過門檻攜出通常須授權銀行證明或央行批准；若不超過最近申報攜入金額，可用海關確認的該次入境申報，在12個月內下一次出境時攜回。20/2022通知第18(4)(b)條修訂第5(1)(a)條證明簽發主體，不改第2條金額，2023年2月15日生效。本項為口岸現金單獨程序，與自願性PAI行前試點無關。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在國際口岸申報；出境前備妥所需批准或符合條件的此前入境證明。

procedures.name_en: FMJ foreign currency declaration and re-export rules
procedures.name_zh: FMJ外币申报与携回规定
procedures.agency: Bangladesh Customs (National Board of Revenue) with Bangladesh Bank FE Circulars
procedures.applicability_en: Bangladesh Bank FE Circular 08 of 11 February 2020 and its amended FMJ form allow incoming passengers to bring up to USD 10,000 equivalent without declaration. Any larger amount may be brought in with FMJ declaration. A foreigner may take out the declared imported amount, or up to USD 10,000 imported without declaration. A Bangladeshi may retain and re-export up to USD 10,000 imported without declaration; resident Bangladeshis must encash or deposit amounts over USD 10,000 within 30 days of arrival, while non-residents may do so at any time after return. The form states a BDT 10,000 allowance for bringing in or taking out Bangladeshi currency. Current annual foreign-exchange purchase/travel quotas are a separate matter and are not established here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 孟加拉国银行2020年2月11日第08号外汇通函及修订FMJ表明确：入境携外币不超过等值10,000美元无需申报，更多金额可用FMJ申报携入。外国人可携回已申报的入境金额，或未申报携入的不超过10,000美元。孟加拉国人可保留并携回未申报携入的不超过10,000美元；居民携入超过10,000美元须在抵达后30天内兑换或存入合适外币账户，非居民可在回国后任意时间办理。表格载本币携入或携出额度为10,000塔卡。现行年度购汇与旅行额度另属其他规定，本项未核实。
procedures.timing_en: FMJ at arrival for foreign currency above USD 10,000 equivalent; resident deposit/encashment rule within 30 days.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境外币超过等值10,000美元时填FMJ；居民超额外币须在30天内兑换或存入。
procedures.name_zh_hant: FMJ外幣申報與攜回規定
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 孟加拉國銀行2020年2月11日第08號外匯通函及修訂FMJ表明確：入境攜外幣不超過等值10,000美元無需申報，更多金額可用FMJ申報攜入。外國人可攜回已申報的入境金額，或未申報攜入的不超過10,000美元。孟加拉國人可保留並攜回未申報攜入的不超過10,000美元；居民攜入超過10,000美元須在抵達後30天內兌換或存入合適外幣賬戶，非居民可在回國後任意時間辦理。表格載本幣攜入或攜出額度為10,000塔卡。現行年度購匯與旅行額度另屬其他規定，本項未核實。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境外幣超過等值10,000美元時填FMJ；居民超額外幣須在30天內兌換或存入。

procedures.name_en: Tourist baggage and currency declarations
procedures.name_zh: 游客行李及货币申报
procedures.agency: Department of Revenue and Customs, Bhutan
procedures.applicability_en: The 2024 Customs Manual (as retrieved 2026-09-12) requires tourists to declare dutiable goods and provides temporary import/re-export treatment for personal effects. Its currency provisions (sections 16.10-16.11), as read then, required declaration of foreign exchange exceeding USD10,000 at entry and Royal Monetary Authority clearance for departure above USD10,000, with 'exceeding ... or more' wording that leaves exactly USD10,000 undetermined. Those currency statements are 2024 manual text only, not a confirmation of the 2026 rule: whether the declaration threshold and the clearance requirement currently apply remains unresolved (BT-2026-fx-regs).
procedures.applicability_zh: 2024年海关手册（2026-09-12获取）要求游客申报应税物品，并对个人物品作暂准进口及复出口安排。其货币条款（第16.10-16.11段）当时所见为：携入外汇超过1万美元（USD10,000）须申报，携出超过1万美元另须货币管理局（RMA）许可；条文使用exceeding…or more表述，恰为1万美元时是否须申报无法确定。上述货币内容仅为2024年手册文本，不构成对2026年现行规则的确认：申报门槛及许可要求目前是否适用仍属未决（BT-2026-fx-regs）。
procedures.timing_en: At entry or departure, as applicable.
procedures.timing_zh: 按适用方向在入境或出境时办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 遊客行李及貨幣申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 2024年海關手冊（2026-09-12獲取）要求遊客申報應稅物品，並對個人物品作暫準進口及復出口安排。其貨幣條款（第16.10-16.11段）當時所見為：攜入外匯超過1萬美元（USD10,000）須申報，攜出超過1萬美元另須貨幣管理局（RMA）許可；條文使用exceeding…or more表述，恰為1萬美元時是否須申報無法確定。上述貨幣內容僅為2024年手冊文本，不構成對2026年現行規則的確認：申報門檻及許可要求目前是否適用仍屬未決（BT-2026-fx-regs）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 按適用方向在入境或出境時辦理。

procedures.name_en: Accompanied baggage declaration (CBD-I)
procedures.name_zh: 随身行李申报（CBD-I）
procedures.agency: Government of India, Ministry of Finance / CBIC
procedures.applicability_en: In force 2 February 2026 (Notification No. 15/2026-Customs (N.T.), Customs Baggage (Declaration and Processing) Regulations, 2026). Arriving passengers carrying dutiable or prohibited goods must file CBD-I electronically through the automated system - the ICEGATE portal (www.icegate.gov.in) or the web/mobile application 'Atithi' - before entering the Green Channel; an Assistant/Deputy Commissioner may allow another manner on arrival. Any 'Yes' to CBD-I items 16-18 (pets, jewellery beyond allowance, listed regulated goods including Indian currency over INR 25,000) directs the passenger to the Red Channel. Duty-free allowances in the CBD-I appendix (applicability description only, not a separate procedure): INR 75,000 for residents, tourists of Indian origin and foreign non-tourist-visa holders arriving other than by land; INR 25,000 for foreign tourists; NIL for land arrivals; jewellery 40g (female)/20g (others) after one year abroad; 2 litres alcohol; 100 cigarettes or 25 cigars or 125g tobacco; one new laptop for passengers aged 18+. Operational supplement (per the official CBIC Atithi 2.0 Passenger User Manual's published steps; this is the documented procedure, not a registration or submission actually completed in this research): a new user clicks 'Register' at the top of the Atithi web/app home page, clicks 'Accept' on the Terms and Conditions, selects the 'Passenger' radio button, enters registration details, clicks 'Submit', then enters the 6-digit OTP sent to the registered e-mail and clicks 'Submit OTP' to complete registration (a welcome e-mail follows). A returning user clicks 'Login' (or a declaration card, which opens the login form if not already logged in), accepts the Terms and Conditions, enters Passport/Gov. ID number, password and captcha, clicks 'Login', and enters the 6-digit e-mail OTP; after login the passenger answers a screening questionnaire, and any 'Yes' answer directs them to fill the declaration form and report to the Customs Officer at the Red Channel counter on arrival. To declare, the passenger opens the Baggage Declaration tab, selects 'Baggage Declaration', clicks 'OK' on the guidelines popup, chooses 'Self' or 'Family Member' (with a dropdown of added members), completes the form sections — passenger/passport details, contact and other details, travel details, earlier export certificate declared, item/gold/silver/foreign-currency, and upload documents — then clicks 'Submit' or 'Save As Draft'; a success message appears and the baggage declaration dashboard opens, where declarations can be viewed, edited or deleted until they are verified.
procedures.applicability_zh: 2026年2月2日生效（第15/2026-Customs (N.T.)号通知，《2026年海关行李（申报及处理）规例》）。携带应税或禁止物品的入境旅客须在进入绿通道前，通过自动化系统——ICEGATE门户（www.icegate.gov.in）或网页/移动应用“Atithi”——电子提交CBD-I；助理/副海关专员可在抵达时允许其他申报方式。CBD-I第16至18项（宠物、超限珠宝、含超过25,000卢比印度货币在内的列示管制物品）任何一项为Yes须走红通道。CBD-I附表免税额（仅为适用说明，不构成单独程序）：居民、印度裔旅客及持非旅游签外国旅客经陆路以外方式入境75,000卢比；外国游客25,000卢比；陆路入境无免税额；出国满一年者珠宝女性40克/其余20克；酒2升；香烟100支或雪茄25支或烟丝125克；18岁以上旅客新笔记本电脑1台。 操作补充（依据 CBIC《Atithi 2.0 旅客用户手册》公布的步骤，属官方手册流程，并非本次研究实际完成的注册或提交）：新用户在 Atithi 网页/应用首页顶部点击 Register，点击 Accept 接受条款与条件，以单选按钮选择 Passenger，填写注册资料后点击 Submit，再输入发送至注册邮箱的 6 位 OTP 并点击 Submit OTP 完成注册（随后注册邮箱会收到欢迎邮件）。已注册用户点击 Login（或直接点击各申报卡片，未登录时系统会弹出登录表单），接受条款后输入护照/政府证件号码、密码与验证码，点击 Login，再输入 6 位邮箱 OTP；登录后先回答筛查问卷，任一问答“是”即需填写申报单并于抵达时向红色通道柜台的海关官员报告。申报时依次进入 Baggage Declaration 标签页、选择 Baggage Declaration、在指引弹窗点击 OK，选择 Self 或 Family Member（从下拉列表选择已添加的家庭成员），逐项填写旅客/护照信息、联系方式及其他信息、行程信息、既往出口证明、物品/黄金/白银/外币、上传文件各栏目，最后点击 Submit 或 Save As Draft；提交成功后显示成功提示并跳转行李申报看板，申报在被核验前可查看、编辑或删除。
procedures.timing_en: CBD-I may be filed electronically three days before arrival; filed details may be updated until the date and time of arrival (regulation 3(4) and the Explanation).
procedures.timing_zh: CBD-I可在旅客抵达前三天电子申报；已申报内容可更新至抵达当日及时刻（第3(4)条及解释条款）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 隨身行李申報（CBD-I）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 2026年2月2日生效（第15/2026-Customs (N.T.)號通知，《2026年海關行李（申報及處理）規例》）。攜帶應稅或禁止物品的入境旅客須在進入綠通道前，通過自動化系統——ICEGATE門戶（www.icegate.gov.in）或網頁/移動應用“Atithi”——電子提交CBD-I；助理/副海關專員可在抵達時允許其他申報方式。CBD-I第16至18項（寵物、超限珠寶、含超過25,000盧比印度貨幣在內的列示管制物品）任何一項為Yes須走紅通道。CBD-I附表免稅額（僅為適用說明，不構成單獨程序）：居民、印度裔旅客及持非旅遊簽外國旅客經陸路以外方式入境75,000盧比；外國遊客25,000盧比；陸路入境無免稅額；出國滿一年者珠寶女性40克/其餘20克；酒2升；香菸100支或雪茄25支或菸絲125克；18歲以上旅客新筆電電腦1臺。 操作補充（依據 CBIC《Atithi 2.0 旅客用戶手冊》公佈的步驟，屬官方手冊流程，並非本次研究實際完成的註冊或提交）：新用戶在 Atithi 網頁/應用首頁頂部點擊 Register，點擊 Accept 接受條款與條件，以單選按鈕選擇 Passenger，填寫註冊資料後點擊 Submit，再輸入發送至註冊信箱的 6 位 OTP 並點擊 Submit OTP 完成註冊（隨後註冊信箱會收到歡迎郵件）。已註冊用戶點擊 Login（或直接點擊各申報卡片，未登入時系統會彈出登入表單），接受條款後輸入護照/政府證件號碼、密碼與驗證碼，點擊 Login，再輸入 6 位信箱 OTP；登入後先回答篩查問卷，任一問答“是”即需填寫申報單並於抵達時向紅色通道櫃檯的海關官員報告。申報時依次進入 Baggage Declaration 標籤頁、選擇 Baggage Declaration、在指引彈窗點擊 OK，選擇 Self 或 Family Member（從下拉列表選擇已添加的家庭成員），逐項填寫旅客/護照資訊、聯繫方式及其他資訊、行程資訊、既往出口證明、物品/黃金/白銀/外幣、上傳文件各欄目，最後點擊 Submit 或 Save As Draft；提交成功後顯示成功提示並跳轉行李申報看板，申報在被核驗前可查看、編輯或刪除。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: CBD-I可在旅客抵達前三天電子申報；已申報內容可更新至抵達當日及時刻（第3(4)條及解釋條款）。

procedures.name_en: Currency Declaration Form (CDF)
procedures.name_zh: 货币申报表（CDF）
procedures.agency: Government of India, Ministry of Finance / CBIC
procedures.applicability_en: India currency declaration and carriage permits: the Currency Declaration Form (CDF) is a stand-alone statutory form annexed to the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Currency) Regulations, 2015 (FEMA 6(R)/RB-2015, as amended in 2019 and 2020) and appended to the 2026 Customs Baggage Regulations; it is distinct from the ordinary electronic baggage declarations (CBD-I/CBD-II). A CDF must be filed on arrival only when the aggregate value of foreign exchange brought in as currency notes, bank notes or travellers cheques strictly exceeds USD 10,000 or its equivalent and/or the aggregate value of foreign currency notes strictly exceeds USD 5,000 or its equivalent; at or below both thresholds no CDF is required. Foreign exchange in any form may be brought into India freely and without limit, provided it is declared on the CDF on arrival to the Customs authorities when the thresholds are exceeded; taking foreign exchange out of India is prohibited unless it was obtained from an authorised dealer or money changer or is otherwise covered by general or special permission of the Reserve Bank of India (for example foreign exchange retained under the 2015 Possession and Retention Regulations). Non-residents may take out of India unspent foreign exchange up to the amount they originally brought in and, where required, declared on arrival. Indian rupee notes carry separate capped permissions: a person resident in India may take out of India (other than to Nepal or Bhutan), and bring back on return from a temporary visit (other than from Nepal or Bhutan), Government of India and RBI currency notes up to INR 25,000 per person; a person resident outside India who is not a citizen of Pakistan or Bangladesh may bring into or take out of India such notes up to INR 25,000 per person. Nepal and Bhutan exception: only Government of India and RBI notes of denominations not exceeding INR 100 generally move between India and Nepal or Bhutan, though an individual travelling from India to Nepal or Bhutan may carry Mahatma Gandhi (new) series INR 200 and/or INR 500 notes up to a total limit of INR 25,000, and Nepalese or Bhutanese currency notes may be taken out or brought in. The USD 10,000 and USD 5,000 figures are declaration triggers only, not carriage limits or licences: the authority to carry foreign exchange or rupee notes comes from the FEMA 2015 Regulations and RBI permissions, and any carriage outside those permissions (including rupee notes above INR 25,000, or foreign currency not obtained from an authorised person) requires prior general or special permission of the Reserve Bank. UI supplement (per the manual's published screen flow, not a filing completed in this research): inside the Atithi baggage declaration form, selecting the Currency checkbox makes an inline Currency Declaration section appear within the same CBD form; currency rows are added or deleted with the add/delete icons, the currency type is selected from the drop-down menu, the respective details are filled in, and the total is auto-calculated; the passenger then uses the same 'Save As Draft'/'Submit' buttons as the rest of the baggage declaration. Accordingly, the currency details are captured within the single Atithi baggage-declaration submission; this checkbox-expanded section within the CBD screen flow is not evidence of two independent online submissions.
procedures.applicability_zh: 印度货币申报与携带许可:货币申报表(Currency Declaration Form,CDF)是《外汇管理(货币输出入)条例2015》(FEMA 6(R)/RB-2015,经2019年及2020年修订)附件所载、并随2026年海关行李条例一并附上的独立法定表单,区别于普通电子行李申报(CBD-I/CBD-II)。仅在入境时携带的外汇(现钞纸币、银行票据或旅行支票)总额严格超过等值10,000美元,和/或外币现钞总额严格超过等值5,000美元时,才须提交CDF申报;两项均未超过门槛则无需申报。任何形式的外汇均可自由、无限额携入印度,但超过门槛者须于抵达时以CDF向海关申报;携出外汇原则上被禁止,除非该外汇系从授权交易商或货币兑换商取得,或另获印度储备银行(RBI)一般或特别许可(例如依2015年《持有与保留外汇条例》保留的外汇)。非居民携出印度未用外汇，以其原携入并（在需要时）于入境时申报的金额为限。印度卢比现钞另设限额许可:印度居民每人可携不超过25,000卢比的政府及印度储备银行纸币出境(赴尼泊尔、不丹除外),临时出国返回时亦可比照自境外携入(自尼泊尔、不丹入境除外);非巴基斯坦、孟加拉国公民且居住在印度境外的访印人士,每人可携入/携出不超过25,000卢比的上述纸币。尼泊尔与不丹例外:印度与尼泊尔、不丹之间一般仅限面额不超过100卢比的纸币流通,但个人自印度赴尼泊尔或不丹可携带圣雄甘地(新版)系列200卢比及/或500卢比纸币,总额不超过25,000卢比;尼泊尔、不丹货币可双向携带。10,000美元与5,000美元仅是申报触发线,不是携带额度或许可:外汇及卢比现钞的携带权来自FEMA 2015年条例及RBI许可,超出许可范围的携带(含卢比纸币超过25,000卢比,或非经授权人士取得的外币)须事先取得印度储备银行的一般或特别许可。 界面补充（依据手册公布的屏幕流程，并非本次实际提交）：在 Atithi 行李申报表内勾选 Currency 复选框后，会在同一份 CBD 表单内展开显示 Currency Declaration 栏目；通过增删图标添加或删除币种行，从下拉菜单选择货币类型并填写相应明细，总额自动计算，之后与行李申报其余内容共用同一组 Save As Draft/Submit 按钮。因此外币申报内容是在 Atithi 行李申报的一次在线提交中一并采集的；该“在 CBD 表单内勾选展开栏目”的界面流程不能证明存在两次相互独立的在线提交。
procedures.timing_en: Declare currency on arrival; retain the certified CDF for unused-currency departure checks.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时申报货币；保留经签认CDF用于离境携出未用外汇。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 貨幣申報表（CDF）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 印度貨幣申報與攜帶許可:貨幣申報表(Currency Declaration Form,CDF)是《外匯管理(貨幣輸出入)條例2015》(FEMA 6(R)/RB-2015,經2019年及2020年修訂)附件所載、並隨2026年海關行李條例一併附上的獨立法定表單,區別於普通電子行李申報(CBD-I/CBD-II)。僅在入境時攜帶的外匯(現鈔紙幣、銀行票據或旅行支票)總額嚴格超過等值10,000美元,和/或外幣現鈔總額嚴格超過等值5,000美元時,才須提交CDF申報;兩項均未超過門檻則無需申報。任何形式的外匯均可自由、無限額攜入印度,但超過門檻者須於抵達時以CDF向海關申報;攜出外匯原則上被禁止,除非該外匯系從授權交易商或貨幣兌換商取得,或另獲印度儲備銀行(RBI)一般或特別許可(例如依2015年《持有與保留外匯條例》保留的外匯)。非居民攜出印度未用外匯，以其原攜入並（在需要時）於入境時申報的金額為限。印度盧比現鈔另設限額許可:印度居民每人可攜不超過25,000盧比的政府及印度儲備銀行紙幣出境(赴尼泊爾、不丹除外),臨時出國返回時亦可比照自境外攜入(自尼泊爾、不丹入境除外);非巴基斯坦、孟加拉國公民且居住在印度境外的訪印人士,每人可攜入/攜出不超過25,000盧比的上述紙幣。尼泊爾與不丹例外:印度與尼泊爾、不丹之間一般僅限面額不超過100盧比的紙幣流通,但個人自印度赴尼泊爾或不丹可攜帶聖雄甘地(新版)系列200盧比及/或500盧比紙幣,總額不超過25,000盧比;尼泊爾、不丹貨幣可雙向攜帶。10,000美元與5,000美元僅是申報觸發線,不是攜帶額度或許可:外匯及盧比現鈔的攜帶權來自FEMA 2015年條例及RBI許可,超出許可範圍的攜帶(含盧比紙幣超過25,000盧比,或非經授權人士取得的外幣)須事先取得印度儲備銀行的一般或特別許可。 界面補充（依據手冊公佈的屏幕流程，並非本次實際提交）：在 Atithi 行李申報表內勾選 Currency 複選框後，會在同一份 CBD 表單內展開顯示 Currency Declaration 欄目；通過增刪圖標添加或刪除幣種行，從下拉菜單選擇貨幣類型並填寫相應明細，總額自動計算，之後與行李申報其餘內容共用同一組 Save As Draft/Submit 按鈕。因此外幣申報內容是在 Atithi 行李申報的一次線上提交中一併採集的；該“在 CBD 表單內勾選展開欄目”的界面流程不能證明存在兩次相互獨立的線上提交。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時申報貨幣；保留經籤認CDF用於離境攜出未用外匯。

procedures.name_en: Unaccompanied baggage declaration (CBD-II)
procedures.name_zh: 分离运输行李申报（CBD-II）
procedures.agency: Government of India, Ministry of Finance / CBIC
procedures.applicability_en: Unaccompanied baggage containing dutiable personal effects for satisfying daily necessities of life must be declared electronically in CBD-II with supporting documents (regulation 3(2)); the Assistant/Deputy Commissioner may allow another manner where no electronic declaration was made. A declaration may be filed for unaccompanied baggage by an authorised person; for a passenger under eighteen only a family member or legal guardian may file, or the passenger personally if travelling alone (regulation 8). Channel supplement: the February 2026 CBIC Guide for International Travellers — which itself states it carries no legal authority and that only notifications in the Gazette of India are legally binding — states in its CBD forms table (p. 46) that four CBD forms are handled on the ATITHI App/web portal while CBD-II (unaccompanied baggage) is handled on ICEGATE, and describes the 'automated system' as the portal at https://www.icegate.gov.in or the Atithi mobile/web application; the Atithi passenger manual likewise does not list CBD-II among the app's filing facilities. The reviewed official documents include no step-by-step ICEGATE CBD-II screens, so no ICEGATE registration or submission steps are asserted here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 含应税个人日用品的分离运输行李须随支持文件以CBD-II电子申报（第3(2)条）；未电子申报时助理/副海关专员可允许其他方式。分离运输行李可由旅客授权他人申报；未满十八岁旅客仅可由家庭成员或法定监护人申报，独自旅行时可由本人申报（第8条）。 渠道补充：CBIC 2026 年 2 月版《国际旅客指南》（其自述不具法律效力，仅印度政府公报发布的通知具有法律约束力）在 CBD 表单一览表（第 46 页）中载明，四种 CBD 表单由 ATITHI 应用/网页门户办理，而 CBD-II（非随身行李申报）由 ICEGATE 办理，并将“自动化系统”描述为 https://www.icegate.gov.in 门户或 Atithi 移动/网页应用；Atithi 旅客手册的服务清单中亦未列入 CBD-II。所查阅的官方文件未包含 ICEGATE 端 CBD-II 的分步操作界面，故此处不陈述任何 ICEGATE 注册或提交步骤。
procedures.timing_en: May be filed electronically three days before arrival of the baggage (regulation 3(4)).
procedures.timing_zh: 可在行李抵达前三天电子申报（第3(4)条）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 分離運輸行李申報（CBD-II）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 含應稅個人日用品的分離運輸行李須隨支持文件以CBD-II電子申報（第3(2)條）；未電子申報時助理/副海關專員可允許其他方式。分離運輸行李可由旅客授權他人申報；未滿十八歲旅客僅可由家庭成員或法定監護人申報，獨自旅行時可由本人申報（第8條）。 渠道補充：CBIC 2026 年 2 月版《國際旅客指南》（其自述不具法律效力，僅印度政府公報發佈的通知具有法律約束力）在 CBD 表單一覽表（第 46 頁）中載明，四種 CBD 表單由 ATITHI 應用/網頁門戶辦理，而 CBD-II（非隨身行李申報）由 ICEGATE 辦理，並將“自動化系統”描述為 https://www.icegate.gov.in 門戶或 Atithi 移動/網頁應用；Atithi 旅客手冊的服務清單中亦未列入 CBD-II。所查閱的官方文件未包含 ICEGATE 端 CBD-II 的分步操作界面，故此處不陳述任何 ICEGATE 註冊或提交步驟。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 可在行李抵達前三天電子申報（第3(4)條）。

procedures.name_en: Export certificate for personal effects taken abroad (CBD-III)
procedures.name_zh: 携出个人物品出口证明（CBD-III）
procedures.agency: Government of India, Ministry of Finance / CBIC
procedures.applicability_en: Passengers taking out of India articles of personal effects (other than used personal effects for daily necessities) who intend duty-free clearance on return must declare such articles in advance before departure from India (regulation 4(1)). The CBD-III export certificate is issued on submission and is valid until the passenger's first arrival back in India or six months, whichever is earlier (regulations 4(2)-(3)). Channel supplement: per the same non-binding CBIC guide's CBD forms table, CBD-III (Export Certificate, filed by the departing passenger) and CBD-IV (Temporary Baggage Import Certificate, arriving tourist) are handled on the ATITHI App/web portal; the Atithi 2.0 manual's service list likewise includes 'Export Certificate (CBD-III)' and 'Temporary Baggage Import Certificate (CBD-IV)', so passengers reach these certificates through the same Atithi register/login/OTP flow described for the baggage declaration. This reflects the officially published guide and manual only, not a submission completed in this research.
procedures.applicability_zh: 携带个人物品（日用旧私人物品除外）出境、拟在返程时免税通关的旅客，须在离印前事先申报（第4(1)条）。提交后签发CBD-III出口证明，有效期至旅客首次返印或六个月，以先到者为准（第4(2)-(3)条）。 渠道补充：据同一不具法律效力的 CBIC 指南 CBD 表单一览表，CBD-III（出口证明，由离境旅客填报）与 CBD-IV（临时行李进口证明，入境游客）均在 ATITHI 应用/网页门户办理；Atithi 2.0 手册的服务清单亦列入 Export Certificate (CBD-III) 与 Temporary Baggage Import Certificate (CBD-IV)，即旅客通过与前述行李申报相同的 Atithi 注册/登录/OTP 流程进入这两项服务。以上仅为官方公布的指南与手册所述流程，并非本次研究实际完成的提交。
procedures.timing_en: Declare in advance before departure from India; certificate number and date generated on submission.
procedures.timing_zh: 离印前事先申报；提交后生成证明编号及日期。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 攜出個人物品出口證明（CBD-III）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 攜帶個人物品（日用舊私人物品除外）出境、擬在返程時免稅通關的旅客，須在離印前事先申報（第4(1)條）。提交後簽發CBD-III出口證明，有效期至旅客首次返印或六個月，以先到者為準（第4(2)-(3)條）。 渠道補充：據同一不具法律效力的 CBIC 指南 CBD 表單一覽表，CBD-III（出口證明，由離境旅客填報）與 CBD-IV（臨時行李進口證明，入境遊客）均在 ATITHI 應用/網頁門戶辦理；Atithi 2.0 手冊的服務清單亦列入 Export Certificate (CBD-III) 與 Temporary Baggage Import Certificate (CBD-IV)，即旅客通過與前述行李申報相同的 Atithi 註冊/登入/OTP 流程進入這兩項服務。以上僅為官方公佈的指南與手冊所述流程，並非本次研究實際完成的提交。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 離印前事先申報；提交後生成證明編號及日期。

procedures.name_en: Temporary baggage import certificate for tourists (CBD-IV)
procedures.name_zh: 游客临时进口行李证明（CBD-IV）
procedures.agency: Government of India, Ministry of Finance / CBIC
procedures.applicability_en: Tourists carrying articles of personal effects (other than used personal effects for daily necessities) for their stay in India, intending duty-free temporary import subject to re-export until their first departure or within six months, shall declare such articles at arrival (regulation 4(4)). The CBD-IV temporary baggage import certificate may be issued and must be produced with the articles before Customs at departure (regulation 4(5)). Channel supplement: per the same non-binding CBIC guide's CBD forms table, CBD-III (Export Certificate, filed by the departing passenger) and CBD-IV (Temporary Baggage Import Certificate, arriving tourist) are handled on the ATITHI App/web portal; the Atithi 2.0 manual's service list likewise includes 'Export Certificate (CBD-III)' and 'Temporary Baggage Import Certificate (CBD-IV)', so passengers reach these certificates through the same Atithi register/login/OTP flow described for the baggage declaration. This reflects the officially published guide and manual only, not a submission completed in this research.
procedures.applicability_zh: 携带个人物品（日用旧私人物品除外）供在印停留期间使用、拟临时免税入境并复运出境（至首次离印或六个月内，以先到者为准）的游客，应在抵达时申报（第4(4)条）。可签发CBD-IV临时进口行李证明，离境时须随物品一并提交海关（第4(5)条）。 渠道补充：据同一不具法律效力的 CBIC 指南 CBD 表单一览表，CBD-III（出口证明，由离境旅客填报）与 CBD-IV（临时行李进口证明，入境游客）均在 ATITHI 应用/网页门户办理；Atithi 2.0 手册的服务清单亦列入 Export Certificate (CBD-III) 与 Temporary Baggage Import Certificate (CBD-IV)，即旅客通过与前述行李申报相同的 Atithi 注册/登录/OTP 流程进入这两项服务。以上仅为官方公布的指南与手册所述流程，并非本次研究实际完成的提交。
procedures.timing_en: Declare at arrival; produce the certificate with the articles before Customs at departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时申报；离境时凭证明随物品提交海关。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 遊客臨時進口行李證明（CBD-IV）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 攜帶個人物品（日用舊私人物品除外）供在印停留期間使用、擬臨時免稅入境並復運出境（至首次離印或六個月內，以先到者為準）的遊客，應在抵達時申報（第4(4)條）。可簽發CBD-IV臨時進口行李證明，離境時須隨物品一併提交海關（第4(5)條）。 渠道補充：據同一不具法律效力的 CBIC 指南 CBD 表單一覽表，CBD-III（出口證明，由離境旅客填報）與 CBD-IV（臨時行李進口證明，入境遊客）均在 ATITHI 應用/網頁門戶辦理；Atithi 2.0 手冊的服務清單亦列入 Export Certificate (CBD-III) 與 Temporary Baggage Import Certificate (CBD-IV)，即旅客通過與前述行李申報相同的 Atithi 註冊/登入/OTP 流程進入這兩項服務。以上僅為官方公佈的指南與手冊所述流程，並非本次研究實際完成的提交。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時申報；離境時憑證明隨物品提交海關。

procedures.name_en: Currency and monetary instrument declaration
procedures.name_zh: 货币及货币工具申报
procedures.agency: Maldives Civil Aviation Authority
procedures.applicability_en: AT01/2024 clauses 3.1.7 and 3.2.5 require passengers/crew at international airports entering or departing Maldives to declare currency and monetary instruments valued at USD10,000 equivalent or more in any currency. The circular offers online submission through the Maldives Customs cash-declaration website. This is distinct from the MVR10,000 goods allowance.
procedures.applicability_zh: AT01/2024第3.1.7和3.2.5条要求经国际机场进出马尔代夫的旅客及机组，申报价值等于或超过1万美元的任何币种货币及货币工具。通告提供马尔代夫海关现金申报网站在线提交途径。该门槛不同于物品的10,000马尔代夫拉菲亚额度。
procedures.timing_en: On international-airport arrival or departure.
procedures.timing_zh: 经国际机场入境或出境时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 貨幣及貨幣工具申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: AT01/2024第3.1.7和3.2.5條要求經國際機場進出馬爾代夫的旅客及機組，申報價值等於或超過1萬美元的任何幣種貨幣及貨幣工具。通告提供馬爾代夫海關現金申報網站線上提交途徑。該門檻不同於物品的10,000馬爾代夫拉菲亞額度。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 經國際機場入境或出境時。

procedures.name_en: Restricted and prohibited baggage at international airports
procedures.name_zh: 国际机场行李限制及禁止物品
procedures.agency: Maldives Civil Aviation Authority
procedures.applicability_en: AT01/2024 distinguishes goods requiring a permit/licence (including alcohol, pork products, dogs, listed wildlife and weapons) from totally prohibited goods (including vapes/e-cigarette devices, narcotics, pornographic material, worship idols and pigs). Baggage remains subject to customs examination; personal-use goods up to MVR10,000 FOB may be released duty free under clause 3.1.6. No exemption from other restrictions follows from this allowance.
procedures.applicability_zh: AT01/2024区分须许可或执照的物品（包括酒类、猪肉制品、犬只、列示野生动植物及武器）与完全禁止物品（包括电子烟及设备、毒品、色情材料、崇拜用偶像及活猪）。行李仍受海关查验；第3.1.6条说明自用物品FOB价值不超过10,000拉菲亚可免税放行，该额度不豁免其他限制。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival customs.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达海关时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 國際機場行李限制及禁止物品
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: AT01/2024區分須許可或執照的物品（包括酒類、豬肉製品、犬隻、列示野生動植物及武器）與完全禁止物品（包括電子煙及設備、毒品、色情材料、崇拜用偶像及活豬）。行李仍受海關查驗；第3.1.6條說明自用物品FOB價值不超過10,000拉菲亞可免稅放行，該額度不豁免其他限制。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達海關時。
