procedures.name_en: Written declaration of currency values of EUR 10,000 or more (or equivalent) — Law No. 62/2008 Art. 33 / Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova
procedures.name_zh: 货币价值书面申报（1万欧元或等值及以上）——第62/2008号法第33条/摩尔多瓦海关署
procedures.agency: Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova (Serviciul Vamal al Republicii Moldova)
procedures.applicability_en: Natural persons, residents and non-residents of Moldova; BOTH directions — bringing into or taking out of Moldova. Written declaration to the customs authorities is OBLIGATORY when the total, per person per trip, of (a) cash in national currency plus foreign-currency cash and traveller's cheques, or (b) securities and payment instruments other than foreign-currency traveller's cheques, is EUR 10,000 (or equivalent) or more (Law No. 62/2008 on currency regulation, Art. 33(1), as amended by Law No. 124 of 29.05.2025, in force 12.07.2025). Below EUR 10,000 per person/trip, written declaration is a right, not a duty (Art. 33(2)). Per the Customs Service standing page: the mandatory case is handled on the 'Declarația valorilor valutare' form (Customs Service Order No. 516-O of 07.12.2023), the optional case on the traveller's customs declaration (Order No. 482-O/2023); the currency-values declaration covers the values regardless of who owns them, once the total starts from EUR 10,000 (or equivalent) per person/trip. The traveller informs the customs officer of the intent to declare and the officer provides the form (Romanian or English, completed manually in block capitals). The red channel must be used when carrying currency, goods or other values that must be declared; the green channel only when carrying nothing declarable. Cash in national or foreign currency and foreign-currency traveller's cheques may NOT be brought in/taken out in unaccompanied baggage. Age condition for declaration: not stated (unknown). Fee: not stated (unknown).
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于摩尔多瓦居民与非居民自然人；方向为双向——带入或带出摩尔多瓦。按《第62/2008号外汇调节法》第33条第(1)款（经2025年5月29日第124号法修订，2025年7月12日生效）：每人每次旅行，(a)本国货币现金及外币现金与旅行支票，或(b)有价证券及支付工具（外币旅行支票除外），总值达10,000欧元（或等值）及以上时，必须向海关书面申报；低于10,000欧元时，书面申报是权利而非义务（第(2)款）。据海关署常设页：强制情形使用《货币价值申报单》（海关署2023年12月7日第516-O号令），自愿情形使用《旅客海关申报单》（第482-O/2023号令）；货币价值申报单不论价值归属何人，总值自10,000欧元（或等值）/人/次起即适用。旅客须告知海关关员申报意向，由其提供表格（罗马尼亚语或英语，用深色笔以大写字母手工填写）。携带须申报的货币、物品或其他价值必须走红色通道，确无申报物方可走绿色通道。本外币现金及外币旅行支票不得放入非随身（分离）行李进出摩尔多瓦。申报的年龄条件未载明（unknown）；费用未载明（unknown）。
procedures.timing_en: At the moment of crossing the state border, in either direction (entry into or exit from Moldova): the completed and signed currency-values declaration, with the transported currency values, is presented for customs control at the customs post through which the person enters or leaves the country, after informing the customs officer, who provides the form.
procedures.timing_zh: 跨越国境之时（入境或出境双向）：填妥并签名的《货币价值申报单》连同所携货币价值，在其入/出境的海关哨所交验；须先告知海关关员申报意向，由其提供表格。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 貨幣價值書面申報（1萬歐元或等值及以上）——第62/2008號法第33條/摩爾多瓦海關署
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於摩爾多瓦居民與非居民自然人；方向為雙向——帶入或帶出摩爾多瓦。按《第62/2008號外匯調節法》第33條第(1)款（經2025年5月29日第124號法修訂，2025年7月12日生效）：每人每次旅行，(a)本國貨幣現金及外幣現金與旅行支票，或(b)有價證券及支付工具（外幣旅行支票除外），總值達10,000歐元（或等值）及以上時，必須向海關書面申報；低於10,000歐元時，書面申報是權利而非義務（第(2)款）。據海關署常設頁：強制情形使用《貨幣價值申報單》（海關署2023年12月7日第516-O號令），自願情形使用《旅客海關申報單》（第482-O/2023號令）；貨幣價值申報單不論價值歸屬何人，總值自10,000歐元（或等值）/人/次起即適用。旅客須告知海關關員申報意向，由其提供表格（羅馬尼亞語或英語，用深色筆以大寫字母手工填寫）。攜帶須申報的貨幣、物品或其他價值必須走紅色通道，確無申報物方可走綠色通道。本外幣現金及外幣旅行支票不得放入非隨身（分離）行李進出摩爾多瓦。申報的年齡條件未載明（unknown）；費用未載明（unknown）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 跨越國境之時（入境或出境雙向）：填妥並簽名的《貨幣價值申報單》連同所攜貨幣價值，在其入/出境的海關哨所交驗；須先告知海關關員申報意向，由其提供表格。

procedures.name_en: Traveller's customs declaration for personal-baggage goods, with duty-free import allowances — Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova
procedures.name_zh: 旅客个人行李物品海关申报及进口免税额——摩尔多瓦海关署
procedures.agency: Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova (Serviciul Vamal al Republicii Moldova)
procedures.applicability_en: Natural persons (travellers) carrying goods in personal baggage, on entry, exit or transit of the Moldovan customs border: the traveller's customs declaration (form approved by Customs Service Order No. 482-O/2023) declares the goods in personal baggage. The written form is deposited for: commercial-character goods in personal baggage not exceeding EUR 1,000 or 1,000 kg net; goods whose cross-border transport is authorized by other control authorities; personal baggage under Customs Code art. 225; at the traveller's request; at the customs officer's requirement; and may be used for voluntary declaration of currency values below EUR 10,000. Goods may also be declared verbally, or via the green channel / 'nothing to declare' (or through a post without a two-channel system, without a self-initiated declaration) — BUT written declaration is mandatory in all cases for: arms, ammunition, explosive and radioactive materials; live animals; wild flora/fauna species, parts and derived products; movable cultural goods; prescription medicines; foodstuffs exceeding the Annex 5 quantities to Government Decision No. 938/2018; household-utility goods (appliances etc.); other goods at the traveller's choice or the officer's request. Duty-free import allowance (goods brought INTO Moldova in personal baggage, non-commercial purposes): intrinsic value not exceeding EUR 300 per person by land transport, or EUR 430 per person for air and maritime travellers; tobacco products (200 cigarettes; 200 heated-tobacco refills; 50 cigars; 50 cigarillos; 250 g smoking tobacco); fuel in the vehicle's standard tank; alcoholic beverages (1 L of spirits over 22% vol or undenatured ethyl alcohol of 80% vol and over, or 2 L of alcohol up to 22% vol, any combination not exceeding 100% of the individual permitted quantities, plus 2 L still wine and 5 L beer). Export: natural persons may export goods of any value if non-commercial, subject to the formalities of Government Decision No. 92/2023 (pct. 281, 286, 289); export declarations may be verbal for non-commercial goods, commercial goods up to EUR 1,000 or 1,000 kg, transport means registered on the customs territory for re-import plus their spare parts/accessories, and animal-accompanying fodder. Age or frequency conditions for the allowances: not stated (unknown). Fee: not stated (unknown).
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于以个人行李携运物品的自然人（旅客），方向为入境、出境或过境摩尔多瓦海关边界：填写《旅客海关申报单》（海关署第482-O/2023号令批准的表格），申报个人行李中的物品。书面提交情形：个人行李中价值不超过1,000欧元或净重1,000公斤的商业性质货物；跨境运输须经其他监管机关批准的物品；海关法典第225条所指个人行李；应旅客本人要求；应海关关员要求；亦可用于1万欧元以下货币价值的自愿申报。物品也可口头申报，或经绿色通道/'无申报'通过（或在未设双通道系统的哨所直接通过而无须自行申报）——但下列物品任何情形均须书面申报：武器、弹药、爆炸及放射性物质；活动物；野生动植物物种及其部分或衍生制品；可移动文物；凭处方发放的药品；超过第938/2018号政府决定附件5所定数量的食品；家庭日用物品（家电等）；旅客自选或应海关关员要求的其他物品。进口免税额（以个人行李带入摩尔多瓦、非商业用途）：陆路运输每人内在价值不超过300欧元，乘空运或海运旅客每人不超过430欧元；烟草制品（香烟200支；加热烟草装置烟弹200个；雪茄50支；小雪茄50支；吸烟用烟丝250克）；交通工具标准油箱内的燃料；酒精饮料（浓度超过22%的酒精饮料或80%及以上浓度未变性乙醇合计1升，或浓度不超过22%的酒精饮料合计2升，可任意组合但各单项允许量使用百分比之和不超过100%，另加静置葡萄酒2升、啤酒5升）。出口：自然人可出口任何价值的非商业性质物品，须办理第92/2023号政府决定（第281、286、289点）规定的手续；非商业性质货物、价值不超过1,000欧元或1,000公斤的商业性质货物、在关境内登记用于复进口的交通工具及其零配件、随动物出口的饲料，可口头申报出口。免税额的年龄或频次条件未载明（unknown）；费用未载明（unknown）。
procedures.timing_en: When crossing the Moldovan customs border on entry, exit or transit; the duty-free import allowances apply at the moment of bringing goods into Moldova in personal baggage.
procedures.timing_zh: 跨越摩尔多瓦海关边界入境、出境或过境之时；进口免税额适用于以个人行李将物品带入摩尔多瓦之时。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客個人行李物品海關申報及進口免稅額——摩爾多瓦海關署
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於以個人行李攜運物品的自然人（旅客），方向為入境、出境或過境摩爾多瓦海關邊界：填寫《旅客海關申報單》（海關署第482-O/2023號令批准的表格），申報個人行李中的物品。書面提交情形：個人行李中價值不超過1,000歐元或淨重1,000公斤的商業性質貨物；跨境運輸須經其他監管機關批准的物品；海關法典第225條所指個人行李；應旅客本人要求；應海關關員要求；亦可用於1萬歐元以下貨幣價值的自願申報。物品也可口頭申報，或經綠色通道/'無申報'通過（或在未設雙通道系統的哨所直接通過而無須自行申報）——但下列物品任何情形均須書面申報：武器、彈藥、爆炸及放射性物質；活動物；野生動植物物種及其部分或衍生製品；可移動文物；憑處方發放的藥品；超過第938/2018號政府決定附件5所定數量的食品；家庭日用物品（家電等）；旅客自選或應海關關員要求的其他物品。進口免稅額（以個人行李帶入摩爾多瓦、非商業用途）：陸路運輸每人內在價值不超過300歐元，乘空運或海運旅客每人不超過430歐元；菸草製品（香菸200支；加熱菸草裝置煙彈200個；雪茄50支；小雪茄50支；吸菸用菸絲250克）；交通工具標準油箱內的燃料；酒精飲料（濃度超過22%的酒精飲料或80%及以上濃度未變性乙醇合計1升，或濃度不超過22%的酒精飲料合計2升，可任意組合但各單項允許量使用百分比之和不超過100%，另加靜置葡萄酒2升、啤酒5升）。出口：自然人可出口任何價值的非商業性質物品，須辦理第92/2023號政府決定（第281、286、289點）規定的手續；非商業性質貨物、價值不超過1,000歐元或1,000公斤的商業性質貨物、在關境內登記用於復進口的交通工具及其零配件、隨動物出口的飼料，可口頭申報出口。免稅額的年齡或頻次條件未載明（unknown）；費用未載明（unknown）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 跨越摩爾多瓦海關邊界入境、出境或過境之時；進口免稅額適用於以個人行李將物品帶入摩爾多瓦之時。

procedures.name_en: EU external-border cash declaration when entering or leaving the EU via Romania
procedures.name_zh: 欧盟外部边境现金申报（经罗马尼亚出入欧盟）
procedures.agency: Autoritatea Vamală Română (AVR) — Romanian customs authority, the Member State competent authority under Regulation (EU) 2018/1672
procedures.applicability_en: Natural persons (carriers) entering or leaving the European Union via Romania — i.e. crossing the EU external border — carrying cash of a value of EUR 10 000 or more, on their person, in their luggage or in their means of transport, must declare it to the Romanian customs authorities (the competent authorities of the Member State through which they are entering or leaving the Union) and make it available for control. Current legal basis: Regulation (EU) 2018/1672, applicable from 3 June 2021, which repealed Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005 (Article 20); the previous affirmative citations of Reg (CE) 1889/2005, HG 707/2006 and ANAF Order 2028/2012 as current law have been removed — the Romanian instruments are not verified as current. Under Article 2 of the Regulation, 'cash' means: (i) currency (banknotes and coins in circulation as a medium of exchange, including out-of-circulation banknotes and coins that can still be exchanged at financial institutions or central banks); (ii) bearer-negotiable instruments (traveller's cheques, and cheques, promissory notes or money orders in bearer or equivalent form — instruments claimable upon presentation without having to prove identity or entitlement); (iii) commodities used as highly-liquid stores of value as listed in Annex I (per the Commission's current page: gold coins with at least 90% gold content, and gold bars, nuggets or clumps with at least 99.5% gold content); and (iv) prepaid cards as defined in point 2 of Annex I (non-nominal cards that store or provide access to funds not linked to a bank account) — not all payment cards. The threshold is value-based, so cash denominated in other currencies counts at equivalent value; ordinary registered (non-bearer) shares or bonds are not, as such, within this legal definition of 'cash' — the Commission page's shorthand mention of 'bonds, shares' is not carried over. The EUR 10 000 threshold applies per person — for a group, to each person individually. All EU countries use the harmonised EU Cash Declaration Form (templates in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776), to be completed in a language available in the country of entry or exit. A declaration with incorrect or incomplete information, or cash not made available for control, does not fulfil the obligation; penalties are set at national level ('effective, proportionate and dissuasive') and undeclared cash may be detained. Scope limits: this is the EU external-border rule only — any additional Romanian national rules on cash carried between EU countries or within Romania are outside these EU rules and remain unverified; Romania-specific submission channels, form availability and penalty details are likewise unverified (customs.ro returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenges on 2026-09-27). The channel value 'conditional' states only the threshold trigger — the declaration duty arises solely when a carrier enters or leaves the EU via Romania carrying cash of a value of EUR 10 000 or more (Article 3(1)) — and is not a claim that any particular Romanian submission medium (paper form at the border, electronic channel, or both) has been verified as available. Unaccompanied cash sent by post, freight or courier falls under a separate disclosure-on-request regime (Article 4), not this procedure.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自然人（携运人）经罗马尼亚出入欧盟——即跨越欧盟外部边境——随身、行李或所乘交通工具中携带价值 1 万欧元（EUR 10 000，含本数）或以上现金的，须向罗马尼亚海关（即其进入或离开联盟所经成员国的主管机关）申报并交由查验。现行法源：Regulation (EU) 2018/1672，自 2021-06-03 起适用，其 Article 20 已废止 Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005；原正文中将 Reg (CE) 1889/2005、HG 707/2006、ANAF Order 2028/2012 作为现行法源的肯定句已删除——上述罗马尼亚本国实施令未核实为现行。按该条例 Article 2，「现金」指：（一）通货——流通中作为交换媒介的钞币，含已退出流通但仍可在金融机构或中央银行兑换者；（二）不记名可转让票据——旅行支票，以及不记名或同等形式的支票、本票、汇票（出示票据即可索取款项，无须证明持有人身份或权利）；（三）附录 I 所列高流动性价值储藏商品——据欧盟委员会现行页：含金量至少 90% 的金币，含金量至少 99.5% 的金条、天然金块或金块；（四）附录 I 第 2 点定义的预付卡——不记名、存储或提供未关联银行账户之资金的卡，并非所有支付卡。门槛按价值计算，其他币种现金按等值折算计入；普通记名（非不记名）股票或债券本身不在该法定「现金」定义之内——欧委会页顺带提到的「债券、股票」措辞不再照搬。EUR 10 000 门槛按人计算，团体出行对每人单独适用。各成员国统一使用欧盟现金申报表（模板见 Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776），以入/出境成员国提供的语言填写。信息不实、不全或未交验现金均不视为履行申报义务；处罚由成员国本国规定（须「有效、相称、具威慑力」），未申报现金可被扣留。范围限定：以上仅为欧盟外部边境规则——罗马尼亚是否另有关于成员国之间或境内携币的国家规定，不属该欧盟规则涵盖、未核实；罗国实际提交渠道、表格可得性与罚则细则亦未核实（customs.ro 2026-09-27 为 HTTP 403 Cloudflare 挑战，不可读）。channel 取值 conditional 仅陈述门槛触发——仅当携运人经罗马尼亚进入或离开欧盟且携带现金价值达 EUR 10 000（含本数）或以上时，申报义务才发生（Article 3(1)）——不表示罗国任何具体提交载体（边境纸质表、电子渠道或两者兼有）已经核实可用。邮件/货运/快递寄送的不随行现金适用另行的应要求披露制度（Article 4），不属本程序。
procedures.timing_en: At the EU external border when entering or leaving through Romania, declare the cash to the competent authorities and make it available for control. Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 Article 3(3) permits the declaration details in writing or electronically. The submission medium currently available at Romanian crossings remains unverified.
procedures.timing_zh: 经罗马尼亚跨越欧盟外部边境入境或出境时，向主管机关申报并交验现金。欧盟第2018/1672号条例第3(3)条允许以书面或电子方式提供申报明细；罗马尼亚各口岸当前实际可用的提交载体仍未核实。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 歐盟外部邊境現金申報（經羅馬尼亞出入歐盟）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自然人（攜運人）經羅馬尼亞出入歐盟——即跨越歐盟外部邊境——隨身、行李或所乘交通工具中攜帶價值 1 萬歐元（EUR 10 000，含本數）或以上現金的，須向羅馬尼亞海關（即其進入或離開聯盟所經成員國的主管機關）申報並交由查驗。現行法源：Regulation (EU) 2018/1672，自 2021-06-03 起適用，其 Article 20 已廢止 Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005；原正文中將 Reg (CE) 1889/2005、HG 707/2006、ANAF Order 2028/2012 作為現行法源的肯定句已刪除——上述羅馬尼亞本國實施令未核實為現行。按該條例 Article 2，「現金」指：（一）通貨——流通中作為交換媒介的鈔幣，含已退出流通但仍可在金融機構或中央銀行兌換者；（二）不記名可轉讓票據——旅行支票，以及不記名或同等形式的支票、本票、匯票（出示票據即可索取款項，無須證明持有人身份或權利）；（三）附錄 I 所列高流動性價值儲藏商品——據歐盟委員會現行頁：含金量至少 90% 的金幣，含金量至少 99.5% 的金條、天然金塊或金塊；（四）附錄 I 第 2 點定義的預付卡——不記名、儲存或提供未關聯銀行賬戶之資金的卡，並非所有支付卡。門檻按價值計算，其他幣種現金按等值折算計入；普通記名（非不記名）股票或債券本身不在該法定「現金」定義之內——歐委會頁順帶提到的「債券、股票」措辭不再照搬。EUR 10 000 門檻按人計算，團體出行對每人單獨適用。各成員國統一使用歐盟現金申報表（模板見 Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776），以入/出境成員國提供的語言填寫。資訊不實、不全或未交驗現金均不視為履行申報義務；處罰由成員國本國規定（須「有效、相稱、具威懾力」），未申報現金可被扣留。範圍限定：以上僅為歐盟外部邊境規則——羅馬尼亞是否另有關於成員國之間或境內攜幣的國家規定，不屬該歐盟規則涵蓋、未核實；羅國實際提交渠道、表格可得性與罰則細則亦未核實（customs.ro 2026-09-27 為 HTTP 403 Cloudflare 挑戰，不可讀）。channel 取值 conditional 僅陳述門檻觸發——僅當攜運人經羅馬尼亞進入或離開歐盟且攜帶現金價值達 EUR 10 000（含本數）或以上時，申報義務才發生（Article 3(1)）——不表示羅國任何具體提交載體（邊境紙質表、電子渠道或兩者兼有）已經核實可用。郵件/貨運/快遞寄送的不隨行現金適用另行的應要求披露制度（Article 4），不屬本程序。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 經羅馬尼亞跨越歐盟外部邊境入境或出境時，向主管機關申報並交驗現金。歐盟第2018/1672號條例第3(3)條允許以書面或電子方式提供申報明細；羅馬尼亞各口岸當前實際可用的提交載體仍未核實。

procedures.name_en: Written declaration of cash of EUR 10,000 or more carried by travellers (Formulár 1a)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客携带1万欧元及以上现金的书面申报（Formulár 1a）
procedures.agency: Finančná správa SR (Financial Administration of the Slovak Republic) — competent border customs offices (hraničné colné úrady)
procedures.applicability_en: Every natural person carrying cash means of at least EUR 10,000 (or the equivalent in another currency) — the page stresses that cash is not only currency — when entering or leaving the Union; the Financial Administration's traveller-cash section is headed 'Dovoz, vývoz a tranzit' (import, export, transit), but the operative duties are anchored to entering/leaving the Union (EU external frontier) and to the border customs office, as follows. National duty: under § 4(2) of the Customs Act (Law No. 199/2004 Z. z., Colný zákon), such person must declare the fact in writing, without being asked (bez vyzvania), to the competent border customs office on the prescribed form — Formulár 1a 'Oznámenie peňažných prostriedkov v hotovosti' (notification of cash carried with the traveller). EU dimension: under Article 3(1) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 on controls on cash entering or leaving the Union (repealing Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005), carriers carrying cash of EUR 10,000 or more must declare it to the competent authorities of the Member State through which they enter or leave the Union and make it available for inspection; under Article 2(1)(h) a 'carrier' is any natural person entering or leaving the Union with cash on their person, in their luggage or in their means of transport. Two boundaries, two comparison operators (Financial Administration's current cash FAQ, 'travelling to Turkey with EUR 30,000' answer): (i) EU external border — persons leaving or entering the Union carrying cash 's hodnotou 10 000 EUR alebo viac' (EUR 10,000 or more; >=, EUR 10,000 itself included) must declare it unprompted to the competent authority of the Member State through which they leave or enter the Union and make it available for inspection, the multilingual notification template standing in Part 1 of Annex I to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776; (ii) Slovakia's border with another EU Member State — an armed Financial Administration officer (ozbrojený príslušník finančnej správy) may require a person who is immediately crossing the state border of the Slovak Republic from or to another Member State, or a person from whom it is clear from all the circumstances that they intend to cross it, to state whether they carry cash 'v sume presahujúcej 10 000 EUR' (strictly exceeding EUR 10,000; >) — a duty to answer when asked under § 48a of Law No. 35/2019 Z. z. on the Financial Administration; the FAQ prescribes no separate proactive written form for this intra-EU situation and none is inferred here, so no separate procedure is created for it (the FAQ adds that some Member States extend cash controls to intra-EU movements and recommends checking with those States' authorities). Formulár 2a 'Hlásenie o peňažných prostriedkoch v hotovosti (bez sprievodu)' — unaccompanied cash sent e.g. by post, freight or courier — is a separate procedure and is excluded. Sanction: failure to declare accompanied cash constitutes a customs misdemeanour (colný priestupok) for natural persons within § 72(1)(n) of the Customs Act (Law No. 199/2004 Z. z.); the traveller-cash section itself states no fine amount for this breach, and no cash-specific or current fixed penalty figure is verified here — the concrete fine is unverified (fee = unknown).
procedures.applicability_zh: 携带现金支付手段最低 1 万欧元（含本数；或等值外币；页面提示现金不只是货币）的自然人，于进出联盟时适用；财政管理局旅客现金小节标题为“Dovoz, vývoz a tranzit（进口、出口、过境）”，但实体义务锚定于进出联盟（欧盟外边界）与边境海关，具体如下。本国义务：依《海关法》（第 199/2004 Z. z. 号法律，Colný zákon）第 4 条第 2 款，须“未经催告即以书面”（bez vyzvania písomne）向主管边境海关（príslušný hraničný colný úrad）按规定表格申报，即 Formulár 1a《现金通知书》（Oznámenie peňažných prostriedkov v hotovosti，随旅行人携带的现金）。欧盟层面：依 (EU) 2018/1672 号条例（进出联盟现金管制，废止 (EC) 1889/2005）第 3 条第 1 款，携带 1 万欧元及以上现金的运输人须向其进入或离开联盟所经成员国的主管机关申报并供查验；该条例第 2 条第 1 款 h) 项界定“运输人”为随身、行李或交通工具中携带现金进出联盟的任何自然人。两套边界、两种比较符（财政管理局现行现金 FAQ“带 3 万欧元赴土耳其”答复）：（一）欧盟外部边界——离开或进入联盟时携带“s hodnotou 10 000 EUR alebo viac”（1 万欧元或以上，≥，含 1 万欧元本数）现金者，须主动向其离盟/入盟所经成员国主管机关申报并供查验，多语种通知书模板载于 (EU) 2021/776 号执行条例附件 I 第 1 部分；（二）斯洛伐克与另一欧盟成员国的边界——武装财政管理局人员（ozbrojený príslušník finančnej správy）可要求正即时从另一成员国领土进入或离开斯洛伐克国境之人、或依全部情况明显意图跨境之人，说明其是否携带“v sume presahujúcej 10 000 EUR”（严格超过 1 万欧元，＞）的现金——此系第 35/2019 Z. z. 号《财政管理局法》第 48a 条的应要求告知义务；FAQ 未对该欧盟内部情形另设主动书面表格，本文亦不作此推断，故不为此另建程序（FAQ 另提示部分成员国将现金管制扩展至欧盟内部移动，建议向相关成员国主管机关了解）。Formulár 2a《非随行现金申报》（bez sprievodu，如经邮寄、货运、快递寄送）属另一程序，已排除。罚则：不申报随身现金构成海关违规（colný priestupok，自然人），见《海关法》（第 199/2004 Z. z. 号法律）第 72 条第 1 款 n) 项；旅客现金小节本身未列该违规的罚款数额，亦未核实到现金专属或现行定额——具体罚款未核实（fee = unknown）。
procedures.timing_en: EU external border, unprompted: entering or leaving the Union carrying EUR 10,000 or more in cash (>=, EUR 10,000 itself included) → submit completed Formulár 1a in writing to the competent border customs office and make the cash available for inspection; the form (.docx) is downloadable from the same page, which also carries information/infographic PDFs and Russian- and Hungarian-language versions of the cash declaration, and the FAQ locates the multilingual notification template in Part 1 of Annex I to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776. Slovakia's border with another EU Member State: no unprompted formality — where an armed Financial Administration officer calls on a person who is immediately crossing that border, or from whom it is clear from all the circumstances that they intend to cross it, the person states on request whether they carry strictly more than EUR 10,000 (>) in cash (§ 48a of Law No. 35/2019 Z. z.).
procedures.timing_zh: 欧盟外部边界主动办理：进出联盟携带 1 万欧元及以上（≥，含本数）现金时，填写 Formulár 1a 书面向主管边境海关申报并供查验；表格（.docx）可在同页下载，页面另附说明/信息图 PDF 及俄语、匈牙利语版现金申报文件，FAQ 并指明多语种通知书模板载于 (EU) 2021/776 号执行条例附件 I 第 1 部分。斯洛伐克与另一欧盟成员国的边界：无主动手续——武装财政管理局人员对正即时跨境、或依全部情况明显意图跨境之人查问是否携带严格超过（＞）1 万欧元现金时，应要求说明即可（第 35/2019 Z. z. 号法律第 48a 条）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客攜帶1萬歐元及以上現金的書面申報（Formulár 1a）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 攜帶現金支付手段最低 1 萬歐元（含本數；或等值外幣；頁面提示現金不只是貨幣）的自然人，於進出聯盟時適用；財政管理局旅客現金小節標題為“Dovoz, vývoz a tranzit（進口、出口、過境）”，但實體義務錨定於進出聯盟（歐盟外邊界）與邊境海關，具體如下。本國義務：依《海關法》（第 199/2004 Z. z. 號法律，Colný zákon）第 4 條第 2 款，須“未經催告即以書面”（bez vyzvania písomne）向主管邊境海關（príslušný hraničný colný úrad）按規定表格申報，即 Formulár 1a《現金通知書》（Oznámenie peňažných prostriedkov v hotovosti，隨旅行人攜帶的現金）。歐盟層面：依 (EU) 2018/1672 號條例（進出聯盟現金管制，廢止 (EC) 1889/2005）第 3 條第 1 款，攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上現金的運輸人須向其進入或離開聯盟所經成員國的主管機關申報並供查驗；該條例第 2 條第 1 款 h) 項界定“運輸人”為隨身、行李或交通工具中攜帶現金進出聯盟的任何自然人。兩套邊界、兩種比較符（財政管理局現行現金 FAQ“帶 3 萬歐元赴土耳其”答覆）：（一）歐盟外部邊界——離開或進入聯盟時攜帶“s hodnotou 10 000 EUR alebo viac”（1 萬歐元或以上，≥，含 1 萬歐元本數）現金者，須主動向其離盟/入盟所經成員國主管機關申報並供查驗，多語種通知書模板載於 (EU) 2021/776 號執行條例附件 I 第 1 部分；（二）斯洛伐克與另一歐盟成員國的邊界——武裝財政管理局人員（ozbrojený príslušník finančnej správy）可要求正即時從另一成員國領土進入或離開斯洛伐克國境之人、或依全部情況明顯意圖跨境之人，說明其是否攜帶“v sume presahujúcej 10 000 EUR”（嚴格超過 1 萬歐元，＞）的現金——此係第 35/2019 Z. z. 號《財政管理局法》第 48a 條的應要求告知義務；FAQ 未對該歐盟內部情形另設主動書面表格，本文亦不作此推斷，故不為此另建程序（FAQ 另提示部分成員國將現金管制擴展至歐盟內部移動，建議向相關成員國主管機關了解）。Formulár 2a《非隨行現金申報》（bez sprievodu，如經郵寄、貨運、快遞寄送）屬另一程序，已排除。罰則：不申報隨身現金構成海關違規（colný priestupok，自然人），見《海關法》（第 199/2004 Z. z. 號法律）第 72 條第 1 款 n) 項；旅客現金小節本身未列該違規的罰款數額，亦未核實到現金專屬或現行定額——具體罰款未核實（fee = unknown）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 歐盟外部邊界主動辦理：進出聯盟攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上（≥，含本數）現金時，填寫 Formulár 1a 書面向主管邊境海關申報並供查驗；表格（.docx）可在同頁下載，頁面另附說明/資訊圖 PDF 及俄語、匈牙利語版現金申報文件，FAQ 並指明多語種通知書模板載於 (EU) 2021/776 號執行條例附件 I 第 1 部分。斯洛伐克與另一歐盟成員國的邊界：無主動手續——武裝財政管理局人員對正即時跨境、或依全部情況明顯意圖跨境之人查問是否攜帶嚴格超過（＞）1 萬歐元現金時，應要求說明即可（第 35/2019 Z. z. 號法律第 48a 條）。

procedures.name_en: Presentation and declaration of goods in travellers' baggage (oral, paper or red/green-channel act)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客行李商品的呈报与申报（口头、纸质或红绿通道行为）
procedures.agency: Financial Directorate of the Slovak Republic — Finančná správa (border customs offices)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: goods carried in travellers' personal baggage into the Union customs territory. Presentation: such goods must be presented to the border customs office at the place where the traveller enters the Union customs territory; a customs declaration is then filed orally, in writing (paper) or by another act. Traveller acts verified on the page: (1) oral customs declaration under Article 135(1)(a) of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/2446 — non-commercial goods only, for release into free circulation and not subject to prohibitions or restrictions; oral declaration is also available for commercial goods carried in personal baggage if the value does not exceed EUR 1,000 or the net mass 1,000 kg; (2) paper import declaration — exceptionally allowed for travellers (otherwise only in a declared 'emergency state', e.g. unavailability of the electronic systems); (3) declaration by another act at border crossings operating the two-channel system (road, airport): joining the red lane declares goods for clearance, walking the green lane declares nothing to clear; where no two-channel system exists, a 'nič na preclenie' sticker (nothing to declare) or a customs declaration affixed to the windscreen substitutes. The standard electronic declaration via cep.financnasprava.sk requires an eID card and qualified electronic signature and is not the traveller path. Postal consignments (Slovenská pošta), courier services and the e-commerce portal for low-value consignments (≤ EUR 150) are separate channels and are excluded here. Relief thresholds (conditional evidence — goods beyond them are taxed/cleared): VAT exemption under § 48a of Law No. 222/2004 Z. z. for non-commercial imports in travellers' baggage from third countries where the value does not exceed EUR 300 per person by non-air transport, EUR 430 per person by air, or EUR 150 per person younger than 15 regardless of transport mode; tobacco per person by air 200 cigarettes / 100 cigarillos / 50 cigars / 250 g smoking tobacco (excise section adds 10 consumer packages of smokeless tobacco), other modes 40 / 20 / 10 / 50 g (2 packages smokeless), proportional combinations up to 100 %; alcohol per person 1 L over 22 % vol. or 2 L at 22 % vol. and below, plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer (the excise subsection additionally covers 2 L sparkling wine/fermented/intermediate products); quantities above the limits are taxed on the excess, and packaged spirits/tobacco need Slovak control stamps for release into free circulation; excise relief for tobacco and alcohol requires import by a person older than 17, while the VAT baggage exemptions do not apply to a traveller younger than 17; customs-duty relief for baggage goods applies where the goods are VAT-exempt (Council Regulation (EC) No 1186/2009 framework); fuel relief covers the standard tank plus a portable tank of up to 10 L. Cash carried in baggage is a separate written declaration — see sk-cash-declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：以随身行李运入欧盟关境的商品。呈报：须在进入欧盟关境之地向边境海关（pohraničný colný úrad）呈报商品，随后以口头、书面（纸质）或其他行为申报。本页核实的旅客申报动作：(1) 口头海关申报——依 (EU) 2015/2446 号授权条例第 135 条第 1 款 a) 项，仅限非商用商品投自由流通且不涉禁限；随行李携带的商用商品价值不超过 1,000 欧元或净重不超过 1,000 公斤时亦可口头申报；(2) 纸质进口报关单——例外允许旅客使用（其余仅在“紧急状态”如电子系统不可用时）；(3) 其他行为申报——在实行双通道的边境口岸（公路、机场）：走红道即申报有需清关商品，走绿道即申报无申报物；无双通道系统时以粘贴“nič na preclenie（无申报物）”标签或将报关单贴于前挡风玻璃替代。标准电子报关经 cep.financnasprava.sk，需电子身份证件及合格电子签名，非旅客路径。邮寄（Slovenská pošta）、快递及低值货物电商门户申报（≤150 欧元）为另行渠道，本条已排除。免税额度（条件证据，超出即征税/清关）：依第 222/2004 Z. z. 号法律第 48a 条，自第三国随身行李非商用进口价值不超过——非空运每人 300 欧元、空运每人 430 欧元、不满 15 岁者每人 150 欧元（不限交通方式）；烟草每人空运 200 支香烟/100 支小雪茄/50 支雪茄/250 克吸烟烟丝（消费税段另含 10 包无烟烟草制品），非空运 40/20/10/50 克（2 包无烟制品），可按比例组合至 100%；酒精每人 >22% vol. 1 升或 ≤22% vol. 2 升，另加静止葡萄酒 4 升、啤酒 16 升（消费税段另含起泡酒/发酵饮/中间产品 2 升）；超限部分就超出量征税，预包装烈酒/烟草须加贴斯洛伐克税标方可投放自由流通；烟草与酒精的消费税免征须由年满 17 岁以上（staršou ako 17 rokov，即严格大于 17 岁）之人进口，而 VAT 行李免税对不满 17 岁（mladšia ako 17 rokov）之旅客不适用；行李商品关税免征以其免征 VAT 为前提（(EC) 1186/2009 号理事会条例框架）；燃料免征涵盖标准油箱及不超过 10 升便携油箱。行李中现金为另行的书面申报事项，见 sk-cash-declaration。
procedures.timing_en: At the point of entering the Union customs territory: present baggage goods to the border customs office and declare there — red lane (or green lane if nothing to declare), orally or on paper; where relief does not apply, the goods are cleared under the legislation in force. The English /en/pages/for-travellers path returned 404 in the 2026-09-10 check; the current official pages are Slovak under /sk/obcania/clo/ (re-captured live 2026-09-27, HTTP 200).
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入欧盟关境之地：向边境海关呈报行李商品并就地申报——走红道（无可申报物则走绿道）、口头或纸质申报；不适用免税时按现行法律清关。英文 /en/pages/for-travellers 路径在 2026-09-10 检查时已 404；现行官方页面为斯洛伐克语 /sk/obcania/clo/（2026-09-27 重新直取，HTTP 200）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客行李商品的呈報與申報（口頭、紙質或紅綠通道行為）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：以隨身行李運入歐盟關境的商品。呈報：須在進入歐盟關境之地向邊境海關（pohraničný colný úrad）呈報商品，隨後以口頭、書面（紙質）或其他行為申報。本頁核實的旅客申報動作：(1) 口頭海關申報——依 (EU) 2015/2446 號授權條例第 135 條第 1 款 a) 項，僅限非商用商品投自由流通且不涉禁限；隨行李攜帶的商用商品價值不超過 1,000 歐元或淨重不超過 1,000 公斤時亦可口頭申報；(2) 紙質進口報關單——例外允許旅客使用（其餘僅在“緊急狀態”如電子系統不可用時）；(3) 其他行為申報——在實行雙通道的邊境口岸（公路、機場）：走紅道即申報有需清關商品，走綠道即申報無申報物；無雙通道系統時以貼上“nič na preclenie（無申報物）”標籤或將報關單貼於前擋風玻璃替代。標準電子報關經 cep.financnasprava.sk，需電子身份證件及合格電子簽名，非旅客路徑。郵寄（Slovenská pošta）、快遞及低值貨物電商門戶申報（≤150 歐元）為另行渠道，本條已排除。免稅額度（條件證據，超出即徵稅/清關）：依第 222/2004 Z. z. 號法律第 48a 條，自第三國隨身行李非商用進口價值不超過——非空運每人 300 歐元、空運每人 430 歐元、不滿 15 歲者每人 150 歐元（不限交通方式）；菸草每人空運 200 支香菸/100 支小雪茄/50 支雪茄/250 克吸菸菸絲（消費稅段另含 10 包無煙菸草製品），非空運 40/20/10/50 克（2 包無煙製品），可按比例組合至 100%；酒精每人 >22% vol. 1 升或 ≤22% vol. 2 升，另加靜止葡萄酒 4 升、啤酒 16 升（消費稅段另含起泡酒/發酵飲/中間產品 2 升）；超限部分就超出量徵稅，預包裝烈酒/菸草須加貼斯洛伐克稅標方可投放自由流通；菸草與酒精的消費稅免徵須由年滿 17 歲以上（staršou ako 17 rokov，即嚴格大於 17 歲）之人進口，而 VAT 行李免稅對不滿 17 歲（mladšia ako 17 rokov）之旅客不適用；行李商品關稅免徵以其免徵 VAT 為前提（(EC) 1186/2009 號理事會條例框架）；燃料免徵涵蓋標準油箱及不超過 10 升便攜油箱。行李中現金為另行的書面申報事項，見 sk-cash-declaration。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入歐盟關境之地：向邊境海關呈報行李商品並就地申報——走紅道（無可申報物則走綠道）、口頭或紙質申報；不適用免稅時按現行法律清關。英文 /en/pages/for-travellers 路徑在 2026-09-10 檢查時已 404；現行官方頁面為斯洛伐克語 /sk/obcania/clo/（2026-09-27 重新直取，HTTP 200）。

procedures.name_en: Passenger green/red corridor customs declaration — goods, cash and norms (State Customs Service of Ukraine)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客绿/红通道海关申报——物品、现金与限额（乌克兰国家海关署）
procedures.agency: State Customs Service of Ukraine (Державна митна служба України)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering or leaving Ukraine. Per the State Customs Service (SCS) guidance page "Як проходить 'червоний' коридор" captured 2026-09-26: the green corridor is a simplified customs control channel where the traveller does not declare goods, and starting to cross the customs zone through the green corridor counts as the traveller's tacit confirmation that nothing prohibited or declarable is carried; passing customs control through the green corridor releases the citizen from filling a customs declaration. Green-corridor limits as stated by the SCS: personal items (two mobile phones, one video camera, one still camera, two portable personal computers, sports equipment, used personal jewellery and clothing, 500 ml of toilet water or 100 ml of perfume); goods with total value not exceeding EUR 1,000 for air crossings and EUR 500/50 kg for other checkpoints; cash in Ukrainian or foreign currency strictly below EUR 10,000 equivalent per person (narrowed; see cash statement at the end of this entry); alcohol — spirits 1 litre, wine 2 litres, beer 5 litres; tobacco — 200 cigarettes or 50 cigars or 250 g of tobacco (or 250 g combined); food for own consumption up to EUR 200 (per-manufacturer-packaged: one package or max 2 kg per item name; unpackaged: up to 2 kg per item; indivisible ready product: 1 piece per item); medicines up to 5 packages per item name per person (excluding narcotics/psychotropics, unless per a certified prescription). These green-corridor norms apply once per 24 hours. The red corridor requires a written customs declaration of the property carried (with receipts, labels and other documents; absent documents, customs values the goods by identical/similar prices); red-corridor goods include goods requiring permits, cultural values, securities and bank metals, medicines containing narcotics/psychotropics or precursors, other goods defined by Ukrainian laws, goods over EUR 1,000 (air) / EUR 500-50 kg (other checkpoints) imported more than once within one day, cash in Ukrainian or foreign currency strictly above EUR 10,000 equivalent per person, and pet animals with original international veterinary certificates; exceeding the norms also triggers tax payment. The SCS travellers hub page (same capture) maintains separate entry ('В'їзд в Україну') and exit ('Виїзд з України') guidance sections, links the customs declaration forms (including the passenger declaration) and cites the underlying legislation — Customs Code of Ukraine (No. 4495-VI), Law of Ukraine No. 2473-VIII 'On Currency and Currency Operations', CMU resolutions No. 450 (2012), No. 203 (2019), No. 434 (2012), No. 458 (2012), and NBU Board resolutions No. 3 (2019) and No. 5 (2019). The corridor page is service guidance restating the norms; it contains typographical artifacts in the source text (e.g. 'спожива ння', 'к рім') reproduced faithfully in the evidence file. Cash threshold is narrowed to what this record asserts: cash in Ukrainian or foreign currency strictly below EUR 10,000 equivalent per person — no mandatory written declaration (confirmed); strictly above EUR 10,000 equivalent per person — written declaration in full required (confirmed); exactly EUR 10,000 equivalent per person — this record confirms neither green-corridor passage without written declaration nor red-corridor written-declaration duty (narrow unresolved UA-cash-exact-eur10000-conflict; the underlying textual conflict is documented only in that unresolved note and the audit report, not in this procedure).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进出乌克兰的旅客。据乌克兰国家海关署（ДМС）指引页《如何通过“红色”通道》（2026-09-26 取得）：“绿色”通道为简化海关监管通道，旅客不申报所携物品；开始经绿色通道穿越海关区即视为旅客以默示方式确认未携带禁止或须申报物品；经绿色通道过关免填海关申报单。绿色通道限额（据海关署）：个人物品（两部手机、一台摄像机、一台照相机、两台便携式电脑、运动器材、已使用的个人饰品和衣物、500 毫升淡香水或 100 毫升香水）；物品总值航空口岸不超 1,000 欧元、其他口岸不超 500 欧元/50 公斤；乌克兰或外国现金货币严格低于每人 10,000 欧元等值（收窄，见本条末尾现金收窄段）；酒类——烈酒 1 升、葡萄酒 2 升、啤酒 5 升；烟草——200 支卷烟或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟草（或合计 250 克）；自用食品不超 200 欧元（厂商零售包装：每种一件包装或每种不超 2 公斤；无包装：每种不超 2 公斤；不可分即食产品：每种 1 件）；药品每人每种不超 5 包装（含麻醉/精神药物成分者除外，须凭经盖章处方的除外）。绿色通道限额每 24 小时适用一次。“红色”通道须书面申报所携财产（须出示发票、标签等凭证；无凭证时海关按相同或类似商品价格估价）；红色通道物品包括：须许可文件方可放行的物品、文化珍品、有价证券与银行贵金属、含麻醉/精神药物或前体的药品、乌克兰法律规定的其他物品、一日内多次入境且总值超 1,000 欧元（航空）/500 欧元-50 公斤（其他口岸）的物品、严格高于每人 10,000 欧元等值的乌克兰或外国现金货币、以及持有原产国国际兽医证书的家养宠物；超限额还须缴税。海关署旅客信息枢纽页（同日取得）分设入境/出境指引栏目，链接海关申报表（含旅客申报单），并列明依据立法——《乌克兰海关法典》（第 4495-VI 号）、《乌克兰货币与货币业务法》（第 2473-VIII 号）、部长会议第 450(2012)、203(2019)、434(2012)、458(2012) 号决议及国家银行董事会第 3(2019)、5(2019) 号决议。指引页为海关署对限额的转述文本，原文含排版笔误（如“спожива ння”“к рім”），证据文件按原样保留。现金限额收窄为本记录所断言的范围：严格低于每人 10,000 欧元等值的乌克兰或外国现金——无强制书面申报（已确认）；严格高于每人 10,000 欧元等值——须全额书面申报（已确认）；恰为每人 10,000 欧元等值——本记录既不确认可免书面申报走绿道，也不确认须走红道书面申报（窄未决 UA-cash-exact-eur10000-conflict，相关文字冲突仅记载于该未决条目与审计报告，不写入本程序）。
procedures.timing_en: At entry into and exit from Ukraine: use the green corridor (no declaration) within the stated norms, which apply once per 24 hours — for cash, 'within the stated norms' is asserted by this record only as strictly below EUR 10,000 equivalent per person, the sole cash branch confirmed as requiring no written declaration; file a written customs declaration through the red corridor when carrying declarable property, including cash strictly above EUR 10,000 equivalent per person (declared in full). At exactly EUR 10,000 equivalent per person, neither green-corridor exemption nor red-corridor written-declaration duty is confirmed (unresolved UA-cash-exact-eur10000-conflict); it is deliberately not stated as certainly exempt nor certainly declarable.
procedures.timing_zh: 进出乌克兰时：限额内走绿色通道（免申报），限额每 24 小时一次——就现金而言，“限额内”仅由本记录断言为严格低于每人 10,000 欧元等值，仅此分支确认免书面申报；携带须申报财产（包括严格高于每人 10,000 欧元等值的现金，须全额申报）时经红色通道书面申报。恰为每人 10,000 欧元等值时，走绿道免申报与走红道须书面申报均不确认（未决 UA-cash-exact-eur10000-conflict），刻意不写为确定可免或确定必报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客綠/紅通道海關申報——物品、現金與限額（烏克蘭國家海關署）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進出烏克蘭的旅客。據烏克蘭國家海關署（ДМС）指引頁《如何通過“紅色”通道》（2026-09-26 取得）：“綠色”通道為簡化海關監管通道，旅客不申報所攜物品；開始經綠色通道穿越海關區即視為旅客以默示方式確認未攜帶禁止或須申報物品；經綠色通道過關免填海關申報單。綠色通道限額（據海關署）：個人物品（兩部手機、一臺攝像機、一臺照相機、兩臺便攜式電腦、運動器材、已使用的個人飾品和衣物、500 毫升淡香水或 100 毫升香水）；物品總值航空口岸不超 1,000 歐元、其他口岸不超 500 歐元/50 公斤；烏克蘭或外國現金貨幣嚴格低於每人 10,000 歐元等值（收窄，見本條末尾現金收窄段）；酒類——烈酒 1 升、葡萄酒 2 升、啤酒 5 升；菸草——200 支捲菸或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸草（或合計 250 克）；自用食品不超 200 歐元（廠商零售包裝：每種一件包裝或每種不超 2 公斤；無包裝：每種不超 2 公斤；不可分即食產品：每種 1 件）；藥品每人每種不超 5 包裝（含麻醉/精神藥物成分者除外，須憑經蓋章處方的除外）。綠色通道限額每 24 小時適用一次。“紅色”通道須書面申報所攜財產（須出示發票、標籤等憑證；無憑證時海關按相同或類似商品價格估價）；紅色通道物品包括：須許可文件方可放行的物品、文化珍品、有價證券與銀行貴金屬、含麻醉/精神藥物或前體的藥品、烏克蘭法律規定的其他物品、一日內多次入境且總值超 1,000 歐元（航空）/500 歐元-50 公斤（其他口岸）的物品、嚴格高於每人 10,000 歐元等值的烏克蘭或外國現金貨幣、以及持有原產國國際獸醫證書的家養寵物；超限額還須繳稅。海關署旅客資訊樞紐頁（同日取得）分設入境/出境指引欄目，連結海關申報表（含旅客申報單），並列明依據立法——《烏克蘭海關法典》（第 4495-VI 號）、《烏克蘭貨幣與貨幣業務法》（第 2473-VIII 號）、部長會議第 450(2012)、203(2019)、434(2012)、458(2012) 號決議及國家銀行董事會第 3(2019)、5(2019) 號決議。指引頁為海關署對限額的轉述文本，原文含排版筆誤（如“спожива ння”“к рім”），證據文件按原樣保留。現金限額收窄為本記錄所斷言的範圍：嚴格低於每人 10,000 歐元等值的烏克蘭或外國現金——無強制書面申報（已確認）；嚴格高於每人 10,000 歐元等值——須全額書面申報（已確認）；恰為每人 10,000 歐元等值——本記錄既不確認可免書面申報走綠道，也不確認須走紅道書面申報（窄未決 UA-cash-exact-eur10000-conflict，相關文字衝突僅記載於該未決條目與審計報告，不寫入本程序）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進出烏克蘭時：限額內走綠色通道（免申報），限額每 24 小時一次——就現金而言，“限額內”僅由本記錄斷言為嚴格低於每人 10,000 歐元等值，僅此分支確認免書面申報；攜帶須申報財產（包括嚴格高於每人 10,000 歐元等值的現金，須全額申報）時經紅色通道書面申報。恰為每人 10,000 歐元等值時，走綠道免申報與走紅道須書面申報均不確認（未決 UA-cash-exact-eur10000-conflict），刻意不寫為確定可免或確定必報。

procedures.name_en: Red-lane customs declaration on arrival from outside the EU (goods value thresholds; alcohol and tobacco quantity limits)
procedures.name_zh: 自非欧盟国家入境丹麦的红通道海关申报（商品货值限额；烟酒数量额度）
procedures.agency: Toldstyrelsen (Danish Customs Agency)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering Denmark from a country outside the EU (per the captured page, the Faroe Islands, Greenland, the Canary Islands, the Åland Islands, the French overseas departments and territories, and the northern part of Cyprus are not regarded as EU countries). Per the Toldstyrelsen page 'Travelling outside the EU' captured live from toldst.dk on 2026-09-27 (HTTP 200): you must pay customs duties, VAT and excise duties if you have bought goods for a value of more than DKK 3,250 (arrival by plane or ship) or DKK 2,250 (arrival by other means of transport); you may be asked to show receipts, so keep them. An item exceeding the threshold is dutiable even when it consists of multiple parts functioning together (e.g. a camera and a lens); the liability cannot be avoided by bringing the parts separately or letting several persons bring different parts in. Special quantity limits apply to alcohol and tobacco, and alcohol and tobacco do not count towards the DKK 3,250/2,250 goods threshold (page example: arriving by plane with 1 litre of whisky priced DKK 1,500, you may also bring other goods worth DKK 3,250 duty-free within the limits). You must be 17 years old to bring alcohol and tobacco into Denmark. Tobacco quantity (alternatives as listed): 200 cigarettes, or 100 cigarillos (max. 3 g each), or 50 cigars, or 250 g of smoking tobacco. Alcohol quantity: 1 litre of spirits (above 22% alcohol and beverages to which alcohol has been added), or 2 litres of fortified wine (22% alcohol or less, e.g. Port, Sherry and Madeira, as well as sparkling wine such as Champagne), and 4 litres of table wine (e.g. red, white and rosé wine and cider-based wine), and 16 litres of beer (and beer-based cider). Motor fuel: 10 litres in spare cans in addition to the vehicle's normal tank. If you bought goods outside the EU and have a flight layover in an EU country, the outside-EU rules still apply. The rules only apply to goods physically brought with you, not to goods sent by mail (the online-shopping rules apply instead). Violations are fined — as a general rule at two times the duties payable (for goods such as tobacco, spirits, gold and silverware and jewellery the fine equals twice the duties; for clothing, electronics, bags and sportswear it equals once the duties), in addition to the duties; a page example prices 400 excess cigarettes at DKK 1,208 total via the red lane versus DKK 3,608 via the green lane including a DKK 2,400 fine.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自非欧盟国家入境丹麦的旅客（据所抓取页面，法罗群岛、格陵兰、加那利群岛、奥兰群岛、法国海外省与领地、塞浦路斯北部不视为欧盟国家）。据 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的 Toldstyrelsen 页面《Travelling outside the EU》：购货价值超过 DKK 3,250（乘飞机或船舶入境）或 DKK 2,250（其他交通方式入境）即须缴纳关税、增值税与消费税；海关可能要求出示收据，应予留存。超限物品即使由多个协同部件组成（如相机与镜头）也须整体计税，不能拆分携带或由多人分携规避。烟酒另设数量限额，且不计入 DKK 3,250/2,250 货值限额（页面示例：乘飞机携 1 升价 DKK 1,500 的威士忌，仍可另带价值 DKK 3,250 的其他货物免税入境）。携酒精和烟草入境丹麦须年满 17 岁。烟草数量（页面所列择一）：卷烟 200 支，或小雪茄（每支不超 3 克）100 支，或雪茄 50 支，或吸用烟草 250 克。酒精数量：烈酒（酒精含量高于 22% 及添加酒精的饮料）1 升，或强化酒（酒精含量不超 22%，如波特、雪莉、马德拉，以及香槟等起泡酒）2 升，并且餐酒（如红、白、桃红葡萄酒及苹果酒基酒）4 升，并且啤酒（及啤酒基苹果酒）16 升。机动车燃料：除车辆正常油箱外可另携 10 升备用罐装燃油。在非欧盟国家购物后经欧盟国家中转返回的，仍适用非欧盟规则。本规则仅适用于随身携带的货物，邮寄不适用（另适用欧盟外网购规则）。违规将被罚款，一般规则为应缴税款的两倍（烟草、烈酒、金银器与珠宝类罚款为两倍，服装、电子产品、箱包与运动服装类为一倍），税款另缴；页面示例：400 支超额卷烟走红道合计 DKK 1,208，走绿道含 DKK 2,400 罚款合计 DKK 3,608。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Denmark (by plane, at some points of entry): select the green exit if you carry no goods on which you have to pay customs duty, VAT and excise duties; if you carry such goods — or are in doubt about whether you comply — go through the red exit and declare to the Danish Customs Agency; if there is no red exit, contact the airport's customs clearance office instead.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达丹麦时（乘飞机入境于部分入境点）：无应缴关税、增值税与消费税物品者走绿色出口；携带此类物品或对是否符合规则有疑问者，走红色出口向丹麦海关署申报；如无红色出口，改联系机场清关办公室。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自非歐盟國家入境丹麥的紅通道海關申報（商品貨值限額；菸酒數量額度）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自非歐盟國家入境丹麥的旅客（據所抓取頁面，法羅群島、格陵蘭、加那利群島、奧蘭群島、法國海外省與領地、塞浦路斯北部不視為歐盟國家）。據 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的 Toldstyrelsen 頁面《Travelling outside the EU》：購貨價值超過 DKK 3,250（乘飛機或船舶入境）或 DKK 2,250（其他交通方式入境）即須繳納關稅、增值稅與消費稅；海關可能要求出示收據，應予留存。超限物品即使由多個協同部件組成（如相機與鏡頭）也須整體計稅，不能拆分攜帶或由多人分攜規避。菸酒另設數量限額，且不計入 DKK 3,250/2,250 貨值限額（頁面示例：乘飛機攜 1 升價 DKK 1,500 的威士忌，仍可另帶價值 DKK 3,250 的其他貨物免稅入境）。攜酒精和菸草入境丹麥須年滿 17 歲。菸草數量（頁面所列擇一）：捲菸 200 支，或小雪茄（每支不超 3 克）100 支，或雪茄 50 支，或吸用菸草 250 克。酒精數量：烈酒（酒精含量高於 22% 及添加酒精的飲料）1 升，或強化酒（酒精含量不超 22%，如波特、雪莉、馬德拉，以及香檳等起泡酒）2 升，並且餐酒（如紅、白、桃紅葡萄酒及蘋果酒基酒）4 升，並且啤酒（及啤酒基蘋果酒）16 升。機動車燃料：除車輛正常油箱外可另攜 10 升備用罐裝燃油。在非歐盟國家購物後經歐盟國家中轉返回的，仍適用非歐盟規則。本規則僅適用於隨身攜帶的貨物，郵寄不適用（另適用歐盟外網購規則）。違規將被罰款，一般規則為應繳稅款的兩倍（菸草、烈酒、金銀器與珠寶類罰款為兩倍，服裝、電子產品、箱包與運動服裝類為一倍），稅款另繳；頁面示例：400 支超額捲菸走紅道合計 DKK 1,208，走綠道含 DKK 2,400 罰款合計 DKK 3,608。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達丹麥時（乘飛機入境於部分入境點）：無應繳關稅、增值稅與消費稅物品者走綠色出口；攜帶此類物品或對是否符合規則有疑問者，走紅色出口向丹麥海關署申報；如無紅色出口，改聯繫機場清關辦公室。

procedures.name_en: Entry from another EU country: own-personal-use allowances and green/red exit (alcohol and tobacco quantity limits; 18+ and 16–17 rules)
procedures.name_zh: 自其他欧盟国家入境：自用限额与绿/红通道（烟酒数量限额；18 岁及以上与 16–17 岁规则）
procedures.agency: Toldstyrelsen (Danish Customs Agency)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering Denmark from another EU country. The non-EU-route DKK 3,250/2,250 goods value thresholds do not apply on this route; instead, per the Toldstyrelsen page 'Travelling within the EU' captured live from toldst.dk on 2026-09-27 (HTTP 200), goods may be brought in free of customs duties, VAT and excise duties only if they are for your own personal use — meaning that only you, persons in your household or your private guests use the goods. Selling the goods (e.g. in your local sports club or at work) or bringing in goods for other persons who are not travelling with you is not own personal use and requires payment of excise duties (and possibly a deposit for certain types of packaging). Quantity limits for alcohol and tobacco. When you are 18 years old: cigarettes 800 pcs; cigarillos (max. 3 g each) 400 pcs; cigars 200 pcs; smoking tobacco 1 kg; spirits (above 22% alcohol and beverages to which alcohol has been added) 10 litres; fortified wine (22% alcohol or less, e.g. Port, Sherry and Madeira) 20 litres; table wine (e.g. red, white and rosé wine and cider-based wine) 90 litres, of which maximum 60 litres of sparkling wine such as champagne; beer (and beer-based cider) 110 litres. If you are 16 or 17 years old: you are not allowed to bring tobacco into Denmark from another EU country; you are allowed to bring beer and wine of a strength of up to and including 16.4% — the page lists table wine 90 litres (of which maximum 60 litres sparkling) and beer 110 litres — while anything stronger is fortified wine or spirits, which you may not bring into Denmark if you are under 18. Some items require a permit, while others are completely forbidden from being brought into Denmark (details on the separate special-items page, not captured this round). For further legal information the page refers to Toldstyrelsen's legal guide (in Danish).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自其他欧盟国家入境丹麦的旅客。本路线不适用非欧盟路线的 DKK 3,250/2,250 货值限额；据 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的 Toldstyrelsen 页面《Travelling within the EU》，货物仅限自用方可免关税、增值税与消费税入境——自用指仅本人、同家庭成员或私人客人使用。在当地体育俱乐部或工作场所出售，或为未同行他人携带货物，均不属自用，须缴消费税（某些包装还可能须缴押金）。烟酒数量限额：年满 18 岁——卷烟 800 支；小雪茄（每支不超 3 克）400 支；雪茄 200 支；吸用烟草 1 公斤；烈酒（酒精含量高于 22% 及添加酒精的饮料）10 升；强化酒（酒精含量不超 22%，如波特、雪莉、马德拉）20 升；餐酒（如红、白、桃红葡萄酒及苹果酒基酒）90 升，其中起泡酒（如香槟）不超 60 升；啤酒（及啤酒基苹果酒）110 升。16 或 17 岁：不得自其他欧盟国家携带烟草入境丹麦；可携带酒精浓度不超过（含）16.4% 的啤酒与葡萄酒——页面列出餐酒 90 升（其中起泡酒不超 60 升）与啤酒 110 升——浓度更高者属强化酒或烈酒，未满 18 岁不得携带入境。部分物品须许可，部分物品完全禁止携带入境（详见另行专页，本轮未抓取）。进一步法律信息见 Toldstyrelsen 法律指南（丹麦语）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Denmark by plane (at some points of entry): go through the green exit if you do not carry goods subject to customs duties, VAT and excise duties; if you carry such goods — or are in doubt about compliance — contact the Danish Customs Agency by going through the red exit; if there is no red exit, contact the airport's customs clearance office. Excise duties (and possibly a packaging deposit) are payable for goods that are not for own personal use.
procedures.timing_zh: 乘飞机抵达丹麦时（部分入境点）：未携带应缴关税、增值税与消费税物品者走绿色出口；携带此类物品或对合规有疑问者走红色出口联系丹麦海关署；如无红色出口，联系机场清关办公室。非自用货物须缴消费税（某些包装或须押金）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自其他歐盟國家入境：自用限額與綠/紅通道（菸酒數量限額；18 歲及以上與 16–17 歲規則）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自其他歐盟國家入境丹麥的旅客。本路線不適用非歐盟路線的 DKK 3,250/2,250 貨值限額；據 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的 Toldstyrelsen 頁面《Travelling within the EU》，貨物僅限自用方可免關稅、增值稅與消費稅入境——自用指僅本人、同家庭成員或私人客人使用。在當地體育俱樂部或工作場所出售，或為未同行他人攜帶貨物，均不屬自用，須繳消費稅（某些包裝還可能須繳押金）。菸酒數量限額：年滿 18 歲——捲菸 800 支；小雪茄（每支不超 3 克）400 支；雪茄 200 支；吸用菸草 1 公斤；烈酒（酒精含量高於 22% 及添加酒精的飲料）10 升；強化酒（酒精含量不超 22%，如波特、雪莉、馬德拉）20 升；餐酒（如紅、白、桃紅葡萄酒及蘋果酒基酒）90 升，其中起泡酒（如香檳）不超 60 升；啤酒（及啤酒基蘋果酒）110 升。16 或 17 歲：不得自其他歐盟國家攜帶菸草入境丹麥；可攜帶酒精濃度不超過（含）16.4% 的啤酒與葡萄酒——頁面列出餐酒 90 升（其中起泡酒不超 60 升）與啤酒 110 升——濃度更高者屬強化酒或烈酒，未滿 18 歲不得攜帶入境。部分物品須許可，部分物品完全禁止攜帶入境（詳見另行專頁，本輪未抓取）。進一步法律資訊見 Toldstyrelsen 法律指南（丹麥語）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 乘飛機抵達丹麥時（部分入境點）：未攜帶應繳關稅、增值稅與消費稅物品者走綠色出口；攜帶此類物品或對合規有疑問者走紅色出口聯繫丹麥海關署；如無紅色出口，聯繫機場清關辦公室。非自用貨物須繳消費稅（某些包裝或須押金）。

procedures.name_en: Cash and monetary instruments declaration (EUR 10,000 or more) when entering or leaving Denmark
procedures.name_zh: 进出丹麦现金及货币工具申报（1 万欧元及以上）
procedures.agency: Toldstyrelsen (Danish Customs Agency)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction and trigger: when you enter or leave Denmark with cash or other liquid funds ('monetary instruments') equal to a value of EUR 10,000 (approx. DKK 75,000) or more, you must declare to the Danish Customs Agency the monetary instruments you are bringing. Per the page 'If you are travelling with large amounts of valuables' captured live from toldst.dk on 2026-09-27 (HTTP 200), this is stated for entering or leaving Denmark — not restricted to the EU external border as the v25 baseline record asserted — and applies regardless of the type of currency and regardless of whether you are travelling as a private individual or on company business. You must also declare even if you are only in transit, for example when travelling by car or train, or if you go ashore from a ship and travel onwards to another country right away. Monetary instruments are cash, bearer securities (for example traveller's cheques and cheques) and certain types of gold: gold coins with a gold content of minimum 90%, and gold bullion or nuggets with a gold content of minimum 99.5%. This traveller procedure does not cover monetary instruments sent by mail, freight or courier, which follow other rules (Danish-language page). If you do not declare your monetary instruments and all the information required in the declaration form, you risk being fined and having your valuables seized; the Danish Customs Agency also has the right to examine and seize amounts both below and above EUR 10,000 if there are indications that they are connected with criminal activities.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向与触发：入境或离开丹麦时携带价值 EUR 10,000（约合 DKK 75,000）及以上（含本数）的现金或其他流动性资金（“货币工具”），须向丹麦海关署申报所携货币工具。据 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的页面《If you are travelling with large amounts of valuables》，原文即为“进入或离开丹麦”，并未如 v25 基线记录所述限于跨越欧盟外部边境；且不论币种、不论私人出行或公务出行均适用。仅过境（如乘汽车或火车）或下船后随即前往他国时同样必须申报。货币工具包括现金、不记名有价证券（如旅行支票与支票）及特定黄金：金含量不低于 90% 的金币，以及金含量不低于 99.5% 的金条或天然金块。本随身旅客程序不适用于经邮寄、货运或快递寄送货币工具，该情形适用其他规则（丹麦语页面）。不申报货币工具及申报单所要求全部信息的，将被罚款并可能没收财物；若有犯罪活动迹象，丹麦海关署对低于或高于 EUR 10,000 的款项均有权查验和扣押。
procedures.timing_en: When entering or leaving Denmark: fill in the declaration form (in Danish or English; with MitID login or without MitID) in advance or at a customs office when travelling, and save your reference number; even if you fill in the form in advance, you must always go to the customs office at the airport or where you enter or leave Denmark, quote the reference number — the Danish Customs Agency will process the declaration and can give you a physical receipt — and bring the receipt with you when entering and/or leaving Denmark as necessary.
procedures.timing_zh: 进出丹麦时：提前或在旅途中的海关办公室填写申报表（丹麦语或英语；可用 MitID 登录或免登录），并保存参考号；即使提前填报，仍必须前往机场或出入境地点的海关办公室报出参考号——丹麦海关署处理申报后可出具纸质收据——进出丹麦时按需随身携带收据。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出丹麥現金及貨幣工具申報（1 萬歐元及以上）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向與觸發：入境或離開丹麥時攜帶價值 EUR 10,000（約合 DKK 75,000）及以上（含本數）的現金或其他流動性資金（“貨幣工具”），須向丹麥海關署申報所攜貨幣工具。據 2026-09-27 自 toldst.dk 直取（HTTP 200）的頁面《If you are travelling with large amounts of valuables》，原文即為“進入或離開丹麥”，並未如 v25 基線記錄所述限於跨越歐盟外部邊境；且不論幣種、不論私人出行或公務出行均適用。僅過境（如乘汽車或火車）或下船後隨即前往他國時同樣必須申報。貨幣工具包括現金、不記名有價證券（如旅行支票與支票）及特定黃金：金含量不低於 90% 的金幣，以及金含量不低於 99.5% 的金條或天然金塊。本隨身旅客程序不適用於經郵寄、貨運或快遞寄送貨幣工具，該情形適用其他規則（丹麥語頁面）。不申報貨幣工具及申報單所要求全部資訊的，將被罰款並可能沒收財物；若有犯罪活動跡象，丹麥海關署對低於或高於 EUR 10,000 的款項均有權查驗和扣押。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進出丹麥時：提前或在旅途中的海關辦公室填寫申報表（丹麥語或英語；可用 MitID 登入或免登入），並保存參考號；即使提前填報，仍必須前往機場或出入境地點的海關辦公室報出參考號——丹麥海關署處理申報後可出具紙質收據——進出丹麥時按需隨身攜帶收據。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding traveller allowances
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报
procedures.agency: Estonian Tax and Customs Board (EMTA)
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving in Estonia from a third (non-EU) country: non-commercial goods up to a customs value of EUR 300 are duty-exempt (air and sea travellers up to EUR 430). Tobacco and alcohol relief requires age 18+. Tobacco relief applies at the first and second entry within a calendar month: 40 cigarettes, 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars or 50 g of smoking tobacco (an air passenger up to 200 cigarettes or 250 g). Alcohol relief applies in principle at the first entry within a calendar month: wine up to 4 L, beer up to 16 L, plus 2 L of beverages up to 22% alcohol or 1 L above 22% (asterisked amounts may be combined up to 100% of the total allowance); at the second entry within a calendar month, the Estonian Tax and Customs Board may apply an additional exemption only if the traveller proves that the import of alcohol was of an occasional nature. Travellers arriving by air, train or sea are not limited by border-crossing frequency. Motor-vehicle arrivals may bring standard-tank fuel plus up to 10 L in a portable container duty-free at the first entry per month. Tobacco, alcohol and motor fuel produced in or brought from Russia are prohibited (Council Regulation (EU) 2022/1904). Goods exceeding the duty-exempt value or quantitative limits, or requiring special permits, are subject to declaration: choose the red channel; if unsure whether goods are declarable, also choose the red channel; where a border point has no channel system, address a customs official to present the goods.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自第三国（非欧盟国家）入境爱沙尼亚：非商用货物按海关价值免税限额 300 欧（航空与海路旅客 430 欧）。烟草与酒类豁免均须年满 18 岁。烟草豁免限于每个日历月第一、二次入境：40 支香烟、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄或 50 克吸烟烟草（航空旅客最多 200 支香烟或 250 克）。酒类原则上仅为每个日历月首次入境：葡萄酒最多 4 升、啤酒最多 16 升，另加 ≤22% 酒精饮料 2 升或 >22% 1 升（带 * 的数量可按总限额 100% 比例合并）；每个日历月第二次入境时，仅在旅客证明携带酒类属偶然性质的情况下，爱沙尼亚税务与海关局方可酌情给予附加豁免。乘飞机、火车或海路抵达的旅客不受入境频率限制。乘机动车辆入境者每个日历月首次入境可免税携带油箱标准容量燃料及最多 10 升便携燃料。俄产或自俄罗斯带来的烟草、酒类及燃料依 (EU) 2022/1904 禁止入境。超出免税价值或数量限额、或需特别许可的物品须申报：走红道；不确定物品是否须申报同样走红道；口岸无红绿通道系统时找海关官员呈报物品。
procedures.timing_en: Declaration is made to customs at the border on arrival: choose the red channel when crossing; where a border crossing point has no channel system, present the goods to a customs official. Page last updated 17.06.2026; URL verified accessible on 2026-09-27.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境时在边境向海关申报：过境走红道；口岸无红绿通道系统时向海关官员呈报物品。页面最后更新于 2026-06-17；该网址已于 2026-09-27 验证可访问。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自第三國（非歐盟國家）入境愛沙尼亞：非商用貨物按海關價值免稅限額 300 歐（航空與海路旅客 430 歐）。菸草與酒類豁免均須年滿 18 歲。菸草豁免限於每個日曆月第一、二次入境：40 支香菸、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄或 50 克吸菸菸草（航空旅客最多 200 支香菸或 250 克）。酒類原則上僅為每個日曆月首次入境：葡萄酒最多 4 升、啤酒最多 16 升，另加 ≤22% 酒精飲料 2 升或 >22% 1 升（帶 * 的數量可按總限額 100% 比例合併）；每個日曆月第二次入境時，僅在旅客證明攜帶酒類屬偶然性質的情況下，愛沙尼亞稅務與海關局方可酌情給予附加豁免。乘飛機、火車或海路抵達的旅客不受入境頻率限制。乘機動車輛入境者每個日曆月首次入境可免稅攜帶油箱標準容量燃料及最多 10 升便攜燃料。俄產或自俄羅斯帶來的菸草、酒類及燃料依 (EU) 2022/1904 禁止入境。超出免稅價值或數量限額、或需特別許可的物品須申報：走紅道；不確定物品是否須申報同樣走紅道；口岸無紅綠通道系統時找海關官員呈報物品。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境時在邊境向海關申報：過境走紅道；口岸無紅綠通道系統時向海關官員呈報物品。頁面最後更新於 2026-06-17；該網址已於 2026-09-27 驗證可訪問。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration when entering or leaving the EU with EUR 10,000 or more
procedures.name_zh: 进出欧盟随身携带 1 万欧元及以上现金申报
procedures.agency: Estonian Tax and Customs Board (EMTA)
procedures.applicability_en: Required when entering or leaving the European Union through Estonia's external border carrying cash of at least EUR 10,000 (threshold inclusive), or the equivalent in another currency or bearer-negotiable instrument. Cash means banknotes and coins in any currency (including currencies no longer in circulation), bearer-negotiable instruments such as travellers' cheques and promissory notes, coins with a gold content of not less than 90%, and gold in nuggets or clumps with a gold content of not less than 99.5%. For amounts below EUR 10,000 customs may carry out checks only where there is information that the cash is related to criminal activity — a separate checking power, not a routine declaration threshold. Sanctions additionally prohibit exporting euro and Member State banknotes to Russia or Belarus (narrow personal-use exemption with no fixed amount threshold) and importing gold from Russia.
procedures.applicability_zh: 经爱沙尼亚外部边界进入或离开欧盟时，随身携带至少 1 万欧元（含本数）现金——或等值其他货币、无记名可转让票据——须申报。现金指任何货币的纸币和硬币（含已停止流通货币）、旅行支票及本票等无记名可转让票据、含金量不低于 90% 的金币、以及含金量不低于 99.5% 的金块或天然金块。低于 1 万欧元时，仅在有信息显示现金涉及犯罪活动的情况下海关方可查验——这是独立查验权，并非常规申报门槛。制裁另禁止向俄罗斯或白俄罗斯出口欧元及成员国货币纸币（个人自用豁免极窄且无固定金额门槛），并禁止自俄罗斯进口黄金。
procedures.timing_en: Electronic declaration in e-MTA (log in, then Customs – Simplified declarations – Cash declaration – New declaration) may be submitted up to three days before crossing the border; once submitted, the traveller must still choose the red lane at the border customs office and inform the customs official of lodging the declaration. Travellers without access to the e-services environment can submit a cash declaration on the 'Cash declaration / disclosure' webpage. Currency equivalents use the exchange rate of the day before submission (ECB rate; the declaration information system applies Estonian Master Tariff System rates). Page last updated 16.06.2026.
procedures.timing_zh: 通过 e-MTA 电子服务（登录后依次选择 海关 – 简化申报 – 现金申报 – New declaration）可于越过边境前最早 3 天提交电子申报；提交后过境时仍须在边境海关走红道并告知海关官员已提交申报。无法使用电子服务环境者，可在“Cash declaration / disclosure”网页提交现金申报。外币折算采用提交前一日汇率（欧洲央行汇率；现金申报信息系统采用爱沙尼亚主关税系统汇率）。页面最后更新于 2026-06-16。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出歐盟隨身攜帶 1 萬歐元及以上現金申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 經愛沙尼亞外部邊界進入或離開歐盟時，隨身攜帶至少 1 萬歐元（含本數）現金——或等值其他貨幣、無記名可轉讓票據——須申報。現金指任何貨幣的紙幣和硬幣（含已停止流通貨幣）、旅行支票及本票等無記名可轉讓票據、含金量不低於 90% 的金幣、以及含金量不低於 99.5% 的金塊或天然金塊。低於 1 萬歐元時，僅在有資訊顯示現金涉及犯罪活動的情況下海關方可查驗——這是獨立查驗權，並非常規申報門檻。制裁另禁止向俄羅斯或白俄羅斯出口歐元及成員國貨幣紙幣（個人自用豁免極窄且無固定金額門檻），並禁止自俄羅斯進口黃金。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 通過 e-MTA 電子服務（登入後依次選擇 海關 – 簡化申報 – 現金申報 – New declaration）可於越過邊境前最早 3 天提交電子申報；提交後過境時仍須在邊境海關走紅道並告知海關官員已提交申報。無法使用電子服務環境者，可在“Cash declaration / disclosure”網頁提交現金申報。外幣折算採用提交前一日匯率（歐洲央行匯率；現金申報資訊系統採用愛沙尼亞主關稅系統匯率）。頁面最後更新於 2026-06-16。

procedures.name_en: Red/green customs channel selection at arrival — TAKS (Faroese Customs and Tax Administration)
procedures.name_zh: 抵达时红/绿海关通道选择——法罗群岛海关税务局（TAKS）
procedures.agency: TAKS — Faroese Customs and Tax Administration
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers arriving in the Faroe Islands. On arrival, in the airport arrival hall or at the ferry terminal, the traveller must choose to go through the red or the green customs channel; both are clearly marked. Green channel: only goods within the duty-free allowance and with a total value not exceeding DKK 2,500 excl. VAT; passing through it counts as declaring nothing, customs may carry out selective checks, and goods found undeclared in a check are fined. Red channel: goods with a value exceeding DKK 2,500 excl. VAT, quantities above the duty-free allowance, or special goods such as a dog or a cat; travellers in doubt must also use the red channel and ask a customs officer. Trigger conditions per TAKS (Faroese rules only — not the Danish/EU allowances): the duty-free allowance may be used once within 24 hours; minimum age 18 for alcohol or tobacco. Alcohol options: 1 litre of spirits over 22% ABV (at most 60% ABV) plus 1 litre of fortified wine up to 22% ABV plus 2 litres of beer or cider up to 5.8% ABV; or 1 litre of spirits over 22% ABV plus 2.25 litres of table wine plus 2 litres of beer or cider; or 2.25 litres of fortified wine plus 2 litres of beer or cider; or 4.5 litres of table wine plus 2 litres of beer or cider; or 10 litres of beer or cider. Tobacco: 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 grams of tobacco or 250 grams of snuff (nicotine pouches). Chocolates/sweets maximum 3 kilograms; soda maximum 10 litres. Other goods may be imported duty-free if the total value does not exceed DKK 2,500 excl. VAT; if exceeded, duty is payable on the total value, and goods consisting of multiple parts belonging together cannot be split across trips or persons. For alcohol above the allowance, travellers aged 18 and over may, when arriving, pay duty on totals of up to 3 litres of spirits between 22% and 60% ABV, 9 litres of wine or other alcohol up to 22% ABV and 10 litres of beer or cider; anything exceeding these amounts is confiscated by customs.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进入法罗群岛的旅客。抵达时，在机场到达厅或渡轮码头，旅客必须选择走红色或绿色海关通道；两者均有明显标识。绿色通道：仅限携物在免税额度内且总值不超过 2,500 丹麦克朗（不含增值税）；走过绿道即视为无申报，海关可实施抽查，查出应报未报物品将被罚款。红色通道：所携物品总值超过 2,500 丹麦克朗（不含增值税）、超过免税额度，或有特殊物品（如狗、猫）时使用；有疑问也应走红道并向海关关员询问。触发条件（据 TAKS，仅适用于法罗群岛，不适用丹麦/EU 额度）：免税额度每 24 小时可使用一次；携带酒类或烟草最低年满 18 岁。酒类可选组合：22% ABV 以上烈酒 1 升（最高 60% ABV）+ 22% ABV 以下强化酒 1 升 + 5.8% ABV 以下啤酒/西打酒 2 升；或 22% ABV 以上烈酒 1 升 + 餐酒 2.25 升 + 啤酒/西打酒 2 升；或强化酒 2.25 升 + 啤酒/西打酒 2 升；或餐酒 4.5 升 + 啤酒/西打酒 2 升；或啤酒/西打酒 10 升。烟草：香烟 200 支或小雪茄 100 支或雪茄 50 支或烟草 250 克或鼻烟 250 克（含尼古丁袋）。巧克力/糖果最多 3 公斤；汽水最多 10 升。其他物品总值不超过 2,500 丹麦克朗（不含增值税）可免税进口；超出则按总价值征税，属同一整体的组合物品不得分次、分人拆分免税。超额度酒类（年满 18 岁）抵达时可在以下总量内申报缴税：22%–60% ABV 烈酒 3 升、22% ABV 以下葡萄酒或其他酒 9 升、啤酒/西打酒 10 升；超过部分将被海关没收。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival in the Faroe Islands — in the airport arrival hall or at the ferry terminal, before leaving the customs area; the allowance is usable once within 24 hours.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达法罗群岛时——在机场到达厅或渡轮码头、离开海关区域前完成通道选择；额度每 24 小时一次。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達時紅/綠海關通道選擇——法羅群島海關稅務局（TAKS）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進入法羅群島的旅客。抵達時，在機場到達廳或渡輪碼頭，旅客必須選擇走紅色或綠色海關通道；兩者均有明顯標識。綠色通道：僅限攜物在免稅額度內且總值不超過 2,500 丹麥克朗（不含增值稅）；走過綠道即視為無申報，海關可實施抽查，查出應報未報物品將被罰款。紅色通道：所攜物品總值超過 2,500 丹麥克朗（不含增值稅）、超過免稅額度，或有特殊物品（如狗、貓）時使用；有疑問也應走紅道並向海關關員詢問。觸發條件（據 TAKS，僅適用於法羅群島，不適用丹麥/EU 額度）：免稅額度每 24 小時可使用一次；攜帶酒類或菸草最低年滿 18 歲。酒類可選組合：22% ABV 以上烈酒 1 升（最高 60% ABV）+ 22% ABV 以下強化酒 1 升 + 5.8% ABV 以下啤酒/西打酒 2 升；或 22% ABV 以上烈酒 1 升 + 餐酒 2.25 升 + 啤酒/西打酒 2 升；或強化酒 2.25 升 + 啤酒/西打酒 2 升；或餐酒 4.5 升 + 啤酒/西打酒 2 升；或啤酒/西打酒 10 升。菸草：香菸 200 支或小雪茄 100 支或雪茄 50 支或菸草 250 克或鼻菸 250 克（含尼古丁袋）。巧克力/糖果最多 3 公斤；汽水最多 10 升。其他物品總值不超過 2,500 丹麥克朗（不含增值稅）可免稅進口；超出則按總價值徵稅，屬同一整體的組合物品不得分次、分人拆分免稅。超額度酒類（年滿 18 歲）抵達時可在以下總量內申報繳稅：22%–60% ABV 烈酒 3 升、22% ABV 以下葡萄酒或其他酒 9 升、啤酒/西打酒 10 升；超過部分將被海關沒收。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達法羅群島時——在機場到達廳或渡輪碼頭、離開海關區域前完成通道選擇；額度每 24 小時一次。

procedures.name_en: Cash Declaration Form (T33) for available means of payment worth EUR 10,000 or more — § 29 sub-s 3 Faroese Customs Act (TAKS)
procedures.name_zh: 现金申报表（T33）：携带总值 1 万欧元或以上可用支付手段——《法罗群岛海关法》第 29 条第 3 款（TAKS）
procedures.agency: TAKS — Faroese Customs and Tax Administration
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering or leaving the Faroe Islands. Travellers carrying available means of payment — cash (banknotes/coins) and/or bearer bonds (e.g. securities, money orders) — with a total value of EUR 10,000 or more (approximately DKK 75,000 per TAKS) must declare it to the customs authorities, according to § 29 sub-s 3 of the Faroese Customs Act as cited by TAKS and corroborated by the statutory wording itself: § 29 stk. 3, inserted by item 28 of Løgtingslóg nr. 49 frá 04.05.2021, was read on the official logir.fo page (browser DOM read of the selected provision; full act not downloaded) and requires travellers to or from the Faroese customs territory carrying such means worth EUR 10,000 or more to stop for customs inspection without being asked and to notify the customs authority of the full amount carried. Declare by completing and submitting the official Cash Declaration Form (T33, 3 pages incl. guide): write in capital letters or complete on a computer and print to sign; per the form, submit it via secure email to taks@taks.fo or by other secure means — the TAKS duty-free page also lists secure email customs@taks.fo and post to TAKS, Smyrilsvegur 20, Postboks 2151, 110 Tórshavn. TAKS recommends making the declaration in good time; the form can also be obtained and the declaration made at TAKS Customs at Vágar airport or the Tórshavn ferry terminal on arrival or departure. Penalties: a fine of 25% of the value exceeding EUR 10,000, no less than DKK 5,000; per the T33 form, a false, inaccurate or incomplete declaration is liable to penalties, detention or confiscation of the cash; customs may retain all cash if they think it may have links to criminal activity (§ 27 b of the Faroese Customs Act, as cited by TAKS). This is the Faroese T33 procedure, distinct from the Danish national cash declaration; TAKS states the obligation is part of an EU-wide anti-money-laundering strategy that also applies to the Faroe Islands.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进出法罗群岛的旅客。携带可用支付手段——现金（钞票/硬币）和/或不记名债券（如证券、汇票）——总值达 10,000 欧元或以上（据 TAKS 约合 75,000 丹麦克朗）者，须依 TAKS 所引《法罗群岛海关法》第 29 条第 3 款向海关申报；该法条原文亦已佐证：logir.fo 官方页面（浏览器 DOM 实读选定条款，整部法规未下载）显示第 29 条第 3 款由 2021 年第 49 号法律（Løgtingslóg nr. 49 frá 04.05.2021）第 28 项插入，规定往返法罗海关区域（tolløkið）携可用支付手段达 10,000 欧元或以上者，无须催告即须停车接受海关检查（tolleftirlit），并有义务将所携全部金额告知海关当局。申报方式为填写并提交官方“现金申报表”（T33，含指南共 3 页）：用大写字母填写或电脑填写后打印签字；按表内说明经安全电子邮件提交至 taks@taks.fo 或以其他安全方式提交——TAKS 免税页另列安全邮箱 customs@taks.fo 及邮寄地址 TAKS, Smyrilsvegur 20, Postboks 2151, 110 Tórshavn。TAKS 建议尽早申报；亦可在抵达或离境时于沃格（Vágar）机场或托尔斯港（Tórshavn）渡轮码头的 TAKS 海关处索取表格办理。罚则：处超出 10,000 欧元部分价值 25% 的罚款，最低 5,000 丹麦克朗；按 T33 表声明，虚假、不准确或不完整的申报可致处罚、现金扣留或没收；海关认为现金可能涉及犯罪活动的，可扣押全部现金（《法罗群岛海关法》第 27 b 条，据 TAKS 所引）。本程序为法罗群岛 T33 程序，不同于丹麦国家现金申报；TAKS 说明该义务属适用于法罗群岛的欧盟反洗钱战略的一部分。
procedures.timing_en: In good time before travel (recommended by TAKS), or on arrival/departure at Vágar airport or the Tórshavn ferry terminal.
procedures.timing_zh: 行前尽早申报（TAKS 建议），或在抵达/离境时于沃格机场或托尔斯港渡轮码头办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金申報表（T33）：攜帶總值 1 萬歐元或以上可用支付手段——《法羅群島海關法》第 29 條第 3 款（TAKS）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進出法羅群島的旅客。攜帶可用支付手段——現金（鈔票/硬幣）和/或不記名債券（如證券、匯票）——總值達 10,000 歐元或以上（據 TAKS 約合 75,000 丹麥克朗）者，須依 TAKS 所引《法羅群島海關法》第 29 條第 3 款向海關申報；該法條原文亦已佐證：logir.fo 官方頁面（瀏覽器 DOM 實讀選定條款，整部法規未下載）顯示第 29 條第 3 款由 2021 年第 49 號法律（Løgtingslóg nr. 49 frá 04.05.2021）第 28 項插入，規定往返法羅海關區域（tolløkið）攜可用支付手段達 10,000 歐元或以上者，無須催告即須停車接受海關檢查（tolleftirlit），並有義務將所攜全部金額告知海關當局。申報方式為填寫並提交官方“現金申報表”（T33，含指南共 3 頁）：用大寫字母填寫或電腦填寫後列印簽字；按表內說明經安全電子郵件提交至 taks@taks.fo 或以其他安全方式提交——TAKS 免稅頁另列安全信箱 customs@taks.fo 及郵寄地址 TAKS, Smyrilsvegur 20, Postboks 2151, 110 Tórshavn。TAKS 建議儘早申報；亦可在抵達或離境時於沃格（Vágar）機場或托爾斯港（Tórshavn）渡輪碼頭的 TAKS 海關處索取表格辦理。罰則：處超出 10,000 歐元部分價值 25% 的罰款，最低 5,000 丹麥克朗；按 T33 表聲明，虛假、不準確或不完整的申報可致處罰、現金扣留或沒收；海關認為現金可能涉及犯罪活動的，可扣押全部現金（《法羅群島海關法》第 27 b 條，據 TAKS 所引）。本程序為法羅群島 T33 程序，不同於丹麥國家現金申報；TAKS 說明該義務屬適用於法羅群島的歐盟反洗錢戰略的一部分。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 行前儘早申報（TAKS 建議），或在抵達/離境時於沃格機場或托爾斯港渡輪碼頭辦理。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding tax-free limits
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报
procedures.agency: Tulli — Finnish Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving in Finland from outside the EU: goods up to EUR 430 tax-free by plane or boat, EUR 300 by car, bus or train (the same applies to arrival on a yacht or a recreationally used aircraft); goods must be carried in your own personal luggage and the import must be non-commercial (occasional, for your own or your family's use or as gifts). If the value limit is exceeded, VAT and customs duty are levied on the price of the whole item, not only the excess; the price of a single item cannot be split into a tax-free and a taxable part, nor can it be shared with another person, not even a spouse. Choose the red channel when exceeding the value limits or when bringing restricted goods that must be presented to Customs; green channel = nothing to declare, blue channel = arriving by airplane from an EU country with nothing to declare; choosing the wrong channel can lead to goods being detained or seized, double tax, or suspicion of a customs offence. Traditional tobacco products (cigarettes, cigars) do not count toward the value limit; snus products, e-cigarettes and nicotine liquids are within it; alcohol and fuel have separate quantity restrictions. From EU countries: goods for your own use are free of tax with no value limits, but restrictions remain for example on tobacco and medicines. The Åland Islands, the Canary Islands and other EU areas outside the EU fiscal territory follow the same 430/300 euro rules. Alcohol allowances and conditions: persons under 18 may not bring in any alcoholic beverages; persons under 20 may only bring in mild alcoholic beverages (max 22% by volume); from age 20 also spirits. From outside the EU, tax-free maximum quantities: 16 litres of beer (over 0.5%) AND 4 litres of still wine (red, white and rosé), plus 1 litre of spirits (over 22%, max 80%) OR 2 litres of other alcoholic beverages (max 22%, e.g. sparkling wines, long drinks, ciders, liqueurs, vermouth, bitters, sherry); spirits and sub-22% beverages may be combined proportionally as long as the total is not exceeded (e.g. 0.5 l spirits + 1 l sparkling wine), which does not apply to still wine or beer; the vehicle used on arrival is irrelevant. From inside the EU: tax-exempt when imported for personal use or as a gift and transported personally in the same vehicle; there are no universal quantity limits — the figures 110 litres of beer, 90 litres of wine/ciders/fermentation-made long drinks (sparkling wines max 60 litres), 20 litres of intermediate products (max 22%) and 10 litres of other alcoholic beverages (over 1.2%, max 80%) are guidelines for personal use, categories cannot be substituted for one another, and quantities exceeding them require credible proof of personal use. The Canary Islands, the Åland Islands, the Finland–Sweden ferries passing through Åland and other EU areas outside the EU fiscal territory are exceptions: tax-exempt alcohol only in quantities corresponding to imports from outside the EU (16 l beer, 4 l still wine, 1 l spirits over 22% or 2 l max 22%); when travelling to the Åland Islands the same allowance applies to beverages bought inclusive of tax, and on a ferry journey between mainland Finland and the Åland Islands only, the ferry is not allowed to sell you more than two litres of beer free of tax. Time limits for non-air arrivals from outside the EEA (EU countries plus Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein): if you live in Finland, you may import alcohol only on journeys lasting more than 24 hours (not allowed even against tax on shorter trips); if you live outside the EEA, you may import only when staying in Finland for more than 72 hours (transit journeys exempt); these limits do not apply to arrivals from an EU country or Åland. Imports from Russia: strong alcoholic beverages (over 22%) and mild beverages mixed with alcohol at the manufacturing stage are prohibited, including purchases from tax-free shops; only restricted quantities of other light beverages such as beer and fermented wines and ciders, for personal use or as a gift. Personal use covers your own use, use by your family and gifts; receiving money or any other compensation for the alcohol makes the import commercial. Tobacco allowances and conditions: to bring in tobacco products you must be aged 18 or over. From outside the EU, without paying taxes: 200 cigarettes OR 50 cigars OR 100 cigarillos (max 3 g each) OR 250 grams of roll-your-own, pipe or waterpipe tobacco; products may be combined proportionally as long as the allowed total quantity is not exceeded (e.g. 100 cigarettes + 50 cigarillos); only for your own personal use — not for family members or as a gift. When you pay tax (declare to Customs on arrival), the maximum quantities from outside the EU are: 200 cigarettes AND 50 cigars AND 100 cigarillos AND 250 grams of roll-your-own, pipe or waterpipe tobacco AND 200 dose units of other tobacco products or 250 grams of other loose tobacco products (e.g. cigarette sticks, tobacco capsules) AND 200 units of ready-rolled plus 250 grams of loose herbal smoking products; you may not bring in more even if you pay tax. Arriving from other EU countries, the same quantities are the maximum amounts you may bring in only for your own personal use, transported in the same vehicle in which you arrive, with no increase even against tax; these restrictions apply to products in packets that do not carry health warning images and texts in Finnish and Swedish, so the 200/50/100/250 figures must not be read as a universal hard cap on all EU tobacco imports. Åland has different restrictions (detailed pages not fetched this round). Imports of all cigarettes, cigarillos and cigars from Russia are prohibited. Non-air arrivals from outside the EEA: if you live in Finland and your journey lasted no more than 24 hours, tobacco products, nicotine liquids and snus are not allowed (exception: apparently obtained before leaving Finland); if you live outside the EEA and your stay in Finland is not transit and lasts no more than three days, they are not allowed (exception: apparently for your own use during the stay).
procedures.applicability_zh: 自欧盟外入境芬兰：乘飞机或轮船免税商品价值上限430欧元，乘汽车、巴士或火车300欧元（乘游艇或休闲用途飞行器抵达亦同）；商品须放入本人随身行李携带，进口须为非商业性质（偶尔进口、本人或家人自用或作礼物）。超出限额时按整件商品全价征收增值税与关税，而非仅超额部分；单件商品价格不可拆分为免税与应税两部分，也不可与他人（含配偶）分摊，免税携带权属个人。超过价值限额或携带须向海关出示的受限商品时选择红通道；绿通道＝无申报物品，蓝通道＝自欧盟乘飞机抵达且无申报物品；选错通道货物可能被扣留或没收、被追缴双倍税款或涉嫌海关违规。传统烟草制品（香烟、雪茄）不计入价值限额，鼻烟、电子烟及烟油计入限额；酒类与燃料另有单独数量限制。自欧盟国家入境：自用商品免税且不适用价值限额，但烟草、药品等仍有限制。奥兰群岛、加那利群岛等属于欧盟但不在欧盟财政领土内的地区同样适用430/300欧元规则。酒类额度与条件：未满18周岁不得携带任何酒精饮料入境；未满20周岁只能携带低度酒精饮料（≤22% vol）；年满20周岁方可携带烈酒。自欧盟外入境免税最高数量：16升啤酒（>0.5%）且4升静止葡萄酒（红、白、桃红），另可携带1升烈酒（>22%、最高80%）或2升其他酒精饮料（≤22%，如起泡酒、long drink、苹果酒、利口酒、味美思、苦艾酒、雪莉酒）；烈酒与≤22%饮料可按比例合并携带，只要总量不超（如0.5升烈酒＋1升起泡酒），静止葡萄酒与啤酒不可合并；与抵达时使用的交通工具无关。自欧盟境内入境：供本人自用或作礼物、本人随抵达车辆运输即可免税，无统一数量上限——110升啤酒、90升葡萄酒/苹果酒/发酵型long drink（其中起泡酒最多60升）、20升中间产品（≤22%）、10升其他酒精饮料（>1.2%、最高80%）等数字仅为自用判断参考，各类之间不可互相替代，超出须能可信证明供自用。加那利群岛、奥兰群岛、途经奥兰的芬瑞轮渡及其他属于欧盟但不在欧盟财政领土内的地区属例外：免税量仅相当于自欧盟外的数量（16升啤酒、4升静止葡萄酒、1升>22%烈酒或2升≤22%）；携含税购买的酒类（如自Alko购买）前往奥兰群岛时适用相同额度，仅在芬兰本岛与奥兰群岛之间航行的轮渡不得免税向您出售超过2升啤酒。自EEA（欧盟国家及挪威、冰岛、列支敦士登）外非空路入境的时间限制：居住在芬兰者仅限旅程超过24小时方可携带酒类（不足24小时即使缴税也不得携带）；居住在EEA外者仅限在芬停留超过72小时方可携带（过境旅程不适用）；自欧盟国家或奥兰入境不适用该时限。自俄罗斯入境：烈性酒精饮料（>22%）及生产阶段掺入酒精的低度饮料禁止进口（免税店购买的同样禁止）；仅可限量携带啤酒及发酵型葡萄酒、苹果酒等其他低度饮料，供自用或作礼物。自用包括本人使用、家人使用及作礼物；收取金钱或任何其他对价即属商业用途。烟草额度与条件：年满18周岁方可携带。自欧盟外免税携带：200支香烟或50支雪茄或100支小雪茄（每支≤3克）或250克手卷烟丝/烟斗丝/水烟丝；可按比例组合携带，只要总额度不超（如100支香烟＋50支小雪茄）；仅限本人自用——不得为家人携带或作礼物。缴税携带（入境时向海关申报缴税）时自欧盟外的最高数量为：200支香烟且50支雪茄且100支小雪茄且250克手卷烟丝/烟斗丝/水烟丝且200剂量单位其他烟草制品或250克其他散装烟草制品（如烟棒、含烟草胶囊）且200单位已卷制草本吸烟制品另加250克散装草本吸烟制品；即便缴税也不得超过该量。自其他欧盟国家入境时，同等数量为仅限本人自用、须随本人抵达车辆运输的最高携带量，即便缴税也不得增加；该限制针对包装上无芬兰文/瑞典文健康警示图文的制品，故200/50/100/250等数字不应理解为对所有欧盟烟草进口的普遍硬上限。奥兰群岛适用不同的限制（细则页本轮未抓取）。自俄罗斯进口所有香烟、小雪茄及雪茄均被禁止。自EEA外非空路入境：居住在芬兰者旅程不超过24小时不得携带烟草制品、烟油及鼻烟（例外：明显在离芬前取得）；居住在EEA外者在芬停留非过境且不超过三日的，不得携带（例外：明显供本人停留期间自用）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Finland: choose the red channel when your goods exceed the tax-free value limits, when your alcohol or tobacco exceeds the tax-free quantities or otherwise fails the conditions for tax-free import, or when you bring restricted goods that must be presented to Customs; to import more tobacco than the tax-free quantity from outside the EU, choose the red channel, declare to Customs and pay tax (within the tax-paid maximum quantities). If unsure, choose the red channel and ask a customs officer. If there are no channels at your point of entry, declare the goods to Customs in some other way.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达芬兰时：商品超过免税价值限额、酒类或烟草超过免税数量或不满足免税条件、或携带须向海关出示的受限商品时选择红通道；自欧盟外超过免税量携带烟草须选择红通道向海关申报并缴税（以缴税上限为限）。如有疑问请走红通道向关员咨询。入境点无通道标识时，须以其他方式向海关申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自歐盟外入境芬蘭：乘飛機或輪船免稅商品價值上限430歐元，乘汽車、巴士或火車300歐元（乘遊艇或休閒用途飛行器抵達亦同）；商品須放入本人隨身行李攜帶，進口須為非商業性質（偶爾進口、本人或家人自用或作禮物）。超出限額時按整件商品全價徵收增值稅與關稅，而非僅超額部分；單件商品價格不可拆分為免稅與應稅兩部分，也不可與他人（含配偶）分攤，免稅攜帶權屬個人。超過價值限額或攜帶須向海關出示的受限商品時選擇紅通道；綠通道＝無申報物品，藍通道＝自歐盟乘飛機抵達且無申報物品；選錯通道貨物可能被扣留或沒收、被追繳雙倍稅款或涉嫌海關違規。傳統菸草製品（香菸、雪茄）不計入價值限額，鼻菸、電子煙及煙油計入限額；酒類與燃料另有單獨數量限制。自歐盟國家入境：自用商品免稅且不適用價值限額，但菸草、藥品等仍有限制。奧蘭群島、加那利群島等屬於歐盟但不在歐盟財政領土內的地區同樣適用430/300歐元規則。酒類額度與條件：未滿18週歲不得攜帶任何酒精飲料入境；未滿20週歲只能攜帶低度酒精飲料（≤22% vol）；年滿20週歲方可攜帶烈酒。自歐盟外入境免稅最高數量：16升啤酒（>0.5%）且4升靜止葡萄酒（紅、白、桃紅），另可攜帶1升烈酒（>22%、最高80%）或2升其他酒精飲料（≤22%，如起泡酒、long drink、蘋果酒、利口酒、味美思、苦艾酒、雪莉酒）；烈酒與≤22%飲料可按比例合併攜帶，只要總量不超（如0.5升烈酒＋1升起泡酒），靜止葡萄酒與啤酒不可合併；與抵達時使用的交通工具無關。自歐盟境內入境：供本人自用或作禮物、本人隨抵達車輛運輸即可免稅，無統一數量上限——110升啤酒、90升葡萄酒/蘋果酒/發酵型long drink（其中起泡酒最多60升）、20升中間產品（≤22%）、10升其他酒精飲料（>1.2%、最高80%）等數字僅為自用判斷參考，各類之間不可互相替代，超出須能可信證明供自用。加那利群島、奧蘭群島、途經奧蘭的芬瑞輪渡及其他屬於歐盟但不在歐盟財政領土內的地區屬例外：免稅量僅相當於自歐盟外的數量（16升啤酒、4升靜止葡萄酒、1升>22%烈酒或2升≤22%）；攜含稅購買的酒類（如自Alko購買）前往奧蘭群島時適用相同額度，僅在芬蘭本島與奧蘭群島之間航行的輪渡不得免稅向您出售超過2升啤酒。自EEA（歐盟國家及挪威、冰島、列支敦士登）外非空路入境的時間限制：居住在芬蘭者僅限旅程超過24小時方可攜帶酒類（不足24小時即使繳稅也不得攜帶）；居住在EEA外者僅限在芬停留超過72小時方可攜帶（過境旅程不適用）；自歐盟國家或奧蘭入境不適用該時限。自俄羅斯入境：烈性酒精飲料（>22%）及生產階段摻入酒精的低度飲料禁止進口（免稅店購買的同樣禁止）；僅可限量攜帶啤酒及發酵型葡萄酒、蘋果酒等其他低度飲料，供自用或作禮物。自用包括本人使用、家人使用及作禮物；收取金錢或任何其他對價即屬商業用途。菸草額度與條件：年滿18週歲方可攜帶。自歐盟外免稅攜帶：200支香菸或50支雪茄或100支小雪茄（每支≤3克）或250克手卷菸絲/菸斗絲/水煙絲；可按比例組合攜帶，只要總額度不超（如100支香菸＋50支小雪茄）；僅限本人自用——不得為家人攜帶或作禮物。繳稅攜帶（入境時向海關申報繳稅）時自歐盟外的最高數量為：200支香菸且50支雪茄且100支小雪茄且250克手卷菸絲/菸斗絲/水煙絲且200劑量單位其他菸草製品或250克其他散裝菸草製品（如煙棒、含菸草膠囊）且200單位已卷制草本吸菸製品另加250克散裝草本吸菸製品；即便繳稅也不得超過該量。自其他歐盟國家入境時，同等數量為僅限本人自用、須隨本人抵達車輛運輸的最高攜帶量，即便繳稅也不得增加；該限制針對包裝上無芬蘭文/瑞典文健康警示圖文的製品，故200/50/100/250等數字不應理解為對所有歐盟菸草進口的普遍硬上限。奧蘭群島適用不同的限制（細則頁本輪未抓取）。自俄羅斯進口所有香菸、小雪茄及雪茄均被禁止。自EEA外非空路入境：居住在芬蘭者旅程不超過24小時不得攜帶菸草製品、煙油及鼻菸（例外：明顯在離芬前取得）；居住在EEA外者在芬停留非過境且不超過三日的，不得攜帶（例外：明顯供本人停留期間自用）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達芬蘭時：商品超過免稅價值限額、酒類或菸草超過免稅數量或不滿足免稅條件、或攜帶須向海關出示的受限商品時選擇紅通道；自歐盟外超過免稅量攜帶菸草須選擇紅通道向海關申報並繳稅（以繳稅上限為限）。如有疑問請走紅通道向關員諮詢。入境點無通道標識時，須以其他方式向海關申報。
