procedures.name_en: Voluntary customs declaration on arrival in Iceland for goods not importable duty-free or subject to restrictions (red/green channel)
procedures.name_zh: 抵达冰岛时就不免税或受限物品的主动海关申报（红/绿通道）
procedures.agency: Iceland Revenue and Customs (Skatturinn)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers arriving in Iceland from abroad. A traveller arriving in Iceland shall voluntarily declare to a customs officer and produce all goods in their possession which they cannot import duty free or which are subject to import restrictions or prohibitions; a traveller who suspects that an item they are bringing might be restricted or prohibited should declare and produce it at customs on their own initiative. Where red and green channels operate, the red channel is for those carrying dutiable goods or goods subject to import restrictions, and the green channel for those with nothing to declare; if in doubt, choose the red channel. Customs officers can always request to examine those going through the green channel, who must render all relevant assistance (e.g. opening suitcases and containers); goods revealed as undeclared may lead to legal proceedings. Conditions that trigger the declaration (duty-free allowances): travel clothing and gear brought in by travellers residing abroad for their personal use, suitable and normal for the purpose and length of the journey; food up to 10 kg including candy, value not exceeding ISK 25,000, with meat and dairy products from outside the EEA prohibited; alcoholic beverages (examples of permitted combinations: 1 litre spirits and 0.75 litre wine and 3 litres beer; or 3 litres wine and 6 litres beer; or 1 litre spirits and 6 litres beer; or 1.5 litres wine and 12 litres beer; or 18 litres beer; spirits = over 21% alcohol, wines = other beverages 21% or less), minimum age 20; tobacco 200 cigarettes or 250 g of other tobacco products, minimum age 18; Icelandic residents may additionally bring duty-free goods worth in total up to ISK 88,000 at the place-of-purchase price (children under 12: half). The allowance must be in the traveller's own possession and presented to customs on request; it cannot be assigned to travel agencies, tour guides, bus drivers or others — if someone imports on the travellers' behalf, the per-traveller allowance does not apply and duties are due per the invoice, or per customs assessment if no invoice is presented. Duty-free admission requires the goods to be in the traveller's possession upon arrival and producible for examination (unaccompanied baggage may qualify if the traveller proves it would have qualified), and solely for personal or family use or as gifts — not for sale or commercial purposes; on leaving Iceland, travellers must take along the duty-free articles insofar as they have not been expended. Restriction examples (declare / obtain permits): telephones and communications equipment (Post and Telecom Administration permit; one GSM mobile phone exempt); used angling gear and riding clothing (disinfection certificate accepted at customs, otherwise disinfected at the holder's own cost on arrival; used leather riding gear — saddles, bridles, halters, whips — prohibited); firearms and ammunition (police permit; European firearms permit holders may import the specified firearms for stays up to three months); live animals (MAST permit); conventional medicines up to 100 days' consumption (doctor's certificate on request); plants (phytosanitary certificate; small quantities of flowers/bulbs/pot-plants from Europe exempt). Prohibition examples: narcotics and dangerous drugs; various weapons (e.g. daggers with blades exceeding 12 cm, switchblade knives, knuckles, crossbows, handcuffs); finely powdered snuff and moist oral snuff; meat and dairy products from outside the EEA. Duty-free importation gives no exemption from import restrictions or prohibitions. This is a genuine arrival declaration duty with red/green channel mechanics — not a standalone allowance filing; the allowance figures above are the conditions that determine what must be declared.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：从国外抵达冰岛的旅客。抵达冰岛的旅客应主动向海关官员申报并出示其携带的一切不能免税进口或受进口限制/禁止的物品；若怀疑所携某物品可能受限或被禁，应主动向海关申报并出示。设有红/绿通道时，携带应税物品或受限物品者走红色通道，无可申报者走绿色通道；存疑时应选择红色通道。海关官员始终可以要求检查走绿色通道的旅客，后者须提供一切必要协助（如打开行李箱和容器）；查获未按上述要求申报的物品，可能被追究法律责任。触发申报的条件（免税额度）：在国外居住的旅客为自用携入、与旅程目的和时长相称的衣物及旅行装备免税；食品（含糖果）最多 10 公斤且价值不超过 25,000 冰岛克朗，禁止自欧洲经济区以外携入肉类和乳制品；酒类（许可组合示例：烈酒 1 升+葡萄酒 0.75 升+啤酒 3 升；或葡萄酒 3 升+啤酒 6 升；或烈酒 1 升+啤酒 6 升；或葡萄酒 1.5 升+啤酒 12 升；或啤酒 18 升；烈酒指酒精含量超过 21% 的酒类，葡萄酒指啤酒以外酒精含量 21% 及以下的其他酒类），携入最低年龄 20 岁；烟草：香烟 200 支或其他烟草制品 250 克，最低年龄 18 岁；冰岛居民可另携按购买地价格计总值最高 88,000 冰岛克朗的免税品（12 岁以下儿童减半）。免税额度须在旅客本人随身占有中、应海关要求出示，不得转让给旅行社、导游、巴士司机或他人——若旅行社、司机或导游代旅客进口，上述每人额度即不适用，须按发票计征税款，无发票则由海关估价。免税入境以物品抵达时在旅客占有中、可出示查验为条件（无随行行李如旅客能证明本符合免税条件亦可），且仅限本人、家庭自用或作礼品——不得用于销售或商业目的；离开冰岛时，旅客应将免税携入且未在境内消耗的物品带走。限制示例（申报/办理许可）：电话及其他通信设备（须经邮政与电信管理局许可；一部 GSM 手机免许可）；用过的垂钓装备和骑马服装（消毒证书可交海关验看，否则抵达时自费消毒；皮革制旧骑马用具——马鞍、笼头、缰绳、马鞭——禁止进口）；枪支弹药（须警察许可；持欧洲枪支证件者拟打猎或射击运动且停留不超过三个月时，可按证件进口所列枪械及适量弹药）；活动物（须 MAST 许可）；常规药品不超过 100 天用量（海关可酌情要求医生证明）；植物（通常须经冰岛食品与兽医局背书的植物检疫证书；自欧洲携入的小量鲜花/球茎/盆栽豁免）。禁止示例：麻醉品与危险药物；各类武器（如刀刃超过 12 厘米的匕首、弹簧刀、指虎、弩、手铐）；细末鼻烟与口用湿鼻烟；来自欧洲经济区以外的肉类和乳制品。免税进口不豁免进口限制或禁止。本条是含红/绿通道机制的真实入境申报义务——并非独立的「免税额度」申报；上列免税额度数字只是判断何物须申报的条件。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival customs in Iceland: choose the red channel to declare dutiable goods or goods subject to import restrictions (and whenever in doubt); use the green channel only if you have nothing to declare; at customs examination places without separate clearance facilities, declare to the customs officer. Present the duty-free allowance goods in your possession when requested.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达冰岛海关时：携有应税物品或受限物品（以及任何时候存疑）走红色通道申报；确无可申报物品方走绿色通道；无独立通关通道设施的查验点，直接向海关官员申报。应海关要求出示随身携带的免税额度物品。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達冰島時就不免稅或受限物品的主動海關申報（紅/綠通道）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：從國外抵達冰島的旅客。抵達冰島的旅客應主動向海關官員申報並出示其攜帶的一切不能免稅進口或受進口限制/禁止的物品；若懷疑所攜某物品可能受限或被禁，應主動向海關申報並出示。設有紅/綠通道時，攜帶應稅物品或受限物品者走紅色通道，無可申報者走綠色通道；存疑時應選擇紅色通道。海關官員始終可以要求檢查走綠色通道的旅客，後者須提供一切必要協助（如打開行李箱和容器）；查獲未按上述要求申報的物品，可能被追究法律責任。觸發申報的條件（免稅額度）：在國外居住的旅客為自用攜入、與旅程目的和時長相稱的衣物及旅行裝備免稅；食品（含糖果）最多 10 公斤且價值不超過 25,000 冰島克朗，禁止自歐洲經濟區以外攜入肉類和乳製品；酒類（許可組合示例：烈酒 1 升+葡萄酒 0.75 升+啤酒 3 升；或葡萄酒 3 升+啤酒 6 升；或烈酒 1 升+啤酒 6 升；或葡萄酒 1.5 升+啤酒 12 升；或啤酒 18 升；烈酒指酒精含量超過 21% 的酒類，葡萄酒指啤酒以外酒精含量 21% 及以下的其他酒類），攜入最低年齡 20 歲；菸草：香菸 200 支或其他菸草製品 250 克，最低年齡 18 歲；冰島居民可另攜按購買地價格計總值最高 88,000 冰島克朗的免稅品（12 歲以下兒童減半）。免稅額度須在旅客本人隨身佔有中、應海關要求出示，不得轉讓給旅行社、導遊、巴士司機或他人——若旅行社、司機或導遊代旅客進口，上述每人額度即不適用，須按發票計徵稅款，無發票則由海關估價。免稅入境以物品抵達時在旅客佔有中、可出示查驗為條件（無隨行行李如旅客能證明本符合免稅條件亦可），且僅限本人、家庭自用或作禮品——不得用於銷售或商業目的；離開冰島時，旅客應將免稅攜入且未在境內消耗的物品帶走。限制示例（申報/辦理許可）：電話及其他通信設備（須經郵政與電信管理局許可；一部 GSM 手機免許可）；用過的垂釣裝備和騎馬服裝（消毒證書可交海關驗看，否則抵達時自費消毒；皮革制舊騎馬用具——馬鞍、籠頭、韁繩、馬鞭——禁止進口）；槍支彈藥（須警察許可；持歐洲槍支證件者擬打獵或射擊運動且停留不超過三個月時，可按證件進口所列槍械及適量彈藥）；活動物（須 MAST 許可）；常規藥品不超過 100 天用量（海關可酌情要求醫生證明）；植物（通常須經冰島食品與獸醫局背書的植物檢疫證書；自歐洲攜入的小量鮮花/球莖/盆栽豁免）。禁止示例：麻醉品與危險藥物；各類武器（如刀刃超過 12 釐米的匕首、彈簧刀、指虎、弩、手銬）；細末鼻菸與口用溼鼻菸；來自歐洲經濟區以外的肉類和乳製品。免稅進口不豁免進口限制或禁止。本條是含紅/綠通道機制的真實入境申報義務——並非獨立的「免稅額度」申報；上列免稅額度數字只是判斷何物須申報的條件。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達冰島海關時：攜有應稅物品或受限物品（以及任何時候存疑）走紅色通道申報；確無可申報物品方走綠色通道；無獨立通關通道設施的查驗點，直接向海關官員申報。應海關要求出示隨身攜帶的免稅額度物品。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cash to Icelandic customs on arrival or departure (form E-29, EUR 10,000 or more)
procedures.name_zh: 抵达或离开冰岛时向海关申报现金（满 1 万欧元及以上，E-29 表）
procedures.agency: Iceland Revenue and Customs (Skatturinn)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers arriving in Iceland or departing abroad must declare to customs the cash they carry at the EUR 10,000 threshold, based on the official reference rate of exchange as registered at any given time. Statutory basis and threshold boundary (inclusive): article 27a of the Customs Act no. 88/2005 (Alþingi official consolidated text, version 157c — Icelandic law as of 1 September 2026) imposes on importers, exporters and, where applicable, customs brokers, travellers, crew and users of the postal service the duty to make specially known to the customs authorities funds, in cash or bearer instruments (handhafabréf) including travellers' cheques (ferðatékkar), that are moved into Iceland from abroad or from Iceland to abroad, 'að fjárhæð sem nemur 10.000 evrum eða meira' — an amount equal to EUR 10,000 or more, at the official reference exchange rate as registered at any given time; the duty expressly extends to funds that travellers and crew carry with them (hafa meðferðis) into or out of the country, and the information is provided in the form the customs authorities determine. Exactly EUR 10,000 therefore triggers the declaration duty. Wording note: Skatturinn's English pages still say cash 'of more than € 10000' / 'exceeding an amount equal to EUR 10.000', and the E-29 form title says 'meira en € 10.000' (more than); the Icelandic page body and the current statute both state the threshold inclusively, and the current statute governs. In practice the declaration is made on form E-29 ('Skýrsla um reiðufé'), printed and handed to customs at the point of departure or arrival; the form is also obtainable from customs; the Icelandic page addresses importers, exporters and, where applicable, customs brokers, travellers and crew. Purpose: prevention of money laundering and of the illegal drug trade, the fight against terrorism and other cross-border threats; customs may seize funds suspected of being intended for offences under the penal-code provisions (cf. article 162 of the Customs Act no. 88/2005), and such cases are handed to the police; comparable rules exist in Iceland's main trading countries. Seizure and penalties are enforcement measures, not filing fees.
procedures.applicability_zh: 抵达冰岛或离境前往国外的旅客，须按任何时候登记的官方参考汇率，就随身携带的现金向海关申报，门槛为 1 万欧元。法定依据与门槛边界（包含式）：《海关法》（2005 年第 88 号法律）第 27a 条（Alþingi 官方合编本 157c 版——2026 年 9 月 1 日版冰岛法律）规定，进口人、出口人及（视情况）报关行、旅客、船员/机组及邮政服务使用者，须就自国外携入冰岛或自冰岛携往国外、以现金或无记名票据（handhafabréf，含旅行支票 ferðatékkar）形式移动的资金，按任何时候登记的官方参考汇率计算达「að fjárhæð sem nemur 10.000 evrum eða meira」（等于 1 万欧元或更多）者，专门向海关机关报告；该义务明确及于旅客与船员/机组随身携带（hafa meðferðis）进出境的资金，信息按海关机关规定的形式提供。因此恰好 1 万欧元整即触发申报义务。措辞说明：Skatturinn 英文页面仍称「more than € 10000」／「exceeding an amount equal to EUR 10.000」，E-29 表格标题亦称「meira en € 10.000」（超过）；但冰岛语页面正文与现行制定法均为包含式表述，以现行制定法为准。实践中申报使用 E-29 表（«Skýrsla um reiðufé»），填写打印后交予出境或入境地点的海关；表格也可向海关索取；冰岛语页面将义务人表述为进口人、出口人及（视情况）报关行、旅客与机组/船员。立法目的：防止洗钱、打击毒品非法交易、恐怖主义及其他跨境威胁；海关可扣押涉嫌将用于刑事犯罪处罚条款所列行为的资金（《海关法》即 2005 年第 88 号法律第 162 条），此类案件移交警方处理；冰岛主要贸易伙伴国亦有类似规则。扣押与处罚属执法措施，并非申报费用。
procedures.timing_en: At the point of departure or arrival: complete form E-29 (pdf), print it and hand it to the customs (tollgæslan) at the departure or arrival point; the form can also be obtained from customs on the spot.
procedures.timing_zh: 在出境或入境地点办理：填写 E-29 表（pdf），打印后交予该出境或入境地点的海关（tollgæslan）；表格也可向海关现场索取。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 抵達或離開冰島時向海關申報現金（滿 1 萬歐元及以上，E-29 表）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 抵達冰島或離境前往國外的旅客，須按任何時候登記的官方參考匯率，就隨身攜帶的現金向海關申報，門檻為 1 萬歐元。法定依據與門檻邊界（包含式）：《海關法》（2005 年第 88 號法律）第 27a 條（Alþingi 官方合編本 157c 版——2026 年 9 月 1 日版冰島法律）規定，進口人、出口人及（視情況）報關行、旅客、船員/機組及郵政服務使用者，須就自國外攜入冰島或自冰島攜往國外、以現金或無記名票據（handhafabréf，含旅行支票 ferðatékkar）形式移動的資金，按任何時候登記的官方參考匯率計算達「að fjárhæð sem nemur 10.000 evrum eða meira」（等於 1 萬歐元或更多）者，專門向海關機關報告；該義務明確及於旅客與船員/機組隨身攜帶（hafa meðferðis）進出境的資金，資訊按海關機關規定的形式提供。因此恰好 1 萬歐元整即觸發申報義務。措辭說明：Skatturinn 英文頁面仍稱「more than € 10000」／「exceeding an amount equal to EUR 10.000」，E-29 表格標題亦稱「meira en € 10.000」（超過）；但冰島語頁面正文與現行制定法均為包含式表述，以現行制定法為準。實踐中申報使用 E-29 表（«Skýrsla um reiðufé»），填寫列印後交予出境或入境地點的海關；表格也可向海關索取；冰島語頁面將義務人表述為進口人、出口人及（視情況）報關行、旅客與機組/船員。立法目的：防止洗錢、打擊毒品非法交易、恐怖主義及其他跨境威脅；海關可扣押涉嫌將用於刑事犯罪處罰條款所列行為的資金（《海關法》即 2005 年第 88 號法律第 162 條），此類案件移交警方處理；冰島主要貿易伙伴國亦有類似規則。扣押與處罰屬執法措施，並非申報費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在出境或入境地點辦理：填寫 E-29 表（pdf），列印後交予該出境或入境地點的海關（tollgæslan）；表格也可向海關現場索取。

procedures.name_en: Temporary import of a foreign-registered vehicle — pre-arrival declaration E-9 to the Directorate of Customs
procedures.name_zh: 临时入境外国牌照车辆——抵达前向海关局提交 E-9 申报
procedures.agency: Iceland Revenue and Customs (Skatturinn) — declaration addressed to the Directorate of Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Those intending to visit Iceland for a period of a year or less for the purpose of employment, study or travel may import a vehicle registered abroad without having to pay duty or import charges (temporary duty-free import of vehicles with foreign registration plates, subject to conditions); at the end of this period the importer of the vehicle must either have completed its customs clearance or exported the vehicle. Prior to arriving in Iceland, importers of vehicles must complete a special declaration (E-9) and send it to the Directorate of Customs in consultation with the carrier or customs broker.
procedures.applicability_zh: 拟在冰岛停留一年及以内、以工作、学习或旅行为目的的访客，可免缴关税与进口费用输入一辆在境外登记的车辆（外国牌照车辆临时免税入境，须符合条件）；该期限届满时，车辆进口人必须完成该车的海关通关或将车辆复出口。抵达冰岛之前，车辆进口人必须填写专门申报表（E-9），并与承运人或报关行协商后送达海关局（Directorate of Customs）。
procedures.timing_en: Before arriving in Iceland: complete declaration E-9 and send it to the Directorate of Customs in consultation with the carrier or customs broker. The customs clearance or export of the vehicle falls due at the end of the permitted period (up to one year).
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达冰岛之前：填写 E-9 申报并与承运人或报关行协商后送达海关局。许可期限（最长一年）届满时须完成车辆海关通关或将其复出口。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 臨時入境外國牌照車輛——抵達前向海關局提交 E-9 申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 擬在冰島停留一年及以內、以工作、學習或旅行為目的的訪客，可免繳關稅與進口費用輸入一輛在境外登記的車輛（外國牌照車輛臨時免稅入境，須符合條件）；該期限屆滿時，車輛進口人必須完成該車的海關通關或將車輛復出口。抵達冰島之前，車輛進口人必須填寫專門申報表（E-9），並與承運人或報關行協商後送達海關局（Directorate of Customs）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達冰島之前：填寫 E-9 申報並與承運人或報關行協商後送達海關局。許可期限（最長一年）屆滿時須完成車輛海關通關或將其復出口。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration when entering or leaving the EU at an Irish airport or port (EUR 10,000 or more)
procedures.name_zh: 经爱尔兰机场或港口进出欧盟的随身现金申报（1 万欧元及以上）
procedures.agency: Revenue — Irish Tax and Customs
procedures.applicability_en: If you enter or leave the European Union (EU) at an Irish airport or port carrying cash of EUR 10,000 or more, you must make a declaration to Customs; the provisions also apply to a cash equivalent of EUR 10,000 or more in other currencies. Cash includes banknotes and coins (including currency now out of general circulation but still exchangeable in a financial institution or central bank); cheques, travellers' cheques, promissory notes or money orders without a named beneficiary; gold coins with a gold content of at least 90%; and gold bars, gold nuggets or clumps with a gold content of at least 99.5% (gold included from 1 June 2021). Since 1 January 2021 the UK is no longer an EU member: the rules apply to movements of cash of EUR 10,000 or more to or from the UK, including the Isle of Man and the Channel Islands, but per the page note they do not apply to movements of cash to or from Northern Ireland. Scope of the handover point: the Overview page (Travelling with, or sending, cash) triggers the declaration only when you enter or leave the EU at an Irish airport or port; the 'where to make your declaration' page does list 'land frontier' among the places to give in your form, but that is its generic wording and it has no operative scope for this declaration in Ireland — Ireland's only land frontier is with Northern Ireland, and the Overview note excludes movements of cash to or from Northern Ireland, so the Northern Ireland exclusion takes precedence and the relevant handover points are Irish airports and ports. The declaration is required to comply with European and national legislation and to deter illegal activities such as money laundering. Procedure: complete the Revenue Cash declaration form, plus the Cash declaration additional sheet form where the space on the main form is not sufficient; the forms are also available from Customs offices at all airports and ports, and other EU-language versions are on the Europa website. Give the completed form to Customs at the airport or port through which you enter or leave the EU — Dublin Airport departures: use the courtesy phone in the public area of the arrivals hall to contact the main Customs office; Dublin Airport arrivals: give the form to a Customs officer in the red channel; Shannon Airport departures: Customs booth in the transit lounge, or the box provided if unattended; Shannon Airport arrivals: Customs officer in the Customs hall, or the post box provided if no officer is present; Knock Airport: forms are on the wall opposite baggage belt number 1 in the baggage reclaim area and in the screening area at the entrance to the departure lounge, and the completed form goes in the post box provided if no Customs officer is present; other airports and ports: contact the Customs authorities there. Customs may check the declaration and the cash to ensure the amount declared is correct, and you may request a stamped copy of the completed declaration. Unaccompanied movements — sending or receiving cash of EUR 10,000 or more by post, freight or courier — are a separate cash disclosure declaration, outside this traveller procedure.
procedures.applicability_zh: 在爱尔兰机场或港口进入或离开欧盟时，随身携带 1 万欧元或以上现金须向海关申报；等值外币现金达到 1 万欧元及以上同样适用。现金包括：纸币和硬币（含已停止流通但仍可在金融机构或央行兑换的币种）；无记名收款人的支票、旅行支票、本票或汇票；含金量至少 90% 的金币；含金量至少 99.5% 的金条、天然金块或金块（黄金自 2021 年 6 月 1 日起纳入）。英国自 2021 年 1 月 1 日起不再属于欧盟：与英国之间 1 万欧元及以上的现金移动适用本规则，包括马恩岛和海峡群岛；但页面注释明确写着本规则不适用于与北爱尔兰之间的现金移动。关于递交地点的范围：Overview 页（Travelling with, or sending, cash）明确申报义务仅在经爱尔兰机场或港口进出欧盟时触发；“申报地点”页确实把“陆路边境”列入可递交表格的地点，但那只是该页的泛用表述，在爱尔兰并无实际适用范围——爱尔兰唯一的陆路边境即北爱尔兰方向，而 Overview 注释明确排除与北爱尔兰之间的现金移动，北爱除外优先，因此实际相关的递交地点为爱尔兰的机场和港口。申报系为遵守欧洲及本国立法、震慑洗钱等违法活动。办理：填写 Revenue 现金申报表，主表空间不足时加填现金申报补充表；两表也可在所有机场和港口的海关办事处领取，欧盟其他语言版本见 Europa 网站。填妥的表格交给你进出欧盟所经机场或港口的海关——都柏林机场出发：用到境厅公共区域的 courtesy phone 联系海关总署；都柏林机场到达：交给红通道的海关关员；香农机场出发：交中转厅的海关亭，无人值守时投入指定箱；香农机场到达：向海关厅的关员申报，无人在场时投入指定邮箱；Knock 机场：表格在行李提取区 1 号行李转盘对面的墙上及出发厅入口安检处领取，无海关关员在场时将填妥表格投入指定邮箱；其他机场和港口：联系当地海关当局。海关可核对该申报及现金以确保申报金额正确，旅客可要求获得已填申报表的盖章副本。经邮递、货运或快递寄送或接收 1 万欧元及以上现金的非随身移动，属独立的现金披露申报，不在本旅客程序范围。
procedures.timing_en: At the border crossing itself, in either direction: the completed paper form is handed to Customs at the airport or port through which you enter or leave the EU, with the airport-specific arrangements listed in applicability (all three Revenue pages marked Published: 04 May 2026). The pages describe a paper form lodged on the spot; no online traveller filing is described.
procedures.timing_zh: 在越过边境当时办理，方向不限：填妥的纸质表格交给你进出欧盟所经机场或港口的海关，各机场具体安排见适用性字段（三个 Revenue 页面均标注发布日期 2026 年 5 月 4 日）。页面只描述当场递交纸质表格，未提供旅客在线申报渠道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 經愛爾蘭機場或港口進出歐盟的隨身現金申報（1 萬歐元及以上）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 在愛爾蘭機場或港口進入或離開歐盟時，隨身攜帶 1 萬歐元或以上現金須向海關申報；等值外幣現金達到 1 萬歐元及以上同樣適用。現金包括：紙幣和硬幣（含已停止流通但仍可在金融機構或央行兌換的幣種）；無記名收款人的支票、旅行支票、本票或匯票；含金量至少 90% 的金幣；含金量至少 99.5% 的金條、天然金塊或金塊（黃金自 2021 年 6 月 1 日起納入）。英國自 2021 年 1 月 1 日起不再屬於歐盟：與英國之間 1 萬歐元及以上的現金移動適用本規則，包括馬恩島和海峽群島；但頁面註釋明確寫著本規則不適用於與北愛爾蘭之間的現金移動。關於遞交地點的範圍：Overview 頁（Travelling with, or sending, cash）明確申報義務僅在經愛爾蘭機場或港口進出歐盟時觸發；“申報地點”頁確實把“陸路邊境”列入可遞交表格的地點，但那只是該頁的泛用表述，在愛爾蘭並無實際適用範圍——愛爾蘭唯一的陸路邊境即北愛爾蘭方向，而 Overview 註釋明確排除與北愛爾蘭之間的現金移動，北愛除外優先，因此實際相關的遞交地點為愛爾蘭的機場和港口。申報系為遵守歐洲及本國立法、震懾洗錢等違法活動。辦理：填寫 Revenue 現金申報表，主表空間不足時加填現金申報補充表；兩表也可在所有機場和港口的海關辦事處領取，歐盟其他語言版本見 Europa 網站。填妥的表格交給你進出歐盟所經機場或港口的海關——都柏林機場出發：用到境廳公共區域的 courtesy phone 聯繫海關總署；都柏林機場到達：交給紅通道的海關關員；香農機場出發：交中轉廳的海關亭，無人值守時投入指定箱；香農機場到達：向海關廳的關員申報，無人在場時投入指定信箱；Knock 機場：表格在行李提取區 1 號行李轉盤對面的牆上及出發廳入口安檢處領取，無海關關員在場時將填妥表格投入指定信箱；其他機場和港口：聯繫當地海關當局。海關可核對該申報及現金以確保申報金額正確，旅客可要求獲得已填申報表的蓋章副本。經郵遞、貨運或快遞寄送或接收 1 萬歐元及以上現金的非隨身移動，屬獨立的現金披露申報，不在本旅客程序範圍。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在越過邊境當時辦理，方向不限：填妥的紙質表格交給你進出歐盟所經機場或港口的海關，各機場具體安排見適用性欄位（三個 Revenue 頁面均標註發佈日期 2026 年 5 月 4 日）。頁面只描述當場遞交紙質表格，未提供旅客線上申報渠道。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding duty-free allowances
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报
procedures.agency: Revenue — Irish Tax and Customs
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving in Ireland from outside the EU, goods are free of duty and tax up to a combined value of EUR 430 (traveller aged 15 or over) or EUR 215 (under 15); if a single item is worth more than the allowance, duty or tax is charged on the full value, and duty-free goods bought when travelling out from Ireland count as part of the allowance. Alcohol (no allowance under 17): 1 litre of spirits (whiskey, gin, vodka and so on) or 2 litres of other alcoholic drinks with no more than 22% alcohol (for example port, sherry, sparkling wine and some liqueurs), plus 4 litres of still wine and 16 litres of beer; the allowance may be split on a fractional basis, for example 0.5 litres of spirits and 1 litre of port. Tobacco (no allowance under 17): 200 cigarettes, 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars or 250 g smoking tobacco, likewise splittable on a fractional basis; the import of oral smokeless tobacco is generally prohibited. Reduced separate quotas apply to transport crews (not a halving of the traveller allowance): 40 cigarettes, 20 cigarillos, 10 cigars or 50 g smoking tobacco; 0.35 litres of spirits or 0.50 litres of other alcoholic drinks with no more than 22% alcohol, plus 0.75 litres of still wine and 4 litres of beer. The allowances require the goods to be transported and accompanied by the traveller, to be for own use or a gift and not for commercial purposes, and cannot be shared with other people travelling in the group; travellers under 17 are not entitled to tobacco or alcohol allowances. Customs Duty, Excise Duty and Value-Added Tax, where applicable, are charged on goods in excess of the duty-free allowances, and any goods imported for commercial purposes must be declared to a customs officer. Cash of EUR 10,000 or more is a separate declaration to Customs (see ie-cash-declaration).
procedures.applicability_zh: 自欧盟外入境爱尔兰：一般商品免税的合并价值限额为 15 岁及以上 430 欧、15 岁以下 215 欧；单件商品价值超过限额的，就其全部价值征收关税或税款，出境时在爱尔兰购买的免税商品也计入限额。酒类（17 岁以下无额度）：烈酒（威士忌、金酒、伏特加等）1 升，或酒精含量不超过 22% 的其他酒类（如波特酒、雪莉酒、起泡酒及某些利口酒）2 升，另加不起泡葡萄酒 4 升、啤酒 16 升；可按比例拆分，例如烈酒 0.5 升加波特酒 1 升。烟草（17 岁以下无额度）：香烟 200 支、小雪茄 100 支、雪茄 50 支或吸烟用烟丝 250 克，同样可按比例拆分；口含无烟烟草的进口一般被禁止。运输机组人员适用单独的较低额度（并非旅客额度减半）：香烟 40 支、小雪茄 20 支、雪茄 10 支或烟丝 50 克；烈酒 0.35 升或酒精含量不超过 22% 的其他酒类 0.50 升，另加不起泡葡萄酒 0.75 升、啤酒 4 升。享受免税须商品由旅客本人运输并随身携带、供自用或作礼品且非商业用途，额度不得与同团他人共享；17 岁以下旅客不享有烟草和酒类额度。超过免税额的商品视情况征收关税、消费税和增值税，任何以商业目的进口的商品必须向海关关员申报。随身 1 万欧元及以上现金另行走海关申报程序（见 ie-cash-declaration）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in Ireland from outside the EU: goods in excess of the allowances are declared to a customs officer, with Customs Duty, Excise Duty and VAT charged where applicable. Both source pages were re-fetched and verified on 2026-09-27 (each marked Published: 22 December 2025).
procedures.timing_zh: 自欧盟外入境爱尔兰时：超额商品向海关关员申报，视情况征收关税、消费税和增值税。两个来源页均于 2026-09-27 重新直取核实（各标注发布日期 2025 年 12 月 22 日）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自歐盟外入境愛爾蘭：一般商品免稅的合併價值限額為 15 歲及以上 430 歐、15 歲以下 215 歐；單件商品價值超過限額的，就其全部價值徵收關稅或稅款，出境時在愛爾蘭購買的免稅商品也計入限額。酒類（17 歲以下無額度）：烈酒（威士忌、金酒、伏特加等）1 升，或酒精含量不超過 22% 的其他酒類（如波特酒、雪莉酒、起泡酒及某些利口酒）2 升，另加不起泡葡萄酒 4 升、啤酒 16 升；可按比例拆分，例如烈酒 0.5 升加波特酒 1 升。菸草（17 歲以下無額度）：香菸 200 支、小雪茄 100 支、雪茄 50 支或吸菸用菸絲 250 克，同樣可按比例拆分；口含無煙菸草的進口一般被禁止。運輸機組人員適用單獨的較低額度（並非旅客額度減半）：香菸 40 支、小雪茄 20 支、雪茄 10 支或菸絲 50 克；烈酒 0.35 升或酒精含量不超過 22% 的其他酒類 0.50 升，另加不起泡葡萄酒 0.75 升、啤酒 4 升。享受免稅須商品由旅客本人運輸並隨身攜帶、供自用或作禮品且非商業用途，額度不得與同團他人共享；17 歲以下旅客不享有菸草和酒類額度。超過免稅額的商品視情況徵收關稅、消費稅和增值稅，任何以商業目的進口的商品必須向海關關員申報。隨身 1 萬歐元及以上現金另行走海關申報程序（見 ie-cash-declaration）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 自歐盟外入境愛爾蘭時：超額商品向海關關員申報，視情況徵收關稅、消費稅和增值稅。兩個來源頁均於 2026-09-27 重新直取核實（各標註發佈日期 2025 年 12 月 22 日）。

procedures.name_en: Declaring goods over duty-free allowances on arrival in the Isle of Man from outside the UK (red channel / red point phone, or online from 72 hours before arrival)
procedures.name_zh: 从英国以外地区抵达马恩岛时申报超额物品（红色通道/红色电话点，或抵港前 72 小时起在线申报）
procedures.agency: Isle of Man Customs and Excise (Customs and Immigration, Isle of Man Treasury)
procedures.applicability_en: Scope and direction: travellers arriving in the Isle of Man from a country other than the UK — the page's own scope is 'When travelling from a country other than the UK you can bring goods up to specified limits without paying duty and/or tax (VAT), known as duty-free allowances'. Arrivals from the UK are covered by IM-arrival-from-uk-goods-declaration (gov.im Travelling to the Island from the UK page, captured 2026-09-29). The allowances apply only to goods for your own use, transported by you; goods for sale or any payment are commercial use and the allowances do not apply. Allowances: alcohol (no allowance under 17) — 4 litres of spirits or strong liqueurs over 22% ABV, or 9 litres of fortified wine (such as port or sherry), sparkling wine or any other alcoholic beverage of less than 22% ABV, combinable within the total alcohol allowance; in addition, 42 litres of beer and 18 litres of still wine. Tobacco (no allowance under 17) — 200 cigarettes, or 100 cigarillos, or 50 cigars, or 250g of tobacco (including shisha tobacco), or 200 sticks of tobacco for heating, combinable within the total tobacco allowance; alcohol and tobacco allowances cannot be combined. Under-18 rule: if a person under 18 can legally buy alcohol duty-free in the country of purchase, any alcohol and tobacco brought back to the Island must be declared before arrival in the Isle of Man. Other goods (including gifts and souvenirs) — most travellers up to £390; passengers travelling by private plane or boat for pleasure purposes only £270. Declaration action: if the goods listed exceed the limits shown, speak to a Customs Officer present or use the red phone (red phones are located in the arrivals hall at Ronaldsway Airport and the Sea Terminal); when arriving with personal goods or cash to declare you must use the red channel or the red point phone. You may alternatively pay any tax and duty due from 72 hours in advance of arrival using the HMRC Online Service for Passengers; having declared online and having nothing further to declare, you may use the green channel, retaining the reference number and email receipt as an officer may ask to check it. Consequences: if you bring in goods over your allowance you must pay taxes on all of the goods in that category, not just those above the allowance; you cannot share your personal allowances with other passengers; if you do not declare goods exceeding these limits, all goods carried within that allowance category may be seized, not just the excess. Declaration methods: per the gov.im imports-and-exports page, most personal goods can be declared by conduct (for example the green channel) or by oral declaration to an officer at a red channel, and these methods are still legal declarations. Duty rates: not stated on the captured pages (the Isle of Man aligns customs and excise duty rates with the UK under the Customs and Excise Agreement 1979 and signposts GOV.UK simplified rates), so the rate is recorded as unknown.
procedures.applicability_zh: 范围与方向：从英国以外国家抵达马恩岛的旅客——页面自身口径为“从英国以外的国家旅行时，可在指定限额内免缴关税和/或税项（VAT）携入物品，即免税额度”。从英国抵达的规则见 IM-arrival-from-uk-goods-declaration（gov.im《Travelling to the Island from the UK》页，2026-09-29 已取得）。额度仅适用于自用并由本人携带运输的物品；用于出售或收取任何对价的属商业用途，不适用额度。额度：酒类（17 岁以下无额度）——22% ABV 以上烈酒或高度利口酒 4 升，或加强型葡萄酒（如波特酒、雪莉酒）、起泡酒及其他 22% ABV 以下酒精饮料 9 升，可在酒类总额度内合并；另可携入啤酒 42 升、静态葡萄酒 18 升。烟草（17 岁以下无额度）——卷烟 200 支，或小雪茄 100 支，或雪茄 50 支，或烟草（含水烟丝）250 克，或加热烟草棒 200 支，可在烟草总额度内合并；酒类与烟草额度不可相互合并。18 岁以下规则：在购买国可合法购买免税酒类的 18 岁以下旅客，携回岛上的任何酒类和烟草必须在抵达马恩岛前申报。其他物品（含礼品与纪念品）——多数旅客不超过 £390；乘私人飞机或游艇休闲抵达的旅客仅为 £270。申报动作：所列物品超过所示限额时，请向在场的海关关员申报或使用红色电话（Ronaldsway 机场与海运码头到港厅设有红色电话）；抵达时携有应申报的个人物品或现金，必须走红色通道或使用红色电话点。也可在抵达前 72 小时起使用 HMRC 旅客在线服务（Online Service for Passengers）缴纳应付税款并申报；已在线申报且无其他应申报事项者可走绿色通道，并保留申报参考号与电子邮件回执备查。后果：携入超过额度的物品，须就该类别全部物品（而非仅超额部分）计税；个人额度不得与其他旅客共享；未申报超额物品的，该额度类别内携带的全部物品均可能被扣押，而非仅超额部分。申报方式：据 gov.im 进出口页，多数自用物品可以行为方式申报（如走绿色通道）或在红色通道向关员口头申报，此类方式仍属法定申报。税率：已获取页面未列明（马恩岛依据 1979 年《海关与货物税协定》与英国对齐关税与货物税率，并链接 GOV.UK 简化税率），故税率记录为 unknown。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in the Isle of Man from outside the UK: declare over-allowance goods to a Customs Officer (in person, by red phone, or via the red channel / red point phone), or pay and declare from 72 hours before arrival through the Online Service for Passengers and then use the green channel if nothing further to declare; duty-free alcohol/tobacco bought abroad by an under-18 traveller must be declared before arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 从英国以外抵达马恩岛时：超额物品向海关关员申报（当面、红色电话，或红色通道/红色电话点）；或在抵达前 72 小时起通过旅客在线服务完税申报，之后如无其他应申报事项可走绿色通道；18 岁以下旅客在境外购买的免税烟酒须在抵达前申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 從英國以外地區抵達馬恩島時申報超額物品（紅色通道/紅色電話點，或抵港前 72 小時起線上申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 範圍與方向：從英國以外國家抵達馬恩島的旅客——頁面自身口徑為“從英國以外的國家旅行時，可在指定限額內免繳關稅和/或稅項（VAT）攜入物品，即免稅額度”。從英國抵達的規則見 IM-arrival-from-uk-goods-declaration（gov.im《Travelling to the Island from the UK》頁，2026-09-29 已取得）。額度僅適用於自用並由本人攜帶運輸的物品；用於出售或收取任何對價的屬商業用途，不適用額度。額度：酒類（17 歲以下無額度）——22% ABV 以上烈酒或高度利口酒 4 升，或加強型葡萄酒（如波特酒、雪莉酒）、起泡酒及其他 22% ABV 以下酒精飲料 9 升，可在酒類總額度內合併；另可攜入啤酒 42 升、靜態葡萄酒 18 升。菸草（17 歲以下無額度）——捲菸 200 支，或小雪茄 100 支，或雪茄 50 支，或菸草（含水煙絲）250 克，或加熱菸草棒 200 支，可在菸草總額度內合併；酒類與菸草額度不可相互合併。18 歲以下規則：在購買國可合法購買免稅酒類的 18 歲以下旅客，攜回島上的任何酒類和菸草必須在抵達馬恩島前申報。其他物品（含禮品與紀念品）——多數旅客不超過 £390；乘私人飛機或遊艇休閒抵達的旅客僅為 £270。申報動作：所列物品超過所示限額時，請向在場的海關關員申報或使用紅色電話（Ronaldsway 機場與海運碼頭到港廳設有紅色電話）；抵達時攜有應申報的個人物品或現金，必須走紅色通道或使用紅色電話點。也可在抵達前 72 小時起使用 HMRC 旅客線上服務（Online Service for Passengers）繳納應付稅款並申報；已線上申報且無其他應申報事項者可走綠色通道，並保留申報參考號與電子郵件回執備查。後果：攜入超過額度的物品，須就該類別全部物品（而非僅超額部分）計稅；個人額度不得與其他旅客共享；未申報超額物品的，該額度類別內攜帶的全部物品均可能被扣押，而非僅超額部分。申報方式：據 gov.im 進出口頁，多數自用物品可以行為方式申報（如走綠色通道）或在紅色通道向關員口頭申報，此類方式仍屬法定申報。稅率：已獲取頁面未列明（馬恩島依據 1979 年《海關與貨物稅協定》與英國對齊關稅與貨物稅率，並連結 GOV.UK 簡化稅率），故稅率記錄為 unknown。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 從英國以外抵達馬恩島時：超額物品向海關關員申報（當面、紅色電話，或紅色通道/紅色電話點）；或在抵達前 72 小時起通過旅客線上服務完稅申報，之後如無其他應申報事項可走綠色通道；18 歲以下旅客在境外購買的免稅菸酒須在抵達前申報。

procedures.name_en: Declaring goods when arriving in the Isle of Man from the UK (Red Channel where available, or red phone point at the Sea Terminal and Ronaldsway Airport)
procedures.name_zh: 从英国抵达马恩岛时的货物申报（红色通道（如有）或海运码头与 Ronaldsway 机场的红色电话点）
procedures.agency: Isle of Man Customs and Excise (Customs and Immigration, Isle of Man Treasury)
procedures.applicability_en: Scope and direction: travellers arriving in the Isle of Man from the UK — the page's own scope is 'this page relates only to travel from the UK to the Island'; arrivals from a country other than the UK are covered by IM-arrival-goods-over-allowance-declaration. Core rule: travelling from the UK to the Island you may bring in unlimited amounts of most goods — an allowance-free rule for 'most goods' only, not for all goods: the page states no duty-free allowances for UK arrivals, and certain goods remain prohibited or restricted regardless of the country travelled from, so UK arrival must not be read as 'nothing to declare'. Conditional declaration duty: you must use the Red Channel (where available) or Red Phone if you have goods or cash to declare, have commercial goods for which you require customs assistance or clearance, or are not sure about what you need to declare. Where to declare: at the Sea Terminal and Ronaldsway Airport there is a red phone point where you can declare goods. Cash, kept separate: declaring cash carried into the Island is a separate procedure — see IM-cash-declaration-over-10000.
procedures.applicability_zh: 范围与方向：从英国抵达马恩岛的旅客——页面自身口径为“本页仅涉及从英国前往马恩岛的旅行”；从英国以外国家抵达的情形见 IM-arrival-goods-over-allowance-declaration。核心规则：从英国前往马恩岛可无限量携入多数货品——这是仅适用于“多数”货品的无额度规则，不等于所有货品：本页未对英国抵达者设任何免税额度，且无论从哪国出发，特定货物仍属禁止或受管制，不得把英国抵达理解为“全部免申报”。条件性申报义务：有货物或现金要申报、携有需海关协助或清关的商业货物、或不确定需申报什么的，必须使用红色通道（如有）或红色电话。申报地点：海运码头（Sea Terminal）与 Ronaldsway 机场设有可申报货物的红色电话点。现金（单列）：携入马恩岛现金的申报为单独程序——见 IM-cash-declaration-over-10000。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in the Isle of Man from the UK: unlimited amounts of most goods may be brought in (no duty-free allowance is stated), but use the Red Channel (where available) or the red phone point at the Sea Terminal or Ronaldsway Airport if you have goods or cash to declare, have commercial goods requiring customs assistance or clearance, or are not sure what you need to declare.
procedures.timing_zh: 从英国抵达马恩岛时：可无限量携入多数货品（本页未设免税额度），但有货物或现金要申报、携有需海关协助或清关的商业货物、或不确定需申报事项的，必须使用红色通道（如有）或海运码头/Ronaldsway 机场的红色电话点。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 從英國抵達馬恩島時的貨物申報（紅色通道（如有）或海運碼頭與 Ronaldsway 機場的紅色電話點）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 範圍與方向：從英國抵達馬恩島的旅客——頁面自身口徑為“本頁僅涉及從英國前往馬恩島的旅行”；從英國以外國家抵達的情形見 IM-arrival-goods-over-allowance-declaration。核心規則：從英國前往馬恩島可無限量攜入多數貨品——這是僅適用於“多數”貨品的無額度規則，不等於所有貨品：本頁未對英國抵達者設任何免稅額度，且無論從哪國出發，特定貨物仍屬禁止或受管制，不得把英國抵達理解為“全部免申報”。條件性申報義務：有貨物或現金要申報、攜有需海關協助或清關的商業貨物、或不確定需申報什麼的，必須使用紅色通道（如有）或紅色電話。申報地點：海運碼頭（Sea Terminal）與 Ronaldsway 機場設有可申報貨物的紅色電話點。現金（單列）：攜入馬恩島現金的申報為單獨程序——見 IM-cash-declaration-over-10000。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 從英國抵達馬恩島時：可無限量攜入多數貨品（本頁未設免稅額度），但有貨物或現金要申報、攜有需海關協助或清關的商業貨物、或不確定需申報事項的，必須使用紅色通道（如有）或海運碼頭/Ronaldsway 機場的紅色電話點。

procedures.name_en: Disclosing cash when arriving in or leaving Jersey — on request (any amount), plus voluntary pre-travel disclosure over €10,000
procedures.name_zh: 进出泽西岛时的现金披露——应关员要求披露（任何金额），及超过 1 万欧元的自愿行前申报
procedures.agency: Jersey Customs and Immigration Service, Government of Jersey
procedures.applicability_en: Two distinct rules on the official Jersey Customs and Immigration Service page; neither is a mandatory pre-travel cash declaration. (1) Conditional duty to disclose when asked: when you arrive in or leave Jersey, you may be asked to reveal the amount of cash you are carrying to a Jersey Customs and Immigration Service officer; the page states this without any amount qualification, so it applies to cash of any amount; if you fail to disclose any cash you are carrying when asked to do so, or if you make a false disclosure, you could be fined up to £5,000 or imprisoned for up to two years, or both. Cash on this page includes travellers' cheques, cheques, promissory notes, money orders and coins. (2) Voluntary disclosure over €10,000: if you are entering or leaving Jersey with more than 10,000 euros (or the equivalent in any other currency) you can make a voluntary cash disclosure; the form can be filled out in advance and sent to the Service before you travel. The euro threshold is exclusive ('more than 10,000 euros') and the disclosure is optional — the page states no duty to declare cash proactively at any amount and sets no penalty for not making the voluntary disclosure; penalties attach only to non-disclosure or false disclosure when asked. Do not mix currencies: the disclosure threshold is EUR 10,000 while the penalty ceiling is GBP 5,000. Statute referenced by the page: Customs and Excise (Jersey) Law 1999 (linked to the Jersey Law website). Contact: Jersey Customs and Immigration Service, Union Street, St Helier JE2 3DN; +44 1534 448000; rgc@gov.je.
procedures.applicability_zh: 官方泽西岛海关与移民局页面区分两项规则，二者均非强制的行前现金申报。（1）应要求披露的条件性义务：抵达或离开泽西岛时，关员可能要求你披露所携带现金的金额；页面未对该权力作任何金额限定，即适用于任何金额的现金；被要求披露时未披露或作虚假披露的，可被罚款最高 5,000 英镑或监禁最高两年，或并罚。页面所称现金包括旅行支票、支票、本票、汇票和硬币。（2）超过 1 万欧元的自愿披露：进入或离开泽西岛时携带超过 10,000 欧元（或等值任何其他货币）者，可以作自愿现金披露；该表可提前填写并在旅行前寄送该局。欧元门槛为不含本数（“超过 10,000 欧元”）且披露属自愿——页面未规定任何金额的主动申报义务，也未对不作自愿披露设定罚则；处罚仅针对被要求披露时未披露或虚假披露。勿混用币种：披露门槛为 10,000 欧元，罚金上限为 5,000 英镑。页面援引法律：《1999 年海关与货物税（泽西）法》（Customs and Excise (Jersey) Law 1999，链接至 Jersey Law 网站）。联系方式：泽西海关与移民局，Union Street, St Helier JE2 3DN；+44 1534 448000；rgc@gov.je。
procedures.timing_en: On request, when arriving in or leaving Jersey (any cash amount): disclose the amount truthfully to the officer. Voluntarily, before travel: travellers entering or leaving with more than 10,000 euros (or the equivalent in any other currency) may fill out the voluntary cash disclosure form in advance and send it to the Service before travelling.
procedures.timing_zh: 应要求：抵达或离开泽西岛时，按关员要求如实披露现金金额（任何金额均适用）。自愿：行前——进出泽西岛携带超过 10,000 欧元（或等值其他货币）者，可提前填写自愿现金披露表并于旅行前寄送该局。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出澤西島時的現金披露——應關員要求披露（任何金額），及超過 1 萬歐元的自願行前申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 官方澤西島海關與移民局頁面區分兩項規則，二者均非強制的行前現金申報。（1）應要求披露的條件性義務：抵達或離開澤西島時，關員可能要求你披露所攜帶現金的金額；頁面未對該權力作任何金額限定，即適用於任何金額的現金；被要求披露時未披露或作虛假披露的，可被罰款最高 5,000 英鎊或監禁最高兩年，或並罰。頁面所稱現金包括旅行支票、支票、本票、匯票和硬幣。（2）超過 1 萬歐元的自願披露：進入或離開澤西島時攜帶超過 10,000 歐元（或等值任何其他貨幣）者，可以作自願現金披露；該表可提前填寫並在旅行前寄送該局。歐元門檻為不含本數（“超過 10,000 歐元”）且披露屬自願——頁面未規定任何金額的主動申報義務，也未對不作自願披露設定罰則；處罰僅針對被要求披露時未披露或虛假披露。勿混用幣種：披露門檻為 10,000 歐元，罰金上限為 5,000 英鎊。頁面援引法律：《1999 年海關與貨物稅（澤西）法》（Customs and Excise (Jersey) Law 1999，連結至 Jersey Law 網站）。聯繫方式：澤西海關與移民局，Union Street, St Helier JE2 3DN；+44 1534 448000；rgc@gov.je。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 應要求：抵達或離開澤西島時，按關員要求如實披露現金金額（任何金額均適用）。自願：行前——進出澤西島攜帶超過 10,000 歐元（或等值其他貨幣）者，可提前填寫自願現金披露表並於旅行前寄送該局。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding allowances
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报
procedures.agency: State Revenue Service / Valsts ieņēmumu dienests (VID)
procedures.applicability_en: Entering Latvia from a country outside the EU (or named special EU territories such as the Canary Islands or Aland Islands, treated as non-EU): goods for personal use or gifts are duty-free per person up to EUR 300 by land and EUR 430 by air or sea; children under 15 are capped at a flat EUR 285 regardless of travel mode. Personal medicines and tobacco, alcohol and fuel within the quantitative limits are excluded from the value calculation. Excise goods are duty-free at most once every 30 days: tobacco — 40 cigarettes, 20 cigarillos, 10 cigars or 50 g of smoking tobacco by road/rail/sea and 200 cigarettes, 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars or 250 g by air (combinations allowed up to a 100% total of the individual percentages); alcohol — 1 L above 22% vol. or 2 L up to 22% vol., plus 4 L of still wine and 16 L of beer (same 100% combination rule); no alcohol allowance below age 18, and persons under 20 may not bring tobacco products, tobacco substitutes, herbal smoking products, electronic smoking devices or refill containers. EU sanctions prohibit importing spirit drinks, cigarettes, cigarillos and cigars from Russia and Belarus (naturally fermented wine and beer without artificial flavours or additives excepted) and importing fuel from Russia or Belarus in portable tanks. Goods exceeding the value or quantity allowances, or excise goods imported more often than once per 30 days, must be declared with excise tax, VAT and customs duty paid — travellers carrying goods to be declared must select the "red channel" at the border (the "green channel" only where there is nothing to declare). Entering Latvia by land from Russia or Belarus, a Statement on the Transport of Excise Goods must additionally be completed at the border in defined cases: entering more than once per 30 days, exceeding the duty-free quantities, claiming the standard-fuel-tank relief when planning to return within 30 days in the same vehicle, or upon an official's request.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自欧盟外国家（或名单内特殊欧盟领地，如加那利群岛、奥兰群岛，按非欧盟待遇）入境拉脱维亚：自用或馈赠商品按人免税——陆路 300 欧、空运或海运 430 欧；15 岁以下儿童无论何种旅行方式一律上限 285 欧。个人自用药品及数量限额内的烟草、酒类、燃料不计入货值计算。消费税商品每 30 天至多免税一次：烟草——公路/铁路/海路 40 支香烟、20 支小雪茄、10 支雪茄或 50 克吸用烟草，空运 200 支香烟、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄或 250 克（可按各项百分比合并至 100%）；酒类——>22% 酒精度 1 升或 ≤22% 2 升，另加 4 升静止葡萄酒与 16 升啤酒（同样适用 100% 合并规则）；18 岁以下无酒类免税额，20 岁以下禁止携带烟草制品、烟草替代品、草本吸烟制品、电子吸烟装置及烟弹。欧盟制裁禁止自俄罗斯、白俄罗斯进口烈性酒、香烟、小雪茄及雪茄（无人工添加的自然发酵葡萄酒与啤酒除外），并禁止以便携油箱自俄、白进口燃料。超出货值或数量限额的商品、或每 30 天内多次进口的消费税商品须申报并缴纳消费税、增值税与关税——携带须申报商品的旅客过境必须选"红通道"（无可申报物品方可行绿道）。自俄罗斯或白俄罗斯陆路入境拉脱维亚者，在规定情形还须在边境填写《消费税商品运输声明》：每 30 天内多次入境、超过免税数量、拟 30 天内同车返程并主张油箱标准燃料豁免、或应官员要求。
procedures.timing_en: Declare to customs at the border when crossing: select the "red channel" when carrying goods to be declared. Personal luggage above the value allowance with a total value not exceeding EUR 700 may use the unified 2.5% customs duty rate (not applicable to tobacco or alcohol). At border crossing sites without customs controls, the Statement on the Transport of Excise Goods is submitted to State Border Guard officials. Excise page updated 22.04.2025; luggage page published 20.10.2022; both read 2026-09-27.
procedures.timing_zh: 过境时向海关申报：携带须申报商品走红通道。超货值但总值不超过 700 欧的个人行李可适用 2.5% 统一关税率（烟草、酒类不适用）。无海关监管的过境点，《消费税商品运输声明》向国家边防警卫队官员提交。消费税页更新于 2025-04-22；行李页发布于 2022-10-20；两页均于 2026-09-27 实读。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自歐盟外國家（或名單內特殊歐盟領地，如加那利群島、奧蘭群島，按非歐盟待遇）入境拉脫維亞：自用或饋贈商品按人免稅——陸路 300 歐、空運或海運 430 歐；15 歲以下兒童無論何種旅行方式一律上限 285 歐。個人自用藥品及數量限額內的菸草、酒類、燃料不計入貨值計算。消費稅商品每 30 天至多免稅一次：菸草——公路/鐵路/海路 40 支香菸、20 支小雪茄、10 支雪茄或 50 克吸用菸草，空運 200 支香菸、100 支小雪茄、50 支雪茄或 250 克（可按各項百分比合並至 100%）；酒類——>22% 酒精度 1 升或 ≤22% 2 升，另加 4 升靜止葡萄酒與 16 升啤酒（同樣適用 100% 合併規則）；18 歲以下無酒類免稅額，20 歲以下禁止攜帶菸草製品、菸草替代品、草本吸菸製品、電子吸菸裝置及煙彈。歐盟制裁禁止自俄羅斯、白俄羅斯進口烈性酒、香菸、小雪茄及雪茄（無人工添加的自然發酵葡萄酒與啤酒除外），並禁止以便攜油箱自俄、白進口燃料。超出貨值或數量限額的商品、或每 30 天內多次進口的消費稅商品須申報並繳納消費稅、增值稅與關稅——攜帶須申報商品的旅客過境必須選"紅通道"（無可申報物品方可行綠道）。自俄羅斯或白俄羅斯陸路入境拉脫維亞者，在規定情形還須在邊境填寫《消費稅商品運輸聲明》：每 30 天內多次入境、超過免稅數量、擬 30 天內同車返程並主張油箱標準燃料豁免、或應官員要求。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 過境時向海關申報：攜帶須申報商品走紅通道。超貨值但總值不超過 700 歐的個人行李可適用 2.5% 統一關稅率（菸草、酒類不適用）。無海關監管的過境點，《消費稅商品運輸聲明》向國家邊防警衛隊官員提交。消費稅頁更新於 2025-04-22；行李頁發佈於 2022-10-20；兩頁均於 2026-09-27 實讀。

procedures.name_en: Cash declaration at EU external borders (≥EUR 10,000); intra-EU border checks upon official request
procedures.name_zh: 欧盟外部边界现金申报（≥1万欧元）；欧盟内部边界检查中仅应官员要求申报
procedures.agency: State Revenue Service / Valsts ieņēmumu dienests (VID)
procedures.applicability_en: (1) EU external border: when entering or leaving Latvia at places that are also the external border of the EU, natural persons must declare cash equivalent to or exceeding EUR 10,000 (threshold inclusive; other currencies converted at the ECB reference rate published on the penultimate Wednesday of each month and used for the following month). The obligation binds every person transporting the cash regardless of ownership and is computed per person — cash is not pooled between fellow travellers (official example: a wife carrying EUR 14,000 through Latvia must declare even though splitting the couple's cash would leave each below EUR 10,000). Where the external border is first crossed in another Member State, the declaration is lodged in that first country (official example: Turkey→Latvia with a transfer in Germany — declare in Germany). At border points with a two-channel customs control system, individuals required to declare must cross via the "red channel". For cash below EUR 10,000 the competent authority (SRS; the State Border Guard where no customs control point exists) may require a declaration only where there are indications that the cash is linked to criminal activity — an officer-initiated control power, not a routine threshold. (2) EU internal border checks, including Latvia–Lithuania and Latvia–Estonia: since 1 July 2019 the SRS Tax and Customs Police Board has controlled cash movement there; a written declaration is filled in on a paper form only upon request of an official of that Board and only for cash of EUR 10,000 and more — the law does not provide that every traveller be controlled, and there is no proactive advance filing. Cash covers banknotes and coins, blank cheques, traveller's cheques, promissory notes and money orders, coins with at least 90% gold content and bullion with at least 99.5% gold. Unaccompanied cash sent by post, freight or courier (EUR 10,000 or more, or below that upon customs request) follows a separate cash-disclosure regime and is outside this accompanied-traveller procedure. EU sanctions additionally permit exporting banknotes of EU Member State currencies to Russia and Belarus only in reasonable amounts for personal travel needs.
procedures.applicability_zh: （1）欧盟外部边界：在同为欧盟外部边界的拉脱维亚口岸入境或出境时，自然人携带等值或超过 1 万欧元（含本数；其他货币按欧洲央行每月倒数第二个周三公布、次月适用的参考汇率折算）的现金须申报。义务约束所有运送现金的人，无论是否为现金所有人；现金按人单独计算，不与同行人合并（官网例：夫妇乘车过境拉脱维亚，妻子携带 1.4 万欧元即须申报，即便两人平摊各不足 1 万欧）。首次跨越欧盟外部边界发生在其他成员国时，在该首个国家申报（官网例：土耳其→拉脱维亚、德国转机——在德国申报）。设双通道海关监管系统的口岸，须申报者必须走红通道。低于 1 万欧元时，主管机关（VID；无海关监管点处为国家边防警卫队）仅在发现现金涉嫌犯罪活动的迹象时方可要求申报——系官员发起的查验权，并非常规门槛。（2）欧盟内部边界检查，包括拉脱维亚—立陶宛、拉脱维亚—爱沙尼亚边界：自 2019 年 7 月 1 日起由 VID 税务与海关警察局管控现金流动；仅应该局官员要求、且仅对 ≥1 万欧元现金以纸表填写书面申报——法律并未规定查验每位旅客，也不存在主动预申报。现金包括纸币与硬币、空白支票、旅行支票、本票及汇票、含金量 ≥90% 的金币及 ≥99.5% 的金条。以邮寄、货运或快递发送的无随行现金（≥1 万欧元，或应海关要求的更低金额）适用单独的现金披露制度，不在本随行旅客程序内。欧盟制裁另仅允许出于个人旅行需要以合理数量向俄罗斯、白俄罗斯出口成员国货币纸币。
procedures.timing_en: The completed declaration is submitted to the official of the competent authority at the border crossing point ("red channel" at two-channel points); intra-EU declarations use a paper form provided by the requesting official, and downloadable EN/LV/RU forms are also on the SRS website. The SRS border "Cash statement" service page lists the price as Free, and forms are supplied free of charge. Non-declaration or false declaration can draw an administrative fine of up to 20% of the amount to be declared and criminal liability for large amounts. Cash page updated 03.12.2024; internal-EU page published 31.10.2022; form files refreshed through 10.02.2026; read 2026-09-27.
procedures.timing_zh: 填妥的申报表在边境口岸向主管机关官员提交（双通道口岸走红通道）；欧盟内部申报使用应要求官员提供的纸表，SRS 网站另提供英/拉/俄文表格下载。VID 边境"现金申报"服务页标价 Free，表格免费提供。未申报或虚假申报可处最高达应申报金额 20% 的行政罚款，数额巨大者负刑事责任。现金页更新于 2024-12-03；欧盟内部页发布于 2022-10-31；表格文件更新至 2026-02-10；2026-09-27 实读。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 歐盟外部邊界現金申報（≥1萬歐元）；歐盟內部邊界檢查中僅應官員要求申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: （1）歐盟外部邊界：在同為歐盟外部邊界的拉脫維亞口岸入境或出境時，自然人攜帶等值或超過 1 萬歐元（含本數；其他貨幣按歐洲央行每月倒數第二個週三公佈、次月適用的參考匯率折算）的現金須申報。義務約束所有運送現金的人，無論是否為現金所有人；現金按人單獨計算，不與同行人合併（官網例：夫婦乘車過境拉脫維亞，妻子攜帶 1.4 萬歐元即須申報，即便兩人平攤各不足 1 萬歐）。首次跨越歐盟外部邊界發生在其他成員國時，在該首個國家申報（官網例：土耳其→拉脫維亞、德國轉機——在德國申報）。設雙通道海關監管系統的口岸，須申報者必須走紅通道。低於 1 萬歐元時，主管機關（VID；無海關監管點處為國家邊防警衛隊）僅在發現現金涉嫌犯罪活動的跡象時方可要求申報——系官員發起的查驗權，並非常規門檻。（2）歐盟內部邊界檢查，包括拉脫維亞—立陶宛、拉脫維亞—愛沙尼亞邊界：自 2019 年 7 月 1 日起由 VID 稅務與海關警察局管控現金流動；僅應該局官員要求、且僅對 ≥1 萬歐元現金以紙表填寫書面申報——法律並未規定查驗每位旅客，也不存在主動預申報。現金包括紙幣與硬幣、空白支票、旅行支票、本票及匯票、含金量 ≥90% 的金幣及 ≥99.5% 的金條。以郵寄、貨運或快遞發送的無隨行現金（≥1 萬歐元，或應海關要求的更低金額）適用單獨的現金披露制度，不在本隨行旅客程序內。歐盟制裁另僅允許出於個人旅行需要以合理數量向俄羅斯、白俄羅斯出口成員國貨幣紙幣。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 填妥的申報表在邊境口岸向主管機關官員提交（雙通道口岸走紅通道）；歐盟內部申報使用應要求官員提供的紙表，SRS 網站另提供英/拉/俄文表格下載。VID 邊境"現金申報"服務頁標價 Free，表格免費提供。未申報或虛假申報可處最高達應申報金額 20% 的行政罰款，數額巨大者負刑事責任。現金頁更新於 2024-12-03；歐盟內部頁發佈於 2022-10-31；表格文件更新至 2026-02-10；2026-09-27 實讀。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of currency to Norwegian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 向挪威海关申报货币
procedures.agency: Tolletaten (Norwegian Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Both directions: if you are bringing currency with a value corresponding to more than NOK 25,000 to or from Norway, you must notify Norwegian Customs. The trigger is amounts above 25,000, not 25,000 itself. The rule covers Norwegian and foreign notes, coins and other means of payment, e.g. gift cards; it is permitted to bring such amounts, but they must be declared before travelling, and there is no tax on the amount. Money transferred through banks, financial institutions and payment companies need not be reported to Customs (such transfers are reported to The Currency Register). Penalty for failure to notify: 20 per cent of the entire amount carried — for example, a failure to report NOK 26,000 results in a NOK 5,200 penalty — or a police report; if criminal activity is suspected, the entire amount is confiscated until the investigation is complete.
procedures.applicability_zh: 双向适用：携带价值超过 25,000 挪威克朗（触发线为“超过”，恰为 25,000 本身不触发）的货币前往或离开挪威，必须通知挪威海关。规则涵盖挪威及外国纸币、硬币和其他支付工具（如礼品卡）；允许携带此类金额，但须在出行前申报，且金额本身不征税。通过银行、金融机构和支付公司的跨境转账无须向海关申报（此类转账由机构向挪威货币登记册（The Currency Register）报告）。未通知的处罚：按携带的全部金额课以 20% 罚款——例如未申报 26,000 克朗将被罚 5,200 克朗——或移送警方；涉嫌犯罪时整笔金额被没收，直至调查结束。
procedures.timing_en: Fill in two copies of the form 'Declaration of cash and cash equivalents' (RD-0026; English version RD-0026E) and submit both copies to Norwegian Customs before crossing the border. Travelling to Norway: go through the red channel upon arrival and submit the two copies there. Leaving Norway: submit the two copies to the nearest customs office from where you are travelling, for instance at the airport before departure. Information Centre: +47 22 86 03 12.
procedures.timing_zh: 填写两份《现金及现金等价物申报表》（RD-0026，英文版编号 RD-0026E），过境前将两份均提交挪威海关。前往挪威：抵达时走红通道，当场提交两份表。离开挪威：向距出发地最近的海关办事处提交两份表，例如出发前在机场提交。咨询电话 +47 22 86 03 12。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 向挪威海關申報貨幣
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 雙向適用：攜帶價值超過 25,000 挪威克朗（觸發線為“超過”，恰為 25,000 本身不觸發）的貨幣前往或離開挪威，必須通知挪威海關。規則涵蓋挪威及外國紙幣、硬幣和其他支付工具（如禮品卡）；允許攜帶此類金額，但須在出行前申報，且金額本身不徵稅。通過銀行、金融機構和支付公司的跨境轉賬無須向海關申報（此類轉賬由機構向挪威貨幣登記冊（The Currency Register）報告）。未通知的處罰：按攜帶的全部金額課以 20% 罰款——例如未申報 26,000 克朗將被罰 5,200 克朗——或移送警方；涉嫌犯罪時整筆金額被沒收，直至調查結束。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 填寫兩份《現金及現金等價物申報表》（RD-0026，英文版編號 RD-0026E），過境前將兩份均提交挪威海關。前往挪威：抵達時走紅通道，當場提交兩份表。離開挪威：向距出發地最近的海關辦事處提交兩份表，例如出發前在機場提交。諮詢電話 +47 22 86 03 12。

procedures.name_en: Traveller declaration of goods exceeding the value limit or quota (red channel, release for free circulation)
procedures.name_zh: 旅客超价值限额或配额商品申报（红通道，流通放行程序）
procedures.agency: Tolletaten (Norwegian Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Entering Norway after travelling abroad. Value limit: outside Norway more than 24 hours — goods up to NOK 6,000 duty-free; shorter trips — once within a 24-hour period goods up to NOK 3,000 free of charge. The limit applies to the total sum of the items purchased, excluding alcohol and tobacco products (separate quotas), and you choose which items to place within it. A single item above the limit is dutiable on its entire value; items that constitute a whole (e.g. a kitchen) cannot be divided across trips or individuals. Tourists not resident in Norway: temporary personal belongings used during the stay and taken back out (clothing, laptops, mobile phones, jewellery) are not subject to the value limit; goods that will remain in Norway, such as items to give away or use up, cannot exceed the NOK 6,000 limit. Alcohol and tobacco: per-person quotas exempt from the value limit; minimum age 18 for beer, wine and tobacco products, 20 for beverages over 22% alcohol. Residents' quota: spirits over 22% up to and including 60% — 1 litre; wine etc. over 2.5% up to and including 22% — 1.5 litres (2 bottles); beer above 2.5%, or alcopops/cider etc. above 2.5% up to and including 4.7% — 2 litres; 100 cigarettes or 125 grams of other tobacco products; 100 sheets of cigarette paper. The spirits quota may be exchanged for 1.5 litres of wine or beer/alcopops/cider, the wine quota for equal amounts of beer/alcopops/cider; wine and beer may not be exchanged for stronger beverages, nor tobacco for beer or wine. Tourists residing outside Norway: 200 cigarettes or 250 grams of tobacco and 200 cigarette papers, alcohol quota as for residents. Stay abroad under 24 hours: alcohol and tobacco only once in that period and only with documentation that local taxes were paid in an EEA country. Food: from the EEA area, a total quota of 10 kilograms of meat, meat products, cheese and animal feed products per person over 12 (the 10-kilogram limit does not apply to dog and cat food, only other animal feed); beyond this quota the value limit determines how much food you may bring without paying Norwegian taxes. Meat and dairy products from outside the EEA require a special permit from the Norwegian Food Safety Authority (Mattilsynet); no permit is needed from Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Iceland, Andorra or San Marino. Potatoes may not be imported without special permission; children may bring only soft drinks, chocolate and sugar products duty-free, otherwise they must be 12 years of age. Beverages over 60% alcohol and unapproved nicotine products (nicotine pouches, heated tobacco products, waterpipe tobacco, e-cigarettes with nicotine without a medical certificate) are prohibited; different quotas apply to transport personnel in international traffic. These thresholds trigger one and the same declaration: goods exceeding the value limit must be declared for the release for free circulation procedure (25% VAT on most items, plus customs duties mainly on clothing and food), the amount of alcohol and tobacco exceeding the quota must be declared, and goods requiring a special permit go through the red channel.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自国外旅行入境挪威。价值限额：在挪威境外停留超过 24 小时——可免税携带价值最高 6,000 挪威克朗的商品；不足 24 小时的短途旅行——每 24 小时期间可一次携带价值最高 3,000 克朗的免税商品。限额按所购商品总额计，不含酒精和烟草制品（另有配额），且由旅客自行选择哪些商品计入限额。单件商品超过限额的，须按其全部价值纳税；构成整体的商品（如整套厨房）不得跨行程或跨人拆分携带。非挪威居民游客：停留期间使用并带离的暂用个人物品（衣物、笔记本电脑、手机、珠宝等）不受价值限额约束；将留在挪威的商品（如拟赠出或耗用的物品）不得超过 6,000 克朗限额。烟酒：配额按每人计，不占价值限额；携带啤酒、葡萄酒和烟草制品须年满 18 岁，携带酒精含量超过 22% 的饮料须年满 20 岁。居民配额：酒精含量超过 22% 至 60%（含）的烈酒等 1 升；超过 2.5% 至 22%（含）的葡萄酒等 1.5 升（2 瓶）；2.5% 以上的啤酒（含烈性啤酒），或 2.5% 至 4.7%（含）的即饮酒/苹果酒等 2 升；100 支香烟或 125 克其他烟草制品（鼻烟、雪茄和小雪茄按克计）；100 张卷烟纸。烈酒配额可兑换 1.5 升葡萄酒或啤酒/即饮酒/苹果酒，葡萄酒配额可兑换等量啤酒/即饮酒/苹果酒；葡萄酒和啤酒不得兑换更烈酒类，烟草配额亦不得兑换啤酒或葡萄酒。居住在挪威境外的游客：烟草配额为 200 支香烟或 250 克烟草及 200 张卷烟纸，酒精配额与居民相同。在境外停留不足 24 小时：该期间仅可一次携带烟酒，且须能证明已在某一 EEA 国家缴纳当地税款。食品：自 EEA 地区入境，按年满 12 岁的每人计，可携带总计 10 公斤的肉、肉制品、奶酪和动物饲料产品（10 公斤上限不适用于猫狗食品，仅适用于其他动物饲料）；超出该配额后，由价值限额决定可免缴挪威税款携带的食品数量。来自 EEA 以外国家的肉及乳制品须持挪威食品安全局（Mattilsynet）特别许可方可携带；自瑞士、列支敦士登、冰岛、安道尔、圣马力诺携带肉、肉制品、牛奶、奶酪及其他乳制品无需许可。马铃薯未经特别许可不得进口；儿童仅可免税携带软饮料、巧克力和糖类制品，携带其他产品须年满 12 岁。酒精含量超过 60% 的饮料及未获批准的含尼古丁产品（尼古丁袋、加热烟草制品、水烟烟草、无戒烟医疗证明的含尼古丁电子烟）禁止入境；国际交通运输人员适用不同配额。上述门槛触发的是同一项申报义务：超过价值限额的商品须按“流通放行”程序申报（多数商品按 25% 增值税征收，部分商品另有关税，主要为服装和食品）；超过配额的烟酒数量必须申报；需特别许可的商品走红通道。
procedures.timing_en: Go through the red channel on arrival. Goods exceeding the value limit are declared for the release for free circulation procedure, and you can pay the duties when you cross the red zone at the border — make sure to choose a border crossing with a staffed customs office; not all crossings have one before you enter Norway (some are located on the Swedish or Finnish side and handle clearance tasks for Norway; check the toll.no map of customs offices). The same red channel applies to alcohol and tobacco amounts exceeding the quota and to goods that require special permits, e.g. meat and dairy products from outside the EEA; if in doubt, go through the red channel and ask a Norwegian Customs officer. The green channel may be used only when you only have goods not liable for duties and taxes within the permitted quota and value limit, the goods are not for sale (personal use or a private gift), and you transport them yourself so they can be presented at a customs control point. If your luggage has been delayed and will arrive later, you must pass through the red channel and state what is in your hand luggage and your other luggage. The Norwegian Customs app can check whether you are within the quota, calculate quota combinations and be used to declare goods. If you cross without declaring and are stopped in a customs control, the items may be confiscated and you could be reported for smuggling.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时走红通道。超过价值限额的商品按“流通放行”程序申报，可在过境时走红区（红通道）缴纳税款——务必选择设有海关办事处的口岸；并非所有口岸在入境挪威前设有办事处（部分位于瑞典或芬兰一侧，代挪威办理清关，可在 toll.no 海关办事处地图查询）。超过配额的烟酒数量以及需特别许可的商品（如来自 EEA 以外的肉及乳制品）同样走红通道；有疑问时走红通道询问挪威海关关员。只有在配额与价值限额内、无需缴税、非售卖用途（自用或私人馈赠）且由本人随身携带以便在海关查验点出示的商品，方可走绿通道。如行李延误稍后到达，必须走红通道，说明手提行李与其他行李中的物品。可用“挪威海关”应用核对是否超额、计算配额组合并申报商品。不申报入境而被海关查获的，商品可能被没收，并可能被以走私报案。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客超價值限額或配額商品申報（紅通道，流通放行程序）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自國外旅行入境挪威。價值限額：在挪威境外停留超過 24 小時——可免稅攜帶價值最高 6,000 挪威克朗的商品；不足 24 小時的短途旅行——每 24 小時期間可一次攜帶價值最高 3,000 克朗的免稅商品。限額按所購商品總額計，不含酒精和菸草製品（另有配額），且由旅客自行選擇哪些商品計入限額。單件商品超過限額的，須按其全部價值納稅；構成整體的商品（如整套廚房）不得跨行程或跨人拆分攜帶。非挪威居民遊客：停留期間使用並帶離的暫用個人物品（衣物、筆電電腦、手機、珠寶等）不受價值限額約束；將留在挪威的商品（如擬贈出或耗用的物品）不得超過 6,000 克朗限額。菸酒：配額按每人計，不佔價值限額；攜帶啤酒、葡萄酒和菸草製品須年滿 18 歲，攜帶酒精含量超過 22% 的飲料須年滿 20 歲。居民配額：酒精含量超過 22% 至 60%（含）的烈酒等 1 升；超過 2.5% 至 22%（含）的葡萄酒等 1.5 升（2 瓶）；2.5% 以上的啤酒（含烈性啤酒），或 2.5% 至 4.7%（含）的即飲酒/蘋果酒等 2 升；100 支香菸或 125 克其他菸草製品（鼻菸、雪茄和小雪茄按克計）；100 張捲菸紙。烈酒配額可兌換 1.5 升葡萄酒或啤酒/即飲酒/蘋果酒，葡萄酒配額可兌換等量啤酒/即飲酒/蘋果酒；葡萄酒和啤酒不得兌換更烈酒類，菸草配額亦不得兌換啤酒或葡萄酒。居住在挪威境外的遊客：菸草配額為 200 支香菸或 250 克菸草及 200 張捲菸紙，酒精配額與居民相同。在境外停留不足 24 小時：該期間僅可一次攜帶菸酒，且須能證明已在某一 EEA 國家繳納當地稅款。食品：自 EEA 地區入境，按年滿 12 歲的每人計，可攜帶總計 10 公斤的肉、肉製品、奶酪和動物飼料產品（10 公斤上限不適用於貓狗食品，僅適用於其他動物飼料）；超出該配額後，由價值限額決定可免繳挪威稅款攜帶的食品數量。來自 EEA 以外國家的肉及乳製品須持挪威食品安全局（Mattilsynet）特別許可方可攜帶；自瑞士、列支敦士登、冰島、安道爾、聖馬力諾攜帶肉、肉製品、牛奶、奶酪及其他乳製品無需許可。馬鈴薯未經特別許可不得進口；兒童僅可免稅攜帶軟飲料、巧克力和糖類製品，攜帶其他產品須年滿 12 歲。酒精含量超過 60% 的飲料及未獲批准的含尼古丁產品（尼古丁袋、加熱菸草製品、水煙菸草、無戒菸醫療證明的含尼古丁電子煙）禁止入境；國際交通運輸人員適用不同配額。上述門檻觸發的是同一項申報義務：超過價值限額的商品須按“流通放行”程序申報（多數商品按 25% 增值稅徵收，部分商品另有關稅，主要為服裝和食品）；超過配額的菸酒數量必須申報；需特別許可的商品走紅通道。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時走紅通道。超過價值限額的商品按“流通放行”程序申報，可在過境時走紅區（紅通道）繳納稅款——務必選擇設有海關辦事處的口岸；並非所有口岸在入境挪威前設有辦事處（部分位於瑞典或芬蘭一側，代挪威辦理清關，可在 toll.no 海關辦事處地圖查詢）。超過配額的菸酒數量以及需特別許可的商品（如來自 EEA 以外的肉及乳製品）同樣走紅通道；有疑問時走紅通道詢問挪威海關關員。只有在配額與價值限額內、無需繳稅、非售賣用途（自用或私人饋贈）且由本人隨身攜帶以便在海關查驗點出示的商品，方可走綠通道。如行李延誤稍後到達，必須走紅通道，說明手提行李與其他行李中的物品。可用“挪威海關”應用核對是否超額、計算配額組合並申報商品。不申報入境而被海關查獲的，商品可能被沒收，並可能被以走私報案。

procedures.name_en: Svalbard goods-movement customs control — no customs or import duties in the Svalbard customs territory (Norwegian Customs)
procedures.name_zh: 斯瓦尔巴货物流动海关监管——斯瓦尔巴关境内不征收关税或进口税费（挪威海关）
procedures.agency: Norwegian Customs (Tolletaten)
procedures.applicability_en: Territorial scope: Svalbard only; the captured page speaks of the 'Svalbard customs territory' and does not extend its statements to Jan Mayen. Per the Norwegian Customs page 'Norwegian Customs in Svalbard' (updated 27.11.2025, captured 2026-09-26): at the request of the Ministry of Finance, Norwegian Customs established a physical presence and control of the movement of goods in Svalbard from May 2022, and Customs is able to control the movement of goods to and from Svalbard (to prevent cross-border crime, ensure Norway fulfils its international obligations, and prevent Svalbard being used to circumvent sanctions and export controls). Norwegian Customs currently has a customs office in Longyearbyen city centre handling the control. The page states that no customs or import duties will be imposed on goods imported into the Svalbard customs territory, and that formal obligations involving advance notice, notification and presentation have as of yet not been imposed. Policy is to develop the control further so that it becomes as similar to the control on the mainland as possible, local considerations taken into account, meaning additional obligations will over time apply to goods moving to and from Svalbard. Legal basis cited on the page: Proposition to the Storting 70 L (2021–2022) amending the Customs Act, and the Norwegian Customs allocation letter for 2024 (regjeringen.no links). Boundary notes: no passenger allowance table, cash-declaration threshold or passenger customs declaration form applicable to Svalbard was captured from official sources this round; mainland Norway passenger allowances are NOT stated by this source to apply in Svalbard and are not asserted here. Jan Mayen is not covered by the captured text (see unresolved).
procedures.applicability_zh: 领土范围：仅斯瓦尔巴；所取得页面使用“斯瓦尔巴关境”（Svalbard customs territory）表述，且未将其内容延伸至扬马延。据挪威海关《挪威海关在斯瓦尔巴》页（2025-11-27 更新，2026-09-26 取得）：应财政部要求，挪威海关自 2022 年 5 月起在斯瓦尔巴设立实体机构并监管货物流动，可对进出斯瓦尔巴的货物实施监管（目的包括防止跨境犯罪、确保挪威履行国际义务、防止斯瓦尔巴被用于规避制裁和出口管制）；海关现已在朗伊尔城市中心设有海关办事处负责监管。页面载明：进口至斯瓦尔巴关境的货物不征收关税或进口税费；涉及事前通知、报备和交验的正式义务目前尚未实施。政策方向是将监管逐步发展到尽可能接近本土水平（考虑当地实际），即进出斯瓦尔巴货物今后将承担更多义务。页面引用的法律依据：第 70 L 号（2021–2022 会期）财政提案（对《海关法》的修正）及 2024 年挪威海关任务委托书（regjeringen.no 链接）。边界说明：本轮未从官方来源取得适用于斯瓦尔巴的旅客免税额度表、现金申报门槛或旅客报关单；本来源并未声明挪威本土旅客额度适用于斯瓦尔巴，本记录亦不作此断言。扬马延不在所获文本覆盖范围内（见未决事项）。
procedures.timing_en: Goods movement to and from Svalbard is subject to Norwegian Customs control since May 2022; as of the captured page (updated 27.11.2025) no customs/import duties are levied on goods imported into the Svalbard customs territory and no advance-notice/notification/presentation obligations are imposed yet.
procedures.timing_zh: 自 2022 年 5 月起，进出斯瓦尔巴的货物流动受挪威海关监管；截至页面更新时（2025-11-27），进口至斯瓦尔巴关境的货物不征关税/进口税费，亦未实施事前通知/报备/交验义务。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 斯瓦爾巴貨物流動海關監管——斯瓦爾巴關境內不徵收關稅或進口稅費（挪威海關）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 領土範圍：僅斯瓦爾巴；所取得頁面使用“斯瓦爾巴關境”（Svalbard customs territory）表述，且未將其內容延伸至揚馬延。據挪威海關《挪威海關在斯瓦爾巴》頁（2025-11-27 更新，2026-09-26 取得）：應財政部要求，挪威海關自 2022 年 5 月起在斯瓦爾巴設立實體機構並監管貨物流動，可對進出斯瓦爾巴的貨物實施監管（目的包括防止跨境犯罪、確保挪威履行國際義務、防止斯瓦爾巴被用於規避制裁和出口管制）；海關現已在朗伊爾城市中心設有海關辦事處負責監管。頁面載明：進口至斯瓦爾巴關境的貨物不徵收關稅或進口稅費；涉及事前通知、報備和交驗的正式義務目前尚未實施。政策方向是將監管逐步發展到儘可能接近本土水平（考慮當地實際），即進出斯瓦爾巴貨物今後將承擔更多義務。頁面引用的法律依據：第 70 L 號（2021–2022 會期）財政提案（對《海關法》的修正）及 2024 年挪威海關任務委託書（regjeringen.no 連結）。邊界說明：本輪未從官方來源取得適用於斯瓦爾巴的旅客免稅額度表、現金申報門檻或旅客報關單；本來源並未聲明挪威本土旅客額度適用於斯瓦爾巴，本記錄亦不作此斷言。揚馬延不在所獲文本覆蓋範圍內（見未決事項）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 自 2022 年 5 月起，進出斯瓦爾巴的貨物流動受挪威海關監管；截至頁面更新時（2025-11-27），進口至斯瓦爾巴關境的貨物不徵關稅/進口稅費，亦未實施事前通知/報備/交驗義務。

procedures.name_en: Traveller goods declaration — duty-free value threshold, tobacco/alcohol/coffee quantities, simplified declaration for excess — Albanian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 旅客物品申报——免税价值门槛、烟酒咖啡自用数量与超额简化申报——阿尔巴尼亚海关
procedures.agency: Drejtoria e Përgjithshme e Doganave (General Directorate of Customs), Republic of Albania
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: the duty-free exemption applies to travellers arriving in the Republic of Albania from another country, while the declaration duty applies both on entry into and on exit from the Republic of Albania. Per the Albanian Customs traveller pages (dogana.gov.al) captured live on 2026-09-27. Travellers coming from another country to the Republic of Albania are exempted from import duties for the goods found in their personal baggage; goods qualify if, by their kind and quantity, they are not intended for trade (travellers' personal-use goods or gifts). Exempted value (not including tobacco and alcohol products; applied at the equivalent value in lekë): land route EUR 300 per traveller; air or sea route EUR 430 per traveller; travellers under 15 years EUR 150. During entry into or exit from the Republic of Albania the traveller must declare goods whose value is higher than the respective threshold above, as well as goods intended for commercial purposes; customs authorities may require the traveller to show all goods transported. For non-commercial goods in travellers' baggage that exceed the duty-free threshold from import customs duties, the customs declaration is carried out through the simplified declaration procedure (page's supporting documents: Customs Code articles 44-71 and 152-154; Instruction No. 01 dated 07.03.2017 on the simplified declaration of travellers' goods; simplified-declaration user manual). Personal-consumption quantities exempt from payment on import, per the tobacco/alcohol/coffee page — travellers under 17 years of age receive no exemption for tobacco and alcohol products: a) tobacco products for personal consumption, quantities: 200 cigarettes; 100 cigarillos; 50 cigars; 250 grams of tobacco; b) alcohol and alcoholic beverages for personal consumption, quantities: 1 litre of alcohol and alcoholic beverages with an alcoholic strength higher than 22% by volume, or undenatured ethyl alcohol of 80% by volume and above; or 2 litres of alcohol and distilled beverages with an alcoholic strength not exceeding 22% by volume (the page states that each quantity specified under letters 'a' and 'b' constitutes 100% of the total exemption for alcohol products and alcoholic beverages, and that for one traveller the exemption may apply to any combination provided the total quantity (percentage) used does not exceed 100%); in addition, 2 litres of non-sparkling wine and 10 litres of beer; c) coffee for personal consumption, quantity: 3 kg. Distinct exit regime, not part of the above entry allowances: excise goods handled by 'Duty free shops' (goods sold on board an aircraft during an international journey are also considered duty-free-shop goods) and taken into personal baggage by travellers leaving Albanian territory by air or sea are exempted from excise payment. Currency corroboration: a customs news item published 17.07.2025 republishes the same thresholds, personal-use quantities, the under-17 exclusion and the simplified-declaration warning; no claim is made beyond the official page text (the underlying statutes are cited only as the page itself lists them).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：免税待遇适用于自另一国抵达阿尔巴尼亚共和国的旅客；申报义务在进入或离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国时均适用。依据 2026-09-27 实时取得的阿尔巴尼亚海关旅客栏目页（dogana.gov.al）。自另一国来阿尔巴尼亚共和国的旅客，其个人行李中的物品免征进口税费；物品须按种类和数量非供贸易用途（旅客自用品或礼品）方可豁免。免税价值（不含烟草和酒精制品，按列克等值计算）：陆路旅客每人 300 欧元；航空或海路旅客每人 430 欧元；15 岁以下旅客 150 欧元。进入或离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国时，旅客须申报价值超过上述相应门槛的物品以及供商业用途的物品；海关当局可要求旅客出示其运输的全部物品。对旅客行李中超过进口海关免税门槛的非商业性质物品，通过简化申报程序（Deklarimi i thjeshtuar）办理海关申报（页面附支撑文件：海关法典第 44-71 条、第 152-154 条；2017 年 3 月 7 日第 01 号关于旅客物品简化申报的指令；简化申报使用手册）。个人消费数量免征进口环节支付（据烟、酒、咖啡专页）——未满 17 周岁旅客不享受烟草和酒精制品豁免：a) 个人消费烟草制品，数量为：卷烟 200 支；小雪茄（cigarillo）100 支；雪茄 50 支；烟草 250 克；b) 个人消费酒精及酒精饮料，数量为：酒精浓度高于 22%（体积比）的酒精及酒精饮料 1 升，或浓度 80%（体积比）及以上的未变性乙醇；或浓度不超过 22%（体积比）的酒精及蒸馏饮料 2 升（页面载明 a、b 两项所列数量各构成酒精及酒精饮料豁免总额的 100%，且对同一名旅客可适用任意组合，条件是其使用的总量（百分比）不超过 100%）；此外另有无气泡葡萄酒 2 升和啤酒 10 升；c) 个人消费咖啡，数量为：3 公斤。另列出境制度，不属于上述入境额度：由 “Duty free shops” 经手的应征消费税商品（国际航程中在飞机上销售的商品亦视为免税店商品），由乘航空或海路离开阿尔巴尼亚领土的旅客携入个人行李的，免缴消费税。时效佐证：海关 2025 年 7 月 17 日发布的新闻重申同样的门槛、自用数量、未满 17 周岁排除及简化申报警示；本记录不作超出官网正文的断言（相关法条仅按页面自身所列引用）。
procedures.timing_en: On entering or leaving the Republic of Albania, at the border crossing point: declare there goods whose value exceeds the applicable threshold (EUR 300 land / EUR 430 air or sea / EUR 150 under 15; tobacco and alcohol follow the quantity quotas instead of the value threshold) and goods intended for commercial purposes; above-threshold non-commercial goods are covered by a customs declaration through the simplified declaration procedure.
procedures.timing_zh: 在进入或离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国时，于边境检查站办理：价值超过适用门槛（陆路 300 欧元／空、海路 430 欧元／15 岁以下 150 欧元；烟酒适用数量限额而非价值门槛）或属商业用途的物品须当场申报；超出门槛的非商业物品通过简化申报程序（Deklarimi i thjeshtuar）办理海关申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客物品申報——免稅價值門檻、菸酒咖啡自用數量與超額簡化申報——阿爾巴尼亞海關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：免稅待遇適用於自另一國抵達阿爾巴尼亞共和國的旅客；申報義務在進入或離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國時均適用。依據 2026-09-27 實時取得的阿爾巴尼亞海關旅客欄目頁（dogana.gov.al）。自另一國來阿爾巴尼亞共和國的旅客，其個人行李中的物品免徵進口稅費；物品須按種類和數量非供貿易用途（旅客自用品或禮品）方可豁免。免稅價值（不含菸草和酒精製品，按列克等值計算）：陸路旅客每人 300 歐元；航空或海路旅客每人 430 歐元；15 歲以下旅客 150 歐元。進入或離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國時，旅客須申報價值超過上述相應門檻的物品以及供商業用途的物品；海關當局可要求旅客出示其運輸的全部物品。對旅客行李中超過進口海關免稅門檻的非商業性質物品，通過簡化申報程序（Deklarimi i thjeshtuar）辦理海關申報（頁面附支撐文件：海關法典第 44-71 條、第 152-154 條；2017 年 3 月 7 日第 01 號關於旅客物品簡化申報的指令；簡化申報使用手冊）。個人消費數量免徵進口環節支付（據煙、酒、咖啡專頁）——未滿 17 週歲旅客不享受菸草和酒精製品豁免：a) 個人消費菸草製品，數量為：捲菸 200 支；小雪茄（cigarillo）100 支；雪茄 50 支；菸草 250 克；b) 個人消費酒精及酒精飲料，數量為：酒精濃度高於 22%（體積比）的酒精及酒精飲料 1 升，或濃度 80%（體積比）及以上的未變性乙醇；或濃度不超過 22%（體積比）的酒精及蒸餾飲料 2 升（頁面載明 a、b 兩項所列數量各構成酒精及酒精飲料豁免總額的 100%，且對同一名旅客可適用任意組合，條件是其使用的總量（百分比）不超過 100%）；此外另有無氣泡葡萄酒 2 升和啤酒 10 升；c) 個人消費咖啡，數量為：3 公斤。另列出境制度，不屬於上述入境額度：由 “Duty free shops” 經手的應徵消費稅商品（國際航程中在飛機上銷售的商品亦視為免稅店商品），由乘航空或海路離開阿爾巴尼亞領土的旅客攜入個人行李的，免繳消費稅。時效佐證：海關 2025 年 7 月 17 日發佈的新聞重申同樣的門檻、自用數量、未滿 17 週歲排除及簡化申報警示；本記錄不作超出官網正文的斷言（相關法條僅按頁面自身所列引用）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在進入或離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國時，於邊境檢查站辦理：價值超過適用門檻（陸路 300 歐元／空、海路 430 歐元／15 歲以下 150 歐元；菸酒適用數量限額而非價值門檻）或屬商業用途的物品須當場申報；超出門檻的非商業物品通過簡化申報程序（Deklarimi i thjeshtuar）辦理海關申報。

procedures.name_en: Cash and valuables border declaration (RTVK) from EUR 10,000 — Albanian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 现金及有价物边境申报（RTVK），自 10,000 欧元起——阿尔巴尼亚海关
procedures.agency: Drejtoria e Përgjithshme e Doganave (General Directorate of Customs), Republic of Albania
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: persons who enter into and/or leave the territory of the Republic of Albania. Per the Albanian Customs money-declaration page (dogana.gov.al) captured live on 2026-09-27, based as the page states on Law No. 9917 of 19.5.2008, as amended. Obligation: all persons entering or leaving Albania are obliged to declare cash sums, any kind of bearer negotiable instrument, precious metals or stones, items of value and antique objects, starting from the amount of EUR 10,000 (inclusive, 'duke filluar nga shuma 10 000 euro') or its equivalent in other currencies; they must also state the purpose of holding the values and present the relevant justifying documents (the page's warning notice adds: appear before the Customs Authorities to complete the RTVK form, presenting supporting documents justifying the source of the funds declared). Where/how: the declaration is made at the Customs Administration offices at the border crossing point, on entry or exit, through the form for reporting the transport of values across the border (RTVK), which is completed online at the customs offices at the border crossing points. Timing: the declaration is made before passport control by the Police and Security authorities; it does not matter how you travel (plane, ship, car, motorbike, bicycle, on foot), where you keep the monetary values (hand luggage, baggage, the vehicle you travel in), or that the monetary means are not your property. Penalties (not a fee): for a false, inaccurate or missing declaration the Customs Administration has the right to impose a fine under article 17/1 of the said law, and in parallel the case is handled under the Criminal Code and the Criminal Procedure Code; fine bands: a) amounts EUR 10,000-19,999 or their equivalent in foreign currency: ALL 20,000 the first time, 10% of the undeclared value the second time, 30% of the undeclared value in other cases; b) EUR 20,000-49,999: ALL 40,000 the first time, 20% the second time, 40% in other cases; c) over EUR 50,000: ALL 60,000 the first time, 30% the second time, 50% in other cases. Fee: no charge is paid for completing the monetary-values declaration form (RTVK).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进入和/或离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国领土的人员。依据 2026-09-27 实时取得的阿尔巴尼亚海关现金申报页（dogana.gov.al），页面载明其依据为经修订的 2008 年 5 月 19 日第 9917 号法。义务：所有进入或离开阿尔巴尼亚的人员均有义务申报现金款项、任何种类的不记名可转让票据、贵金属或宝石、有价物品及古董，起点为 10,000 欧元（含本数，原文 duke filluar nga shuma 10 000 euro）或其他货币等值；还须说明持有上述财物的目的并出示相应证明文件（页内警示提示补充：前往海关当局填报 RTVK 表格时，须出示能证明所申报资金来源的辅助文件）。地点/方式：申报在边境检查站的海关总署办公室办理，入境或出境均适用；通过跨境价值运输报告表（RTVK）办理，该表在边境检查站海关办公室在线填报。时点：申报在警察及安全当局进行护照检查之前办理；旅行方式（飞机、轮船、汽车、摩托车、自行车、步行）无关紧要，财物存放位置（手提行李、行李、所乘交通工具）无关紧要，即使款项不属本人所有亦须申报。处罚（非费用）：虚假、不准确申报或未申报的，海关总署有权依上述法律第 17/1 条处以罚款，并同时按《刑法典》和《刑事诉讼法典》处理；罚款档次：a) 10,000-19,999 欧元或等值外币：首次 20,000 列克，第二次按未申报价值的 10%，其余情形按 30%；b) 20,000-49,999 欧元：首次 40,000 列克，第二次 20%，其余 40%；c) 50,000 欧元以上：首次 60,000 列克，第二次 30%，其余 50%。费用：填报货币价值申报表（RTVK）不缴任何税费。
procedures.timing_en: Before passport control by the Police/Security authorities at the border crossing point, on both entry into and exit from Albania: persons carrying cash, bearer negotiable instruments, precious metals or stones, items of value or antique objects from EUR 10,000 (inclusive) or the equivalent in other currencies complete the RTVK form online at the customs offices at the border crossing point and present justifying documents; the mode of travel, the place where the values are kept and the ownership of the money are irrelevant.
procedures.timing_zh: 无论入境还是出境阿尔巴尼亚，均须在边境检查站由警察／安全当局进行护照检查之前办理：携带 10,000 欧元（含本数）或其他货币等值起现金、不记名可转让票据、贵金属或宝石、有价物品或古董的人员，在边境检查站海关办公室在线填报 RTVK 表格并出示证明文件；交通方式、财物存放位置及款项是否归本人所有均不影响该义务。

fee.note: 仅限 RTVK 表格填报本身免费：官网原文 Nuk paguani taksë për plotësimin formularit të deklarimit të vlerave monetare (RTVK)（填报货币价值申报表 RTVK 不缴税费）。虚假／不准确／未申报依第 9917/2008 号法（经修订）第 17/1 条所课罚款属行政罚款，不是费用；本字段亦不涵盖货物申报可能产生的进口税费。

procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及有價物邊境申報（RTVK），自 10,000 歐元起——阿爾巴尼亞海關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進入和/或離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國領土的人員。依據 2026-09-27 實時取得的阿爾巴尼亞海關現金申報頁（dogana.gov.al），頁面載明其依據為經修訂的 2008 年 5 月 19 日第 9917 號法。義務：所有進入或離開阿爾巴尼亞的人員均有義務申報現金款項、任何種類的不記名可轉讓票據、貴金屬或寶石、有價物品及古董，起點為 10,000 歐元（含本數，原文 duke filluar nga shuma 10 000 euro）或其他貨幣等值；還須說明持有上述財物的目的並出示相應證明文件（頁內警示提示補充：前往海關當局填報 RTVK 表格時，須出示能證明所申報資金來源的輔助文件）。地點/方式：申報在邊境檢查站的海關總署辦公室辦理，入境或出境均適用；通過跨境價值運輸報告表（RTVK）辦理，該表在邊境檢查站海關辦公室線上填報。時點：申報在警察及安全當局進行護照檢查之前辦理；旅行方式（飛機、輪船、汽車、摩托車、自行車、步行）無關緊要，財物存放位置（手提行李、行李、所乘交通工具）無關緊要，即使款項不屬本人所有亦須申報。處罰（非費用）：虛假、不準確申報或未申報的，海關總署有權依上述法律第 17/1 條處以罰款，並同時按《刑法典》和《刑事訴訟法典》處理；罰款檔次：a) 10,000-19,999 歐元或等值外幣：首次 20,000 列克，第二次按未申報價值的 10%，其餘情形按 30%；b) 20,000-49,999 歐元：首次 40,000 列克，第二次 20%，其餘 40%；c) 50,000 歐元以上：首次 60,000 列克，第二次 30%，其餘 50%。費用：填報貨幣價值申報表（RTVK）不繳任何稅費。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 無論入境還是出境阿爾巴尼亞，均須在邊境檢查站由警察／安全當局進行護照檢查之前辦理：攜帶 10,000 歐元（含本數）或其他貨幣等值起現金、不記名可轉讓票據、貴金屬或寶石、有價物品或古董的人員，在邊境檢查站海關辦公室線上填報 RTVK 表格並出示證明文件；交通方式、財物存放位置及款項是否歸本人所有均不影響該義務。

procedures.name_en: Exit declaration of works of art / cultural-heritage objects, with permit and object passport — Albanian Customs
procedures.name_zh: 艺术品／文化遗产物品出境申报（附许可与物品护照）——阿尔巴尼亚海关
procedures.agency: Drejtoria e Përgjithshme e Doganave (General Directorate of Customs), Republic of Albania
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: exit only. Per the Albanian Customs traveller page 'Objektet e Trashëgimisë Kulturore dhe Veprat e Artit' (dogana.gov.al) captured live on 2026-09-27. Narrow duty as printed: any individual who wishes to export out of the territory of the Republic of Albania an object that is a work of art or an object constituting cultural heritage must declare it to the Customs Authorities and present the relevant permits for it, accompanied by the object's passport, issued by the National Centre for the Inventory of Cultural Properties (Qendra Kombëtare e Inventarizimit të Pasurieve Kulturore, QKIPK) or the Ministry of Culture ('Ministri i Kulturës' as printed); the page refers to www.qkipk.gov.al for further information. Context of the term on the page: cultural heritage comprises material and immaterial, movable and immovable cultural property as a whole of cultural values carrying historical memory and national identity and of scientific or cultural importance; some movable cultural-property examples listed: paintings, photographs, various collections; books, manuscripts, historical documents, stamps; archaeological objects, statues; items of artisanal, ethnographic or historical value. Deliberate limits: the page imposes this duty only on the EXPORT of such objects by an individual; it states no import rule for antiques or for goods in general, so this record does not generalize to imports or to all antiques; no value threshold, age rule, quantity limit, form name, stage relative to passport control or penalty is stated; fee unknown; the page neither states nor implies a charge for the customs declaration or for the QKIPK/Ministry-of-Culture permit itself (permit-issuance terms lie outside this page). Relation to the other captured AL regimes: distinct from the traveller value-threshold declaration (AL-goods-declaration) and from the RTVK EUR 10,000 rule (AL-cash-declaration), which separately counts antique objects among items of value; as printed the cultural-heritage export duty carries no value threshold and the page cross-references neither regime, so the three are kept unmerged.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：仅出境。依据 2026-09-27 实时取得的阿尔巴尼亚海关旅客栏目页 “Objektet e Trashëgimisë Kulturore dhe Veprat e Artit”（dogana.gov.al）。页面原述的狭窄义务：任何个人欲将一件艺术品或构成文化遗产的物品携出阿尔巴尼亚共和国领土之外，均须向海关当局（Autoriteteve Doganore）申报，并出示相应许可（随附物品护照 pasaporta e objektit），该许可由国家文化财产清查中心（Qendra Kombëtare e Inventarizimit të Pasurieve Kulturore，QKIPK）或文化部（原文 Ministri i Kulturës）签发；页面另指引 www.qkipk.gov.al 获取更多信息。术语在页面中的语境：文化遗产涵盖物质与非物质、可移动与不可移动的文化财产，作为承载历史记忆与民族认同、具科学或文化重要性的一整套文化价值；页面列举的部分可移动文化财产示例：绘画、照片、各类收藏；书籍、手稿、历史文献、邮票；考古物品、雕像；具有手工艺、民族学或历史价值的物品。刻意限界：页面仅就个人出口此类物项设定义务，未就古董或一般物品的进口另设规则，故本记录不概括进口情形、亦不概括一切古董；页面未载明价值门槛、年龄规则、数量限制、指定表格、相对护照检查的办理阶段或罚则；fee unknown；页面既未载明亦未暗示海关申报本身或 QKIPK／文化部许可本身收取费用（许可签发条件在本页范围之外）。与另两条已取得的 AL 制度的关系：有别于旅客超价值门槛申报（AL-goods-declaration）与 RTVK 一万欧元规则（AL-cash-declaration，该页将古董另计为有价物品）；按页面原文，本文化遗产出境义务不设价值门槛，且未交叉援引上述任一制度，故三者保持不合并。
procedures.timing_en: On exit from the Republic of Albania: an individual exporting a work of art or a cultural-heritage object out of Albanian territory declares it to the Customs Authorities and presents the relevant permit, accompanied by the object's passport, issued by QKIPK or the Ministry of Culture; the page states no stage relative to passport control, no time limit and no place for obtaining the permit.
procedures.timing_zh: 在离开阿尔巴尼亚共和国时：出口艺术品或构成文化遗产的物品的个人向海关当局申报，并出示 QKIPK 或文化部签发的相应许可（随附物品护照）；页面未载明相对护照检查的办理阶段、时限或许可取得地点。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 藝術品／文化遺產物品出境申報（附許可與物品護照）——阿爾巴尼亞海關
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：僅出境。依據 2026-09-27 實時取得的阿爾巴尼亞海關旅客欄目頁 “Objektet e Trashëgimisë Kulturore dhe Veprat e Artit”（dogana.gov.al）。頁面原述的狹窄義務：任何個人欲將一件藝術品或構成文化遺產的物品攜出阿爾巴尼亞共和國領土之外，均須向海關當局（Autoriteteve Doganore）申報，並出示相應許可（隨附物品護照 pasaporta e objektit），該許可由國家文化財產清查中心（Qendra Kombëtare e Inventarizimit të Pasurieve Kulturore，QKIPK）或文化部（原文 Ministri i Kulturës）簽發；頁面另指引 www.qkipk.gov.al 獲取更多資訊。術語在頁面中的語境：文化遺產涵蓋物質與非物質、可移動與不可移動的文化財產，作為承載歷史記憶與民族認同、具科學或文化重要性的一整套文化價值；頁面列舉的部分可移動文化財產示例：繪畫、照片、各類收藏；書籍、手稿、歷史文獻、郵票；考古物品、雕像；具有手工藝、民族學或歷史價值的物品。刻意限界：頁面僅就個人出口此類物項設定義務，未就古董或一般物品的進口另設規則，故本記錄不概括進口情形、亦不概括一切古董；頁面未載明價值門檻、年齡規則、數量限制、指定表格、相對護照檢查的辦理階段或罰則；fee unknown；頁面既未載明亦未暗示海關申報本身或 QKIPK／文化部許可本身收取費用（許可簽發條件在本頁範圍之外）。與另兩條已取得的 AL 制度的關係：有別於旅客超價值門檻申報（AL-goods-declaration）與 RTVK 一萬歐元規則（AL-cash-declaration，該頁將古董另計為有價物品）；按頁面原文，本文化遺產出境義務不設價值門檻，且未交叉援引上述任一制度，故三者保持不合並。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在離開阿爾巴尼亞共和國時：出口藝術品或構成文化遺產的物品的個人向海關當局申報，並出示 QKIPK 或文化部簽發的相應許可（隨附物品護照）；頁面未載明相對護照檢查的辦理階段、時限或許可取得地點。
