procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods on entry to Austria from a non-EU country (duty-free amounts and duty-free allowance) — Zoll Austria / BMF
procedures.name_zh: 自非欧盟国家入境奥地利的物品申报（免税数量与免税额度）——奥地利海关／财政部（BMF）
procedures.agency: Zoll Austria — Bundesministerium für Finanzen (BMF), Austria — national customs authority
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering Austria from a non-EU (third) country. The figures below are the general travellers' duty-free amounts; the reduced cross-border-traffic amounts (including the Samnaun Valley tobacco amounts for travellers domiciled in Austria) are special regimes listed separately at the end and must not be read as the general values. Goods intended for your own personal use or for persons living in the same household can be brought into Austria without paying charges. When going through customs control you must declare the following goods — in other words you must submit a customs declaration for: goods not intended for your personal use; goods obtained outside the EU which exceed the duty-free amounts for tobacco products, alcoholic beverages and medicinal products or the duty-free allowance for other goods; and goods that are subject to prohibitions or restrictions on imports. Duty-free when imported in your personal luggage for your own personal use or as a gift, traveller aged 17 or older: tobacco — 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 grams of smoking tobacco or a proportional combination of these goods (for the product category 'Tobacco for heating'/tobacco sticks the duty-free limits of the 'Other goods' section apply); alcoholic beverages — 1 litre of alcohol, distilled beverages and spirits with an alcohol content exceeding 22% vol. (including undenatured ethyl alcohol of 80% vol. and over), or 2 litres of alcohol and alcoholic beverages with an alcohol content not exceeding 22% vol., or a proportional combination of these goods, and in addition 4 litres of non-sparkling wines as well as 16 litres of beer; medicine — amounts consistent with your personal needs during the trip (without authorisation, travellers resident in the EU may import medication they already carried with them on departure; import of medication bought abroad is only permitted up to three retailer packages per person); other goods — with a cumulative value of EUR 430 for airline travellers or EUR 300 for all other travellers per calendar day, provided it is a non-commercial import; for travellers younger than 15 years those amounts are generally reduced to EUR 150. Within those amounts the product group 'Tobacco for heating' may not contain more than 800 tobacco sticks or, in other presentation, 250 grams of tobacco; when exceeding these indicative levels you must demonstrate that the goods really are for your personal use. Several travellers are not allowed to pool their allowances, and the duty-free allowance may be claimed once per calendar day. When travelling via another EU member state, that member state's individual regulations must be considered. Import prohibitions and restrictions also apply to the duty-free goods listed above. Special regime — reduced duty-free amounts in cross-border traffic: tobacco (17+) 25 cigarettes or 10 cigarillos or 5 cigars or 25 grams of smoking tobacco or a proportional combination; alcohol (17+) 0.25 litres exceeding 22% vol. or 0.75 litres not exceeding 22% vol. or a proportional combination; 1 litre non-sparkling wine (17+); 2 litres beer (17+); other goods up to a cumulative value of EUR 40 (non-commercial); the 'small' cross-border traffic agreement covers persons residing at the border of Austria's neighbouring countries Switzerland and Liechtenstein, with further food-related exemptions. Special regime — Samnaun Valley: for travellers domiciled in Austria entering from the Swiss customs exclave Samnaun Valley, reduced tobacco amounts apply (17+): 40 cigarettes or 20 cigarillos or 10 cigars or 50 grams of smoking tobacco or a proportional combination; other goods remain duty-free at the general cumulative values (EUR 430 airline / EUR 300 other travellers per calendar day, EUR 150 for travellers under 15); entries with tobacco products obtained in Samnaun Valley via the customs offices of Pfunds, Spiss or Martinsbruck are regarded as direct imports.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自非欧盟（第三国）国家入境奥地利的旅客。以下为一般旅客免税数值；边境通勤减免数值（含居住在奥地利的旅客自 Samnaun 飞地入境的烟草减免）为文末单列的特别制度，不得当作一般数值使用。自用或供同住家庭成员使用的物品，可免税带入奥地利。经海关检查时必须申报下列物品——即须提交海关申报（submit a customs declaration）：非自用物品；在欧盟境外获得、超过烟草制品、酒精饮料、药品免税数量或超过其他商品免税额度的物品；受进口禁止或限制的物品。在随身行李中自用或作为礼品免税（须满 17 周岁）：烟草——200 支香烟，或 100 支小雪茄（cigarillos），或 50 支雪茄，或 250 克吸用烟草，或按比例组合（'加热烟草'即烟草棒类产品适用'其他商品'一节的免税限额）；酒精饮料——酒精含量超过 22% vol. 的酒精、蒸馏饮料和烈酒（含 80% vol. 及以上的未变性乙醇）1 升，或酒精含量不超过 22% vol. 的酒精饮料 2 升，或按比例组合，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒以及 16 升啤酒；药品——与旅途个人需要相一致的数量（欧盟居民无需许可即可携带其出境时已随身携带的药品入境；在境外购买的药品每人仅限 3 个零售包装）；其他商品——每公历日累计价值航空旅客 430 欧元、其他所有旅客 300 欧元，以非商业性入境为前提；15 岁以下旅客该额度一般降为 150 欧元。在该额度内，'加热烟草'类产品不得超过 800 支烟草棒或以其他形态计 250 克烟草；超过该指示性数量时，须证明物品确为自用。多名旅客不得合并免税额度（例如两人不能合并 80 欧元额度免税带入一件商品）；免税额度每公历日只能主张一次。经另一欧盟成员国中转前来时，须注意该成员国自身的规定。上述免税商品同样适用进口禁止与限制。特别制度——边境通勤减免：烟草（17 周岁及以上）25 支香烟或 10 支小雪茄或 5 支雪茄或 25 克吸用烟草或按比例组合；酒精（17 周岁及以上）超过 22% vol. 的 0.25 升或不超过 22% vol. 的 0.75 升或按比例组合；不起泡葡萄酒（17 周岁及以上）1 升；啤酒（17 周岁及以上）2 升；其他商品累计价值不超过 40 欧元（非商业性）；'小'边境交通协议涵盖居住在奥地利邻国瑞士和列支敦士登边境的人员，并含特定食品的进一步豁免。特别制度——Samnaun 飞地：居住在奥地利的旅客自瑞士海关飞地 Samnaun 入境时，烟草适用减免数量（17 周岁及以上）：40 支香烟或 20 支小雪茄或 10 支雪茄或 50 克吸用烟草或按比例组合；其他商品仍按一般累计价值免税（航空旅客每公历日 430 欧元／其他旅客 300 欧元，15 岁以下 150 欧元）；自 Samnaun 购得烟草制品经 Pfunds、Spiss 或 Martinsbruck 海关办事处入境视同直接进口。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival at the border: when going through customs control, submit the customs declaration there for goods not intended for personal use, goods obtained outside the EU exceeding the duty-free amounts/allowance, and prohibited or restricted goods; goods within the allowances for personal or same-household use pass without charges. Current BMF page: /topics/customs/travellers/entry-from-non-eu-countries/duty-free-amounts-and-allowances.html; the v21 URL /topics/customs/travelling/entry-from-non-eu-countries.html was re-verified as 404 on 2026-09-27 and is no longer citable.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达边境时：经海关检查须当场提交海关申报，对象为非自用物品、在欧盟境外获得且超过免税数量/额度的物品以及禁止或限制进口的物品；额度内的自用或同住家庭用品免税放行。现行 BMF 页面为 /topics/customs/travellers/entry-from-non-eu-countries/duty-free-amounts-and-allowances.html；v21 旧地址 /topics/customs/travelling/entry-from-non-eu-countries.html 已于 2026-09-27 复核为 404，不得继续引用。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 自非歐盟國家入境奧地利的物品申報（免稅數量與免稅額度）——奧地利海關／財政部（BMF）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自非歐盟（第三國）國家入境奧地利的旅客。以下為一般旅客免稅數值；邊境通勤減免數值（含居住在奧地利的旅客自 Samnaun 飛地入境的菸草減免）為文末單列的特別制度，不得當作一般數值使用。自用或供同住家庭成員使用的物品，可免稅帶入奧地利。經海關檢查時必須申報下列物品——即須提交海關申報（submit a customs declaration）：非自用物品；在歐盟境外獲得、超過菸草製品、酒精飲料、藥品免稅數量或超過其他商品免稅額度的物品；受進口禁止或限制的物品。在隨身行李中自用或作為禮品免稅（須滿 17 週歲）：菸草——200 支香菸，或 100 支小雪茄（cigarillos），或 50 支雪茄，或 250 克吸用菸草，或按比例組合（'加熱菸草'即菸草棒類產品適用'其他商品'一節的免稅限額）；酒精飲料——酒精含量超過 22% vol. 的酒精、蒸餾飲料和烈酒（含 80% vol. 及以上的未變性乙醇）1 升，或酒精含量不超過 22% vol. 的酒精飲料 2 升，或按比例組合，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒以及 16 升啤酒；藥品——與旅途個人需要相一致的數量（歐盟居民無需許可即可攜帶其出境時已隨身攜帶的藥品入境；在境外購買的藥品每人僅限 3 個零售包裝）；其他商品——每公曆日累計價值航空旅客 430 歐元、其他所有旅客 300 歐元，以非商業性入境為前提；15 歲以下旅客該額度一般降為 150 歐元。在該額度內，'加熱菸草'類產品不得超過 800 支菸草棒或以其他形態計 250 克菸草；超過該指示性數量時，須證明物品確為自用。多名旅客不得合併免稅額度（例如兩人不能合併 80 歐元額度免稅帶入一件商品）；免稅額度每公曆日只能主張一次。經另一歐盟成員國中轉前來時，須注意該成員國自身的規定。上述免稅商品同樣適用進口禁止與限制。特別制度——邊境通勤減免：菸草（17 週歲及以上）25 支香菸或 10 支小雪茄或 5 支雪茄或 25 克吸用菸草或按比例組合；酒精（17 週歲及以上）超過 22% vol. 的 0.25 升或不超過 22% vol. 的 0.75 升或按比例組合；不起泡葡萄酒（17 週歲及以上）1 升；啤酒（17 週歲及以上）2 升；其他商品累計價值不超過 40 歐元（非商業性）；'小'邊境交通協議涵蓋居住在奧地利鄰國瑞士和列支敦士登邊境的人員，並含特定食品的進一步豁免。特別制度——Samnaun 飛地：居住在奧地利的旅客自瑞士海關飛地 Samnaun 入境時，菸草適用減免數量（17 週歲及以上）：40 支香菸或 20 支小雪茄或 10 支雪茄或 50 克吸用菸草或按比例組合；其他商品仍按一般累計價值免稅（航空旅客每公曆日 430 歐元／其他旅客 300 歐元，15 歲以下 150 歐元）；自 Samnaun 購得菸草製品經 Pfunds、Spiss 或 Martinsbruck 海關辦事處入境視同直接進口。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達邊境時：經海關檢查須當場提交海關申報，對象為非自用物品、在歐盟境外獲得且超過免稅數量/額度的物品以及禁止或限制進口的物品；額度內的自用或同住家庭用品免稅放行。現行 BMF 頁面為 /topics/customs/travellers/entry-from-non-eu-countries/duty-free-amounts-and-allowances.html；v21 舊地址 /topics/customs/travelling/entry-from-non-eu-countries.html 已於 2026-09-27 複核為 404，不得繼續引用。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cross-border transports of cash of EUR 10,000 or more (obligation déclarative d'argent liquide)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境携带现金 1 万欧元及以上申报（obligation déclarative d'argent liquide）
procedures.agency: Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI)
procedures.applicability_en: Any person, French resident or not, entering or leaving France carrying EUR 10,000 or more (inclusive, or the equivalent in foreign currency) in cash or bearer instruments must declare it to customs: banknotes and coins; bearer or endorsable negotiable instruments (bearer cheques, traveller's cheques, money orders, non-domiciled bills of exchange and letters of credit, anonymous cashier's certificates, bearer securities and capitalization bonds); gold — coins, and unminted metal such as ingots, nuggets or other native gold agglomerates containing at least 99.5% gold. Prepaid cards are covered only for intra-EU flows. Both flows are declared: to or from a non-EU country (Regulation (EU) 2018/1672) and to or from an EU member state (article L152-1 of the Code monétaire et financier); transports to or from Monaco are included, while interbank and dematerialized transfers are outside the scheme. If you carry for a third party, the declaration must additionally identify the owner of the funds. Non-declaration, false declaration or non-presentation of the money: fine of up to 50% of the sum concerned and temporary retention of the cash; no declaration may be deposited a posteriori as regularization.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何人员（无论是否法国居民）入境或出境法国时携带等于或超过 1 万欧元（含本数，或等值外币）的现金或无记名工具，均须向海关申报：纸币与硬币；无记名或可背书转让的票据（无记名支票、旅行支票、汇票 mandats、非 domicilié 的商业票据与信用证、无记名存单、无记名有价证券与资本化债券）；黄金——金币，以及未铸币形态的金属（金锭、天然金块或其他含金量至少 99.5% 的自然金凝聚物）。预付卡仅适用于欧盟内部流动（intra-UE）。两种流动均须申报：与欧盟以外国家之间（欧盟 (UE) 2018/1672 号条例）以及与欧盟成员国之间（《货币与金融法典》L152-1 条）；与摩纳哥之间的运送同样包含，银行间转账及经专门机构的非实体化资金转账不适用。为第三方携带时，申报还须载明资金所有人身份。未申报、虚假申报或不出示资金：最高可处涉案金额 50% 的罚款并临时扣留现金；不得事后补报作为补正。
procedures.timing_en: The person transporting the cash files the declaration. Electronically, via the DALIA teledeclaration service (recommended by the douane): at the earliest 30 days before the transport date, at the latest before crossing the border on the day of travel. On paper: the EU harmonized form for extra-EU flows; the national FR form for intra-EU flows (metropolitan France, DROM, Saint-Martin); the COM form for flows involving Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, New Caledonia, French Polynesia, Wallis-et-Futuna or Saint-Barthélemy. Or directly with the customs service at the moment of entry into or exit from French territory.
procedures.timing_zh: 由实际携带现金之人申报。电子方式：经 DALIA 电子申报服务（海关推荐使用），最早可在运送日期前 30 天内、最迟须在旅行当日越过边境之前提交。纸质方式：欧盟外流动用欧盟统一表格；欧盟内部流动（法国本土、海外省与大区 DROM、圣马丁）用法国国家表格；涉及圣皮埃尔和密克隆、新喀里多尼亚、法属波利尼西亚、瓦利斯和富图纳或圣巴泰勒米的流动用 COM 表格。或在入境或出境法国领土之时直接向海关部门申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境攜帶現金 1 萬歐元及以上申報（obligation déclarative d'argent liquide）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何人員（無論是否法國居民）入境或出境法國時攜帶等於或超過 1 萬歐元（含本數，或等值外幣）的現金或無記名工具，均須向海關申報：紙幣與硬幣；無記名或可背書轉讓的票據（無記名支票、旅行支票、匯票 mandats、非 domicilié 的商業票據與信用證、無記名存單、無記名有價證券與資本化債券）；黃金——金幣，以及未鑄幣形態的金屬（金錠、天然金塊或其他含金量至少 99.5% 的自然金凝聚物）。預付卡僅適用於歐盟內部流動（intra-UE）。兩種流動均須申報：與歐盟以外國家之間（歐盟 (UE) 2018/1672 號條例）以及與歐盟成員國之間（《貨幣與金融法典》L152-1 條）；與摩納哥之間的運送同樣包含，銀行間轉賬及經專門機構的非實體化資金轉賬不適用。為第三方攜帶時，申報還須載明資金所有人身份。未申報、虛假申報或不出示資金：最高可處涉案金額 50% 的罰款並臨時扣留現金；不得事後補報作為補正。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 由實際攜帶現金之人申報。電子方式：經 DALIA 電子申報服務（海關推薦使用），最早可在運送日期前 30 天內、最遲須在旅行當日越過邊境之前提交。紙質方式：歐盟外流動用歐盟統一表格；歐盟內部流動（法國本土、海外省與大區 DROM、聖馬丁）用法國國家表格；涉及聖皮埃爾和密克隆、新喀里多尼亞、法屬波利尼西亞、瓦利斯和富圖納或聖巴泰勒米的流動用 COM 表格。或在入境或出境法國領土之時直接向海關部門申報。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding the customs and tax franchises (franchises douanières et fiscales)
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报（franchises douanières et fiscales）
procedures.agency: Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI)
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving in metropolitan France with goods bought (or received as gifts) in a country or territory that counts as non-EU for these franchises: a third country; a collectivité d'Outre-Mer or New Caledonia (outside the EU customs territory); or a fiscally third territory such as the DOM (Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, Réunion, Mayotte), Saint-Martin, the Channel Islands or the Canary Islands. Within the value franchise nothing is declared and nothing is due: EUR 430 by plane or boat, EUR 300 by car, train or any other mode, EUR 150 for travellers under 15 whatever the mode. Arriving from a DOM, the Channel Islands or the Canary Islands, customs duties are not due but VAT applies above the same value thresholds; Andorra has its own franchise regime. Any object whose value exceeds the franchise must be declared, with VAT and customs duties levied on the whole purchase price. Quantitative franchises on non-EU arrivals (metropolitan France only): tobacco 200 cigarettes (1 carton), 100 cigarillos, 50 cigars or 250 g smoking tobacco, pro-rata assortment within the category, travellers under 17 excluded, not applicable to Andorra tobacco; alcohol 4 L still wine plus 16 L beer plus 1 L over 22% or 2 L at or under 22% (proportionate assortment), travellers under 17 excluded; medicines to the traveller's needs and fuel (normal tank plus a reserve can of up to 10 L) are separately franchised; quantities are per person, not per vehicle. Frontier workers, cross-border workers and international transport staff have reduced franchises (value EUR 75, EUR 40 for under-15s; 40 cigarettes). Returning from an EU member state: no fixed value or quantity caps on this page — products for the traveller's own use bear no French excise, assessed per passenger aged over 18 (décret n° 2024-276).
procedures.applicability_zh: 在视为非欧盟的国家或地区购物（或获赠）后抵达法国本土时适用：第三国；海外领地或新喀里多尼亚（欧盟关税领土之外）；或财政上视为第三方的领地，如海外省 DOM（瓜德罗普、马提尼克、圭亚那、留尼汪、马约特）、圣马丁、盎格鲁-诺曼底群岛或加那利群岛。价值免税额内无须申报、无须缴税：乘飞机或船 430 欧，乘汽车、火车或其他任何方式 300 欧，15 岁以下旅客不论交通方式 150 欧。自海外省、盎格鲁-诺曼底群岛或加那利群岛入境：无须缴关税，但超过同样的价值门槛须缴增值税；安道尔另有专门免税制度。任何价值超过免税额的物品均须申报，增值税与关税按购货全价计征。非欧盟入境的数量免税额（仅限法国本土）：烟草 200 支香烟（1 条）、100 支 cigarillos、50 支雪茄或 250 克吸烟烟丝，同类内可按比例组合，17 岁以下旅客排除，安道尔烟草不适用；酒精 4 升不起泡葡萄酒加 16 升啤酒，加 1 升 22 度以上或 2 升 22 度及以下（可按比例组合），17 岁以下旅客排除；药品以旅客行程所需为限、燃料以正常油箱加最多 10 升备用桶为限，另行免税；数量按人计算而非按车辆。边境居民、跨境工作者与国际运输从业人员适用减免额度（价值 75 欧、15 岁以下 40 欧；香烟 40 支）。自欧盟成员国返回：本页无固定价值或数量上限——自用产品在法国不产生消费税，按 18 岁以上每位旅客逐人判定（2024-276 号政令）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival in France: goods within the value and quantity franchises require no declaration and no payment; above them, the object must be declared, and customs duties, VAT and excise apply to the whole price on the purchase invoice (or the appraised value for a private sale), surplus goods being taxed when several objects are imported at once.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境法国时：价值与数量均在免税额内的物品无须申报、无须缴税；超出时该物品须申报，关税、增值税与消费税按购货发票全价（无发票则按协议估价）计征，同时进口多件物品时超额部分课税。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報（franchises douanières et fiscales）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 在視為非歐盟的國家或地區購物（或獲贈）後抵達法國本土時適用：第三國；海外領地或新喀里多尼亞（歐盟關稅領土之外）；或財政上視為第三方的領地，如海外省 DOM（瓜德羅普、馬提尼克、圭亞那、留尼汪、馬約特）、聖馬丁、盎格魯-諾曼底群島或加那利群島。價值免稅額內無須申報、無須繳稅：乘飛機或船 430 歐，乘汽車、火車或其他任何方式 300 歐，15 歲以下旅客不論交通方式 150 歐。自海外省、盎格魯-諾曼底群島或加那利群島入境：無須繳關稅，但超過同樣的價值門檻須繳增值稅；安道爾另有專門免稅制度。任何價值超過免稅額的物品均須申報，增值稅與關稅按購貨全價計徵。非歐盟入境的數量免稅額（僅限法國本土）：菸草 200 支香菸（1 條）、100 支 cigarillos、50 支雪茄或 250 克吸菸菸絲，同類內可按比例組合，17 歲以下旅客排除，安道爾菸草不適用；酒精 4 升不起泡葡萄酒加 16 升啤酒，加 1 升 22 度以上或 2 升 22 度及以下（可按比例組合），17 歲以下旅客排除；藥品以旅客行程所需為限、燃料以正常油箱加最多 10 升備用桶為限，另行免稅；數量按人計算而非按車輛。邊境居民、跨境工作者與國際運輸從業人員適用減免額度（價值 75 歐、15 歲以下 40 歐；香菸 40 支）。自歐盟成員國返回：本頁無固定價值或數量上限——自用產品在法國不產生消費稅，按 18 歲以上每位旅客逐人判定（2024-276 號政令）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境法國時：價值與數量均在免稅額內的物品無須申報、無須繳稅；超出時該物品須申報，關稅、增值稅與消費稅按購貨發票全價（無發票則按協議估價）計徵，同時進口多件物品時超額部分課稅。

procedures.name_en: Cash and equivalent means of payment declaration (Barmittelanmeldung)
procedures.name_zh: 现金及等同支付手段申报（Barmittelanmeldung）
procedures.agency: Generalzolldirektion / Zoll (German Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Two distinct duties per the Zoll page, not one blanket obligation. (1) Cash (Barmittel): travellers entering Germany from a non-EU member state carrying cash with a total value of 10,000 euros or more must proactively register (anmelden) the amount with customs. (2) Equal means of payment (gleichgestellte Zahlungsmittel, e.g. securities, precious metals, money instruments): these are not subject to proactive registration; they must be declared orally only upon questioning (auf Befragung) by a customs officer. The obligation also applies to passengers from a non-EU state staying in the international transit zone of an EU member state airport before flying on to another non-EU state.
procedures.applicability_zh: 按 Zoll 官方页面，这是两项不同的义务，不能用一句“须主动申报”统括。(1) 现金（Barmittel）：从非欧盟成员国入境德国、携带总价值 10,000 欧元及以上现金的旅客，必须主动向海关申报登记该金额。(2) 等同支付手段（gleichgestellte Zahlungsmittel，如有价证券、贵金属、货币票据）：不适用主动申报，仅在海关人员询问时口头申报。从非欧盟国家出发、经欧盟成员国机场国际中转区前往另一非欧盟国家的旅客同样适用。
procedures.timing_en: Online via the Zollportal service 'Barmittelanmeldeerklärung', form 040000_1; registration and login are required and submission produces a reference number. Paper forms 040000 (German) / 040001 (English) with annex sheets 040050/040051 may still be used in individual cases only — not an unconditional equivalent option.
procedures.timing_zh: 通过 Zollportal 在线服务「Barmittelanmeldeerklärung」办理，表单 040000_1，需注册登录，提交后产生识别码。纸质表 040000（德文）/040001（英文）及附页 040050/040051 仅在个别情况下仍可使用，不是无条件等价的任选路径。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金及等同支付手段申報（Barmittelanmeldung）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 按 Zoll 官方頁面，這是兩項不同的義務，不能用一句“須主動申報”統括。(1) 現金（Barmittel）：從非歐盟成員國入境德國、攜帶總價值 10,000 歐元及以上現金的旅客，必須主動向海關申報登記該金額。(2) 等同支付手段（gleichgestellte Zahlungsmittel，如有價證券、貴金屬、貨幣票據）：不適用主動申報，僅在海關人員詢問時口頭申報。從非歐盟國家出發、經歐盟成員國機場國際中轉區前往另一非歐盟國家的旅客同樣適用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 通過 Zollportal 線上服務「Barmittelanmeldeerklärung」辦理，表單 040000_1，需註冊登入，提交後產生識別碼。紙質表 040000（德文）/040001（英文）及附頁 040050/040051 僅在個別情況下仍可使用，不是無條件等價的任選路徑。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding travellers' allowances (Reisefreimengen)
procedures.name_zh: 超旅客免税额商品申报（Reisefreimengen）
procedures.agency: Generalzolldirektion / Zoll (German Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Entering Germany from a non-EU country: goods up to EUR 300 duty-free (EUR 430 for air/sea travellers, EUR 175 for travellers under 15). Alcohol (17+): 1 L spirits over 22% vol or 2 L up to 22%, plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer. Tobacco (17+): 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g tobacco. Fuel: tank plus up to 10 L in a portable container. Goods above the allowances must be declared and taxed on the whole item value.
procedures.applicability_zh: 自非欧盟国家入境德国：商品价值免税额 300 欧（飞机/海路 430 欧，15 岁以下 175 欧）；酒精（17 岁以上）22% vol 以上 1 升或 22% 及以下 2 升，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒；烟草（17 岁以上）200 支香烟或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟丝；燃料为油箱加最多 10 升备用。超出免税额的商品须申报并按整件计税。
procedures.timing_en: Use the red channel / declare to customs on arrival; the current official page is travellers-allowances_node.html (previously cited _functions.html URL is dead).
procedures.timing_zh: 入境走红通道或向海关申报；现行官方页为 travellers-allowances_node.html（原引用的 _functions.html 已失效）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超旅客免稅額商品申報（Reisefreimengen）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 自非歐盟國家入境德國：商品價值免稅額 300 歐（飛機/海路 430 歐，15 歲以下 175 歐）；酒精（17 歲以上）22% vol 以上 1 升或 22% 及以下 2 升，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒和 16 升啤酒；菸草（17 歲以上）200 支香菸或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸絲；燃料為油箱加最多 10 升備用。超出免稅額的商品須申報並按整件計稅。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境走紅通道或向海關申報；現行官方頁為 travellers-allowances_node.html（原引用的 _functions.html 已失效）。

procedures.name_en: Unsolicited declaration of carried goods at the external border of the customs territory (green/red channel, QuickZoll) — Swiss customs rules applicable to Liechtenstein through the customs union
procedures.name_zh: 在共同海关领地对外边境主动申报随身物品（绿色/红色通道、QuickZoll）——经关税同盟适用于列支敦士登的瑞士海关规则
procedures.agency: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (Bundesamt für Zoll und Grenzsicherheit, BAZG), Switzerland — customs authority for the Swiss customs territory, which includes Liechtenstein under the Customs Union Treaty of 29 March 1923
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering the common Swiss–Liechtenstein customs territory with goods — for Liechtenstein this is effectively its external border (with Austria); the same Swiss rules govern the Swiss external borders, while crossing between Switzerland and Liechtenstein is not a repeat declaration point for these import matters — the 1923 Customs Union Treaty Art. 1(2) expressly provides only that neither side may levy duties or impose general import/export restrictions at that internal border, and no assertion is made that customs questioning or other checks cannot occur there. Territorial basis: Treaty Art. 1(1) and Art. 4(1); EGZV Art. 1(1) (entire Swiss customs legislation applies in Liechtenstein). At the border crossing, travellers should keep recognized valid travel documents ready and unsolicitedly declare all goods and animals they are carrying that are not covered by the duty-free allowances (Freimengen) and the value-free limit (Wertfreigrenze) — i.e. declarable goods must be declared even without being asked. The customs declaration can be completed for most goods with the QuickZoll app (which also pre-calculates import charges for traveller imports); travellers unsure whether goods must be declared should choose the red channel / customs office, while travellers with nothing to declare may use the green channel (e.g. at airports) or display the green visor self-declaration card (Sichtzollanmeldung) on the dashboard when crossing by car. The green self-declaration is binding, and customs staff may conduct controls without questioning. Specific allowance figures (including any CHF 150-type value-free limit) are deliberately NOT asserted here: the direction-specific BAZG subpages carrying the figures were not captured for this record (see unresolved).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：携带物品进入瑞士—列支敦士登共同海关领地的旅客——对列支敦士登而言即其对外边境（与奥地利接壤处）；瑞士对外边境适用同样规则，而在瑞士与列支敦士登之间穿越内部边境不构成此类对外进口事项的重复申报点——1923年《同盟条约》第1条第2款明文仅规定该内部边境双方不得征收关税、不得设一般进出口限制，此处不断言该边境不会发生海关问询或其他查验。属地依据：条约第1条第1款、第4条第1款；EGZV 第1条第1款（瑞士全部海关立法在列支敦士登适用）。过境时应备好受认可的有效旅行证件，并主动（无待询问）申报所携带的一切不在免税额度（Freimengen）与免征限额（Wertfreigrenze）范围内的物品及动物——即须申报物品即使未被询问也须申报。大多数物品的海关申报可用 QuickZoll 应用办理（该应用还可预计算旅行入境物品的进口费用）；不确定是否须申报时应走红色通道/海关柜台，无可申报者可走绿色通道（如机场）或在乘车过境时将绿色自觉申报卡（Sichtzollanmeldung）置于仪表板上。绿色自觉申报具约束力，海关人员可不经问询即实施检查。具体免税额度数字（包括任何类似 150 瑞郎的免征限额）在此明确不作断言：载有数字的分方向 BAZG 子页面本轮未捕获（见未决项）。
procedures.timing_en: At the border crossing on entry: declare carried goods beyond the allowances unsolicited — via the QuickZoll app (self-assessment, usable before reaching the border) or at the red channel / customs post on arrival; nothing to declare → green channel or dashboard visor card. Crossing between Switzerland and Liechtenstein is not a repeat declaration point for this goods declaration — Treaty Art. 1(2) expressly provides only that neither side may levy duties or impose general import/export restrictions at that internal border; no assertion is made that customs questioning or other checks cannot occur there.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境过境时：主动申报超额随身物品——可用 QuickZoll 应用（自行估税，可在抵达边境前办理）或在抵达时经红色通道/海关柜台申报；无可申报则走绿色通道或放置仪表板自觉申报卡。在瑞士与列支敦士登之间穿越不构成此项物品申报的重复申报点——条约第1条第2款明文仅规定该内部边境不得征税、不得设一般进出口限制；此处不断言该边境不会发生海关问询或其他查验。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 在共同海關領地對外邊境主動申報隨身物品（綠色/紅色通道、QuickZoll）——經關稅同盟適用於列支敦士登的瑞士海關規則
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：攜帶物品進入瑞士—列支敦士登共同海關領地的旅客——對列支敦士登而言即其對外邊境（與奧地利接壤處）；瑞士對外邊境適用同樣規則，而在瑞士與列支敦士登之間穿越內部邊境不構成此類對外進口事項的重複申報點——1923年《同盟條約》第1條第2款明文僅規定該內部邊境雙方不得徵收關稅、不得設一般進出口限制，此處不斷言該邊境不會發生海關問詢或其他查驗。屬地依據：條約第1條第1款、第4條第1款；EGZV 第1條第1款（瑞士全部海關立法在列支敦士登適用）。過境時應備好受認可的有效旅行證件，並主動（無待詢問）申報所攜帶的一切不在免稅額度（Freimengen）與免徵限額（Wertfreigrenze）範圍內的物品及動物——即須申報物品即使未被詢問也須申報。大多數物品的海關申報可用 QuickZoll 應用辦理（該應用還可預計算旅行入境物品的進口費用）；不確定是否須申報時應走紅色通道/海關櫃檯，無可申報者可走綠色通道（如機場）或在乘車過境時將綠色自覺申報卡（Sichtzollanmeldung）置於儀表板上。綠色自覺申報具約束力，海關人員可不經問詢即實施檢查。具體免稅額度數字（包括任何類似 150 瑞郎的免徵限額）在此明確不作斷言：載有數字的分方向 BAZG 子頁面本輪未捕獲（見未決項）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境過境時：主動申報超額隨身物品——可用 QuickZoll 應用（自行估稅，可在抵達邊境前辦理）或在抵達時經紅色通道/海關櫃檯申報；無可申報則走綠色通道或放置儀表板自覺申報卡。在瑞士與列支敦士登之間穿越不構成此項物品申報的重複申報點——條約第1條第2款明文僅規定該內部邊境不得徵稅、不得設一般進出口限制；此處不斷言該邊境不會發生海關問詢或其他查驗。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of goods exceeding allowances (franchises hors UE)
procedures.name_zh: 超免税额商品申报（franchises hors UE）
procedures.agency: Administration des douanes et accises du Luxembourg (ADA)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers arriving directly in Luxembourg from a country outside the European Union. On entry, you must declare the transported goods to the customs office (bureau de douane) and pay the corresponding duties and taxes — the current page states an actual traveller submission action, so this entry is retained as a genuine customs declaration duty. Duty-free franchises (purchases or gifts): tobacco products — 200 cigarettes or 100 cigarillos or 50 cigars or 250 g of tobacco (proportional assortment within the same category; travellers under 17 excluded); alcoholic beverages — in total 1 litre of alcohol and alcoholic beverages over 22% vol., or non-denatured ethyl alcohol of 80% vol. and above, or in total 2 litres of alcohol and alcoholic beverages not exceeding 22% vol., plus 4 litres of still wine and up to 16 litres of beer in total (for VAT and excise purposes; travellers under 17 excluded); other goods, including perfume, coffee or tea, and products assimilated to manufactured tobacco such as heated tobacco, e-liquids and nicotine pouches — value not exceeding EUR 430 for travellers by air or sea, EUR 300 for other travellers, reduced to EUR 175 for travellers under 15. Franchise amounts cannot be pooled by several persons for one and the same object (a group or family of four cannot claim the franchise for a EUR 1,720 item), and goods composed of several elements transported together count as a single set regardless of the number of invoices. Any object whose value exceeds the franchise must be declared, and duties and taxes are charged on the total value without any abatement. Personal effects of EU residents in a regular EU situation (bought in the EU with taxes paid, or with proof that EU duties/taxes were paid) may be admitted without formalities and without national duties/taxes; customs may ask for supporting documents on arrival, and unworn items in original packaging, large quantities of apparently new personal effects or high-value electronics can raise a presumption that the franchise conditions are not met.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：自欧盟外国家直接抵达卢森堡的旅客。入境时必须向海关办事处（bureau de douane）申报所运物品并缴纳相应关税与税款——现行官方页面载有真实的旅客申报动作，故本条保留为真实的海关申报义务。免税额度（购物或礼品）：烟草制品——200 支香烟或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克烟草（同类别内可按比例组合；17 岁以下旅客不适用）；酒精饮料——合计 1 升酒精含量超过 22% vol. 的酒精及酒精饮料，或 80% vol. 及以上的非变性乙醇，或合计 2 升不超过 22% vol. 的酒精及酒精饮料，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒及总共最多 16 升啤酒（仅为增值税与消费税目的；17 岁以下旅客不适用）；其他商品（含香水、咖啡、茶，以及视同烟草制品的加热烟草、电子烟烟液与尼古丁袋）——乘飞机或海路旅客价值不超过 430 欧，其他旅客 300 欧，15 岁以下旅客减为 175 欧。多人不得就同一物品合并免税额（四人家庭不能对 1,720 欧物品主张 430 欧×4），由多个部件组成并经同一交通工具同时运输的商品无论发票数量均视为单件成套物品。任何价值超过免税额的物品均须申报，关税与税款按总值计征、不作任何扣减。处于欧盟合规状态（在欧盟含税购得，或能出示欧盟关税/税款已缴证明）的欧盟居民个人自用品可免手续、免国家税费携入；海关可在入境时要求出示凭证，未有明显使用痕迹的原包装物品、大批量看似全新的个人衣物或高价值电子产品可能引发不符合免税条件的推定。
procedures.timing_en: At entry to Luxembourg: declare the transported goods to the customs office and pay the corresponding duties and taxes; goods within the franchise pass free of duties and taxes. The amounts and the declaration duty are stated on the hors-ce subpage of the franchises section (captured live 2026-09-27, HTTP 200). The duties and taxes payable on excess goods are a tax charge on the goods, not a form-filing fee.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境卢森堡时：向海关办事处申报所运物品并缴纳相应关税与税款；免税额内物品免征放行。各项额度与申报义务载于 franchises 栏目 hors-ce 子页（2026-09-27 现场抓取，HTTP 200）。超额物品缴纳的关税与税款属对物品征收的税负，并非表格申报费用。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 超免稅額商品申報（franchises hors UE）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：自歐盟外國家直接抵達盧森堡的旅客。入境時必須向海關辦事處（bureau de douane）申報所運物品並繳納相應關稅與稅款——現行官方頁面載有真實的旅客申報動作，故本條保留為真實的海關申報義務。免稅額度（購物或禮品）：菸草製品——200 支香菸或 100 支 cigarillos 或 50 支雪茄或 250 克菸草（同類別內可按比例組合；17 歲以下旅客不適用）；酒精飲料——合計 1 升酒精含量超過 22% vol. 的酒精及酒精飲料，或 80% vol. 及以上的非變性乙醇，或合計 2 升不超過 22% vol. 的酒精及酒精飲料，另加 4 升不起泡葡萄酒及總共最多 16 升啤酒（僅為增值稅與消費稅目的；17 歲以下旅客不適用）；其他商品（含香水、咖啡、茶，以及視同菸草製品的加熱菸草、電子煙煙液與尼古丁袋）——乘飛機或海路旅客價值不超過 430 歐，其他旅客 300 歐，15 歲以下旅客減為 175 歐。多人不得就同一物品合併免稅額（四人家庭不能對 1,720 歐物品主張 430 歐×4），由多個部件組成並經同一交通工具同時運輸的商品無論發票數量均視為單件成套物品。任何價值超過免稅額的物品均須申報，關稅與稅款按總值計徵、不作任何扣減。處於歐盟合規狀態（在歐盟含稅購得，或能出示歐盟關稅/稅款已繳證明）的歐盟居民個人自用品可免手續、免國家稅費攜入；海關可在入境時要求出示憑證，未有明顯使用痕跡的原包裝物品、大批量看似全新的個人衣物或高價值電子產品可能引發不符合免稅條件的推定。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境盧森堡時：向海關辦事處申報所運物品並繳納相應關稅與稅款；免稅額內物品免徵放行。各項額度與申報義務載於 franchises 欄目 hors-ce 子頁（2026-09-27 現場抓取，HTTP 200）。超額物品繳納的關稅與稅款屬對物品徵收的稅負，並非表格申報費用。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of cross-border transports of accompanied cash of EUR 10,000 or more (déclaration d'argent liquide)
procedures.name_zh: 跨境运输随行现金满 1 万欧元及以上申报（déclaration d'argent liquide）
procedures.agency: Administration des douanes et accises du Luxembourg (ADA)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: any person of full age (whatever their residence and nationality) entering or leaving the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg while carrying accompanied cash of a sum equal to or greater than EUR 10,000, or the equivalent in other currencies. The duty covers both directions and both regimes: transports from Luxembourg to an EU member state (intra-EU) or to a third country (extra-EU), and transports into Luxembourg from an EU member state or from a third country. Declared instruments (aggregate value EUR 10,000 or more): banknotes and coins in circulation as instruments of exchange; bearer negotiable instruments, including monetary instruments such as travellers' cheques; negotiable instruments including cheques, promissory notes and money orders that are to bearer, endorsable without restriction, made out to a fictitious payee, or in a form transferring ownership upon delivery; incomplete signed instruments (cheques, promissory notes, money orders) with no payee indicated; and very liquid stores of value with a high value-to-volume ratio easily converted into cash at low transaction cost — coins containing at least 90% gold, and unminted metal such as ingots, nuggets or other native gold agglomerates containing at least 99.5% gold. Jewellery, diamonds and other precious stones are not covered. The duty applies whether the person carries for their own account or for a third party (individual or company); minors declare through their parents or legal guardians, and adults under guardianship through their legal representative. Interbank transfers are not covered. In extra-EU transports, a customs declaration may additionally be required for gold stores-of-value transported to or from third countries. The declaration is not deemed executed if the information provided is incorrect or incomplete. Non-declaration or false declaration: criminal fine of EUR 251 to 25,000 under article 14 of the law of 16 July 2021, plus possible partial confiscation of the cash — a penalty, not a filing fee. Scope decision: unaccompanied cash forming part of a shipment (e.g. sent by mail, parcel or freight) is subject to a separate disclosure declaration (déclaration de divulgation d'argent liquide) with its own intra-EU and extra-EU forms, and, where not filed beforehand, must be disclosed at the latest within 30 days of an ADA requisition; that shipment procedure is distinct and deliberately outside this traveller accompanied-cash record.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：任何成年人员（无论居住地与国籍）进入或离开卢森堡大公国时携带总和等于或超过 1 万欧元（或等值其他货币）的随行现金。义务双向覆盖、两种制度并包：自卢森堡前往欧盟成员国（欧盟内 intra-UE）或第三国（欧盟外 extra-UE），以及自欧盟成员国或第三国进入卢森堡。应申报工具（合计价值满 1 万欧元及以上）：流通中作为交换手段的纸币与硬币；无记名可转让票据，含旅行支票等无记名货币工具；以无记名、无限制背书、以虚构受益人为抬头或以交付即转移所有权形式存在的可转让票据（支票、本票、汇票）；已签署但未载明受益人姓名的不完整票据（支票、本票、汇票）；以及价值/体积比高、仅低交易成本即可在可及市场轻易变现的高流动性价值储藏商品——含金量至少 90% 的金币，及含金量至少 99.5% 的未铸币金属（金锭、天然金块或其他自然金凝聚物）。珠宝、钻石及其他宝石不属于申报范围。为本人或为第三方（个人或公司）携带均适用义务；未成年人须经父母或法定监护人申报，受监护的成年人须经法定代理人申报。银行间转账不适用。欧盟外运输中，与第三国往来的黄金价值储藏物或须在现金申报之外另行提交海关申报（déclaration en douane）。所提供信息不实或不全的，申报视为未履行。未申报或虚假申报：依 2021 年 7 月 16 日法律第 14 条可处 251 至 25,000 欧刑事罚款，并可能被部分没收现金——此为处罚，并非申报费用。范围决定：作为货物发送的非随行现金（如经邮寄、包裹、货运）适用另一项独立的披露申报（déclaration de divulgation d'argent liquide），另有无欧盟内/欧盟外专用表格；未事先申报的，最迟须在 ADA 要求（réquisition）后 30 日内披露。该发送程序性质不同，明确不在本旅客随行现金记录范围内。
procedures.timing_en: Before the movement (préalablement au déplacement): file the declaration via the MyGuichet procedure 'Déclaration de transport transfrontalier d'argent liquide' (authenticated mode, private or business space, or non-authenticated mode under MyGuichet.lu conditions), or complete and sign the paper form (intra-EU or extra-EU version, plus supplementary sheet if needed) and return it by e-mail to cashdeclaration@do.etat.lu, or by post or by deposit at one of the customs offices: Centre Douanier - Croix de Gasperich, Bureau Nord, or Findel Aérogare (departure: desk Douane/Customs (9) at level 0; arrival: desk contrôle Douane/Customs Control (30) at level -1). If no declaration has been made before entering or leaving the territory, you are in violation of the legal framework. Information: ADA Bureau Centre, (+352) 2818 4499, cashinfo@do.etat.lu. Legal basis: Regulation (EU) 2018/1672, Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/776, the law of 16 July 2021 and the grand-ducal regulation of 16 July 2021.
procedures.timing_zh: 在出行前（préalablement au déplacement）办理：经 MyGuichet 程序「Déclaration de transport transfrontalier d'argent liquide」申报（认证模式——个人空间或专业空间——或按 MyGuichet.lu 规则以非认证模式），或填写并签署纸质表格（欧盟内版或欧盟外版，需要时加附页）后，以电子邮件发回 cashdeclaration@do.etat.lu，或以邮寄/当面递交至以下海关办事处之一：Centre Douanier - Croix de Gasperich、Bureau Nord 或 Findel 机场航站楼（出发：0 层 Douane/Customs 9 号柜台；到达：-1 层 contrôle Douane/Customs Control 30 号柜台）。入境或出境领土前未申报的，即属违反法律框架。咨询：ADA Bureau Centre，(+352) 2818 4499，cashinfo@do.etat.lu。法律依据：欧盟 2018/1672 号条例、欧盟实施条例 2021/776、2021 年 7 月 16 日法律及 2021 年 7 月 16 日大公国条例。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 跨境運輸隨行現金滿 1 萬歐元及以上申報（déclaration d'argent liquide）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：任何成年人員（無論居住地與國籍）進入或離開盧森堡大公國時攜帶總和等於或超過 1 萬歐元（或等值其他貨幣）的隨行現金。義務雙向覆蓋、兩種制度並包：自盧森堡前往歐盟成員國（歐盟內 intra-UE）或第三國（歐盟外 extra-UE），以及自歐盟成員國或第三國進入盧森堡。應申報工具（合計價值滿 1 萬歐元及以上）：流通中作為交換手段的紙幣與硬幣；無記名可轉讓票據，含旅行支票等無記名貨幣工具；以無記名、無限制背書、以虛構受益人為抬頭或以交付即轉移所有權形式存在的可轉讓票據（支票、本票、匯票）；已簽署但未載明受益人姓名的不完整票據（支票、本票、匯票）；以及價值/體積比高、僅低交易成本即可在可及市場輕易變現的高流動性價值儲藏商品——含金量至少 90% 的金幣，及含金量至少 99.5% 的未鑄幣金屬（金錠、天然金塊或其他自然金凝聚物）。珠寶、鑽石及其他寶石不屬於申報範圍。為本人或為第三方（個人或公司）攜帶均適用義務；未成年人須經父母或法定監護人申報，受監護的成年人須經法定代理人申報。銀行間轉賬不適用。歐盟外運輸中，與第三國往來的黃金價值儲藏物或須在現金申報之外另行提交海關申報（déclaration en douane）。所提供資訊不實或不全的，申報視為未履行。未申報或虛假申報：依 2021 年 7 月 16 日法律第 14 條可處 251 至 25,000 歐刑事罰款，並可能被部分沒收現金——此為處罰，並非申報費用。範圍決定：作為貨物發送的非隨行現金（如經郵寄、包裹、貨運）適用另一項獨立的披露申報（déclaration de divulgation d'argent liquide），另有無歐盟內/歐盟外專用表格；未事先申報的，最遲須在 ADA 要求（réquisition）後 30 日內披露。該發送程序性質不同，明確不在本旅客隨行現金記錄範圍內。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 在出行前（préalablement au déplacement）辦理：經 MyGuichet 程序「Déclaration de transport transfrontalier d'argent liquide」申報（認證模式——個人空間或專業空間——或按 MyGuichet.lu 規則以非認證模式），或填寫並簽署紙質表格（歐盟內版或歐盟外版，需要時加附頁）後，以電子郵件發回 cashdeclaration@do.etat.lu，或以郵寄/當面遞交至以下海關辦事處之一：Centre Douanier - Croix de Gasperich、Bureau Nord 或 Findel 機場航站樓（出發：0 層 Douane/Customs 9 號櫃檯；到達：-1 層 contrôle Douane/Customs Control 30 號櫃檯）。入境或出境領土前未申報的，即屬違反法律框架。諮詢：ADA Bureau Centre，(+352) 2818 4499，cashinfo@do.etat.lu。法律依據：歐盟 2018/1672 號條例、歐盟實施條例 2021/776、2021 年 7 月 16 日法律及 2021 年 7 月 16 日大公國條例。

procedures.name_en: Declaration of accompanied cash on entering or leaving Monaco (over EUR 10,000)
procedures.name_zh: 进出摩纳哥随身现金申报（超过1万欧元）
procedures.agency: Direction de la Sûreté Publique — autorité de contrôle designated by Article 52 of Ordonnance Souveraine n° 2.318 (Principauté de Monaco)
procedures.applicability_en: Any natural person entering or leaving the territory of the Principality of Monaco who transports cash on themselves, in their baggage or in their means of transport must declare it when the total is strictly above EUR 10,000 (Law n° 1.362 of 3 August 2009, Art. 60: "supérieur à un montant fixé par ordonnance souveraine"; Ordonnance Souveraine n° 2.318, Art. 64 fixes that amount at 10.000 euros and the annex form is for a "valeur totale excédant 10.000 euros" — exactly EUR 10,000 does not trigger the duty; do not apply the French/EU "EUR 10,000 or more" rule). "Argent liquide" per OS 2.318 Art. 51-1: banknotes and coins in circulation; bearer-negotiable instruments (travellers' cheques; bearer cheques, promissory notes and money orders); gold coins with at least 90% gold and unminted gold (bars, nuggets, aggregates) with at least 99.5% gold; non-named prepaid cards not linked to a bank account. Unaccompanied cash shipped without a carrier falls under Law Art. 60-1 (sender/recipient disclosure) and is out of scope here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 任何自然人进入或离开摩纳哥公国领土，随身、行李或所乘交通工具携带“现金（argent liquide）”且总额严格超过1万欧元时，必须申报：法律第60条原文为“supérieur à un montant fixé par ordonnance souveraine”（严格超过，不含本数），实施令（Ordonnance Souveraine n° 2.318）第64条将该金额定为10.000欧元，附件表单亦写明“valeur totale excédant 10.000 euros”——恰好1万欧元不触发申报义务，不得套用法国/欧盟“满1万即须申报”的口径。“现金”范围（实施令第51-1条）：流通中（或仍可兑换为流通中）的纸币与硬币；无记名可转让票据（旅行支票；无记名支票、本票与汇票）；含金量≥90%的金币与≥99.5%的未铸币黄金（金条、天然金块或聚合体）；不记名且未关联银行账户的预付卡。无承运人随行运送的现金属法律第60-1条（寄件人/收件人申报），不在本条范围。
procedures.timing_en: Dated and signed annex form: by post before transporting the funds, addressed to the Direction de la Sûreté Publique (9, rue Suffren-Reymond, BP 555, MC 98015 Monaco Cedex); or at the latest during the transport of the funds in the Principality, by handing it to an agent of the Sûreté Publique. Keep a duplicate of the declaration during the stay in the Principality and produce it on request (OS 2.318 Arts. 53–54). Law Art. 60 also allows declaration "par écrit ou par voie électronique", but the complete consolidated OS 2.318 as served by Legimonaco (version @2025.06.07, full page verified 2026-09-30) operationalises only these two modes for the Arts. 60/60-1 declarations — no electronic filing channel for them appears anywhere in the ordinance text; whether a separate service outside the ordinance offers one is unconfirmed.
procedures.timing_zh: 使用实施令附件表单（须注明日期并签字）：可在运送资金之前邮寄至公共安全局 Direction de la Sûreté Publique（9, rue Suffren-Reymond, BP 555, MC 98015 Monaco Cedex）；或最迟在公国境内运送资金期间，当面交给公共安全局人员。在公国逗留期间须留存申报副本，并应公共安全局人员要求出示（实施令第53–54条）。法律第60条虽提及“书面或电子形式（par écrit ou par voie électronique）”，但经2026-09-30对 Legimonaco 现行合并版实施令（@2025.06.07）完整页面逐条核验，第52–53条仅落实邮寄与当面递交两种方式，条例全文未载任何针对第60/60-1条申报的电子渠道；条例文本之外的单独服务渠道是否存在仍未确认。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 進出摩納哥隨身現金申報（超過1萬歐元）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 任何自然人進入或離開摩納哥公國領土，隨身、行李或所乘交通工具攜帶“現金（argent liquide）”且總額嚴格超過1萬歐元時，必須申報：法律第60條原文為“supérieur à un montant fixé par ordonnance souveraine”（嚴格超過，不含本數），實施令（Ordonnance Souveraine n° 2.318）第64條將該金額定為10.000歐元，附件表單亦寫明“valeur totale excédant 10.000 euros”——恰好1萬歐元不觸發申報義務，不得套用法國/歐盟“滿1萬即須申報”的口徑。“現金”範圍（實施令第51-1條）：流通中（或仍可兌換為流通中）的紙幣與硬幣；無記名可轉讓票據（旅行支票；無記名支票、本票與匯票）；含金量≥90%的金幣與≥99.5%的未鑄幣黃金（金條、天然金塊或聚合體）；不記名且未關聯銀行賬戶的預付卡。無承運人隨行運送的現金屬法律第60-1條（寄件人/收件人申報），不在本條範圍。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 使用實施令附件表單（須註明日期並簽字）：可在運送資金之前郵寄至公共安全局 Direction de la Sûreté Publique（9, rue Suffren-Reymond, BP 555, MC 98015 Monaco Cedex）；或最遲在公國境內運送資金期間，當面交給公共安全局人員。在公國逗留期間須留存申報副本，並應公共安全局人員要求出示（實施令第53–54條）。法律第60條雖提及“書面或電子形式（par écrit ou par voie électronique）”，但經2026-09-30對 Legimonaco 現行合併版實施令（@2025.06.07）完整頁面逐條核驗，第52–53條僅落實郵寄與當面遞交兩種方式，條例全文未載任何針對第60/60-1條申報的電子渠道；條例文本之外的單獨服務渠道是否存在仍未確認。

Verified to contain Arts. 1–64 plus the annex, closing the 2026-09-29 truncation gap: Chapitre XVI 'Transport transfrontalier d'argent liquide' (Arts. 51-1–54) — Art. 51-1 (créé à compter du 31 décembre 2021 par l'ordonnance n° 8.634 du 29 avril 2021) defines argent liquide (espèces; instruments négociables au porteur incl. chèques de voyage; pièces ≥90 % d'or and métal non monnayé ≥99,5 % d'or; cartes prépayées non nominatives); Art. 52 designates the Direction de la Sûreté Publique as autorité de contrôle and requires the annex form 'formulaire tenu à la disposition du public'; Art. 53 provides only postal submission before transport or hand-over to a Sûreté Publique agent at the latest during transport; Art. 54 duplicate retention; Art. 64 fixes the Law Arts. 60/60-1 amounts at 10.000 euros; annex 'pour une valeur totale excédant 10.000 euros'. procedures.name_en: Cash and gold declaration when entering or leaving the EU through the Netherlands (EUR 10,000 or more)
procedures.name_zh: 经荷兰进出欧盟的现金与黄金申报（满1万欧元及以上，aangifte geld of goud）
procedures.agency: Douane — Belastingdienst (Netherlands Customs)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers carrying cash and/or gold with a total value of EUR 10,000 or more must declare it to Dutch Customs when entering or leaving the European Union through the Netherlands (douane.nl, page last updated 07-04-2026: 'If you are carrying cash or gold with a (total) value of € 10,000 or more and you are travelling into or out of the EU, you must declare it'). Qualifying gold covers only nuggets and gold bars with a gold content of at least 99.5% and coins with a gold content of at least 90%; ordinary gold jewellery and other gold objects are NOT part of the cash-and-gold declaration — they follow the goods value rules (declare and pay tax when bringing products worth more than EUR 430 per person from outside the EU). The test is the euro-converted total of all currencies; it applies per person and to the person transporting the funds, even when carrying on behalf of someone else, whether as hand or hold luggage. Direct movements between the Netherlands and another EU country are NOT declared to Dutch Customs (the other country may have its own rules). Each entry into and exit out of the EU must be declared separately. Non-, incomplete or incorrect declaration: fine of at least EUR 1,000 and possibly imprisonment. This narrows the v18 entry, which overstated the duty as a generic EUR 10,000 arrival rule without the EU external-border scope or the gold-content limits.
procedures.applicability_zh: 携带现金和/或黄金总值满1万欧元及以上的旅客，经荷兰进入或离开欧盟时必须向荷兰海关申报（douane.nl官方英文页，最后更新2026-04-07，原文：“If you are carrying cash or gold with a (total) value of € 10,000 or more and you are travelling into or out of the EU, you must declare it”）。计入的“黄金”仅限：含金量≥99.5%的天然金块与金条、含金量≥90%的金币；普通黄金首饰及其他黄金制品不属于现金申报对象，适用商品价值规则（自欧盟外携入商品价值超过每人430欧元须申报并纳税）。金额按折算欧元后的总值计算；按人头分别适用，由实际运输资金的人负责申报（代人携带亦然）；手提或托运行李均不影响义务。荷兰与其他欧盟国家之间的直接流动无须向荷兰海关申报（对方国可能另有规定）。每次进出欧盟均须分别申报。不申报、申报不全或申报不实：罚款至少1,000欧元，甚至可能监禁。此条收窄v18旧记录——旧记录泛化为“携带1万欧元即须申报”的入境规则，未限定欧盟外部边界范围，也未载明黄金成色界限。
procedures.timing_en: Complete the declaration form and submit it to Customs at the point where you enter or leave the EU (the form can also be requested from Customs there). By plane: departing from Schiphol — declare to Customs in departure hall 3 (Tax refund/OB-teruggave office), making sure to do so before checking in luggage and going through security; departing from another Dutch airport — Customs at that airport; arriving in the Netherlands from outside the EU — go to the exit with the 'Goods to declare/ Aangifte goederen' sign. By ship: hand in the cash declaration form at the Customs Office of the port of entry or departure, directly or through a shipping agent or shipbroker. By road: declare at the point where you enter or leave the EU, which may be in another member state (e.g. Greece or Bulgaria on an Istanbul–Rotterdam route). Declare at the first EU point of entry or the last point of exit (with a layover in Frankfurt you declare in Frankfurt, not Amsterdam).
procedures.timing_zh: 填写申报表并在进入或离开欧盟的地点提交海关（也可在该地点向海关索取表格）。乘飞机：自史基浦机场出发——在3号出发大厅海关（Tax refund/OB-teruggave 办事处）申报，务必在行李托运与安检之前办理；自荷兰其他机场出发——在该机场海关办理；从欧盟外抵达荷兰——走“Goods to declare/ Aangifte goederen”标识通道办理。乘船：在入出港港口的海关办事处提交现金申报表，可直接办理或经船舶代理/经纪办理。公路：在进出欧盟的地点申报，该地点可能在其他成员国（如伊斯坦布尔—鹿特丹路线在希腊或保加利亚申报）。应在进入/离开欧盟的第一站（或最后一站）申报——如在法兰克福中转即在法兰克福而非阿姆斯特丹申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 經荷蘭進出歐盟的現金與黃金申報（滿1萬歐元及以上，aangifte geld of goud）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 攜帶現金和/或黃金總值滿1萬歐元及以上的旅客，經荷蘭進入或離開歐盟時必須向荷蘭海關申報（douane.nl官方英文頁，最後更新2026-04-07，原文：“If you are carrying cash or gold with a (total) value of € 10,000 or more and you are travelling into or out of the EU, you must declare it”）。計入的“黃金”僅限：含金量≥99.5%的天然金塊與金條、含金量≥90%的金幣；普通黃金首飾及其他黃金製品不屬於現金申報對象，適用商品價值規則（自歐盟外攜入商品價值超過每人430歐元須申報並納稅）。金額按折算歐元后的總值計算；按人頭分別適用，由實際運輸資金的人負責申報（代人攜帶亦然）；手提或托運行李均不影響義務。荷蘭與其他歐盟國家之間的直接流動無須向荷蘭海關申報（對方國可能另有規定）。每次進出歐盟均須分別申報。不申報、申報不全或申報不實：罰款至少1,000歐元，甚至可能監禁。此條收窄v18舊記錄——舊記錄泛化為“攜帶1萬歐元即須申報”的入境規則，未限定歐盟外部邊界範圍，也未載明黃金成色界限。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 填寫申報表並在進入或離開歐盟的地點提交海關（也可在該地點向海關索取表格）。乘飛機：自史基浦機場出發——在3號出發大廳海關（Tax refund/OB-teruggave 辦事處）申報，務必在行李託運與安檢之前辦理；自荷蘭其他機場出發——在該機場海關辦理；從歐盟外抵達荷蘭——走“Goods to declare/ Aangifte goederen”標識通道辦理。乘船：在入出港港口的海關辦事處提交現金申報表，可直接辦理或經船舶代理/經紀辦理。公路：在進出歐盟的地點申報，該地點可能在其他成員國（如伊斯坦布爾—鹿特丹路線在希臘或保加利亞申報）。應在進入/離開歐盟的第一站（或最後一站）申報——如在法蘭克福中轉即在法蘭克福而非阿姆斯特丹申報。

procedures.name_en: Proactive declaration of goods on entry into Switzerland with quantity allowances (Freimengen) and the CHF 150 VAT value-free limit — Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (BAZG)
procedures.name_zh: 入境瑞士物品主动申报及免税量（Freimengen）与 150 瑞郎增值税免征限额——瑞士联邦海关与边境安全局（BAZG）
procedures.agency: Bundesamt für Zoll und Grenzsicherheit (BAZG / Federal Office for Customs and Border Security), Switzerland — national customs authority
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers entering Switzerland (including residents returning from abroad). Per BAZG pages captured live on 2026-09-27 (all HTTP 200). This is a proactive goods-declaration procedure for goods that are not duty-free on entry. At the border crossing you contribute to a rapid customs assessment by keeping recognised valid travel documents ready and proactively declaring (unaufgefordert anmelden) the goods and animals you carry that are not duty-free — that is, that exceed the quantity allowances (Freimengen) or the CHF 150 VAT value-free limit, or that are prohibited or restricted; the customs declaration can be handled for most goods with the official BAZG app QuickZoll before crossing (the app also computes import charges in advance; it does not apply to internet shopping). Travellers with nothing to declare — those carrying only goods that are duty-free within the Freimengen and the value-free limit or already taxed via QuickZoll — can use the green way at airports; when crossing by car, the green visible customs declaration (grüne Sichtzollanmeldung) may be placed on the dashboard — it is a binding declaration that you and your fellow passengers carry only goods that are duty-free within the Freimengen and the value-free limit or that you have already taxed via QuickZoll, and customs staff may carry out checks without questioning; if you are unsure whether your goods must be declared, choose the red passage. VAT value-free limit (Wertfreigrenze): when returning from abroad or entering Switzerland you may import goods up to a total value of CHF 150 inclusive ('bis zu einem Gesamtwert von 150 Franken') free of VAT, provided they are for your private use or as gifts; only a total value strictly exceeding CHF 150 triggers VAT on the entire value of the imported goods; the limit may be used once per person per day and also applies to children; single items valued over CHF 150 are always VAT-taxable regardless of the number of persons; the decisive value is the price net of foreign VAT where this is shown on the receipt/invoice, and foreign-currency values are converted into Swiss francs; the VAT rate is 8.1%, with a reduced rate of 2.6% for certain goods (e.g. foodstuffs, non-alcoholic beverages, books, magazines, medicines); in principle all carried goods count towards the limit — including duty-free foodstuffs, tobacco products, alcoholic beverages, pets and repairs/maintenance carried out abroad on your own vehicle — while the value of personal effects, travel provisions (Reiseproviant) and vehicle fuel is not counted; presenting a receipt or other proof of value eases assessment. Quantity allowances (Freimengen) per person per day, calculation basis gross weight: meat and meat preparations of all animal species, excluding wild game, fish, crustaceans, molluscs and other aquatic invertebrates — 1 kg in total, excess CHF 17 per kg up to 10 kg and CHF 23 per kg above 10 kg (includes edible animal parts with or without bone, meat/blood sausages, other meat products, and prepared foods with more than 20% by weight of sausage, meat or blood assessed on total preparation weight; marrow bone and sauce bones and labelled retail-pack pet food are excluded); butter and cream with fat content from 15% — 1 kg/litre in total, excess CHF 16 per kg/litre; oils, fats and margarine for food purposes — 5 kg/litre in total, excess CHF 2 per kg/litre; alcoholic beverages (allowances only for persons aged at least 17): up to 18% vol. alcohol — 5 litres in total, excess CHF 2 per litre; over 18% vol. alcohol — 1 litre in total, excess CHF 15 per litre (beverages with an alcohol content up to 0.5% vol. do not count as alcoholic beverages); tobacco products (including tobacco substitute products): cigarettes/cigars/heated-tobacco products/nicotine cartridges for e-cigarettes — 250 pieces in total, excess CHF 0.25 per piece; other tobacco products — 250 g in total, excess CHF 0.10 per g; nicotine-containing liquids for e-cigarettes — 250 ml, excess CHF 0.25 per ml; electronic single-use cigarettes — 25 pieces, excess CHF 2.50 per piece; a proportional combination of these products is permitted; other foodstuffs and other goods are duty-free. Animal products may be imported exclusively from EU member states, Iceland, Northern Ireland and Norway — import from other countries is prohibited. If the total value of the carried goods (including the value of all foodstuffs) exceeds CHF 150, VAT must in any case be paid; in addition to VAT, customs duty is payable when the carried goods exceed the Freimengen for alcoholic beverages, tobacco products and certain foodstuffs. Certain goods are prohibited or subject to restrictions on import (e.g. species-protected plants, animals and goods, counterfeits, weapons, fireworks, medicines).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：进入瑞士（含自境外返程）的旅客。据 2026-09-27 实时取得的 BAZG 官方页面（均 HTTP 200）。这是一项针对入境不免税物品的主动申报程序。过境时，备好经认可的有效旅行证件、并主动（unaufgefordert anmelden）申报随身携带的不免税物品和动物——即超过免税量（Freimengen）或 150 瑞郎增值税免征限额、或受禁止/限制的物品——有助于快速完成海关核定；多数物品的海关申报可在过境前用 BAZG 官方应用 QuickZoll 办理（该应用还可预先计算进口税费；不适用于网购）。仅携带免税额度内物品或已经 QuickZoll 完税、无物申报的旅客，在机场可走绿色通道；自驾过境时可将绿色自行申报卡（grüne Sichtzollanmeldung）置于仪表板上——这是一项有约束力的声明，表示您与同行者仅携带在免税量（Freimengen）和免征限额内免税的物品、或已经 QuickZoll 完税的物品，海关人员可不经问询直接实施查验；如不确定物品是否须申报，建议选择红色通道。增值税免征限额（Wertfreigrenze）：自境外返回或进入瑞士时，总价值不超过（含）150 瑞郎（'bis zu einem Gesamtwert von 150 Franken'）的自用或礼品物品可免征增值税入境；只有总价值严格超过 150 瑞郎，才须对进口物品的全部价值缴纳增值税；该限额每人每日仅可使用一次，儿童同样适用；单件价值超过 150 瑞郎的物品不论同行人数一律应税；计值以收据/发票所列外国增值税扣除后的金额为准（如已列明），外币金额换算为瑞士法郎；增值税率为 8.1%，特定商品适用 2.6% 低税率（如食品、无酒精饮料、书籍、杂志、药品）；原则上全部随身物品计入限额——包括免税的食品、烟草制品、酒精饮料、宠物以及在境外对自有车辆进行的维修保养——但不计入个人随身物品、旅途口粮（Reiseproviant）和车辆燃料的价值；出示收据或其他价值证明有助于核定。免税量（Freimengen，每人每日，以毛重为计算基础）：各种动物的肉类及肉制品（野味、鱼、甲壳类、软体动物及其他水生无脊椎动物除外）合计 1 公斤，超出部分在 10 公斤以内每公斤 CHF 17、超过 10 公斤每公斤 CHF 23（含带骨或不带骨的可食动物部位、肉肠/血肠、其他肉制品，以及香肠、肉或血含量超过 20% 重量比的预制食品——按预制食品总重计；髓骨、汤骨及以零售包装标明为宠物食品的猫狗粮不计入）；脂肪含量 15% 及以上的黄油和奶油合计 1 公斤/升，超出部分每公斤/升 CHF 16；供食用的油、脂、人造奶油合计 5 公斤/升，超出部分每公斤/升 CHF 2；酒精饮料（仅年满 17 周岁者享有免税量）：酒精含量 18% vol. 及以下合计 5 升，超出每升 CHF 2；超过 18% vol. 合计 1 升，超出每升 CHF 15（酒精含量 0.5% vol. 及以下的饮料不属于酒精饮料）；烟草制品（含烟草替代品）：香烟/雪茄/加热烟草制品/电子烟尼古丁烟弹合计 250 支，超出每支 CHF 0.25；其他烟草制品合计 250 克，超出每克 CHF 0.10；电子烟尼古丁液体 250 毫升，超出每毫升 CHF 0.25；电子一次性香烟 25 支，超出每支 CHF 2.50；这些制品可按比例组合选用；其他食品和其他商品免税。动物源产品仅允许自欧盟成员国、冰岛、北爱尔兰和挪威进口，来自其他国家的进口被禁止。随身物品总价值（含全部食品价值）超过 150 瑞郎时，无论如何须缴纳增值税；超过酒精饮料、烟草制品和特定食品的免税量时，除增值税外还须缴纳关税。特定物品禁止入境或受限制（如受物种保护的动植物及其制品、仿冒品、武器、烟花爆竹、药品等）。
procedures.timing_en: At the border on entry into Switzerland: proactively declare the goods and animals you carry that exceed the Freimengen or the CHF 150 value-free limit or that are prohibited or restricted — for most goods via the QuickZoll app before crossing, otherwise at the red passage (choose the red passage also when unsure whether goods must be declared). With nothing to declare — only goods that are duty-free within the allowances or already taxed via QuickZoll — use the green way (airports) or place the green Sichtzollanmeldung on the dashboard (car); the green sign is itself a binding summary declaration, and customs may inspect without questioning. If the total value strictly exceeds CHF 150, VAT (8.1%, reduced 2.6%) is due on the entire value; quantities above the Freimengen additionally attract customs duty per kg/litre/piece as listed.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境瑞士在边境时：主动申报随身携带的超过免税量（Freimengen）或 150 瑞郎免征限额、或受禁止/限制的物品和动物——多数物品可在过境前经 QuickZoll 应用办理，否则走红色通道当场申报（不确定物品是否须申报时亦应选择红色通道）。无物申报——即仅携带免税额度内物品或已经 QuickZoll 完税——则走绿色通道（机场）或将绿色自行申报卡置于仪表板（自驾），绿色标示本身即构成有约束力的概括声明，海关可不经问询直接查验。总价值严格超过 150 瑞郎时，须按全部价值缴纳增值税（8.1%，低税率 2.6%）；超过免税量的部分另按所列标准（每公斤/升/支）缴纳关税。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境瑞士物品主動申報及免稅量（Freimengen）與 150 瑞郎增值稅免徵限額——瑞士聯邦海關與邊境安全局（BAZG）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：進入瑞士（含自境外返程）的旅客。據 2026-09-27 實時取得的 BAZG 官方頁面（均 HTTP 200）。這是一項針對入境不免稅物品的主動申報程序。過境時，備好經認可的有效旅行證件、並主動（unaufgefordert anmelden）申報隨身攜帶的不免稅物品和動物——即超過免稅量（Freimengen）或 150 瑞郎增值稅免徵限額、或受禁止/限制的物品——有助於快速完成海關核定；多數物品的海關申報可在過境前用 BAZG 官方應用 QuickZoll 辦理（該應用還可預先計算進口稅費；不適用於網購）。僅攜帶免稅額度內物品或已經 QuickZoll 完稅、無物申報的旅客，在機場可走綠色通道；自駕過境時可將綠色自行申報卡（grüne Sichtzollanmeldung）置於儀表板上——這是一項有約束力的聲明，表示您與同行者僅攜帶在免稅量（Freimengen）和免徵限額內免稅的物品、或已經 QuickZoll 完稅的物品，海關人員可不經問詢直接實施查驗；如不確定物品是否須申報，建議選擇紅色通道。增值稅免徵限額（Wertfreigrenze）：自境外返回或進入瑞士時，總價值不超過（含）150 瑞郎（'bis zu einem Gesamtwert von 150 Franken'）的自用或禮品物品可免徵增值稅入境；只有總價值嚴格超過 150 瑞郎，才須對進口物品的全部價值繳納增值稅；該限額每人每日僅可使用一次，兒童同樣適用；單件價值超過 150 瑞郎的物品不論同行人數一律應稅；計值以收據/發票所列外國增值稅扣除後的金額為準（如已列明），外幣金額換算為瑞士法郎；增值稅率為 8.1%，特定商品適用 2.6% 低稅率（如食品、無酒精飲料、書籍、雜誌、藥品）；原則上全部隨身物品計入限額——包括免稅的食品、菸草製品、酒精飲料、寵物以及在境外對自有車輛進行的維修保養——但不計入個人隨身物品、旅途口糧（Reiseproviant）和車輛燃料的價值；出示收據或其他價值證明有助於核定。免稅量（Freimengen，每人每日，以毛重為計算基礎）：各種動物的肉類及肉製品（野味、魚、甲殼類、軟體動物及其他水生無脊椎動物除外）合計 1 公斤，超出部分在 10 公斤以內每公斤 CHF 17、超過 10 公斤每公斤 CHF 23（含帶骨或不帶骨的可食動物部位、肉腸/血腸、其他肉製品，以及香腸、肉或血含量超過 20% 重量比的預製食品——按預製食品總重計；髓骨、湯骨及以零售包裝標明為寵物食品的貓狗糧不計入）；脂肪含量 15% 及以上的黃油和奶油合計 1 公斤/升，超出部分每公斤/升 CHF 16；供食用的油、脂、人造奶油合計 5 公斤/升，超出部分每公斤/升 CHF 2；酒精飲料（僅年滿 17 週歲者享有免稅量）：酒精含量 18% vol. 及以下合計 5 升，超出每升 CHF 2；超過 18% vol. 合計 1 升，超出每升 CHF 15（酒精含量 0.5% vol. 及以下的飲料不屬於酒精飲料）；菸草製品（含菸草替代品）：香菸/雪茄/加熱菸草製品/電子煙尼古丁煙彈合計 250 支，超出每支 CHF 0.25；其他菸草製品合計 250 克，超出每克 CHF 0.10；電子煙尼古丁液體 250 毫升，超出每毫升 CHF 0.25；電子一次性香菸 25 支，超出每支 CHF 2.50；這些製品可按比例組合選用；其他食品和其他商品免稅。動物源產品僅允許自歐盟成員國、冰島、北愛爾蘭和挪威進口，來自其他國家的進口被禁止。隨身物品總價值（含全部食品價值）超過 150 瑞郎時，無論如何須繳納增值稅；超過酒精飲料、菸草製品和特定食品的免稅量時，除增值稅外還須繳納關稅。特定物品禁止入境或受限制（如受物種保護的動植物及其製品、仿冒品、武器、煙花爆竹、藥品等）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境瑞士在邊境時：主動申報隨身攜帶的超過免稅量（Freimengen）或 150 瑞郎免徵限額、或受禁止/限制的物品和動物——多數物品可在過境前經 QuickZoll 應用辦理，否則走紅色通道當場申報（不確定物品是否須申報時亦應選擇紅色通道）。無物申報——即僅攜帶免稅額度內物品或已經 QuickZoll 完稅——則走綠色通道（機場）或將綠色自行申報卡置於儀表板（自駕），綠色標示本身即構成有約束力的概括聲明，海關可不經問詢直接查驗。總價值嚴格超過 150 瑞郎時，須按全部價值繳納增值稅（8.1%，低稅率 2.6%）；超過免稅量的部分另按所列標準（每公斤/升/支）繳納關稅。

procedures.name_en: Incoming Passenger Card for Christmas Island — inwards air passengers
procedures.name_zh: 圣诞岛入境旅客卡（Incoming Passenger Card）——入境航空旅客
procedures.agency: Customs and Immigration authorities for Christmas Island entry (AIP GEN 1.3 para 8.3.3 names no issuing form operator)
procedures.applicability_en: Each passenger arriving at Christmas Island by air. Within AIP GEN 1.3 section 8 (designated Australian External Territory international airports), physical PDF page 90, para 8.3.3(a) requires inwards passengers to complete an Incoming Passenger Card for both Customs and Immigration purposes; the card includes a Customs declaration, which includes a requirement to declare all prohibited imports. Card medium (paper or electronic), full field list and distribution method are not stated in the cited text; no sea or other non-air route is asserted. The AIP does not state an IPC submission fee; the fee remains unknown.
procedures.applicability_zh: 乘飞机抵达圣诞岛的每名旅客。在 AIP GEN 1.3 第 8 节（指定的澳大利亚外领地国际机场）范围内，PDF 实体页 90 第 8.3.3(a) 段要求入境旅客填写一张同时用于海关（Customs）与移民（Immigration）目的的入境旅客卡（Incoming Passenger Card）；该卡含海关申报，其中包括申报全部禁止进口物品的要求。所引文本未说明卡片介质（纸质或电子）、完整字段清单与发放方式；不主张海运或其他非航空路线。AIP未载明该卡提交费用，费用仍为未知。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival (inwards) at the Christmas Island international airport. The exact point at which the card is issued or collected is not stated in the cited text.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达（入境）圣诞岛国际机场时。所引文本未说明该卡发放或收取的确切环节。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 聖誕島入境旅客卡（Incoming Passenger Card）——入境航空旅客
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 乘飛機抵達聖誕島的每名旅客。在 AIP GEN 1.3 第 8 節（指定的澳大利亞外領地國際機場）範圍內，PDF 實體頁 90 第 8.3.3(a) 段要求入境旅客填寫一張同時用於海關（Customs）與移民（Immigration）目的的入境旅客卡（Incoming Passenger Card）；該卡含海關申報，其中包括申報全部禁止進口物品的要求。所引文本未說明卡片介質（紙質或電子）、完整欄位清單與發放方式；不主張海運或其他非航空路線。AIP未載明該卡提交費用，費用仍為未知。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達（入境）聖誕島國際機場時。所引文本未說明該卡發放或收取的確切環節。

procedures.name_en: Incoming Passenger Card (Cocos (Keeling) Islands)
procedures.name_zh: 入境旅客卡（科科斯（基林）群岛）
procedures.agency: Customs and Immigration authorities (AIP GEN 1.3 §8.4.2(a) states the card is completed for both Customs and Immigration purposes; the source names no issuing form operator)
procedures.applicability_en: All passengers arriving by air at the Cocos (Keeling) Islands designated international airport (AIP GEN 1.3 §8.2.1(b), §8.4.2(a); page footer 09 JUL 2026) must complete an Incoming Passenger Card for both Customs and Immigration purposes. The card includes a Customs declaration, which includes a requirement to declare all prohibited imports. Applicability to sea arrivals is not established by this source and is not asserted.
procedures.applicability_zh: 所有乘飞机抵达科科斯（基林）群岛指定国际机场的旅客（AIP GEN 1.3 第8.2.1(b)条、第8.4.2(a)条，页脚日期2026年7月9日）均须填写入境旅客卡（Incoming Passenger Card），兼作海关与移民用途。该卡包含海关申报，其中包括申报所有禁止进口物品的要求。本来源未确立海路抵达是否适用，本记录亦不作此断言。
procedures.timing_en: On inwards arrival by air; the exact distribution point of the card and any completion or submission deadline are not captured in the AIP excerpt.
procedures.timing_zh: 乘飞机入境抵达时；AIP摘录未载明该卡的具体发放时点及任何填写或提交期限。

procedures.name_en: Heard Island and McDonald Islands — entry permit required (EPMO 1987, AAD permits page)
procedures.name_zh: 赫德岛和麦当劳群岛——入境许可要求（EPMO 1987，澳南极局许可页）
procedures.agency: Australian Antarctic Division (AAD), Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water, Australia
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: any person or expedition seeking to access Heard Island and McDonald Islands (HIMI). Per the AAD permits page: the HIMI Environment Protection and Management Ordinance 1987 (EPMO) provides that a person may only enter the HIMI Territory (including the 12 nautical miles territorial sea) in accordance with a permit issued under the Ordinance, or during an emergency, or while performing duties as an inspector appointed under the EPMO. Per the AAD territory page: the Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water is responsible for the administration of the HIMI Territory, and the Australian Antarctic Division fulfils this role for the Department. Applications must be submitted at least five months in advance. No ordinary traveller declaration entry was found on the AAD pages this round; recorded as unresolved.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：任何寻求进入赫德岛和麦当劳群岛（HIMI）的人员或探险队。据AAD许可页：1987年环境保护与管理条例（EPMO）规定，人员只能依据该条例签发的许可进入HIMI领地（包括12海里领海），或在紧急情况下，或在履行EPMO任命的监察员职责时进入。据AAD领地页：气候变化、能源、环境和水务部负责HIMI领地的行政管理，澳大利亚南极局代行该职能。申请须至少提前5个月提交。本轮在AAD页面未发现普通旅客申报入口——记入unresolved。
procedures.timing_en: Permit application at least 5 months in advance.
procedures.timing_zh: 许可申请至少提前5个月提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 赫德島和麥當勞群島——入境許可要求（EPMO 1987，澳南極局許可頁）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：任何尋求進入赫德島和麥當勞群島（HIMI）的人員或探險隊。據AAD許可頁：1987年環境保護與管理條例（EPMO）規定，人員只能依據該條例簽發的許可進入HIMI領地（包括12海里領海），或在緊急情況下，或在履行EPMO任命的監察員職責時進入。據AAD領地頁：氣候變化、能源、環境和水務部負責HIMI領地的行政管理，澳大利亞南極局代行該職能。申請須至少提前5個月提交。本輪在AAD頁面未發現普通旅客申報入口——記入unresolved。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 許可申請至少提前5個月提交。

procedures.name_en: New Zealand Traveller Declaration (NZTD) — unified immigration, customs and biosecurity digital declaration
procedures.name_zh: 新西兰旅客申报（NZTD）——移民、海关与生物安全统一数字申报
procedures.agency: New Zealand Customs Service
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: everyone travelling into New Zealand must complete a New Zealand Traveller Declaration (NZTD), including New Zealand citizens and residents; it is free to submit. Complete a digital declaration at www.TravellerDeclaration.govt.nz or via the NZTD app (App Store / Google Play); a paper declaration form is available on arrival if needed, and is not required if you have completed a digital declaration. The online form is available in 14 additional languages but questions must be answered in English; translated examples of the paper form are reference only and cannot be printed and presented to Customs or MPI staff. Air travellers transiting New Zealand who stay in the airport transit area do not need a declaration; travellers arriving unexpectedly due to emergencies (medical evacuation, rescue at sea, temporary weather diversion) may not need one. Starting a declaration triggers an emailed reference number used to review, complete or change it; any change requires resubmission; nothing needs to be printed. The NZTD app may be unavailable in some international regions and, for maritime travellers, is limited to cruise-ship arrivals; those unable to use the app can still complete the online form. INFORMATION REQUIRED: details of the passport you will use to enter New Zealand; contact details in New Zealand (first address if staying in multiple locations); travel history from the last 30 days; flight or voyage details; what you are bringing into New Zealand including checked-in luggage and carry-on bags; immigration status including your visa or NZeTA if you need one. Each traveller, including babies and children, needs an individual declaration; caregivers may complete it on behalf of children, and the app can copy travel details between declarations for the same journey. SUBMISSION TIMING: air — earliest 24 hours before you start your trip to New Zealand; with a stopover where you leave the airport with your bags, 24 hours before the flight leaving the stopover; on multiple flights without a stopover, 24 hours before the first leg. Sea — earliest 24 hours before departing the vessel's last foreign port. Declarations can be changed up until you reach passport control or are processed by a border officer, and no longer after; anything forgotten must be raised with a border officer. WHAT TO DECLARE (select 'Yes' in your NZTD): medicine — over three months' supply, or medicine not prescribed to you; restricted or prohibited goods — e.g. weapons, indecent publications, endangered plants or wildlife, illegal or controlled drugs; alcohol — more than three bottles of spirits (not exceeding 1.125 litres each) and 4.5 litres of wine or beer; tobacco — more than 50 cigarettes, or 50 grams of tobacco products (including a mixture of cigarettes and other tobacco products); goods obtained overseas and/or purchased duty-free in New Zealand with a total value of more than NZ$700 (including gifts); goods carried for business or commercial use; goods carried on behalf of another person; cash — NZ$10,000 or more (or foreign equivalent), including travellers cheques, bank drafts and money orders. ALLOWANCE CONTEXT: the alcohol, tobacco and NZ$700 limits are personal traveller concessions, with no separate application — you must be 17 or older to claim the alcohol and tobacco concessions (18 to buy them in New Zealand), families and groups cannot pool their NZ$700 goods allowances, and duty and GST are payable on the excess above any limit. Items meeting biosecurity requirements do not need declaring: clothing, footwear, jewellery and toiletries intended solely for your own use ('personal effects'); have purchase receipts available. PENALTIES: a NZ$400 instant fine (the minimum) for failing to declare restricted or prohibited items or making a false or incorrect declaration; false declarations can also lead to confiscation of goods, prosecution, imprisonment and deportation from New Zealand. On arrival you must answer all NZTD questions and produce your identity documents; it is an offence not to. After clearing passport control and collecting baggage, follow the appropriate lanes through biosecurity screening.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：所有进入新西兰的旅客均须完成新西兰旅客申报（NZTD），含新西兰公民与居民；提交免费。可通过 www.TravellerDeclaration.govt.nz 网站或 NZTD 应用（App Store / Google Play）完成数字申报；如需，抵达时有纸质申报表可填，已完成数字申报者无须再填纸质表。在线表单另有14种语言版本，但问题须以英语回答；纸质申报表的翻译样本仅供参考，不可打印后向海关或MPI人员出示。经新西兰中转且不离开机场中转区的空运旅客无须申报；因紧急情况（医疗后送、海上获救、天气原因临时抵达）抵新的旅客可能无须申报。开始申报后将收到含参考号的电子邮件，凭该号可查看、完成或修改申报；任何修改后须重新提交；无须打印任何材料。NZTD 应用在部分国际区域可能无法使用；对海上旅客，应用仅限乘邮轮抵达新西兰者使用，无法使用应用者仍可用在线表单完成数字申报。需提供的信息：入境新西兰所用护照的资料；新西兰联系方式（多处住宿填首个住址）；过去30天旅行史；航班或航程信息；携入新西兰的物品信息（含托运与手提行李）；移民身份信息（如需要，含签证或NZETA）。每位旅客（含婴幼儿）均须单独申报；照护人可代同行儿童或婴幼儿申报；应用可将旅行信息复制到另一份申报，便于同一行程多人申报。提交时限：空运——最早可在开始赴新西兰行程前24小时提交；中途停留并取行李离开机场者，为离开中转地飞往新西兰的航班起飞前24小时；多段航班且不停留者，为首段航程开始前24小时。海运——最早可在船舶离开最后一个境外港口前24小时提交。到达护照查验或由边境关员处理前可修改申报，之后不可再改；如有遗漏须告知边境关员。须申报事项（在NZTD中选择“是”）：药品——超过三个月用量，或非处方给本人的药品；受限或禁止物品——例如武器、不良出版物、濒危动植物或野生动物制品、非法或管制药物；酒类——超过烈酒3瓶（每瓶不超过1.125升）且葡萄酒或啤酒4.5升；烟草——超过50支香烟，或50克烟草制品（含香烟与其他烟草制品的混合物）；境外取得和/或在新西兰免税购买且总值超过 NZ$700 的物品（含礼品）；商业或公务用途物品；代他人携带的物品；现金——NZ$10,000 或以上（或外币等值），含旅行支票、银行汇票、汇票等。额度背景：上述酒类、烟草与 NZ$700 限额为旅客个人额度，无须另行申请——酒类和烟草免税额度须年满17岁方可享受（在新西兰购买此类商品须年满18岁）；家庭或同行团体不可合并各自的 NZ$700 物品额度；超出限额部分须缴纳关税与GST。符合生物安全要求的物品无须申报：仅供本人使用的衣物、鞋履、珠宝、洗漱用品（“个人自用品”）；请备好购物凭证。罚则：未申报受限或禁止物品或作虚假、错误申报，可处最低 NZ$400 即时罚款；虚假申报还可能导致物品没收、起诉、监禁及被驱逐出新西兰。抵达后须回答NZTD全部问题并出示身份证件，否则即属违法。通过护照查验并提取行李后，请沿相应通道接受生物安全筛查。
procedures.timing_en: Complete before reaching passport control. Air: submit from 24 hours before starting your trip to New Zealand (with a stopover where you leave the airport with your bags, 24 hours before the flight leaving the stopover; on multiple flights without a stopover, 24 hours before the first leg). Sea: from 24 hours before departing the vessel's last foreign port. Changes are allowed until you reach passport control or are processed by a border officer, and not after.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达护照查验前完成。空运：最早可在开始赴新西兰行程前24小时提交（停留并取行李离开机场者，为离开中转地航班起飞前24小时；多段航班不停留者，为首段航程前24小时）。海运：最早可在船舶离开最后一个境外港口前24小时提交。到达护照查验或由边境关员处理前均可修改，之后不可再改。

fee.note: Free to complete and submit, whether online, in the NZTD app, or on the paper declaration form.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 新西蘭旅客申報（NZTD）——移民、海關與生物安全統一數字申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：所有進入新西蘭的旅客均須完成新西蘭旅客申報（NZTD），含新西蘭公民與居民；提交免費。可通過 www.TravellerDeclaration.govt.nz 網站或 NZTD 應用（App Store / Google Play）完成數字申報；如需，抵達時有紙質申報表可填，已完成數字申報者無須再填紙質表。線上表單另有14種語言版本，但問題須以英語回答；紙質申報表的翻譯樣本僅供參考，不可列印後向海關或MPI人員出示。經新西蘭中轉且不離開機場中轉區的空運旅客無須申報；因緊急情況（醫療後送、海上獲救、天氣原因臨時抵達）抵新的旅客可能無須申報。開始申報後將收到含參考號的電子郵件，憑該號可查看、完成或修改申報；任何修改後須重新提交；無須列印任何材料。NZTD 應用在部分國際區域可能無法使用；對海上旅客，應用僅限乘郵輪抵達新西蘭者使用，無法使用應用者仍可用線上表單完成數字申報。需提供的資訊：入境新西蘭所用護照的資料；新西蘭聯繫方式（多處住宿填首個住址）；過去30天旅行史；航班或航程資訊；攜入新西蘭的物品資訊（含託運與手提行李）；移民身份資訊（如需要，含簽證或NZETA）。每位旅客（含嬰幼兒）均須單獨申報；照護人可代同行兒童或嬰幼兒申報；應用可將旅行資訊複製到另一份申報，便於同一行程多人申報。提交時限：空運——最早可在開始赴新西蘭行程前24小時提交；中途停留並取行李離開機場者，為離開中轉地飛往新西蘭的航班起飛前24小時；多段航班且不停留者，為首段航程開始前24小時。海運——最早可在船舶離開最後一個境外港口前24小時提交。到達護照查驗或由邊境關員處理前可修改申報，之後不可再改；如有遺漏須告知邊境關員。須申報事項（在NZTD中選擇“是”）：藥品——超過三個月用量，或非處方給本人的藥品；受限或禁止物品——例如武器、不良出版物、瀕危動植物或野生動物製品、非法或管制藥物；酒類——超過烈酒3瓶（每瓶不超過1.125升）且葡萄酒或啤酒4.5升；菸草——超過50支香菸，或50克菸草製品（含香菸與其他菸草製品的混合物）；境外取得和/或在新西蘭免稅購買且總值超過 NZ$700 的物品（含禮品）；商業或公務用途物品；代他人攜帶的物品；現金——NZ$10,000 或以上（或外幣等值），含旅行支票、銀行匯票、匯票等。額度背景：上述酒類、菸草與 NZ$700 限額為旅客個人額度，無須另行申請——酒類和菸草免稅額度須年滿17歲方可享受（在新西蘭購買此類商品須年滿18歲）；家庭或同行團體不可合併各自的 NZ$700 物品額度；超出限額部分須繳納關稅與GST。符合生物安全要求的物品無須申報：僅供本人使用的衣物、鞋履、珠寶、洗漱用品（“個人自用品”）；請備好購物憑證。罰則：未申報受限或禁止物品或作虛假、錯誤申報，可處最低 NZ$400 即時罰款；虛假申報還可能導致物品沒收、起訴、監禁及被驅逐出新西蘭。抵達後須回答NZTD全部問題並出示身份證件，否則即屬違法。通過護照查驗並提取行李後，請沿相應通道接受生物安全篩查。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達護照查驗前完成。空運：最早可在開始赴新西蘭行程前24小時提交（停留並取行李離開機場者，為離開中轉地航班起飛前24小時；多段航班不停留者，為首段航程前24小時）。海運：最早可在船舶離開最後一個境外港口前24小時提交。到達護照查驗或由邊境關員處理前均可修改，之後不可再改。

procedures.name_en: Norfolk Island Incoming Passenger Card (IPC)
procedures.name_zh: 诺福克岛入境旅客卡（IPC）
procedures.agency: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts (travel information) / Australian Border Force / Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry (biosecurity)
procedures.applicability_en: Travellers on the air services between the Australian mainland (Sydney/Brisbane) and Norfolk Island, an Australian external territory in the Pacific Ocean, for movement onto Norfolk Island: you must complete an Incoming Passenger Card (IPC) and declare certain food, plant material (including wooden articles) and animal products on that same card. This entry covers movement onto Norfolk Island only; the card/documentation requirement on Norfolk Island to mainland Australia flights is tracked separately as unresolved.
procedures.applicability_zh: 搭乘澳大利亚大陆（悉尼/布里斯班）与诺福克岛（澳大利亚太平洋海外领地）之间空运航线、进入诺福克岛的旅客：须填写入境旅客卡（IPC），并在同一张卡上申报特定食品、植物材料（含木制品）和动物产品。本条目仅覆盖进入诺福克岛的移动；诺福克岛返回澳大利亚大陆航班的旅客卡/证件要求作为未决事项另行跟踪。
procedures.timing_en: An Incoming Passenger Card is required for movement onto Norfolk Island. The Norfolk-specific official travel information page states that the card must be completed but does not specify how it is distributed or completed (for example, whether on the aircraft) or a precise completion deadline; generic mainland-Australia card distribution rules are not asserted for this route.
procedures.timing_zh: 进入诺福克岛须填写入境旅客卡（IPC）。诺福克岛专用的官方旅行信息页面仅说明必须完成该卡，未说明其发放或填写方式（例如是否在航班上填写），也未规定明确的完成期限；本条目不将澳大利亚大陆的通用发卡规则当作该航线的既定事实。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 諾福克島入境旅客卡（IPC）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 搭乘澳大利亞大陸（悉尼/布里斯班）與諾福克島（澳大利亞太平洋海外領地）之間空運航線、進入諾福克島的旅客：須填寫入境旅客卡（IPC），並在同一張卡上申報特定食品、植物材料（含木製品）和動物產品。本條目僅覆蓋進入諾福克島的移動；諾福克島返回澳大利亞大陸航班的旅客卡/證件要求作為未決事項另行跟蹤。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 進入諾福克島須填寫入境旅客卡（IPC）。諾福克島專用的官方旅行資訊頁面僅說明必須完成該卡，未說明其發放或填寫方式（例如是否在航班上填寫），也未規定明確的完成期限；本條目不將澳大利亞大陸的通用髮卡規則當作該航線的既定事實。

procedures.name_en: Fiji Passenger Arrival Card
procedures.name_zh: 斐济旅客入境卡
procedures.agency: Fiji Revenue and Customs Service (FRCS)
procedures.applicability_en: Every traveller arriving in Fiji. Before landing, the traveller receives a Fiji Passenger Arrival Card from the airline, shipping agent or flight crew and must complete both sides of the card clearly and legibly; the captured official text describes only this paper card and mentions no online arrival declaration. At the immigration checkpoint the traveller presents the completed card, passport and any supporting documents (e.g. visa approvals, airline tickets, authority letters). The traveller must tick 'Yes' in the Customs section of the card if carrying: (1) prohibited or restricted items (Prohibited Imports and Exports Regulations 1986); (2) currency of FJ$10,000 or more, or equivalent in foreign currency (inclusive threshold, i.e. exactly FJ$10,000 triggers it; section 5 of the same page adds 'or negotiable instruments'); or (3) biosecurity risk goods. These three are question items inside the same arrival card, not separate forms. Duty-free allowances on the same page: personal effects duty-free if owned and used prior to arrival, for personal use only (not for sale or as gifts) and reasonably expected to be carried in baggage (commercial quantities of clothing or footwear not included); alcohol and tobacco duty-free only for travellers 18 and over, if accompanied by the traveller and not for sale or on behalf of others - tobacco up to 200 cigarettes, or 200g cigars/tobacco, or a combination not exceeding 200g, e-cigarettes up to 200ml/mg, chewing tobacco prohibited; alcohol up to 3L spirits, or 4.5L wine, or 4.5L beer, or a combination not exceeding the total limit; other goods duty-free only if for personal use only, accompanied by the traveller and value does not exceed FJ$2,000 (inclusive limit); Gold Card holders: value should not exceed FJ$3,000, accompanied by the gold card holder, for personal use only, with the same tobacco and alcohol limits. Subject to duty: goods intended for commercial use (e.g. samples, business equipment), professional or technical equipment, and personal goods exceeding FJ$2,000 in value (excluding used personal effects). Currency of FJ$10,000 or more additionally requires a separate Border Currency Reporting Form (recorded as fj-border-currency-reporting-form). Medicines: if carrying prescription or controlled drugs, bring a doctor's prescription and ensure the medicine is for personal use and medically necessary. Biosecurity risk goods must be declared to the Biosecurity Authority of Fiji (BAF): food of any kind; animals, animal products, fish, birds, eggs, honey; plants, fruits, seeds, flowers, wood, soil; used equipment (e.g. camping gear, sports shoes, tools); biological specimens (e.g. vaccines, insects, fungi). Dispose of undeclared items in the Biosecurity Amnesty Bins at the border. Penalties for non-compliance: spot fine FJ$400; prosecution up to FJ$20,000 fine, 6 months imprisonment, or both.
procedures.applicability_zh: 适用于抵达斐济的每位旅客。降落前，旅客从航空公司、船务代理或机组领取斐济旅客入境卡，并须清楚、工整地填写卡片两面；捕获的官文只描述这张纸质卡，未提及任何线上入境申报。在移民检查站出示填好的入境卡、护照及辅助文件（如签证批文、机票、授权书）。携带下列物品须在卡片海关栏勾选「是」：(1) 禁止或限制物品（1986 年禁止进出口条例）；(2) 10,000 斐济元及以上货币，或等值外币（含本数，即恰为 10,000 斐济元亦须勾选；同页第 5 节另加「或可转让票据」）；(3) 生物安全风险物品。此三项是同一张入境卡内部的问项，不是另行提交的表格。同页免税额度：自用品须入境前已拥有并使用、仅限自用（非售卖或馈赠）、合理随身行李携带（商业化数量的服装或鞋类不包括在内）；烟酒仅限 18 岁及以上旅客、随身携带且非售卖或代他人携带方予免税——烟草不超过 200 支香烟，或 200 克雪茄/烟丝，或合计不超过 200 克的组合；电子烟不超过 200ml/mg；嚼烟禁止。酒精不超过 3 升烈酒，或 4.5 升葡萄酒，或 4.5 升啤酒，或不超过总限量的组合。其他物品仅限自用、随身携带且价值不超过 2,000 斐济元（含本数上限）方予免税。金卡持有人：价值不应超过 3,000 斐济元、由金卡持有人随身携带、仅限自用，烟酒额度与上相同。应征税情形：拟作商业用途的货物（如样品、商务设备）、专业或技术设备、价值超过 2,000 斐济元的个人物品（不含旧自用品）。携带 10,000 斐济元及以上货币另须填写独立的边境货币报告表（见 fj-border-currency-reporting-form）。药品：携带处方药或管制药物须携带医生处方，且药品限于自用并有医疗需要。生物安全风险物品须向斐济生物安全局（BAF）申报：各类食品；动物、动物制品、鱼类、鸟类、蛋、蜂蜜；植物、水果、种子、花卉、木材、土壤；旧设备（如露营装备、运动鞋、工具）；生物标本（如疫苗、昆虫、真菌）。未申报物品可投入边境的生物安全自弃箱。违规处罚：当场罚款 400 斐济元；起诉最高 20,000 斐济元罚款、6 个月监禁或两者并处。
procedures.timing_en: Card issued before landing and completed before the immigration checkpoint; presented there with passport and supporting documents. Goods not qualifying for duty-free entry are subject to Customs Duty (based on CIF value - Cost, Insurance, Freight), Value Added Tax, Import Excise Duty (where applicable) and an Import Entry Transaction Fee; these are goods-related duty/tax charges, not a fee for the card, and no card fee is stated anywhere on the captured pages. If duty cannot be paid, goods will be detained and may be disposed of if unclaimed; all payments must be made in Fijian currency. Tip on the page: keep receipts for all purchases, including duty-free items. Page last updated: September 18, 2025.
procedures.timing_zh: 降落前发卡，并在抵达移民检查站前填妥；检查时连同护照及辅助文件一并出示。不符合免税入境条件的货物须缴纳关税（按 CIF 价值，即成本加保险加运费）、增值税、进口消费税（如适用）及进口报关交易费；这些是对货物的税费，不是入境卡费用，捕获页面未载明任何卡费。如无法缴纳税款，货物将被扣留，无人认领可能被处置；所有付款必须以斐济货币支付。页面提示：保留所有购物收据，含免税品。页面最后更新日期：2025 年 9 月 18 日。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 斐濟旅客入境卡
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 適用於抵達斐濟的每位旅客。降落前，旅客從航空公司、船務代理或機組領取斐濟旅客入境卡，並須清楚、工整地填寫卡片兩面；捕獲的官文只描述這張紙質卡，未提及任何線上入境申報。在移民檢查站出示填好的入境卡、護照及輔助文件（如簽證批文、機票、授權書）。攜帶下列物品須在卡片海關欄勾選「是」：(1) 禁止或限制物品（1986 年禁止進出口條例）；(2) 10,000 斐濟元及以上貨幣，或等值外幣（含本數，即恰為 10,000 斐濟元亦須勾選；同頁第 5 節另加「或可轉讓票據」）；(3) 生物安全風險物品。此三項是同一張入境卡內部的問項，不是另行提交的表格。同頁免稅額度：自用品須入境前已擁有並使用、僅限自用（非售賣或饋贈）、合理隨身行李攜帶（商業化數量的服裝或鞋類不包括在內）；菸酒僅限 18 歲及以上旅客、隨身攜帶且非售賣或代他人攜帶方予免稅——菸草不超過 200 支香菸，或 200 克雪茄/菸絲，或合計不超過 200 克的組合；電子煙不超過 200ml/mg；嚼菸禁止。酒精不超過 3 升烈酒，或 4.5 升葡萄酒，或 4.5 升啤酒，或不超過總限量的組合。其他物品僅限自用、隨身攜帶且價值不超過 2,000 斐濟元（含本數上限）方予免稅。金卡持有人：價值不應超過 3,000 斐濟元、由金卡持有人隨身攜帶、僅限自用，菸酒額度與上相同。應徵稅情形：擬作商業用途的貨物（如樣品、商務設備）、專業或技術設備、價值超過 2,000 斐濟元的個人物品（不含舊自用品）。攜帶 10,000 斐濟元及以上貨幣另須填寫獨立的邊境貨幣報告表（見 fj-border-currency-reporting-form）。藥品：攜帶處方藥或管制藥物須攜帶醫生處方，且藥品限於自用並有醫療需要。生物安全風險物品須向斐濟生物安全局（BAF）申報：各類食品；動物、動物製品、魚類、鳥類、蛋、蜂蜜；植物、水果、種子、花卉、木材、土壤；舊設備（如露營裝備、運動鞋、工具）；生物標本（如疫苗、昆蟲、真菌）。未申報物品可投入邊境的生物安全自棄箱。違規處罰：當場罰款 400 斐濟元；起訴最高 20,000 斐濟元罰款、6 個月監禁或兩者並處。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 降落前髮卡，並在抵達移民檢查站前填妥；檢查時連同護照及輔助文件一併出示。不符合免稅入境條件的貨物須繳納關稅（按 CIF 價值，即成本加保險加運費）、增值稅、進口消費稅（如適用）及進口報關交易費；這些是對貨物的稅費，不是入境卡費用，捕獲頁面未載明任何卡費。如無法繳納稅款，貨物將被扣留，無人認領可能被處置；所有付款必須以斐濟貨幣支付。頁面提示：保留所有購物收據，含免稅品。頁面最後更新日期：2025 年 9 月 18 日。
