procedures.name_en: Arrival goods declaration in French Polynesia (traveller franchises; JE DÉCLARE simplified or formal customs declaration)
procedures.name_zh: 法属波利尼西亚抵达货物申报（旅客免税额；JE DÉCLARE简易申报或正式海关申报）
procedures.agency: Direction régionale des douanes de Polynésie française (local portal service-public.pf/douane); DGDDI (douane.gouv.fr) central traveller page as complementary source. French Polynesia has customs and fiscal autonomy.
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: arrival in French Polynesia only. Travellers must declare goods carried when they exceed the traveller franchise, are taxable, or are duty-free/détaxe purchases from EU shops; personal-use objects without commercial character are admitted without customs or tax formality. Franchises by traveller category (local customs page, updated 2026-07-03): under 15 years — XPF 15,000 in value, no alcohol or tobacco; 15 to 17 years — XPF 50,000, no alcohol or tobacco (the local page's «entre 15 ans et 17 ans» band covers exactly 15, resolving the central DGDDI page's «over 15 / under 15» wording, which omits age 15); 18 years and over — XPF 50,000 in value plus quantitative alcohol/tobacco limits (still or sparkling wine ≤ 4 litres, or beer/vermouth ≤ 2 litres, or other spirits ≤ 2 litres; cigarettes ≤ 200 units, or cigarillos ≤ 100 units, or cigars ≤ 50 units, or smoking tobacco ≤ 250 grams); crew members (personnel naviguant) — XPF 15,000. Flat-rate taxation (taxation forfaitaire) applies above the franchise on the total value, from XPF 15,001 (under 15) or XPF 50,001 (15 and over) up to XPF 200,000 (hors franchises), at 20% of value for goods from the European Union and 30% for third-country goods. When total value exceeds XPF 200,000 (hors franchises), goods must be placed in deposit at the Air Tahiti warehouse and a formal customs declaration filed. The local JE DÉCLARE page routes purchases below XPF 200,000 to the simplified online declaration and purchases above XPF 200,000 to the deposit-plus-formal-declaration path; the boundary value of exactly XPF 200,000 is assigned by no source and is left unresolved. JE DÉCLARE applies only to personal, non-commercial goods in baggage exceeding the franchises at Tahiti Faa'a airport — per the DGDDI launch page, online payment of the flat-rate tax can be made 48 hours before arrival in French Polynesia, or from arrival at Tahiti Faa'a airport, before crossing the customs point; another sentence on the same page states that goods can be declared 48 hours before the flight and until passing customs, without stating the exact earliest opening time of the declaration window (see unresolved PF-jedeclare-earliest-window-ambiguous) — and cannot be used for goods under special formalities destined for a business; nothing extends it to sea ports or cargo. Otherwise, on arrival present to the customs officer with an ID, purchase invoices and the goods. Channel is conditional rather than multi-channel by default: the default path is declaration to the customs officer on arrival; the JE DÉCLARE simplified online declaration is an option only within the limited scenario above (personal, non-commercial goods in baggage exceeding the franchises at Tahiti Faa'a airport). EU duty-free shop or détaxe-slip purchases must be declared on arrival.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：仅限抵达法属波利尼西亚。所携物品超过旅客免税额、应税或属欧盟免税店/退税单购买时须申报；不具商业性质的个人自用物品无须海关或税务手续即可入境。按旅客类别的免税额（本地海关页，2026-07-03更新）：15岁以下——15,000 XPF（按价值），不得携入烟酒；15至17岁——50,000 XPF，不得携入烟酒（本地页«entre 15 ans et 17 ans»区间涵盖恰满15岁，解决中央DGDDI页«超过15岁/未满15岁»措辞遗漏恰15岁的问题）；18岁及以上——50,000 XPF（按价值），另有限量烟酒额度（静止或起泡葡萄酒≤4升，或啤酒/味美思≤2升，或其他烈酒≤2升；香烟≤200支，或小雪茄≤100支，或雪茄≤50支，或烟丝≤250克）；航行人员（personnel naviguant）——15,000 XPF。超免税额部分按包干征税（taxation forfaitaire）对总值计征：15岁以下自15,001 XPF、15岁及以上自50,001 XPF起，至200,000 XPF（不含免税额），欧盟来源货品按价值的20%、第三国来源按30%计征。总值超过200,000 XPF（不含免税额）时，须将物品暂存Air Tahiti仓库并提交正式海关申报。本地JE DÉCLARE页将低于200,000 XPF的购物导向简易线上申报、高于200,000 XPF导向暂存加正式申报路径；恰好200,000 XPF的归属任何来源均未指明，留为未决。JE DÉCLARE仅适用于Faa'a机场行李内、超额的个人非商业物品——据DGDDI发布页，包干税线上缴税可于抵达法属波利尼西亚前48小时办理，或自抵达Faa'a机场起、于通过海关检查点前办理；同页另句称申报可在航班前48小时办理并持续至通过海关，页面未明示申报窗口的准确最早开放时间（见未决PF-jedeclare-earliest-window-ambiguous）——不得用于须办理特别手续且供企业使用的货品；无任何依据将其外推至海港或货运。否则抵达时携身份证件、购物发票及物品向海关关员申报。渠道为条件性而非默认多渠道：默认路径为抵达时向海关关员申报；JE DÉCLARE简易线上申报仅是上述限定场景（Faa'a机场行李内超额的个人非商业物品）内的可选项。欧盟免税店或退税单购买须于抵达时申报。
procedures.timing_en: Conditional channel: by default at the customs office on arrival; optionally via JE DÉCLARE within its limited scenario — the DGDDI page states that online payment of the flat-rate tax can be made 48 hours before arrival or from arrival at Tahiti Faa'a airport, before crossing the customs point, and that goods can be declared 48 hours before the flight and until passing customs, the exact earliest opening time not being stated (see unresolved PF-jedeclare-earliest-window-ambiguous); for values above XPF 200,000, Air Tahiti warehouse deposit plus a formal customs declaration.
procedures.timing_zh: 渠道条件性：默认抵达时在海关办公室办理；限定场景可选经JE DÉCLARE——DGDDI页称包干税线上缴税可于抵达前48小时或自抵达Faa'a机场起、通过海关检查点前办理，另句称申报可在航班前48小时办理并持续至通过海关，准确最早开放时间未明示（见未决PF-jedeclare-earliest-window-ambiguous）；超过200,000 XPF者办理Air Tahiti仓库暂存并提交正式海关申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 法屬波利尼西亞抵達貨物申報（旅客免稅額；JE DÉCLARE簡易申報或正式海關申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：僅限抵達法屬波利尼西亞。所攜物品超過旅客免稅額、應稅或屬歐盟免稅店/退稅單購買時須申報；不具商業性質的個人自用物品無須海關或稅務手續即可入境。按旅客類別的免稅額（本地海關頁，2026-07-03更新）：15歲以下——15,000 XPF（按價值），不得攜入菸酒；15至17歲——50,000 XPF，不得攜入菸酒（本地頁«entre 15 ans et 17 ans»區間涵蓋恰滿15歲，解決中央DGDDI頁«超過15歲/未滿15歲»措辭遺漏恰15歲的問題）；18歲及以上——50,000 XPF（按價值），另有限量菸酒額度（靜止或起泡葡萄酒≤4升，或啤酒/味美思≤2升，或其他烈酒≤2升；香菸≤200支，或小雪茄≤100支，或雪茄≤50支，或菸絲≤250克）；航行人員（personnel naviguant）——15,000 XPF。超免稅額部分按包乾徵稅（taxation forfaitaire）對總值計徵：15歲以下自15,001 XPF、15歲及以上自50,001 XPF起，至200,000 XPF（不含免稅額），歐盟來源貨品按價值的20%、第三國來源按30%計徵。總值超過200,000 XPF（不含免稅額）時，須將物品暫存Air Tahiti倉庫並提交正式海關申報。本地JE DÉCLARE頁將低於200,000 XPF的購物導向簡易線上申報、高於200,000 XPF導向暫存加正式申報路徑；恰好200,000 XPF的歸屬任何來源均未指明，留為未決。JE DÉCLARE僅適用於Faa'a機場行李內、超額的個人非商業物品——據DGDDI發佈頁，包乾稅線上繳稅可於抵達法屬波利尼西亞前48小時辦理，或自抵達Faa'a機場起、於通過海關檢查點前辦理；同頁另句稱申報可在航班前48小時辦理並持續至通過海關，頁面未明示申報窗口的準確最早開放時間（見未決PF-jedeclare-earliest-window-ambiguous）——不得用於須辦理特別手續且供企業使用的貨品；無任何依據將其外推至海港或貨運。否則抵達時攜身份證件、購物發票及物品向海關關員申報。渠道為條件性而非默認多渠道：默認路徑為抵達時向海關關員申報；JE DÉCLARE簡易線上申報僅是上述限定場景（Faa'a機場行李內超額的個人非商業物品）內的可選項。歐盟免稅店或退稅單購買須於抵達時申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 渠道條件性：默認抵達時在海關辦公室辦理；限定場景可選經JE DÉCLARE——DGDDI頁稱包乾稅線上繳稅可於抵達前48小時或自抵達Faa'a機場起、通過海關檢查點前辦理，另句稱申報可在航班前48小時辦理並持續至通過海關，準確最早開放時間未明示（見未決PF-jedeclare-earliest-window-ambiguous）；超過200,000 XPF者辦理Air Tahiti倉庫暫存並提交正式海關申報。

procedures.name_en: Cross-border cash declaration when entering or leaving French Polynesia (DALIA online, or to customs officers)
procedures.name_zh: 出入法属波利尼西亚的跨境现金申报（DALIA线上办理，或向海关关员申报）
procedures.agency: Direction régionale des douanes de Polynésie française (local page); DGDDI (DALIA teleservice)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: both entry and exit of French Polynesia. Travellers carrying cash of an amount equal to or greater than EUR 10,000 — the threshold that is common and explicit across all sources — must declare it to customs; the threshold applies individually to each traveller. The exact XPF equivalent is not unique across sources and is left unresolved: the local customs page (updated 2026-07) and the DGDDI traveller page state XPF 1,193,300, while the COM paper form still offered by DGDDI (2021) states XPF 1,193,317; no exchange rate is assumed and neither figure is adjudicated (see unresolved PF-cash-xpf-equivalent-discrepancy). Cash covers banknotes and coins, bearer negotiable instruments (traveller's cheques, cheques, promissory notes or money orders), highly liquid stores of value (gold) and prepaid cards. Scope: the obligation applies only to cross-border flows, i.e. between the overseas territory and foreign countries (EU member states or third countries) — direct flows with metropolitan France, New Caledonia or Wallis and Futuna are not external flows; however, travellers transiting a foreign territory when departing metropolitan France (e.g. United States, Japan) are subject to it. Carrying cash on behalf of another person must also be declared. Channel is conditional: the DALIA teleservice covers the formality online, available from at earliest 30 days before the travel date and at latest before crossing the border; if not declared online, the fallback is in person to customs officers on arrival. On control, the fully completed declaration must be presentable on paper or an electronic device and the declared amount must exactly match the funds transported; movements of EUR 50,000 or more (XPF 5,966,500 per the 2021 form) require documents justifying the origin of the cash (PF legal basis: article L751-4 of the code monétaire et financier). Cash received or sent by post, express freight or other means of transport falls under a separate customs-initiated disclosure procedure, not this traveller declaration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：入境与出境法属波利尼西亚双向。旅客携带等值或超过10,000欧元的现金——该门槛为各来源共同且明确——须向海关申报；门槛按每位旅客分别适用。XPF精确等值并非各来源唯一、留为未决：本地海关页（2026-07更新）与DGDDI旅客页写1,193,300 XPF，DGDDI仍提供的海外领地纸质表（2021年）写1,193,317 XPF；不假设任何汇率、不自行裁决任何一个数（见未决PF-cash-xpf-equivalent-discrepancy）。现金涵盖纸币与硬币、不记名可转让票据（旅行支票、支票、本票或汇票）、高流动性价值储藏物（黄金）及预付卡。范围：该义务仅适用于跨境流动，即海外领地与外国（欧盟成员国或第三国）之间——与法国本土、新喀里多尼亚或瓦利斯和富图纳之间的直达流动不属对外流动；但从法国本土经外国领土过境（如美国、日本）的旅客须办理。替他人携带现金亦须申报。渠道为条件性：DALIA线上服务办理该手续，最早可于旅行日期前30日、最迟于跨越边境前；若未线上申报，后备为抵达时向海关关员当面办理。受检查时须能以纸质或电子设备出示完整填写的申报，且申报金额须与实际携带资金完全一致；50,000欧元及以上（按2021年表格为5,966,500 XPF）的流动须附证明现金来源的文件（法波法律依据：货币与金融法典L751-4条）。以邮政、快递货运或其他运输方式收寄现金适用由海关发起的另一披露程序，非本旅客主动申报。
procedures.timing_en: Conditional channel: DALIA online at earliest 30 days before the travel date and at latest before crossing the border; otherwise the fallback is in person to customs officers on arrival.
procedures.timing_zh: 渠道条件性：DALIA线上最早旅行日期前30日、最迟跨越边境前；否则后备为抵达时向海关关员申报。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 出入法屬波利尼西亞的跨境現金申報（DALIA線上辦理，或向海關關員申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：入境與出境法屬波利尼西亞雙向。旅客攜帶等值或超過10,000歐元的現金——該門檻為各來源共同且明確——須向海關申報；門檻按每位旅客分別適用。XPF精確等值並非各來源唯一、留為未決：本地海關頁（2026-07更新）與DGDDI旅客頁寫1,193,300 XPF，DGDDI仍提供的海外領地紙質表（2021年）寫1,193,317 XPF；不假設任何匯率、不自行裁決任何一個數（見未決PF-cash-xpf-equivalent-discrepancy）。現金涵蓋紙幣與硬幣、不記名可轉讓票據（旅行支票、支票、本票或匯票）、高流動性價值儲藏物（黃金）及預付卡。範圍：該義務僅適用於跨境流動，即海外領地與外國（歐盟成員國或第三國）之間——與法國本土、新喀里多尼亞或瓦利斯和富圖納之間的直達流動不屬對外流動；但從法國本土經外國領土過境（如美國、日本）的旅客須辦理。替他人攜帶現金亦須申報。渠道為條件性：DALIA線上服務辦理該手續，最早可於旅行日期前30日、最遲於跨越邊境前；若未線上申報，後備為抵達時向海關關員當面辦理。受檢查時須能以紙質或電子設備出示完整填寫的申報，且申報金額須與實際攜帶資金完全一致；50,000歐元及以上（按2021年表格為5,966,500 XPF）的流動須附證明現金來源的文件（法波法律依據：貨幣與金融法典L751-4條）。以郵政、快遞貨運或其他運輸方式收寄現金適用由海關發起的另一披露程序，非本旅客主動申報。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 渠道條件性：DALIA線上最早旅行日期前30日、最遲跨越邊境前；否則後備為抵達時向海關關員申報。

procedures.name_en: Niue Passenger Arrival Form — Government of Niue (Immigration/Customs/Biosecurity/Health joint arrival declaration)
procedures.name_zh: 纽埃旅客抵达表——纽埃政府（移民/海关/生物安全/卫生联合入境申报）
procedures.agency: Government of Niue (form administers Immigration, Customs, Biosecurity and Health laws; customs sits with the Treasury Department)
procedures.applicability_en: Every passenger fills in a physical arrival card on arrival, including the Customs and Biosecurity sections at the back. Local residents and regular returning visitors may additionally choose to complete the arrival declaration online within 24 hours before departure to proceed through the Express Lane, but even after completing online they must still fill in the physical card. Direction: every passenger arriving in Niue. Per the official Government of Niue form page: one form must be completed for each passenger, including children; the information collected on the form and during the arrival process is sought to administer Immigration, Customs, Biosecurity and Health laws; the form is a legal document and false declarations can lead to penalties including confiscation of goods, fines, prosecution, imprisonment and deportation from Niue; the form must not be completed more than 24 hours prior to departure; and even after online submission the traveller must still complete their full name and sections D and E of the physical arrival card (form page wording). Separately, the Niue Immigration notice of 2026-02-05 tells local residents and regular returning visitors that to proceed through the Express Lane they should complete the arrival declaration online, still completing the physical card with their name, date of birth, passport number and sections D, E and F at the back; those who do not complete online join the main queue with the other passengers, and the 2025-11-30 notice likewise describes online completion as an opportunity for locals and regular visitors. Online completion is therefore an express route described for those groups on the notice, not a requirement the form page states for all passengers; do not read the notice as making online submission mandatory for everyone. The notices of 2025-02-21 and 2025-11-30 describe the back of the physical card as the Customs and Biosecurity sections, but the field contents of sections D, E and F are not published in any captured page: duty-free quantities, arrival-side cash thresholds and goods categories remain unverified, and no figures or letter-to-section mappings are asserted here.
procedures.applicability_zh: 每位抵达旅客均须在抵达时填写实体抵达卡，包括背面的海关与生物安全部分。本地居民及定期返纽访客可在出发前24小时内自愿选择在线完成抵达申报、经 Express Lane（快速通道）通关，但在线完成后仍须填写实体卡。方向：抵达纽埃的每位旅客。据纽埃政府官方表单页：每名旅客（含儿童）须各填一份；表内及抵达过程中收集的信息用于执行移民、海关、生物安全与卫生法律；本表为法律文件，虚假申报可致货物没收、罚款、起诉、监禁及驱逐出境；该表不得在出发前24小时之前填写；在线提交后仍须在实体抵达卡上填写全名及D、E部分（表单页措辞）。另据纽埃移民局2026-02-05公告：本地居民及定期返纽访客如欲经快速通道（Express Lane）通关，须在线完成抵达申报，且仍须填写实体卡——正面姓名、出生日期、护照号码，背面D、E、F部分；未在线完成者与其他旅客一起走主队列；2025-11-30公告同样将在线完成表述为本地居民和定期访客可享的机会。故在线申报是公告中面向上述人群的快速途径，并非表单页对全体旅客的强制要求，不应将公告解读为人人必须在线。2025-02-21与2025-11-30公告称实体卡背面为海关与生物安全部分，但D、E、F的字段内容未在任何已抓取页面公布：免税数量、入境侧现金门槛与物品类别仍未核验，此处不作任何数字或字母-栏目对应断言。
procedures.timing_en: Every passenger completes the physical arrival card on arrival, including the Customs and Biosecurity sections at the back. Local residents and regular returning visitors may optionally complete the online arrival form within 24 hours before departure to use the Express Lane, but they must still complete the physical card on arrival. The online form must not be completed more than 24 hours prior to departure. Physical-card completion is captured in two wordings: full name and sections D and E per the form page; name, date of birth, passport number and sections D, E and F at the back per the 2026-02-05 notice.
procedures.timing_zh: 每位旅客抵达时填写实体抵达卡，包括背面的海关与生物安全部分。本地居民及定期返纽访客可在出发前24小时内自愿选用在线入境表走 Express Lane（快速通道），但在线完成后仍须在抵达时填写实体卡。在线表不得在出发前24小时之前填写。实体卡填写范围两口径并存：表单页为全名及D、E部分；2026-02-05公告为姓名、出生日期、护照号码及背面D、E、F部分。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 紐埃旅客抵達表——紐埃政府（移民/海關/生物安全/衛生聯合入境申報）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 每位抵達旅客均須在抵達時填寫實體抵達卡，包括背面的海關與生物安全部分。本地居民及定期返紐訪客可在出發前24小時內自願選擇線上完成抵達申報、經 Express Lane（快速通道）通關，但線上完成後仍須填寫實體卡。方向：抵達紐埃的每位旅客。據紐埃政府官方表單頁：每名旅客（含兒童）須各填一份；表內及抵達過程中收集的資訊用於執行移民、海關、生物安全與衛生法律；本表為法律文件，虛假申報可致貨物沒收、罰款、起訴、監禁及驅逐出境；該表不得在出發前24小時之前填寫；線上提交後仍須在實體抵達卡上填寫全名及D、E部分（表單頁措辭）。另據紐埃移民局2026-02-05公告：本地居民及定期返紐訪客如欲經快速通道（Express Lane）通關，須線上完成抵達申報，且仍須填寫實體卡——正面姓名、出生日期、護照號碼，背面D、E、F部分；未線上完成者與其他旅客一起走主隊列；2025-11-30公告同樣將線上完成表述為本地居民和定期訪客可享的機會。故線上申報是公告中面向上述人群的快速途徑，並非表單頁對全體旅客的強制要求，不應將公告解讀為人人必須線上。2025-02-21與2025-11-30公告稱實體卡背面為海關與生物安全部分，但D、E、F的欄位內容未在任何已抓取頁面公佈：免稅數量、入境側現金門檻與物品類別仍未核驗，此處不作任何數字或字母-欄目對應斷言。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 每位旅客抵達時填寫實體抵達卡，包括背面的海關與生物安全部分。本地居民及定期返紐訪客可在出發前24小時內自願選用線上入境表走 Express Lane（快速通道），但線上完成後仍須在抵達時填寫實體卡。線上表不得在出發前24小時之前填寫。實體卡填寫範圍兩口徑並存：表單頁為全名及D、E部分；2026-02-05公告為姓名、出生日期、護照號碼及背面D、E、F部分。

procedures.name_en: Niue — exit-side customs cash declaration: report NZ$10,000 or more in cash to a customs officer at departure passport formalities
procedures.name_zh: 纽埃——离境海关现金申报：办理护照查验手续时向海关官员报告NZ$10,000及以上现金
procedures.agency: Government of Niue (obligation published on the official Niue Passenger Departure Card page; report is made to a customs officer; BNI defined by reference to the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2006)
procedures.applicability_en: Conditional; exit direction only; triggered solely by the cash threshold. Per the official Niue Passenger Departure Card page: if you are carrying, on your person or in your baggage, NZ$10,000 or more in cash or foreign equivalent, you must report this to a customs officer when you are completing passport formalities on departure from Niue. Cash means physical currency, bearer negotiable instruments (BNI), or both; the page defines BNI by reference to the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2006. If anyone you are responsible for who is travelling with you has cash to that value, you must report this to a customs officer. If neither you nor anyone you are responsible for travelling with you is carrying cash to that threshold, no report is due. The obligation is published on the same gov.nu page as, but textually separate from, the statistical departure form. The page does not state that the report is made through the online statistical departure form or any other designated form — whether a prescribed written form exists is unknown, and the statistical form must not be read as the required channel. No arrival-side cash rule is captured anywhere this round, so none is asserted.
procedures.applicability_zh: 有条件适用；仅出境方向；仅由现金门槛触发。据纽埃旅客离境卡官方页面：如本人随身或行李内携带NZ$10,000及以上现金或等值外币，须在离开纽埃办理护照查验手续时向海关官员报告。现金指实物货币、不记名可转让票据（BNI）或两者兼有；页面依据《2006年金融交易报告法》（Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2006）定义BNI。如由本人负责的同行者携带该数额现金，亦须向海关官员报告。本人及由本人负责的同行者均未携带该数额现金时，无须报告。该义务与统计性离境表刊载于同一gov.nu页面但文本各自独立。页面未称该报告须经在线统计离境表或任何指定表格提交——是否存在规定的书面表格为未知，且不得把统计表当作必经渠道。本轮任何页面均未捕获入境侧现金规则，故不作断言。
procedures.timing_en: Only when the threshold is met — you, or anyone you are responsible for travelling with you, are carrying NZ$10,000 or more in cash: report to a customs officer when completing passport formalities on departure from Niue.
procedures.timing_zh: 仅达到阈值时——本人或由本人负责的同行者携带NZ$10,000及以上现金：在离开纽埃办理护照查验手续时向海关官员报告。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 紐埃——離境海關現金申報：辦理護照查驗手續時向海關官員報告NZ$10,000及以上現金
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 有條件適用；僅出境方向；僅由現金門檻觸發。據紐埃旅客離境卡官方頁面：如本人隨身或行李內攜帶NZ$10,000及以上現金或等值外幣，須在離開紐埃辦理護照查驗手續時向海關官員報告。現金指實物貨幣、不記名可轉讓票據（BNI）或兩者兼有；頁面依據《2006年金融交易報告法》（Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2006）定義BNI。如由本人負責的同行者攜帶該數額現金，亦須向海關官員報告。本人及由本人負責的同行者均未攜帶該數額現金時，無須報告。該義務與統計性離境表刊載於同一gov.nu頁面但文本各自獨立。頁面未稱該報告須經線上統計離境表或任何指定表格提交——是否存在規定的書面表格為未知，且不得把統計表當作必經渠道。本輪任何頁面均未捕獲入境側現金規則，故不作斷言。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 僅達到閾值時——本人或由本人負責的同行者攜帶NZ$10,000及以上現金：在離開紐埃辦理護照查驗手續時向海關官員報告。

procedures.name_en: Short-term visitor visa (14 days or less, same vessel) with combined immigration and biosecurity declaration — Pitcairn immigration
procedures.name_zh: 短期访问签证（≤14天、同船往返）及移民与生物安全合并申报——皮特凯恩移民局
procedures.agency: Pitcairn immigration (Immigration Officer on arrival; Chief Immigration Officer; Governor of Pitcairn)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: visitors arriving at Pitcairn by vessel. Per the Pitcairn Islands Government immigration page: a visitor staying 14 days or less and travelling to and departing from Pitcairn on the same vessel may be eligible for a short-term visitor visa, which can be applied for on arrival at Pitcairn. The applicant must meet character, health, travel and medical insurance, and financial capacity requirements as outlined in the Immigration policy (unless waived by the Governor). Applications for short-term visitor visas are made to an immigration officer on arrival at Pitcairn through completion of the combined immigration and biosecurity declaration form (given out on arrival); no advance application is needed, though travellers whose Section D (character), Section E (immigration history) or Section F (health) answers are 'Yes' are encouraged to contact Pitcairn immigration before travel as a waiver may be required. Fees: under the Immigration Control Ordinance 2006: Fees and Levies notice issued by the Governor in consultation with the Island Council under s 2D(1), effective as of 2 June 2026 and titled for Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands, the application fee for a short-term visitor visa is NIL; in addition, the applicant must pay the applicable per-island landing fee, which is charged regardless of visa category: per island per passenger aged 18 years or over NZ$100; per island per passenger aged over 5 years and under 18 years NZ$50; passengers aged under 5 years NIL; a passenger aged exactly 5 falls into no stated band, and the landing fee for that exact age remains unresolved (see PN-landing-fee-age-5-boundary-unspecified). The Governor has the discretion to waive or reduce application and landing fees (s 2D(3)). The same notice also sets separate charges — extension of a short-term visitor visa, passport stamp if a passenger is not going ashore, and a passenger head levy applying to cruise ships and chartered tour vessels entering the territorial sea — which are different fee matters: no amounts for them are stated in this procedure, they are not part of the short-term visitor visa application fee, and the head levy applies to the vessel rather than being a fee the applicant personally must pay; see the country report. The Pitcairn Islands Immigration Policy (made pursuant to s 2A Immigration Control Ordinance 2006; official PDF dated 2026-03-22), s 9, confirms the eligibility conditions — stay of 14 days or less, departure on the same vessel, presentation of a valid travel document to an immigration officer upon arrival, and payment of all applicable fees upon arrival unless the Chief Immigration Officer has authorised other arrangements — and that an immigration officer decides short-term visitor visa applications at the border.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：乘船抵达皮特凯恩的访客。据皮特凯恩群岛政府移民页：停留14天或以下、且乘同一船舶往返皮特凯恩的访客，可获短期访问签证，抵达皮特凯恩时申请。申请人须符合移民政策所列品格、健康、旅行与医疗保险及资金能力要求（州长可豁免）。短期访问签证申请在抵达时向移民官提出，方式为填写移民与生物安全合并申报表（抵达时发放）；无需提前申请，但D部分（品格）、E部分（移民史）或F部分（健康）任一回答为"是"者，建议出行前联系皮特凯恩移民局，可能需申请豁免。费用：据总督经与岛议会磋商、依《2006年移民管制条例》第2D(1)条颁布、自2026年6月2日起生效且标题载明适用于皮特凯恩、亨德森、迪西及奥诺群岛的《费用与征费通知》，短期访问签证申请费为NIL（免费）；此外，申请人另须按规定支付适用的按岛登岸费，该项收费不区分签证类别、按每岛每乘客计征：18岁或以上乘客每岛NZ$100；5岁以上且18岁以下乘客每岛NZ$50；5岁以下乘客NIL；恰好5岁乘客未落入任何所列档次，该确切年龄的登岸费金额未决（见PN-landing-fee-age-5-boundary-unspecified）。总督有裁量权减免申请费及登岸费（第2D(3)条）。同一通知另设其他收费事项——短期访问签证延期、乘客不登岸时的护照盖章、以及适用于进入领海的游轮及包租游览船舶的乘客人头费——属不同收费事项：本程序不列其金额，其亦非短期访问签证申请费的组成部分，且人头费适用于船舶而非申请人本人必缴的费用；详见国别报告。2026-03-22版《皮特凯恩群岛移民政策》（依《2006年移民管制条例》第2A条制定）第9条印证资格条件——停留14天或以下、乘抵达的同一船舶离境、抵达时向移民官出示有效旅行证件、抵达时缴纳全部适用费用（除非首席移民官已核准其他安排）——并规定短期访问签证申请由移民官在边境决定。
procedures.timing_en: Applied for on arrival at Pitcairn, before landing clearance; no advance application required (waiver contact encouraged for Section D/E/F 'Yes' answers).
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达皮特凯恩时、登陆清关前申请；无需提前申请（D/E/F部分答"是"者建议提前联系）。

fee.note: Application fee only: 'Application for Short-term Visitor Visa NIL' under the Immigration Control Ordinance 2006 Fees and Levies notice effective 2 June 2026. Additionally the applicable per-island landing fee (regardless of visa category) must be paid — see applicability for the age bands and the exactly-5 gap. Other charges in the same notice (extension, passport stamp, cruise/charter head levy) are separate fee matters — see report.

procedures.name_zh_hant: 短期訪問簽證（≤14天、同船往返）及移民與生物安全合併申報——皮特凱恩移民局
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：乘船抵達皮特凱恩的訪客。據皮特凱恩群島政府移民頁：停留14天或以下、且乘同一船舶往返皮特凱恩的訪客，可獲短期訪問簽證，抵達皮特凱恩時申請。申請人須符合移民政策所列品格、健康、旅行與醫療保險及資金能力要求（州長可豁免）。短期訪問簽證申請在抵達時向移民官提出，方式為填寫移民與生物安全合併申報表（抵達時發放）；無需提前申請，但D部分（品格）、E部分（移民史）或F部分（健康）任一回答為"是"者，建議出行前聯繫皮特凱恩移民局，可能需申請豁免。費用：據總督經與島議會磋商、依《2006年移民管制條例》第2D(1)條頒佈、自2026年6月2日起生效且標題載明適用於皮特凱恩、亨德森、迪西及奧諾群島的《費用與徵費通知》，短期訪問簽證申請費為NIL（免費）；此外，申請人另須按規定支付適用的按島登岸費，該項收費不區分簽證類別、按每島每乘客計徵：18歲或以上乘客每島NZ$100；5歲以上且18歲以下乘客每島NZ$50；5歲以下乘客NIL；恰好5歲乘客未落入任何所列檔次，該確切年齡的登岸費金額未決（見PN-landing-fee-age-5-boundary-unspecified）。總督有裁量權減免申請費及登岸費（第2D(3)條）。同一通知另設其他收費事項——短期訪問簽證延期、乘客不登岸時的護照蓋章、以及適用於進入領海的遊輪及包租遊覽船舶的乘客人頭費——屬不同收費事項：本程序不列其金額，其亦非短期訪問簽證申請費的組成部分，且人頭費適用於船舶而非申請人本人必繳的費用；詳見國別報告。2026-03-22版《皮特凱恩群島移民政策》（依《2006年移民管制條例》第2A條制定）第9條印證資格條件——停留14天或以下、乘抵達的同一船舶離境、抵達時向移民官出示有效旅行證件、抵達時繳納全部適用費用（除非首席移民官已核准其他安排）——並規定短期訪問簽證申請由移民官在邊境決定。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達皮特凱恩時、登陸清關前申請；無需提前申請（D/E/F部分答"是"者建議提前聯繫）。

procedures.name_en: Long-term visitor visa (more than 14 days) — Pitcairn immigration / Governor of Pitcairn
procedures.name_zh: 长期访问签证（>14天）——皮特凯恩移民局/皮特凯恩总督
procedures.agency: Pitcairn immigration (Chief Immigration Officer); decisions by the Governor of Pitcairn after consultation with the Pitcairn Island Council
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: visitors wishing to stay in Pitcairn for more than 14 days. Per the immigration page: a long-term visitor visa must be obtained before travelling; the application requires the long-term visitor visa application form, a general medical certificate and chest x-ray form, police certificates from the country of citizenship and any country resided in for more than 12 months, supporting documentation emailed to Pitcairn immigration, and payment of the application fee (NZ$150). The Governor of Pitcairn decides on applications after consultation with the Pitcairn Island Council; long-term visitor visas are issued for six months and extensions may be applied for before expiry; holders must maintain adequate travel and medical insurance for the visa duration.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：拟在皮特凯恩停留超过14天的访客。据移民页：须在出行前取得长期访问签证；申请材料包括长期访问签证申请表、通用体检证明与胸片表、国籍国及任何居住超12个月国家的无犯罪证明、连同支持文件电邮至皮特凯恩移民局，并缴纳申请费（NZ$150）。皮特凯恩总督经与皮特凯恩岛议会磋商后作出决定；长期访问签证有效期六个月，可在到期前申请延期；持有人须在签证期间保持足够的旅行与医疗保险。
procedures.timing_en: Applied for well in advance of intended travel; issued for six months; extension possible before expiry.
procedures.timing_zh: 须在拟出行前尽早申请；签发有效期六个月；到期前可申请延期。

fee.note: Application fee as stated on the immigration page (NZ$150).

procedures.name_zh_hant: 長期訪問簽證（>14天）——皮特凱恩移民局/皮特凱恩總督
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：擬在皮特凱恩停留超過14天的訪客。據移民頁：須在出行前取得長期訪問簽證；申請材料包括長期訪問簽證申請表、通用體檢證明與胸片表、國籍國及任何居住超12個月國家的無犯罪證明、連同支持文件電郵至皮特凱恩移民局，並繳納申請費（NZ$150）。皮特凱恩總督經與皮特凱恩島議會磋商後作出決定；長期訪問簽證有效期六個月，可在到期前申請延期；持有人須在簽證期間保持足夠的旅行與醫療保險。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 須在擬出行前儘早申請；簽發有效期六個月；到期前可申請延期。

procedures.name_en: Samoa Arrival Declaration Card (completed card presented to Customs on arrival)
procedures.name_zh: 萨摩亚入境申报卡（入境时向海关出示已填妥的卡片）
procedures.agency: Ministry of Customs (Matagaluega o Tiute), Government of Samoa
procedures.applicability_en: Direct support — Customs Services page (Passenger Clearance > Arrival Declaration): 'When arriving in Samoa, you are required to present your passport along with your completed Arrival Declaration Card, and any other necessary documents, such as your ticket (including e-ticket), itinerary, boarding pass, and receipts of payment, when requested by a Customs officer at the Airport or Wharf.' The FAQ page confirms, answering whether a passport must be presented after immigration: 'Yes it is an obligation to provide Customs with your passport together with your arrival declaration card and any other documents such as your ticket (including e-ticket) or itinerary, boarding pass, receipts of payment, etc when required by a Customs officer at the airport/wharf.' The same page warns 'There are penalties for failing to declare prohibited/excess of restricted goods on arrival in Samoa' without detailing amounts. Background only (Customs Act 2014, supports:[]): the Act's general traveller report/present/inspection duties (ss27-35) are summarised in the normalization report, not in this user-facing text; no captured provision prints, names, or lists the fields of an Arrival Declaration Card, so the Act is context, not evidence, and this procedure rests solely on the two Customs pages. Applicability is not differentiated by nationality in any captured text; no age condition is stated for the card itself. The blank card's field list and its distribution channel (in-flight, terminal, online) remain unknown: the site's Customs Forms list (captured) contains only cargo/broker/back-office forms (e.g. CCA, IM8, broker and manifest forms), no arrival card; the page's Travellers Guide (English and Samoan versions, wp-content uploads of April 2024) exists only as images, whose text cannot be extracted offline. No captured page contains a direct filing-fee sentence for this card; fee remains unknown.
procedures.applicability_zh: 直接依据——海关部《Customs Services》页面（Passenger Clearance > Arrival Declaration）原文：「抵达萨摩亚时，你须出示护照及已填妥的入境申报卡（Arrival Declaration Card），并应机场或码头海关关员要求出示票据（含电子票）、行程单、登机牌、付款收据等其他必要文件。」FAQ 页在回答移民查验后是否须出示护照时确认：「是的，有义务向海关出示护照并连同入境申报卡及其他文件（如票据含电子票、行程单、登机牌、付款收据等），应机场/码头海关关员要求。」同页警告「未申报禁止品/超量限制品抵达萨摩亚将受处罚」，但未列金额。仅为背景（《2014年海关法》，supports:[]）：该法关于旅行者报到、出示与查验的一般性义务（第27-35条）仅概述于规范化报告，不载于本用户面向文本；任何已获条文都未印载、未点名、也未列明入境申报卡的字段，故该法仅为语境而非证据，本程序仅以两页海关页面为直接依据。所获文本均未按国籍区分适用；申报卡本身无年龄条件。空白卡片的字段清单与发放渠道（机上、航站楼、线上）仍未知：站点 Customs Forms 清单（已留档）仅含货运/报关行/内部表单（如 CCA、IM8、报关行与舱单表格），无入境卡；页面所挂 Travellers Guide（英文版与萨摩亚语版，2024年4月上传）仅为图片，离线无法提取文字。任何所获页面均无针对该卡的直接收费语句；费用仍为未知。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, at the Airport or Wharf, when requested by a Customs officer; the FAQ places the obligation after immigration. The captured text does not state when or where the blank card is obtained or completed (in-flight distribution is not mentioned on any captured page).
procedures.timing_zh: 到达时在机场或码头，应海关关员要求出示；FAQ 显示该环节在移民查验之后。所获文本未说明空白卡的获取与填写时点地点（未提及是否机上发放）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 薩摩亞入境申報卡（入境時向海關出示已填妥的卡片）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 直接依據——海關部《Customs Services》頁面（Passenger Clearance > Arrival Declaration）原文：「抵達薩摩亞時，你須出示護照及已填妥的入境申報卡（Arrival Declaration Card），並應機場或碼頭海關關員要求出示票據（含電子票）、行程單、登機牌、付款收據等其他必要文件。」FAQ 頁在回答移民查驗後是否須出示護照時確認：「是的，有義務向海關出示護照並連同入境申報卡及其他文件（如票據含電子票、行程單、登機牌、付款收據等），應機場/碼頭海關關員要求。」同頁警告「未申報禁止品/超量限制品抵達薩摩亞將受處罰」，但未列金額。僅為背景（《2014年海關法》，supports:[]）：該法關於旅行者報到、出示與查驗的一般性義務（第27-35條）僅概述於規範化報告，不載於本用戶面向文本；任何已獲條文都未印載、未點名、也未列明入境申報卡的欄位，故該法僅為語境而非證據，本程序僅以兩頁海關頁面為直接依據。所獲文本均未按國籍區分適用；申報卡本身無年齡條件。空白卡片的欄位清單與發放渠道（機上、航站樓、線上）仍未知：網站 Customs Forms 清單（已留檔）僅含貨運/報關行/內部表單（如 CCA、IM8、報關行與艙單表格），無入境卡；頁面所掛 Travellers Guide（英文版與薩摩亞語版，2024年4月上傳）僅為圖片，離線無法提取文字。任何所獲頁面均無針對該卡的直接收費語句；費用仍為未知。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 到達時在機場或碼頭，應海關關員要求出示；FAQ 顯示該環節在移民查驗之後。所獲文本未說明空白卡的獲取與填寫時點地點（未提及是否機上發放）。

procedures.name_en: Border Currency Report (BCR) – cash or negotiable bearer instruments at the SAT 20,000 threshold (or foreign-currency equivalent), entering or leaving Samoa
procedures.name_zh: 边境货币报告（BCR）——入境或离开萨摩亚时携带现金或不记名可转让票据达到 20,000 萨摩亚塔拉门槛（或等值外币）
procedures.agency: Central Bank of Samoa – Financial Intelligence Unit (BCR form publisher; statutory basis s13 Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007); Ministry of Customs instructs completion on arrival
procedures.applicability_en: COMPARATOR CONFLICT, STATED FIRST (unresolved): carrying STRICTLY MORE THAN SAT 20,000 (or foreign-currency equivalent) in cash or negotiable bearer instruments must be reported when entering or leaving Samoa — on that, the statute and the Central Bank materials agree. They DISAGREE at exactly SAT 20,000: the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 s13(1) catches only 'more than $20,000', while the Central Bank's BCR page and its 2017 BCR form catch 'SAT 20,000 or more' (inclusive). The exact-threshold case is therefore unsettled between statute and form/page; no unqualified instruction is issued for it (following the Central Bank's inclusive wording is traveller prudence, not an official determination). Predicate and threshold — statute (MLP Act 2007 s13(1), Office of the Attorney General consolidation, as amended through 2018): a person who 'leaves or enters Samoa with more than $20,000, or such other amount as may be prescribed, in cash or negotiable bearer instruments (in Samoan currency or equivalent foreign currency) on the person or in the person's luggage, cargo or mail' must not leave or enter 'without first having reported the fact to the Financial Intelligence Unit'; non-compliance is an offence (penalty formulations diverge across sources and are recorded in the report, not here). Central Bank of Samoa BCR & STR Forms page (last updated 25 Nov 2024): the BCR is completed by 'Any person who leaves or enter Samoa carrying cash or negotiable bearer instruments with a combined value of SAT 20,000 or more or its equivalent in foreign currency'; it is 'a requirement under section 13 of the MLP Act 2007'. Central Bank 2017 BCR form (paper form completed by the traveller, in ink and capital letters): complete it if carrying cash or negotiable bearer instruments of a combined value of SAT 20,000 or more or its equivalent in foreign currency 'into or out of Samoa'; persons in charge of young people or people with disability complete it for those incapable; Part A ticks 'Into Samoa?' / 'Out of Samoa?' and the completed report is given to an authorised officer at the port of arrival/departure; the form's declaration line cites the 'MLP Regulations 2009' (the natural home of any prescribed different amount; not captured). Ministry of Customs page (arrival direction only, no comparator stated): 'SAT $20,000.00 (or its foreign equivalent) must be declared and a Border Currency Report must be completed on arrival.' Directions: the BCR is a true traveller-submitted procedure at BOTH entry and exit (statute 'leaves or enters'; CBS page 'leaves or enter'; form 'into or out of Samoa', port of arrival/departure); only the Customs page is arrival-worded. The generic outward-baggage inspection duty in Customs Act 2014 s33 is NOT a departure declaration card and is not treated as one. Persons and amount: no nationality condition in any captured text; the amount is denominated in Samoan tala and the foreign leg is a variable equivalent ('or its equivalent in foreign currency'), never a fixed foreign figure. No captured page contains a direct filing-fee sentence for this report; fee remains unknown.
procedures.applicability_zh: 比较词冲突，置于最前（未决）：携带现金或不记名可转让票据（或等值外币）严格超过 20,000 萨摩亚塔拉者，入境或离开萨摩亚均须报告——就此，法条与央行材料的口径一致。但在「恰为 20,000 塔拉」一点上两说相互矛盾：《2007年防止洗钱法》第13(1)条仅覆盖「超过 $20,000」者，而央行 BCR 页面与 2017 年 BCR 表格覆盖「SAT 20,000 或以上」（含等于）。等额情形因此在法条与表格/页面之间未决；本程序不对其发布无保留的申报指令（按央行含等号口径处理属出行人审慎做法，非官方裁断）。要件与门槛——法条（总检察署合编本，含至2018年修正）：「离开或进入萨摩亚时，随身或于行李、货物、邮件中携带超过 $20,000（或规章规定的其他数额）的现金或不记名可转让票据（萨摩亚货币或等值外币）」者，未「先行向金融情报组（FIU）报告该事实」不得离境或入境；不报告即构成犯罪（各来源刑罚表述不一，仅录于报告，不载于本用户面向程序）。萨摩亚中央银行 BCR & STR Forms 页（2024年11月25日最后更新）：BCR 由「任何离开或进入萨摩亚、携带现金或不记名可转让票据合计价值达 SAT 20,000 或以上（或等值外币）的人」填报；系「《2007年防止洗钱法》第13条的要求」。央行 2017 年 BCR 表格（旅行者本人填报的纸质表，须以墨水笔大写填写）：携带现金或不记名可转让票据合计达 SAT 20,000 或以上（或等值外币）「进入或离开萨摩亚」即须填报；年幼或残障人士由其负责人代为填报；表格 A 部分勾选「进入萨摩亚？／离开萨摩亚？」，填妥后交予抵达／离境口岸的获授权人员；表格声明栏并援引「MLP Regulations 2009」（任何经规章改定数额的最可能出处；未捕获）。海关部页面（仅入境方向，未给出比较词）：「SAT $20,000.00（或其等值外币）必须申报，并于抵达时填写边境货币报告。」方向：BCR 是真正的旅行者递交程序，入境与出境两方向均适用（法条「离开或进入」；央行页「leaves or enter」；表格「进入或离开萨摩亚」、抵达／离境口岸）；仅海关页面只涉入境。《2014年海关法》第33条的离境行李交验义务是一般查验规定，并非离境申报卡，不得混同。人群与金额：所获文本均无国籍条件；金额以萨摩亚塔拉计，外币腿为等值折算（「或其等值外币」），绝非固定外币数额。任何所获页面均无针对本报告的直接收费语句；费用仍为未知。
procedures.timing_en: Conditional on amount and on EITHER border direction: a traveller carrying more than the threshold — or, on the Central Bank's wording, SAT 20,000 or more — in cash or negotiable bearer instruments reports at the border, on entry OR on exit. The statute forbids leaving or entering 'without first having reported the fact' to the Financial Intelligence Unit, i.e. before/at the crossing in both directions. The 2017 BCR form directs the traveller to complete it and give it to an authorised officer at the port of arrival/departure. The Ministry of Customs page instructs completion 'on arrival' for the entry direction. Paper form, completed in ink and capital letters; no online lodgement channel is stated on the captured Central Bank page, which only links the PDF form.
procedures.timing_zh: 视金额与任一边境方向而定的条件性时点：携带现金或不记名可转让票据超过门槛（按央行口径为 SAT 20,000 或以上）的旅行者，入境或离开萨摩亚时均须报告，即入境或出境择一触发。法条要求未「先行向金融情报组（FIU）报告该事实」不得离境或入境，即两个方向均须在过境前/过境时报告。2017 年 BCR 表格指示旅行人填妥后交予抵达／离境口岸的获授权人员。海关部页面就入境方向指示「于抵达时填写」。纸质表格，以墨水笔大写填报；所获央行页面仅提供 PDF 表格链接，未述线上递交渠道。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 邊境貨幣報告（BCR）——入境或離開薩摩亞時攜帶現金或不記名可轉讓票據達到 20,000 薩摩亞塔拉門檻（或等值外幣）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 比較詞衝突，置於最前（未決）：攜帶現金或不記名可轉讓票據（或等值外幣）嚴格超過 20,000 薩摩亞塔拉者，入境或離開薩摩亞均須報告——就此，法條與央行材料的口徑一致。但在「恰為 20,000 塔拉」一點上兩說相互矛盾：《2007年防止洗錢法》第13(1)條僅覆蓋「超過 $20,000」者，而央行 BCR 頁面與 2017 年 BCR 表格覆蓋「SAT 20,000 或以上」（含等於）。等額情形因此在法條與表格/頁面之間未決；本程序不對其發佈無保留的申報指令（按央行含等號口徑處理屬出行人審慎做法，非官方裁斷）。要件與門檻——法條（總檢察署合編本，含至2018年修正）：「離開或進入薩摩亞時，隨身或於行李、貨物、郵件中攜帶超過 $20,000（或規章規定的其他數額）的現金或不記名可轉讓票據（薩摩亞貨幣或等值外幣）」者，未「先行向金融情報組（FIU）報告該事實」不得離境或入境；不報告即構成犯罪（各來源刑罰表述不一，僅錄於報告，不載於本用戶面向程序）。薩摩亞中央銀行 BCR & STR Forms 頁（2024年11月25日最後更新）：BCR 由「任何離開或進入薩摩亞、攜帶現金或不記名可轉讓票據合計價值達 SAT 20,000 或以上（或等值外幣）的人」填報；系「《2007年防止洗錢法》第13條的要求」。央行 2017 年 BCR 表格（旅行者本人填報的紙質表，須以墨水筆大寫填寫）：攜帶現金或不記名可轉讓票據合計達 SAT 20,000 或以上（或等值外幣）「進入或離開薩摩亞」即須填報；年幼或殘障人士由其負責人代為填報；表格 A 部分勾選「進入薩摩亞？／離開薩摩亞？」，填妥後交予抵達／離境口岸的獲授權人員；表格聲明欄並援引「MLP Regulations 2009」（任何經規章改定數額的最可能出處；未捕獲）。海關部頁面（僅入境方向，未給出比較詞）：「SAT $20,000.00（或其等值外幣）必須申報，並於抵達時填寫邊境貨幣報告。」方向：BCR 是真正的旅行者遞交程序，入境與出境兩方向均適用（法條「離開或進入」；央行頁「leaves or enter」；表格「進入或離開薩摩亞」、抵達／離境口岸）；僅海關頁面只涉入境。《2014年海關法》第33條的離境行李交驗義務是一般查驗規定，並非離境申報卡，不得混同。人群與金額：所獲文本均無國籍條件；金額以薩摩亞塔拉計，外幣腿為等值折算（「或其等值外幣」），絕非固定外幣數額。任何所獲頁面均無針對本報告的直接收費語句；費用仍為未知。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 視金額與任一邊境方向而定的條件性時點：攜帶現金或不記名可轉讓票據超過門檻（按央行口徑為 SAT 20,000 或以上）的旅行者，入境或離開薩摩亞時均須報告，即入境或出境擇一觸發。法條要求未「先行向金融情報組（FIU）報告該事實」不得離境或入境，即兩個方向均須在過境前/過境時報告。2017 年 BCR 表格指示旅行人填妥後交予抵達／離境口岸的獲授權人員。海關部頁面就入境方向指示「於抵達時填寫」。紙質表格，以墨水筆大寫填報；所獲央行頁面僅提供 PDF 表格連結，未述線上遞交渠道。

procedures.name_en: Passenger Declaration (Customs Form C18) on arrival — Ministry of Revenue & Customs, Tonga
procedures.name_zh: 入境旅客申报单（海关C18表）——汤加税务局与海关部
procedures.agency: Ministry of Revenue & Customs (Customs and Immigration services), Government of Tonga
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers arriving in Tonga, by air or by sea. Statutory basis (Customs and Excise Management Regulations 2008, as hosted by the Ministry): a passenger arriving in the Kingdom shall present a completed passenger declaration on Customs Form C18 to the Customs officer on arrival (Regulation 65); Customs Form C18 is the designated passenger's declaration (Regulation 62(a)); a Customs area is designated at each declared port or place for the processing of passengers (Regulation 63); a passenger disembarking from an aircraft or ship shall proceed directly to the baggage place and, after completing immigration processing, to the baggage examination area (Regulation 64(2)-(3)). Current website flow (airport wording): when arriving at any of Tonga's international airports, travellers must proceed immediately to a Customs Officer at the Passport Control booths for immigration clearance; passports valid a minimum of 6 months are required when entering Tonga; after collecting baggage, travellers submit their completed Passenger Declaration to Customs Officers at the Baggage Inspection area, who apply the dual channel system of clearance; baggage and person may be examined; prohibited or restricted goods must be declared. The hosted single-page Form C18 asks arriving passengers (Customs Declaration section, 'Are you bringing into Tonga') to tick for: cash in any currency to the value of TOP10,000 or more; goods over the personal concession for alcohol and tobacco products; goods for commercial or business purposes; goods that may be prohibited or restricted; followed by agriculture quarantine questions (farm or forest visit in the past 30 days, food, animals or animal products, plants or plant products, items such as tents, spiked sporting shoes/boots, soil or water). The cash line is recorded as a form question on the passenger declaration only: the separately catalogued Border Currency Reporting Form was not retrieved this round, the form file on the Ministry server is dated 2021-03-31, and no independent cash-declaration procedure or unconditionally current threshold is asserted. Duty-free quantities are not asserted as a single current rule: the current Duty Free Allowances page and Regulation 77 agree on 4.5 litres of wine or beer, personal effects, and TOP$500 combined other goods, but conflict on tobacco (site: 250 sticks of cigarettes/cigars or 250 grams of tobacco product; Regulation: 500 cigarettes or 50 cigars or 250 grams of tobacco) and spirits (site: 25 litres of portable spirits; Regulation: 2.25 litres of spirits); see unresolved TO-duty-free-tobacco-spirits-official-values-conflict. After-hours Customs attendance fees under Regulation 64(1) are payable by the master of the aircraft or ship, not a passenger form fee. Visa/entry-permit nationality rules are not recorded in this procedure: the captured page contains mutually inconsistent visa statements (see unresolved TO-visa-30d-vs-entry-permit-contradiction).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：抵达汤加的旅客，含空路与海路。法定依据（海关与消费税管理条例2008，部方官网托管文本）：抵达王国的旅客须在到达时向海关关员提交填妥的海关C18表旅客申报单（第65条）；C18表为指定的旅客申报表（第62(a)条）；各申报港口或地点均设海关区域办理旅客（第63条）；从航空器或船舶下客的旅客须直接前往行李交运地点，办完移民手续后立即前往行李查验区（第64(2)、(3)款）。当前官网流程（措辞为机场）：抵达任一汤加国际机场后，旅客须立即前往护照查验亭的海关关员办理移民清关；入境须持有有效期至少6个月的护照；提取行李后，旅客须在行李查验区向海关关员提交填写完整的旅客申报单，海关实行红绿双通道验放；行李及人身可能被查验；禁止或限制物品必须申报。官网托管的单页C18表在海关申报部分（“Are you bringing into Tonga”）要求抵达旅客勾选：任何币种价值达TOP10,000或以上的现金；超过个人免税额的酒类及烟草制品；商用或营业用途货物；可能禁止或受限的货物；其后为农业检疫问项（过去30天农场或森林到访、食品、动物或动物制品、植物或植物制品、帐篷/钉鞋/土壤或水等）。现金问项仅按旅客申报单的表内问题记录：目录中另列的边境现金申报表本轮未获取，部方服务器上的表单文件日期为2021-03-31，不据此设立独立现金申报程序，也不将该门槛无条件视为现行。免税额度不写为单一现行规定：当前免税额度页面与第77条在4.5升葡萄酒或啤酒、个人自用品、其他货品合计TOP$500上一致，但烟草（官网：250支香烟/雪茄或250克烟草制品；条例：500支香烟或50支雪茄或250克烟草）与烈酒（官网：25升便携烈酒；条例：2.25升烈酒）数字冲突，见未决项TO-duty-free-tobacco-spirits-official-values-conflict。第64(1)款的加班海关服务费由航空器或船舶的船长/机长支付，不是旅客表单费用。本事项不记录签证/入境许可的国籍规则：已抓取页面存在相互矛盾的签证表述（见未决项TO-visa-30d-vs-entry-permit-contradiction）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival: immigration clearance at the Passport Control booths, then immediately the completed Form C18 at the Baggage Inspection area (dual channel system of clearance).
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时：先在护照查验亭办理移民清关，随后立即在行李查验区提交填妥的C18表（红绿双通道验放）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 入境旅客申報單（海關C18表）——湯加稅務局與海關部
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：抵達湯加的旅客，含空路與海路。法定依據（海關與消費稅管理條例2008，部方官網託管文本）：抵達王國的旅客須在到達時向海關關員提交填妥的海關C18表旅客申報單（第65條）；C18表為指定的旅客申報表（第62(a)條）；各申報港口或地點均設海關區域辦理旅客（第63條）；從航空器或船舶下客的旅客須直接前往行李交運地點，辦完移民手續後立即前往行李查驗區（第64(2)、(3)款）。當前官網流程（措辭為機場）：抵達任一湯加國際機場後，旅客須立即前往護照查驗亭的海關關員辦理移民清關；入境須持有有效期至少6個月的護照；提取行李後，旅客須在行李查驗區向海關關員提交填寫完整的旅客申報單，海關實行紅綠雙通道驗放；行李及人身可能被查驗；禁止或限制物品必須申報。官網託管的單頁C18表在海關申報部分（“Are you bringing into Tonga”）要求抵達旅客勾選：任何幣種價值達TOP10,000或以上的現金；超過個人免稅額的酒類及菸草製品；商用或營業用途貨物；可能禁止或受限的貨物；其後為農業檢疫問項（過去30天農場或森林到訪、食品、動物或動物製品、植物或植物製品、帳篷/釘鞋/土壤或水等）。現金問項僅按旅客申報單的表內問題記錄：目錄中另列的邊境現金申報表本輪未獲取，部方伺服器上的表單文件日期為2021-03-31，不據此設立獨立現金申報程序，也不將該門檻無條件視為現行。免稅額度不寫為單一現行規定：當前免稅額度頁面與第77條在4.5升葡萄酒或啤酒、個人自用品、其他貨品合計TOP$500上一致，但菸草（官網：250支香菸/雪茄或250克菸草製品；條例：500支香菸或50支雪茄或250克菸草）與烈酒（官網：25升便攜烈酒；條例：2.25升烈酒）數字衝突，見未決項TO-duty-free-tobacco-spirits-official-values-conflict。第64(1)款的加班海關服務費由航空器或船舶的船長/機長支付，不是旅客表單費用。本事項不記錄簽證/入境許可的國籍規則：已抓取頁面存在相互矛盾的簽證表述（見未決項TO-visa-30d-vs-entry-permit-contradiction）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時：先在護照查驗亭辦理移民清關，隨後立即在行李查驗區提交填妥的C18表（紅綠雙通道驗放）。

procedures.name_en: Passenger Departure Declaration (Customs Form C18) — Ministry of Revenue & Customs, Tonga
procedures.name_zh: 旅客离境申报单（海关C18表）——汤加税务局与海关部
procedures.agency: Ministry of Revenue & Customs (Customs and Immigration services), Government of Tonga
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: travellers departing from Tonga, by air or by sea. Statutory basis (Customs and Excise Management Regulations 2008, as hosted by the Ministry): a passenger departing from the Kingdom shall present a completed passenger declaration on Customs Form C18 to the Customs officer on departure (Regulation 65); Customs Form C18 is the designated passenger's declaration (Regulation 62(a)); a passenger or crew member leaving the Kingdom shall declare to the Customs officer whether carrying prohibited or restricted exports or imports, quarantine-restricted goods, or unpaid dutiable goods (Regulation 75). The current Ministry Customs Forms page catalogues, under TRAVELLERS, a 'Passenger Departure Declaration' carrying form number C18 (the adjacent 'Passenger Arrival Declaration' row carries no form number or link on the current page). The hosted single-page Form C18 cites Regulation 62(a) and 65 and is a combined card: it states the Immigration Officer will detach the departure card, and its printed instruction reads 'PLEASE SUBMIT TO IMMIGRATION OFFICER ON YOUR DEPQRTURE FROM THE KINGDOM' (sic). Which officer finally receives the departing card (Customs officer per Regulation 65, or Immigration Officer per the form print) is not decided by the obtained texts; see unresolved TO-c18-departure-card-recipient-officer. No fee is stated for the form itself; after-hours Customs attendance fees under Regulation 64(1) are payable by the master of the aircraft or ship, not by the passenger.
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：离开汤加的旅客，含空路与海路。法定依据（海关与消费税管理条例2008，部方官网托管文本）：离开王国的旅客须在离境时向海关关员提交填妥的海关C18表旅客申报单（第65条）；C18表为指定的旅客申报表（第62(a)条）；离开王国的旅客或机组人员须向海关关员申报是否携带禁止或限制的进出口货物、检疫受限货物或未完税货物（第75条）。当前部方海关表单页在TRAVELLERS（旅客）类目下列出“Passenger Departure Declaration”，表号为C18（相邻的“Passenger Arrival Declaration”行在当前页面上未标表号亦无链接）。官网托管的单页C18表援引第62(a)条和第65条，为合并卡片式表单：表内注明由移民官撕下离境卡（departure card），印制说明为“PLEASE SUBMIT TO IMMIGRATION OFFICER ON YOUR DEPQRTURE FROM THE KINGDOM”（原文如此）。离境卡最终交给哪位关员（第65条的海关关员，还是表内印制的移民官）现有文本未能判定；见未决项TO-c18-departure-card-recipient-officer。表单本身未载费用；第64(1)款的加班海关服务费由航空器或船舶的船长/机长支付，非旅客费用。
procedures.timing_en: On departure from the Kingdom, at the departure control point, per Regulation 65 and the form's printed instruction.
procedures.timing_zh: 离境时在出境查验点，按第65条及表内印制说明提交。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 旅客離境申報單（海關C18表）——湯加稅務局與海關部
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：離開湯加的旅客，含空路與海路。法定依據（海關與消費稅管理條例2008，部方官網託管文本）：離開王國的旅客須在離境時向海關關員提交填妥的海關C18表旅客申報單（第65條）；C18表為指定的旅客申報表（第62(a)條）；離開王國的旅客或機組人員須向海關關員申報是否攜帶禁止或限制的進出口貨物、檢疫受限貨物或未完稅貨物（第75條）。當前部方海關表單頁在TRAVELLERS（旅客）類目下列出“Passenger Departure Declaration”，表號為C18（相鄰的“Passenger Arrival Declaration”行在當前頁面上未標表號亦無連結）。官網託管的單頁C18表援引第62(a)條和第65條，為合併卡片式表單：表內註明由移民官撕下離境卡（departure card），印製說明為“PLEASE SUBMIT TO IMMIGRATION OFFICER ON YOUR DEPQRTURE FROM THE KINGDOM”（原文如此）。離境卡最終交給哪位關員（第65條的海關關員，還是表內印製的移民官）現有文本未能判定；見未決項TO-c18-departure-card-recipient-officer。表單本身未載費用；第64(1)款的加班海關服務費由航空器或船舶的船長/機長支付，非旅客費用。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 離境時在出境查驗點，按第65條及表內印製說明提交。

procedures.name_en: Conditional written baggage declaration when required by Customs (Regulation 84: customs forms C11/C12, and C41 if appropriate) — Customs Regulations (CAP. 26.04.1), Tuvalu
procedures.name_zh: 应海关要求时才需作出的有条件书面行李申报（第84条：海关C11/C12表，视情况另附C41表）——图瓦卢《海关条例》（CAP. 26.04.1）
procedures.agency: Tuvalu Customs (proper officer / Director of Customs), under the Customs Regulations (CAP. 26.04.1, 2022 Revised Edition; the 1964 regulations continued in force by section 270 of the Customs Revenue and Border Protection Act, CAP 26.04)
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: arrival. Core rule — conditional, not universal: regulation 84 of the Customs Regulations (CAP. 26.04.1, 2022 Revised Edition; the 1964 regulations continued in force by section 270 of the Customs Revenue and Border Protection Act, CAP 26.04) provides that the owner of baggage brought into a customs area may be required to make such declaration in writing — in customs form C11 (Passenger’s Baggage Declaration, for passengers arriving by sea) or C12 (International Passenger Baggage Declaration, for passengers arriving by air), and in customs form C41 (Baggage) if appropriate — relating to such baggage as the officer shall require, paying any duty payable thereon and removing the baggage. The condition is a requirement of the proper officer: no arriving passenger owes a written customs form unless the officer requires one. Reporting and examination duties are not declarations: the baggage owner's duty to attend immediately upon the proper officer and answer questions (regulation 84, first limb) is only the prerequisite; the duty of every person arriving to report to a Customs officer or Police station (Act s 38) and the duty to make accompanying baggage available for examination (Act s 40; s 43 is the outbound counterpart) are report and examination duties only — none of them, by itself, constitutes submitting a declaration. Persons: the owner of any baggage brought into a customs area — no crew exemption appears in the captured provisions. Scope of forms: C11/C12/C41 are the only passenger customs forms in the captured current law; the Schedule 4 list of forms contains no departure-side passenger baggage declaration; carrier forms (C4 Ships Report Inwards, C5 General Declaration for Aircraft) and the s 37 inward report are the master's or owner's obligations, not passenger forms. Fee: no amount is captured for the forms; unknown. Duty-free quantities and any cash threshold are not stated in the captured current law (see unresolved TV-duty-free-quantities-not-captured).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：入境。核心规则——有条件而非普遍：《海关条例》（CAP. 26.04.1，2022年修订版；1964年条例经《海关收入与边境保护法》（CAP 26.04）第270条延续有效）第84条规定，将行李带入海关区的行李所有人“可能被要求”作出书面申报——海关C11表（Passenger’s Baggage Declaration，海运抵达旅客）或C12表（International Passenger Baggage Declaration，空运抵达旅客），视情况另附海关C41表（Baggage）——按该主管关员的要求就其行李作出，随即缴纳应付税款并移走行李。其条件是主管关员提出要求：关员不要求，抵达旅客即不负担任何海关书面表格。报到与查验义务不是申报：行李所有人立即到场接受主管关员询问并回答问题（第84条前段）只是前置义务；每个抵达人员向海关关员或警察局报到（该法第38条）与将随身行李交由查验（该法第40条；第43条为出境对应条款）均只是报到与查验义务——任何一项本身都不构成提交申报。人员：将行李带入海关区的行李所有人——已抓取条款中无机组或船员豁免。表格范围：C11/C12/C41是已抓取现行法中仅有的旅客海关表；附表四（Schedule 4）表单清单中没有离境侧的旅客行李申报表；承运人表（C4船舶进港报告、C5航空器总申报）与第37条的进口报告是船长或船东的义务，不是旅客表。费用：未捕获表单收费金额，故费用未知。免税额度数量与现金门槛未见于已抓取的现行法（见未决项TV-duty-free-quantities-not-captured）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, at the baggage examination and clearance stage: the baggage owner attends upon the proper officer and answers questions (regulation 84); a written declaration in customs form C11 or C12 (and C41 if appropriate) is due only if the proper officer requires it, with any duty payable thereon. Reporting (Act s 38) and baggage examination (Act s 40) involve no form by themselves.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达时，在行李查验与清关环节：行李所有人到场接受主管关员询问并回答问题（第84条）；书面海关C11或C12表（视情况另附C41表）仅在主管关员要求时才需填写，并随即缴纳应付税款。报到（第38条）与行李查验（第40条）本身不涉及任何表格。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 應海關要求時才需作出的有條件書面行李申報（第84條：海關C11/C12表，視情況另附C41表）——圖瓦盧《海關條例》（CAP. 26.04.1）
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：入境。核心規則——有條件而非普遍：《海關條例》（CAP. 26.04.1，2022年修訂版；1964年條例經《海關收入與邊境保護法》（CAP 26.04）第270條延續有效）第84條規定，將行李帶入海關區的行李所有人“可能被要求”作出書面申報——海關C11表（Passenger’s Baggage Declaration，海運抵達旅客）或C12表（International Passenger Baggage Declaration，空運抵達旅客），視情況另附海關C41表（Baggage）——按該主管關員的要求就其行李作出，隨即繳納應付稅款並移走行李。其條件是主管關員提出要求：關員不要求，抵達旅客即不負擔任何海關書面表格。報到與查驗義務不是申報：行李所有人立即到場接受主管關員詢問並回答問題（第84條前段）只是前置義務；每個抵達人員向海關關員或警察局報到（該法第38條）與將隨身行李交由查驗（該法第40條；第43條為出境對應條款）均只是報到與查驗義務——任何一項本身都不構成提交申報。人員：將行李帶入海關區的行李所有人——已抓取條款中無機組或船員豁免。表格範圍：C11/C12/C41是已抓取現行法中僅有的旅客海關表；附表四（Schedule 4）表單清單中沒有離境側的旅客行李申報表；承運人表（C4船舶進港報告、C5航空器總申報）與第37條的進口報告是船長或船東的義務，不是旅客表。費用：未捕獲表單收費金額，故費用未知。免稅額度數量與現金門檻未見於已抓取的現行法（見未決項TV-duty-free-quantities-not-captured）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達時，在行李查驗與清關環節：行李所有人到場接受主管關員詢問並回答問題（第84條）；書面海關C11或C12表（視情況另附C41表）僅在主管關員要求時才需填寫，並隨即繳納應付稅款。報到（第38條）與行李查驗（第40條）本身不涉及任何表格。

procedures.name_en: Arrival Card (Form 11 of Schedule 2) for persons arriving by air or sea — Immigration Regulations 2014, Tuvalu
procedures.name_zh: 到达卡（附表二Form 11表，空路或海路抵达人员填写）——图瓦卢《2014年移民条例》
procedures.agency: Tuvalu Immigration (Principal Immigration Officer), under the Immigration Act and the Immigration Regulations 2014
procedures.applicability_en: Direction: arrival. Persons and routes: regulation 9 of the Immigration Regulations 2014 (made under section 18 of the Immigration Act) requires every person arriving in Tuvalu by air or by sea, except the crew of commercial aircraft or commercial vessels, to complete an Arrival Card in Form 11 of Schedule 2, in terms of section 5(2) of the Act. The exemption is limited to commercial crew: crew of non-commercial aircraft or vessels, and all other persons, remain covered. Form 11 collects surname, given name, country of birth, date of birth, occupation, country of citizenship, permanent address, gender, passport number, place and dates of issue and expiry, address and phone/email in Tuvalu (non-resident), last port of embarkation, flight number or ship name, purpose of visit (holiday, transit, research/study, business/commerce, government official conference, returning resident, other purpose) and intended length of stay, closing with a signed declaration that the particulars are correct and true in every respect, under the form's warning that a false declaration is a serious offence. Fee: no fee is stated for the card; the card fee is unknown — the $100 in regulation 2(1)(b) (mirrored at regulation 7(h)) is the visitor's permit fee payable by citizens of countries not listed in Schedule 1 of the Regulations, not a card fee. Departure equivalent: regulation 10 requires the same scope of persons departing by air or sea to complete a Departure Card in Form 12; that obligation is not modelled as a procedure here because the record schema's procedure type enum has no departure_card value (see unresolved TV-departure-card-form12-not-modeled).
procedures.applicability_zh: 方向：入境。人员与路线：《2014年移民条例》（依据《移民法》第18条制定）第9条规定，凡乘空路或海路抵达图瓦卢的人员，商业航空器或商业船舶的机组/船员除外，均须按该法第5(2)条填写附表二（Schedule 2）Form 11表到达卡。豁免仅限商业机组/船员：非商业航空器或船舶的机组/船员及其他所有人员仍在适用范围内。Form 11表采集姓氏、名字、出生国、出生日期、职业、公民身份国、永久住址、性别、护照号码、签发地点与签发/到期日期、在图瓦卢的住址及电话/邮箱（非居民）、最后出发港、航班号或船名、访问目的（度假、过境、研究/学习、商务/贸易、政府官员会议、回返居民、其他目的）与拟停留时长，末尾为签名申报“上述各项资料真实无误”，并印有虚假申报属严重罪行的警告。费用：条例未规定到达卡费用，卡费未知——第2(1)(b)条的100美元（与第7(h)条相同）是未列入附表一（Schedule 1）国家的公民应缴的访客许可费，不是卡费。离境对应义务：第10条要求同等范围的人员于乘空路或海路离境时填写Form 12表离境卡；因本记录 schema 的程序类型枚举无 departure_card 值，该义务未建为程序（见未决项TV-departure-card-form12-not-modeled）。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival by air or sea: the card is completed for immigration processing, in terms of section 5(2) of the Immigration Act (regulation 9).
procedures.timing_zh: 乘空路或海路抵达时：为办理移民手续填写此卡，依据《移民法》第5(2)条（第9条）。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 到達卡（附表二Form 11表，空路或海路抵達人員填寫）——圖瓦盧《2014年移民條例》
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 方向：入境。人員與路線：《2014年移民條例》（依據《移民法》第18條制定）第9條規定，凡乘空路或海路抵達圖瓦盧的人員，商業航空器或商業船舶的機組/船員除外，均須按該法第5(2)條填寫附表二（Schedule 2）Form 11表到達卡。豁免僅限商業機組/船員：非商業航空器或船舶的機組/船員及其他所有人員仍在適用範圍內。Form 11表採集姓氏、名字、出生國、出生日期、職業、公民身份國、永久住址、性別、護照號碼、簽發地點與簽發/到期日期、在圖瓦盧的住址及電話/信箱（非居民）、最後出發港、航班號或船名、訪問目的（度假、過境、研究/學習、商務/貿易、政府官員會議、回返居民、其他目的）與擬停留時長，末尾為簽名申報“上述各項資料真實無誤”，並印有虛假申報屬嚴重罪行的警告。費用：條例未規定到達卡費用，卡費未知——第2(1)(b)條的100美元（與第7(h)條相同）是未列入附表一（Schedule 1）國家的公民應繳的訪客許可費，不是卡費。離境對應義務：第10條要求同等範圍的人員於乘空路或海路離境時填寫Form 12表離境卡；因本記錄 schema 的程序類型枚舉無 departure_card 值，該義務未建為程序（見未決項TV-departure-card-form12-not-modeled）。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 乘空路或海路抵達時：為辦理移民手續填寫此卡，依據《移民法》第5(2)條（第9條）。

procedures.name_en: Accompanied baggage and alcohol declaration
procedures.name_zh: 随身行李与酒类申报
procedures.agency: 财政部关务署
procedures.applicability_en: Arriving travellers: the general allowance for personal/household goods is TWD35,000 (effective 26 June 2024). Excess value must be declared at the red channel. Travellers aged 18 or over may bring 1.5 litres of alcohol duty free (effective 25 January 2025); excess requires declaration. The general allowance must not be applied to goods imported for sale.
procedures.applicability_zh: 入境旅客：自用家用行李一般免税额自2024年6月26日起为新台币35,000元，超额须走红线申报。年满18岁旅客的酒类免税数量自2025年1月25日起为1.5公升；超过免税数量须申报。用于销售的货物不能套用自用免税额。
procedures.timing_en: On arrival, before passing customs.
procedures.timing_zh: 抵达后通过海关前办理。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 隨身行李與酒類申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 入境旅客：自用家用行李一般免稅額自2024年6月26日起為新臺幣35,000元，超額須走紅線申報。年滿18歲旅客的酒類免稅數量自2025年1月25日起為1.5公升；超過免稅數量須申報。用於銷售的貨物不能套用自用免稅額。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 抵達後通過海關前辦理。

procedures.name_en: Cash and bearer instruments declaration
procedures.name_zh: 现金与无记名票据申报
procedures.agency: 财政部关务署
procedures.applicability_en: The Customs Administration lists separate thresholds: foreign cash over USD10,000 equivalent; bearer negotiable securities over USD10,000 face value; gold over USD20,000 value; non-personal diamonds, gemstones or platinum over TWD500,000. TWD100,000 and CNY20,000 are carrying limits with separate controls. Reporting an excess does not itself authorize carriage: excess incoming TWD is returned and excess incoming CNY is held for departure. Gold over its threshold additionally needs an import/export permit.
procedures.applicability_zh: 关务署分别列示：外币现钞总值超过等值1万美元；无记名有价证券总面额超过等值1万美元；黄金总值超过2万美元；超越自用目的的钻石、宝石或白金总值超过新台币50万元须申报。新台币10万元及人民币2万元是另有携带限制的额度；申报不等于准许超额携带。入境新台币超额部分退运，人民币超额部分封存待离境携出；黄金超额另须输出入许可证。
procedures.timing_en: Arrival: after baggage collection and before the customs lanes. Departure: after airline check-in and before security.
procedures.timing_zh: 入境：领取行李后、通过海关通道前。出境：航空公司报到后、安检前。
procedures.name_zh_hant: 現金與無記名票據申報
procedures.applicability_zh_hant: 關務署分別列示：外幣現鈔總值超過等值1萬美元；無記名有價證券總面額超過等值1萬美元；黃金總值超過2萬美元；超越自用目的的鑽石、寶石或白金總值超過新臺幣50萬元須申報。新臺幣10萬元及人民幣2萬元是另有攜帶限制的額度；申報不等於准許超額攜帶。入境新臺幣超額部分退運，人民幣超額部分封存待離境攜出；黃金超額另須輸出入許可證。
procedures.timing_zh_hant: 入境：領取行李後、通過海關通道前。出境：航空公司報到後、安檢前。

procedures.name_en: Commercial goods in passenger baggage
procedures.name_zh: 旅客携带商业货物
procedures.agency: 财政部关务署
procedures.applicability_en: Goods brought for sale are outside the personal-use exemption and must be proactively declared through the red channel using normal import clearance in the company's name.
procedures.applicability_zh: 为销售携带的公司货物不属于自用范围，应主动走红线，以公司名义办理一般货物进口申报。
procedures.timing_en: At arrival customs.
